articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了时间反演对称性破缺、无倾斜 Weyl 半金属中，在动量空间 Berry 曲率和斯格明子诱导涌现磁场同时存在时的磁输运。基于包含 Berry 曲率修正与谷间散射的半经典 Boltzmann 方法，作者分析了纵向磁电导和面内霍尔电导。结果表明，谷间散射与实空间拓扑分别控制响应的不同几何特征，涌现磁场可作为独立拓扑调控参量并产生可测输运信号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在动量空间 Berry 曲率和斯格明子诱导涌现磁场 Bₑₘₑᵣ 同时存在的情况下，时间反演对称性破缺、无倾斜 Weyl 半金属中的磁输运。使用一种包含 Berry 曲率修正和谷间散射的半经典 Boltzmann 方法，我们分析了这一混合拓扑区域中的纵向磁电导率和面内霍尔电导率。在不存在 Bₑₘₑᵣ 时，增大谷间散射会驱动纵向磁电导率发生强烈的符号反转。有限的 Bₑₘₑᵣ 会引入磁场抛物线依赖关系的额外位移，从而导致弱符号反转区域，而不改变曲率。这些效应的共存自然产生强—弱符号反转区域，表明谷间散射和实空间拓扑控制响应的不同几何特征。涌现磁场还会诱导纵向电导和面内霍尔电导角度依赖关系中的不对称性。我们表明，当改变 Bₑₘₑᵣ 的方向时，仅由 Bₑₘₑᵣ 就可以产生有限的面内霍尔响应，从而提供实空间拓扑的输运标志。我们的结果确立了斯格明子诱导涌现磁场作为一种独立的拓扑调控参数，揭示了 Weyl 体系中实空间与动量空间 Berry 曲率相互作用的可测量后果。

articles.title: The Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou problem after 70 years: toward universal laws of thermalization in lattice systems in the thermodynamic limit
articles.title_zh: 70 年后的费米–帕斯塔–乌拉姆–钦沟问题：走向热力学极限下晶格体系热化的普适规律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.23347v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Fermi--Pasta--Ulam--Tsingou (FPUT) problem provides a paradigmatic framework for understanding thermalization in weakly nonlinear many-body Hamiltonian systems. This focused review summarizes major developments in near-integrable dynamics, wave resonances, and phonon kinetic theory, emphasizing recent results on thermalization-time scaling in nonlinear lattices. A coherent picture emerges in the thermodynamic limit based on the eigenmode properties of an appropriate integrable reference system. If the reference system has extended eigenmodes and the leading resonant or quasi-resonant processes form a sufficiently connected network, the thermalization time follows Tₑqpropto g⁻², where g measures the effective deviation from integrability. This scaling is found broadly in ordered and weakly disordered lattices and is robust to dimensionality, interaction potential, integrability-breaking mechanism, and multimode initial conditions. Identifying the correct integrable reference is essential; in some one-dimensional FPUT-type lattices with cubic interactions, the nearby Toda lattice, rather than the harmonic chain, provides the proper reference. If all reference eigenmodes are localized, spatial-overlap constraints progressively fragment low-order resonance networks as g decreases, and thermalization becomes controlled by higher-order processes. Numerical studies reveal successive regimes Tₑqpropto g⁻γ with γ=2,4,6, together with weak system-size dependence. Whether this hierarchy persists asymptotically and whether a finite thermalization threshold exists remain open questions. We also discuss finite-size effects, strongly nonintegrable dynamics, heat transport, localization, and higher-dimensional lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇聚焦综述总结了 FPUT 问题在近可积动力学、波共振和声子动理学理论方面的重要进展，尤其关注非线性晶格热化时间标度。作者指出，在热力学极限中，若适当可积参考体系具有扩展本征模且低阶共振网络足够连通，则热化时间通常遵循 Teq ∝ g⁻²。若参考本征模局域化，低阶共振网络会随偏离可积性减小而破碎，热化由更高阶过程控制，并可能出现多种幂律区间。
authors: Weicheng Fu, Zhen Wang, Wei Lin, Dahai He, Jiao Wang, Yong Zhang, Hong Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 费米–帕斯塔–乌拉姆–钦沟（FPUT）问题为理解弱非线性多体哈密顿体系中的热化提供了一个范式框架。这篇聚焦综述总结了近可积动力学、波共振和声子动理学理论方面的主要进展，重点强调非线性晶格中热化时间标度的最新结果。在热力学极限中，基于适当可积参考体系的本征模性质，呈现出一种连贯图像。如果参考体系具有扩展本征模，并且主导的共振或准共振过程形成了足够连通的网络，则热化时间遵循 Tₑqpropto g⁻²，其中 g 衡量相对于可积性的有效偏离。这一标度广泛见于有序和弱无序晶格，并且对维度、相互作用势、破坏可积性的机制以及多模初始条件都具有鲁棒性。识别正确的可积参考体系至关重要；在某些具有三次相互作用的一维 FPUT 型晶格中，邻近的 Toda 晶格而非谐链提供了适当的参考。如果所有参考本征模都是局域化的，则随着 g 减小，空间重叠约束会逐渐使低阶共振网络碎裂，热化转而由更高阶过程控制。数值研究揭示了连续的区间 Tₑqpropto g⁻γ，其中 γ=2、4、6，并伴随较弱的系统尺寸依赖。这一层级结构是否在渐近意义下持续存在，以及是否存在有限热化阈值，仍是开放问题。我们还讨论了有限尺寸效应、强不可积动力学、热输运、局域化和高维晶格。

articles.title: PASCHEN-1D: A one-dimensional fluid plasma solver with multi-mechanism surface emission and flexible external circuit coupling
articles.title_zh: PASCHEN-1D：具有多机制表面发射与灵活外部电路耦合的一维流体等离子体求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present PASCHEN-1D (Plasma Advanced Solver with Coupled High-fidelity Emission and external Network), a one-dimensional time-dependent fluid plasma solver developed for self-consistent simulation of gas discharges and plasma breakdown with coupled electrode surface emission and flexible external circuit networks. The code solves drift-diffusion continuity equations for electrons and ions together with Poisson's equation. It is dynamically coupled to lumped RLC circuits, which self-consistently treat plasma transport, plasma-surface interaction, dielectric effects, and circuit response within a single framework. The electrode emission module includes ion-induced secondary electron emission, Fowler-Nordheim and Murphy-Good field emission, Richardson-Dushman thermionic emission, and photoemission based on a general, exact quantum mechanical emission theory. A finite-volume formulation with Kurganov-Tadmor fluxes, explicit diffusion, and fourth-order Runge-Kutta time integration is employed to ensure stable transient (sometimes ultrafast) evolution across breakdown and glow regimes. The solver is validated against multiple benchmark cases, including nanosecond pulsed dielectric-barrier discharges, DC breakdown and glow transitions, and Paschen curve construction for argon and nitrogen, with results consistent with published studies. With high-fidelity emission physics and a flexible circuit-coupling framework, PASCHEN-1D provides a versatile and efficient tool for modeling breakdown and transient discharge phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍 PASCHEN-1D，一种用于自洽模拟气体放电和等离子体击穿的一维时变流体等离子体求解器。该代码耦合漂移–扩散连续性方程、Poisson 方程、电极表面多机制发射以及集总 RLC 外部电路。通过多个基准算例验证后，结果与已有研究一致，表明其可高效模拟击穿和瞬态放电现象。
authors: Asif Iqbal, Yves Heri, Bingqing Wang, Lan Jin, Md Arifuzzaman Faisal, Peng Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出 PASCHEN-1D（Plasma Advanced Solver with Coupled High-fidelity Emission and external Network），这是一种一维时间依赖流体等离子体求解器，用于对气体放电和等离子体击穿进行自洽模拟，并耦合电极表面发射和灵活的外部电路网络。该代码求解电子和离子的漂移–扩散连续性方程以及 Poisson 方程。它与集总 RLC 电路动态耦合，在单一框架内自洽处理等离子体输运、等离子体–表面相互作用、介电效应和电路响应。电极发射模块包括离子诱导二次电子发射、Fowler-Nordheim 和 Murphy-Good 场发射、Richardson-Dushman 热电子发射，以及基于一般、精确量子力学发射理论的光发射。采用带有 Kurganov-Tadmor 通量、显式扩散和四阶 Runge-Kutta 时间积分的有限体积格式，以确保跨越击穿和辉光区域的稳定瞬态（有时是超快）演化。该求解器通过多个基准案例得到验证，包括纳秒脉冲介质阻挡放电、直流击穿和辉光转变，以及氩和氮的 Paschen 曲线构建，其结果与已发表研究一致。凭借高保真发射物理和灵活的电路耦合框架，PASCHEN-1D 为建模击穿和瞬态放电现象提供了一种通用而高效的工具。

articles.title: Probing P,T-Symmetry Violation with Optically Trapped Asymmetric Top Molecules
articles.title_zh: 利用光学俘获不对称陀螺分子探测 P、T 对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Searches for P,T-violating electromagnetic moments are among the most sensitive probes of physics beyond the Standard Model. Extending beyond current limits will benefit from molecules with fully controllable orientation at low electric fields, long coherence times, and laser coolability---all offered by asymmetric top molecules (ATMs). Exploiting the intrinsic rotational K-doubling in ATMs and the associated long-lived (T₁ gtrsim 10 s) parity doublets afforded by C₂ᵥ symmetry and nuclear-spin statistics, these species combine large electric polarizability with long coherence times in modest laboratory fields. We study alkaline-earth(-like) monoamides, M--NH₂ (M = Ca, Sr, Ba, Yb, Ra), which possess favorable electronic structure for laser cooling. We perform ab initio calculations of fine and hyperfine constants, identifying the importance of relativistic effects in the spin-rotation tensor. An effective Hamiltonian then models the rotational and hyperfine structure of the vibronic ground state, quantifying electron electric dipole moment (EDM) sensitivities and identifying feasible measurement schemes. We compute the effect of external fields and identify engineered clock transitions that suppress sensitivity to external perturbations while retaining strong EDM sensitivity, and characterize the magic trapping conditions that null differential light shifts in an optical trap. Under these conditions we project a statistical electron-EDM sensitivity over an order of magnitude beyond current best experimental limits, with further gains available from increased molecule number and coherence time. Our results establish asymmetric top molecules as a tunable platform for sensitive symmetry-violation measurements with long coherence times.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出利用不对称陀螺分子进行 P、T 破缺电磁矩搜索，以突破当前电子 EDM 等精密测量限制。作者研究了碱土及类碱土单酰胺分子 M--NH₂，结合从头算和有效哈密顿量分析其精细、超精细、转动及外场性质。结果表明，经工程化的钟跃迁与魔术俘获条件可在保持强 EDM 灵敏度的同时抑制外界扰动，并有望实现超过当前最佳实验极限一个数量级以上的统计灵敏度。
authors: Yuxi Yang, Arian Jadbabaie, Lukáš Félix Pašteka, I. Agustín Aucar, Rob G. E. Timmermans, Nicholas R. Hutzler
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对 P、T 破缺电磁矩的搜索是探测标准模型之外物理的最灵敏手段之一。若要超越当前限制，将受益于在低电场下具有完全可控取向、长相干时间和可激光冷却性的分子——这些特性均由不对称陀螺分子（ATM）提供。利用 ATM 中内禀的转动 K 双重性，以及由 C₂ᵥ 对称性和核自旋统计赋予的相关长寿命（T₁ gtrsim 10 s）宇称双重态，这些物种在适中的实验室电场中结合了大的电极化率和长相干时间。我们研究碱土（类）单酰胺 M--NH₂（M = Ca、Sr、Ba、Yb、Ra），它们具有有利于激光冷却的电子结构。我们进行了精细和超精细常数的从头算，识别出相对论效应在自旋–转动张量中的重要性。随后，一个有效哈密顿量对振电子基态的转动和超精细结构进行建模，量化电子电偶极矩（EDM）灵敏度并识别可行的测量方案。我们计算外场效应，并识别出工程化钟跃迁，这些跃迁在保持强 EDM 灵敏度的同时抑制对外部扰动的敏感性；同时表征了在光学陷阱中使差分光移为零的魔术俘获条件。在这些条件下，我们预测统计电子 EDM 灵敏度将超过当前最佳实验限制一个数量级以上，并且可通过增加分子数和相干时间进一步提升。我们的结果确立了不对称陀螺分子作为一种可调平台，用于具有长相干时间的高灵敏对称性破缺测量。

articles.title: Performance of an HRPPD in Tesla-scale magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: HRPPD 在特斯拉量级磁场中的性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-Rate Picosecond Photodetectors (HRPPDs) are state-of-the-art microchannel-plate (MCP) photodetectors that offer excellent timing and spatial resolution, together with high single-photon detection efficiency. They are currently being considered for the ePIC experiment at the future Electron Ion Collider (EIC) at Brookhaven National Laboratory. A key requirement for the application of this technology is reliable operation in a strong magnetic field up to 1.5 T, with magnetic flux lines at an inclination of łe15ⁱ̧rc to the normal of the MCP surface. Magnetic field-induced distortions of the collected charge in MCP-based detectors can be compensated by tuning the operating parameters; however, the objective of this study is to quantify this performance in the case of the EIC-HRPPD, a particular MCP stack-up specialized for operation within ePIC. This photosensor employs a high quantum efficiency photocathode, 10~μm capillary pores, narrow transfer gaps, and a custom ceramic pixelated DC-coupled readout. This article explores the optimal operating parameters (mainly the voltages applied across the gaps and the MCPs) for single photon detection at various inclination angles in a uniform field up to 1.8 T. Ultimately, it was found that the gain and single photon detection efficiency of the HRRPD could be recovered over a range of polar inclination angles up to ±35ⁱ̧rc.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评估高倍率皮秒光探测器 HRPPD 在强磁场中的单光子探测性能，面向未来电子离子对撞机 ePIC 实验应用。研究考察了在最高 1.8 T 均匀磁场和不同倾角下，通过调节间隙和微通道板电压恢复增益与探测效率的最优运行参数。结果显示，在极角倾斜范围达 ±35° 时，HRPPD 的增益和单光子探测效率可得到恢复。
authors: B. Azmoun, Y. Ilieva, Y. Jin, J. Kim, A. Kiselev, B. S. Page, M. Popecki, M. L. Purschke, A. Tamis, V. Teotia, C. P. Wong, C. Woody
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高倍率皮秒光探测器（HRPPD）是最先进的微通道板（MCP）光探测器，兼具优异的时间分辨率和空间分辨率，以及高单光子探测效率。它们目前正被考虑用于布鲁克海文国家实验室未来电子离子对撞机（EIC）的 ePIC 实验。该技术应用的一项关键要求是在高达 1.5 T 的强磁场中可靠运行，并且磁通线相对于 MCP 表面法线的倾角为 łe15ⁱ̧rc。MCP 基探测器中由磁场诱导的收集电荷畸变可以通过调节运行参数来补偿；然而，本研究的目标是量化 EIC-HRPPD 情形下的这一性能，EIC-HRPPD 是一种针对 ePIC 内部运行而专门设计的 MCP 堆叠结构。该光传感器采用高量子效率光阴极、10~μm 毛细孔、窄传输间隙，以及定制陶瓷像素化直流耦合读出。本文探索了在最高 1.8 T 的均匀磁场中、不同倾角下用于单光子探测的最优运行参数，主要是施加在间隙和 MCP 上的电压。最终发现，在极角倾斜范围最高达 ±35ⁱ̧rc 时，HRRPD 的增益和单光子探测效率可以得到恢复。

articles.title: Nonadiabatic Molecular Dynamics on Real-time Excited-State Surfaces via Machine Learning Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 通过机器学习哈密顿量在实时激发态势能面上进行非绝热分子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating the coupled, nonequilibrium dynamics of electrons and nuclei is a central challenge in chemistry, physics, and materials science, governing phenomena from photocatalysis to quantum information. The primary bottleneck has been the lack of a general, accurate, and efficient method for modeling the complete excited-state landscape: the potential energy surfaces, forces, and non-adiabatic couplings for multiple electronic states. While machine learning has revolutionized ground-state simulations and shown promise for excited states in molecules, a unified framework that solves the complete multi-state problem for general condensed matter systems has remained elusive. Here we introduce on-the-fly N²AMD (Neural network NAMD), a machine learning framework that makes on-the-fly NAMD in solids a reality. By employing an equivariant neural network to predict the system Hamiltonian, the framework delivers excited-state energies, forces, and non-adiabatic coupling vectors at a fraction of the cost of ab initio calculations. Crucially, it allows simulations with hybrid functional accuracy, a level of approach previously inaccessible for NAMD. We showcase its capabilities with three topical examples: correcting order-of-magnitude errors in carrier dynamics predicted by conventional procedure in a MoS₂/WS₂ heterostructure, simulating previously inaccessible photoinduced ferroelectric switching, and capturing real-time polaron formation in TiO₂ at the hybrid-functional level. On-the-fly N²AMD moves beyond the limitations of equilibrium theory, establishing a new paradigm for the predictive, first-principles design of materials operating far from equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 on-the-fly N²AMD，一种通过等变神经网络预测体系哈密顿量的机器学习框架，用于在固体中实现实时非绝热分子动力学。该方法能够以远低于从头算的成本获得多电子态激发态能量、力和非绝热耦合矢量，并支持混合泛函精度。作者通过 MoS₂/WS₂ 异质结构载流子动力学、光诱导铁电翻转和 TiO₂ 中实时极化子形成展示了该方法的能力。
authors: Changwei Zhang, Yang Zhong, Zhi-Guo Tao, Yingzhou Li, Zhenggang Lan, Oleg V. Prezhdo, Xin-Gao Gong, Weibin Chu, Hongjun Xiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 模拟电子与原子核之间耦合的非平衡动力学，是化学、物理和材料科学中的核心挑战，它支配着从光催化到量子信息的诸多现象。主要瓶颈一直在于缺乏一种通用、准确且高效的方法来建模完整的激发态图景：多个电子态的势能面、力和非绝热耦合。尽管机器学习已经革新了基态模拟，并在分子激发态方面显示出前景，但一种能够解决一般凝聚态体系完整多态问题的统一框架仍难以实现。在这里，我们引入实时 N²AMD（神经网络 NAMD），这是一种机器学习框架，使固体中的实时 NAMD 成为现实。通过采用等变神经网络来预测体系哈密顿量，该框架能够以从头算成本的一小部分给出激发态能量、力和非绝热耦合矢量。关键的是，它允许以混合泛函精度进行模拟，而这一层级的方法此前对于 NAMD 是不可及的。我们用三个前沿示例展示其能力：修正传统流程在 MoS₂/WS₂ 异质结构中预测载流子动力学时产生的数量级错误，模拟此前无法实现的光诱导铁电翻转，以及在混合泛函层级捕捉 TiO₂ 中实时极化子形成。实时 N²AMD 超越了平衡理论的限制，为远离平衡运行材料的预测性第一性原理设计建立了一种新范式。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出了基于等变神经网络的 on-the-fly N²AMD 框架，可在固体中直接预测多激发态的哈密顿量、力和非绝热耦合，从而实现实时非绝热分子动力学。结果表明该方法能够以接近从头算精度处理激发态耦合动力学，适用于复杂凝聚态体系。
articles.focus_relation: 这与我们在非绝热分子动力学、机器学习哈密顿量、电子-声子/电子-核耦合以及载流子弛豫方面的方向高度一致。尤其对机器学习 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量、激发态动力学和热载流子过程的建模很有借鉴价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可重点关注其等变网络如何表征多态哈密顿量与非绝热耦合，并比较其与现有 ML Hamiltonian/NAMD 方案的差异。后续可考虑将类似框架推广到缺陷体系、二维半导体或钙钛矿中的激发态输运与非辐射复合。

articles.title: Skills for forecasting space weather
articles.title_zh: 空间天气预报的预报技巧
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coronal mass ejections (CMEs) from the Sun can have severe impacts on the Earth environment in the form of geomagnetic storms. These storms pose a risk to the global technological infrastructure, making the prediction of these events imperative. In this paper, we have broadened the statistical verification of the Bz4Cast tool, the first empirically-driven model to forecast solar wind magnetic vectors inside a CME prior to their Earth arrival. Twenty five CME events (between 2012 and 2016) have been tested with the Bz4Cast model, and the skills have been compared to the heuristic approach of NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC) G-scale for 3-day geomagnetic storm forecasts. For a broad range of scores, and within uncertainty, the Bz4Cast architecture provided the same skill as the experienced on-duty forecasters at SWPC. The most prominent difference is that the Bz4Cast architecture provides a slightly higher false alarm ratio than the SWPC 3-day forecast.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文扩展了对 Bz4Cast 工具的统计检验，该工具是首个在 CME 到达地球前预测其内部太阳风磁场矢量的经验驱动模型。研究使用 2012—2016 年间 25 个 CME 事件进行测试，并与 NOAA 空间天气预报中心 3 日地磁暴 G 级预报的启发式方法进行比较。结果显示，在多种评分和不确定性范围内，Bz4Cast 的预报技巧与 SWPC 值班预报员相当，但误报率略高。
authors: H. J. Austin, N. P. Savani
articles.abstract_zh_full: 来自太阳的日冕物质抛射（CME）可能以地磁暴的形式对地球环境产生严重影响。这些风暴会对全球技术基础设施构成风险，因此预测这些事件至关重要。在本文中，我们扩展了对 Bz4Cast 工具的统计验证；该工具是第一个经验驱动的模型，用于在 CME 到达地球之前预报其内部的太阳风磁场矢量。使用 Bz4Cast 模型测试了 25 个 CME 事件（发生在 2012 年至 2016 年之间），并将其预报技巧与 NOAA 空间天气预报中心（SWPC）用于 3 日地磁暴预报的 G 级启发式方法进行了比较。对于广泛的评分指标，并在不确定性范围内，Bz4Cast 架构提供了与 SWPC 经验丰富的值班预报员相同的预报技巧。最显著的差异是，Bz4Cast 架构给出的误报率略高于 SWPC 的 3 日预报。

articles.title: Finite basis physics-informed neural networks with hard constraints for viscous fluid flow in highly perforated domains
articles.title_zh: 用于高度穿孔区域中黏性流体流动的带硬约束有限基物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08114v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, viscous fluid flow governed by the Stokes equations in highly perforated domains is studied using physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). Perforated microstructures induce complex boundary conditions and fine-scale flow features that are difficult for standard neural networks to resolve. Conventional PINNs, even when combined with advanced training techniques, can suffer from a loss of accuracy and efficiency as the number of perforations increases. One important source of this difficulty is the soft enforcement of boundary conditions through penalty terms, which can lead to stiffness, gradient conflicts, and poor resolution of near-boundary flow structures. Hard constraints provide an alternative by encoding boundary conditions exactly into the network ansatz, but may introduce undesirable non-local effects due to the global nature of the approximation. To address these challenges, finite basis PINNs (FBPINNs), which are based on domain decomposition and localisation principles, are used together with hard boundary constraints that efficiently encode perforation-related boundary conditions. This approach helps mitigate spectral bias, improves overall accuracy, and exhibits convergence that is only weakly affected by the number of perforations, thereby providing an efficient and highly parallelisable neural network framework. The proposed approach is further supported with theoretical arguments, specifically focusing on the localisation and approximation properties of FBPINNs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了高度穿孔区域中由 Stokes 方程控制的黏性流体流动，并采用有限基物理信息神经网络结合硬边界约束进行求解。针对常规 PINN 在穿孔数量增加时因边界条件软约束导致的精度和效率问题，作者利用区域分解与局部化思想改善近边界流动结构的解析能力。该方法可缓解谱偏差，提高精度，并使收敛性仅弱受穿孔数量影响，形成一种高效且易并行的神经网络框架。
authors: Jeeeun Lee, Denis Korolev, Miro Duhovic, Seong Su Kim
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，使用物理信息神经网络（PINN）研究了高度穿孔区域中由 Stokes 方程控制的黏性流体流动。穿孔微结构会引入复杂的边界条件和细尺度流动特征，这些特征对于标准神经网络而言难以解析。传统 PINN 即使结合先进训练技术，也可能随着穿孔数量增加而出现精度和效率下降。这一困难的一个重要来源是通过惩罚项对边界条件进行软施加，这可能导致刚性、梯度冲突以及近边界流动结构解析不佳。硬约束通过将边界条件精确编码到网络试探解中提供了一种替代方案，但由于近似的全局性质，可能引入不希望出现的非局部效应。为应对这些挑战，本文将基于区域分解和局部化原则的有限基 PINN（FBPINN）与能够高效编码穿孔相关边界条件的硬边界约束结合使用。该方法有助于缓解谱偏差，提高整体精度，并表现出仅受穿孔数量弱影响的收敛性，从而提供了一种高效且高度可并行化的神经网络框架。所提出的方法还通过理论论证得到进一步支持，重点关注 FBPINN 的局部化和近似性质。

articles.title: Epsilon-Near-Zero Materials based Photonic Architectures for Absorption and Emission Control
articles.title_zh: 基于近零介电常数材料的用于吸收与发射控制的光子架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Engineering optical responses at surfaces, including reflection, absorption, transmission, and emission, is crucial for advanced photonic, energy, thermal-management, and optoelectronic applications. This thesis investigates epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) materials, particularly indium tin oxide (ITO) and titanium nitride (TiN), for controlling light-matter interactions through engineered optical coatings and nanostructures. It also explores the enhancement of optical absorption and emission in two-dimensional (2D) materials such as monolayer molybdenum disulphide (MoS2), whose atomic-scale thickness inherently limits light interaction. The research integrates theoretical analysis, finite-element simulations, nanofabrication, and experimental characterization to develop and validate ENZ-based optical platforms. An ITO-based multilayer coating is demonstrated to provide step-function-like reflectivity, with low reflectance in the visible-to-near-infrared range and high reflectance beyond a tunable cut-in wavelength, offering potential for spectrally selective energy management. Building on this, an ITO-based grating structure is developed to achieve broadband and angularly robust near-infrared absorption, demonstrating its potential for thermal-emission applications. TiN thin films are further demonstrated as an effective platform for enhancing the absorption and emission of monolayer MoS2 without complex nanostructuring. Complementary studies investigate substrate-induced strain and ion-irradiation-induced defects as approaches for tailoring the electronic and optical properties of MoS2. Overall, this work establishes ENZ materials based engineered surfaces as versatile platforms for spectral and light-matter interaction control, contributing to efficient, tunable, thermally stable, and scalable solutions for energy, thermal management, and 2D-material-based optoelectronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究近零介电常数（ENZ）材料，特别是 ITO 和 TiN，用于通过工程化光学涂层与纳米结构控制光-物质相互作用。工作展示了 ITO 多层涂层的光谱选择性反射、ITO 光栅的近红外宽带吸收以及 TiN 薄膜对单层 MoS2 吸收和发射的增强。总体而言，研究建立了基于 ENZ 材料的工程化表面平台，用于能量管理、热管理和二维材料光电子应用中的光谱与相互作用调控。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在表面上工程化调控光学响应，包括反射、吸收、透射和发射，对于先进光子学、能源、热管理和光电子应用至关重要。本论文研究近零介电常数（ENZ）材料，特别是氧化铟锡（ITO）和氮化钛（TiN），用于通过工程化光学涂层和纳米结构控制光-物质相互作用。它还探索了增强二维（2D）材料中光吸收和发射的方法，例如单层二硫化钼（MoS2），其原子尺度厚度本质上限制了光相互作用。该研究结合理论分析、有限元模拟、纳米制造和实验表征，以开发并验证基于 ENZ 的光学平台。展示了一种基于 ITO 的多层涂层，可提供类似阶跃函数的反射率，在可见光到近红外范围内具有低反射率，并在可调截止波长之后具有高反射率，为光谱选择性能量管理提供了潜在方案。在此基础上，开发了一种基于 ITO 的光栅结构，以实现宽带且角度稳健的近红外吸收，展示了其在热发射应用中的潜力。进一步证明 TiN 薄膜是在无需复杂纳米结构化的情况下增强单层 MoS2 吸收和发射的有效平台。互补研究考察了衬底诱导应变和离子辐照诱导缺陷作为调控 MoS2 电子和光学性质的方法。总体而言，本工作确立了基于 ENZ 材料的工程化表面作为光谱和光-物质相互作用控制的多功能平台，为能源、热管理和基于二维材料的光电子应用提供高效、可调、热稳定且可扩展的解决方案作出了贡献。

articles.title: Eikonal Regularisation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Three-Dimensional Level-Set Advection: Transferability of Two-Dimensional Design Principles
articles.title_zh: 三维水平集平流物理信息神经网络中的 Eikonal 正则化：二维设计原则的可迁移性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks applied to the level-set formulation of interface advection commonly augment the residual and initial-condition losses with an eikonal regulariser, penalising the deviation of |nablaφ| from unity. A previous two-dimensional study identified this weight as the dominant hyperparameter and found its optimum shifts by four orders of magnitude between rigid-body and deforming flows, but left open whether these principles transfer to three dimensions and whether single-seed results survive run-to-run variability. We answer both by repeating the weight selection across four 3D benchmarks (translating sphere, rotating sphere, slotted sphere, reversed vortex), sweeping six weights with three seeds at full training budget under a pre-registered selection rule. The ordering transfers: the selected weight tracks how far the exact solution departs from the signed-distance property, spanning four decades from 10⁻¹ where it holds exactly to 10⁻⁵ where the interface is stretched. Values transfer only benchmark by benchmark; two of four carry over unchanged and two do not, so inheritance must be verified. The multi-seed protocol reveals that at small weights the seed-to-seed standard deviation equals the error itself, and the regulariser reduces it by more than an order of magnitude, buying reproducibility as well as accuracy. We benchmark against a fifth-order WENO solver on identical grids and error measures; the classical scheme is more accurate on all four problems, by two orders of magnitude on smooth rigid advection, with a margin that narrows with geometric difficulty and is smaller in volume conservation than in the field norm. Finally, we show that the relative L₂ error cannot certify the preservation of thin features, and report a feature-restricted measure that can.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在三维水平集界面平流 PINN 中，Eikonal 正则化权重的二维设计原则是否可迁移，并考察多随机种子下的稳健性。作者在四个三维基准问题上扫描六种权重并使用三个种子，发现权重排序原则可迁移，但具体数值只能按基准问题验证继承。结果还显示正则化可显著降低种子间误差波动，提高可重复性；与五阶 WENO 方法相比，PINN 在所有问题上精度仍较低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 应用于界面平流水平集形式的物理信息神经网络通常会在残差损失和初始条件损失之外加入一个 eikonal 正则化项，用于惩罚 |nablaφ| 偏离 1 的程度。此前的一项二维研究确定该权重是主导超参数，并发现其最优值在刚体流和变形流之间相差四个数量级，但尚不清楚这些原则是否能迁移到三维，以及单一种子结果是否能经受运行间变异性的考验。我们通过在四个三维基准问题（平移球、旋转球、开槽球、反向涡）上重复权重选择来回答这两个问题，在预注册的选择规则下，以完整训练预算扫描六个权重并使用三个种子。排序关系可以迁移：所选择的权重跟踪精确解偏离有符号距离性质的程度，跨越四个数量级，从该性质严格成立时的 10⁻¹ 到界面被拉伸时的 10⁻⁵。数值只能逐基准问题迁移；四个中有两个保持不变，另外两个则不能，因此继承必须经过验证。多种子协议揭示，在小权重下，种子之间的标准差等于误差本身，而正则化项将其降低了一个数量级以上，从而不仅提高了精度，也提高了可重复性。我们在相同网格和误差度量上与五阶 WENO 求解器进行了基准比较；经典格式在所有四个问题上都更准确，在光滑刚体平流中高出两个数量级，并且随着几何难度增加差距缩小，在体积守恒方面的差距小于场范数方面的差距。最后，我们表明相对 L₂ 误差无法证明细薄特征的保持，并报告了一种受限于特征的度量。

articles.title: Fundamental limits of hot-carrier and photothermal plasmonic solar chemistry
articles.title_zh: 热载流子与光热等离激元太阳化学的基本极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasmonic catalysts convert sunlight through direct metal--adsorbate excitation, nonequilibrium hot carriers and photothermal heating, yet these channels lack a common efficiency limit analogous to the Shockley-Queisser (SQ) limit. Here, we formulate a channel-resolved detailed-balance theory for plasmonic solar chemistry. The theory enforces exclusive partition of absorbed power, microscopic reversibility, non-negative entropy production, electromagnetic passivity and causality, and one physical nanostructure shared by all wavelengths and operating states. A reduced tightly coupled cycle obeys a chemical diode law with closed-form stall and maximum-power free energies. It recovers a 33.68% single-threshold radiative limit and the 30.58% ideal single-junction water-splitting limit at a 1.23-eV chemical load, whereas a Fowler hot-carrier kernel lowers the limit to 8.53%. Finite one-structure benchmarks show that independent wavelength optimization overestimates shared-geometry performance by 6.6-33.8%, while cross-frequency correlations tighten semidefinite upper bounds by 21-56%. An exact multi-electron network yields a universal arrival-storage criterion and the low-flux scaling Jₙsim gⁿτⁿ⁻¹. A source-conditioned gold/p-type gallium nitride case study and a bias- and separation-complete ledger then distinguish enhanced product formation from net solar-energy conversion. The resulting framework provides a thermodynamically closed benchmark for hot-carrier and photothermal plasmonic chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了面向等离激元太阳化学的分通道细致平衡理论，为直接金属-吸附物激发、非平衡热载流子和光热加热等路径建立统一的效率基准。理论纳入吸收功率互斥分配、微观可逆性、非负熵产生、电磁无源性与因果性，以及所有波长和工作状态共享同一物理纳米结构等约束。结果给出了若干闭式极限和实际结构基准，指出独立波长优化会高估共享几何性能，并提供了区分增强产物生成与净太阳能转化的热力学闭合框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 等离激元催化剂通过直接金属—吸附物激发、非平衡热载流子和光热加热来转化太阳光，然而这些通道缺乏类似 Shockley-Queisser（SQ）极限的共同效率极限。在这里，我们为等离激元太阳化学构建了一种分通道的细致平衡理论。该理论强制执行吸收功率的互斥分配、微观可逆性、非负熵产生、电磁无源性和因果性，以及由所有波长和运行状态共享的一个物理纳米结构。一个简化的紧耦合循环服从化学二极管定律，并具有闭式的停滞自由能和最大功率自由能。它恢复了 33.68% 的单阈值辐射极限，以及在 1.23 eV 化学负载下 30.58% 的理想单结水分解极限，而 Fowler 热载流子核将该极限降低到 8.53%。有限单结构基准表明，独立波长优化会将共享几何性能高估 6.6% 至 33.8%，而跨频率相关性使半定上界收紧 21% 至 56%。一个精确的多电子网络给出了普适的到达-存储判据以及低通量标度 Jₙsim gⁿτⁿ⁻¹。随后，一个源条件化的金/p 型氮化镓案例研究以及一个包含偏置和分离的完整账本区分了增强产物形成与净太阳能转换。由此形成的框架为热载流子和光热等离激元化学提供了一个热力学闭合的基准。

articles.title: Data-Driven Surrogate Modeling for Micromixing of Non-Newtonian Fluids in Sinusoidal Converging-Diverging Microchannels
articles.title_zh: 正弦收缩-扩张微通道中非牛顿流体微混合的数据驱动代理建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Micromixing of non-Newtonian fluids remains challenging because laminar flow at microscales restricts transverse transport primarily to molecular diffusion. In this study, we investigate the transport mechanisms governing passive micromixing of a Carreau--Yasuda fluid in two-dimensional sinusoidal converging--diverging microchannels and develop a surrogate-assisted framework for their multi-objective design. We perform high-fidelity finite-volume simulations by systematically varying the wall-amplitude ratio, phase offset, and wave count under creeping-flow conditions. The results show that successive contraction--expansion units enhance mixing through the combined effects of interface stretching, elevated shear rates, and shear-thinning-induced viscosity reduction. These mechanisms improve scalar transport but simultaneously increase pressure drop, creating an inherent trade-off between mixing performance and hydraulic resistance. To efficiently explore the multidimensional design space, we construct surrogate models from high-fidelity numerical simulations and identify Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) as the most accurate predictor of both the mixing index and pressure drop. Coupling the validated GPR surrogate with Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) accurately reproduces the Pareto front obtained from the high-fidelity simulations and identifies optimal microchannel geometries that balance mixing enhancement against pressure loss. The proposed machine learning framework provides a fast, accurate, and physically consistent strategy for the multi-objective design of passive micromixers for non-Newtonian fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维正弦收缩-扩张微通道中 Carreau-Yasuda 非牛顿流体的被动微混合机制，并构建代理辅助的多目标设计框架。高保真有限体积模拟显示，连续收缩-扩张单元通过界面拉伸、较高剪切率和剪切变稀导致的黏度降低来增强混合，但同时增加压降。作者发现高斯过程回归能准确预测混合指数和压降，并与 NSGA-II 结合有效重建 Pareto 前沿，识别兼顾混合增强和压力损失的优化几何。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非牛顿流体的微混合仍然具有挑战性，因为微尺度下的层流将横向输运主要限制为分子扩散。在本研究中，我们考察了二维正弦收缩—扩张微通道中支配 Carreau-Yasuda 流体被动微混合的输运机制，并为其多目标设计开发了代理辅助框架。我们在蠕动流条件下，通过系统改变壁面振幅比、相位偏移和波数，进行了高保真有限体积模拟。结果表明，连续的收缩—扩张单元通过界面拉伸、升高的剪切率以及剪切变稀诱导的黏度降低的共同作用来增强混合。这些机制改善了标量输运，但同时增加了压降，从而在混合性能和水力阻力之间形成内在权衡。为高效探索多维设计空间，我们基于高保真数值模拟构建了代理模型，并确定高斯过程回归（GPR）是混合指数和压降两者最准确的预测器。将经过验证的 GPR 代理模型与非支配排序遗传算法 II（NSGA-II）耦合，可以准确再现由高保真模拟获得的 Pareto 前沿，并识别在混合增强与压力损失之间取得平衡的最优微通道几何形状。所提出的机器学习框架为非牛顿流体被动微混合器的多目标设计提供了一种快速、准确且物理一致的策略。

articles.title: Transitional evolution of the wave dispersion relation during helicon discharge ignition: an analytical theory from vacuum to steady operation
articles.title_zh: 螺旋波放电点火期间波色散关系的过渡演化：从真空到稳态运行的解析理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dispersion relations of the helicon and Trivelpiece--Gould (TG) waves in a steady, fully developed magnetised plasma column are well established, but the discharge does not begin in that state. During ignition the electron density rises through five to seven orders of magnitude and the electron--neutral collision frequency falls by two to three, so the dispersion relation is itself a time-dependent object whose very existence must be justified. This paper develops a closed analytical theory of that transition for a cylindrical column in a uniform axial field, using a cold, collisional, two-species description that remains regular in the vacuum limit. Three structural results emerge. First, the vacuum limit is a degenerate double root of the quartic governing the perpendicular wavenumber; the helicon and TG branches are not independent modes that appear at some threshold but the two lobes of a single vacuum root, split by the gyrotropic and anisotropic parts of the dielectric tensor. The leading-order contribution to the discriminant cancels identically, so the branches separate linearly in density rather than with the square-root behaviour generic to a perturbed repeated root; the separation is correspondingly suppressed, and the helicon root remains pinned at its vacuum value until the electron density reaches about 10¹⁵ m⁻³ while the TG root departs immediately.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个闭合解析理论，用于描述圆柱形均匀轴向磁场等离子体柱中螺旋波放电点火期间色散关系从真空到稳态运行的过渡。研究采用在真空极限下保持正则的冷、碰撞、双组分模型，指出真空极限是控制垂直波数的四次方程的退化双根。结果表明，螺旋波和 Trivelpiece-Gould 波并非在某阈值出现的独立模式，而是同一真空根在回旋与各向异性介电张量作用下分裂出的两个分支，且分支分离随密度线性发生并受到抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稳态、充分发展磁化等离子体柱中螺旋波和 Trivelpiece-Gould（TG）波的色散关系已经得到充分确立，但放电并不是从这种状态开始的。在点火期间，电子密度上升五到七个数量级，而电子—中性粒子碰撞频率下降两到三个数量级，因此色散关系本身就是一个随时间变化的对象，其存在性本身也必须得到论证。本文针对均匀轴向磁场中的圆柱形等离子体柱，使用在真空极限下保持正则的冷、碰撞、双组分描述，发展了该过渡过程的闭合解析理论。由此得到三个结构性结果。首先，真空极限是控制垂直波数的四次方程的一个退化双根；螺旋波和 TG 分支并不是在某个阈值出现的相互独立模式，而是单一真空根的两个瓣，它们由介电张量的回旋和各向异性部分分裂而来。判别式的主导阶贡献完全相消，因此分支随密度线性分离，而不是表现出受扰重复根通常具有的平方根行为；相应地，分离受到抑制，并且螺旋波根在电子密度达到约 10¹⁵ m⁻³ 之前一直钉扎在其真空值，而 TG 根则立即偏离。

articles.title: Analytical Nuclear Gradients and Hessians on Quantum Hardware via Orbital-Optimized VQE with Error Mitigation
articles.title_zh: 通过带误差缓解的轨道优化 VQE 在量子硬件上实现解析核梯度与 Hessian
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08758v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nuclear gradients and Hessians are fundamental quantities in computational chemistry, essential for a wide range of applications including geometry optimization, vibrational spectroscopy, and molecular property calculations. In this work, we present their analytical implementation on quantum hardware. The methodology is formulated within an active-space framework combining orbital optimization and linear-response theory. On the quantum-computing side, the approach employs the tiled unitary product state (tUPS) ansatz to directly evaluate the tensor elements required for solving the response equations. Moreover, the expectation values are corrected using an adapted confusion-matrix error-mitigation scheme in combination with post-selection criteria. The resulting workflow is assessed on molecular hydrogen and on water through the calculation of potential energy surfaces, nuclear gradients, Hessians, and vibrational frequencies, enabling the evaluation of both its capabilities and current limitations. The results demonstrate good performance for the hydrogen molecule, whereas the water molecule provides a more demanding test of quantum-hardware resources and highlights the trade-offs associated with error-mitigation strategies. The quantified analysis of the results identify the main sources of errors, suggesting improvement directions for more accurate quantum computer applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在量子硬件上实现了计算化学中关键的解析核梯度与 Hessian，方法结合活性空间、轨道优化和线性响应理论。量子计算部分采用 tUPS Ansatz 直接评估响应方程所需张量，并结合混淆矩阵误差缓解与后选择修正期望值。氢分子表现良好，而水分子测试揭示了当前硬件资源与误差缓解策略的权衡及主要误差来源。
authors: Renato Olarte Hernandez, Karl Michael Ziems, Erik Kjellgren, Jacob Kongsted, Sonia Coriani, Stephan P. A. Sauer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 核梯度和 Hessian 是计算化学中的基本量，对于几何优化、振动光谱和分子性质计算等广泛应用至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了它们在量子硬件上的解析实现。该方法在活性空间框架内表述，结合了轨道优化和线性响应理论。在量子计算方面，该方法采用平铺酉乘积态（tUPS）Ansatz，以直接评估求解响应方程所需的张量元素。此外，期望值通过一种改造的混淆矩阵误差缓解方案并结合后选择准则进行校正。由此得到的工作流程通过计算氢分子和水分子的势能面、核梯度、Hessian 和振动频率来评估，从而能够评价其能力和当前局限性。结果表明，该方法对氢分子表现良好，而水分子则对量子硬件资源提出了更高要求，并突显了与误差缓解策略相关的权衡。对结果的定量分析识别出主要误差来源，为更精确的量子计算机应用提出了改进方向。

articles.title: Self-consistent double-hybrid density functional theory via one-body second-order Møller-Plesset perturbation theory and projection-based embedding
articles.title_zh: 通过单体二阶 Møller-Plesset 微扰理论与基于投影的嵌入实现自洽双杂化密度泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the development of self-consistent one-body double-hybrid (OBDH) density functional theory (DFT). In this approach, the one-body second-order Møller-Plesset (OBMP2) perturbation potential is embedded directly in the generalized Kohn-Sham framework, allowing orbitals to be optimized in the presence of MP2-level dynamic correlation. Unlike existing orbital-optimized double hybrids, OBDH requires neither the optimized effective potential nor perturbative orbital relaxation corrections. The energy functional combines a semilocal exchange-correlation functional, exact exchange, and OBMP2 correlation, from which the effective Hamiltonian and self-consistent-field equations are systematically derived. To reduce computational cost, projector-based embedding with concentric localization truncation is applied to the OBMP2 component, termed sub-OBDH. OBDH and sub-OBDH are benchmarked on diatomic potential energy curves, self-interaction errors, dihedral torsions of organic molecules, and interaction energies in non-covalent charged systems. Across all systems, OBDH consistently outperforms standard DFT, demonstrating its potential for accurate and practical electronic structure calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了自洽单体双杂化密度泛函理论，将 OBMP2 微扰势直接嵌入广义 Kohn-Sham 框架，使轨道在 MP2 级动态相关影响下优化。该方法无需优化有效势或微扰轨道弛豫修正，并通过基于投影的嵌入降低 OBMP2 部分成本。基准测试显示，OBDH 及其子系统版本在多类体系中优于标准 DFT，具有实用电子结构计算潜力。
authors: Huy Gia Bui, Lan Nguyen Tran
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了自洽单体双杂化（OBDH）密度泛函理论（DFT）的发展。在该方法中，单体二阶 Møller-Plesset（OBMP2）微扰势被直接嵌入广义 Kohn-Sham 框架，使得轨道能够在 MP2 级动态相关存在的情况下得到优化。不同于现有的轨道优化双杂化方法，OBDH 既不需要优化有效势，也不需要微扰轨道弛豫修正。该能量泛函结合了半局域交换-相关泛函、精确交换和 OBMP2 相关，并由此系统地推导出有效哈密顿量和自洽场方程。为降低计算成本，对 OBMP2 组分应用了带同心局域化截断的基于投影的嵌入，称为 sub-OBDH。我们在双原子分子势能曲线、自相互作用误差、有机分子二面角扭转以及非共价带电体系相互作用能上对 OBDH 和 sub-OBDH 进行了基准测试。在所有体系中，OBDH 始终优于标准 DFT，显示出其用于准确且实用电子结构计算的潜力。

articles.title: Giant Rotational Meta-Doppler from Genetically Designed Superscatterers
articles.title_zh: 来自遗传设计超散射体的巨型旋转元多普勒效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The motion of a rigid body interacting with a wave leaves spectral signatures, with the Doppler shift as the dominant contribution. Since any motion can be decomposed into translational and rotational components, rotational Doppler provides additional information about the object's dynamics. In the electromagnetic domain, rotating objects generally produce rotational Doppler, or micro-Doppler, signals determined by the symmetry and spatial structure of the scattering process. For objects that are subwavelength or comparable in size to the wavelength, the response is typically dominated by the lowest dipolar scattering channel, so the leading spectral component commonly appears at twice the angular frequency. Here, we introduce the concept of artificially engineered rotational micro-Doppler by designing a compact, strongly scattering structure that operates through a high-order multipolar cascade of resonances, thereby producing a giant enhancement. Magneto-electric arrays composed of strongly coupled electric and magnetic resonators are optimized in the GHz range using a covariance matrix adaptation genetic algorithm to maximize the micro-Doppler frequency. Unlike conventional higher-order multipole designs used in superscatterers for a specific angle of incidence and polarization, our approach jointly optimizes excitation and scattering under radar-relevant conditions for a rotating blade. The resulting arrays exhibit a giant rotational meta-micro-Doppler response, exceeding the dipolar limit by two orders of magnitude and mapping rotations of tens of hertz into the kilohertz range. Beyond its fundamental significance, this mapping has practical value because it shifts rotor micro-Doppler signatures well above slow-moving radar clutter, thereby improving the detectability of slow motion.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出人工工程化旋转微多普勒的概念，通过紧凑强散射结构中的高阶多极共振级联实现巨大增强。研究利用协方差矩阵自适应遗传算法优化 GHz 范围内的磁电阵列，以最大化旋转叶片在雷达相关条件下的微多普勒频率。所得结构将数十赫兹旋转映射到千赫兹范围，显著提高慢速旋转目标在雷达杂波中的可探测性。
authors: Dmytro Vovchuk, Sergey Geyman, Konstantin Grotov, Dmitry Dobrykh, Andrey Machnev, Anna Mikhailovskaya, Susanna Rozental, Anton Kharchevskii, Mikhail Tsukerman, Vjaceslavs Bobrovs, Aviel Glam, Alexander Gumennik, Pavel Ginzburg
articles.abstract_zh_full: 与波相互作用的刚体运动会留下光谱特征，其中多普勒频移是主导贡献。由于任何运动都可分解为平移分量和旋转分量，旋转多普勒能够提供关于物体动力学的额外信息。在电磁领域，旋转物体通常会产生由散射过程的对称性和空间结构决定的旋转多普勒或微多普勒信号。对于亚波长或尺寸与波长相当的物体，响应通常由最低阶偶极散射通道主导，因此主要光谱分量通常出现在角频率的两倍处。在这里，我们提出人工工程化旋转微多普勒的概念，即设计一种紧凑的强散射结构，使其通过高阶多极共振级联运行，从而产生巨大增强。由强耦合电谐振器和磁谐振器组成的磁电阵列在 GHz 范围内利用协方差矩阵自适应遗传算法进行优化，以最大化微多普勒频率。不同于传统超散射体中针对特定入射角和偏振的高阶多极设计，我们的方法在旋转叶片的雷达相关条件下联合优化激发与散射。所得阵列表现出巨型旋转元微多普勒响应，超过偶极极限两个数量级，并将数十赫兹的旋转映射到千赫兹范围。除其基础意义之外，这种映射还具有实际价值，因为它将转子的微多普勒特征移至慢速运动雷达杂波之上，从而提高慢速运动的可探测性。

articles.title: Coordinate-Residual Physics-Driven Neural Network for Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering
articles.title_zh: 用于电磁逆散射的坐标-残差物理驱动神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electromagnetic inverse scattering is a nonlinear and ill-posed problem, where accurate reconstruction is challenging due to measurement limitations, noise, and high computational costs, especially for 3-D imaging. Although physics-driven neural networks (PDNNs) reduce the dependence on labeled training data, existing accelerated PDNN frameworks often rely on preliminary reconstruction-based region selection, which may introduce instability when the selected region is inaccurate. In this paper, a coordinate-residual physics-driven neural network (CRPDNN) is proposed for 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering. The proposed solver directly reconstructs the unknown contrast distribution using normalized spatial coordinates and a residual convolutional network, without requiring a preliminary reconstruction. For the reported noise-free 3-D synthetic cases, CRPDNN achieves an average relative error of 2.10%, compared with 7.97% for CSI and 3.99% for L₂/₃-FBE-WCIE, while providing approximately 5.5- and 12.1-fold speedups over the two baselines, respectively. Supplementary 2-D comparisons further confirm its stability and computational efficiency relative to existing PDNN frameworks. CRPDNN also maintains reliable reconstruction performance under noisy measurements, and the 3-D Fresnel experiments further indicate its potential for practical imaging applications. The related code is available at https://github.com/Physics-driven-methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出用于三维电磁逆散射的坐标-残差物理驱动神经网络 CRPDNN，可直接由归一化空间坐标和残差卷积网络重建未知对比度分布，无需预重建选区。无噪声三维合成算例中，该方法相对误差低于 CSI 和 L₂/₃-FBE-WCIE，并显著加速。二维对比、含噪测量和三维 Fresnel 实验进一步表明其稳定性、效率和实际成像潜力。
authors: Yutong Du, Zicheng Liu, Bo Qi, Yali Zong, Peixian Han
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电磁逆散射是一个非线性且病态的问题，其中由于测量限制、噪声和高计算成本，特别是在三维成像中，精确重建具有挑战性。尽管物理驱动神经网络（PDNN）降低了对带标签训练数据的依赖，但现有加速 PDNN 框架通常依赖基于初步重建的区域选择，当所选区域不准确时可能引入不稳定性。本文提出了一种用于三维电磁逆散射的坐标-残差物理驱动神经网络（CRPDNN）。所提出的求解器利用归一化空间坐标和残差卷积网络直接重建未知对比度分布，而不需要初步重建。对于报告的无噪声三维合成算例，CRPDNN 实现了 2.10% 的平均相对误差，而 CSI 为 7.97%，L₂/₃-FBE-WCIE 为 3.99%，同时相对于这两个基线分别提供约 5.5 倍和 12.1 倍的加速。补充的二维比较进一步证实了其相对于现有 PDNN 框架的稳定性和计算效率。CRPDNN 在含噪测量下也保持可靠的重建性能，三维 Fresnel 实验进一步表明了其用于实际成像应用的潜力。相关代码可在作者提供的代码仓库获取。

articles.title: The Tilting Mode: A New Degree of Freedom for Magneto-Mechanical Resonator Sensors
articles.title_zh: 倾斜模式：磁机械谐振器传感器的新自由度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magneto-mechanical resonators (MMRs) are an emerging class of passive, wireless sensors. Their torsional oscillation mode has recently been established for sensing and tracking applications. In this work, we report the identification and characterization of a second mechanical mode, the tilting mode, that provides sensitivity along an axis inaccessible to the torsional mode, opening up a new degree of freedom for tracking and sensing with a single MMR sensor. We derive an analytical model predicting the tilting frequency as a function of the geometric and magnetic parameters of the resonator, compare the tilting mode frequency to that of the torsional mode, and obtain a characteristic frequency ratio between the torsional and the tilting mode in the small angle approximation. Experimental characterization using three-axis excitation and detection confirms the mode's existence and its directional selectivity. Notably, the three-axis frequency response shows no observable cross-coupling between the torsional and the tilting mode. We further show that the tilting mode frequency follows the predicted dependence on magnet distance, confirming the analytical model and the mode's applicability for sensing, analogous to that of the torsional mode.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文识别并表征了磁机械谐振器中的第二种机械模式——倾斜模式，它提供了扭转模式无法访问方向上的灵敏度。作者建立了解析模型，预测倾斜频率随几何和磁参数变化，并给出小角近似下两种模式的特征频率比。三轴实验验证了该模式的存在、方向选择性以及与扭转模式之间无可观测交叉耦合，支持其传感应用。
authors: Nora Timm, Florian Hartwig, Jonas Faltinath, Sarah Reiss, Pascal Stagge, Tobias Knopp
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁机械谐振器（MMR）是一类新兴的无源无线传感器。其扭转振荡模式最近已被确立用于传感和跟踪应用。在这项工作中，我们报告了第二种机械模式——倾斜模式——的识别和表征，该模式沿扭转模式无法访问的轴提供灵敏度，从而为利用单个 MMR 传感器进行跟踪和传感开辟了新的自由度。我们推导了一个解析模型，用于预测倾斜频率作为谐振器几何参数和磁参数函数的变化，将倾斜模式频率与扭转模式频率进行比较，并在小角近似下得到扭转模式与倾斜模式之间的特征频率比。使用三轴激励和探测进行的实验表征证实了该模式的存在及其方向选择性。值得注意的是，三轴频率响应显示扭转模式与倾斜模式之间没有可观测的交叉耦合。我们进一步表明，倾斜模式频率遵循所预测的对磁体距离的依赖关系，从而证实了解析模型以及该模式类似于扭转模式的传感适用性。

articles.title: Resonant photoionization dynamics during optical trapping of lithium atoms
articles.title_zh: 锂原子光学俘获过程中的共振光电离动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09549v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photoionization induced by trapping and auxiliary laser fields is an inherent feature of many laser-cooling and optical trapping experiments, yet its microscopic dynamics are rarely investigated directly. In this work, we employ a reaction microscope implementing an event-by-event photoionization time retrieval technique to extend momentum-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy to continuous-wave laser--atom interactions. We investigate low-intensity multicolor photoionization of laser-cooled lithium atoms confined in an all-optical trap. Complete three-dimensional electron momentum distributions and kinetic-energy spectra recorded for different laser wavelengths and polarization configurations identify resonant excitation of the 5p and 5f states and reveal an additional ionization channel following spontaneous decay from the 5f to the 4d state. A pronounced polarization dependence of the photoionization yield is explained by magnetic-sublevel selection rules and the coherent interference of different virtual excitation pathways. These results demonstrate that reaction microscopy combined with event-by-event time reconstruction provides a powerful approach for investigating microscopic electronic dynamics in laser-cooled atomic systems and offers new insight into photoionization processes occurring during optical trapping.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用反应显微镜和逐事件光电离时间重建技术，将动量分辨光电子能谱扩展到连续波激光-原子相互作用。研究了全光阱中激光冷却锂原子的低强度多色光电离，识别出 5p 和 5f 态共振激发以及 5f 自发衰变至 4d 后的额外电离通道。光电离产额的强偏振依赖被归因于磁子能级选择规则和不同虚激发路径的相干干涉。
authors: K. Foster, S. Majumdar, D. Fischer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由俘获激光场和辅助激光场诱导的光电离是许多激光冷却和光学俘获实验的固有特征，但其微观动力学很少被直接研究。在这项工作中，我们采用一种反应显微镜，该显微镜实现了逐事件光电离时间反演技术，从而将动量分辨光电子能谱扩展到连续波激光-原子相互作用。我们研究了束缚在全光学阱中的激光冷却锂原子的低强度多色光电离。针对不同激光波长和偏振构型记录的完整三维电子动量分布和动能谱识别出 5p 和 5f 态的共振激发，并揭示了一个由 5f 态自发衰变到 4d 态之后产生的额外电离通道。光电离产额表现出的显著偏振依赖性可由磁子能级选择规则以及不同虚激发路径的相干干涉来解释。这些结果表明，反应显微术结合逐事件时间重建为研究激光冷却原子体系中的微观电子动力学提供了一种强有力的方法，并为光学俘获过程中发生的光电离过程提供了新的认识。

articles.title: Decoding Transient X-ray Absorption Spectra of Acetylacetone With Multireference Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Theory
articles.title_zh: 用多参考代数图解构造理论解码乙酰丙酮的瞬态 X 射线吸收光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-resolved X-ray absorption spectroscopy (TR-XAS) offers an element- and site-specific probe of coupled electronic and nuclear dynamics, but its interpretation requires methods that can treat multiconfigurational excited states across nonequilibrium nuclear ensembles. Here, we report time-resolved simulations of the acetylacetone (AcAc) transient X-ray absorption spectra by combining surface-hopping dynamics from complete active space second-order perturbation theory with multireference algebraic diagrammatic construction (MR-ADC). The simulated 20-200 fs spectra show a good agreement with experimental measurements and reveal that the TR-XAS response is governed by continuously evolving distributions of molecular geometries on the singlet potential energy surfaces (S2 and S1). In particular, absorption at 279.5-281.5 eV is enhanced for transient, nearly symmetric proton-sharing configurations, whereas the 284-286 eV profile reflects geometry-dependent C1s excitations modulated by proton transfer, bond alternation, and ring opening. For the long-time T₁ spectrum (7-10 ps), the principal features near 281.4 and 283.8 eV are assigned to central C 1s excitations into low-lying triplet pi-orbitals. Together, our simulations provide a more complete mechanistic picture of AcAc photorelaxation by directly linking ultrafast carbon K-edge signals to proton transfer, skeletal reorganization, internal conversion, and triplet formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合 CASPT2 表面跳跃动力学与多参考 ADC 方法，模拟乙酰丙酮的时间分辨瞬态 X 射线吸收谱。20–200 fs 模拟谱与实验吻合良好，并表明响应由 S₂ 和 S₁ 单重态势能面上持续演化的分子几何分布控制。研究将碳 K 边超快信号与质子转移、骨架重组、内转换和三重态形成直接关联起来。
authors: Bennett W. Clark, Donna H. Odhiambo, Haden Dickerson, Alexander Yu. Sokolov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 时间分辨 X 射线吸收光谱（TR-XAS）提供了一种元素和位点特异性的探针，用于研究耦合的电子和核运动动力学，但其解释需要能够处理非平衡核构型集合中多组态激发态的方法。在这里，我们报告了乙酰丙酮（AcAc）瞬态 X 射线吸收光谱的时间分辨模拟，该模拟结合了来自完全活性空间二阶微扰理论的表面跳跃动力学与多参考代数图解构造（MR-ADC）方法。模拟的 20–200 fs 光谱与实验测量结果吻合良好，并揭示 TR-XAS 响应受单重态势能面（S2 和 S1）上持续演化的分子几何分布所支配。特别是，对于瞬态、近似对称的质子共享构型，279.5–281.5 eV 处的吸收得到增强，而 284–286 eV 的轮廓反映了受质子转移、键交替和开环调制的几何依赖性 C1s 激发。对于长时间 T₁ 光谱（7–10 ps），281.4 和 283.8 eV 附近的主要特征被归属于中心碳 1s 到低能三重态 π 轨道的激发。总体而言，我们的模拟通过将超快碳 K 边信号与质子转移、骨架重组、内转换和三重态形成直接联系起来，为 AcAc 光弛豫提供了更完整的机制图景。

articles.title: Full-Wave Harmonic Balance Framework for Dispersive Time-Varying Photonic Structures
articles.title_zh: 用于色散时变光子结构的全波谐波平衡框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-varying photonic structures redistribute electromagnetic energy among Floquet harmonics, enabling frequency conversion, nonreciprocity, parametric gain, and dynamic wavefront control. Accurate modeling of realistic platforms remains challenging when temporal modulation occurs in strongly dispersive materials, because each harmonic experiences a distinct material response while remaining coupled to all others through the modulation. This work introduces a full-wave harmonic-balance framework for dispersive time-varying photonic structures. The formulation solves the steady-state Floquet response in the frequency domain by representing modulated components as induced secondary sources: volumetric polarization densities for bulk media and surface current densities for conductive sheets. Material dispersion and radiation operators are evaluated at each harmonic frequency, whereas temporal modulation enters as off-diagonal convolutional coupling in Floquet space. The framework is validated for a parametrically pumped rolled graphene cylinder, where numerical results agree with an analytical Floquet scattering solution and resolve harmonic-specific scattering, absorption, and near fields. It is further applied to an ITO-based epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) space-time metasurface, enabling shape optimization of a reflective device that converts an optical input into sidebands and redirects them into selected spatial diffraction orders. The approach establishes a general platform for modeling and designing dispersive active photonic structures with harmonic-resolved field, power, absorption, and diffraction observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于色散时变光子结构的全波谐波平衡频域框架，可处理不同 Floquet 谐波在色散材料中具有不同响应且彼此耦合的问题。该方法将调制组分表示为体极化密度或表面电流密度等诱导次级源，并在各谐波频率评估材料色散和辐射算符。框架经泵浦卷曲石墨烯圆柱验证，并用于 ITO ENZ 时空超表面优化，支持谐波分辨的场、功率、吸收和衍射设计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 时变光子结构在 Floquet 谐波之间重新分配电磁能量，从而实现频率转换、非互易性、参量增益和动态波前控制。当时间调制发生在强色散材料中时，对现实平台的精确建模仍然具有挑战性，因为每个谐波都会经历不同的材料响应，同时又通过调制与所有其他谐波保持耦合。本工作提出了一种用于色散时变光子结构的全波谐波平衡框架。该表述通过将调制组分表示为诱导次级源，在频域中求解稳态 Floquet 响应：对于体介质为体极化密度，对于导电薄片为表面电流密度。材料色散和辐射算符在每个谐波频率处进行评估，而时间调制则作为 Floquet 空间中的非对角卷积耦合进入。该框架在参量泵浦的卷曲石墨烯圆柱上得到验证，其中数值结果与解析 Floquet 散射解一致，并分辨出谐波特异性的散射、吸收和近场。该框架进一步应用于基于 ITO 的 epsilon 近零（ENZ）时空超表面，从而能够对一种反射器件进行形状优化，该器件将光学输入转换为边带并将其重定向到选定的空间衍射级。该方法建立了一个通用平台，用于建模和设计具有谐波分辨场、功率、吸收和衍射观测量的色散有源光子结构。

articles.title: Testing Antimatter Couplings with Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 用光谱学检验反物质耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07656v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate how scalar-mediated potentials with Lorentz-violating couplings to Standard Model fermions affect spectroscopic observables in atoms and highly charged ions. Suitable combinations of an ordinary scalar and a time-like component of a Lorentz violating vector coupling allow for a split into "matter" and "antimatter" couplings, at least in the non-relativistic limit. By considering hydrogen and antihydrogen spectra, we access both matter and antimatter couplings. While relativistic effects alone lift degeneracies in ordinary hydrogen, providing indirect access to antimatter couplings, comparisons with antihydrogen measurements lead to significantly improved sensitivity to the antimatter couplings. In highly charged ions, enhanced relativistic effects further amplify the sensitivity, compensating for reduced experimental precision and larger theoretical uncertainties. We obtain the strongest bounds to date for scalar masses m_φ gtrsim 400:keV. For comparison, we estimate astrophysical constraints on the same parameter space, providing strong bounds even on antimatter couplings, despite stars being predominantly composed of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有洛伦兹破缺耦合的标量介导势如何影响原子和高电荷离子的光谱观测量。通过普通氢和反氢光谱比较，可分别探测物质与反物质耦合，反氢测量显著提高对反物质耦合的灵敏度。高电荷离子中的增强相对论效应进一步提高灵敏度，并使作者在较高标量质量范围给出当前最强约束，同时估计了天体物理约束。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有对标准模型费米子的洛伦兹破缺耦合的标量介导势如何影响原子和高电荷离子中的光谱观测量。普通标量与洛伦兹破缺矢量耦合的类时间分量的适当组合，至少在非相对论极限下，允许分解为“物质”耦合和“反物质”耦合。通过考虑氢和反氢光谱，我们能够接触到物质和反物质耦合。尽管仅相对论效应就会解除普通氢中的简并性，从而间接接触反物质耦合，但与反氢测量的比较会显著提高对反物质耦合的灵敏度。在高电荷离子中，增强的相对论效应进一步放大了灵敏度，从而补偿了实验精度降低和理论不确定性增大的影响。对于标量质量 m_φ 大于约 400 keV 的情形，我们获得了迄今最强的约束。作为比较，我们估计了同一参数空间上的天体物理约束；尽管恒星主要由物质组成，这些约束甚至对反物质耦合也给出了强限制。

articles.title: PhysAttNet: Enhancing Predictive Performance in Industrial and Astrophysical Time Series via Physics-Informed Attention
articles.title_zh: PhysAttNet：通过物理信息注意力提升工业与天体物理时间序列的预测性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07681v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate and robust time series forecasting is essential in many applications involving physical processes, such as manufacturing monitoring and astrophysical event detection. In these settings, predictive models must remain reliable under noise, variability, and measurement uncertainty while capturing temporally localized structures corresponding to physically meaningful events. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely used for such tasks due to their computational efficiency and strong representational capacity. However, their learned temporal representations often exhibit unstable or physically inconsistent attention patterns, reducing robustness, generalization, and interpretability. This paper introduces PhysAttNet, a physics-informed attention framework for time series forecasting. PhysAttNet augments a lightweight CNN forecaster with an attention head guided by domain-informed regularization reflecting the structural properties of physical signals. Specifically, three complementary constraints are imposed during training: an alignment regularization that encourages attention to follow smooth, peak-centered temporal structures derived from the input signal, a smoothness regularization that enforces continuous temporal evolution, and a sparsity regularization that promotes selective focus on informative intervals. These differentiable regularization terms introduce physics-guided inductive bias without requiring annotated explanations or manual supervision. Experiments on two distinct applications, namely predicting cutting forces during milling and forecasting flares in blazar time series, demonstrate that PhysAttNet improves forecasting accuracy, generalization, and prediction performance on structurally important events.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 PhysAttNet，一种面向时间序列预测的物理信息注意力框架，在轻量 CNN 上加入受物理信号结构约束的注意力头。训练中引入对齐、平滑性和稀疏性三类可微正则项，以提升注意力模式的物理一致性、选择性和可解释性。铣削切削力预测和耀变体时间序列耀发预测实验表明，该方法改进了精度、泛化能力和关键事件预测表现。
authors: Amal Saadallah, Julia Tjus, Petra Wiederkeher, Wolfgang Rhode
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确且鲁棒的时间序列预测在许多涉及物理过程的应用中至关重要，例如制造监测和天体物理事件探测。在这些场景中，预测模型必须在噪声、变异性和测量不确定性下保持可靠，同时捕捉与具有物理意义事件相对应的时间局域结构。卷积神经网络（CNN）因其计算效率和强表征能力而被广泛用于此类任务。然而，它们学习到的时间表征常常表现出不稳定或物理上不一致的注意力模式，从而降低鲁棒性、泛化能力和可解释性。本文提出 PhysAttNet，这是一种用于时间序列预测的物理信息注意力框架。PhysAttNet 在轻量级 CNN 预测器上增强了一个注意力头，该注意力头由反映物理信号结构性质的领域信息正则化来引导。具体而言，训练过程中施加三种互补约束：一种对齐正则化，鼓励注意力遵循从输入信号导出的平滑、以峰值为中心的时间结构；一种平滑性正则化，强制时间演化连续；以及一种稀疏性正则化，促进对信息性区间的选择性聚焦。这些可微正则化项引入了物理引导的归纳偏置，而不需要带注释的解释或人工监督。在两个不同应用上的实验，即预测铣削过程中的切削力和预测耀变体时间序列中的耀发，表明 PhysAttNet 改进了预测精度、泛化能力以及对结构上重要事件的预测性能。

articles.title: Bell nonlocality with directly generated telecom-band spin-photon entanglement
articles.title_zh: 利用直接生成的电信波段自旋-光子纠缠实现 Bell 非定域性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08109v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum nonlocality, typically revealed through entanglement distribution across quantum networks, is a cornerstone of quantum information science. Long-distance distribution of entanglement requires the information carrier, i.e. flying photons, to operate in the minimum-loss telecom band of optical fiber. While extensive efforts have been devoted to the direct generation of entanglement between C-band telecom photons and various stationary spins, the verification of quantum nonlocality remains an outstanding challenge. Here, utilizing a dipole transition in rubidium atoms with a wavelength of 1530 nm and a cavity-assisted protocol, we achieve resonant excitation and direct emission of C-band telecom photons from a single atom, generating spin-photon entanglement with a measured Bell state fidelity exceeding 91.4%. We then verify Bell nonlocality by observing a Bell inequality violation of 2.455(77) > 2 using this high-quality entangled pair. These results extend the wavelength of a single-atom quantum emitter to the telecom C-band, achieving sufficiently high-fidelity spin-photon entanglement to finally verify Bell nonlocality. This work thereby provides a promising building block for a large-scale atom-based quantum network capable of distributed quantum metrology and long-distance quantum communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用铷原子 1530 nm 偶极跃迁和腔辅助方案，从单原子直接发射 C 波段电信光子并生成高保真自旋-光子纠缠。实验测得 Bell 态保真度超过 91.4%，并观察到 Bell 不等式违背 2.455(77) > 2，从而验证非定域性。该成果为基于原子的长距离电信量子网络提供了关键构件。
authors: Dong-Yu Huang, Jian Wang, Xiao-Long Zhou, Ze-Min Shen, Si-Jian He, Qi-Yang Huang, Yi-Jia Liu, Yu-Shu Chen, Quan Jiang, Chuan-Feng Li, Guang-Can Guo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子非定域性通常通过量子网络中的纠缠分发来揭示，是量子信息科学的基石。纠缠的长距离分发要求信息载体，即飞行光子，在光纤最低损耗的电信波段工作。尽管人们已投入大量努力直接生成 C 波段电信光子与各种静止自旋之间的纠缠，但量子非定域性的验证仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。在这里，我们利用铷原子中波长为 1530 nm 的偶极跃迁以及腔辅助方案，实现了来自单个原子的 C 波段电信光子的共振激发和直接发射，生成了测得 Bell 态保真度超过 91.4% 的自旋-光子纠缠。随后，我们利用这一高质量纠缠对，通过观察到 2.455(77) > 2 的 Bell 不等式违背来验证 Bell 非定域性。这些结果将单原子量子发射体的波长扩展到电信 C 波段，实现了足够高保真的自旋-光子纠缠，从而最终验证了 Bell 非定域性。因此，本工作为能够实现分布式量子计量和长距离量子通信的大规模基于原子的量子网络提供了一个有前景的构建模块。

articles.title: Millisecond optical coherence and strong collective coupling in an integrated telecom rare-earth photonic platform
articles.title_zh: 集成电信稀土光子平台中的毫秒光学相干与强集体耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08221v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-range quantum network nodes require the combination of strong light-matter coupling, long coherence times and in situ spectral control at telecom wavelengths. The coherence of erbium in integrated devices is held back by its hosts, which do not simultaneously provide the weakly magnetic nuclear-spin environment and the well-defined substitutional sites found in coherence-optimised bulk crystals. Here we bring such an optimised crystal onto a photonic chip, by bonding an Er³⁺:CaWO₄ host without an adhesive interlayer to a high-Q electro-optically tuneable thin-film lithium niobate microring resonator. At an effective temperature of 75 mK and a field of only 0.2 T, the bonded ensemble retains an effective homogeneous linewidth of 289±34 Hz (T_M=1.10±0.13 ms), with spectral diffusion proceeding at 86±18 Hz and saturating at 1.5±0.2 kHz. Electro-optically tuning the resonator through the erbium optical transition resolves an avoided crossing with a collective cooperativity of C=6.7±0.4. Exploiting superhyperfine coupling to the host's ¹⁸³W nuclear spins, we store and retrieve optical phase information over 5 s with a visibility of 0.935±0.015. Strong collective coupling, millisecond coherence and in situ spectral tuning in a single device thus establish heterogeneous integration leveraging coherence-optimised hosts as a route to scalable telecom quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将相干性优化的 Er³⁺:CaWO₄ 晶体无胶层键合到高 Q、可电光调谐的薄膜铌酸锂微环谐振器上，实现电信波长下强光-物质耦合、长相干时间和原位光谱控制的结合。在 75 mK 有效温度和 0.2 T 磁场下，该集成器件保持毫秒级相干，并观测到集体协同性为 6.7 的避免交叉。借助与 ¹⁸³W 核自旋的超超精细耦合，系统可在 5 s 内存取光学相位信息，展示了可扩展电信量子网络路线。
authors: Kah Jen Wo, Pavel A. Dmitriev, Karthik Dasigi, Fumiya Hanamura, Steven Touzard
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长距离量子网络节点需要在电信波长下结合强光-物质耦合、长相干时间和原位光谱控制。集成器件中铒的相干性受其宿主限制，因为这些宿主无法同时提供相干性优化体晶体中所具有的弱磁性核自旋环境和定义明确的替位格点。在这里，我们通过将 Er³⁺:CaWO₄ 宿主在没有黏合剂中间层的情况下键合到高 Q、电光可调谐的薄膜铌酸锂微环谐振器上，将这样一种优化晶体集成到光子芯片上。在 75 mK 的有效温度和仅 0.2 T 的磁场下，键合集成的系综保持了 289±34 Hz 的有效均匀线宽（T_M=1.10±0.13 ms），其谱扩散以 86±18 Hz 进行并在 1.5±0.2 kHz 处饱和。通过将谐振器电光调谐穿过铒的光学跃迁，我们分辨出一个避免交叉，其集体协同性为 C=6.7±0.4。利用与宿主 ¹⁸³W 核自旋的超超精细耦合，我们在 5 s 内存储并读出光学相位信息，可见度为 0.935±0.015。因此，在单个器件中实现强集体耦合、毫秒相干和原位光谱调谐，确立了利用相干性优化宿主的异质集成作为通向可扩展电信量子网络的路线。

articles.title: Plasmoid-Mediated 2D Magnetic Reconnection in Partially Ionized Plasmas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08448v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic reconnection in partially ionized plasmas is an important channel for energy release. While the plasmoid instability is well characterized in 2D fully ionized plasmas, its behavior in the presence of neutral-dominated plasma remains poorly understood in the nonlinear, high-Lundquist-number (S = 10⁵⁾ regime. We present high-resolution (16384 × 4096 cells) two-dimensional two-fluid (ion + neutral) simulations of Harris-sheet reconnection with upstream plasma beta β = 2, comparing fully ionized and partially ionized (ionization fraction ξ = 10⁻¹ and 10⁻²) regimes. Neutral-ion decoupling accelerates the linear tearing stage and alters the plasmoid hierarchy: the large-scale ``monster'' plasmoid that dominates the fully ionized case is suppressed, and the sheet instead fragments into a dense chain of sub-scale plasmoids. Below the neutral-ion decoupling scale ellₘ̊ dₑc, ions concentrate into the plasmoids, reaching peak overdensities h̊oᵢ/h̊oᵢ,₀ approx 10 (ξ = 10⁻¹) and 3-5×10³ (ξ = 10⁻²), while the neutrals remain comparatively smooth. This local pile-up raises the ionization fraction and recouples the two fluids within the plasmoids. Measured from the out-of-plane electric field at the reconnection sites, the reconnection rate in the ξ = 10⁻² case achieves Rₘ̊ ᵣₑcapprox0.01, whereas the ξ = 10⁻¹ case rises to a rate approx0.02 and further 0.035 when apparent coalescence occurs. In the ξ = 10⁻² case, the ambipolar drift drives a rapid ion inflow sim0.5,vA,₀ into the layer at the same reconnection sites, far above the neutral inflow velocity sim0.1,vA,₀. Here, vA,₀ is the upstream total Alfvén speed.
authors: Yue Hu, Siyao Xu, Grzegorz Kowal, James M. Stone, Alex Lazarian, Hui Li

articles.title: High Precision Fundamental Physics Experiments at JLab with Spin-transparent Storage Rings of Low-energy Polarized Electron Beams
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08551v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A breakthrough in fundamental physics experiments measuring particle spin precession may happen if spin-transparent storage rings become adopted tools for such experiments. We present a new design of highly specialized table-sized storage rings, which use low-energy polarized electron beams and Mott polarimetry. Based on the spin transparency ansatz, the spin precession stemming from the magnetic dipole moment is canceled at any beam energy after an electron's turn along the periodic orbit in the ring. Meanwhile, a spin precession induced by the fundamental physics of interest, e.g., the electron's permanent electric dipole moment (EDM) and/or ultralight-dark-matter-mediated forces such as axions, will accumulate. However, capitalizing on such types of rings is not only desirable for measurements of EDMs and axion searches relevant to CP violation and matter-antimatter asymmetry in the Universe, but may also find very promising applications in quantum computing.
authors: Vladimir Khachatryan (Bill), Riad Suleiman (Bill), Alberto Accardi (Bill), Carlos Ayerbe Gayoso (Bill), Marco Battaglieri (Bill), Devesh Bhattarai (Bill), Silviu Covrig Dusa (Bill), Yaroslav Derbenev (Bill), Forrest Friesen (Bill), Joseph Grames (Bill), Paul Guèye (Bill), Tyler J. Hague (Bill), Ching Him Leung (Bill), Wenliang (Bill), Li, Magno V. T. Machado, Preet Mann, Vasiliy Morozov, Son Nguyen, Michael Nycz, Howard Oh, Udit Raha, Mario Reig, Marco Schreck, Nathaniel Sherrill, Ye Tian, Zakia Tithi, Alexandre Vieira, Erik Wrightson, Zichen Yin

articles.title: Born-Oppenheimer, Born-Huang, and exact factorization: quantum geometry and error in analytically transparent benchmark models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08668v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The phrase "potential energy surface" refers to several distinct objects. The Born-Oppenheimer construction gives a clamped-nucleus electronic eigenvalue, the single-surface Born-Huang construction adds the diagonal correction, and exact factorization gives a state-dependent exact scalar potential. These constructions answer different questions and should not be regarded as competing definitions of one universal surface. We compare them in two analytically transparent benchmark models. For Fernández's bilinearly coupled oscillators, the exact molecular spectrum, the Born-Oppenheimer and Born-Huang spectra, and the ground-state exact-factorization surface are obtained in closed form. We prove the ground-state ordering of these energies for every admissible mass ratio and coupling and show why it does not extend uniformly to excited states. The diagonal Born-Huang correction is identified with the mass-weighted quantum metric, and Fernández's sixth-order result is recast as a leading geometric error budget involving the metric and a gap-weighted spectral moment of the same derivative couplings. In a linear vibronic-coupling model the metric localizes at an avoided crossing while the total Fubini-Study length remains π/2, separating the localization of electronic-state change from its total magnitude. Exact factorization is smooth for the nodeless ground state but becomes increasingly ill-conditioned, while remaining finite, when an excited-state nuclear marginal becomes small. These models separate approximation error, geometric correction, and conditioning in a form that can be checked directly.

articles.title: Comment on "Regarding the Rotational Unruh Effect"
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08759v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We comment on various statements in a recent document (A.~Deur, S.~J.~Brodsky, C.~D.~Roberts and B.~Terzić, Regarding the Rotational Unruh Effect, arXiv:2607.25004v1 [hep.ph], (2026)). The examples cited treat electrons (or positrons) circulating and emitting photons in high-energy storage rings. The topic is also of interest in astrophysics, for electrons orbiting in magnetic fields around neutron stars.

articles.title: Preview-Based Relative-Motion Control of an Insertion Tool for Neural-Thread Placement in Pulsating Tissue
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08860v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robotic neural-thread placement requires regulating the insertion-tool tip relative to tissue that moves with cardiac and respiratory pulsation. This paper develops a preview-based relative-motion controller that estimates latency-delayed periodic surface motion, predicts it over a short horizon, and uses offset-free model predictive control to regulate relative placement while limiting actuator effort and lateral relative velocity. In MuJoCo, the 1-DOF controller achieves 12.0m̆ free-space and 1.9m̆ contact RMS relative-placement error, versus 18.3/176.8m̆ for delayed-feedback impedance and 286.1/275.5m̆ for lab-frame PD, at the cost of higher peak contact force (3.43 versus 2.00~mN) since offset-free tracking drives the tip fully to the commanded depth rather than yielding against the tissue. In 3 DOF, coupled preview reduces contact lateral shear from 1.34 to 0.50~mm/s with 2.1m̆ lateral RMS error. A feasibility-restored octagonal shear formulation keeps the QP solvable under degraded sensing by adding a bounded shared slack: at 10m̆ RMS per-axis sensing noise, where a matched cost-only controller violates the 0.80~mm/s budget in all 10 seeds (mean/maximum 0.988/1.175~mm/s), the soft-octagon controller completes all 10 seeds with no fallback and no measured violation (0.653/0.712~mm/s), with its operating envelope characterized up to 15m̆ RMS. A two-vertex Lyapunov certificate for the controller's actual finite-horizon error-feedback gain holds over -40%/+50% reflected-mass mismatch. The modeled tip is a rigid contact point, and the study is simulation-only: flexible-thread and carrier-needle mechanics, a validated transient-force constraint, biological damage thresholds, and hardware-realistic sensing and timing remain required before deployment.

articles.title: Hierarchical rank-evolving representation for physics-informed neural networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09483v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recently, tensor-based physics-informed neural networks (T-PINNs) have received increasing attention. However, existing T-PINNs still face a fundamental challenge: they mainly rely on pre-specified low-rank tensor decompositions with manually tuned ranks, which limits their ability to capture the underlying structures of multivariate solution functions and hinders their practical deployment. To address this challenge, we propose a hierarchical rank-evolving (abbreviated as HRE) representation for multivariate functions, which endows us to faithfully capture the underlying structure of the targeted multivariate function accompanying with automatic rank determination. Concretely, in the hierarchical design of HRE representation, the target multivariate function is decomposed as a small-scale inner tensor with a set of univariate functions along each mode, where a customized tensor network decomposition can be readily deployed to capture the underlying structure of the small-scale inner tensor. In HRE representation, the crucial hyperparameters, ranks, can be adaptively revealed during the decomposition, freeing us from manual rank tuning and making HRE practically applicable to real-world problems. Besides, we build the HRE-PINNs correspondingly. Extensive numerical experiments, including high-dimensional static problems (Helmholtz equation and Poisson equation), nonlinear time-dependent problems (Klein-Gordon equation), and complex fluid-dynamics problems (flow mixing equation and Navier-Stokes equation), demonstrate that HRE-PINNs consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art approaches in terms of accuracy.
authors: Ruoyang Su, Xi-Le Zhao, Kun Li, Liang Li

articles.title: Deep Learning Imputation of Missing Radius of Maximum Winds (Rmax) Values in Tropical Cyclone Best-Track Data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09683v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Probabilistic coastal hazard assessments require accurate characterization of tropical cyclone (TC) parameters, yet datasets often contain missing records for the radius of maximum winds (Rmax), a key variable in Joint Probability Method analyses. This study evaluates data-driven approaches for Rmax imputation, including one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1DCNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and conventional machine learning models. We examine physics-informed input augmentation, temporal modeling, and transfer learning using synthetic RAFT and STORM datasets for pre-training and observational IBTrACS data for fine-tuning. Including the radius of 34-knot winds (R34) substantially improves performance across all model types. Temporal models achieve higher average correlations than non-temporal models despite using approximately an order of magnitude fewer samples, indicating better preservation of relative Rmax variability across storms. This advantage is more pronounced when R34 is unavailable, suggesting temporal information can partially compensate for missing storm-size predictors. Transfer learning does not improve performance, likely because synthetic datasets have lower and less variable Rmax distributions than IBTrACS. These findings demonstrate the potential of temporal deep learning for reconstructing incomplete TC records and highlight the importance of physics-informed inputs, observational data availability, and distributional consistency in coastal hazard assessment.
authors: Swastik Agrawal, Nishkal Hundia, Ziyue Liu, Michelle Bensi

articles.title: Observation of Iron Oxide to Nitride Conversion via Liquid Liquid Phase Separation in High pressure Borate Melt
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.24289v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High pressure chemistry provides a powerful route to materials that are inaccessible or difficult to synthesize under ambient conditions. However, high pressure chemical reaction processes and mechanisms remain largely unexplored because of the challenges associated with in situ characterization under high pressure and high temperature, particularly within the deeply enclosed sample environment of a large volume press. Here, we employ the state of the art real time synchrotron X ray radiography to image a high pressure chemical reaction at 5.4 GPa and 1700 K within a large volume press. Using Fe2O3 and BN as precursors, we capture the complete dynamic metal oxide to nitride conversion and show that it differs fundamentally from conventional solid state diffusion controlled nitridation. Synchrotron X ray radiography clearly revealed that this conversion involves a two stage liquid liquid separation process (LLPS), including fluid nitrogen and fluid Fe N alloy. On the basis of these observations, we propose a nitrogen driven mechanism for LLPS in borate melts. Specifically, nitrogen reduces metal cations in the borate network, altering their coordination environments and triggering a substantial reorganization of the melt structure. This coordination induced restructuring destabilizes the borate melt and promotes the LLPS of fluid Fe N alloy. Our in-situ observations suggest a general pathway for high pressure metal oxide to nitride conversion. This study provides a direct visualization of a pres-sure-enabled chemical reaction that is inaccessible under ambient conditions, offering fundamental in-sight into how high pressure reshapes chemical reaction pathways and enables the synthesis of metal nitrides.
authors: Yu Tao, Depu Liu, Chunyin Zhou, Xu Jia, Jingyi Liu, Xue Chang, Yangbin Wang, Yipeng Wang, Duanwei He, Li Lei

articles.title: A reinterpretation of classical magnetism via the regular representation of displacement current
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.14492v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The displacement current, introduced by Maxwell, has long caused confusion regarding its relationship to the magnetic field. To develop a new understanding of classical magnetism, this work first decomposes the displacement current into a localized internal component and an external field distribution by employing a discal regularization of the dipole distribution. Due to a surprising cancellation of the electric current by this internal displacement current, an integral expression for the magnetic field in terms of the external displacement current (or total current) enables a reinterpretation of classical magnetism. Consequently, the current equivalence is resolved and refined through this integral representation in both quasi-steady and quasi-static states. In the latter case, the nonzero external displacement current is exactly equal to---and can easily be mistaken for---the current in the circuit system. This paper proposes a potential solution to several longstanding historical disputes concerning the displacement current.

articles.title: Rimu.jl: Random integrators for many-body quantum systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.19505v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Rimu.jl is a Julia package for solving many-body quantum problems. The core of the package is a matrix-free implementation of Hamiltonians and other operators and compact representation of Fock states, which together allow for efficient methods suitable for high-performance computing. Rimu.jl includes a Julia implementation of the full configuration interaction quantum Monte Carlo (FCIQMC) algorithm which is a type of projector QMC algorithm for stochastically solving the time-independent Schrödinger equation. It also includes many well-known model Hamiltonians, and an interface for exact diagonalisation based on external eigenvalue solvers. Both the stochastic and exact diagonalisation methods are accessed with a CommonSolve.jl interface. We describe the FCIQMC algorithm and how to obtain estimators of observables as well as the key features of the implementation.
authors: Matija Čufar, C. J. Bradly, Ray Yang, Elke Pahl, Joachim Brand

articles.title: Gyrofluid Magnetic Reconnection Beyond the δ F Approximation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.06234v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic reconnection in a two-dimensional system is studied employing a novel Full-F gyrofluid model with arbitrary- wavelength polarization. In strongly magnetized plasmas, the long wavelength dimension parallel to the magnetic field can be separated from the much smaller perpendicular scales, motivating an isolated two-dimensional description. While previous studies have predominantly employed delta- F gyrofluid models, the present Full-F formulation is applied to simulate Harris-sheet magnetic reconnection with domain aspect ratios L_y/Lₓ <= 16, investigating tearing-mode growth, plasmoid formation, and the influence of finite ion Larmor radius (FLR) effects. In addition to a linear tearing-mode analysis, a non-modal stability analysis of the linearized system is performed. The evolution operator is shown to be strongly non-normal, exhibiting large condition numbers and extended pseudospectra that indicate the possibility of significant transient amplification, even in marginally stable regimes. Such transient amplification may facilitate the transition from linear tearing growth to rapid nonlinear acceleration. We focus on low-plasma-beta magnetic reconnection on the scale of the drift scale and incorporate ion FLR effects, placing the simulations in the context of magneti- cally confined fusion plasmas such as tokamaks. After discussing numerical resolution and convergence, we present a parameter scan varying the normalized electron skin depth and the ion-to-electron temperature ratio. Finally, the influence of aspect ratio, polarization model, and FLR effects on the reconnection dynamics and plasmoid formation is investigated.
authors: F. F. Locker, M. Rinner, M. Held, A. Kendl

articles.title: Non-Hermitian-induced higher-order topological phases in acoustic fractal lattices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09186v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: For fractal (non-integer-dimension) geometries in Hermitian system, high-order topological phases were realized in the past few years, for which, it is difficult to tune the energy concentration degree of topological states flexibly and smoothly. Non-Hermiticity method is expected to solve this problem. However, in non-integer-dimension system, the non-Hermitian-fractal coupled topological mechanism is unclear and topological phases induced by non-Hermiticity remain unrealized. By introducing a loss contrast in a fractal lattice, this study proposes a non-Hermitian route to realize higher-order topological phases in acoustic fractal lattices with good tunability. Based on the tight-binding approximation, calculations on the Hamiltonian of the system yield the wave-function distribution of the zero-energy modes, revealing the formation mechanisms and conditions for the topological phase transitions induced by non-Hermiticity in acoustic fractal lattices. We numerically and experimentally realize non-Hermitian-induced topological edge and corner states in a fractal structure. Furthermore, a tunable acoustic energy concentrator has been realized, namely, the degree of acoustic energy localization can be tuned conveniently by merely adjusting the loss contrast, rather than redesigning the structure parameters.
