articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并分析了一种可编程近场辐射热网络，可通过热交换模拟卷积与循环运算。该框架结合由 VO2、GST 等相变材料构成的辐射热二极管和晶体管，实现热卷积神经网络与热循环神经网络，并具备三态逻辑、辐射增益和非易失热存储等特征。研究表明，温度场可作为非电子计算中的信息载体，为热传递、记忆和自适应推理的一体化提供新范式。
authors: Hexiang Zhang, Mauro Antezza, Yi Zheng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出并分析了一种可编程的近场辐射热网络，该网络通过热交换来模拟卷积和循环操作。通过集成由 VO2 和 GST 等相变材料组成的辐射热二极管和晶体管，我们构建了两种基本架构：热卷积神经网络（T-CNN）和热循环神经网络（T-RNN）。T-CNN 通过依赖温度的发射率调制来执行空间模式识别，其中每个门都作为可调谐的辐射滤波器，用于放大或抑制局域热通量。该系统可通过 VO2/GST 中的门温度分布进行外部编程，从而实现加权求和和非线性激活；滞后相变提供了依赖状态的响应，可用于记忆。T-RNN 将这一功能扩展到时间维度，嵌入辐射反馈和滞后相变，以实现记忆和序列推理。这些系统共同表现出三态逻辑行为、辐射增益和非易失热存储，这是物理学习的关键属性。每个逻辑节点都不依赖电荷载流子或电路运行，而仅依赖纳米尺度表面之间的近场光子隧穿。由此形成的框架使卷积、记忆保持和反馈学习能够在一种非接触、节能的平台中直接实现。本研究建立了热深度学习的首个辐射实现，揭示了一种新的计算范式，其中温度场作为智能的载体，将热传递、记忆和自适应推理统一于一个非电子系统之中。

articles.title: Unconventional Scaling of Electric Hall Effect in Magnetic Weyl Semimetals
articles.title_zh: 磁性 Weyl 半金属中电霍尔效应的非常规标度行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric Hall Effect (EHE), a unique phenomenon in two-dimensional (2D) magnetic systems, refers to the generation of Hall current by an out-of-plane electric field Ez. Here, we demonstrate that for 2D magnetic Weyl semimetals that host doubly degenerate nodal points, the EHE features multiple unconventional scaling laws. At zero temperature, the EHE exhibits a topological E_F⁻¹ Fermi-energy scaling. Remarkably, the prefactor of the scaling is determined by the global topological charge of the point without any dependence on the local parameters of the system, leading to a universal and significant enhancement of Hall response in any species of Weyl points as the Fermi energy approaches the Weyl point. This significant response enables a weak electric field to be directly converted into a measurable Hall signal. Surprisingly, this enhanced Hall response is not diminished by temperature, but evolves into an unconventional logarithmically corrected scaling at finite temperature σₓyproptoEzłn(1/|Ez|) for weak Ez, still yielding a divergent electric-field susceptibility. Thus, our work not only unveils intriguing scaling laws resulting from the interaction between magnetism and topology, but also suggests a novel scaling-enhanced and temperature-robust mechanism that may enable weak electric-field sensing through a practical and all-electric route.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维磁性 Weyl 半金属中的电霍尔效应，即面外电场诱导霍尔电流的现象。作者发现该效应在零温和有限温下均表现出非常规标度律，且在费米能接近 Weyl 点或弱电场极限下具有显著增强。结果揭示了磁性与拓扑相互作用导致的新型标度机制，并为温度稳健的弱电场探测提供了全电学路径。
authors: Chaoxi Cui, Yilin Han, Run-Wu Zhang, Zhi-Ming Yu, Yugui Yao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电霍尔效应（EHE）是二维（2D）磁性系统中的一种独特现象，指由面外电场 Ez 产生霍尔电流。本文中，我们证明，对于具有双重简并节点的二维磁性 Weyl 半金属，EHE 呈现出多种非常规标度律。在零温下，EHE 表现出拓扑性的 E_F⁻¹ 费米能标度。值得注意的是，该标度的前因子由该点的整体拓扑荷决定，而不依赖于系统的任何局域参数，从而在费米能接近 Weyl 点时，在任何类型的 Weyl 点中都导致普适且显著增强的霍尔响应。这种显著响应使弱电场能够被直接转换为可测量的霍尔信号。令人惊讶的是，这种增强的霍尔响应不会被温度削弱，而是在有限温度下演化为一种带有非常规对数修正的标度，在弱 Ez 下有 σₓy ∝ Ez ln(1/|Ez|)，仍然产生发散的电场磁化率。因此，我们的工作不仅揭示了由磁性与拓扑相互作用产生的引人关注的标度律，而且提出了一种新的、由标度增强且温度稳健的机制，该机制可能通过实际可行的全电学路线实现弱电场传感。

articles.title: Geometric closure of classical nucleation theory for magnetic-field-controlled nanoparticle size across magnetic classes
articles.title_zh: 跨磁性类别的磁场调控纳米颗粒尺寸经典成核理论的几何闭合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling nanoparticle size during synthesis remains a central challenge in nanoscience, particularly in systems where external magnetic fields are used as continuous control parameters. Existing descriptions of magnetic-field-assisted nucleation are typically material-specific or rely on computationally intensive atomistic methods. Here, we reformulate classical nucleation theory as a geometrically closed thermodynamic framework by introducing a sphere-packing representation of atomic assembly. This construction establishes a direct link between discrete atomic structure and continuum free-energy contributions under applied magnetic fields, yielding a field-driven evolution equation for the critical nucleus size. The resulting theory provides a unified description of nanoparticle nucleation across superparamagnetic, paramagnetic, and diamagnetic systems within a single formalism. It quantitatively reproduces previously unresolved experimental observations for magnetite and nickel nanoparticles, namely the systematic reduction of mean particle size and narrowing of size distributions with increasing magnetic field. In the diamagnetic limit, the framework recovers our earlier analytical susceptibility-based description of silver nanoparticles, in which the field-dependent critical radius is governed by the induced-magnetization contribution to the nucleation free energy. Beyond modeling the reduction of mean particle size with increasing magnetic field, the framework reveals that the narrowing of size distributions emerges naturally from the curvature of the field-modified free-energy landscape. These results establish magnetic-field-assisted nucleation as a geometrically constrained thermodynamic process, providing a computationally efficient route for controlling nanoparticle size across distinct magnetic material classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将经典成核理论重构为一种几何闭合的热力学框架，以描述外加磁场对不同磁性类别纳米颗粒成核尺寸的调控。通过引入原子组装的球堆积表示，作者建立了离散原子结构与连续自由能项之间的联系，并导出临界核尺寸的磁场驱动演化方程。该理论统一描述超顺磁、顺磁和抗磁体系，并解释了磁场增强下平均粒径减小和尺寸分布变窄的实验现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在合成过程中控制纳米颗粒尺寸仍然是纳米科学中的核心挑战，尤其是在外部磁场被用作连续控制参数的体系中。现有关于磁场辅助成核的描述通常具有材料特异性，或依赖计算量很大的原子级方法。本文中，我们通过引入原子组装的球堆积表示，将经典成核理论重新表述为一种几何闭合的热力学框架。这一构造在外加磁场下建立了离散原子结构与连续自由能贡献之间的直接联系，从而得到临界核尺寸的场驱动演化方程。所得理论在单一形式体系内为超顺磁、顺磁和抗磁系统中的纳米颗粒成核提供了统一描述。它定量再现了此前关于磁铁矿和镍纳米颗粒尚未解决的实验观测，即随着磁场增强，平均粒径系统性减小且尺寸分布变窄。在抗磁极限下，该框架恢复了我们早先针对银纳米颗粒提出的基于磁化率的解析描述，其中依赖磁场的临界半径由诱导磁化对成核自由能的贡献所控制。除了模拟随磁场增强而出现的平均粒径减小之外，该框架还揭示，尺寸分布变窄自然源于经磁场修正的自由能景观的曲率。这些结果确立了磁场辅助成核是一种受几何约束的热力学过程，为跨不同磁性材料类别控制纳米颗粒尺寸提供了一条计算高效的途径。

articles.title: Anyon-Impurity Bound States in Quantum-Engineered Fractional Chern Insulators
articles.title_zh: 量子工程分数量子陈绝缘体中的任意子-杂质束缚态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile impurities provide a powerful means of probing correlated and topological quantum matter, through their dressing by the surrounding medium and the practical probes granting access to the resulting composite object. Motivated by the recent observation of anyon-impurity composites in the solid state, as well as recent realizations of Laughlin-type states in engineered lattice systems, we investigate the formation of a bound state between a mobile impurity and a single pinned quasihole in the interacting Harper-Hofstadter model deep in the fractional Chern insulator regime. Combining analytical arguments with large-scale numerical simulations, we characterize the structure, energetics, and stability of hybrid anyon-impurity bound states, and show that their binding energy provides direct access to the fractional charge of the quasihole under conditions that we identify. We further demonstrate that the composite object can be coherently transported by externally steering the quasihole pinning potential. Our results establish a realistic pathway for controlled anyon-impurity manipulation in quantum-engineered platforms, enabling experimentally feasible protocols for braiding.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究相互作用 Harper-Hofstadter 模型中移动杂质与单个钉扎准空穴之间束缚态的形成，背景为分数量子陈绝缘体深区。作者结合解析论证和大规模数值模拟，刻画了混合任意子-杂质束缚态的结构、能量学与稳定性，并指出其束缚能可在特定条件下直接反映准空穴的分数电荷。研究还表明该复合体可通过外部操控准空穴钉扎势实现相干输运，为量子工程平台中的任意子操纵和编织实验提供路径。
authors: Botao Wang, Amit Vashisht, Felix A. Palm, Fabian Grusdt, Laurens Vanderstraeten, Nathan Goldman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 移动杂质通过被周围介质包覆以及可用于探测所得复合对象的实际探针，为研究关联和拓扑量子物质提供了有力手段。受固态体系中近期观察到任意子-杂质复合体以及工程化晶格系统中近期实现 Laughlin 型态的启发，我们研究了在分数量子陈绝缘体区域深处的相互作用 Harper-Hofstadter 模型中，移动杂质与单个钉扎准空穴之间束缚态的形成。结合解析论证和大规模数值模拟，我们表征了混合任意子-杂质束缚态的结构、能量学和稳定性，并表明在我们确定的条件下，其束缚能可直接通达准空穴的分数电荷。我们进一步证明，通过从外部引导准空穴钉扎势，可以相干地输运该复合对象。我们的结果为在量子工程平台中受控操纵任意子-杂质建立了一条现实路径，从而使实验上可行的编织协议成为可能。

articles.title: Metal-Coordination Effects on the Stability and ORR/OER Activity of Layered Organometallic Single-Atom Catalysts: A Theoretical Study
articles.title_zh: 金属配位对层状有机金属单原子催化剂稳定性及 ORR/OER 活性的影响：一项理论研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06309v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organometallic layered materials have emerged as promising single-atom catalysts for oxygen reduction and evolution reactions, but their practical use has been limited by insufficient electrochemical stability. Here, we present a density functional theory study clarifying the relationship between catalytic activity and stability in organometallic single-atom catalysts with metal-N₄ (MN₄₎ and metal-O₄ (MO₄₎ coordination. We compare graphene-embedded MN₄ motif and phthalocyanine-like frameworks with MO₄₋coordination frameworks, including M₄₍OHPTP)₂ and M₃₍HHTP)₂ (M = Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn). Stability is assessed by surface Pourbaix analysis, while activity is evaluated using the computational hydrogen electrode method. MN₄ systems show competitive overpotentials but suffer strong pH-dependent instability. In contrast, MO₄ frameworks exhibit enhanced robustness across wide pH ranges while maintaining good catalytic performance. A proposed stability descriptor enables direct comparison across systems, identifying MO₄ coordination structures, particularly M₄₍OHPTP)₂ (M = Zn, Co) as optimal for balancing activity and stability in practical electrocatalysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用密度泛函理论研究金属-N4 与金属-O4 配位的层状有机金属单原子催化剂在氧还原和析氧反应中的活性与稳定性关系。结果显示，MN4 体系虽具竞争性过电位，但存在显著 pH 依赖的不稳定性；MO4 框架则在宽 pH 范围内更稳健，并保持良好催化性能。作者提出稳定性描述符，指出部分 MO4 配位结构尤其有利于实际电催化中活性与稳定性的平衡。
authors: Pedro H. Souza, Victor Hoyos-Sinchi, Walter Orellana
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有机金属层状材料已成为用于氧还原反应和析氧反应的有前景的单原子催化剂，但其实际应用受到电化学稳定性不足的限制。本文中，我们提出一项密度泛函理论研究，阐明具有金属-N₄（MN₄）和金属-O₄（MO₄）配位的有机金属单原子催化剂中催化活性与稳定性之间的关系。我们比较了嵌入石墨烯的 MN₄ 基元和类酞菁框架，以及具有 MO₄ 配位的框架，包括 M₄(OHPTP)₂ 和 M₃(HHTP)₂（M = Mn、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu、Zn）。稳定性通过表面 Pourbaix 分析评估，而活性使用计算氢电极方法评价。MN₄ 体系表现出有竞争力的过电位，但遭受强烈的 pH 依赖不稳定性。相比之下，MO₄ 框架在宽 pH 范围内表现出增强的稳健性，同时保持良好的催化性能。所提出的稳定性描述符能够在不同体系之间进行直接比较，并将 MO₄ 配位结构，尤其是 M₄(OHPTP)₂（M = Zn、Co），确定为在实际电催化中平衡活性与稳定性的最佳选择。

articles.title: Vector Edge Solitons and Domain Walls in a Nonlinear Mechanical Topological Insulator
articles.title_zh: 非线性机械拓扑绝缘体中的矢量边缘孤子与畴壁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report nonlinear edge waves in a 2D mechanical topological insulator. A bulk lattice consists of pendulums with on-site cubic nonlinearity connected by linear springs realizing quantum spin Hall effect. We show that the nonlinear interaction between two edge modes with equal group velocities (EGV) is described by a 1D two-component coupled nonlinear Schrödinger (CNLS) equation. On the interface separating two bulk lattices with opposite spin Chern numbers, we construct linear springs such that the dispersion relation exhibits EGV points with favorable CNLS coefficients. Thus, we realize nonlinear edge waves propagating along the interface, including bright-bright (BB) edge solitons for focusing CNLS coefficients, and dark-dark edge solitons, edge domain walls, and dark-bright edge solitons for defocusing CNLS coefficients. In terms of the site amplitudes, these solutions resemble bright and dark breathers. These solutions should be topologically protected when both carrier frequencies lie within a band gap, which we explicitly show by passing BB edge solitons through compact defects on the interface. We also show energy transfer in BB edge soliton collisions with potential application to collision-based computing. Generally, vector edge solitons exhibit a large parameter space for soliton collisions, which endows mechanical devices with greater potential for information processing and other functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种二维机械拓扑绝缘体中的非线性边缘波，其中体晶格由带在位三次非线性的摆和线性弹簧构成，可实现量子自旋霍尔效应。作者证明等群速度边缘模之间的非线性相互作用可由一维双分量耦合非线性薛定谔方程描述，并构造出亮-亮、暗-暗、暗-亮边缘孤子及边缘畴壁等解。研究还展示了拓扑保护下孤子穿越缺陷以及碰撞中的能量转移，提示其在机械信息处理和碰撞计算中的潜在应用。
authors: David D. J. M. Snee, Yi-Ping Ma
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报道了一种二维机械拓扑绝缘体中的非线性边缘波。体晶格由具有在位三次非线性的摆组成，这些摆通过实现量子自旋霍尔效应的线性弹簧连接。我们表明，两个具有相等群速度（EGV）的边缘模之间的非线性相互作用可由一维双分量耦合非线性薛定谔（CNLS）方程描述。在分隔两个具有相反自旋陈数的体晶格的界面上，我们构造了线性弹簧，使色散关系表现出具有有利 CNLS 系数的 EGV 点。因此，我们实现了沿界面传播的非线性边缘波，包括在聚焦 CNLS 系数下的亮-亮（BB）边缘孤子，以及在散焦 CNLS 系数下的暗-暗边缘孤子、边缘畴壁和暗-亮边缘孤子。就格点振幅而言，这些解类似于亮呼吸子和暗呼吸子。当两个载波频率均位于带隙内时，这些解应当受到拓扑保护；我们通过让 BB 边缘孤子穿过界面上的紧凑缺陷明确展示了这一点。我们还展示了 BB 边缘孤子碰撞中的能量转移，其可能应用于基于碰撞的计算。一般而言，矢量边缘孤子为孤子碰撞提供了巨大的参数空间，这赋予机械器件在信息处理和其他功能方面更大的潜力。

articles.title: Next Generation of Ultra-Coarse-Graining: Self-Consistent Inference of Critical Internal States
articles.title_zh: 下一代超粗粒化：关键内部状态的自洽推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05388v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bottom-up coarse-graining expands the length and time scales accessible to molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, but information loss can hinder accurate representation of multistate phenomena in complex biomolecular dynamics. Ultra-Coarse-Graining (UCG) projects discrete "quantum-like" extended degrees of freedom, or "internal states," onto coarse-grained (CG) molecules, extending CG model expressiveness. The rapid-local-equilibrium (RLE) approximation in UCG depends on user-defined collective variables (CVs, e.g., local density) and neglects correlations between internal states within and between CG molecules. We present Self-Consistent UCG (SC-UCG), which uses the underlying UCG interactions directly to assign internal states without designing CVs in the CG ensemble. During simulation, internal state probabilities are determined self-consistently through graph message passing. We enhance the RLE Hamiltonian with the Bethe approximation and AI-based inference to represent explicit correlations between UCG beads. For force-field training, we develop Multilayer Internal State Consistency (MISC), a machine-learning method derived from relative entropy minimization that avoids iterative sampling of intermediate force fields. We apply SC-UCG to a tetramer exhibiting a second-order symmetry-breaking phase transition from a supercritical racemic fluid to subcritical D-rich and L-rich fluids. SC-UCG captures collective switching of internal states in the subcritical region and recapitulates the phase transition across temperatures, despite being trained on a single-temperature dataset.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出自洽超粗粒化（SC-UCG）方法，以改进传统超粗粒化在复杂生物分子多态动力学中的信息损失问题。该方法不依赖用户预设集体变量，而是在模拟过程中通过图消息传递和基于相互作用的自洽推断分配内部状态，并结合 Bethe 近似和人工智能推断刻画粗粒化珠子之间的相关性。应用于具有二级对称破缺相变的四聚体体系时，SC-UCG 即使只用单温度数据训练，也能再现实验相关的内部状态集体切换和跨温度相变行为。
authors: Weizhi Xue, Xiao Shuai, Gregory A. Voth
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自下而上的粗粒化扩展了分子动力学（MD）模拟可及的长度和时间尺度，但信息损失可能阻碍对复杂生物分子动力学中多态现象的准确表示。超粗粒化（UCG）将离散的“类量子”扩展自由度，即“内部状态”，投影到粗粒化（CG）分子上，从而扩展 CG 模型的表达能力。UCG 中的快速局域平衡（RLE）近似依赖用户定义的集体变量（CV，例如局域密度），并忽略了 CG 分子内部和分子之间内部状态的相关性。我们提出自洽 UCG（SC-UCG），它直接使用底层 UCG 相互作用来分配内部状态，而无需在 CG 系综中设计 CV。在模拟过程中，内部状态概率通过图消息传递自洽确定。我们用 Bethe 近似和基于 AI 的推断增强 RLE 哈密顿量，以表示 UCG 珠子之间的显式相关性。对于力场训练，我们开发了多层内部状态一致性（MISC），这是一种由相对熵最小化推导出的机器学习方法，可避免对中间力场进行迭代采样。我们将 SC-UCG 应用于一个四聚体，该四聚体表现出从超临界外消旋流体到亚临界富 D 和富 L 流体的二级对称破缺相变。尽管 SC-UCG 仅在单温度数据集上训练，它仍捕捉到了亚临界区域内部状态的集体切换，并再现了跨温度的相变。

articles.title: Large anomalous shifts of potassium-39 Feshbach resonances
articles.title_zh: 钾-39 Feshbach 共振的大异常位移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05512v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We report the observation of large anomalous shifts, up to +7.5 G, of the positions of the 33.6 G and 39.9 G Feshbach resonances in potassium-39 atoms confined in a 1063.9 nm optical dipole trap (ODT) at temperatures up to around 35 μK and trap depths up to about 136 μK. When the atom cloud is cooled to lower temperatures, by reducing the trap depth of the ODT, the shifts decrease proportionally with trap depth and approach zero at zero depth. We show that the large observed shifts originate from a large differential ac Stark shift between the incoming pair of potassium-39 atoms and the weakly bound Feshbach molecule, which in turn originates from an unexpectedly large dynamic polarizability of the Feshbach molecule. The polarizabilities of the Feshbach molecules extracted from the measured shifts of the 33.6 G and 39.9 G resonances are about four to seven times the sum of the polarizabilities of the two incoming potassium-39 atoms, that is, about four to seven times larger than the usual polarizability of weakly bound Feshbach molecules. The large polarizabilities of the Feshbach molecules are attributed to a near-coincidence between the frequency of the 1063.9 nm ODT laser and the frequency of a molecular transition from the last vibrational level of the lowest triplet a3Σ+u potential to a vibrational level of the excited b3Σ+g potential. Other potassium-39 Feshbach resonances we have studied exhibit a zero or very small shift, corresponding to molecular polarizabilities close to the sum of the polarizabilities of the two incoming potassium-39 atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了在 1063.9 nm 光偶极阱中钾-39 原子 33.6 G 和 39.9 G Feshbach 共振位置出现最高约 +7.5 G 的大异常位移。实验表明位移随阱深降低而减小并在零阱深趋近于零，其来源是入射原子对与弱束缚 Feshbach 分子之间较大的差分交流 Stark 位移。作者将异常大的分子极化率归因于光偶极阱激光频率与某一分子跃迁频率的近重合，而其他共振则表现出零或很小位移。
authors: Ali Zaheer, Mohammed Bouras, Krzysztof Giergiel, Rudolf Grimm, Andrei Sidorov, Peter Hannaford
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报道了在 1063.9 nm 光偶极阱（ODT）中束缚的钾-39 原子中，33.6 G 和 39.9 G Feshbach 共振位置出现高达 +7.5 G 的大异常位移，实验温度最高约为 35 μK，阱深最高约为 136 μK。当通过降低 ODT 阱深将原子云冷却到较低温度时，位移随阱深成比例减小，并在零阱深时趋近于零。我们表明，观测到的大位移源于入射的钾-39 原子对与弱束缚 Feshbach 分子之间较大的差分交流 Stark 位移，而这一位移又源于 Feshbach 分子出乎意料地大的动态极化率。从 33.6 G 和 39.9 G 共振测得位移中提取出的 Feshbach 分子极化率约为两个入射钾-39 原子极化率之和的四到七倍，也就是说，比弱束缚 Feshbach 分子的通常极化率大约四到七倍。Feshbach 分子的巨大极化率被归因于 1063.9 nm ODT 激光频率与从最低三重态 a3Σ+u 势的最后一个振动态到激发态 b3Σ+g 势的一个振动态的分子跃迁频率之间的近重合。我们研究的其他钾-39 Feshbach 共振表现出零位移或很小位移，对应的分子极化率接近两个入射钾-39 原子极化率之和。

articles.title: Multi-cavity strong coupling to an electron spin ensemble: spectral and dark-state signatures
articles.title_zh: 多腔与电子自旋系综的强耦合：谱学与暗态特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05765v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spin ensembles are considered as potential candidates for quantum memory and quantum enhanced sensing applications. Here, we explore the controlled coupling of multiple superconducting microwave cavities to a spin ensemble, which shows signatures of strong coupling and, due to the multi-mode character, the formation of dark states. In particular, the latter are of interest, as they provide a potential pathway to enhance memory times and enable protected storage of non-classical states in spin ensembles due to the suppressed coupling to the circuit environment. We model the spin multi-cavity hybrid to reproduce the spectra and extract characteristic coupling strengths using the input-output formalism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究多个超导微波腔与电子自旋系综之间的受控耦合，观察并分析强耦合特征以及由多模性质导致的暗态形成。暗态因其与电路环境耦合受抑制，有望延长存储时间并保护自旋系综中的非经典态存储。作者采用输入-输出形式对自旋多腔混合系统建模，以再现实验谱并提取特征耦合强度。
authors: P. Oehrl, B. Pérez González, A. Dunaev, M. Althammer, T. S. Parvini, F. Piazza, M. Benito, H. Huebl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋系综被认为是量子存储器和量子增强传感应用的潜在候选体系。本文中，我们探索了多个超导微波腔与一个自旋系综之间的受控耦合，该体系显示出强耦合的特征，并且由于其多模特性而形成暗态。特别是后者令人感兴趣，因为由于其与电路环境的耦合受到抑制，它们为延长存储时间并在自旋系综中实现非经典态的受保护存储提供了一条潜在路径。我们使用输入-输出形式对自旋多腔混合系统进行建模，以再现其谱并提取特征耦合强度。

articles.title: Impact of Nonlinearities on Local Kinetic and Thermokinetic Uncertainty Relations in Bosonic Transport
articles.title_zh: 非线性对玻色输运中局域动力学与热动力学不确定性关系的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06303v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The precision of transport observables can be bounded by the entropy production and the activity of the transport process via kinetic and thermokinetic uncertainty relations. In linear bosonic systems, such uncertainty relations can provide tight bounds when the activity is replaced by a local activity of the measurement contact of interest---even in the strong-coupling regime. How much nonlinearities (or interactions) impact the validity and predictiveness of these local bounds and how much this impact depends on the concrete definition of activity are open questions that we address for two experimentally relevant model systems, a harmonic oscillator network and the intrinsically nonlinear spin-boson model. We thereby provide experimentally testable predictions on how nonlinearities impact or even break local kinetic and thermokinetic precision bounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究非线性或相互作用如何影响玻色输运中局域动力学与热动力学不确定性关系的有效性和预测能力。作者考察了谐振子网络和本征非线性的自旋-玻色模型两个实验相关体系，并比较不同活动度定义下局域精度界的表现。研究给出了可实验检验的预测，说明非线性可能改变甚至破坏局域动力学和热动力学精度界。
authors: Didrik Palmqvist, Luca Magazzù, Milena Grifoni, Janine Splettstoesser
articles.abstract_zh_full: 输运可观测量的精度可以通过熵产生和输运过程的活动度，由动力学和热动力学不确定性关系加以界定。在线性玻色系统中，即使在强耦合区域，当活动度被感兴趣的测量接触的局域活动度替代时，这类不确定性关系也可以给出紧致界。非线性（或相互作用）会在多大程度上影响这些局域界的有效性和预测能力，以及这种影响在多大程度上依赖于活动度的具体定义，仍是开放问题；我们针对两个实验相关的模型系统，即谐振子网络和本征非线性的自旋-玻色模型，对这些问题进行研究。由此，我们给出了可由实验检验的预测，说明非线性如何影响甚至破坏局域动力学和热动力学精度界。

articles.title: Study of polarization of even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in SU(4) Graphene
articles.title_zh: SU(4) 石墨烯中偶分母分数量子霍尔态极化的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2206.08647v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We have focussed to study the even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (EDFQH) states observed in monolayer graphene. In this letter, we have studied polarization mainly for the two EDFQH states at filling fractions ν = 1/2, 1/4, which are observed in an experimental study [Nat. Phys. 14, 930 (2018)] a few years ago. We have applied Chern Simon's gauge field theory to explain the possible variational wave functions for different polarized states and calculated their ground state energies using the Coulomb potential. We have chosen the lowest energy states using suitable combinations of flux attached with the electrons for different polarized states of those EDFQH states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文聚焦单层石墨烯中观测到的偶分母分数量子霍尔态，主要研究填充分数 ν = 1/2 和 1/4 态的极化性质。作者采用 Chern-Simons 规范场理论构造不同极化态的可能变分波函数，并用库仑势计算其基态能量。通过选择不同极化态下电子附着磁通的合适组合，确定能量最低的候选态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们集中研究了在单层石墨烯中观察到的偶分母分数量子霍尔（EDFQH）态。在这封信中，我们主要研究了填充分数 ν = 1/2、1/4 的两个 EDFQH 态的极化，这些态几年前在一项实验研究 [Nat. Phys. 14, 930 (2018)] 中被观察到。我们应用 Chern-Simons 规范场理论来解释不同极化态可能的变分波函数，并使用库仑势计算它们的基态能量。我们通过为这些 EDFQH 态的不同极化态选择与电子附着的磁通的合适组合，选出了最低能量态。

articles.title: Odd-parity altermagnetism through sublattice currents: From Haldane-Hubbard model to general bipartite lattices
articles.title_zh: 通过子晶格电流实现奇宇称交替磁性：从 Haldane-Hubbard 模型到一般二分晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.09602v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose the sublattice currents in a compensated collinear magnetic system as a feasible route to odd-parity altermagnetism (ALM), where nonrelativistic collinear spin splitting occurs in the bands as an odd function of momentum. In contrast to previously classified ALMs, the sublattice currents break the time-reversal symmetry in the nonmagnetic crystal structure and allow for such odd-parity spin splitting. A representative example is the Haldane-Hubbard model at half filling. Although the compensated collinear magnetic ground state was previously recognized as antiferromagnetism, we show that it is actually an odd-parity ALM. Interestingly, its topological version serves as an example of an ALM Chern insulator. We further generalize the Haldane-Hubbard model to common two- and three-dimensional bipartite lattices. With spin splitting allowed by sublattice currents, the compensated collinear magnetic ground states at half filling are generally odd-parity ALM.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出在补偿共线磁性系统中，子晶格电流可作为实现奇宇称交替磁性的可行途径，其中非相对论共线自旋劈裂是动量的奇函数。作者指出，半填充 Haldane-Hubbard 模型中此前被视为反铁磁的补偿共线磁性基态实际上是奇宇称交替磁性，其拓扑版本可作为交替磁性陈绝缘体。进一步推广到常见二维和三维二分晶格后，结果表明由子晶格电流允许的自旋劈裂通常会使半填充补偿共线磁性基态成为奇宇称交替磁性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出，补偿共线磁性系统中的子晶格电流是实现奇宇称交替磁性（ALM）的一条可行途径，在这种磁性中，能带中的非相对论共线自旋劈裂作为动量的奇函数出现。与此前分类的 ALM 不同，子晶格电流在非磁性晶体结构中破坏时间反演对称性，并允许这种奇宇称自旋劈裂。一个代表性例子是半填充的 Haldane-Hubbard 模型。尽管其补偿共线磁性基态此前被认为是反铁磁性，我们表明它实际上是一种奇宇称 ALM。有趣的是，其拓扑版本可作为 ALM 陈绝缘体的一个例子。我们进一步将 Haldane-Hubbard 模型推广到常见的二维和三维二分晶格。由于子晶格电流允许自旋劈裂，半填充下的补偿共线磁性基态通常是奇宇称 ALM。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出补偿共线磁性体系中的子晶格电流可实现奇宇称交替磁性，并以半填充 Haldane-Hubbard 模型为代表例子进行说明。研究进一步推广到常见二维和三维二分晶格，指出这类体系可产生动量奇函数形式的非相对论自旋劈裂，并可能形成交替磁性陈绝缘体。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在交替磁性、拓扑磁性、强关联模型、自旋轨道相关电子结构和磁性量子材料方面高度相关。其从模型哈密顿量和对称性出发理解新型交替磁性机制，对构建有效哈密顿量和筛选拓扑磁性材料有参考价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点关注其对奇宇称交替磁性的对称性判据、子晶格电流定义以及拓扑版本的能带特征。后续可结合第一性原理和 Wannier 哈密顿量，在真实二分晶格材料或范德华磁体中筛选类似机制。

articles.title: Geometric Irreversibility - Enriching Lanford's Theorem with Orientational and Deformable Degrees of Freedom
articles.title_zh: 几何不可逆性：以取向与可形变自由度丰富兰福德定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.09650v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose an extended structural dynamics framework that enriches classical mechanics by treating particle orientation and internal structure as fundamental phase-space coordinates. This extension preserves Hamiltonian structure and Liouville invariance while revealing two distinct mechanisms for entropy production: (i) collisional randomization through orientation-dependent scattering (generalizing Boltzmann), and (ii) continuous geometric instability arising from rotational-deformational coupling. We argue this dual-mechanism structure provides a dynamical justification for the molecular chaos assumption central to Boltzmann-Lanford derivations, particularly in regimes (dense systems, few bodies, structured particles) where classical point-particle theory fails. Recent mathematical advances (Deng, Hani & Ma 2024) extend Lanford's theorem to arbitrary times but still require molecular chaos as input and apply only to dilute gases. This extended structural framework addresses the complementary philosophical question: how can molecular chaos itself emerge from deterministic dynamics? We show that geometric instability in extended phase space makes entropy-decreasing trajectories dynamically unstable, offering a structural explanation for the Second Law. This reframes thermodynamic irreversibility as a geometric property of structured motion rather than a purely statistical postulate.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种扩展的结构动力学框架，将粒子的取向和内部结构作为基本相空间坐标纳入经典力学。该框架保持哈密顿结构与刘维尔不变性，同时揭示由取向依赖散射和旋转—形变耦合导致的两类熵产生机制。作者认为，这为玻尔兹曼—兰福德推导中的分子混沌假设提供了动力学解释，并将热力学不可逆性重新表述为结构化运动的几何性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种扩展的结构动力学框架，通过将粒子取向和内部结构视为基本的相空间坐标来丰富经典力学。该扩展保持哈密顿结构和刘维尔不变性，同时揭示出两种不同的熵产生机制：（i）通过取向依赖散射产生的碰撞随机化（对玻尔兹曼理论的推广），以及（ii）由旋转—形变耦合产生的连续几何不稳定性。我们认为，这种双机制结构为玻尔兹曼—兰福德推导中核心的分子混沌假设提供了动力学论证，尤其适用于经典点粒子理论失效的情形，如稠密系统、少体系统和结构化粒子。近期数学进展（Deng、Hani 与 Ma，2024）将兰福德定理扩展到任意时间，但仍需要将分子混沌作为输入，并且仅适用于稀薄气体。这个扩展的结构框架处理的是互补的哲学问题：分子混沌本身如何能够从确定性动力学中涌现？我们表明，扩展相空间中的几何不稳定性使熵减少轨道在动力学上不稳定，从而为第二定律提供了一种结构性解释。这将热力学不可逆性重新界定为结构化运动的一种几何性质，而不是纯粹的统计假设。

articles.title: Field-induced magnetic phase transition driven by a ground state level-crossing in CsErSe₂
articles.title_zh: CsErSe₂ 中由基态能级交叉驱动的场诱导磁相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.21616v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a comprehensive study of the low-temperature magnetic properties of the insulating rare-earth triangular magnet CsErSe₂. We uncover a field-induced level crossing at the crystal electric field (CEF) ground state, which gives rise to a first order phase transition as well as to distinctive magnetic properties. This crossing is identified by the accurate determination of the single-ion Hamiltonian, the reliability of which is substantially enhanced by field-dependent optical spectroscopy that directly tracks the Zeeman splittings of Kramers doublets. We also observe spontaneous antiferromagnetic ordering in CsErSe₂ below T_N approx 110 mK, and resolve the corresponding magnetic structure using elastic neutron scattering. We discuss how the rich magnetic behavior of CsErSe₂ arises from the interplay of non-trivial field-dependent single-ion physics and spontaneous ordering, and highlight the implications of these results for understanding magnetic phenomena across a wide range of insulating rare-earth magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了绝缘稀土三角晶格磁体 CsErSe₂ 的低温磁性质。作者发现晶体电场基态存在场诱导能级交叉，并导致一级相变及独特磁行为。通过场依赖光谱、单离子哈密顿量确定和中子散射，研究揭示了单离子物理与自发磁有序之间的相互作用。
authors: Hope Whitelock, Allen O. Scheie, Marissa McMaster, Ian A. Leahy, Li Xiang, Mykhaylo Ozerov, Dmitry Smirnov, Eun Sang Choi, C. dela Cruz, M. O. Ajeesh, Eliana S. Krakovsky, Daniel A. Rehn, Jie Xing, Athena S. Sefat, Minhyea Lee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了对绝缘稀土三角晶格磁体 CsErSe₂ 低温磁性质的全面研究。我们发现晶体电场（CEF）基态中存在场诱导能级交叉，该交叉导致一级相变并产生独特的磁性质。通过精确确定单离子哈密顿量来识别这一交叉，而场依赖光学光谱直接追踪克拉默斯双重态的塞曼劈裂，从而显著提高了该哈密顿量的可靠性。我们还观察到 CsErSe₂ 在 T_N 约为 110 mK 以下出现自发反铁磁有序，并利用弹性中子散射解析了相应的磁结构。我们讨论了 CsErSe₂ 丰富的磁行为如何源于非平凡的场依赖单离子物理与自发有序之间的相互作用，并强调这些结果对于理解广泛绝缘稀土磁体中的磁现象所具有的意义。

articles.title: Parastatistics in Interacting Periodic Chains Revealed by Peierls Phase Twists and Shifted Conformal Towers
articles.title_zh: 由 Peierls 相位扭转与移位共形塔揭示的相互作用周期链中的副统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.01150v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We consider interacting paraparticle chains with a constant R-matrix where the Hamiltonian sums over the internal degrees (flavors) of the paraparticles. For such flavor-blind Hamiltonians we show a general factorization of the Hilbert space into occupation and flavor parts with the Hamiltonian acting non-trivially only on the former. For open boundaries, the spectrum therefore coincides with that of the occupation Hamiltonian Hₘ̊ ₒcc with the flavor part merely adding degeneracies. For periodic boundaries, a cyclic reordering of the flavors leads to a separation of Hₘ̊ ₒcc into flux sectors at fixed particle number, thus making the parastatistics directly observable in the energy spectrum. For important exemplary cases, Hₘ̊ ₒcc reduces to the XXZ chain with flux allowing for an exact solution. In the gapless regime, this solution shows flux-shifted c=1 conformal towers in the low-energy spectrum and a temperature-dependent chemical potential in the bulk thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有常数 R 矩阵的相互作用副粒子链，其中哈密顿量对副粒子的内部味自由度求和。作者证明，对于味盲哈密顿量，希尔伯特空间可分解为占据部分与味部分，开放边界下谱与占据哈密顿量一致，而周期边界下味的循环重排会导致通量扇区分离。若占据哈密顿量化为带通量的 XXZ 链，则可精确求解，并在无能隙区显示通量移位的 c=1 共形塔和温度依赖化学势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考虑具有常数 R 矩阵的相互作用副粒子链，其中哈密顿量对副粒子的内部自由度（味）求和。对于这种味盲哈密顿量，我们证明希尔伯特空间可一般地分解为占据部分和味部分，而哈密顿量只在前者上非平凡地作用。因此，在开放边界条件下，能谱与占据哈密顿量 Hₒcc 的能谱一致，味部分仅增加简并度。在周期边界条件下，味的循环重排导致 Hₒcc 在固定粒子数下分离为不同通量扇区，从而使副统计能够直接在能谱中被观测到。对于重要的示例情形，Hₒcc 化为带通量的 XXZ 链，因此可以精确求解。在无能隙区域，该解显示低能谱中存在通量移位的 c=1 共形塔，并在体热力学中出现温度依赖的化学势。

articles.title: Real-time imaging of quasiparticle dynamics at a topological defect in an electronic crystal
articles.title_zh: 电子晶体中拓扑缺陷处准粒子动力学的实时成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.02688v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Defects formed during nonequilibrium self-assembly of quantum matter can dominate its emergent properties. Their macroscopic manifestations are typically characterised as noise, but their internal dynamics remain largely experimentally inaccessible. Making significant advances into the investigation of the microscopic degrees of freedom of such defects, we use fast scanning tunnelling microscopy to resolve, in real time, both internal and global dynamics of a mesoscopic Y-junction defect in an electronic crystal created through self-assembly after a local electromagnetic perturbation. We directly track individual electron rearrangements on millisecond timescales and map spatially localised telegraph noise characteristic of a two-level system. The phase and amplitude of these fluctuations are correlated with the observed charged particle trajectories, revealing a direct connection between collective order-parameter dynamics and microscopic charge motion. We model the dynamics as arising from the interplay of local Coulomb correlations, non-local configurational constraints and hybridised amplitude - phase collective modes bound to the junction. These constraints, together with the non-trivial broken symmetries of the defect, protect long-lived local quasiparticle configurations against external perturbations. Our results establish fast scanning tunnelling microscopy as a means of probing the internal dynamics of metastable quantum defects and reveal how microscopic correlations and collective modes are intertwined within topologically non-trivial structures in electronic crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用快速扫描隧道显微术实时解析电子晶体中介观 Y 形结缺陷的内部与整体动力学。研究直接追踪毫秒时间尺度上的单个电子重排，并绘制与两能级系统相关的局域电报噪声。结果显示微观电荷运动、序参量涨落与束缚在缺陷处的集体模式相互耦合，证明快速 STM 可用于探测亚稳量子缺陷的内部动力学。
authors: Yevhenii Vaskivskyi, Jaka Vodeb, Igor Vaskivskyi, Dragan Mihailovic
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子物质在非平衡自组装过程中形成的缺陷可能主导其涌现性质。它们的宏观表现通常被表征为噪声，但其内部动力学在实验上很大程度上仍难以触及。为了在研究这类缺陷的微观自由度方面取得重要进展，我们使用快速扫描隧道显微术，实时解析了在局域电磁扰动后通过自组装形成的电子晶体中一个介观 Y 形结缺陷的内部动力学和整体动力学。我们直接追踪毫秒时间尺度上的单个电子重排，并绘制出具有两能级系统特征的空间局域电报噪声。这些涨落的相位和振幅与所观测到的带电粒子轨迹相关，揭示了集体序参量动力学与微观电荷运动之间的直接联系。我们将该动力学建模为源于局域库仑关联、非局域构型约束以及束缚于该结处的杂化振幅—相位集体模式之间的相互作用。这些约束与缺陷的非平凡破缺对称性一起，保护长寿命局域准粒子构型免受外部扰动影响。我们的结果确立了快速扫描隧道显微术作为探测亚稳量子缺陷内部动力学的手段，并揭示了电子晶体中拓扑非平凡结构内部的微观关联与集体模式如何相互交织。

articles.title: First-principles calculation of coherence length and penetration depth based on density functional theory for superconductors
articles.title_zh: 基于超导体密度泛函理论的相干长度与穿透深度第一性原理计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05123v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a first-principles framework for evaluating the fundamental length scales of superconductivity, namely the coherence length ξ₀ and the magnetic penetration depth łambda_L, within superconducting density functional theory (SCDFT). By incorporating finite-momentum Cooper pairs, we formulate a microscopic scheme that enables a consistent and parameter-free determination of ξ₀, łambda_L, and the superconducting transition temperature T_c on the same theoretical footing. Applying the method to representative elemental superconductors, the A15 compound V₃Si, and H₃S under high pressure, we obtain results in good agreement with available experimental and reproduce the type-I/type-II classification across all materials studied. The unified access to ξ₀ and łambda_L further allows us to construct the Uemura plot entirely from first principles, showing that higher-T_c systems are characterized by the simultaneous realization of strong pairing and large phase stiffness. Our results establish a predictive first-principles route to superconducting length scales and provide a microscopic interpretation of empirical correlations in superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在超导密度泛函理论框架内发展了计算超导基本长度尺度的第一性原理方法，包括相干长度 ξ₀ 和伦敦磁穿透深度 λ_L。通过纳入有限动量库珀对，作者实现了对 ξ₀、λ_L 和 T_c 的一致、无参数预测。对多种超导体的应用与实验符合良好，并从第一性原理构建了 Uemura 图，揭示高 T_c 系统兼具强配对与大相位刚度。
authors: Mitsuaki Kawamura, Takuya Nomoto, Niklas Witt, Ryotaro Arita
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在超导密度泛函理论（SCDFT）中发展了一种第一性原理框架，用于评估超导性的基本长度尺度，即相干长度 ξ₀ 和磁穿透深度 λ_L。通过引入有限动量库珀对，我们建立了一种微观方案，能够在同一理论基础上对 ξ₀、λ_L 和超导转变温度 T_c 进行一致且无参数的确定。将该方法应用于代表性元素超导体、A15 化合物 V₃Si 以及高压下的 H₃S，我们得到的结果与已有实验结果符合良好，并再现了所有所研究材料的 I 型/II 型分类。对 ξ₀ 和 λ_L 的统一获取进一步使我们能够完全从第一性原理构建 Uemura 图，表明较高 T_c 的体系以强配对和大相位刚度的同时实现为特征。我们的结果建立了一条预测超导长度尺度的第一性原理途径，并为超导性中的经验关联提供了微观解释。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作发展了基于超导密度泛函理论的第一性原理框架，用于计算超导相干长度和伦敦穿透深度。通过引入有限动量 Cooper 对，该方法可在同一理论框架下无参数预测相干长度、穿透深度和超导转变温度，并在多类超导体中得到与实验一致的结果。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在第一性原理计算、超导材料、电子-声子耦合和量子功能材料方面相关。虽然不属于团队最核心的铁电、磁性或缺陷方向，但对超导材料关键长度尺度的计算方法具有较强方法价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议关注其 SCDFT 理论实现、有限动量 Cooper 对处理以及与传统电子-声子超导计算的关系。后续可用于研究高压氢化物、拓扑超导候选材料或涡旋钉扎相关材料参数。

articles.title: Fermiology, charge transfer energy, and robust paramagnons in high-T_c cuprate superconductors
articles.title_zh: 高温铜氧化物超导体中的费米面学、电荷转移能与稳健顺磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.23281v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Copper-oxide high-temperature (high-T_c) superconductors host robust paramagnon excitations whose propagation energies are insensitive to hole concentration and correlate with maximal measured superconducting transition temperatures. Given variation of electronic structure across (and within) cuprate families, elucidation of the relationship between microscopic parameters relevant to high-T_c superconductivity and paramagnon dynamics remains a key challenge to theory. Employing canonical Hubbard- and t-J-U models of a CuO₂ plane, we relate robust paramagnon energies to high-T_c fermiology (via the ratio r equiv t^prime/|t| of next-nearest- to nearest-neighbor hopping integrals) and charge transfer energy, Δ_CT. It is shown that variation of r and Δ_CT between materials has an opposite effect on paramagnon energy, rationalizing comparable bandwidth of magnetic excitations across multiple cuprates. Utilizing empirical values of r and Δ_CT as input to theory, we address magnetic dynamics in Bi-cuprate family representatives with up to three CuO₂ planes, and demonstrate quantitative (within 6,% margin) agreement of calculated paramagnon energies with experiment. Our work offers a route toward quantitative control of robust paramagnon physics in strongly-correlated electron systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究铜氧化物高温超导体中对空穴浓度不敏感且与最高 T_c 相关的稳健顺磁振子激发。作者利用 CuO₂ 平面的 Hubbard 和 t-J-U 模型，将顺磁振子能量与费米面参数 r 及电荷转移能 Δ_CT 联系起来。结果表明二者对顺磁振子能量具有相反影响，可解释不同铜氧化物中磁激发带宽相近，并在 Bi 系铜氧化物中与实验定量符合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铜氧化物高温（high-T_c）超导体具有稳健的顺磁振子激发，其传播能量对空穴浓度不敏感，并且与所测得的最高超导转变温度相关。鉴于铜氧化物家族之间以及家族内部电子结构的变化，阐明与高 T_c 超导性相关的微观参数和顺磁振子动力学之间的关系仍然是理论面临的关键挑战。利用 CuO₂ 平面的典型 Hubbard 模型和 t-J-U 模型，我们将稳健顺磁振子能量与高 T_c 费米面学，即次近邻跃迁积分与近邻跃迁积分之比 r ≡ t'/|t|，以及电荷转移能 Δ_CT 联系起来。研究表明，不同材料之间 r 和 Δ_CT 的变化对顺磁振子能量具有相反作用，从而解释了多种铜氧化物中磁激发带宽相近的现象。利用 r 和 Δ_CT 的经验值作为理论输入，我们研究了最多含有三个 CuO₂ 平面的 Bi 系铜氧化物家族代表材料中的磁动力学，并证明计算得到的顺磁振子能量与实验在定量上符合，误差在 6% 以内。我们的工作为在强关联电子系统中定量控制稳健顺磁振子物理提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Attractive statistical forces and Pauli crystal formation in trapped Fermi gases
articles.title_zh: 俘获费米气体中的吸引性统计力与泡利晶体形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.12043v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exchange statistics endows identical particles with an effective "statistical potential", whose familiar exact form is two-body and purely repulsive for fermions. Here we construct an exact collective many-body form: the thermodynamics of N trapped ideal fermions maps onto classical distinguishable particles governed by a single potential -- exactly for harmonic confinement at all temperatures, and to leading semiclassical order for arbitrary potentials. The associated force separates canonically into pairwise contributions, which for N≥ 3 can turn attractive, governed by a simple geometric criterion. Classical minimization reproduces observed few-body Pauli-crystal symmetries and agrees with the N=55 ground-state probability maximum at sub-percent shell accuracy. Heating drives discrete structural transitions accompanied by a crossover of the strongest force from attractive to repulsive. Both the potential and its forces are directly computable from existing single-shot imaging data, turning quantum exchange into measurable classical mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构造了俘获理想费米子热力学的精确集体多体统计势表示，将其映射为受单一势支配的经典可区分粒子体系。该势对应的力可分解为成对贡献，且在 N≥3 时可由几何判据决定其转为吸引。经典极小化再现实验中的少体泡利晶体对称性，并显示加热会引发结构转变和统计力从吸引到排斥的交叉。
authors: Kawon Lee, Sangeun Oh, Young Woo Choi, Jeong-Hyuck Park
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交换统计赋予相同粒子一种有效的“统计势”，对于费米子而言，其熟悉的精确形式是二体且纯排斥的。这里我们构造了一种精确的集体多体形式：N 个俘获理想费米子的热力学可映射为由单一势支配的经典可区分粒子；对于谐振子囚禁，该映射在所有温度下精确成立，而对于任意势，则在主导半经典阶上成立。相应的力可规范地分解为成对贡献，对于 N≥3，这些贡献可以转为吸引，并受一个简单几何判据控制。经典极小化再现了已观测到的少体泡利晶体对称性，并且与 N=55 基态概率最大值在亚百分比壳层精度内一致。升温驱动离散结构转变，并伴随最强作用力从吸引到排斥的交叉。该势及其力都可以直接从现有单次成像数据中计算出来，从而将量子交换转化为可测量的经典力学。

articles.title: Direct observation of the transverse near field of an edge excitation in a fractional quantum Hall state
articles.title_zh: 分数量子霍尔态中边缘激发横向近场的直接观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.21989v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Stroboscopic time-resolved photoluminescence (PL) microscopy and spectroscopy reveal that an electrically launched edge excitation in a μ = 1/3 fractional quantum Hall (FQH) state produces an immediate PL response extending more than 30 μm into the bulk transverse to the edge when the edge magnetoplasmon (EMP) passes the mesa boundary. The nearly instantaneous nature and downstream-only appearance of this long-range response identify it as the non-radiative, quasi-electrostatic near field. We also observe a broad delayed response near the mesa boundary that evolves on a much slower time scale and gradually extends into the bulk. The coexistence of the immediate near-field response and this broad delayed response shows that an electrically launched edge excitation cannot be understood solely as a one-dimensional mode propagating along the boundary, but must instead be viewed as a structure extending in both space and time into the surrounding FQH fluid.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用频闪时间分辨光致发光显微与光谱技术，观测 μ=1/3 分数量子霍尔态中电激发边缘模式产生的横向近场响应。结果显示，当边缘磁等离激元经过台面边界时，光致发光响应几乎瞬时延伸入体区超过 30 μm，表明其为非辐射准静电近场。研究还发现较慢的延迟响应，说明电激发边缘态不是单纯一维边界传播模式，而是在空间和时间上延伸入周围 FQH 流体的结构。
authors: Yunhyeon Jeong, Akinori Kamiyama, John N. Moore, Takaaki Mano, Ken-ichi Sasaki, Yuuki Sugiyama, Tokiro Numasawa, Masahiro Hotta, Go Yusa
articles.abstract_zh_full: 频闪时间分辨光致发光（PL）显微术和光谱学揭示，在 μ=1/3 分数量子霍尔（FQH）态中，电发射的边缘激发在边缘磁等离激元（EMP）经过台面边界时会产生即时 PL 响应，该响应沿垂直于边缘的横向方向向体内延伸超过 30 μm。这种长程响应近乎瞬时的性质以及仅出现在下游方向的特征，表明它是非辐射的准静电近场。我们还在台面边界附近观察到一种宽阔的延迟响应，它在慢得多的时间尺度上演化，并逐渐延伸到体内。即时近场响应与这种宽阔延迟响应的共存表明，电发射的边缘激发不能仅仅理解为沿边界传播的一维模式，而必须被看作是在空间和时间上都延伸到周围 FQH 流体中的结构。

articles.title: Berry-Curvature Activation by Orbital Flux in a Kagome Altermagnet
articles.title_zh: Kagome 交错磁体中由轨道通量激活的贝里曲率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04984v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate topological electronic responses in a kagome altermagnetic metal hosting a compensated coplanar 120ⁱ̧rc magnetic texture. Using a minimal tight-binding model containing nearest-neighbor hopping, noncollinear exchange coupling, intrinsic spin--orbit coupling, and a time-reversal-odd loop-current order, we disentangle the magnetic, orbital, and relativistic mechanisms governing the electronic response. The exchange field produces pronounced momentum-dependent spin splitting and spin-polarized Fermi surfaces without generating a net magnetization. Nevertheless, in the absence of loop-current order, a hidden antiunitary symmetry TC₂z enforces vanishing Berry curvature and intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity, even for finite spin--orbit coupling. A directed imaginary bond order breaks this protection and activates finite Berry curvature and a sizable, strongly filling-dependent Hall response already in the nonrelativistic limit. Spin--orbit coupling subsequently reconstructs the avoided crossings and redistributes the Berry curvature, enhancing or suppressing the Hall response depending on filling. For sufficiently strong loop-current order and spin--orbit coupling, a global gap opens at nₑ₌₃, and the Hall conductivity approaches 2e²/h, consistent with an occupied-band Chern number of magnitude two. Parameter-space and filling-dependent calculations further demonstrate that the Hall-active regime extends over broad ranges of exchange coupling, spin--orbit coupling, and chemical potential and remains robust against symmetry-preserving longer-range hopping. These results identify orbital-current order as an independent route for converting a Hall-silent kagome altermagnet into an anomalous Hall metal or a gapped topological phase without net magnetization, noncoplanar spin order, or scalar spin chirality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有补偿共面 120° 磁织构的 Kagome 交错磁性金属中的拓扑电子响应。作者通过最小紧束缚模型区分磁、轨道和相对论机制，发现无环电流序时隐藏反幺正对称性会使贝里曲率和反常霍尔电导消失。定向虚键序可打破该保护并激活有限贝里曲率和填充依赖的霍尔响应，在特定条件下还可打开全局能隙并实现接近 2e²/h 的霍尔电导。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究一种 Kagome 交错磁性金属中的拓扑电子响应，该金属具有补偿的共面 120° 磁织构。利用包含近邻跃迁、非共线交换耦合、本征自旋—轨道耦合以及时间反演奇性的环电流序的最小紧束缚模型，我们分离出支配电子响应的磁性、轨道和相对论机制。交换场产生显著的动量依赖自旋劈裂和自旋极化费米面，而不产生净磁化。然而，在没有环电流序的情况下，隐藏的反幺正对称性 TC₂z 强制贝里曲率和本征反常霍尔电导为零，即使存在有限自旋—轨道耦合也是如此。定向虚键序打破这种保护，并且即使在非相对论极限下也会激活有限贝里曲率和一个显著且强烈依赖填充的霍尔响应。随后，自旋—轨道耦合重构避免交叉并重新分布贝里曲率，根据填充情况增强或抑制霍尔响应。对于足够强的环电流序和自旋—轨道耦合，在 nₑ₌₃ 处会打开全局能隙，霍尔电导接近 2e²/h，与大小为二的占据带陈数相一致。参数空间和填充依赖计算进一步表明，霍尔活性区域在交换耦合、自旋—轨道耦合和化学势的宽广范围内延伸，并且对保持对称性的长程跃迁具有稳健性。这些结果表明，轨道电流序是一条独立途径，可在没有净磁化、非共面自旋序或标量自旋手性的情况下，将霍尔静默的 Kagome 交错磁体转化为反常霍尔金属或有能隙拓扑相。

articles.title: Bilinear Flexo-Antiferrodistortive Coupling in Ferroelastics: Polar Twins, Antiphase Boundaries and Fingerprints of Alterelectricity
articles.title_zh: 铁弹体中的双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合：极性孪晶、反相边界与交电性的指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.29456v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using the Landau-Ginsburg-Devonshire approach we show that the linear gradient-type coupling between the electric polarization vector and antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter pseudovector, that has the form of Lifshitz invariant and named "bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling", can emerge in all antiferrodistortive ferroelastics, since it is symmetry-allowed. Using the four sublattices model we reveal that the bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling can induce the sublattice-sensitive polarization at the twin walls and antiphase boundaries in antiferrodistortive ferroelastics without any ferroelectric or antiferroelectric ordering. Since the induced polarization is perpendicular to the antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter and counter-directed in neighboring sublattices with checkerboard-type direction of antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter, such structure of polarization may correspond to the alterelectric-type quadrupolar electric order. However, physical manifestations of the bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling are invisible in most nanostructured antiferrodistortive ferroelectrics and antiferroelectrics due to the domination of piezoelectric and/or omnipresent linear flexoelectric couplings. The bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling can induce alterelectric-type polarization near antiferrodistortive domain boundaries in ferroelastics without any ferroelectric or antiferroelectric long-range ordering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于 Landau-Ginsburg-Devonshire 方法表明，电极化与反铁畸变长程序参量之间的线性梯度型耦合在所有反铁畸变铁弹体中由对称性允许。四子晶格模型显示，该双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合可在无铁电或反铁电长程序的体系中，于孪晶壁和反相边界诱导对子晶格敏感的极化。作者认为这种极化结构可能对应交电型四极电序，但在许多纳米结构反铁畸变铁电体和反铁电体中会被更强耦合掩盖。
authors: Eugene A. Eliseev, Anna N. Morozovska, Akash Saha, Venkatraman Gopalan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用 Landau-Ginsburg-Devonshire 方法，我们表明电极化矢量与反铁畸变长程序参量赝矢量之间的线性梯度型耦合可以出现在所有反铁畸变铁弹体中，因为它在对称性上是允许的；这种耦合具有 Lifshitz 不变量的形式，并被称为“双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合”。利用四子晶格模型，我们揭示双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合能够在没有任何铁电或反铁电有序的反铁畸变铁弹体的孪晶壁和反相边界处诱导对子晶格敏感的极化。由于诱导极化垂直于反铁畸变长程序参量，并且在具有棋盘型反铁畸变长程序参量方向的相邻子晶格中反向排列，这种极化结构可能对应于交电型四极电序。然而，在大多数纳米结构反铁畸变铁电体和反铁电体中，由于压电耦合和/或无处不在的线性挠曲电耦合占主导，双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合的物理表现不可见。双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合能够在没有任何铁电或反铁电长程序的铁弹体中，在反铁畸变畴边界附近诱导交电型极化。

articles.title: Deconfined criticality between an antiferromagnetic insulator and a nodal d-wave superconductor: a quantum Monte Carlo study
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁绝缘体与节点 d 波超导体之间的解禁闭临界性：量子蒙特卡洛研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00762v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a quantum Monte Carlo study of the transition between the insulating Néel state and the nodal d-wave superconductor on the square lattice at half-filling. We access a regime of frustrated magnetic order without a sign problem using a parton representation of the electron in terms of fermionic spinons and bosonic chargons. Both partons move in a background π-flux (so the electron experiences no net flux) and are coupled to a quantum fluctuating SU(2) lattice gauge field. In contrast to earlier studies directly on the electronic degrees of freedom, we find evidence for a second-order deconfined quantum phase transition at which both the Néel and d-wave superconductivity orders vanish continuously. We compute correlators of the spinon-chargon composite with the same quantum numbers as the electron: we find a gapless Dirac dispersion inside the d-wave superconductor, turning into a gapped dispersion in the antiferromagnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用量子蒙特卡洛方法研究半填充平方晶格上绝缘 Néel 态与节点 d 波超导体之间的相变。作者通过将电子表示为费米自旋子和玻色荷子的 parton 表象，在无符号问题下进入受挫磁有序区域，并引入涨落 SU(2) 格点规范场。结果支持一个二阶解禁闭量子相变，其中 Néel 序和 d 波超导序均连续消失，且电子量子数复合关联在超导相中呈无能隙 Dirac 色散、在反铁磁相中变为有能隙色散。
authors: Chuang Chen, Subir Sachdev, Zi Yang Meng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一项关于半填充平方晶格上绝缘 Néel 态与节点 d 波超导体之间相变的量子蒙特卡洛研究。我们利用电子的 parton 表示，即用费米型自旋子和玻色型荷子来表示电子，从而在没有符号问题的情况下进入受挫磁有序区域。两种 parton 都在背景 π 通量中运动，因此电子感受到的净通量为零，并且它们耦合到一个量子涨落的 SU(2) 格点规范场。与早期直接针对电子自由度的研究不同，我们发现了二阶解禁闭量子相变的证据，在该相变点处 Néel 序和 d 波超导序都连续消失。我们计算了具有与电子相同量子数的自旋子—荷子复合体的关联函数：我们发现其在 d 波超导体内部呈现无能隙 Dirac 色散，而在反铁磁体中转变为有能隙色散。

articles.title: Running Quantum Computers in Discovery Mode
articles.title_zh: 以发现模式运行量子计算机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.01013v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Using a 36-qubit quantum processor, we demonstrate that, by operating in conjunction with a classical machine learning agent, quantum computers can discover instances of interesting quantum many-body dynamics. The central object in this new mode of use of a quantum device is an "interest function" defined for a given circuit (family) instance that can be evaluated on a quantum computer. The circuit is adapted by the learning agent to maximize interest. We illustrate this approach using two examples and show that, within a sufficiently general circuit family, two simple interest functions based on (i) binary classifiability of evolved states and (ii) spectral properties of the unitary circuit, are maximized by discrete time crystals (DTCs) and dual-unitary circuits, respectively. For the classifiability-based interest function, we implement the protocol on a superconducting quantum processor and find that it indeed discovers DTCs with high probability. For the dual-unitaries, our simulations of the dynamics suggest that an interest-function optimization would have set us close to a discovery of such unitaries. Our results using quantum devices and accompanying simulations suggest that learning agents with access to quantum-computing resources can almost autonomously discover new phenomena in many-body quantum dynamics, and establish the design of good interest functions optimizable in hybrid devices as a paradigm for quantum many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 36 量子比特处理器展示，量子计算机可与经典机器学习代理协同，发现有趣的量子多体动力学实例。核心思想是为电路实例定义可在量子计算机上评估的“兴趣函数”，并由学习代理调整电路以最大化该函数。作者通过离散时间晶体和双酉电路两个例子说明该方法，并在超导量子处理器上实现了高概率发现 DTC 的协议。
authors: Aydin Deger, Benedikt Placke, G. J. Sreejith, Alessio Lerose, S. L. Sondhi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用一台 36 量子比特量子处理器，我们证明，通过与经典机器学习代理协同运行，量子计算机能够发现有趣的量子多体动力学实例。在这种使用量子设备的新模式中，核心对象是为给定电路（族）实例定义的“兴趣函数”，该函数可以在量子计算机上评估。学习代理调整电路以最大化兴趣。我们用两个例子说明这种方法，并表明，在足够一般的电路族中，两个简单的兴趣函数分别由离散时间晶体（DTC）和双酉电路最大化，其中前者基于演化态的二元可分类性，后者基于酉电路的谱性质。对于基于可分类性的兴趣函数，我们在超导量子处理器上实现了该协议，并发现它确实以高概率发现 DTC。对于双酉电路，我们的动力学模拟表明，兴趣函数优化会使我们接近发现这类酉电路。我们使用量子设备获得的结果以及相应模拟表明，能够访问量子计算资源的学习代理可以近乎自主地发现多体量子动力学中的新现象，并确立了在混合设备中设计可优化的良好兴趣函数作为量子多体物理学的一种范式。

articles.title: Pulsed Generation of Continuous-Variable Cluster States in a Phononic Quantum Network
articles.title_zh: 声子量子网络中连续变量簇态的脉冲生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.12529v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Cluster states are multipartite entangled states that are maximally connected and resilient to decoherence, making them valuable resources for quantum information processing. Continuous-variable (CV) cluster states have been extensively investigated for such applications. Here we present a pulsed protocol for generating CV cluster states in a phononic quantum network composed of phonon waveguides, mechanical resonators, and optical cavities. A key feature of this architecture is its modular design, where pairs of mechanical modes serve as building blocks with only local, tunable interactions between mechanical and cavity modes. We characterize the generated cluster states through the average nullifier of the CV modes. Our numerical results show that high-quality CV cluster states can be generated with moderate squeezing parameters, whereas strong squeezing and the resulting large phonon occupations can degrade the cluster states in the presence of finite dissipation. We further show that, under moderate squeezing and dissipation, the average nullifier can decrease with increasing system size N, demonstrating the scalability of the proposed scheme. As a direct application, we demonstrate that distant mechanical modes can be entangled through local measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种在由声子波导、机械谐振器和光学腔组成的声子量子网络中生成连续变量簇态的脉冲方案。该架构具有模块化设计，以成对机械模为构件，并只需机械模与腔模之间的局域可调相互作用。数值结果表明，在中等压缩和耗散下可生成高质量且可扩展的簇态，并可通过局域测量纠缠远距离机械模。
authors: A. Govindarajan, M. Mazzei, H. Wang, L. Tian
articles.abstract_zh_full: 簇态是多体纠缠态，具有最大连接性并对退相干具有鲁棒性，使其成为量子信息处理中的有价值资源。连续变量（CV）簇态已被广泛研究用于此类应用。在这里，我们提出一种用于在由声子波导、机械谐振器和光学腔组成的声子量子网络中生成 CV 簇态的脉冲协议。该架构的一个关键特征是其模块化设计，其中成对机械模作为构建模块，且只存在机械模与腔模之间的局域、可调相互作用。我们通过 CV 模的平均零化算符来表征所生成的簇态。我们的数值结果表明，使用中等压缩参数即可生成高质量 CV 簇态，而强压缩以及由此产生的大声子占据数在存在有限耗散时会使簇态退化。我们进一步表明，在中等压缩和耗散下，平均零化算符可随系统尺寸 N 的增加而减小，展示了所提方案的可扩展性。作为直接应用，我们展示了可通过局域测量使远距离机械模发生纠缠。

articles.title: Scaling Laws and Spectra of Shallow Neural Networks in the Feature Learning Regime
articles.title_zh: 特征学习区域中浅层神经网络的标度律与谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.24882v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neural scaling laws underlie many of the recent advances in deep learning, yet their theoretical understanding remains largely confined to linear models. In this work, we present a systematic analysis of scaling laws for quadratic and diagonal neural networks in the feature learning regime. Leveraging connections with matrix compressed sensing and LASSO, we derive a detailed phase diagram for the scaling exponents of the excess risk as a function of sample complexity and weight decay. This analysis uncovers crossovers between distinct scaling regimes and plateau behaviors, mirroring phenomena widely reported in the empirical neural scaling literature. Furthermore, we establish a precise link between these regimes and the spectral properties of the trained network weights, which we characterize in detail. As a consequence, we provide a theoretical validation of recent empirical observations connecting the emergence of power-law tails in the weight spectrum with network generalization performance, yielding an interpretation from first principles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统分析了特征学习区域中二次神经网络和对角神经网络的标度律。作者利用其与矩阵压缩感知和 LASSO 的联系，推导了过剩风险标度指数随样本复杂度和权重衰减变化的相图。研究揭示了不同标度区域之间的交叉和平台行为，并将这些区域与训练后权重谱性质精确联系起来，从第一性原理解释了权重谱幂律尾与泛化性能之间的经验关联。
authors: Leonardo Defilippis, Yizhou Xu, Julius Girardin, Emanuele Troiani, Vittorio Erba, Lenka Zdeborová, Bruno Loureiro, Florent Krzakala
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经标度律支撑了深度学习近期许多进展，然而其理论理解在很大程度上仍局限于线性模型。在这项工作中，我们对特征学习区域中的二次神经网络和对角神经网络的标度律进行了系统分析。借助与矩阵压缩感知和 LASSO 的联系，我们推导出过剩风险标度指数作为样本复杂度和权重衰减函数的详细相图。该分析揭示了不同标度区域之间的交叉和平台行为，这与经验神经标度文献中广泛报道的现象相呼应。此外，我们在这些区域与训练后网络权重的谱性质之间建立了精确联系，并对这些谱性质进行了详细表征。因此，我们为近期将权重谱中幂律尾的出现与网络泛化性能联系起来的经验观察提供了理论验证，并给出了第一性原理的解释。

articles.title: Marchenko Theory, Algorithms, and Applications: A Review
articles.title_zh: Marchenko 理论、算法与应用：综述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Seismic reflection data collected at the Earth's surface carry information from every depth in the subsurface, including the internal multiples that conventional migration treats as noise or artefacts. The Marchenko method retrieves subsurface Green's functions directly from these single-sided measurements. The only model information it requires is a smooth macro-velocity model, used to estimate the direct-wave traveltime from the surface to a virtual point at depth. The method originates in one-dimensional quantum mechanical inverse scattering and has been generalised over the past two decades to three-dimensional acoustic media using acoustic reciprocity theorems, and to elastic and electromagnetic media using the corresponding elastodynamic and Maxwell reciprocity theorems. This review covers the classical Gelfand--Levitan--Marchenko equation and its derivation through the Schrodinger scattering formalism, the seismic interferometry results that motivated the multidimensional extension, and the coupled Marchenko equations for wave focusing in higher dimensions. On the application side it treats Marchenko redatuming, single- and double-sided imaging conditions, internal multiple elimination, target-oriented processing, and full-waveform inversion. Extensions to dissipative media, elastodynamics, electromagnetic fields, and plane-wave acquisition are also covered, along with practical topics such as least-squares implementations, GPU acceleration, compressive-sensing acquisition, and recent machine-learning approaches to predicting the focusing functions. Field-data results from marine, land, sub-salt, and time-lapse monitoring settings are summarised. The review closes with an assessment of current limitations and open problems, among them elastic multi-component extensions, joint inversion, and neural-network accelerators.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述 Marchenko 方法的理论、算法与地震应用，该方法可从地表单侧反射测量直接恢复地下 Green 函数，并利用平滑宏观速度模型估计直达波走时。综述涵盖从一维量子逆散射到多维声学、弹性和电磁介质推广的理论基础，以及重定标、成像、多次波消除、目标处理和全波形反演等应用。文章还讨论耗散介质、GPU 加速、压缩感知、机器学习预测聚焦函数、现场数据结果及开放问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在地球表面采集的地震反射数据携带来自地下每一深度的信息，包括常规偏移会视为噪声或伪影的内部多次波。Marchenko 方法能够直接从这些单侧测量中恢复地下 Green 函数。它唯一需要的模型信息是一个平滑的宏观速度模型，用于估计从地表到地下虚拟点的直达波走时。该方法起源于一维量子力学逆散射，并在过去二十年中利用声学互易定理推广到三维声学介质，又利用相应的弹性动力学和 Maxwell 互易定理推广到弹性和电磁介质。本综述涵盖经典 Gelfand--Levitan--Marchenko 方程及其通过 Schrodinger 散射形式主义的推导、促成多维推广的地震干涉测量结果，以及用于高维波聚焦的耦合 Marchenko 方程。在应用方面，它讨论 Marchenko 重定标、单侧和双侧成像条件、内部多次波消除、目标导向处理以及全波形反演。还涵盖向耗散介质、弹性动力学、电磁场和平面波采集的扩展，以及最小二乘实现、GPU 加速、压缩感知采集和近期用于预测聚焦函数的机器学习方法等实际主题。综述总结了来自海洋、陆地、盐下和时移监测环境的现场数据结果。文章最后评估了当前局限和开放问题，其中包括弹性多分量扩展、联合反演和神经网络加速器。

articles.title: Physics-Based Molecular Fingerprints from Spectral Graph Theory Provide Efficient Geometry-Aware Measures of Chemical Similarity
articles.title_zh: 来自谱图理论的物理分子指纹提供高效且几何感知的化学相似性度量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular representations are essential for the evaluation of molecular similarity and the development of structure-property relationships. Despite the known importance of 3D structure to determine chemical and physical properties, the most widely used molecular fingerprints encode only two-dimensional connectivity. Such representations fail to distinguish similar but distinct stereoisomers and conformers. Alternative 3D methods are typically defined pairwise, making their application to large chemical spaces prohibitive, while deep learning embeddings are expressive but uninterpretable and limited by their training data diversity. Here, we introduce novel physics-inspired molecular fingerprints based on principles from spectral graph theory. We represent molecules as a complete graph in 3D space, with edge weights encoding heuristic physical interactions. Eigenvalue decomposition of the resulting graph Laplacian matrix results in a computationally efficient fixed-length chemical fingerprint that encodes 3D structure while obeying necessary physical symmetries of permutation and E(3) invariance. Spectral fingerprints differentiate between unique molecular structures with identical 2D connectivity, overcoming a limitation of 2D descriptors, while maintaining the low computational cost needed for efficient screening of vast chemical spaces. We evaluate our fingerprints with community detection algorithms and observe strong performance against representative baselines across datasets from organic, inorganic, biological, reticular, and reaction chemistry. Nearest-neighbor property estimation and applicability domain analyses reveal the utility of our molecular representation in machine learning and cheminformatics. We anticipate that spectral fingerprints will serve as generalizable, interpretable, and efficient measures of chemical similarity that incorporate 3D information at minimal cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出基于谱图理论的物理启发分子指纹，将分子表示为三维空间中的完全图，并用边权编码启发式物理相互作用。对图 Laplacian 矩阵进行特征值分解可得到固定长度、计算高效且满足置换与 E(3) 不变性的三维结构指纹。该方法能区分二维连接相同但结构不同的立体异构体和构象体，并在多类化学数据集的社区检测、近邻性质估计和适用域分析中表现良好。
authors: Jacob W. Toney, Ayleen Y. Farnood, Samir Darouich, Heather J. Kulik
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子表示对于评估分子相似性和发展结构—性质关系至关重要。尽管三维结构对于决定化学和物理性质的重要性已被认识，最广泛使用的分子指纹仍只编码二维连接性。这类表示无法区分相似但不同的立体异构体和构象体。替代性的三维方法通常是成对定义的，使其在大规模化学空间中的应用成本过高，而深度学习嵌入虽然表达能力强，但不可解释且受限于其训练数据的多样性。在这里，我们引入基于谱图理论原则的新型物理启发分子指纹。我们将分子表示为三维空间中的完全图，边权编码启发式物理相互作用。对所得图 Laplacian 矩阵进行特征值分解，会产生一种计算高效的固定长度化学指纹，该指纹编码三维结构，同时满足置换不变性和 E(3) 不变性等必要物理对称性。谱指纹能够区分具有相同二维连接性的独特分子结构，克服二维描述符的局限，同时保持筛选巨大化学空间所需的低计算成本。我们使用社区检测算法评估我们的指纹，并在来自有机、无机、生物、网状和反应化学的数据集上观察到相对于代表性基线的强性能。近邻性质估计和适用域分析揭示了我们的分子表示在机器学习和化学信息学中的实用性。我们预计谱指纹将成为一种可泛化、可解释且高效的化学相似性度量，并以最低成本纳入三维信息。

articles.title: Moving Magnetic Flux and Electromagnetic Induction
articles.title_zh: 运动磁通与电磁感应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic flux can move, and moving magnetic flux is associated with induced electric fields. Where there are multiple sources of flux, the induced electric field is the vector resultant of the induced fields attributable to the fluxes acting individually; it is not necessarily associated with the resultant magnetic field. The key insight is that flux can move through regions in which the magnetic field itself vanishes, much as electric charge can move (as electric current) through a region in which the net charge density is zero. For this reason, moving flux can account for the induced emf around a long solenoid in which the current is changing. It also accounts for unipolar induction, and this account is testable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出磁通可以运动，而运动磁通会伴随感生电场。当存在多个磁通源时，总感生电场应由各磁通单独产生的感生场矢量叠加得到，并不必然与合磁场相关。该观点可解释长螺线管变流时的感生电动势以及单极感应，并具有可检验性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁通可以运动，而运动的磁通与感生电场相关联。当存在多个磁通来源时，感生电场是可归因于各个磁通单独作用所产生感生场的矢量合成；它不一定与合成磁场相关联。关键洞见在于，磁通可以穿过磁场本身为零的区域，这很像电荷可以作为电流穿过净电荷密度为零的区域。由于这个原因，运动磁通可以解释长螺线管中电流变化时环绕其周围的感生电动势。它也解释了单极感应，而且这种解释是可检验的。

articles.title: Data-driven reconstruction of dynamical systems using Takens' Theorem, manifold learning, and universal function approximators
articles.title_zh: 利用 Takens 定理、流形学习与通用函数逼近器的数据驱动动力系统重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Embedding theorems can be used to provide theoretical guarantees about the relation between low-dimensional observations of a system and its full-dimensional state and dynamics. Such theorems do not, however, provide guidance on observable choice, embedding construction, or methodologies to learn the mapping between the embedding and full-dimensional state. In this work, we develop an algorithmic framework, TAkens Reconstruction (TAR), to analyze and reconstruct arbitrary dynamical systems from low-dimensional time series using an integration of Takens' Delay Embedding Theorem, manifold learning techniques, and universal function approximators. We validate TAR in applications to a variety of simulated and observed dynamical systems and use it to investigate how delay vector structure impacts reconstruction accuracy. In an ecological system, we show that simple predator-prey dynamics can be reconstructed with observations taken over a wide variety of embedding time scales. In molecular dynamics simulations of the protein Villin, we demonstrate how including multiple time delays of the same observable series can be used to improve reconstruction of systems with multiple characteristic time scales. In the trade record of Vanguard S&P 500, we show how the approach exposes underlying dynamical phenomenologies in the data and accurate return predictions over short time horizons without access to full-dimensional market observations. We develop and release an open-source software package to enable the application of TAR to arbitrary dynamical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 TAkens Reconstruction（TAR）算法框架，将 Takens 延迟嵌入定理、流形学习和通用函数逼近器结合起来，从低维时间序列分析并重构任意动力系统。作者在生态系统、蛋白质分子动力学和金融交易记录等模拟与观测系统中验证了该方法，并研究延迟向量结构对重构精度的影响。结果表明 TAR 可在多时间尺度系统和短期预测任务中揭示并重构潜在动力学，作者还发布了开源软件包。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 嵌入定理可用于为系统低维观测与其全维状态和动力学之间的关系提供理论保证。然而，这类定理并不提供关于可观测量选择、嵌入构造或学习嵌入与全维状态之间映射的方法论指导。在本工作中，我们发展了一种算法框架 TAkens Reconstruction（TAR），通过整合 Takens 延迟嵌入定理、流形学习技术和通用函数逼近器，从低维时间序列分析并重构任意动力系统。我们在多种模拟和观测动力系统的应用中验证了 TAR，并用它研究延迟向量结构如何影响重构精度。在一个生态系统中，我们表明，可以用在多种嵌入时间尺度上取得的观测来重构简单的捕食者—猎物动力学。在蛋白质 Villin 的分子动力学模拟中，我们展示了如何通过纳入同一可观测序列的多个时间延迟来改进具有多个特征时间尺度系统的重构。在 Vanguard S&P 500 的交易记录中，我们展示了该方法如何揭示数据中潜在的动力学现象，并在无法获得全维市场观测的情况下对短时间范围内的收益进行准确预测。我们开发并发布了一个开源软件包，以支持将 TAR 应用于任意动力系统。

articles.title: Inverse mask design for interference lithography using automatic differentiable wave propagation
articles.title_zh: 利用自动可微波传播进行干涉光刻反掩模设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05488v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interference lithography (IL) is powerful for fabricating high-resolution periodic nanostructures, but designing masks to produce non-periodic patterns remains challenging. We introduce a gradient-based optimization framework for binary IL mask design using automatic differentiation. The forward model is implemented using the differentiable angular spectrum method (ASM). The inverse mask design is formulated as an optimization problem, where the mask logits are updated through backpropagation of the loss between the simulated field amplitude and the target pattern. We optimize a mask that reproduces a target pattern with only 0.1% isolated pixel-level defects, resolving features at half the mask pixel pitch. To scale mask optimization, we employ the shifted ASM, which partitions the mask into patches that are propagated independently and summed at the image plane. For a 3.84 mm×3.84 mm mask, shifted ASM with 16 patches reduces peak GPU memory by 3.8× at only 1.3× runtime cost relative to standard ASM. With gradient checkpointing, peak memory is reduced by 7.4× at 2× runtime. Distributing across multiple GPUs further accelerates the optimization. This work establishes a physics-informed, machine learning-driven approach for IL mask design, moving a step further towards complex, non-periodic patterns. The source code is available at https://github.com/chuntian236/holography-optimization.git .
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于梯度优化的二值干涉光刻掩模设计框架，利用自动微分和可微角谱法建立正向传播模型。作者将反掩模设计表述为优化问题，通过反向传播目标图案与模拟场振幅之间的损失来更新掩模 logits。该方法可高质量重现目标图案，并通过 shifted ASM、梯度检查点和多 GPU 分布式计算降低显存需求、提升可扩展性。
authors: Chuntian Cao, Jangwoon Sung, Jack Griffiths, Yuan Gao, Xi Yu, Paul Baity, Nikhil Tiwale, Zhitian Shi, Juhong Ahn, Shinjae Yoo, Yong S. Chu, Chang-Yong Nam
articles.abstract_zh_full: 干涉光刻（IL）在制备高分辨率周期性纳米结构方面非常有力，但设计用于产生非周期图案的掩模仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种用于二值 IL 掩模设计的基于梯度的优化框架，该框架使用自动微分。正向模型采用可微角谱法（ASM）实现。反掩模设计被表述为一个优化问题，其中掩模 logits 通过模拟场振幅与目标图案之间损失的反向传播来更新。我们优化得到的掩模能够重现目标图案，且仅有 0.1% 的孤立像素级缺陷，并能分辨达到掩模像素间距一半的特征。为扩展掩模优化规模，我们采用 shifted ASM，该方法将掩模划分为若干块，独立传播后在像面求和。对于 3.84 mm×3.84 mm 的掩模，相对于标准 ASM，使用 16 个分块的 shifted ASM 在运行时间仅增加 1.3 倍的情况下，将 GPU 峰值显存降低 3.8 倍。结合梯度检查点，峰值显存降低 7.4 倍，运行时间为 2 倍。跨多 GPU 分布式计算进一步加速了优化。本工作建立了一种物理信息引导、机器学习驱动的 IL 掩模设计方法，使复杂非周期图案的实现更进一步。源代码已公开。

articles.title: Dual-polarization control of broadband nonreciprocal thermal radiation by combining local and nonlocal metasurfaces
articles.title_zh: 结合局域与非局域超表面实现宽带非互易热辐射的双偏振控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05640v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal thermal radiation offers a route to decouple spectral directional absorptivity and emissivity, thereby enabling new paradigms in thermal-photonic systems. However, in magneto-optical platforms, the intrinsic gyroelectric response generally confines observable nonreciprocity to transverse-magnetic (TM) polarization, while the transverse-electric (TE) response is absent. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate, for the first time, a local thermal metasurface strategy to activate TE-polarized nonreciprocity by creating artificial gyromagnetic response in a gyroelectric semiconductor platform. We further extend this mechanism to broadband dual-polarization operation employing a nonlocal thermal metasurface, which combines a resonator supercell with gradient-doped epsilon-near-zero magneto-optical multilayers. Pronounced absorptivity contrast is maintained over 22-27 μm for TE polarization and 19-27 μm for TM polarization. This platform provides a mechanism-based route to achieve broadband and dual-polarization nonreciprocal thermal absorption, opening new opportunities for advancing radiative energy-conversion devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次实验展示了一种局域热超表面策略，通过在回旋电半导体平台中产生人工回旋磁响应来激活 TE 偏振非互易性。作者进一步利用非局域热超表面实现宽带双偏振工作，将谐振器超晶胞与梯度掺杂近零介电常数磁光多层结构结合。该平台为宽带、双偏振非互易热吸收提供了基于机制的实现路径，有望推动辐射能量转换器件发展。
authors: Shuang Xia, Mengqi Liu, Wenjian Wan, Jialong Wang, Weihao Yang, Chaoran Wang, Huiqin Ma, Jun Qin, Hua Li, Yuan Wang, Lei Bi, Chengwei Qiu, Xiaobo Yin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非互易热辐射提供了一条解耦光谱方向吸收率与发射率的途径，从而为热光子系统带来新的范式。然而，在磁光平台中，内禀回旋电响应通常将可观测的非互易性限制在横磁（TM）偏振，而横电（TE）响应缺失。在本工作中，我们首次通过实验展示了一种局域热超表面策略，通过在回旋电半导体平台中创造人工回旋磁响应来激活 TE 偏振非互易性。我们进一步将这一机制扩展到宽带双偏振工作，采用一种非局域热超表面，该超表面将谐振器超晶胞与梯度掺杂的近零介电常数磁光多层结构相结合。在 TE 偏振的 22–27 μm 范围内以及 TM 偏振的 19–27 μm 范围内，显著的吸收率对比得以保持。该平台为实现宽带和双偏振非互易热吸收提供了一条基于机制的路径，为推进辐射能量转换器件开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: BORAY-3D: A ray tracing code for three-dimensional magnetized plasma configurations
articles.title_zh: BORAY-3D：用于三维磁化等离子体构型的射线追踪程序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05667v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ray tracing codes are useful tools for studying electromagnetic wave propagation and absorption using the geometrical-optics approximation. Existing codes commonly provide either broad radio-frequency coverage in axisymmetric equilibria or three-dimensional capability specialized for electron-cyclotron (EC) applications. BORAY-3D integrates three desirable features in a single version. First, it has a broad frequency range of validity regime from ion-cyclotron, helicon and lower-hybrid waves to EC waves and emission. Second, it provides a unified treatment of arbitrary two- and three-dimensional magnetic-plasma configurations, including both closed and open field-line regions. Third, it incorporates fully relativistic Maxwellian EC absorption. The code extends the axisymmetric BORAY formulation by solving the ray equations in cylindrical coordinates (r,φ,z) while allowing the toroidal mode number n_φ to vary. Magnetic-field, density and temperature data are directly described in (r,φ,z) coordinates without the restriction of flux functions, so that numerical equilibria and analytic field models can be handled in the same form. The non-relativistic hot-plasma model inherited from BORAY is used for lower-hybrid, ion-cyclotron and helicon absorption, whereas the relativistic model is coupled to reciprocal radiative transfer for electron cyclotron emission (ECE). Practical applications include 13.56 MHz helicon and 50 MHz fast waves, a 3.7 GHz lower-hybrid wave, and 115--220 GHz EC emission. BORAY-3D has been systematically benchmarked against GENRAY for tokamak toroidal-field ripple, Raytrax and TRAVIS for W7-X, as well as public HSX heating and W7-X ECE results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍 BORAY-3D，一种面向三维磁化等离子体构型的射线追踪代码，覆盖从离子回旋、螺旋波和低杂波到电子回旋波及辐射的宽频率适用范围。该代码统一处理任意二维和三维磁等离子体构型，并纳入完全相对论 Maxwell 分布电子回旋吸收模型。作者通过多种应用案例和与现有代码、公开结果的系统基准比较验证了 BORAY-3D。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 射线追踪代码是利用几何光学近似研究电磁波传播和吸收的有用工具。现有代码通常要么在轴对称平衡中提供宽射频覆盖范围，要么具备专门用于电子回旋（EC）应用的三维能力。BORAY-3D 在单一版本中整合了三个理想特性。第一，它具有宽频率适用范围，从离子回旋、螺旋波和低杂波到 EC 波与辐射。第二，它提供对任意二维和三维磁等离子体构型的统一处理，包括闭合和开放磁力线区域。第三，它纳入完全相对论 Maxwell 分布的 EC 吸收。该代码通过在柱坐标（r,φ,z）中求解射线方程，同时允许环向模数 n_φ 变化，从而扩展了轴对称 BORAY 形式。磁场、密度和温度数据直接在（r,φ,z）坐标中描述，不受通量函数限制，因此数值平衡和解析场模型可以用同一形式处理。继承自 BORAY 的非相对论热等离子体模型用于低杂波、离子回旋和螺旋波吸收，而相对论模型则与用于电子回旋辐射（ECE）的互易辐射传输相耦合。实际应用包括 13.56 MHz 螺旋波和 50 MHz 快波、3.7 GHz 低杂波以及 115–220 GHz EC 辐射。BORAY-3D 已针对托卡马克环向场纹波与 GENRAY、针对 W7-X 与 Raytrax 和 TRAVIS，以及针对公开 HSX 加热和 W7-X ECE 结果进行了系统基准测试。

articles.title: SafeDivertor: Faithful Divertor Heat Flux Reconstruction from Macroscopic Plasma State Signals via Time-Frequency Prior Exploitation
articles.title_zh: SafeDivertor：通过利用时频先验从宏观等离子体状态信号忠实重构偏滤器热通量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05669v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Divertor heat-flux analysis is essential for understanding plasma-wall interactions and protecting plasma-facing components in magnetic-confinement fusion devices, while conventional infrared-based inversion is usually performed after discharge and requires heat-conduction modeling with device-specific material properties, divertor geometry, and boundary conditions. Rather than accelerating this conventional infrared-based inversion paradigm, we introduce a new online-oriented signal-based reconstruction paradigm that directly reconstructs time-resolved radial heat-flux profiles from multi-source macroscopic plasma-state signals available during discharge. To enable systematic study of this task, we construct DivMPS2HF, a multi-source discharge dataset that provides the data foundation and benchmark for signal-based divertor heat-flux reconstruction. We further propose SafeDivertor, a task-driven framework designed to address the key challenges of signal-based heat-flux reconstruction. It employs physical prior-aware initialization to provide radial-distribution guidance for target channels, input perturbation to reduce over-reliance on specific heterogeneous signals, spectral-aware reconstruction optimization to exploit time-frequency priors and preserve transient dynamics, and progressive training to stabilize the optimization of these complementary objectives. Experiments on DivMPS2HF demonstrate that SafeDivertor achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated time-series baselines across all five metrics, establishing a new performance benchmark for signal-based divertor heat-flux reconstruction. The source code will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向在线应用的信号驱动偏滤器热通量重构范式，直接从放电期间可用的多源宏观等离子体状态信号重构随时间变化的径向热通量剖面。作者构建 DivMPS2HF 数据集，并提出 SafeDivertor 框架，以物理先验初始化、输入扰动、频谱感知优化和渐进训练应对关键挑战。实验显示 SafeDivertor 在五项指标上整体优于所评估的时间序列基线，为信号驱动热通量重构建立了新基准。
authors: Hao Si, Zehua Chen, Qingquan Yang, Xiao Wang, Dengdi Sun, Wanli Lyu, Gaoting Chen, Guosheng Xu, Hang Su, Jin Tang, Jun Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 偏滤器热通量分析对于理解等离子体—壁相互作用以及保护磁约束聚变装置中的面向等离子体部件至关重要，而传统的基于红外的反演通常在放电之后进行，并且需要包含装置特定材料性质、偏滤器几何和边界条件的热传导建模。我们并非加速这种传统的基于红外的反演范式，而是引入一种新的面向在线的基于信号的重构范式，该范式直接从放电期间可获得的多源宏观等离子体状态信号重构时间分辨的径向热通量剖面。为支持对该任务的系统研究，我们构建了 DivMPS2HF，一个多源放电数据集，为基于信号的偏滤器热通量重构提供数据基础和基准。我们进一步提出 SafeDivertor，这是一个任务驱动框架，旨在解决基于信号的热通量重构中的关键挑战。它采用物理先验感知初始化，为目标通道提供径向分布指导；采用输入扰动，减少对特定异构信号的过度依赖；采用频谱感知重构优化，以利用时频先验并保留瞬态动力学；并采用渐进训练来稳定这些互补目标的优化。DivMPS2HF 上的实验表明，SafeDivertor 在所有五项指标上相对于所评估的时间序列基线取得最佳整体性能，为基于信号的偏滤器热通量重构建立了新的性能基准。源代码将公开发布。

articles.title: Foundation Model-Assisted Full Waveform Inversion
articles.title_zh: 基础模型辅助的全波形反演
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05763v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Full waveform inversion (FWI) can recover high-resolution subsurface velocity models. Conventional waveform-difference objectives, however, are vulnerable to cycle skipping when the starting model is inaccurate. We introduce an FWI objective that compares features produced from modeled and observed seismic traces by SeisLM, a pretrained seismic foundation model. The SeisLM encoder remains frozen during inversion, and the feature discrepancy is differentiated with respect to the modeled traces to construct an adjoint source compatible with the standard adjoint-state framework. We also test a scheduled hybrid loss that combines the SeisLM feature loss with the conventional L₂ objective. Time-shift diagnostics show that the loss computed from features produced by the pretrained encoder has a broader and smoother basin around the correct alignment than either the waveform L₂ objective or the feature loss obtained from an encoder with the same architecture and randomly initialized parameters. In the Marmousi experiment, the SeisLM and hybrid objectives produce similar improvements during early-stage inversion and provide useful models for subsequent reflection-based L₂ refinement. In the 2D Overthrust experiment, which begins from a laterally invariant linear-gradient model, the SeisLM feature-loss workflow outperforms the conventional and hybrid workflows, indicating that introducing the L₂ contribution too early can reintroduce cycle-skipping sensitivity. In the 3D Overthrust experiment, conventional L₂ inversion stalls near the initial linear gradient, whereas the SeisLM feature loss guides the inversion toward a background model from which L₂ refinement recovers the principal structures. These results support using features produced by pretrained seismic networks to define early-stage FWI objectives rather than complete replacements for waveform-domain misfits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种利用预训练地震基础模型 SeisLM 特征来定义全波形反演目标函数的方法，以缓解初始模型不准确时传统波形差异目标易发生的周跳问题。SeisLM 编码器在反演过程中保持冻结，特征差异被反传到模拟地震道以构造与标准伴随状态框架兼容的伴随源。多个 Marmousi、2D/3D Overthrust 实验表明，SeisLM 特征损失适合作为早期 FWI 目标，并可为后续传统 L₂ 精细反演提供更好的背景模型。
authors: Mustafa Alfarhan, Matteo Ravasi, Fuqiang Chen, George Turkiyyah, David Keyes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全波形反演（FWI）可以恢复高分辨率地下速度模型。然而，当起始模型不准确时，传统的波形差异目标容易受到周跳影响。我们引入一种 FWI 目标，该目标比较由 SeisLM（一种预训练地震基础模型）从建模和观测地震道中产生的特征。在反演过程中，SeisLM 编码器保持冻结，特征差异相对于建模地震道求导，以构造与标准伴随状态框架兼容的伴随源。我们还测试了一种调度式混合损失，将 SeisLM 特征损失与传统 L₂ 目标结合起来。时移诊断表明，由预训练编码器产生的特征所计算的损失，在正确对齐附近具有比波形 L₂ 目标或由相同架构但随机初始化参数的编码器得到的特征损失更宽且更平滑的盆地。在 Marmousi 实验中，SeisLM 和混合目标在早期反演阶段产生相似改进，并为随后的基于反射的 L₂ 精细化提供有用模型。在二维 Overthrust 实验中，该实验从横向不变的线性梯度模型开始，SeisLM 特征损失工作流优于传统和混合工作流，表明过早引入 L₂ 贡献可能重新引入对周跳的敏感性。在三维 Overthrust 实验中，传统 L₂ 反演停滞在接近初始线性梯度的位置，而 SeisLM 特征损失引导反演走向一个背景模型，使 L₂ 精细化能够恢复主要结构。这些结果支持使用预训练地震网络产生的特征来定义早期 FWI 目标，而不是将其作为波形域失配的完全替代。

articles.title: Rotational spectra and de-perturbation analysis for ground state ytterbium oxide, YbO
articles.title_zh: 基态氧化镱 YbO 的转动光谱与去微扰分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A combination difference analysis of Fourier transform microwave spectroscopy (FTMW) measurements of ¹⁷⁴YbO combined with earlier near-infrared chemiluminescence data have resulted in much improved YbO rotational and centrifugal distortion constants. These have been confirmed in a multi-isotopologue analysis of further FTMW measurements of ¹⁷²YbO and ¹⁷⁶YbO and an analysis of nuclear-size-dependent Born-Oppenheimer breakdown effects in the molecule. Multiple excited electronic states overlap with low-lying excited vibrational levels of the electronic ground state leading to irregularities in its vibrational spacings and other previously observed electronic manifolds. This has been modeled with a matrix of the vibrational levels of the ground and multiple interacting states assuming Morse potentials and including electronic Hamiltonian matrix elements mixing the states. Vibrational level overlaps were calculated numerically assuming Morse vibrational wavefunctions. The resulting de-perturbed potentials for the states inform continuing experimental and theoretical work on this and other ytterbium-containing molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合 ¹⁷⁴YbO 的傅里叶变换微波光谱测量和早期近红外化学发光数据，通过组合差分析显著改进了 YbO 的转动常数和离心畸变常数。作者进一步通过 ¹⁷²YbO、¹⁷⁶YbO 多同位素体 FTMW 测量和核尺寸相关 Born-Oppenheimer 破缺效应分析进行验证。研究还建立了包含基态与多个相互作用电子态振动态的矩阵模型，得到去微扰势能面，为含镱分子的后续实验与理论研究提供依据。
authors: Richard J. Mawhorter, Sean Jackson, Charles Brainin, Trevor J. Sears, Peter F. Bernath, Philipp Buschmann, Jens-Uwe Grabow
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对 ¹⁷⁴YbO 的傅里叶变换微波光谱（FTMW）测量结合早期近红外化学发光数据所进行的组合差分析，得到了大幅改进的 YbO 转动常数和离心畸变常数。这些结果在对 ¹⁷²YbO 和 ¹⁷⁶YbO 的进一步 FTMW 测量的多同位素体分析，以及对分子中核尺寸相关 Born-Oppenheimer 破缺效应的分析中得到了确认。多个激发电子态与电子基态的低位激发振动态发生重叠，导致其振动间隔以及其他先前观测到的电子流形中出现不规则性。对此，我们用一个包含基态和多个相互作用态振动能级的矩阵进行建模，假设 Morse 势，并纳入混合这些态的电子哈密顿矩阵元。在假设 Morse 振动波函数的情况下，振动能级重叠通过数值方法计算。由此得到的这些态的去微扰势能为关于该分子及其他含镱分子的持续实验和理论工作提供了信息。

articles.title: Twist-angle Control of Nonlinear Interference in a ZnO Nanowire/Monolayer WSe₂ Hybrid Structure
articles.title_zh: ZnO纳米线/单层WSe₂杂化结构中非线性干涉的扭转角控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nanoscale devices that integrate materials of different dimensionalities (0D, 1D, and 2D) hold great potential for advanced applications in photonics and optoelectronics. A fundamental requirement for the development of such devices is the engineering and control of light-matter interactions beyond the simple enhancement or quenching of linear and nonlinear optical emission. In this study, we demonstrate control over nanoscale light-matter interactions by achieving twist-angle tunability of the nonlinear optical response in a hybrid system composed of a ZnO nanowire and a monolayer of WSe₂.
