Reflectivity spectra were calculated using the ABCD transfer matrix formalism, and the optimized structure was subsequently analyzed using experimentally reported refractive indices of healthy and malaria-infected RBCs. The optimized graphene–MoS₂ configuration operating at 1100 nm achieved angular sensitivities of 198.08 Deg/RIU and 201.52 Deg/RIU for refractive-index variations of 0.005 and 0.007 RIU, respectively, with a relatively narrow FWHM of 7.43°. Distinct reflectivity responses were obtained for healthy RBCs (0.9530 a.u.) and malaria-infected cells at the ring (0.9439 a.u.), trophozoite (0.8946 a.u.), and schizont (0.8193 a.u.) stages. These results demonstrate that graphene/TMDC hybrid plasmonic structures can substantially improve SPR sensing performance and highlight the potential of the proposed platform for label-free discrimination of malaria infection stages based on refractive-index variations. The presented optimization strategy may also provide useful design guidelines for next-generation plasmonic biosensors operating in the near-infrared region.

articles.title: Can Octopus maya win the climate change fight through resilience to maternal heat stress?
articles.abstract: Embryonic development in cephalopods is a critical phase characterized by high energy demands, high metabolic production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and limited aerobic flexibility. As postulated in Octopus maya, maternal heat stress transfers ROS and oxidative damage to offspring, potentially compromising their ability to cope with ocean warming scenarios. The present study evaluated whether embryos and early juveniles from females subjected to heat stress (30°C) regulate their respiratory metabolism, activate antioxidant mechanisms, and modulate oxidative balance throughout development. Routine, maximum and standard metabolic rates, aerobic capacity, antioxidant enzyme activity, superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and glutathione S-transferase (GST), oxidative damage (lipid peroxidation and protein oxidation), total glutathione levels, and esterase activity were measured in embryos and juveniles maintained at 24, 26, and 30°C. Embryos were found receiving a high ROS load, which in addition were produced by the embryos during development. This double ROS load caused deformities and high embryonic mortality, associated with the inability of this life cycle phase to neutralize the oxidative damage produced by ROS. In the juvenile stage, animals maintained at 24°C showed metabolic and morphological recovery, while those incubated at 30°C showed smaller body size, accelerated yolk depletion, and antioxidant system disruption. Intermediate values were observed in juveniles maintained at 26°C. The results suggest that maternal heat stress profoundly affects the embryonic stage of O. maya. However, juveniles hatching in a suitable thermal environment (24°C) showed physiological mechanisms to neutralize the negative maternal stress effects, suggesting that populations may persist under these conditions.

articles.title: Structured Semantic Supervision for Annotation-Scarce Composed Image Retrieval
articles.abstract: Objectives: Composed image retrieval (CIR) identifies a target image by combining a reference image with a textual modification, enabling fine-grained visual search such as preserving an object while changing its attributes. Existing methods often rely on manually annotated triplets or unconstrained generated descriptions, limiting adaptation to target domains where labelled composed queries are scarce.  Methods: This paper investigates zero-shot target-domain adaptation for CIR through structured semantic supervision. The proposed framework uses an offline vision-language and language-model agent to convert unlabeled images into structured semantic anchors containing global descriptions, attributes, and entities. These anchors replace free-form caption supervision with a low-entropy, field-constrained interface for edit-related semantics. The framework then infers target-side anchors from reference anchors and modification texts, and learns a query-slot-driven multi-vector representation that separates subject preservation from attribute variation. A multi-view masked learning strategy aligns gallery indexing, attribute-aware supervision, and online query modeling under different information-visibility conditions.  Results: Experiments on FashionIQ and CIRR show that the approach improves zero-shot retrieval performance in fine-grained fashion scenarios while maintaining competitive open-domain retrieval ability. On FashionIQ, it achieves Avg R@10 = 31.81 and Avg R@50 = 53.07, outperforming the strongest compared zero-shot baseline by 2.42 and 2.19 percentage points, respectively. On CIRR, it obtains R@1 = 24.20, R@5 = 55.18, R@10 = 66.71, and R@50 = 90.30.  Conclusion: The results suggest that structured semantic supervision offers a controllable route for adapting CIR models without manually annotated triplets, while revealing remaining challenges in relational reasoning, viewpoint change, and reproducible generated supervision.

articles.title: Magnetophoretic modulation of BaSO4 scaling: laboratory investigation and industrial case study
articles.title_zh: 磁泳调控 BaSO4 结垢：实验室研究与工业案例分析
articles.abstract: Scale formation in supersaturated BaSO4-bearing �uids poses a persistent challenge in domestic and industrial settings due to the scalant's extremely low solubility, high mechanical strength, and resistance to removal. We revisit the long-standing question of whether magnetic fields can mitigate such a scaling. Under our current experimental conditions, our analysis shows that magnetic-field effects on BaSO4-bearing �uids are negligible in magnetically clean �uids. In �uids containing ferromagnetic or ferrimagnetic particulates, which are common in practical settings, strong field gradients can induce particle polarization and magnetophoretic drift, promoting the coalescence of nanoscale particles into larger agglomerates. These agglomerates can act as heterogeneous  nucleation templates, thereby modifying crystallization kinetics and deposit morphology. As a result, precipitation may be partially redirected from undesirable surface-bound fouling toward volume-bound suspended particulates that remain entrained in the �ow and can be more readily removed. This shift toward heterogeneous nucleation and growth provides a possible �eld- and contamination-mediated mechanism for rationalizing many disparate reports on magnetic anti-scale treatment across laboratory, domestic, and industrial settings, including hydrocarbon oil and gas environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 过饱和的含 BaSO4 流体会形成结垢，由于该结垢物溶解度极低、机械强度高且难以去除，因此在家庭和工业环境中都长期存在挑战。作者重新审视了磁场是否能够缓解此类结垢这一长期问题。结果表明，在磁净化的流体中，磁场效应几乎可以忽略；而在含有铁磁性或亚铁磁性颗粒的流体中，强磁场梯度可诱导颗粒极化和磁泳漂移，促进纳米颗粒聚并为更大的团聚体，从而改变成核与沉积形貌。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过饱和的含 BaSO4 流体中的结垢形成，在家庭和工业环境中都构成了持续性挑战，因为这种结垢物具有极低的溶解度、高机械强度以及难以去除等特性。我们重新审视了一个长期存在的问题，即磁场是否能够缓解这种结垢。在我们当前的实验条件下，分析表明，在磁净化的流体中，磁场对含 BaSO4 流体的影响可以忽略不计。对于含有铁磁性或亚铁磁性颗粒的流体，这类颗粒在实际场景中很常见，强磁场梯度可诱导颗粒极化和磁泳漂移，促进纳米尺度颗粒并合为更大的团聚体。这些团聚体可作为异质成核模板，从而改变结晶动力学和沉积形貌。结果，沉淀可能会部分从不希望出现的表面附着结垢，转向体相中的悬浮颗粒；这些颗粒仍被带入流动中，因此更容易被去除。这种向异质成核和生长转变的过程，为解释实验室、家庭和工业环境中关于磁性防垢处理的许多差异较大的报道提供了一种可能的、由磁场与污染共同介导的机制，包括烃类油气环境中的应用。

articles.abstract: Author(s): Yuchi Yang and Yusheng Hou Here, the authors focus on a representative pair of simple closed-pocket Fermi surfaces in hole-doped RuO 2 and establish a quasilinear correlation between the local magnetic moment of Ru atoms and quantum-oscillation-based signature of spin splitting. Combined with the distinct quantum oscillation characteristics of the nonmagnetic, intermediate, and stable altermagnetic regimes, this correlation provides experimentally accessible fingerprints for identifying magnetic states and tracking altermagnetic spin splitting in hole-doped RuO 2 . [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094410] Published Thu Aug 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者聚焦于空穴掺杂 RuO2 中一对具有简单闭合口袋的代表性费米面，并建立了 Ru 原子局域磁矩与基于量子振荡的自旋分裂特征之间的准线性相关。结合非磁、中间态和稳定交替磁性区的不同量子振荡特征，这一相关性为识别磁态以及追踪空穴掺杂 RuO2 中的交替磁性自旋分裂提供了实验上可获取的指纹。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出了在空穴掺杂 RuO₂ 中识别 altermagnetism 的量子振荡指纹。作者建立了局域磁矩与自旋分裂特征之间的准线性关系，为实验识别不同磁态提供了可观测信号。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们关注的 altermagnetism、磁性拓扑性质和自旋分裂输运直接相关，也适合用第一性原理与电子结构方法进一步分析。对理解磁有序与量子振荡响应之间的联系有较强参考价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可继续结合第一性原理、Wannier 插值和输运计算，系统评估不同掺杂和应变下的自旋分裂与量子振荡特征。也可拓展到其他候选 altermagnet 材料，筛选更易实验探测的体系。

articles.abstract_zh_full: 《美国国家科学院院刊》，第123卷，第32期，2026年8月。意义：在复杂的生理固—液界面中导航是微型机器人面临的一项重大挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种由协同光场和磁场驱动的微型机器人，这种驱动由嵌入的磁性……的光热效应实现。

articles.title: Economised path integrals
articles.title_zh: 经济化路径积分
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06414v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Hessian of the ring polymer spring potential in the standard Trotter path integral is a P× P symmetric circulant matrix with a centroid eigenvalue of zero. All such matrices commute and are diagonalised by the same bead to normal mode transformation matrix, and their eigenvalues contain łceil P/2c̊eil-1 degenerate pairs by symmetry. However, this still leaves some freedom to improve on the Trotter approximation: one can optimise the remaining łfloor P/2f̊loor independent non-zero normal mode frequencies to fit the exact quantum mechanical radii of gyration of harmonic ring polymers with frequencies in the range 0łeømegałeømegaₘ̊ ₘₐₓ, where ømegaₘ̊ ₘₐₓ is the maximum physical frequency in the problem of interest. The optimisation involves solving a simple least squares problem for the optimum (economised or "Eco") internal mode frequencies. The remainder of the calculation then proceeds in the same way as a Trotter path integral calculation. An example application to hexagonal ice shows that the convergence of the Eco path integral is comparable to that of the 4th order Suzuki-Chin path integral, but with purely 2nd order Trotter effort. There is no need to calculate the projected Hessians that arise in the Suzuki-Chin method by finite differences, there is no need to develop any new estimators for observables, and once the Eco frequencies have been calculated the implementation of the Eco path integral involves changing just a few lines of a Trotter path integral code. To provide a more impressive example we have implemented the Eco method in GPUMD and used it to converge the (negative) thermal expansion coefficient and the constant pressure heat capacity of MOF-5 with a machine-learned neuroevolution potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种“经济化”（Eco）路径积分方法，通过优化环聚合物内部正常模频率来改进标准Trotter路径积分在给定物理频率范围内的表现。该方法保持二阶Trotter计算代价，却在六方冰等示例中达到与四阶Suzuki-Chin路径积分相近的收敛性。作者还将其实现于GPUMD，并用于收敛MOF-5的负热膨胀系数和定压热容。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.06414v3，公告类型：替换交叉。摘要：标准Trotter路径积分中环聚合物弹簧势的Hessian是一个P×P的对称循环矩阵，其质心本征值为零。所有这类矩阵彼此对易，并由同一个从珠粒到正常模的变换矩阵对角化，而且由于对称性，它们的本征值包含⌈P/2⌉−1个简并对。然而，这仍然留下了一些改进Trotter近似的自由度：可以优化剩余的⌊P/2⌋个独立非零正常模频率，使其拟合频率范围0≤ω≤ωmax内谐振子环聚合物的精确量子力学回转半径，其中ωmax是所关心问题中的最大物理频率。该优化涉及求解一个简单的最小二乘问题，以得到最优的内部模频率，即经济化或“Eco”频率。随后计算的其余部分以与Trotter路径积分计算相同的方式进行。对六方冰的一个应用示例表明，Eco路径积分的收敛性可与四阶Suzuki-Chin路径积分相媲美，但只需纯二阶Trotter的工作量。不需要通过有限差分计算Suzuki-Chin方法中出现的投影Hessian，不需要为可观测量开发任何新的估计量，并且一旦Eco频率已被计算出来，Eco路径积分的实现只需修改Trotter路径积分代码中的几行。为了提供一个更令人印象深刻的例子，我们在GPUMD中实现了Eco方法，并用它结合机器学习的神经进化势来收敛MOF-5的负热膨胀系数和定压热容。

articles.title: Miniaturized laser technology paves the way for fundamental physics experiments in space
articles.title_zh: 小型化激光技术为空间基础物理实验铺平道路
articles.abstract: An international team of researchers has succeeded in producing atomic quantum gas mixtures with an unprecedented particle flux. In the journal Nature Communications, the scientists report on experiments conducted with the MAIUS-B apparatus, in which Bose–Einstein condensates (BECs) consisting of two different atomic species—rubidium and potassium—were generated and studied under microgravity conditions in the Einstein Elevator at Leibniz University Hannover in Germany.
articles.abstract_zh: 一个国际研究团队成功产生了具有前所未有粒子通量的原子量子气体混合物。研究人员在MAIUS-B装置上，于德国汉诺威莱布尼茨大学的爱因斯坦升降机微重力条件下，生成并研究了由铷和钾两种原子组成的玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体。该进展与面向空间基础物理实验的小型化激光技术密切相关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一个国际研究团队成功地产生了具有前所未有粒子通量的原子量子气体混合物。科学家们在《自然·通讯》期刊上报告了使用MAIUS-B装置进行的实验，在这些实验中，由两种不同原子种类——铷和钾——组成的玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体在德国汉诺威莱布尼茨大学的爱因斯坦升降机中的微重力条件下被生成并加以研究。

articles.title: Air-stable, ultrathin superconductors developed for more scalable quantum devices
articles.title_zh: 用于更可扩展量子器件的空气稳定超薄超导体问世
articles.abstract: Super-thin superconducting materials, which are only one or a few atoms thick, have unique properties scientists can leverage to produce more compact, scalable, and efficient quantum devices. But these fragile materials degrade so rapidly in air that they are difficult to study or manufacture.
articles.abstract_zh: 仅有一个或少数几个原子厚度的超薄超导材料具有独特性质，可用于制造更紧凑、可扩展且高效的量子器件。然而，这类材料通常在空气中迅速退化，给研究和制造带来困难。该新闻报道的工作围绕空气稳定的超薄超导体开发展开，具体材料体系和性能需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超薄超导材料只有一个或少数几个原子厚，具有科学家可以利用来制造更紧凑、更可扩展且更高效量子器件的独特性质。但是，这些脆弱材料在空气中退化得如此之快，以至于难以对其进行研究或制造。

articles.title: Breakdown of Monotonic Impurity Entropy Flow in mathscrPT-Symmetric Multichannel Kondo Systems
articles.title_zh: PT对称多通道近藤体系中单调杂质熵流的破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a mathscrPT-symmetric non-Hermitian multichannel Kondo model consisting of a pair of spin-frac12 impurities coupled to n conduction-electron channels through complex-conjugate Kondo couplings. The impurity renormalization-group (RG) flow is characterized by the Kondo scale T_K and a dimensionless non-Hermiticity parameter α. As α increases, the exact Bethe Ansatz solution exhibits four impurity phases: overscreened Kondo, zero mode, Yu--Shiba--Rusinov (YSR), and local moment. The Kondo, zero-mode, and local-moment phases are mathscrPT-unbroken, whereas the YSR phase spontaneously breaks mathscrPT symmetry. Using a generalized thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz, we determine the impurity free energy and Affleck--Ludwig g-function throughout the mathscrPT-unbroken phases. In the Kondo phase, the defect RG flow connects the ultraviolet and infrared conformal fixed points, with the impurity entropy flowing from 2łn2 to 2łnłeft[2o̧słeft(fracπn+2i̊ght)i̊ght], in agreement with defect conformal field theory. In the zero-mode phase, zero-energy impurity strings reorganize the spectrum into multiple excitation towers, while in the local-moment phase, the RG flow becomes cyclic, returning to the unscreened local-moment fixed point. We conjecture that RG irreversibility, and hence a generalized Affleck--Ludwig g-theorem, survives throughout the Kondo phase. Our exact solution nevertheless shows that a real spectrum and defect entropies consistent with defect CFT do not guarantee RG irreversibility: the impurity entropy is non-monotonic in both the zero-mode and local-moment phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究由一对自旋1/2杂质和n个导电电子通道组成的PT对称非厄米多通道近藤模型，其中近藤耦合为复共轭形式。精确Bethe Ansatz解显示，随非厄米性参数增加，体系出现过屏蔽近藤、零模、Yu-Shiba-Rusinov和局域磁矩四种杂质相。作者发现，尽管某些相具有实谱并与缺陷共形场论相容，零模相和局域磁矩相中的杂质熵仍可呈非单调行为，从而表明RG不可逆性并非自动成立。
authors: Pradip Kattel, Abay Zhakenov, Natan Andrei
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04083v1，公告类型：新。摘要：我们研究一个PT对称的非厄米多通道近藤模型，该模型由一对自旋1/2杂质组成，它们通过复共轭近藤耦合与n个导电电子通道相耦合。杂质重整化群（RG）流由近藤标度TK和一个无量纲非厄米性参数α表征。随着α增加，精确Bethe Ansatz解显示出四种杂质相：过屏蔽近藤相、零模相、Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）相和局域磁矩相。近藤相、零模相和局域磁矩相是PT未破缺的，而YSR相自发破缺PT对称性。利用广义热力学Bethe Ansatz，我们确定了整个PT未破缺相中的杂质自由能和Affleck-Ludwig g函数。在近藤相中，缺陷RG流连接紫外和红外共形不动点，杂质熵从2ln2流向2ln[2cos(π/(n+2))]，这与缺陷共形场论一致。在零模相中，零能杂质弦将谱重组为多个激发塔，而在局域磁矩相中，RG流变为循环的，并返回到未屏蔽的局域磁矩不动点。我们猜想，RG不可逆性以及因此广义Affleck-Ludwig g定理在整个近藤相中保持成立。尽管如此，我们的精确解表明，实谱以及与缺陷CFT相一致的缺陷熵并不能保证RG不可逆性：在零模相和局域磁矩相中，杂质熵都是非单调的。

articles.title: Entanglement entropy of fermions in a strange metal
articles.title_zh: 奇异金属中费米子的纠缠熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The subsystem-size dependence of ground-state entanglement entropy and its crossover to thermal entropy as a function of temperature are well understood for one-dimensional (1D) gapless systems described by conformal field theory (CFT), and for free fermions with a Fermi surface in any dimension. However, little is known about the entanglement entropy for gapless fermionic systems without quasi-particles, such as a strange metal. Here we study the entanglement entropy of fermions in a solvable large-N 1D lattice model akin to the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (Yukawa SYK) model. In this model, two Fermi points are coupled to scalar bosons via spatially random Yukawa interactions, providing a solvable model of a strange metal when the bosons become critical at a quantum critical point. We exactly compute the second Rényi entropy of fermions in a spatial subregion in this model. Our results unravel crucial role of intra-subregion entanglement between fermionic and bosonic degrees of freedom along with the inter-subregion entanglement in understanding the ground states of such strongly coupled fermion-boson systems. We show that the crossover from thermal entropy to entanglement entropy, is captured by a single scaling ansatz, that collapses the second Rényi entropy of fermions for different subregion sizes and temperatures into a single universal curve. We further show that the universal scaling curve for the critical strange metal is well described by the standard CFT formula, albeit with an effective central charge substantially larger than the non-interacting value.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一种可解的大N一维晶格模型中奇异金属费米子的纠缠熵，该模型类似Yukawa-SYK模型。作者精确计算了空间子区域中费米子的第二Rényi熵，并揭示了费米—玻色自由度在子区域内部纠缠以及子区域之间纠缠的共同作用。结果表明，热熵到纠缠熵的跨越可由单一标度假设描述，临界奇异金属的普适标度曲线可用类似CFT公式刻画，但有效中心荷显著大于非相互作用值。
authors: Santanu Singh, Surajit Bera, Chenyuan Li, Subir Sachdev, Sumilan Banerjee
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04098v1，公告类型：新。摘要：对于由共形场论（CFT）描述的一维无能隙系统，以及任意维度中具有费米面的自由费米子，基态纠缠熵对子系统尺寸的依赖及其随温度变化向热熵的跨越已被很好地理解。然而，对于没有准粒子的无能隙费米体系，例如奇异金属，人们对其纠缠熵知之甚少。在这里，我们研究一个可解的大N一维晶格模型中费米子的纠缠熵，该模型类似于Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（Yukawa SYK）模型。在该模型中，两个费米点通过空间随机的Yukawa相互作用与标量玻色子耦合，当玻色子在量子临界点处变为临界时，该模型提供了一个可解的奇异金属模型。我们精确计算了该模型中空间子区域内费米子的第二Rényi熵。我们的结果揭示，在理解这种强耦合费米—玻色体系的基态时，费米和玻色自由度之间的子区域内部纠缠以及子区域之间纠缠都起着关键作用。我们表明，从热熵到纠缠熵的跨越可由一个单一的标度假设捕捉，该假设将不同子区域尺寸和温度下费米子的第二Rényi熵塌缩为一条单一的普适曲线。我们进一步表明，临界奇异金属的普适标度曲线可由标准CFT公式很好地描述，尽管其有效中心荷显著大于非相互作用值。

articles.title: Valley polarization of moiré interlayer exciton complexes driven by many-body interactions
articles.title_zh: 多体相互作用驱动的莫尔层间激子复合体谷极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Localized interlayer excitons (IX) in moiré transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures can both probe and participate in many-body states hosted by the moiré superlattice. When the IX density is small compared to the moiré lattice density, the formation of incompressible charge crystals at fractional electronic moiré fillings modifies exciton-charge scattering, leading to enhanced lifetimes in photoluminescence (PL) measurements. At high IX densities, the exciton dynamics are altered by the emergence of an excitonic Mott insulator and the formation of doubly-occupied sites (IXX). Here, we investigate the IX PL lifetime and valley polarization in an R-type WSe₂/WS₂ bilayer across a wide range of IX and charge densities. While previous studies reported a decrease of polarization in time-integrated measurements in charge-incompressible phases, our results show that this arises not from enhanced intervalley scattering, but from a dilution of the valley polarization by the dramatic enhancement of IX lifetimes. At high excitation densities, we probe the dynamics of the IXX and show that despite the nominal antiparallel valley configuration of the two constituent excitons, a strong, anomalous valley polarization develops as the IXX population decays. Our results shed light on the complex exciton and valley dynamics of IX and demonstrate that they are strongly modified by the rich many-body physics of moiré heterobilayers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究R型WSe2/WS2双层中层间激子的光致发光寿命和谷极化，覆盖宽范围的激子密度与电荷密度。作者指出，此前在电荷不可压缩相中观察到的时间积分极化降低，并非源于增强的谷间散射，而是由层间激子寿命显著延长导致的谷极化稀释。高激发密度下，对双占据层间激子复合体的动力学研究显示，尽管其名义上由反平行谷构型激子组成，衰减过程中仍会形成强烈的反常谷极化。
authors: Adrian O. Paulus, Mikołaj J. Metelski, Alain Dijkstra, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Nathan P. Wilson, Jonathan J. Finley
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04151v1，公告类型：新。摘要：莫尔过渡金属二硫族化物异质结构中的局域层间激子（IX）既可以探测莫尔超晶格承载的多体态，也可以参与其中。当IX密度相对于莫尔晶格密度较小时，在分数电子莫尔填充处形成的不可压缩电荷晶体会改变激子—电荷散射，从而在光致发光（PL）测量中导致寿命增强。在高IX密度下，激子动力学会因激子Mott绝缘体的出现和双占据位点（IXX）的形成而改变。在这里，我们在很宽的IX和电荷密度范围内研究R型WSe2/WS2双层中的IX PL寿命和谷极化。尽管先前研究报告称，在电荷不可压缩相中，时间积分测量的极化会降低，但我们的结果表明，这并非源于增强的谷间散射，而是源于IX寿命显著增强对谷极化造成的稀释。在高激发密度下，我们探测IXX的动力学，并显示尽管两个组成激子在名义上具有反平行谷构型，随着IXX布居衰减，仍会发展出强烈的反常谷极化。我们的结果阐明了IX复杂的激子和谷动力学，并证明它们会受到莫尔异质双层中丰富多体物理的强烈修饰。

articles.title: Zero-Clustering Geometry in Realistic Fractional Quantum Hall Wave Functions
articles.title_zh: 现实分数量子霍尔波函数中的零点成簇几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The clustering pattern of zeros in the ground state of a fractional quantum Hall system is a defining feature of its topological properties. We analyze the geometrical fluctuations of the zeros around individual electrons and propose to use the displacement ratio of the zeros to visualize and measure the distance of a realistic state to a model wave function. The distribution of the zero displacement ratio behaves like an order parameter in the transition from a Laughlin phase to a topologically trivial one. The statistical comparison between quantum Hall states belonging to different Jain sequences leads to a composite fermion fluid description of the ν = 1/5 ground state with long-range Coulomb interaction that agrees almost perfectly for as few as 3-5 electrons, overcoming the long-standing difficulties of accommodating the competing liquid and crystal orders at short distances.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究分数量子霍尔基态中零点的成簇模式及其几何涨落，并提出用零点位移比来可视化和度量现实态与模型波函数之间的距离。零点位移比分布在Laughlin相向拓扑平庸相转变时表现得类似序参量。作者还通过不同Jain序列量子霍尔态的统计比较，为ν=1/5长程库仑相互作用基态提供了与少电子体系高度吻合的复合费米子流体描述。
authors: Xin Wan, Ziang Wang, Zi-Xiang Hu, Zhao Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04395v1，公告类型：新。摘要：分数量子霍尔体系基态中零点的成簇模式是其拓扑性质的一个定义性特征。我们分析单个电子周围零点的几何涨落，并提出使用零点位移比来可视化和度量一个现实态到模型波函数的距离。在从Laughlin相到拓扑平庸相的转变中，零点位移比的分布表现得像一个序参量。属于不同Jain序列的量子霍尔态之间的统计比较，导向了对具有长程库仑相互作用的ν=1/5基态的复合费米子流体描述；即使只有少至3—5个电子，该描述也几乎完美吻合，从而克服了长期以来在短距离上容纳相互竞争的液体序和晶体序所面临的困难。

articles.title: Microscopic theory of the field-induced instability of the vortex-free state in superconducting thin-film strips
articles.title_zh: 超导薄膜条带中外场诱导无涡旋态不稳定性的微观理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04508v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the Pearl--London theory, the edge-barrier-disappearance field of a superconducting thin-film strip depends on an arbitrary short-distance core cutoff because the vortex is treated as a point object. The theory does not determine the cutoff or how it depends on temperature T, and therefore cannot determine the T dependence of the instability field. Here we formulate the microscopic stability problem directly for the vortex-free superconducting state. This removes the core-cutoff ambiguity and determines the instability field Bₛ over the full temperature range and across all width regimes considered here. For a homogeneous dirty strip with negligible self-field, three width regimes occur. For WW₂₍T), the critical wave number is finite and the unstable mode is localized near an edge. In the wide-strip limit, Bₛpropto1/W, recovering the Pearl--London scaling. In sufficiently narrow strips, however, the Pearl--London edge-barrier picture fails qualitatively.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文直接从微观层面建立无涡旋超导态的稳定性问题，以消除Pearl-London理论中由点涡旋处理引入的芯部短程截断任意性。该理论在完整温度范围和所考虑的宽度区间内确定不稳定场Bs。结果显示，均匀脏极限薄膜条带在自场可忽略时存在三个宽度区间；宽条带极限恢复Bs∝1/W的Pearl-London标度，而足够窄的条带中传统边缘势垒图像会发生定性失效。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04508v1，公告类型：新。摘要：在Pearl-London理论中，超导薄膜条带的边缘势垒消失场依赖于一个任意的短距离芯部截断，因为涡旋被作为点对象处理。该理论不能确定该截断，也不能确定它如何依赖于温度T，因此无法确定不稳定场的T依赖性。在这里，我们直接针对无涡旋超导态建立微观稳定性问题。这消除了芯部截断的模糊性，并在完整温度范围以及这里考虑的所有宽度区间中确定不稳定场Bs。对于自场可忽略的均匀脏条带，会出现三个宽度区间。对于W>W2(T)，临界波数是有限的，且不稳定模局域在边缘附近。在宽条带极限中，Bs∝1/W，恢复Pearl-London标度。然而，在足够窄的条带中，Pearl-London边缘势垒图像在定性上失效。

articles.title: In search of novel ductile superconductors
articles.title_zh: 寻找新型延性超导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We performed a first-principles high-throughput screening of the mechanical properties of phonon-mediated superconductors selected from the recent experimentally synthesized superconducting materials database PRX Energy 4, 033012 (2025). We developed the workflows that combine first-principles calculations of elastic constants and generalized stacking fault energies to assess the ductility of superconducting candidates. Starting from the 250 materials identified with promising superconducting critical temperatures, we computed their elastic tensors to evaluate bulk and shear moduli, Pugh's ratio, and Pettifor's ratio from first principles. To further characterize their plastic deformation behavior, we calculated the stacking fault energy and surface energy for selected materials and slip directions, allowing the estimation of Rice's ratio and ductility indicators. We found that several new materials simultaneously exhibit high-T_c and ductility including HfPd₂Al, TiRuSb, and ZrNi₂Ga with predicted isotropic T_c= 6.80K, 12.88K, and 8.23K, respectively. This work offers a quantitative mapping of mechanical performance across a wide range of superconductors and provides a reference to identify new mechanically promising superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对近期实验合成超导材料数据库中的声子介导超导体进行第一性原理高通量力学性能筛选。作者结合弹性常数和广义层错能计算，评估候选超导材料的延性，并进一步计算若干材料的层错能和表面能。研究发现HfPd2Al、TiRuSb和ZrNi2Ga等材料兼具较高超导临界温度和延性，为寻找机械性能优良的新型超导体提供了定量参考。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04789v1，公告类型：新。摘要：我们对从近期实验合成超导材料数据库PRX Energy 4, 033012 (2025)中选取的声子介导超导体的力学性质进行了第一性原理高通量筛选。我们开发了将弹性常数的第一性原理计算与广义层错能相结合的工作流程，以评估超导候选材料的延性。从被确定具有有前景超导临界温度的250种材料出发，我们计算了它们的弹性张量，以从第一性原理评估体模量和剪切模量、Pugh比以及Pettifor比。为了进一步表征它们的塑性变形行为，我们针对选定材料和滑移方向计算了层错能和表面能，从而能够估计Rice比和延性指标。我们发现若干新材料同时表现出高Tc和延性，包括HfPd2Al、TiRuSb和ZrNi2Ga，它们预测的各向同性Tc分别为6.80 K、12.88 K和8.23 K。这项工作对广泛超导体的力学性能进行了定量映射，并为识别新的具有良好力学前景的超导体提供了参考。

articles.title: Ghost-RISB for Correlated Electron-Phonon Systems: Application to the Hubbard-Holstein Model
articles.title_zh: 用于关联电子—声子体系的Ghost-RISB：在Hubbard-Holstein模型中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04816v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a generalization of the ghost-rotationally-invariant slave-boson (ghost-RISB) method that incorporates local phonon modes coupled to arbitrary on-site electronic degrees of freedom, enabling a nonperturbative treatment of electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions within an efficient variational framework. The method extends the ghost-orbital construction to capture dynamical self-energy effects and phonon-induced renormalizations beyond static slave-boson approaches. Benchmarking against dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) results for the Hubbard-Holstein model, we find excellent quantitative agreement for electron quasiparticle weights and phonon properties across a wide range of coupling strengths, and it captures accurately the competition between electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions. We show that the inclusion of the ghost orbitals is crucial to accurately describe the regime of low-frequency, strongly dynamical, phonons. The extended ghost-RISB achieves this accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost of DMFT, due to its self-consistency rooted in static observables instead of dynamical ones, enabling rapid exploration of correlated electron-phonon phase diagrams. We exploit this advantage to characterize the most demanding regime of strong coupling and adiabatic phonons. Our analysis shows a suppression of the superconducting order parameter, which is interpreted as a Franck-Condon-like reduction of the overlap between the phonon wavefunctions associated with empty and doubly-occupied sites in the bipolaronic regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了ghost-旋转不变奴玻色子（ghost-RISB）方法的推广形式，将局域声子模纳入与任意在位电子自由度耦合的框架中。该方法能够在高效变分框架下非微扰处理电子—电子和电子—声子相互作用，并通过ghost轨道捕捉动态自能效应及声子诱导重整化。与Hubbard-Holstein模型的DMFT结果比较显示，该方法在准粒子权重和声子性质上具有良好定量一致性，同时计算成本显著低于DMFT。
authors: Samuele Giuli, Ricardo J. Campos-Lopes, Emin Moghadas, Massimo Capone
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04816v1，公告类型：新。摘要：我们发展了ghost-旋转不变奴玻色子（ghost-RISB）方法的一种推广，该方法包含与任意在位电子自由度耦合的局域声子模，从而能够在高效的变分框架内对电子—电子和电子—声子相互作用进行非微扰处理。该方法扩展了ghost轨道构造，以捕捉静态奴玻色子方法之外的动态自能效应和声子诱导重整化。通过与Hubbard-Holstein模型的动力学平均场理论（DMFT）结果进行基准比较，我们发现，在很宽的耦合强度范围内，该方法对电子准粒子权重和声子性质给出极好的定量一致性，并能准确捕捉电子—电子和电子—声子相互作用之间的竞争。我们表明，包含ghost轨道对于准确描述低频、强动态声子的区域至关重要。扩展的ghost-RISB以DMFT计算成本的一小部分实现了这种精度，这是由于其自洽性建立在静态可观测量而非动态可观测量之上，从而能够快速探索关联电子—声子相图。我们利用这一优势表征了最具挑战性的强耦合和绝热声子区域。我们的分析显示超导序参量受到抑制，这被解释为在双极化子区域中，与空位点和双占据位点相关的声子波函数之间重叠发生类似Franck-Condon的减小。

articles.title: Large nonlinear Hall effect in strained moiré structures hosting high-pseudospin fermions
articles.title_zh: 承载高赝自旋费米子的应变莫尔结构中的大非线性霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the linear and nonlinear Hall response of a moiré emphwatermill lattice, in which stacking and twisting generate a four-band manifold near the Fermi level with suppressed group velocities at discrete magic angles. Including an inversion symmetry breaking onsite mass breaks the interlayer symmetry, opening a gap in this manifold and driving the system into a non-trivial bulk topological phase. We map the resulting phase diagram as a function of the strength of the mass and twist angle θ, revealing several sectors with high Chern numbers. We then introduce strain to break the residual C₃ symmetry of the lattice which activates a finite Berry curvature dipole and correspondingly, a nonlinear Hall response. The dipole reverses sign sharply across topological phase boundaries, producing butterfly like features when plotted against the relevant system parameters. Its magnitude substantially exceeds that reported for symmetry-broken transition metal dichalcogenides, consistent with the elevated Wilson-loop winding and enhanced quantum geometry associated with the lattice's pseudospin-3/2 character. We conclude by incorporating thermal effects on the Berry curvature dipole, asserting that it is an important tool for discerning topology at low temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究莫尔watermill晶格中的线性与非线性霍尔响应，该体系在费米能级附近具有四能带流形，并在特定魔角处表现出受抑制的群速度。引入破缺反演对称性的在位质量项会打开能隙并驱动非平庸体拓扑相；进一步施加应变破坏剩余C3对称性后，会激活有限Berry曲率偶极和非线性霍尔响应。作者发现该偶极在拓扑相边界附近会急剧反号，并且幅度显著大于已报道的对称性破缺过渡金属二硫族化物体系。
authors: Srijata Lahiri, Gourab Paul, Bilal Tanatar, Saurabh Basu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04875v1，公告类型：新。摘要：我们研究一种莫尔watermill晶格的线性和非线性霍尔响应，在该晶格中，堆垛和扭转在费米能级附近产生一个四能带流形，并在离散魔角处呈现受抑制的群速度。加入一个破缺反演对称性的在位质量项会破坏层间对称性，在该流形中打开能隙，并驱动体系进入非平庸的体拓扑相。我们绘制了作为质量强度和扭转角θ函数的相图，揭示出若干具有高陈数的区域。随后我们引入应变以破坏晶格残余的C3对称性，从而激活有限的Berry曲率偶极，并相应地产生非线性霍尔响应。该偶极在跨越拓扑相边界时会急剧反号，当相对于相关体系参数作图时产生类似蝴蝶的特征。其幅度显著超过已报道的对称性破缺过渡金属二硫族化物中的数值，这与该晶格赝自旋3/2特征所关联的提高的Wilson环绕数和增强的量子几何一致。最后，我们纳入Berry曲率偶极的热效应，并指出它是在低温下辨识拓扑的重要工具。

articles.title: Nonlinear nanoelectromechanics of a movable Cooper-pair box
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically study the dynamics of a movable Cooper-pair box coupled to a normal-metal pillar using a semiclassical approach. We analyze the dynamical stability induced by the nonlinear nanoelectromechanical coupling between the mechanical motion and an inelastic Andreev tunneling through linear stability and bifurcation analyses. As a function of η, defined as the ratio of electrostatic energy to Josephson coupling energy, the system exhibits reentrant stability. At small η, the fixed point loses stability through a supercritical Hopf bifurcation, giving rise to self-sustained vibrations. With a further increase of η, a second critical point appears, at which the fixed point regains stability. We show that this second transition corresponds to an inverse subcritical Hopf bifurcation in the adiabatic regime and to an inverse supercritical Hopf bifurcation in the nonadiabatic regime. These results extend previous studies of adiabatic self-vibrations to the nonadiabatic regime and reveal a rich nonlinear dynamical phase diagram arising from the interplay between electronic and mechanical degrees of freedom in superconducting devices.
authors: S. Park, A. Patra, L. Y. Gorelik, M. J. Park, H. C. Park, R. I. Shekhter

articles.title: Effective single particle picture for anharmonic lattice dynamics: a Rosetta stone for electronic and ionic response
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05068v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish a theoretical framework for the dynamics of a lattice of ions in a mean-field approach, where anharmonicity is included via self-consistency. In this picture, the many-body dynamics of a system of N atoms in three dimensions is mapped onto two kinds of 6N-dimensional vectors: the phonon condensate, describing the evolution of the average atomic positions, and the phonon spinors, describing the evolution of the atomic elastic constants. The phonon spinors are classified by a quantum number that behaves as a spin: the phonon pseudospin. The many-body Liouville equation is replaced by two wave equations equivalent to the time-dependent Schrödinger equation for the electronic wave function in density functional theory. Exploiting this parallelism, we formulate the response of the anharmonic lattice in one-to-one correspondence with time-dependent density functional theory for electrons. In complete analogy with the electronic case, we express the ionic response in terms of matrix elements of operators representing external fields and forces. We show how anharmonicity screens external perturbations through a phonon analogue of the Hartree-exchange-correlation kernel. We provide expressions for the lattice optical and thermal conductivity, showing how thermal conductivity depends on the phonon pseudospin. By approximating the density matrix as a Gaussian, we recover the equations of the time-dependent self-consistent harmonic approximation. In this case, the linear-response equations are formulated in terms of an anharmonic kernel including three- and four-phonon scattering. By translating anharmonic lattice dynamics into the language of density functional theory, this work shows how theoretical and computational advances in modeling the dynamical response of interacting electrons can be directly applied to interacting ions.

articles.title: A fractional quantum Hall factory on quantum processors: constant-depth preparation of clustered non-Abelian states
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons arise as exotic excitations in fractional quantum Hall (FQH) matter and have proved very elusive to realize in conventional platforms. In this work, we show that on a programmable quantum hardware platform, the more exotic FQH excitations are the less costly ones to prepare: clustered non-Abelian FQH states admit parallel quantum preparation circuits whose two-qubit depth is independent of system size, while constructing the more common Abelian Laughlin state requires a sequential circuit chain with linear depth. The centerpiece of this work is our new systematic framework for cataloging possible FQH states and preparing them on quantum circuits at unprecedented scale and variety. Our prepared parafermionic Read--Rezayi Z₃ state holds depth 3 from 8 to 118 qubits, and full root sampling extends to a 154-qubit, 104-electron Read--Rezayi Z₄ state. In all, our demonstrated 18-family catalog of prepared FQH states extends to all 156 qubits of an IBM Heron processor, limited only by existing hardware scale. Measurements on the prepared states recover the expected fractional quasihole charges, with the charge estimator exact in every symmetry-selected shot for the clustered states, and braiding data of the non-Abelian e/4 quasihole measured via interferometric extensions. Our work establishes a scalable route to studying FQH physics on quantum processors and opens new avenues for preparing and probing non-Abelian topological matter far beyond the reach of conventional platforms.
authors: Cheng Xu, Ching Hua Lee, Hong-Hao Tu, Yang Zhang

articles.title: Unifying quantum measurement constructions via a relative-entropy minimum change principle
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04055v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The minimum change principle provides an information-theoretic characterization of the Bayes reversal channel in classical probability theory and has recently been proposed as a framework for extending Bayes' rule to quantum information theory. Using quantum relative entropy, we investigate a minimum change principle for the setting of quantum statistical inference. Specifically, we consider a forward process based on a classical-to-quantum preparation channel and a reverse process based on a quantum-to-classical measurement channel. We establish a closed-form characterization of measurements that are optimal for this principle, and this optimal measurement can be found via a dual formulation involving a single unconstrained Hermitian variable. This perspective allows us to recover some notable measurements within the same framework, including pretty good measurements and Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements, and we use it to discover a novel family that we call softmin thermal measurements. We further show that softmin thermal measurements arise as optimal solutions to entropy-regularized semidefinite optimization problems, demonstrating that they play a role for measurements analogous to that of thermal states in statistical mechanics. Finally, we prove an additivity property for the relative-entropy minimum change principle and investigate the performance of Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements for quantum hypothesis testing.

articles.title: Reconstructing non-Abelian braiding and fusion without anyon transport
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04103v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons offer a route to fault-tolerant and universal quantum computing, but experimental access to their defining braiding and fusion data remains limited by the resource overhead of implementing extended anyonic processes on quantum hardware. Here we introduce and experimentally realise a measurement-only protocol based on temporally ordered ribbon operations that reconstructs the non-Abelian braiding and fusion primitives of the quantum double model D(S₃₎ without physical anyon transport. We implement a reduced two-qutrit version of the protocol on Quantinuum's H2 trapped-ion processors, realising ancilla-assisted ribbon operations and anyonic charge projections in a qubit encoding. We reconstruct the squared braiding phases and fusion amplitudes using an adapted Hadamard test and post-selected measurements, respectively. The associated braiding and fusion transformations reproduce their ideal actions with average normalised output-state fidelities of øverlineFR=0.9988 and øverlineFF=0.9987. Combining these primitives produces a non-Clifford braid and a non-stabilizer resource state, supporting measurement-only anyonic encodings as building blocks for larger topologically encoded quantum processors.
authors: Lucy Byles, Matthew D. Horner, Benjamin T. H. Varcoe, Jiannis K. Pachos

articles.title: Fabrication of oxide/FeSe multilayer films using the PLD technique
articles.title_zh: 利用 PLD 技术制备氧化物/FeSe 多层薄膜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.23591v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this study, we demonstrate the successful fabrication of TiO2/FeSe/STO and TiO2/FeSe/LaAlO3 heterostructures using PLD. When the growth rates were sufficiently low, anatase TiO2, which has been reported to induce superconductivity in FeSe, could be grown epitaxially on FeSe. For TiO2/FeSe/STO, the FeSe/TiO2 interface was relatively clean, as confirmed by the observation of Laue fringes in FeSe(001) reflection. Although a thinner FeSe layer is expected to enhance Tc, our results instead suggest that deposition of TiO2 introduces additional disorder in FeSe. Most strikingly, superconductivity appeared when TiO2 was deposited on FeSe/LaAlO3, clearly demonstrating that the interaction between the top oxide layer and underlying FeSe can induce superconductivity. This work demonstrates the feasibility of fabricating FeSe/oxide superlattices by PLD, establishing a novel platform for the exploration of interfacial superconductivity in iron-based superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究展示了利用脉冲激光沉积（PLD）成功制备 TiO2/FeSe/STO 和 TiO2/FeSe/LaAlO3 异质结构。结果表明，在足够低的生长速率下，可在 FeSe 上外延生长被认为能诱导 FeSe 超导的锐钛矿 TiO2。尤其值得注意的是，在 FeSe/LaAlO3 上沉积 TiO2 后出现超导，证明顶部氧化物层与底层 FeSe 的相互作用可诱导超导性。该工作为通过 PLD 制备 FeSe/氧化物超晶格并探索铁基超导体界面超导提供了新平台。
authors: Tomoki Kobayashi, Hiroki Nakagawa, Ryo Ogawa, Atsutaka Maeda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本研究中，我们展示了利用 PLD 成功制备 TiO2/FeSe/STO 和 TiO2/FeSe/LaAlO3 异质结构。当生长速率足够低时，曾被报道可在 FeSe 中诱导超导性的锐钛矿 TiO2 能够在 FeSe 上外延生长。对于 TiO2/FeSe/STO，FeSe/TiO2 界面相对洁净，这一点由 FeSe(001) 反射中 Laue 条纹的观测得到证实。尽管预计更薄的 FeSe 层会提高 Tc，但我们的结果反而表明 TiO2 的沉积会在 FeSe 中引入额外无序。最引人注目的是，当 TiO2 沉积在 FeSe/LaAlO3 上时出现了超导性，清楚地证明了顶部氧化物层与下方 FeSe 之间的相互作用能够诱导超导性。本工作证明了通过 PLD 制备 FeSe/氧化物超晶格的可行性，为探索铁基超导体中的界面超导建立了一个新平台。

articles.title: Electrostatics-induced breakdown of the integer quantum Hall effect in cavity QED
articles.title_zh: 腔量子电动力学中静电效应诱导的整数量子霍尔效应击穿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.04744v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We address the prevailing theoretical explanation of the recently observed breakdown of the integer quantum Hall effect in a two-dimensional electron gas embedded in a metallic split-ring resonator. Within the same single-particle description of quantized Hall conductance, we compare previously proposed vacuum-induced transport modifications against an alternative mechanism that explains this breakdown in terms of non-chiral edge channels arising solely from electrostatic boundary effects. This direct comparison shows that for experimentally relevant parameters, the electrostatic contribution exceeds that of any vacuum-induced conductance modifications by many orders of magnitude and yields characteristic transport signatures and energy scales that align well with experimental observations. This finding sheds new light on this puzzling phenomenon, supporting an electrostatic rather than a vacuum-related interpretation that can be directly tested in experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论了近期在嵌入金属开口环谐振器的二维电子气中观察到的整数量子霍尔效应击穿现象的主流理论解释。作者在同一单粒子量子化霍尔电导框架内，比较了真空诱导输运修正与一种基于静电边界效应产生非手征边缘通道的替代机制。结果显示，在实验相关参数下，静电贡献远大于真空诱导修正，并能更好解释实验中的输运特征和能标。该研究支持对该现象的静电解释，并提出可由实验直接检验。
authors: Gian Marcello Andolina, Zeno Bacciconi, Alberto Nardin, Marco Schirò, Peter Rabl, Daniele De Bernardis
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们讨论了近期在嵌入金属开口环谐振器中的二维电子气里观察到的整数量子霍尔效应击穿现象的流行理论解释。在同一种量子化霍尔电导的单粒子描述框架内，我们将先前提出的真空诱导输运修正与一种替代机制进行比较，后者将这种击穿解释为完全由静电边界效应产生的非手征边缘通道所致。这种直接比较表明，对于实验相关参数，静电贡献比任何真空诱导的电导修正都大许多个数量级，并产生与实验观测良好一致的特征输运信号和能量尺度。这一发现为这一令人困惑的现象提供了新的认识，支持一种静电而非真空相关的解释，并且该解释可以在实验中直接检验。

articles.title: The exact dynamical structure factor of one-dimensional hard rods and its universal random matrix behavior
articles.title_zh: 一维硬棒体系的精确动力学结构因子及其普适随机矩阵行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.15108v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We obtain an exact analytic expression for the dynamical structure factor of one-dimensional quantum gas of hard rods. Our result is valid for an arbitrary many-body state of the system, with finite temperature states and the ground state being important special cases that we analyse in detail. We demonstrate that the expression obeys fundamental relations such like the f-sum rule and the detailed balance. We also reveal the hidden fermionic structure behind the correlator. In the static limit we show that it can be written in terms of universal functions which, at zero temperature, coincide with the level spacing distribution function of the Gaussian Unitary Ensemble. Our work provides a full and exact characterisation of a dynamic correlation function in a strongly correlated interacting quantum many-body system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文给出了一维硬棒量子气动力学结构因子的精确解析表达式，适用于体系任意多体态，并重点分析了有限温态和基态。作者证明该表达式满足 f-求和规则和细致平衡等基本关系，并揭示了相关函数背后的隐藏费米子结构。在静态极限下，该结构因子可用普适函数表示；零温时这些函数与高斯酉系综的能级间距分布函数一致。该工作为强关联相互作用量子多体系统中的动力学关联函数提供了完整且精确的刻画。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们获得了一维硬棒量子气动力学结构因子的精确解析表达式。我们的结果适用于该系统的任意多体态，其中有限温度态和基态是我们详细分析的重要特例。我们证明该表达式满足诸如 f-求和规则和细致平衡等基本关系。我们还揭示了该关联函数背后的隐藏费米子结构。在静态极限下，我们表明它可以用普适函数来表示；在零温下，这些函数与高斯酉系综的能级间距分布函数相一致。我们的工作对强关联相互作用量子多体系统中的一个动力学关联函数给出了完整而精确的表征。

articles.title: Polarization-resolved attosecond gamma-ray emission from few-cycle laser interactions with cone targets
articles.title_zh: 少周期激光与锥形靶相互作用产生的偏振分辨阿秒伽马射线发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04363v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Linearly polarized attosecond γ-ray pulses in the MeV range are generated from a cone target irradiated by a single few-cycle laser pulse. Electron layers are periodically extracted from the cone walls and subsequently accelerated. Their interaction with the counter-propagating reflected attosecond field produces high-energy photons through nonlinear Compton scattering (NCS), forming attosecond γ-ray pulses. We model this interaction using two-dimensional quantum electrodynamics particle-in-cell (QED-PIC) simulations that resolve electron spin and photon polarization during emission. The results show a shortest equivalent duration of 300,as, with a corresponding linear polarization degree of 0.78. The photon spectrum extends to 6,MeV, and the linear polarization degree in the high-energy range reaches 0.88. The linear polarization degree remains high when photons from both emission directions are collected over wide momentum-angle ranges. Scans over the cone opening angle and the coupled laser-plasma parameters reveal tradeoffs among photon number, mean photon energy, and polarization. Such highly polarized attosecond γ-ray pulses could be used to investigate ultrafast nuclear dynamics and polarization-dependent processes in strong-field quantum electrodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出利用单个少周期激光脉冲辐照锥形靶，产生 MeV 能区线偏振阿秒 γ 射线脉冲。电子层周期性地从锥壁抽取并加速，与反向传播的反射阿秒场相互作用，经非线性康普顿散射产生高能光子。二维 QED-PIC 模拟显示最短等效持续时间为 300 as，相应线偏振度为 0.78，高能区线偏振度可达 0.88。该类高偏振阿秒 γ 射线有望用于研究超快核动力学和强场量子电动力学中的偏振依赖过程。
authors: De-Sheng Zhang, Cui-Wen Zhang, Xue-Ren Hong, Feng Wan, Jian-Xing Li, Bai-Song Xie
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过用单个少周期激光脉冲辐照锥形靶，产生了 MeV 范围内的线偏振阿秒 γ 射线脉冲。电子层周期性地从锥壁中被抽取出来，随后被加速。它们与反向传播的反射阿秒场相互作用，通过非线性康普顿散射（NCS）产生高能光子，形成阿秒 γ 射线脉冲。我们使用二维量子电动力学粒子模拟（QED-PIC）对这种相互作用进行建模，该模拟在发射过程中分辨电子自旋和光子偏振。结果显示，最短等效持续时间为 300 as，对应的线偏振度为 0.78。光子谱延伸至 6 MeV，高能范围内的线偏振度达到 0.88。当在宽动量角范围内收集来自两个发射方向的光子时，线偏振度仍保持较高。对锥形开口角以及耦合的激光-等离子体参数的扫描揭示了光子数、平均光子能量和偏振之间的权衡。此类高度偏振的阿秒 γ 射线脉冲可用于研究超快核动力学以及强场量子电动力学中的偏振依赖过程。

articles.title: Accessing the symmetric component of quadrupole misalignment through counter-rotating closed orbits in EDM storage rings
articles.title_zh: 通过 EDM 储存环中的反向旋转闭合轨道获取四极磁铁失准的对称分量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the storage ring proposed to measure the proton electric dipole moment (EDM), quadrupole misalignments of a few microns mimic a genuine EDM through a geometric (Berry) phase; at a 10 micron rms misalignment the false signal is up to a thousand times the target sensitivity of 1e-29 e-cm. The misalignment splits into an antisymmetric component, which distorts the closed orbit and is visible to the beam-position monitors, and a symmetric component, whose orbit signature is strongly suppressed. Standard single-beam orbit correction therefore removes only the antisymmetric part. The proposed design reaches the symmetric one by beam-based alignment (BBA), which is effective but relatively slow and invasive. Using symplectic beam and spin tracking, we show that correcting the two counter-rotating beams jointly recovers the symmetric component from the orbit itself; it is carried by the sum of the two orbits, whereas their difference is blind and a single beam is far too weak to recover it. The static BPM offset is degenerate with the symmetric misalignment in this sum, so the scheme does not replace the initial absolute alignment. However, the drift is differential and the offset cancels, so continuous two-beam correction maintains the alignment after a single initial BBA calibration, reducing the repeated realignment required by the original proton EDM proposal.
articles.abstract_zh: 在用于测量质子电偶极矩（EDM）的储存环中，微米级四极磁铁失准会通过几何（Berry）相位模拟真实 EDM，可能产生远超目标灵敏度的假信号。失准可分为能被束流位置监测器看到的反对称分量和轨道信号被强烈抑制的对称分量，传统单束流校正只能去除前者。作者通过辛束流与自旋跟踪表明，联合校正两束反向旋转束流可从轨道本身恢复对称分量。该方法不能替代初始绝对准直，但可在一次初始束流基准准直后通过连续双束流校正维持准直。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在拟用于测量质子电偶极矩（EDM）的储存环中，几微米的四极磁铁失准会通过几何（Berry）相位模拟真实的 EDM；在 10 微米均方根失准下，假信号最高可达 1e-29 e-cm 目标灵敏度的一千倍。失准可分解为反对称分量和对称分量，前者会扭曲闭合轨道并可被束流位置监测器看到，后者的轨道信号则受到强烈抑制。因此，标准的单束流轨道校正只能去除反对称部分。所提出的设计通过束流基准准直（BBA）触及对称部分，这种方法有效但相对缓慢且具有侵入性。利用辛束流和自旋跟踪，我们表明联合校正两束反向旋转束流可从轨道本身恢复对称分量；它由两条轨道之和携带，而它们的差对此不敏感，并且单束流信号太弱，远不足以恢复它。静态 BPM 偏移在该和轨道中与对称失准简并，因此该方案不能取代初始绝对准直。然而，漂移是差分的且偏移会抵消，因此连续双束流校正在一次初始 BBA 校准后可维持准直，从而减少原始质子 EDM 方案所需的重复重新准直。

articles.title: Photo-ionization Compensation of Stray Electric Fields for Cold Rydberg Atoms
articles.title_zh: 用于冷里德堡原子的杂散电场光电离补偿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04660v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neurtal atoms in optical tweezer arrays constitute a highly promising platform for quantum computing and quantum simulation. Their operation relies on precise control of the Rydberg excitation, which is highly sensitive to background electric fields. Here, we identify a previously overlooked source of stray electric fields arising from trapped charges within the antireflection coating layers of glass vacuum cells. In contrast to the conventional approach of removing surface charges through ultraviolet-light-induced desorption, we compensate these clamped charges by generating additional charges via photo-ionization of a cold atomic ensemble. We verify the resulting suppression of stray electric fields through Rydberg excitation spectroscopy in an atomic array and further confirm that the residual electric field inside the vacuum cell is effectively eradicated with the aid of external electrodes. Our work identifies and mitigates a previously unrecognized source of residual electric field, providing a practical solution for improving the performance of neutral atomic quantum processors and other Rydberg-based quantum technologies, as well as surface-sensitive atomic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 光镊阵列中的中性原子是量子计算和量子模拟的重要平台，但其里德堡激发对背景电场极为敏感。本文识别出玻璃真空腔抗反射镀膜层内俘获电荷产生的一种此前被忽视的杂散电场来源。作者不同于传统紫外光诱导解吸去除表面电荷的方法，而是通过冷原子系综光电离产生附加电荷来补偿这些固定电荷，并通过里德堡激发光谱和外部电极验证了残余电场的有效抑制。该工作为提升中性原子量子处理器及其他里德堡量子技术性能提供了实用方案。
authors: Z. -Y. Chen, Z. -X. Fu, Z. -R He, Z. -Y. Chen, S. -A. Cheng, J. -H. Liang, S. -C. Zhang, Y. -X. Du, C. Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光镊阵列中的中性原子构成了一个极具前景的量子计算和量子模拟平台。它们的运行依赖于对里德堡激发的精确控制，而里德堡激发对背景电场高度敏感。在这里，我们识别出一种此前被忽视的杂散电场来源，它源于玻璃真空腔抗反射镀膜层内的俘获电荷。不同于通过紫外光诱导解吸去除表面电荷的传统方法，我们通过对冷原子系综进行光电离来产生额外电荷，从而补偿这些被固定的电荷。我们通过原子阵列中的里德堡激发光谱验证了由此产生的杂散电场抑制，并进一步确认，在外部电极的辅助下，真空腔内的残余电场被有效消除。我们的工作识别并缓解了一种此前未被认识到的残余电场来源，为提高中性原子量子处理器和其他基于里德堡的量子技术以及表面敏感原子系统的性能提供了一种实用解决方案。

articles.title: Computing Reaction and Activation Energies of Pericyclic Reactions using a Symmetry-Adapted VQE Algorithm
articles.title_zh: 使用对称性适配 VQE 算法计算周环反应的反应能和活化能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pericyclic reactions provide stringent tests for quantum simulations because their mechanisms are governed by orbital symmetry and involve correlated transition states. In this work, we employ the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) combined with a previously established symmetry-guided active-space selection protocol based on symmetry-matched fractions (SMF-VQE) to simulate Diel-Alder and Alder-ene reactions in complex systems involving extended pi-conjugation and multiple bonding. Although absolute electronic energies obtained from the current protocol exhibit significant deviations from the values computed using CCSD method, the symmetry-guided active spaces yield substantial cancellation of deviations in the energy differences. As a result, reaction energies are predicted with error (relative to CCSD) less than one kcal per mol, while activation energies are reproduced within about five to six kcal per mol. The symmetry-guided protocol also reduces the large combinatorial space of active-space choices to a single symmetry-consistent selection for each reaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 周环反应因受轨道对称性支配且涉及相关过渡态，是量子模拟的严格测试对象。本文将变分量子本征求解器（VQE）与基于对称匹配分数的对称性引导活性空间选择协议（SMF-VQE）结合，用于模拟具有扩展 π 共轭和多重成键的复杂 Diels-Alder 与 Alder-ene 反应。尽管绝对电子能量与 CCSD 结果有显著偏差，但能量差中的偏差大幅抵消，使反应能误差低于 1 kcal/mol，活化能可在约 5–6 kcal/mol 内复现。该协议还将庞大的活性空间组合选择缩减为每个反应一个对称一致的选择。
authors: Maitreyee Sarkar, Manikandan Paranjothy, Atul Kumar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周环反应为量子模拟提供了严格测试，因为其机理由轨道对称性支配，并涉及相关过渡态。在本工作中，我们采用变分量子本征求解器（VQE），并结合一种先前建立的、基于对称匹配分数的对称性引导活性空间选择协议（SMF-VQE），来模拟涉及扩展 π 共轭和多重成键的复杂体系中的 Diels-Alder 和 Alder-ene 反应。尽管由当前协议获得的绝对电子能量相对于使用 CCSD 方法计算的数值表现出显著偏差，但对称性引导的活性空间在能量差中产生了显著的偏差抵消。因此，反应能的预测误差相对于 CCSD 小于每摩尔一千卡，而活化能则可在约每摩尔五到六千卡范围内复现。该对称性引导协议还将活性空间选择的巨大组合空间缩减为每个反应一个对称性一致的选择。

articles.title: A plasma photocathode for spin-polarized electron beams using excited hydrogen halides
articles.title_zh: 利用激发态卤化氢产生自旋极化电子束的等离子体光阴极
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-polarized electron beams are essential tools for probing fundamental symmetries and for the search beyond the Standard Model. While plasma-based accelerators are a promising pathway towards higher-energy frontiers, they have so far failed to deliver a competitive polarized source: existing proposals are challenging to realize and achievable polarizations remain far below conventional sources. Here, we introduce a photocathode-like scheme, applied to a gas of pre-polarized hydrogen halides. A VUV and a visible laser pulse excite the halide atoms to create a two-component ionization medium, consisting of low-threshold excited halide and high-threshold polarized hydrogen. Particle-in-cell simulations show witness beams of approx. 10 pC retaining 97% of the initial polarization P₀, reaching P approx 68% for unaligned bonds (P₀ = 70%) and P=97% for aligned bonds (P₀ = 100%), rivaling state-of-the-art conventional sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋极化电子束是检验基本对称性和探索标准模型之外物理的重要工具，但等离子体加速器尚缺乏有竞争力的极化源。本文提出一种类似光阴极的方案，应用于预极化卤化氢气体。通过 VUV 与可见光激光脉冲激发卤素原子，形成由低阈值激发卤素和高阈值极化氢组成的双组分电离介质。粒子模拟显示，约 10 pC 的见证束可保持初始极化的 97%，在未取向化学键和取向化学键情况下分别达到约 68% 和 97% 的极化度，接近先进传统源水平。
authors: Lars Reichwein, Thomas C. Wilson, Dimitris Sofikitis, Chinmaya Singh, T. Peter Rakitzis, Bernhard Hidding, Alexander Pukhov, Liangliang Ji, Markus Büscher
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋极化电子束是探测基本对称性以及寻找标准模型之外物理的关键工具。尽管基于等离子体的加速器是通向更高能量前沿的一条有前景路径，但迄今它们尚未提供具有竞争力的极化源：现有方案难以实现，且可达到的极化度仍远低于传统源。在这里，我们提出一种类似光阴极的方案，并将其应用于预极化卤化氢气体。一个 VUV 激光脉冲和一个可见光激光脉冲激发卤素原子，以产生一种双组分电离介质，该介质由低阈值激发态卤素和高阈值极化氢组成。粒子模拟显示，约 10 pC 的见证束保持了初始极化 P₀ 的 97%，对于未取向化学键达到 P 约为 68%（P₀ = 70%），对于取向化学键达到 P = 97%（P₀ = 100%），可与当前最先进的传统源相媲美。

articles.title: Quantum Contextuality and Entanglement-Free Grover Search in a Trapped-Ion Optical Qudit
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子光学量子四能级中的量子情境性与无纠缠 Grover 搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04128v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum computational advantage is generally attributed to coherent interference and other non-classical resources, yet their respective roles remain difficult to disentangle in experimental platforms where multipartite entanglement is inherently present. High-dimensional quantum systems provide an attractive route for investigating these resources while simultaneously reducing hardware overhead for quantum information processing. Here we realize a programmable four-dimensional optical qudit encoded in a single trapped ¹³⁸Ba⁺ ion and demonstrate universal coherent control through phase-programmable optical rotations. Using this platform, we implement an entanglement-free realization of Grover's quantum search algorithm, achieving target-state identification probabilities of up to 94.5±2.0%. Within the same processor, we further demonstrate state-dependent quantum contextuality through a Clauser--Horne--Shimony--Holt (CHSH)-type noncontextuality inequality, obtaining a maximum violation of S = 2.816 ± 0.082, in close agreement with the Tsirelson bound. By integrating programmable quantum computation and contextuality measurements within a single multilevel trapped-ion platform, our work establishes a versatile architecture for investigating the relationship between coherent interference and contextuality in quantum information processing and provides a scalable route toward high-dimensional quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算优势通常归因于相干干涉及其他非经典资源，但在天然存在多体纠缠的平台中难以区分这些资源的作用。本文在单个囚禁 ¹³⁸Ba⁺ 离子中实现可编程四维光学量子位（qudit），并通过相位可编程光学旋转实现通用相干控制。作者实现了无纠缠 Grover 量子搜索算法，目标态识别概率最高达 94.5±2.0%，并在同一处理器中通过 CHSH 型非情境性不等式展示态依赖量子情境性，最大违背为 S = 2.816 ± 0.082。该工作为研究相干干涉与情境性在量子信息处理中的关系提供了多能级囚禁离子平台。
authors: Tarun Dutta, Jasper Phua Sing Cheng, Alex Jin, Sergi Ramos-Calderer, José Ignacio Latorre, Manas Mukherjee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算优势通常被归因于相干干涉和其他非经典资源，然而在多体纠缠天然存在的实验平台中，它们各自的作用仍然难以区分。高维量子系统为研究这些资源提供了一条有吸引力的途径，同时还能降低量子信息处理的硬件开销。在这里，我们在单个囚禁 ¹³⁸Ba⁺ 离子中实现了一个可编程四维光学量子位，并通过相位可编程光学旋转展示了通用相干控制。利用该平台，我们实现了 Grover 量子搜索算法的一种无纠缠实现，目标态识别概率最高达到 94.5±2.0%。在同一处理器中，我们进一步通过 Clauser--Horne--Shimony--Holt（CHSH）型非情境性不等式展示了态依赖量子情境性，获得最大违背 S = 2.816 ± 0.082，与 Tsirelson 界限高度一致。通过在单一多能级囚禁离子平台中集成可编程量子计算和情境性测量，我们的工作建立了一种多用途架构，用于研究量子信息处理中相干干涉与情境性之间的关系，并为高维量子技术提供了一条可扩展路径。

articles.title: Applications of Spin-Dependent Generalized Squeezing in Hybrid Spin-Oscillator Quantum Processors
articles.title_zh: 自旋-振子混合量子处理器中自旋依赖广义压缩的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04197v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generalized squeezing interactions are foundational to quantum optics, and have recently come under experimental control in hybrid spin-oscillator quantum processors [O. Băzăvan, et al., Nat. Phys. 22, 757 (2026); S. Saner, et al., Phys. Rev. X 16, 021049 (2026)]. These interactions open the door for new applications in the processing of discrete- and continuous-variable quantum information, four of which we propose and investigate in this work: geometric phase gates mediated by spin-dependent generalized squeezing acting on two spins and a common oscillator; genuine N-body spin interactions mediated by individually addressed spin-dependent generalized squeezing; oscillator thermometry via spin readout; and the preparation of high-fidelity quantum states of the oscillator via spin-dependent generalized squeezing and mid-circuit measurement. A unifying feature of these applications is the geometric phase induced by generalized squeezing interactions, which is nonlinear in the Fock occupation of the oscillator and the interaction order of the generalized squeezing. This work provides a foundation for fast, high-fidelity discrete- and continuous-variable quantum computation and sensing in the hybrid spin-oscillator platform via generalized squeezing.
articles.abstract_zh: 广义压缩相互作用是量子光学的基础，并已在自旋-振子混合量子处理器中实现实验控制。本文提出并研究了四类新应用：由自旋依赖广义压缩介导的几何相位门、真实 N 体自旋相互作用、通过自旋读出进行振子测温，以及结合中途测量制备高保真振子量子态。这些应用的共同特征是广义压缩相互作用诱导的几何相位，其对振子 Fock 占据数和广义压缩相互作用阶数呈非线性依赖。该工作为混合自旋-振子平台中的快速高保真离散变量和连续变量量子计算与传感奠定基础。
authors: Kai Shinbrough, Donovan J. Webb, Iver R. Øvergaard, Oana Băzăvan, Sebastian Saner, Christopher J. Ballance, Raghavendra Srinivas
articles.abstract_zh_full: 广义压缩相互作用是量子光学的基础，并且最近已在混合自旋-振子量子处理器中受到实验控制 [O. Băzăvan 等，Nat. Phys. 22, 757 (2026)；S. Saner 等，Phys. Rev. X 16, 021049 (2026)]。这些相互作用为离散变量和连续变量量子信息处理中的新应用打开了大门，在本工作中我们提出并研究其中四种：由作用于两个自旋和一个公共振子的自旋依赖广义压缩介导的几何相位门；由单独寻址的自旋依赖广义压缩介导的真实 N 体自旋相互作用；通过自旋读出进行振子测温；以及通过自旋依赖广义压缩和线路中测量制备振子的高保真量子态。这些应用的一个统一特征是由广义压缩相互作用诱导的几何相位，该相位对振子的 Fock 占据数和广义压缩的相互作用阶数呈非线性依赖。本工作为通过广义压缩在混合自旋-振子平台中实现快速、高保真的离散变量和连续变量量子计算与传感提供了基础。

articles.title: Engineering Nanodiamonds for Quantum Sensing: Material Constraints at the Nanoscale
articles.title_zh: 面向量子传感的纳米金刚石工程：纳米尺度下的材料约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04489v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Optically addressable solid-state spin defects have emerged as powerful multimodal quantum sensors, with nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in bulk diamond providing benchmark quantum control and sensitivity under ambient conditions. Embedding such defects in nanodiamonds (NDs) extends these capabilities to mobile probes capable of accessing complex biological and nanoscale environments. Reduced dimensions, however, introduce constraints beyond volumetric spin impurities, notably enhanced lattice strain and surface-induced noise sources, which shorten NV spin relaxation times (T1 and T2) and destabilize the NV charge state, as well as resulting in pronounced particle-to-particle variability in NDs typically produced by top-down approaches. These effects complicate both sensing performance and the quantitative interpretation of multimodal signals in realistic environments. This article provides a structured perspective on the physical mechanisms by which material properties constrain NV behavior in NDs, together with mitigation strategies that shape the robust use of these mobile quantum sensors for biosensing and nanoscale science.
articles.abstract_zh: 可光学寻址的固态自旋缺陷已成为强大的多模态量子传感器，其中体金刚石中的氮-空位（NV）中心在室温量子控制与灵敏度方面树立了基准。将这类缺陷嵌入纳米金刚石可使其成为能够进入复杂生物和纳米环境的移动探针，但尺寸缩小会引入增强晶格应变、表面噪声、缩短自旋弛豫时间和电荷态不稳定等问题。本文系统讨论材料性质如何约束纳米金刚石中 NV 行为的物理机制，并总结缓解策略，以促进这些移动量子传感器在生物传感和纳米科学中的可靠应用。
authors: Ashutosh Rathi, Keisuke Oshimi, Kento Sasaki, Kensuke Kobayashi, Yutaka Shikano, Oliver Benson, Tim Schröder, Shery L. Y. Chang, Masazumi Fujiwara
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可光学寻址的固态自旋缺陷已成为强大的多模态量子传感器，其中体金刚石中的氮-空位（NV）中心在环境条件下提供了量子控制和灵敏度的基准。将此类缺陷嵌入纳米金刚石（NDs）中，可将这些能力扩展到能够进入复杂生物和纳米尺度环境的移动探针。然而，减小的尺寸引入了超出体积自旋杂质之外的限制，尤其是增强的晶格应变和表面诱导噪声源，它们会缩短 NV 自旋弛豫时间（T1 和 T2）并使 NV 电荷态不稳定，同时还会导致通常由自上而下方法制备的纳米金刚石中明显的颗粒间差异。这些效应使现实环境中的传感性能和多模态信号的定量解释都变得复杂。本文对材料性质限制纳米金刚石中 NV 行为的物理机制提供了结构化视角，并讨论了相关缓解策略，这些策略塑造了这些移动量子传感器在生物传感和纳米尺度科学中的稳健使用。

articles.title: Timeless Histories: Quantum Measurement and the Maximum Entropy Principle
articles.title_zh: 无时间的历史：量子测量与最大熵原理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2311.04893v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The quantum measurement problem, i.e. the apparent conflict between unitary quantum evolution and non-unitary, stochastic wave-function collapse, remains unresolved a century after the formulation of quantum mechanics. We first review the standard picture, from the Copenhagen prescription with its Heisenberg cut, through von Neumann's movable cut, to environment-induced decoherence, which explains the emergence of stable classical records but still presupposes the Born rule and therefore cannot by itself replace the measurement postulates. We then connect this problem to the Maximum Entropy Principle in two complementary ways. First, decoherence drives the measurement apparatus toward the least biased state compatible with the dynamically protected pointer distribution, so that the emergent collapse may be viewed as a thermodynamic relaxation toward constrained maximum entropy. Second, we propose a Timeless Histories formulation of quantum mechanics in which the primitive objects are ordered sequences of events rather than evolving wave functions. Their conditional probabilities are assigned, relative to specified refinements, by a single Born-Boltzmann rule that combines the quadratic structure of Born's rule with Boltzmann's counting of equally probable microstates. The textbook form of Born's rule, the projection postulate, density operators, and wave functions are then recovered as derived informational constructs, while collapse becomes Bayesian conditioning on recorded events. Time and space enter only subsequently through unitary translation symmetry. Because the probability rule is postulated independently of any physical collapse or classical observer, decoherence is no longer asked to justify the rule used to interpret its own reduced states, and can be invoked to explain the approximate additivity and stability of macroscopic records, i.e. the emergence of classicality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文回顾量子测量问题，从哥本哈根诠释、冯·诺依曼可移动切割到环境诱导退相干，指出退相干虽能解释稳定经典记录的出现，却仍预设玻恩规则。作者将测量问题与最大熵原理联系起来，认为退相干可被理解为在指针分布约束下趋向最大熵的热力学弛豫。进一步提出“无时间历史”表述，以事件序列为基本对象，并用统一的玻恩-玻尔兹曼规则导出波函数、密度算符和塌缩等概念。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2311.04893v4 公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：量子测量问题，即幺正量子演化与非幺正、随机的波函数塌缩之间的表观冲突，在量子力学形成一个世纪之后仍未得到解决。我们首先回顾标准图像，从带有海森堡切割的哥本哈根处方，到冯·诺依曼的可移动切割，再到环境诱导退相干；后者解释了稳定经典记录的出现，但仍然预设玻恩规则，因此其本身不能取代测量公设。随后，我们以两种互补方式将这一问题与最大熵原理联系起来。第一，退相干驱动测量装置走向与受动力学保护的指针分布相容的最少偏置状态，因此涌现的塌缩可被视为朝向受约束最大熵的热力学弛豫。第二，我们提出一种量子力学的“无时间历史”表述，其中原始对象是有序事件序列，而非演化的波函数。相对于给定的细化，它们的条件概率由单一的玻恩-玻尔兹曼规则赋予，该规则把玻恩规则的二次结构与玻尔兹曼对等概率微观态的计数结合起来。教科书形式的玻恩规则、投影公设、密度算符和波函数随后都作为派生的信息性构造被恢复，而塌缩则成为对已记录事件的贝叶斯条件化。时间和空间只是在随后通过幺正平移对称性进入。由于概率规则是在不依赖任何物理塌缩或经典观察者的情况下被公设的，退相干不再被要求去证明用于解释其自身约化态的规则，而可以被用来解释宏观记录的近似可加性和稳定性，即经典性的涌现。

articles.title: Dynamical Lie Algebras Cannot Describe Shallow QAOA: Cragged Terrains, Barren Plateaus, and Empirical Hardness Models
articles.title_zh: 动力学李代数无法描述浅层 QAOA：崎岖地形、贫瘠高原与经验困难度模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04252v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The dynamical Lie algebraic (DLA) theory of variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) predicts commonplace exponentially vanishing loss and gradient variances for sufficiently deep parametrized circuits. In this work, we show that these predictions fail dramatically in the shallow-circuit (and particularly constant-depth) regime for the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) applied to the maximum independent set (MIS) problem. In a large-scale numerical study across sim23,000 problem instances, we find that barren plateaus are rare, while landscapes whose variances polynomially increase with system size---which we term "cragged terrains"---are common across graph families. This aggregate polynomial growth persists both for generic, low-symmetry random graphs and for highly symmetric vertex-transitive graphs, indicating that DLA-based variance predictions do not describe landscape scaling in this regime. As a stopgap alternative to the theory, we train empirical hardness models to predict instance-wise hardness metrics for QAOA-MIS. While these models generalize poorly, they nonetheless recover the correct landscape scaling class (barren plateau vs. cragged terrain) with high fidelity. Taken together, our results identify shallow QAOA for MIS as a prototypical setting in which asymptotic, unitary-design-centric predictions may be fundamentally insufficient to describe shallow variational quantum algorithms more broadly, emphasizing the need for more empirically-informed models of VQA loss landscapes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，变分量子算法的动力学李代数理论对足够深参数化线路的预测，在最大独立集问题的浅层 QAOA 中显著失效。大规模数值研究显示，贫瘠高原较少见，而方差随系统规模多项式增长的“崎岖地形”在多类图中普遍存在。作者还训练经验困难度模型，虽泛化能力有限，但能较高保真地区分景观缩放类别，强调浅层变分量子算法需要更贴近经验的损失景观模型。
authors: Harrison Copp, Charlton Li, Anžej Margeta-Cacace, Amy Qiao
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.04252v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：变分量子算法（VQA）的动力学李代数（DLA）理论预言，对于足够深的参数化线路，损失和梯度方差通常会以指数方式消失。在这项工作中，我们表明，对于应用于最大独立集（MIS）问题的量子近似优化算法（QAOA），这些预测在浅层线路、尤其是常数深度情形下会显著失效。在一项涵盖约 23,000 个问题实例的大规模数值研究中，我们发现贫瘠高原很少见，而方差随系统规模多项式增加的景观——我们称之为“崎岖地形”——在各类图族中都很常见。这种总体上的多项式增长既存在于一般的低对称性随机图中，也存在于高度对称的顶点传递图中，表明基于 DLA 的方差预测不能描述该区域中的景观缩放行为。作为该理论的临时替代方案，我们训练经验困难度模型，以预测 QAOA-MIS 的逐实例困难度指标。尽管这些模型泛化较差，它们仍能以高保真度恢复正确的景观缩放类别（贫瘠高原或崎岖地形）。综合来看，我们的结果将用于 MIS 的浅层 QAOA 确定为一个典型场景，在该场景中，以渐近性和幺正设计为中心的预测可能从根本上不足以更广泛地描述浅层变分量子算法，并强调需要更受经验信息指导的 VQA 损失景观模型。

articles.title: Representational separation between unitary and channel quantum generative models via shared classical randomness at shallow depth
articles.title_zh: 浅层条件下通过共享经典随机性实现幺正与信道量子生成模型的表示分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05110v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Near-term quantum hardware limits circuit depth and often imposes geometrically local connectivity for quantum generative models, restricting the output distributions accessible to shallow unitary Born models. Introducing stochasticity into a unitary quantum Born model can improve the empirical generative performance of the resulting channel model and, for a restricted small-scale architecture, has been proven to represent a strictly larger family of distributions than its unitary counterpart. However, whether such randomness provides a provable separation at fixed shallow depth for arbitrarily large systems has remained open. Here, we show that shared classical randomness, a comparatively weak resource from entanglement theory, is sufficient to establish such a strict scalable representational separation over the corresponding shallow unitary Born model. More specifically, we augment bounded-connectivity shallow unitary circuits, followed by computational-basis measurements, with spatially separated local Pauli operations, whose joint application is controlled by a single classically sampled random bit. The resulting shallow-depth channel model generates long-range correlations in the classical output distribution that no purely unitary shallow-depth model with bounded connectivity can reproduce. For one-dimensional nearest-neighbour architectures, reproducing such distributions with a purely unitary model can require depth Ømega(N) in the worst case. We further show that measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) provides a natural implementation of the required shared classical randomness through suitable adaptation of the random measurement outcomes. Numerical experiments on MBQC-based generative models support the analytical results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究近端量子硬件中浅层量子生成模型的表示能力，证明共享经典随机性足以使浅层量子信道模型相对于对应浅层幺正 Born 模型产生严格且可扩展的表示分离。作者在有界连通浅层幺正线路后加入由同一个经典随机比特控制的空间分离局域 Pauli 操作，从而生成纯幺正浅层模型无法复现的长程相关。研究还指出 MBQC 可自然实现所需共享随机性，并用数值实验支持解析结果。
authors: Arunava Majumder, Marius Krumm, Hendrik Poulsen Nautrup, Hans J. Briegel
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.05110v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：近端量子硬件限制线路深度，并且常常对量子生成模型施加几何局域连通性，从而限制了浅层幺正 Born 模型可达到的输出分布。向幺正量子 Born 模型中引入随机性可以提高所得信道模型的经验生成性能，并且对于一种受限的小规模架构，已有证明表明它能表示的分布族严格大于其幺正对应物。然而，这种随机性是否能在固定浅层深度下对任意大系统提供可证明的分离，仍是一个开放问题。在这里，我们表明，共享经典随机性这一从纠缠理论角度看相对较弱的资源，足以相对于对应的浅层幺正 Born 模型建立严格的可扩展表示分离。更具体地说，我们用空间分离的局域 Pauli 操作来增强有界连通的浅层幺正线路，并随后进行计算基测量；这些 Pauli 操作的联合施加由一个经典采样的随机比特控制。所得浅层深度信道模型在经典输出分布中生成长程相关，而任何具有有界连通性的纯幺正浅层模型都无法复现这种相关。对于一维最近邻架构，在最坏情况下，用纯幺正模型复现这类分布可能需要 Ω(N) 的深度。我们进一步表明，测量基量子计算（MBQC）通过对随机测量结果进行适当自适应，为所需共享经典随机性提供了一种自然实现。基于 MBQC 的生成模型数值实验支持了解析结果。

articles.title: Precipitant-Dosage Regulation of Spinel-Type (FeCoMnCuZn) 3 O 4 High-Entropy Oxide for High-Performance Asymmetric Supercapacitors
articles.title_zh: 沉淀剂用量调控尖晶石型 (FeCoMnCuZn)3O4 高熵氧化物用于高性能非对称超级电容器
articles.abstract: High-entropy oxides (HEOs) have emerged as promising electrode materials for supercapacitors owing to their compositional tunability, robust crystal structures, multicomponent synergistic effects, and excellent structural stability. In this work, spinel-type (FeCoMnCuZn)3O4 HEO was synthesized via a facile coprecipitation strategy followed by air calcination. The effects of precipitant type and Na2CO3 dosage on the phase structure, particle morphology, elemental distribution, surface valence states, and electrochemical performance were systematically investigated. The sample prepared with 10 mmol Na2CO3 exhibited a single-phase spinel structure, relatively high crystallinity, uniform nanoparticle morphology, and homogeneous multimetal elemental distribution. XPS analysis confirmed the coexistence of multivalent Fe, Co, Mn, and Cu species, together with oxygen-vacancy-related defects, which are beneficial for charge transfer and reversible Faradaic reactions. Benefiting from the optimized microstructure and compositional synergy, the 10 mmol electrode delivered a specific capacitance of 416.4 F g− 1 at 1 A g− 1 and retained 207.4 F g− 1 at 20 A g− 1. Furthermore, an asymmetric supercapacitor assembled using (FeCoMnCuZn)3O4 as the positive electrode and activated carbon as the negative electrode operated stably within a 1.4 V voltage window, achieving an energy density of 46.94 Wh kg− 1 at 750 W kg− 1 and maintaining 12.06 Wh kg− 1 at 15000 W kg− 1. After 5000 cycles at 5 A g− 1, a capacitance retention of 87.23% was retained. This work demonstrates that precipitant-dosage regulation is an effective strategy for optimizing the microstructure and electrochemical performance of high-entropy spinel oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过共沉淀与空气煅烧合成尖晶石型 (FeCoMnCuZn)3O4 高熵氧化物，并系统研究沉淀剂类型和 Na2CO3 用量对结构、形貌、元素分布、价态及电化学性能的影响。10 mmol Na2CO3 制备的样品表现出单相尖晶石结构、均匀纳米颗粒形貌和多金属均匀分布，并具有多价金属物种和氧空位缺陷。该电极显示较高比电容和倍率性能，组装的非对称超级电容器具有较高能量密度和良好循环稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高熵氧化物（HEO）因其组成可调性、稳健的晶体结构、多组分协同效应以及优异的结构稳定性，已成为有前景的超级电容器电极材料。在本工作中，通过简便的共沉淀策略并随后进行空气煅烧，合成了尖晶石型 (FeCoMnCuZn)3O4 高熵氧化物。系统研究了沉淀剂类型和 Na2CO3 用量对相结构、颗粒形貌、元素分布、表面价态以及电化学性能的影响。采用 10 mmol Na2CO3 制备的样品表现出单相尖晶石结构、相对较高的结晶度、均匀的纳米颗粒形貌以及均一的多金属元素分布。XPS 分析证实，多价 Fe、Co、Mn 和 Cu 物种与氧空位相关缺陷共存，这有利于电荷转移和可逆法拉第反应。得益于优化的微结构和组成协同作用，10 mmol 电极在 1 A g−1 下提供了 416.4 F g−1 的比电容，并在 20 A g−1 下保持 207.4 F g−1。此外，以 (FeCoMnCuZn)3O4 作为正极、活性炭作为负极组装的非对称超级电容器可在 1.4 V 电压窗口内稳定工作，在 750 W kg−1 下实现 46.94 Wh kg−1 的能量密度，并在 15000 W kg−1 下保持 12.06 Wh kg−1。在 5 A g−1 下循环 5000 次后，仍保持 87.23% 的电容保持率。本工作表明，沉淀剂用量调控是优化高熵尖晶石氧化物微结构和电化学性能的有效策略。

articles.title: Extreme perivascular space burden in healthy youth as normative variation
articles.title_zh: 健康青少年中极高血管周围间隙负荷作为规范变异
articles.abstract: Purpose Perivascular spaces (PVS) are increasingly quantified as neuroimaging biomarkers related to glymphatic dysfunction. However, their normative distribution in healthy youth, especially in the upper tail, remains unclear. We aimed (1) to characterize the distribution of total PVS burden and define its upper-tail in neurologically healthy youth, and (2) examine whether upper-tail PVS extremes are associated with structural, behavioral, or cognitive deviations.Materials & Methods T1- and T2-weighted MRI from 80 neurologically healthy participants were processed with an automated enhanced-PVS-contrast pipeline to derive total PVS volume (mm³). Upper-tail individuals were defined using percentile thresholds (P75/P85/P95). Regression models compared high-PVS with non-high-PVS participants on global structural measures and behavioral outcomes. The most extreme cases were visually reviewed on source images for segmentation artifacts or radiological abnormalities.Results PVS burden was strongly right-skewed, with a small subset exhibiting very high values. Across P75/P85/P95 thresholds, upper-tail individuals showed no consistent differences in whole-brain cerebrospinal fluid or ventricular volumes, or behavioral measures. Visual review found no obvious abnormalities or major segmentation artifacts in the most extreme cases. Continuous PVS burden showed no clear association with behavioral outcomes.Conclusion Extremely large PVS volumes can occur as part of the normative distribution in healthy youth and do not necessarily imply concurrent abnormalities in global structural volumes or behavioral performance. These results argue against automatically excluding individuals with upper-tail PVS burden as “invalid outliers” in youth cohorts and highlight the value of combining normative benchmarking with targeted quality control and robustness checks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究健康青少年中血管周围间隙（PVS）负荷的规范分布及其上尾极端值的意义。基于 80 名神经系统健康参与者的 MRI 数据，作者发现 PVS 负荷呈强右偏分布，少数个体具有很高数值。上尾 PVS 个体未表现出一致的整体脑结构、脑脊液/脑室体积或行为认知异常，提示极高 PVS 负荷不应自动被视为无效离群值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 目的：血管周围间隙（PVS）越来越多地被量化为与类淋巴功能障碍相关的神经影像生物标志物。然而，它们在健康青少年中的规范分布，尤其是上尾部分，仍不清楚。我们的目标是：（1）表征总 PVS 负荷的分布并界定其在神经系统健康青少年中的上尾；（2）考察上尾 PVS 极端值是否与结构、行为或认知偏离相关。材料与方法：对来自 80 名神经系统健康参与者的 T1 加权和 T2 加权 MRI 进行处理，使用自动化增强 PVS 对比度流程得到总 PVS 体积（mm³）。使用百分位阈值（P75/P85/P95）定义上尾个体。回归模型比较高 PVS 与非高 PVS 参与者在全局结构指标和行为结局上的差异。对最极端病例的源图像进行视觉复核，以检查分割伪影或放射学异常。结果：PVS 负荷呈强烈右偏分布，少数子集表现出非常高的数值。在 P75/P85/P95 阈值下，上尾个体在全脑脑脊液或脑室体积以及行为指标方面均未显示一致差异。视觉复核在最极端病例中未发现明显异常或重大分割伪影。连续 PVS 负荷与行为结局之间未显示明确关联。结论：极大的 PVS 体积可以作为健康青少年规范分布的一部分出现，并不必然意味着同时存在全局结构体积或行为表现异常。这些结果反对在青少年队列中将上尾 PVS 负荷个体自动排除为“无效离群值”，并强调将规范基准、针对性质量控制和稳健性检查相结合的价值。

articles.title: Δ-learning for transferable machine learning interatomic potentials
articles.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) trained by directly learning the total interatomic interaction energies can suffer from limited transferability, unphysical behavior beyond a finite cutoff, and large errors for out-of-distribution geometries such as transition states and uncommon conformers. We evaluate Δ-learning (delta-learning) as a remedy by training an ANI-style high-dimensional neural network (HDNNP) potential as a correction to predict PBE0/aug-cc-pVTZ energies from a third-order tight-binding density functional theory (DFTB3) baseline model. On a held-out test set derived from the modified ANI-1x training set, the Δ-learning model (named ANIDFTB-Δ) achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.82 kcal/mol, while the HDNNP model (ANIPBE0-Direct) has an MAE of 2.01 kcal/mol. On selected GMTKN55 benchmarks, the Δ model systematically improves relative energies for conformers and tautomers and avoids catastrophic outliers on challenging structures. The good physical description of DFTB3 significantly reduces the error in proton-transfer transition states in the PX13 benchmark and intermolecular interactions in the DES370K dataset in comparison with reference target PBE0. The long-range electrostatics in DFTB3 also partially correct the long-range behavior of local descriptor MLIPs outside of their predetermined cutoff, reducing the MAE from 0.098 to 0.019 kcal/mol. The computational cost of this method is incrementally more expensive than DFTB3 alone, making it practical for extensive simulations of moderately sized systems, although the DFTB3 step makes the Δ model much more costly than a simple HDNNP alone.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.focus_summary: 本文讨论了用于分子间相互作用和构象能量预测的 Δ-learning 机器学习原子间势。结果表明，相比直接学习总能量，基于 DFTB3 基线模型的 Δ-learning 在泛化性、误差控制和异常结构鲁棒性方面更好。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们团队在机器学习势、分子动力学和材料模拟方法学上的工作非常相关。尽管文中主要面向分子体系，但其 Δ-learning 思路对构建更稳定、更可迁移的材料势函数具有直接借鉴意义。
