Principal component analysis of the resulting correlation maps yields low-dimensional, strictly convex representations that support lean neural networks (<100k trainable parameters) and non-parametric surrogate models, achieving sub-2% prediction error with as few as 10 training samples. Demonstrated across periodic crystals, chemically disordered high-entropy alloys, and non-periodic organic molecules, this framework enables Bayesian active learning and zero-shot extrapolation on commodity hardware, which current large-scale architectures cannot replicate at equivalent data budgets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述提出基于空间统计的特征工程，作为数据稀缺分子筛选中大型深度学习架构的物理严谨替代方案。该方法将分子结构编码为体素化标量场，并通过快速傅里叶变换确定性计算两点自相关和互相关，从而获得低维、凸性的结构表征。研究显示，该框架可支持小型神经网络和非参数代理模型，在少量训练样本下实现较低预测误差，并适用于晶体、高熵合金和有机分子等体系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计算材料发现中的主导范式依赖高度参数化的深度架构，包括消息传递图网络和等变模型，这些模型需要数百万个带有 DFT 标签的训练结构，并产生非凸潜在表示，从而使逆向设计中的连续优化复杂化。这些架构在数据稀缺情形下并不实用，而这正是分子筛选中的典型情况，并且在捕捉化学无序构型和手性几何方面存在已有充分记录的局限性。本综述提出基于空间统计的特征工程，作为一种物理上严格且可立即部署的替代方案。分子结构被编码为体素化标量场，并通过快速傅里叶变换确定性地评估两点自相关和互相关，从而明确地将空间模式识别的负担从学习算法转移到一个闭式的、具有物理信息的操作上。对所得相关图进行主成分分析，可得到低维、严格凸的表示，这些表示支持精简神经网络（少于 100k 个可训练参数）和非参数代理模型，并且在仅有 10 个训练样本的情况下即可实现低于 2% 的预测误差。该框架已在周期晶体、化学无序高熵合金和非周期有机分子中得到展示，可在普通硬件上实现贝叶斯主动学习和零样本外推，而当前的大规模架构在相同数据预算下无法复制这些能力。

articles.title: Dominant spin Hall torque and negligible orbital Hall torque in α-W/ferromagnet heterostructures with artifacts-free angular momentum detectors
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14872v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: α-phased W was theoretically predicted to have a negative spin Hall conductivity and a positive orbital Hall conductivity at the same time, leaving the physical origin of the current-induced torque a critical open question. Here, we develop two angular momentum detectors of Cu/Ni/Cu and Cu/Fe60Co20B20/Cu that are free of artifacts torques (e.g., self-induced torque and spin-vorticity torque) and clarify that the spin-orbit torque contributed by α-W remains negative and predominantly from the spin Hall effect in the entire thickness regime. The damping-like torque exhibits a monotonic decay as the W thickness increases above 5 nm likely due to the thickness-dependent structural evolution and resistivity reduction of the W layer. The negative torque in the entire thickness regime suggests negligible orbital Hall torque from α-W. This result is consistent with the theory that the orbital Hall effect from simplified band structure calculations is not a non-local angular momentum source.
authors: Taiyang Zhang, Lujun Zhu, Qianbiao Liu, Lijun Zhu

articles.title: Engineering symmetry-protected topological states in waveguide arrays
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.01769v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The topological classification of a system depends on the discrete symmetries of its Hamiltonian. In Floquet photonic waveguide arrays, the abstract symmetries of the Altland--Zirnbauer (AZ) scheme -- chiral, particle-hole, and time-reversal (for photonics, z-reversal) -- arise from structural properties of the lattice, yet a systematic correspondence has not been established. Here, we illustrate this correspondence for a simpler system of one-dimensional waveguide arrays with real coupling coefficients, showing how bipartite structure and z-reflection symmetry alone determine the whole AZ class. We further demonstrate that non-bipartite networks -- lacking conventional particle-hole symmetry, chiral symmetry, and z-reversal symmetry -- can nonetheless support topologically protected boundary states at quasienergy ǎrepsilon = π, even in one dimension. The protecting symmetry -- shifted-particle-hole symmetry -- applies equally to higher-dimensional Floquet waveguides.

articles.title: Radial transport of electric current by electromagnetic microturbulence in tokamaks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02763v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The turbulent transport of toroidal angular momentum helps determine the rotation profiles of tokamak plasmas, and thereby their confinement and stability. The electron contribution therein has an additional consequence: even a modest electron momentum flux can correspond to a substantial turbulent flux of toroidal current, whose divergence could in principle modify the safety-factor profile. Here, using nonlinear gyrokinetic simulations, we show that electromagnetic fluctuations qualitatively alter turbulent momentum transport. In microtearing-mode-driven turbulence, the total momentum transport is inefficient relative to that of heat, yet an electron contribution associated with the turbulent Maxwell stress dominates the momentum flux. We show that this contribution exceeds an estimated scale required for turbulent current redistribution to compete with the collisional processes maintaining the bootstrap current. In the case of kinetic-ballooning-mode-driven turbulence considered, the momentum transport is found to be stronger and remains dominated by the electrostatic ion contribution; nevertheless, retaining the Maxwell stress is essential for the electron momentum flux to exceed this bootstrap-based reference scale. To enable this study, we independently implemented complete electromagnetic momentum-flux diagnostics in the gyrokinetic codes GENE and CGYRO, and verified them through linear and nonlinear cross-code benchmarks. Taken together, these results suggest that electromagnetic momentum transport may potentially be important for the coupled evolution of the rotation, current, and safety-factor profiles in high-beta tokamak plasmas.
authors: Haomin Sun, Toby Adkins, Justin Ball, Yann Camenen

articles.title: The Existence Regions for Transcomplex Recombination of Heavy Ions. Two-Dimensional Recombination Regions and Surroundings Indices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02818v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we examine transcomplex recombination RCs⁺ + Br⁻ → CsBr + R (R = Kr, Xe, Hg) for collision energies from 0.1 to 2.5 eV. Within the framework of the quasiclassical trajectory method on semiempirical diabatic potential energy surfaces, we have considered the existence regions for recombination in the space of kinematic parameters. Two-dimensional "slices" of the existence regions for recombination (on the sphere where the coordinates are the orientation angles of the initial direction of the axis of the ionic complex RCs⁺⁾ sometimes exhibit a chaotic structure. We have proposed a quantitative measure of chaoticity of two-dimensional existence regions for recombination (on the basis of the combinatorics of matrices of zeros and ones) and have presented examples of chaotic regions. We have introduced the surroundings index of recombinative trajectories and have explored its connection with the integration time of the trajectory and with the total internal energy of the product molecule CsBr.
authors: V. M. Akimov, V. M. Azriel, E. V. Ermolova, D. B. Kabanov, L. I. Kolesnikova, L. Yu. Rusin, M. B. Sevryuk

articles.title: An Open Source RFSoC-based Readout Electronics System for Arrays of Kinetic Inductance Detectors and Superconducting Resonators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a novel readout electronics system for large arrays of superconducting electromagnetic resonators, such as kinetic inductance detectors (KIDs), based on a Radio Frequency System on Chip (RFSoC) architecture. Each channel in the readout system is designed for frequency division multiplexing of up to 1024 high quality factor resonances placed on a single microwave transmission line at unique frequencies within a 512 MHz bandwidth. We describe the design of the digital and analog signal processing chains for the implementation of a two-channel 2048-resonator system on the Xilinx ZCU111 RFSoC evaluation board in combination with a custom intermediate frequency (IF) system to convert the RFSoC band to higher frequencies up to 4 GHz. We also detail an associated software interface that provides a range of tools commonly utilized for characterizing KID resonators and for operating them as part of a photometric millimeter-wave imager. We additionally provide noise characterizations of the individual readout components, along with the complete readout system in isolation and in operation to readout KID resonators.
authors: Cody Roberson, Nia McNichols, Jack Sayers, Sean Bryan, Daniel Cunnane, Peter K. Day, Fabien Defrance, Simon Hempel-Costello, Tracee Jamison-Hooks, Bradley R. Johnson, Maya Lee, Philip Mauskopf, Adrian Sinclair, Liam C. Walters, Eric Weeks

articles.title: Cooling down trees for finite-temperature quantum dynamics: Purification within ML-MCTDH
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating multidimensional quantum systems at finite temperature is inherently challenging as the system is no longer described by a single, pure-state wavefunction but by a density operator, squaring an already exponential scaling of the Hilbert space. Building upon the compact wavefunction ansatz of the multi-layer multiconfiguration time-dependent Hartree (ML-MCTDH) method, we present a new scheme for simulating finite-temperature quantum dynamics based on purification. Here, a density operator is mapped to a single ML-MCTDH wavefunction in an enlarged Hilbert space, comprising physical and auxiliary degrees of freedom. In the key step, one obtains a pure-state representation of the canonical density operator via imaginary time-propagation of the infinite-temperature state. The most important observation is that this state can be exactly decomposed as a Hartree product of maximally entangled combined modes, each combined mode consisting of a physical degree of freedom and its auxiliary counterpart. Through dynamically pruning the node ranks of the ML-tree during the "cool down" stage yields a compact finite-temperature wavefunction, thus accelerating the real-time propagation and enabling finite-temperature simulations of multidimensional, correlated molecular systems. Our method circumvents both intensive statistical sampling and costly tensor-decomposition of the full density-operator, while being broadly applicable to model Hamiltonians and general ab initio potential energy surfaces alike. Two applications of the method are presented, benchmark results on the thermal ground-state of H2O as well as temperature-dependent infrared absorption spectra of the more challenging, floppy H3O2- anion.

articles.title: Quasi-single-stage optimization for advanced stellarators
articles.title_zh: 先进仿星器的准单阶段优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advanced stellarator design requires a balance between plasma performance and the manufacturability of three-dimensional modular coils. In conventional two-stage optimization, the coils required to realize an optimized equilibrium can be limited by engineering feasibility. Here, we develop a quasi-single-stage (QSS) framework that incorporates coil feasibility directly into plasma-boundary optimization. QSS uses the maximum normalized normal-field error, evaluated rapidly from surface currents on a uniformly offset winding surface, as a coil-feasibility surrogate. We apply this method to optimize configurations targeting quasi-axisymmetry, quasi-helical symmetry, quasi-isodynamicity, and a combination of omnigenity with piecewise omnigenity. The QSS-optimized configurations exhibit smoother plasma boundaries and winding surfaces, lower normal-field reconstruction errors, and reduced coil complexity, while preserving favourable magnetic-symmetry and transport properties. QSS provides a practical proof-of-principle strategy for co-optimizing plasma physics and coil engineering in stellarator design.
articles.abstract_zh: 先进仿星器设计需要在等离子体性能与三维模块化线圈可制造性之间取得平衡。本文提出准单阶段优化框架，将线圈可行性直接纳入等离子体边界优化，并在多种磁场优化目标中验证其效果。结果显示，该方法可获得更平滑的等离子体边界和绕线面，降低法向场重构误差与线圈复杂度，同时保持有利的磁对称性和输运性质。
authors: Guodong Yu, Yidong Xie, Hengqian Liu, Caoxiang Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03122v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：先进仿星器设计需要在等离子体性能与三维模块化线圈的可制造性之间取得平衡。在传统的两阶段优化中，实现优化平衡所需的线圈可能受到工程可行性的限制。在这里，我们发展了一种准单阶段（QSS）框架，将线圈可行性直接纳入等离子体边界优化。QSS 使用从均匀偏置绕线面上的表面电流快速评估得到的最大归一化法向场误差，作为线圈可行性的替代指标。我们将该方法用于优化以准轴对称性、准螺旋对称性、准等动力性以及全局等漂移性与分段全局等漂移性组合为目标的构型。经 QSS 优化的构型表现出更平滑的等离子体边界和绕线面、更低的法向场重构误差以及降低的线圈复杂度，同时保持了有利的磁对称性和输运性质。QSS 为在仿星器设计中协同优化等离子体物理与线圈工程提供了一种实用的原理验证策略。

articles.title: Generation of dense relativistic electron beams via vortex laser-driven self-generated magnetic pinching
articles.title_zh: 通过涡旋激光驱动的自生磁箍缩产生高密度相对论电子束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03240v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In multi-petawatt laser plasma accelerators, achieving high-density relativistic electron beams is typically accompanied by large transverse divergence, limiting the attainable effective electron density needed for high-flux interaction regimes relevant to laboratory astrophysics. Here we report experimental demonstration of self-generated magnetic pinching (SMP), a collective mechanism that actively regulates transverse beam dynamics using a Laguerre-Gaussian laser at strong relativistic intensity (~8 x 10¹⁹ W/cm²⁾ interacting with an underdense plasma. The electron beam evolves from a two-lobe high-charge injection structure into a compressed, high-density profile, yielding a threefold reduction in divergence and nearly an order-of-magnitude enhancement in effective beam density compared with a Gaussian driver. Particle-in-cell simulations agree with the experimental observations and reveal that a self-generated azimuthal magnetic field governs the electron dynamics within the SMP regime, which is defined by the forming condition S = 0.717 l a0 [ne(10¹⁸ cm⁻³⁾]⁻³/4 = 1, where l, a0, and ne are topological charge, laser amplitude, and plasma density, respectively. A transient kick from a dense inner sheath electron population drives collective magnetic pinching, transforming an initially separated electron distribution into a compressed and well-collimated beam. For higher-power laser systems, the forming condition can be extended to higher plasma densities and larger orbital angular momentum modes, potentially enabling electron beams with charges exceeding several nC and effective densities above 10¹⁹ cm⁻³. This mechanism provides a route to overcoming transverse expansion and enhancing rare interaction processes relevant to high-flux particle sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 多拍瓦激光等离子体加速器中，高密度相对论电子束通常伴随较大发散角，限制了有效电子密度。本文实验展示了由强相对论强度拉盖尔-高斯激光与欠密等离子体相互作用引发的自生磁箍缩机制，可显著压缩并准直电子束。实验与粒子模拟表明，自生方位角磁场主导该过程，并为更高功率激光系统产生高电荷、高有效密度电子束提供了途径。
authors: Mingxuan Wei, Fengyu Sun, Zhongpeng Li, Xichen Hu, Huiting Ma, Guangwei Lu, Zhuofan Zhang, Lijie Cui, Qijin Zhang, Mengjiao Wang, Weijun Zhou, Qian Zhao, Wenqing Wei, Yi Xu, Zongxin Zhang, Jiayi Qian, Jiacheng Zhu, Xiaoyan Liang, Min Chen, Wenpeng Wang, Jian-Xing Li, Wenchao Yan, Yuxin Leng, Jie Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03240v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：在多拍瓦激光等离子体加速器中，实现高密度相对论电子束通常伴随着较大的横向发散，这限制了与实验室天体物理相关的高通量相互作用状态所需的可达到有效电子密度。这里我们报道了自生磁箍缩（SMP）的实验演示，这是一种集体机制，在强相对论强度（约 8 x 10¹⁹ W/cm²）的拉盖尔-高斯激光与欠密等离子体相互作用时，能够主动调控横向束流动力学。电子束从双瓣高电荷注入结构演化为压缩的高密度剖面，与高斯驱动相比，其发散角降低三倍，有效束密度提高近一个数量级。粒子-in-cell 模拟与实验观测一致，并揭示在 SMP 状态中，自生方位角磁场支配电子动力学；该状态由形成条件 S = 0.717 l a0 [ne(10¹⁸ cm⁻³)]⁻³/4 = 1 定义，其中 l、a0 和 ne 分别为拓扑荷、激光振幅和等离子体密度。来自致密内鞘电子群体的瞬态冲量驱动集体磁箍缩，将初始分离的电子分布转变为压缩且良好准直的束流。对于更高功率的激光系统，该形成条件可扩展到更高等离子体密度和更大的轨道角动量模式，从而有可能实现电荷超过数 nC、有效密度高于 10¹⁹ cm⁻³ 的电子束。该机制提供了一条克服横向膨胀并增强与高通量粒子源相关的稀有相互作用过程的途径。

articles.title: A Unified Graph Neural Network Framework for Non-Equilibrium Carrier and Lattice Dynamics Driven by Electric Fields
articles.title_zh: 用于电场驱动非平衡载流子与晶格动力学的统一图神经网络框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite-temperature simulations of electric-field-driven dynamics need a unified description of interatomic interactions, local electronic states, and configuration-dependent electric responses. First-principles simulations remain scale-limited, whereas conventional machine-learning potentials lack electric-field effects. Recent machine-learning frameworks have incorporated electric-field response or atom-resolved electronic-state information, but rarely both within a single framework. Here, we develop an electric-field-response graph neural network (EFR-GNN) that predicts energies, forces, Born effective charge tensors, atom-resolved charges and magnetic moments, and supports long-time field-driven molecular dynamics with atom-resolved tracking of localized electronic states. In hole-doped MgO, static fields rectify thermally activated hole-polaron hopping through a forward--backward asymmetry quantified by a nearest-neighbor model. In GaAs, resonant terahertz excitation generates a coherent Γ-point transverse-optical phonon with dephasing consistent with experiment, while opposite helicities reverse its rotation. In superionic α-AgI, it reproduces temperature-dependent Ag⁺ mobility and collective field-driven ionic drift. Together, EFR-GNN offers an approach to finite-temperature simulations of field-driven atomic and localized-carrier dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 电场驱动有限温度动力学模拟需要同时描述原子间相互作用、局域电子态和构型依赖的电响应。本文提出电场响应图神经网络 EFR-GNN，可预测能量、力、Born 有效电荷张量、原子分辨电荷和磁矩，并支持长时间电场驱动分子动力学。其在空穴掺杂 MgO、GaAs 和超离子 α-AgI 中展示了对局域载流子、声子和离子迁移行为的有效模拟能力。
authors: Jia-Wen Li, Sheng Meng, Xinghua Shi, Jin Zhang, Wei-Hai Fang
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03287v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：电场驱动动力学的有限温度模拟需要对原子间相互作用、局域电子态以及构型依赖的电响应进行统一描述。第一性原理模拟仍受到尺度限制，而传统机器学习势缺乏电场效应。近期的机器学习框架已经纳入了电场响应或原子分辨电子态信息，但很少在单一框架中同时包含二者。在这里，我们发展了一种电场响应图神经网络（EFR-GNN），可预测能量、力、Born 有效电荷张量、原子分辨电荷和磁矩，并支持长时间的电场驱动分子动力学，同时对局域电子态进行原子分辨跟踪。在空穴掺杂 MgO 中，静态电场通过由最近邻模型量化的前向—后向不对称性，对热激活的空穴极化子跳跃进行整流。在 GaAs 中，共振太赫兹激发产生相干的 Γ 点横向光学声子，其退相干与实验一致，而相反的螺旋性会反转其旋转方向。在超离子 α-AgI 中，它再现了温度依赖的 Ag⁺ 迁移率和集体电场驱动离子漂移。总体而言，EFR-GNN 为场驱动原子动力学和局域载流子动力学的有限温度模拟提供了一种方法。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出电场响应图神经网络 EFR-GNN，统一预测能量、力、Born 有效电荷、原子电荷和磁矩，并支持有限温度电场驱动的长时间分子动力学。应用于 MgO 空穴极化子迁移、GaAs 太赫兹激发相干声子以及超离子 AgI 等体系，展示了对非平衡载流子和晶格动力学的描述能力。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习势、图神经网络、Born 有效电荷、非平衡载流子动力学、极化子和电场驱动分子动力学方向高度相关。其将电响应、局域电子态和磁矩纳入统一 GNN 的思路，可直接借鉴到铁电翻转、缺陷迁移、热载流子弛豫和自旋-晶格耦合模拟中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读模型架构、长程电场处理和可观测量训练策略，并评估其与现有等变神经网络势或机器学习哈密顿量框架的兼容性。可尝试扩展到 HfO2 铁电、卤化物钙钛矿缺陷动力学或二维铁电电场驱动翻转过程。

articles.title: Radiation reaction in the classical relativistic Størmer problem
articles.title_zh: 经典相对论 Størmer 问题中的辐射反作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend the classical relativistic Størmer problem by incorporating radiation reaction through the Landau--Lifshitz formulation, thereby providing a self-consistent description of dissipative charged-particle motion in a static dipole magnetic field. We derive the complete dimensionless equations and distinguish them from a reduced drag-only model that preserves the exact energy-loss law while omitting directional effects associated with magnetic field gradients. For planar motion, the reduced system yields exact instantaneous evolution laws for the particle energy and canonical angular momentum, together with averaged transport equations for regular bound librations. When the motion is constrained to the instantaneous circular branch, the secular evolution can be integrated in closed form and approaches a simple large-radius power law. This analytical solution provides a useful benchmark, although the circular branch is radially unstable and therefore does not describe generic nearby trajectories. Numerical integrations further illustrate the nonuniform dissipative deformation of planar rosette-like orbits. In three dimensions, the complete Landau--Lifshitz force produces local exponential damping of small vertical perturbations, with the leading contribution arising from the field-gradient term absent from the reduced model. These exact, averaged, conditional, and local results establish a controlled analytical framework for studying radiation-driven phase-space transport in strongly inhomogeneous magnetic fields and provide a foundation for future global simulations, kinetic descriptions, and calculations of the associated electromagnetic emission.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过 Landau--Lifshitz 形式将辐射反作用引入经典相对论 Størmer 问题，描述静态偶极磁场中带电粒子的耗散运动。作者推导了完整无量纲方程，并与只保留阻力的约化模型加以区分。平面和三维分析揭示了能量、角动量、轨道形变以及垂直扰动阻尼等行为，为强非均匀磁场中的辐射驱动相空间输运研究提供了分析框架。
authors: Francisco S. N. Lobo, Tiberiu Harko
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03310v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：我们通过 Landau--Lifshitz 表述纳入辐射反作用，扩展了经典相对论 Størmer 问题，从而为静态偶极磁场中的耗散带电粒子运动提供了自洽描述。我们推导了完整的无量纲方程，并将其与一种约化的仅阻力模型区分开来，后者保留精确的能量损失定律，但省略了与磁场梯度相关的方向效应。对于平面运动，约化系统给出了粒子能量和正则角动量的精确瞬时演化定律，以及规则有界摆动的平均输运方程。当运动被约束在瞬时圆形分支上时，其长期演化可以以闭式形式积分，并趋近于一个简单的大半径幂律。该解析解提供了有用的基准，尽管圆形分支在径向上不稳定，因此不能描述一般的邻近轨道。数值积分进一步展示了平面玫瑰状轨道的非均匀耗散形变。在三维中，完整的 Landau--Lifshitz 力会对小的垂直扰动产生局域指数阻尼，其主导贡献来自约化模型中缺失的场梯度项。这些精确、平均、条件性和局域结果建立了一个受控的分析框架，用于研究强非均匀磁场中的辐射驱动相空间输运，并为未来的全局模拟、动力学描述以及相关电磁辐射计算奠定基础。

articles.title: Space-Time Event Scattering and Extension Method (STESEM): A Universal Framework for Scattering in Space-Time Metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 时空事件散射与延拓方法（STESEM）：时空超材料散射的通用框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Space-time metamaterials offer unprecedented control over electromagnetic waves by enabling simultaneous manipulation of spatial and temporal degrees of freedom. However, analytical descriptions of their scattering processes remain fragmented, with existing approaches typically requiring configuration-specific derivations or transformations to specialized reference frames that become impractical for accelerated or multi-interface structures. In this tutorial, we introduce the space-time event scattering and extension method (STESEM), a universal framework for electromagnetic scattering at arbitrary space-time interfaces. By decomposing the scattering process into a local interaction event and a subsequent extension along invariant traveling-wave coordinates, STESEM formulates space-time scattering directly in the laboratory frame without requiring coordinate transformations. The method provides a unified description of scattering amplitudes, frequency transitions and phase transformations for arbitrary incident waveforms and interface trajectories. We demonstrate the framework by deriving the complete scattering responses of canonical space-time structures, including stationary and instantaneous interfaces, space-time corners, uniformly moving interfaces, wedges and accelerated boundaries. Beyond providing analytical solutions, STESEM reveals the physical principles underlying these distinct phenomena and shows that complex space-time scattering processes can be constructed from elementary moving-interface interactions. This framework establishes a systematic foundation for analyzing and designing advanced space-time metamaterials, enabling extensions toward dispersive, bianisotropic and higher-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 时空超材料可同时操控电磁波的空间和时间自由度，但其散射解析描述长期较为碎片化。本文提出时空事件散射与延拓方法 STESEM，将散射分解为局域相互作用事件和沿不变量行波坐标的后续延拓，从而在实验室参考系中直接处理任意时空界面。该框架统一描述多类典型时空结构的散射响应，并为先进时空超材料的分析与设计奠定系统基础。
authors: Klaas De Kinder, Amir Bahrami, Christophe Caloz
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03333v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：时空超材料通过实现对空间和时间自由度的同时操控，为电磁波提供了前所未有的控制能力。然而，对其散射过程的解析描述仍然是碎片化的，现有方法通常需要针对特定构型进行推导，或变换到专门的参考系，而对于加速或多界面结构，这些做法会变得不切实际。在这篇教程中，我们介绍了时空事件散射与延拓方法（STESEM），这是一个用于任意时空界面电磁散射的通用框架。通过将散射过程分解为一个局域相互作用事件以及随后沿不变行波坐标的延拓，STESEM 无需坐标变换即可直接在实验室参考系中表述时空散射。该方法为任意入射波形和界面轨迹下的散射振幅、频率跃迁和相位变换提供了统一描述。我们通过推导典型时空结构的完整散射响应来展示该框架，包括静止界面和瞬时界面、时空角、匀速运动界面、楔形结构和加速边界。除提供解析解之外，STESEM 还揭示了这些不同现象背后的物理原理，并表明复杂的时空散射过程可以由基本的运动界面相互作用构造而成。该框架为分析和设计先进时空超材料建立了系统基础，并使其能够扩展到色散、双各向异性和更高维系统。

articles.title: Mid-infrared spontaneous and stimulated emission dynamics in black phosphorus
articles.title_zh: 黑磷中的中红外自发与受激发射动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03346v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Black phosphorus (BP) has attracted attention as a light-emitting layered semiconductor for mid-infrared (MIR) photonics owing to its direct and thickness-tunable bandgap energy, highly anisotropic optical transitions, and potentially suppressed Auger recombination. However, spontaneous and stimulated emission dynamics governed by carrier recombination in BP have remained unexplored because time-resolved emission spectroscopy is challenging in the MIR region. Here we develop a time-resolved MIR emission microscope combining wavelength upconversion with superconducting single photon detection. This approach enables observation of emission dynamics in photoexcited BP at a wavelength around 4.6 μm with sub-100-ps temporal resolution. Temperature-dependent measurements reveal a crossover from excitonic to electron-hole plasma emission at around 70 K, supported by independent results in the characteristic transition temperature, pump-fluence dependence, and rise and decay dynamics of MIR emission. In a suspended BP structure, we further observe a nonlinear increase in the emission intensity above a well-defined pump threshold. Spectral narrowing and intense picosecond emission pulses appear above the threshold, providing solid evidence of stimulated emission assisted by optical feedback from a Fabry-Pérot cavity. These results elucidate ultrafast carrier dynamics and optical gain formation in BP and establish time-resolved upconversion spectroscopy as a powerful approach for investigating MIR photonic materials and devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 黑磷因其直接且厚度可调的带隙、高各向异性光学跃迁和潜在受抑的 Auger 复合，被视为有前景的中红外发光层状半导体。本文发展了结合波长上转换与超导单光子探测的时间分辨中红外发射显微技术，在约 4.6 μm 处观测光激发黑磷的发射动力学。结果揭示了激子到电子-空穴等离子体发射的转变，并在悬空黑磷结构中观察到由 Fabry-Pérot 腔反馈辅助的受激发射证据。
authors: Hisashi Sumikura, Akihiko Shinya, Masaya Notomi
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03346v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：黑磷（BP）作为一种用于中红外（MIR）光子学的发光层状半导体而受到关注，这是由于其具有直接且厚度可调的带隙能量、高度各向异性的光学跃迁以及可能受到抑制的 Auger 复合。然而，由于中红外区域的时间分辨发射光谱具有挑战性，由 BP 中载流子复合所支配的自发和受激发射动力学仍未得到探索。在这里，我们开发了一种时间分辨中红外发射显微镜，将波长上转换与超导单光子探测相结合。该方法能够以低于 100 ps 的时间分辨率，在约 4.6 μm 波长处观测光激发 BP 的发射动力学。温度依赖测量揭示了在约 70 K 附近从激子发射到电子-空穴等离子体发射的交叉转变，并得到特征转变温度、泵浦通量依赖性以及中红外发射上升和衰减动力学方面独立结果的支持。在悬空 BP 结构中，我们进一步观察到发射强度在一个明确定义的泵浦阈值以上发生非线性增加。阈值以上出现光谱变窄和强烈的皮秒发射脉冲，为由 Fabry-Pérot 腔光反馈辅助的受激发射提供了坚实证据。这些结果阐明了 BP 中的超快载流子动力学和光增益形成，并确立了时间分辨上转换光谱作为研究中红外光子材料与器件的有力方法。

articles.title: Organic liquid scintillator neutrino detector experiment, theoretical modeling, and computational simulation
articles.title_zh: 有机液体闪烁体中微子探测器实验、理论建模与计算模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Liquid Scintillator Neutrino Detector (LSND) experiment aimed at investigating neutrino oscillations, particularly the transformation of muon-type antineutrinos ((øverlineν_μ)) into electron-type antineutrinos ((øverlineνₑ)). This phenomenon challenges the Standard Model's assumption of massless neutrinos. The LSND employed a large organic liquid scintillator (LS) to detect low-energy neutrino interactions, enhanced by the addition of metal ions such as gadolinium (Gd) for improved signal sensitivity and noise suppression. Theoretical modeling and simulations are used in this paper to accurately interpret experimental results. The FLUKA Monte Carlo code was employed to simulate particle interactions and transport in the detector. Key processes modeled included neutrino interactions ((øverlineνₑ + p → e⁺ + n)), neutron capture ((n + p → d + γ)), and the corresponding light output in the scintillator. The simulations accounted for quenching effects using Birks' law, enabling precise predictions of light yield and detector response to secondary particles. Neutrino fluxes from decay-at-rest (DAR) and decay-in-flight (DIF) processes were calculated, capturing the energy spectra of neutrinos generated by pion and muon decays. Pion production cross-sections and light output efficiency for various particles were also modeled to understand detector performance comprehensively. The theoretical modeling and simulation framework validated the experimental observations and provided insights into the detector's sensitivity and limitations. The LSND results hinted at deviations from the Standard Model, stimulating further investigations into neutrino oscillations and the potential existence of sterile neutrinos.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文围绕 LSND 实验的中微子振荡研究，结合理论建模和 FLUKA 蒙特卡罗模拟解释有机液体闪烁体探测器响应。模拟涵盖反电子中微子与质子相互作用、中子俘获、闪烁光输出、淬灭效应以及 DAR 和 DIF 中微子通量等过程。该框架用于验证实验观测并分析探测器灵敏度和局限，同时讨论 LSND 结果对超出标准模型现象的启示。
authors: Xi Liu, Wenxi Fang, Ken Perlin
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03359v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：液体闪烁体中微子探测器（LSND）实验旨在研究中微子振荡，特别是 μ 型反中微子（øverlineν_μ）向电子型反中微子（øverlineνₑ）的转变。这一现象挑战了标准模型关于中微子无质量的假设。LSND 采用大型有机液体闪烁体（LS）来探测低能中微子相互作用，并通过加入钆（Gd）等金属离子来提高信号灵敏度和抑制噪声。本文使用理论建模和模拟来准确解释实验结果。采用 FLUKA 蒙特卡罗代码来模拟探测器中的粒子相互作用和输运。建模的关键过程包括中微子相互作用（øverlineνₑ + p → e⁺ + n）、中子俘获（n + p → d + γ）以及闪烁体中相应的光输出。模拟使用 Birks 定律考虑淬灭效应，从而能够精确预测光产额和探测器对次级粒子的响应。计算了来自静止衰变（DAR）和飞行衰变（DIF）过程的中微子通量，捕捉由 π 介子和 μ 子衰变产生的中微子能谱。还对 π 介子产生截面以及不同粒子的光输出效率进行了建模，以全面理解探测器性能。理论建模和模拟框架验证了实验观测，并提供了对探测器灵敏度和局限性的认识。LSND 结果暗示了与标准模型的偏离，推动了对中微子振荡以及惰性中微子潜在存在的进一步研究。

articles.title: Real-Time Smart Self-Mixing Interferometry Sensor With Embedded Neural Network
articles.title_zh: 带嵌入式神经网络的实时智能自混合干涉传感器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-mixing interferometry is a measurement ap- proach in which a laser beam is re-injected into the emitting laser itself after reflection on a target. Information about the position of the target can be obtained from monitoring the voltage across the laser. However, analyzing this signal is difficult. In previous works, neural networks have been used with great success to process this data. In this article, we present an updated prototype of an integrated sensor based on self-mixing interferometry with embedded neural networks. It consists of a semiconductor laser (acting both as light emitter and detector) equipped with an embedded platform for data processing. The platform includes an ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) and an STM32U575ZI microcontroller. The microcontroller runs a residual neural network in charge of reconstructing the displacement of a target from the interferometric signal entering the ADC. We assess the robustness of the neural network to unwanted signal amplitude variations, the impact of different network weights quantization choices required to run the network on the microcontroller, and the energy consumption of the system. Finally, we provide a demonstration of target displacement reconstruction fully running on the embedded platform in real-time. Our results pave the way towards robust, low power and versatile sensors based on self-mixing interferometry and embedded neural networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 自混合干涉通过将目标反射光重新注入发射激光器，并监测激光器电压来获取目标位置信息，但信号分析较困难。本文提出更新版集成传感器原型，将半导体激光器与嵌入式数据处理平台结合，并在微控制器上运行残差神经网络以实时重构目标位移。研究评估了网络对幅度扰动、权重量化和能耗的影响，并展示了完整嵌入式实时位移重构。
authors: Pierre-Emmanuel Novac, Laurent Rodriguez, Stéphane Barland
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03448v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：自混合干涉是一种测量方法，其中激光束在目标上反射后被重新注入发射激光器本身。通过监测激光器两端的电压，可以获得关于目标位置的信息。然而，分析该信号是困难的。在以往工作中，神经网络已被非常成功地用于处理这些数据。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于自混合干涉并嵌入神经网络的集成传感器更新原型。它由一个半导体激光器和一个用于数据处理的嵌入式平台组成，其中半导体激光器同时作为光发射器和探测器。该平台包括一个 ADC（模数转换器）和一个 STM32U575ZI 微控制器。微控制器运行一个残差神经网络，负责从进入 ADC 的干涉信号中重构目标位移。我们评估了神经网络对不希望出现的信号幅度变化的鲁棒性、在微控制器上运行网络所需的不同网络权重量化选择的影响，以及系统的能量消耗。最后，我们展示了完全在嵌入式平台上实时运行的目标位移重构。我们的结果为基于自混合干涉和嵌入式神经网络的稳健、低功耗且多功能传感器铺平了道路。

articles.title: A 3-D Hybrid Numerical Method for Simulating Electromagnetic Fields in Structures with Multiple Inhomogeneous Layered Media
articles.title_zh: 用于模拟多重非均匀层状介质结构中电磁场的三维混合数值方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03639v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A three-dimensional (3-D) hybrid numerical method (HNM) is presented for electromagnetic scattering in structures with multiple inhomogeneous layered media coupled to an arbitrary 3-D non-layered scattering region. It integrates the 3-D numerical mode-matching (NMM) method with a tree-cotree-based mixed finite element method (MFEM). In the NMM, the fields in the 3-D layered media are reduced to a superposition of 2-D waveguide eigenmodes, while the MFEM discretizes the 3-D scattering region. The HNM thus inherits the dimensionality-reduction advantages of both conventional hybrid MM/FEM and pure NMM. Numerical experiments show that the HNM provides an effcient alternative for scattering problems involving non-layered regions embedded in layered media.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种三维混合数值方法，用于处理多重非均匀层状介质与任意三维非层状散射区域耦合结构中的电磁散射。该方法结合三维数值模式匹配方法和基于树-余树的混合有限元方法，将层状介质中的场化为二维波导本征模叠加，同时离散三维散射区域。数值实验表明，该方法可高效处理嵌入层状介质中的非层状区域散射问题。
authors: Jie Liu, Taihe Li, Ke Chen, Mingwei Zhuang, Qing Huo Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03639v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：本文提出了一种三维（3-D）混合数值方法（HNM），用于研究包含多重非均匀层状介质并耦合任意三维非层状散射区域的结构中的电磁散射。它将三维数值模式匹配（NMM）方法与基于树-余树的混合有限元方法（MFEM）相结合。在 NMM 中，三维层状介质中的场被化简为二维波导本征模的叠加，而 MFEM 对三维散射区域进行离散。因此，HNM 继承了传统混合 MM/FEM 和纯 NMM 的降维优势。数值实验表明，对于涉及嵌入层状介质中的非层状区域的散射问题，HNM 提供了一种高效替代方案。

articles.title: TNASS: Tensor Network Active Space Selection with the Entanglement Feature
articles.title_zh: TNASS：具有纠缠特征的张量网络活性空间选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quality of multi-scale modelling techniques in molecular electronic structure calculations, such as embedding and subspace methods, relies upon the chosen active space. The automation of active space selection is vital for ensuring the accuracy, reproducibility, and scalability in such calculations. In this work, we introduce Tensor Network Active Space Selection using the Entanglement Feature. Through the isolation of strongly correlated electrons, this method provides a scalable foundation for embedding methods in multi-scale modelling. By representing the purities of all possible orbital partitions as a Matrix Product State, our method isolates regions of strong electron correlation without requiring manual preselection of target atoms or the calculation of expensive high-order density matrices. The results demonstrate that this approach leads to lower ground state energies and more accurate dipole moments than other fully automated selection schemes such as those based solely on single-orbital entropy or the selection of spatial orbitals around the HOMO/LUMO gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子电子结构多尺度建模中，嵌入和子空间方法的质量高度依赖所选活性空间，自动化选择对准确性、可重复性和可扩展性至关重要。本文提出利用纠缠特征的张量网络活性空间选择方法，通过隔离强关联电子为多尺度嵌入方法提供可扩展基础。该方法将所有可能轨道划分的纯度表示为矩阵乘积态，可在无需手动预选目标原子或昂贵高阶密度矩阵的情况下识别强电子关联区域。
authors: Angus Mingare, Isabelle Heuzé, Peter V. Coveney
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03645v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：分子电子结构计算中的多尺度建模技术，如嵌入方法和子空间方法，其质量依赖于所选择的活性空间。活性空间选择的自动化对于确保此类计算的准确性、可重复性和可扩展性至关重要。在这项工作中，我们引入了利用纠缠特征的张量网络活性空间选择方法。通过隔离强关联电子，该方法为多尺度建模中的嵌入方法提供了可扩展基础。通过将所有可能轨道划分的纯度表示为矩阵乘积态，我们的方法能够隔离强电子关联区域，而不需要手动预选目标原子，也不需要计算昂贵的高阶密度矩阵。结果表明，与其他完全自动化的选择方案相比，例如仅基于单轨道熵或选择 HOMO/LUMO 能隙附近空间轨道的方法，该方法能够得到更低的基态能量和更准确的偶极矩。

articles.title: A windy sea surface with Stokes waves
articles.title_zh: 具有 Stokes 波的有风海面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting the transition of wind-forced, gravito-capillary surface waves from smooth to corrugated states remains a longstanding problem in nonlinear wave mechanics. Solving driven-dissipative, nonlinear potential flow equations we map these waves (4-13 cm) onto a Reynolds number -- wave energy phase-space. We identify a transition band separating smooth from corrugated wave states - the wave steepness exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on Reynolds number within this. Subharmonic (in)stability analysis reveals that the fastest-growing mode intensifies corrugations on alternate faces of the carrier wave, offering insights with broad implications for interfacial pattern-formation and oceanic remote-sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测受风强迫的重力-毛细表面波从平滑态向褶皱态转变，仍是非线性波力学中的长期问题。本文求解受驱耗散非线性势流方程，将 4--13 cm 波长的波映射到 Reynolds 数—波能量相空间，并识别出分隔平滑和褶皱波态的转变带。亚谐波稳定性分析表明，增长最快的模会增强载波交替波面的褶皱，对界面图案形成和海洋遥感具有启示意义。
authors: Nikhil Yewale, Anil Kumar, Vinod Kadari, Ratul Dasgupta
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03657v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：预测受风强迫的重力-毛细表面波从平滑状态向褶皱状态的转变，仍然是非线性波力学中的一个长期问题。通过求解受驱动-耗散的非线性势流方程，我们将这些波（4--13 cm）映射到 Reynolds 数—波能量相空间中。我们识别出一个将平滑波态与褶皱波态分开的转变带——在该转变带内，波陡对 Reynolds 数表现出非单调依赖。亚谐波（不）稳定性分析揭示，增长最快的模会增强载波交替波面上的褶皱，从而为界面图案形成和海洋遥感提供具有广泛意义的认识。

articles.title: AFLOW-EMERALD: ElectroMagnetic modes EngineeRing in Advanced LayereD materials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03759v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered and periodically patterned heterostructures underpin advanced optical, photonic, and plasmonic (meta)materials, whose rational design demands electromagnetic solvers that are both numerically robust and tightly linked to the underlying material properties. Here, we present AFLOW-EMERALD (ElectroMagnetic modes EngineeRing in Advanced LayereD materials), an open-source, modular, Python-based computational framework for simulating electromagnetic wave propagation in finite and periodic layered (meta)materials. Built around a unified object-oriented architecture, AFLOW-EMERALD combines a numerically stable scattering-matrix method with plane-wave expansion and extends to rigorous coupled-wave analysis for laterally patterned structures such as gratings. The software computes optical spectra, spatial field distributions, and photonic band structures, including complex-k dispersion in lossy, dispersive media. A streamlined YAML workflow allows users to seamlessly import dielectric function datasets from experimental, literature, or first-principles sources. Owing to its modular design, AFLOW-EMERALD is readily extensible and suitable for integration into computational materials-design pipelines, providing a practical platform for the coupled material-geometry engineering of dielectric photonic crystals, plasmonic multilayers, hyperbolic metamaterials, and more complex architectures supporting, e.g., surface and volume plasmon-polariton modes.
authors: Stefano Campanaro, Luca Bursi, Nicholas H. Anderson, Stefano Curtarolo, Arrigo Calzolari

articles.title: Simultaneous Mars-orbit observations reveal Kelvin-Helmholtz instability-driven bulk atmospheric ion escape
articles.title_zh: 火星轨道同步观测揭示开尔文–亥姆霍兹不稳定性驱动的大规模大气离子逃逸
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atmospheric ion escape driven by the solar wind is a key process controlling the long-term loss of the Martian atmosphere. Localized plasma clouds can carry substantial fluxes of planetary ions away from Mars, representing episodes of bulk escape. However, their origin has remained unclear due to the absence of simultaneous upstream measurements. Using joint observations from the MAVEN and Tianwen-1 missions, which provide real-time upstream monitoring, we present direct evidence that these plasma clouds are nonlinear wave packets generated by the Kelvin-Helmholtz instability (KHI). The spatial scale of KH waves is constrained for the first time via two-point measurements. Ion fluxes within plasma clouds are one to two orders of magnitude higher than those in typical steady-state escape channels. Our results indicate that KHI is an important process for solar wind coupling to planetary upper atmospheres and plays a crucial role in shaping atmospheric ion escape for unmagnetized planets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 MAVEN 与天问一号的联合观测，直接证明火星附近携带大量行星离子的等离子体云是由开尔文–亥姆霍兹不稳定性产生的非线性波包。双点测量首次约束了 KH 波的空间尺度，并显示等离子体云中的离子通量显著高于典型稳态逃逸通道。结果表明，KHI 是太阳风耦合到无全球磁场行星高层大气并塑造大气离子逃逸的重要过程。
authors: Chi Zhang, Chuanfei Dong, Gangkai Poh, Jasper Halekas, Xuanye Ma, Ruhunusiri Suranga, Kathleen G. Hanley, Han-Wen Shen, Hongyang Zhou, Xinmin Li, Liang Wang, Jiawei Gao, Shannon Curry, Christian Mazelle
articles.abstract_zh_full: 太阳风驱动的大气离子逃逸是控制火星大气长期损失的关键过程。局域化的等离子体云能够携带大量行星离子通量远离火星，代表大规模逃逸事件。然而，由于缺乏同步的上游测量，它们的起源一直不清楚。利用 MAVEN 和天问一号任务的联合观测，这些任务提供了实时上游监测，我们给出了直接证据，表明这些等离子体云是由开尔文–亥姆霍兹不稳定性（KHI）产生的非线性波包。通过双点测量，KH 波的空间尺度首次得到约束。等离子体云中的离子通量比典型稳态逃逸通道中的离子通量高一到两个数量级。我们的结果表明，KHI 是太阳风与行星高层大气耦合的重要过程，并且在塑造无磁化行星的大气离子逃逸方面起着关键作用。

articles.title: A variational hybrid continuous-variable discrete-variable quantum algorithm for adiabatic nuclear dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于绝热核运动动力学的变分混合连续变量–离散变量量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gaussian wavepacket (GWP) methods are prevalent means of solving the nuclear time-dependent Schrodinger equation (TDSE) on classical computers. They consist of representing the nuclear wave function as a superposition of Gaussians. Here, we present a variational hybrid continuous-variable discrete-variable (CV-DV) algorithm for simulating adiabatic nuclear dynamics on qubit-oscillator quantum hardware. It encodes a superposition of frozen Gaussians (FGs) onto the qubit-oscillator register and evolves it according to the time-dependent variational principle (VP). We test two variants of the approach, one that evolves a single FG and another that evolves a superposition of FGs, on a set of prototypical 1D harmonic and anharmonic systems. We simulate the photoexcited state dynamics of SO2 using the single FG variant of the algorithm and compute its autocorrelation function on physical quantum hardware. For harmonic and Morse potentials, the variant evolving the superposition of FGs converges to the numerically exact solution as the number of Gaussians increases. In the case of the double-well potential, the algorithm simulates wavepacket bifurcation and recurrence correctly, and the ensuing irregular dynamics moderately well. Overall, this work establishes a pathway for simulating molecular dynamics on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于量子比特–振子量子硬件的变分混合连续变量–离散变量算法，以模拟绝热核运动动力学。该算法将冻结高斯波包叠加编码到量子寄存器中，并依据含时变分原理演化。测试表明，该方法可在多种一维体系及 SO2 光激发态动力学中有效工作，为在含噪中等规模量子设备上模拟分子动力学提供了路径。
authors: Rami Gherib, Roya Radgohar, Anastasiia Pusenkova, Seyyed Mehdi Hosseini Jenab, Sara Turcotte, Dany Lachance-Quirion, Nicholas E. Frattini, Scott N. Genin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高斯波包（GWP）方法是在经典计算机上求解核含时薛定谔方程（TDSE）的常用手段。它们通过将核波函数表示为高斯函数的叠加来实现。在这里，我们提出一种变分混合连续变量–离散变量（CV-DV）算法，用于在量子比特–振子量子硬件上模拟绝热核运动动力学。该算法将冻结高斯（FG）的叠加编码到量子比特–振子寄存器上，并根据含时变分原理（VP）对其进行演化。我们在一组典型的一维谐振和非谐振体系上测试了该方法的两个变体：一个演化单个 FG，另一个演化 FG 的叠加。我们使用该算法的单 FG 变体模拟 SO2 的光激发态动力学，并在物理量子硬件上计算其自相关函数。对于谐振势和 Morse 势，演化 FG 叠加的变体随着高斯函数数量增加而收敛到数值精确解。在双阱势的情况下，该算法正确地模拟了波包分岔和再现，并较好地模拟了随后出现的不规则动力学。总体而言，这项工作为在含噪中等规模量子器件上模拟分子动力学建立了一条途径。

articles.title: Joint spectral characterization of SPDC photon pairs near 2 μm in (Al)GaAs-on-insulator waveguides
articles.title_zh: 绝缘体上（Al）GaAs 波导中近 2 微米 SPDC 光子对的联合光谱表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03950v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrated photon-pair sources are a core component of chip-based quantum computing, communication, and metrology. Although such sources have been demonstrated at conventional telecom wavelengths, the 2 μm band remains comparatively less explored, despite offering advantages for free-space quantum communication, low-loss transmission in emerging fiber networks, and integration with silicon photonic platforms. In this paper, we demonstrate spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in straight GaAs- and AlGaAs-on-insulator waveguides. This platform offers strong second-order nonlinearity and geometry-tunable dispersion, which are advantageous for efficient on-chip pair generation. Measurements of the joint spectral intensity and heralded second-order correlation function show broadband emission around 2 μm with strong spectral anti-correlations. To our knowledge, this is the first direct joint-spectral characterization of an integrated SPDC source in this wavelength regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在直线型绝缘体上 GaAs 和 AlGaAs 波导中演示了自发参量下转换光子对产生。测量结果显示，该平台可在约 2 微米波段产生宽带发射，并具有强光谱反相关。作者认为这是该波长范围内集成 SPDC 光源的首次直接联合光谱表征。
authors: Alexandre Z. Leger, Emil Z. Ulsig, Samuel E. Fontaine, Dileep V. Reddy, Eric J. Stanton, Lynden K. Shalm, Richard P. Mirin, Martin J. Stevens, J. E. Sipe, Nicolas Volet, Deny R. Hamel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 集成光子对源是芯片级量子计算、通信和计量的核心组成部分。尽管此类光源已在常规电信波长下得到演示，但 2 微米波段仍相对较少被探索，尽管它在自由空间量子通信、新兴光纤网络中的低损耗传输以及与硅光子平台集成方面具有优势。在本文中，我们在直线型绝缘体上 GaAs 和 AlGaAs 波导中演示了自发参量下转换（SPDC）。该平台具有强二阶非线性和几何可调色散，这有利于高效的片上光子对产生。联合光谱强度和预示二阶相关函数的测量显示，在 2 微米附近存在宽带发射，并具有强光谱反相关。据我们所知，这是在该波长范围内对集成 SPDC 光源进行的首次直接联合光谱表征。

articles.title: Modulation in degree of cross-polarization at Young's interferometer illuminated by non-uniformly polarized electromagnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 非均匀偏振电磁场照明的杨氏干涉仪中交叉偏振度的调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03957v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The degree of cross-polarization (DoCP) and the electromagnetic degree of coherence (EM DoC) of an electromagnetic beam are investigated at the observation points for incoherent and non-uniformly polarized, i.e., different degree of polarization with respect to space at the two pinholes in Young's interference experiment. We note that DoCP at the observation plane can be expressed as the average value of the degree of polarization at the pinholes of Young's interference experiment. The present study also verifies that the DoCP is a two-point generalization of the DoP. Additionally, EM DoC at observation points can be controlled by DoP at pinholes. The findings may be useful for classical ghost imaging, lensless imaging, and the study of Stokes correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了杨氏干涉实验中由非相干、非均匀偏振电磁光束照明时，观察点处的交叉偏振度和电磁相干度。研究指出，观察平面的交叉偏振度可表示为两针孔处偏振度的平均值，并验证其是偏振度的双点推广。结果还表明，可通过针孔处的偏振度控制观察点的电磁相干度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在杨氏干涉实验中，对于非相干且非均匀偏振的电磁光束，即两个针孔处相对于空间具有不同偏振度的情况，本文研究了观察点处的交叉偏振度（DoCP）和电磁相干度（EM DoC）。我们注意到，观察平面处的 DoCP 可以表示为杨氏干涉实验中针孔处偏振度的平均值。本研究还验证了 DoCP 是偏振度（DoP）的双点推广。此外，观察点处的 EM DoC 可以由针孔处的 DoP 来控制。这些发现可能有助于经典鬼成像、无透镜成像以及 Stokes 相关性的研究。

articles.title: Symmetry/asymmetry within a cylindrical lattice model of nuclear structure predicts cosmic abundance/scarcity
articles.title_zh: 核结构圆柱晶格模型中的对称性/非对称性预测宇宙丰度/稀缺性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Protons and neutrons are the smallest forms of measurable matter, and each nucleon has 3 up (+2/3) and down (-1/3) quarks. Quarks treated as point-like particles within polygonal geometries model the structures of stable nuclides through ³⁶Ar. The model derives from the proton's radius (r=0.8414 fm), the hadron's prolate spheroid shape (from the Δ(1232) resonance), and the separation distance between bound nucleons (approx0.8 fm, from the Argonne v₁₈ NN potential). The prolate nucleon's spatial extent arises from its 3 quarks, which implies a qualitatively linear quark sequence. Spin-spin forces repel the like-flavored quarks to opposite ends of the nucleon, leaving the unlike quark in the middle. Quark-to-quark distance within the nucleon corresponds to the nucleon's radius. Nucleons link by quark-to-quark interactions to form proton-neutron short-range correlated pairs (pn SRC pairs), separated by a distance equal to the proton's radius. Alternating nucleons produce regularly alternating up/down quark sequences. We contemplate structures for each stable nuclide through ³⁶Ar and include the one whose rotational radius (from the regular polygon radius formula) best correlates with its accepted charge radius (r(31)=0.98, p<0.001). Nucleon alternation makes pn SRC pairs and produces the equal numbers of protons and neutrons (Z=N) in the isotopes ⁴₂He, ¹²₆C, ¹⁴₇N, ¹⁶₈O, ²⁰₁₀Ne, ²⁴₁₂Mg, ²⁸₁₄Si, and ³²₁₆S, comprising 99.5% of stable baryonic matter. Bilateral structural symmetry emerges as a sensitive and specific predictor of cosmic abundance. Opposing deuteron-deuteron alternating quark charge sequences produce alternating and unequal electromagnetic fields capable of modelling the close-range attraction and far-range repulsion of the fusion potential curve and Coulomb potential energy barrier.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种基于圆柱晶格和多边形几何的核结构模型，用夸克点粒子排列来描述直到 36Ar 的稳定核素结构。模型声称核子交替排列可形成质子–中子短程关联对，并解释若干 Z=N 同位素在稳定重子物质中的高丰度。作者进一步提出，双侧结构对称性可作为宇宙丰度的敏感而特异的预测因子，并讨论其与聚变势垒建模的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 质子和中子是可测量物质的最小形式，并且每个核子都有 3 个上夸克（+2/3）和下夸克（-1/3）。将夸克视为多边形几何中的点状粒子，可以模拟直到 ³⁶Ar 的稳定核素结构。该模型源自质子的半径（r=0.8414 fm）、强子的扁长球体形状（来自 Δ(1232) 共振）以及束缚核子之间的分离距离（约 0.8 fm，来自 Argonne v₁₈ NN 势）。扁长核子的空间范围来自其 3 个夸克，这意味着一种定性的线性夸克序列。自旋–自旋力将同味夸克排斥到核子的相对两端，使不同味夸克留在中间。核子内部的夸克到夸克距离对应于核子的半径。核子通过夸克到夸克相互作用连接，形成质子–中子短程关联对（pn SRC 对），其分离距离等于质子半径。交替核子产生规则交替的上/下夸克序列。我们考虑了直到 ³⁶Ar 的每一种稳定核素的结构，并纳入了其旋转半径（来自正多边形半径公式）与公认电荷半径相关性最佳的结构（r(31)=0.98，p<0.001）。核子交替形成 pn SRC 对，并在 ⁴₂He、¹²₆C、¹⁴₇N、¹⁶₈O、²⁰₁₀Ne、²⁴₁₂Mg、²⁸₁₄Si 和 ³²₁₆S 等同位素中产生相等数量的质子和中子（Z=N），这些同位素构成稳定重子物质的 99.5%。双侧结构对称性表现为宇宙丰度的敏感且特异的预测因子。相对的氘核–氘核交替夸克电荷序列产生交替且不相等的电磁场，能够模拟聚变势曲线的近距离吸引和远距离排斥以及库仑势能垒。

articles.title: Collective tunnel ionization in atomic systems
articles.title_zh: 原子体系中的集体隧穿电离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03998v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theory of the collective tunnel effect in atomic systems subject to strong low-frequency laser fields. Using an analytic semi-classical method and numerical solution to the time-dependent Schrodinger equation we demonstrate the collective channel of the nonsequential double ionization in neutral xenon and in the negative bromine ion. Collective tunneling in the presence of the electron-electron repulsion comprises the joint sub-barrier motion of the two electrons along quantum trajectories transversely shifted in opposite directions with respect to the direction of the external electric field. Momentum distributions of the electron pairs carry clear signatures of the collective channel in the form of shoulders in the direction lateral to the field polarization. We propose and discuss potential experimental approaches to a search for collective tunneling in atomic systems using short circularly polarized laser pulses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出强低频激光场中原子体系集体隧穿效应的理论。通过解析半经典方法和含时薛定谔方程数值求解，作者展示了中性氙和溴负离子中非序列双电离的集体通道。研究指出，电子对动量分布中横向于场偏振方向的肩部结构可作为集体隧穿的清晰标志。
authors: D. I. Tyurin, V. V. Strelkov, S. V. Popruzhenko
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了强低频激光场作用下原子体系中集体隧穿效应的理论。利用解析半经典方法以及对含时薛定谔方程的数值求解，我们展示了中性氙和溴负离子中非序列双电离的集体通道。在存在电子–电子排斥的情况下，集体隧穿包括两个电子沿量子轨道的联合势垒下运动，这些轨道相对于外部电场方向在横向上向相反方向偏移。电子对的动量分布以沿场偏振横向方向出现肩部的形式，携带了集体通道的清晰特征。我们提出并讨论了利用短圆偏振激光脉冲在原子体系中寻找集体隧穿的潜在实验方法。

articles.title: Solar Orbiter SEP Dropout during a Magnetic Cloud with Evidence for Strong Connectivity Gradients
articles.title_zh: 磁云期间 Solar Orbiter 观测到的太阳高能粒子下降事件及强连通性梯度证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00427v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We analyze an impulsive solar energetic particle (SEP) event observed by Solar Orbiter at 0.93 au on 2022 December 24 that exhibits a pronounced intensity dropout between approximately 07:15 and 10:00 UT. Pitch-angle distributions show a near-field-aligned beam before the dropout, which disappears abruptly at the dropout onset. At the same time, a weak 100--200 keV component appears at pitch angles of about 90--180 degrees; no comparable enhancement over this pitch-angle range is present at MeV energies. The dropout onset is not accompanied by an abrupt change in the in situ magnetic field or solar wind plasma. Solar imaging associates the SEP event with a jet from a compact source. Ballistic back mapping, together with Potential Field Source Surface extrapolations and quasi-separatrix-layer proxy diagnostics, indicates that Solar Orbiter nominally connects to the source region, but lies close to strong connectivity gradients where small displacement may shift the connection to neighboring open field lines. The in situ measurements show that the event occurs during a magnetic-cloud passage and that additional dropouts occur later in the event. These results favor an interpretation in which the dropout reflects rapid changes in particle access between adjacent flux tubes, while the magnetic cloud may help preserve the sharp SEP intensity gradients between them.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了 Solar Orbiter 于 2022 年 12 月 24 日在 0.93 au 观测到的一次脉冲型太阳高能粒子事件，其中出现显著强度下降。俯仰角分布、太阳成像和磁场连通性分析表明，该下降更可能源于相邻磁通管之间粒子通达性的快速变化。磁云可能有助于维持这些磁通管之间尖锐的 SEP 强度梯度。
authors: Radoslav Bucik, Raul Gomez-Herrero, Samuel T. Hart, Maher A. Dayeh, Nariaki V. Nitta
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析了 Solar Orbiter 于 2022 年 12 月 24 日在 0.93 au 处观测到的一次脉冲型太阳高能粒子（SEP）事件，该事件在约 07:15 至 10:00 UT 之间表现出显著的强度下降。俯仰角分布显示，在下降之前存在一个近似沿磁场方向的束流，该束流在下降开始时突然消失。同时，在约 90 至 180 度的俯仰角处出现了一个较弱的 100–200 keV 分量；在 MeV 能量范围内，该俯仰角范围没有类似增强。下降的开始并未伴随原位磁场或太阳风等离子体的突然变化。太阳成像将该 SEP 事件与来自紧凑源区的喷流联系起来。弹道回溯映射结合势场源表面外推和准分界层代理诊断表明，Solar Orbiter 名义上与源区相连，但位于强连通性梯度附近，在那里微小位移可能使连接转移到相邻开放磁力线上。原位测量显示，该事件发生在磁云通过期间，并且在事件后期还出现了额外的下降。这些结果支持这样一种解释：该下降反映了相邻磁通管之间粒子通达性的快速变化，而磁云可能有助于保持它们之间尖锐的 SEP 强度梯度。

articles.title: SU3HOB-cgvcs: harmonic-oscillator brackets in the SU(3) basis with isofactors from an external SU(3),supset,SO(3) Clebsch--Gordan library
articles.title_zh: SU3HOB-cgvcs：在 SU(3) 基中利用外部 SU(3)⊃SO(3) Clebsch–Gordan 库等因子计算谐振子括号
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02640v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: DeclareRobustCommandSuo̧deSu3cgvcs We present SU3HOB-cgvcs, a Fortran~2008 package that computes the general Talmi--Moshinsky harmonic-oscillator transformation brackets, for an arbitrary mass-ratio parameter d. These brackets arte constructed in the suSU(3) basis by the method of Kalinauskas et al. . The transformation is reduced to a single sum over Wigner d-functions of the reflection-containing Talmi--Moshinsky matrix weighted by products of suSU(3)supsetsuSO(3) isofactors of the chain suU(6)supsetsuU(3)×suU(2). SU3HOB-cgvcs obtains these isofactors from the established external Clebsch--Gordan library Su{} . In this library they are computed there by the vector-coherent-state (VCS) method. We bridge Su{} formalism to ours and this requires two fixes: reinserting a sign/phase factor that depends on each state's radial-quantum number and handling the trivial (0,0) representation analytically. The package reproduces, bracket for bracket to machine precision (sim!10⁻¹³), the general Talmi--Moshinsky bracket code of Kamuntavičius et al. , and demonstrates that a self-contained SU(3)-scheme HOB code can be built on top of a general-purpose SU(3) Clebsch--Gordan library.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍 SU3HOB-cgvcs，这是一个 Fortran 2008 软件包，用于计算任意质量比参数下的一般 Talmi–Moshinsky 谐振子变换括号。该程序在 SU(3) 基中构造括号，并从外部 Clebsch–Gordan 库获取 SU(3)⊃SO(3) 等因子。结果表明，该软件可达到机器精度并复现既有 Talmi–Moshinsky 括号代码。
authors: Augustinas Stepšys, Saulius Mickevičius, Darius Germanas
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍 SU3HOB-cgvcs，这是一个 Fortran 2008 软件包，用于计算任意质量比参数 d 下的一般 Talmi–Moshinsky 谐振子变换括号。这些括号通过 Kalinauskas 等人的方法在 SU(3) 基中构造。该变换被化简为对含反射的 Talmi–Moshinsky 矩阵的 Wigner d 函数进行单重求和，并以 U(6)⊃U(3)×U(2) 链的 SU(3)⊃SO(3) 等因子乘积作为权重。SU3HOB-cgvcs 从已建立的外部 Clebsch–Gordan 库 Su{} 获取这些等因子。在该库中，它们通过矢量相干态（VCS）方法计算。我们将 Su{} 形式主义与我们的形式主义相衔接，这需要两项修正：重新插入一个依赖于每个态的径向量子数的符号/相位因子，并解析处理平凡的 (0,0) 表示。该软件包逐括号地以机器精度（约 10⁻¹³）复现了 Kamuntavičius 等人的一般 Talmi–Moshinsky 括号代码，并证明可以在通用 SU(3) Clebsch–Gordan 库之上构建一个自包含的 SU(3) 方案 HOB 代码。

articles.title: ScoreField: Neural Inverse Scattering with Score-Based Generative Priors
articles.title_zh: ScoreField：具有基于分数的生成先验的神经逆散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02937v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Designing an effective electromagnetic inverse-scattering solver requires faithful enforcement of nonlinear full-wave physics together with an expressive prior on the unknown permittivity contrast. We propose ScoreField, a neural inverse scattering framework that integrates coupled implicit neural representations (INRs) with a pretrained score-based generative prior. ScoreField employs two INRs to parameterize the permittivity contrast and the induced current fields, and jointly optimize them under the Lippmann-Schwinger equations. In addition to the implicit regularization by the INR architecture, the score model provides a learned prior gradient on the contrast, which is propagated to the contrast INR through the chain rule. This formulation enables ScoreField to effectively handle strong multiple scattering, where nonlinear wave interactions require accurate modeling of the coupled full-wave physics. We evaluate ScoreField on simulated weak- and strong-scattering benchmarks, the canonical Austria phantom, and experimental Fresnel measurements. We note that ScoreField significantly improves reconstruction fidelity and suppresses artifacts relative to classical full-wave methods and deep learning baselines, achieving an average PSNR improvement of 1.8 , dB over the best competing method on real Fresnel data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ScoreField，一种结合耦合隐式神经表示与预训练分数生成先验的神经电磁逆散射框架。该方法同时参数化介电常数反差和感生电流场，并在 Lippmann–Schwinger 方程约束下联合优化。实验显示，ScoreField 在弱/强散射仿真、Austria 体模和 Fresnel 实测数据上提高了重建保真度并抑制伪影。
authors: Wenhan Guo, Yuan Gao, Yu Sun
articles.abstract_zh_full: 设计有效的电磁逆散射求解器需要忠实执行非线性全波物理，同时对未知介电常数反差施加具有表达能力的先验。我们提出 ScoreField，这是一种神经逆散射框架，将耦合隐式神经表示（INR）与预训练的基于分数的生成先验相结合。ScoreField 使用两个 INR 分别参数化介电常数反差和感生电流场，并在 Lippmann-Schwinger 方程下对它们进行联合优化。除了 INR 架构带来的隐式正则化之外，分数模型还提供关于反差的学习到的先验梯度，该梯度通过链式法则传播到反差 INR。这一形式使 ScoreField 能够有效处理强多重散射，在这种情况下，非线性波相互作用需要对耦合全波物理进行精确建模。我们在模拟的弱散射和强散射基准、经典 Austria 体模以及实验 Fresnel 测量上评估 ScoreField。我们注意到，与经典全波方法和深度学习基线相比，ScoreField 显著提高了重建保真度并抑制了伪影，在真实 Fresnel 数据上相对于最佳竞争方法实现了平均 1.8 dB 的 PSNR 提升。

articles.title: A study on the contribution of the interplanetary medium in radio occultation experiments
articles.title_zh: 射电掩星实验中行星际介质贡献的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03435v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Irregularities in electron density within the interplanetary medium (IPM) can cause fluctuations in the Doppler frequency of spacecraft radio signals. The amplitude of these fluctuations depends on factors such as the carrier frequency, propagation geometry, and link configuration. However, quantitative characterization of these effects across different frequencies in various occultation experiments is currently limited. We analyze five complementary datasets: two-way S-band observations from Chandrayaan-3 outside the lunar ionosphere, two-way S-band data from Chandrayaan-2 during lunar occultation, one-way S/X band measurements from the Venus Express Radio Science (VeRa)/Akatsuki Radio Science (Akatsuki) under IPM-only conditions, and one-way X-band Akatsuki data during solar occultation. The Chandrayaan-3 and Akatsuki IPM observations isolate IPM effects by excluding contributions from planetary atmospheres, the lunar ionosphere, and, except during solar occultation, the solar corona. Chandrayaan-3 data sample dynamically evolving Earth-Moon geometries and exhibit weak, mHz-level Doppler fluctuations, while Chandrayaan-2 observations provide near-lunar plasma benchmarks with higher amplitudes, during quiet time solar and geomagnetic conditions. Akatsuki and VeRa's IPM-only measurements capture long-path interplanetary effects, whereas Akatsuki solar occultation data reveal strong coronal signatures. Power spectral density analysis indicates Kolmogorov-like turbulence for lunar occultation and solar occultation cases, while IPM-only spectra show low-amplitude fluctuations. These results quantify the IPM contribution to Doppler noise, demonstrate the enhanced plasma sensitivity of two-way coherent links, and provide constraints relevant to turbulence modelling, precision spacecraft tracking, and the interpretation of radio occultation experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用月船三号、月船二号、金星快车/晓号等多组射电科学数据，定量分析行星际介质电子密度不规则性对航天器无线电信号多普勒频率波动的影响。研究比较了 IPM-only、月球掩星和太阳掩星等情形，并通过功率谱密度分析识别湍流特征。结果为多普勒噪声评估、湍流建模、精密定轨和射电掩星解释提供约束。
authors: Keshav Aggarwal, R. K. Choudhary, Abhirup Datta, Soumyaneal Banerjee, R. Manikantan, Anshuman Sharma, Takeshi Imamura
articles.abstract_zh_full: 行星际介质（IPM）中的电子密度不规则性会引起航天器无线电信号多普勒频率的波动。这些波动的幅度取决于载波频率、传播几何和链路配置等因素。然而，目前对于不同频率下各种掩星实验中这些效应的定量表征仍然有限。我们分析了五组互补数据集：来自月船三号、位于月球电离层之外的双向 S 波段观测；来自月船二号、月球掩星期间的双向 S 波段数据；来自金星快车无线电科学（VeRa）/晓号无线电科学（Akatsuki）在仅有 IPM 条件下的一向 S/X 波段测量；以及晓号在太阳掩星期间的一向 X 波段数据。月船三号和晓号的 IPM 观测通过排除行星大气、月球电离层以及除太阳掩星期间外的太阳日冕贡献，隔离了 IPM 效应。月船三号数据采样了动态演化的地月几何，并表现出弱的、毫赫兹级多普勒波动，而月船二号观测在太阳和地磁平静条件下提供了近月等离子体基准，其幅度更高。晓号和 VeRa 的仅 IPM 测量捕获了长路径行星际效应，而晓号太阳掩星数据揭示了强日冕特征。功率谱密度分析表明，月球掩星和太阳掩星情形呈现类似 Kolmogorov 的湍流，而仅 IPM 光谱显示低幅度波动。这些结果量化了 IPM 对多普勒噪声的贡献，展示了双向相干链路增强的等离子体敏感性，并为湍流建模、精密航天器跟踪以及射电掩星实验的解释提供了相关约束。

articles.title: Generation and Enhancement of Bipartite and Tripartite Entanglement in an Electro-Optomechanical Ring Cavity
articles.title_zh: 电–光机械环形腔中双体和三体纠缠的产生与增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03578v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This study investigates the generation and enhancement of quantum entanglement in an electro-optomechanical ring cavity system. The setup integrates two Coulomb-coupled mechanical resonators, which serve as the fundamental mechanism for the generation of bipartite and tripartite entanglement via charge mediated coupling. We then demonstrate the significant enhancement of this entanglement via a nonlinear parametric drive (an optical parametric amplifier, OPA), which injects a controllable nonlinearity into the cavity. We derive the system's Hamiltonian and the corresponding quantum Langevin equations, which are linearized around steady-state solutions to analyze Gaussian quantum fluctuations. Employing the covariance matrix formalism, we quantify bipartite entanglement via logarithmic negativity and tripartite entanglement via the minimum residual contangle. Our results unequivocally show that while the Coulomb interaction is indispensable for creating entanglement, the OPA acts as a powerful control tool, dramatically amplifying the degree of quantum correlations for all subsystems. We find that the strength of entanglement is highly sensitive to several parameters and can be optimized through the strategic selection of the OPA's gain and phase, the laser detuning, and the input power. A key finding is the existence of a trade-off, where parameters that maximize entanglement also constrain the stable operating regime of the system. Furthermore, thermal noise is shown to progressively degrade all quantum correlations, underscoring the necessity for low-temperature operation. These findings provide comprehensive guidance for parameter optimization, outlining a clear path from generation to enhancement, and highlight the potential of such hybrid systems as versatile platforms for controlling multipartite entanglement in quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究电–光机械环形腔系统中量子纠缠的产生与增强。系统包含两个库仑耦合机械谐振器，并通过光学参量放大器引入可控非线性以增强纠缠。结果表明，库仑相互作用对产生纠缠不可或缺，而 OPA 可显著放大各子系统的量子关联，但系统稳定性和热噪声会限制可实现性能。
authors: Fouad Essaadi, Yassine Oussarhan, Mohamed Ouhammou, Said Mouslih, Mohamed Jakha, Bouzid Manaut, Souad Taj
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究考察了电–光机械环形腔系统中量子纠缠的产生和增强。该装置集成了两个库仑耦合机械谐振器，它们通过电荷介导耦合作为产生双体和三体纠缠的基本机制。随后我们证明，可通过非线性参量驱动（光学参量放大器，OPA）显著增强这种纠缠，该驱动向腔中注入可控非线性。我们推导了系统的哈密顿量以及相应的量子朗之万方程，并围绕稳态解对其线性化，以分析高斯量子涨落。采用协方差矩阵形式主义，我们通过对数负性量化双体纠缠，并通过最小残余 contangle 量化三体纠缠。我们的结果明确表明，虽然库仑相互作用对于产生纠缠不可或缺，但 OPA 作为一种强大的控制工具，能够显著放大所有子系统的量子关联程度。我们发现，纠缠强度对多个参数高度敏感，并且可以通过策略性选择 OPA 的增益和相位、激光失谐以及输入功率来优化。一个关键发现是存在一种权衡，即使纠缠最大化的参数也会限制系统的稳定运行区域。此外，热噪声被证明会逐步削弱所有量子关联，凸显了低温运行的必要性。这些发现为参数优化提供了全面指导，勾勒出从产生到增强的清晰路径，并突出了此类混合系统作为量子技术中控制多体纠缠的多功能平台的潜力。

articles.title: Refraction laws in spatio-temporal media
articles.title_zh: 时空介质中的折射定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03995v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the time-dependent Maxwell system, formulated in the sense of distributions, for electromagnetic waves propagating through media with temporal and spatial material interfaces. Under explicit trace and regularity assumptions on the permittivity and permeability, we derive the jump conditions produced by temporal discontinuities and by subsequent spatial interfaces. These conditions are used to obtain generalized Snell laws for the wave vectors generated by temporal splitting, reflection, and transmission. We also derive the associated amplitude equations and organize them as a finite-dimensional linear system for a space-time slab geometry. Finally, we provide an explicit oblique-incidence example. Our approach does not impose a smooth-field ansatz and allows material parameters that need not be constant away from the interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了时变麦克斯韦系统，并在分布意义下描述电磁波在具有时间与空间材料界面的介质中的传播。基于对介电常数和磁导率的显式迹与正则性假设，作者推导了时间不连续以及随后空间界面所引起的跃变条件，并据此得到由时间分裂、反射和透射产生的波矢广义斯涅尔定律。文中还导出了相应的振幅方程，并将其组织为空-时薄层几何下的有限维线性系统，最后给出一个斜入射的具体示例。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了时变麦克斯韦系统，在分布意义下表述，针对在具有时间和空间材料界面的介质中传播的电磁波。基于对介电常数和磁导率的显式迹与正则性假设，我们推导了由时间不连续以及随后空间界面产生的跃变条件。利用这些条件，我们得到由时间分裂、反射和透射生成的波矢的广义斯涅尔定律。我们还推导了相关的振幅方程，并在空-时薄层几何中将其组织为一个有限维线性系统。最后，我们给出一个斜入射的具体示例。我们的方法不要求平滑场的设定，并且允许材料参数在远离界面处不必为常数。

articles.title: Reduced-order modeling for electromagnetic inverse problems: a layered medium benchmark
articles.title_zh: 电磁反问题的降阶建模：层状介质基准问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03996v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study reduced-order modeling for inverse problems in layered media, focusing on the recovery of impedance profiles from time-domain measurements. Using the Goupillaud structure, we formulate the forward problem as a discrete dynamical system and introduce a ROM-based objective defined at the level of reduced operators. Through numerical experiments on a 5-layer medium under various structured perturbations, we compare the ROM-based objective with a classical data misfit. The results show that the ROM-based inversion provides a more favorable reconstruction in the clean setting and in certain structured perturbation regimes, while remaining consistently competitive with the classical approach across all cases considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究层状介质中的反问题降阶建模，重点是从时域测量中恢复阻抗分布。作者基于 Goupillaud 结构将正问题表述为离散动力系统，并在降阶算子层面构造了 ROM 基目标函数。数值实验表明，在无噪声及某些结构化扰动条件下，ROM 反演通常比经典数据失配更有利于重建，同时在所有测试情形中都保持了竞争性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究层状介质中的反问题降阶建模，重点是从时域测量中恢复阻抗分布。利用 Goupillaud 结构，我们将正问题表述为一个离散动力系统，并在降阶算子的层面上引入了一个基于 ROM 的目标函数。通过在一个五层介质上、针对不同结构化扰动进行的数值实验，我们比较了 ROM 基目标函数与经典数据失配函数。结果表明，在干净情形以及某些结构化扰动机制下，ROM 反演提供了更有利的重建，同时在所考虑的所有情形中始终与经典方法保持竞争性。

articles.title: Small-Angle Scattering
articles.title_zh: 小角散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:1901.07353v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Small-Angle Scattering (SAS) investigates structures in samples that generally range from approximately 0.5 nm to a few 100 nm. This can both be done for isotropic samples such as blends and liquids, as well as anisotropic samples such as quasi-crystals. In order to obtain data about that size regime scattered intensity, mostly of x-rays or neutrons, is investigated at angles from close to zero, still in the region of the primary beam up to 10deg , depending on the wavelength of the incoming radiation. The two primary sources for SAS experiments are x-ray (small-angle x-ray scattering, SAXS) sources and neutron (small-angle neutron scattering, SANS) sources, which shall be the two cases discussed here. Also scattering with electrons or other particle waves is possible, but not the main use case for the purpose of this manuscript. For most small-angle scattering instruments, both SAXS and SANS, the science case covers the investigation of self-assembled polymeric and biological systems, multi-scale systems with large size distribution of the contained particles, solutions of (nano-)particles and soft-matter systems, protein solutions, and material science investigations. In the case of SANS this is augmented by the possibility to also investigate the spin state of the sample and hence perform investigations of the magnetic structure of the sample. In the following sections the general setup of both SAXS and SANS instruments shall be discussed, as well as data acquisition and evaluation and preparation of the sample and the experiment in general. The information contained herein should provide sufficient information for planning and performing a SAS experiment and evaluate the gathered data.
articles.abstract_zh: 小角散射研究样品中大约 0.5 nm 到数百纳米尺度的结构，既适用于各向同性样品，也适用于准晶等各向异性样品。该方法通常通过在接近主束方向的小角度范围内测量 X 射线或中子散射强度来获取信息，主要对应 SAXS 和 SANS 两类实验。本文概述了这两类仪器的基本构型、数据采集与分析，以及样品和实验准备的关键步骤，可为小角散射实验的规划、实施与数据处理提供参考。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 小角散射（Small-Angle Scattering, SAS）研究的是样品中通常处于约 0.5 nm 到数百纳米范围内的结构。该技术既可用于各向同性样品，例如混合物和液体，也可用于各向异性样品，例如准晶。为了获得该尺度区间的信息，通常在非常接近零的散射角上测量散射强度，主要是 X 射线或中子散射，角度范围处于主束附近，直至约 10 度，具体取决于入射辐射的波长。SAS 实验的两个主要来源是 X 射线（小角 X 射线散射，SAXS）和中子（小角中子散射，SANS）源，本文将主要讨论这两种情况。电子或其他粒子波的散射也是可能的，但并不是本稿的主要应用场景。对于大多数小角散射仪器，无论是 SAXS 还是 SANS，其科学应用场景都包括聚合物和生物自组装体系、具有大尺寸分布的多尺度体系、纳米粒子溶液和软物质体系、蛋白质溶液以及材料科学研究。对于 SANS 而言，还可进一步研究样品的自旋态，因此也能够开展样品磁结构的研究。以下各节将讨论 SAXS 和 SANS 仪器的一般设置，以及数据采集与评估、样品制备和实验总体准备。本文所包含的信息应足以为规划和实施 SAS 实验以及评估所获得的数据提供必要支持。

articles.title: All molecules are entangled in the number of electrons following a general physical principle
articles.title_zh: 基于一般物理原理的所有分子在电子数上都存在纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2405.00203v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A physically motivated equation that determines the number of electrons of a molecule is proposed based on some generally accepted basic chemical knowledge. It permits a complete local definition of molecules and shows that all molecules are entangled in the number of electrons. It also results in the extensivity and convexity of molecular energy, which underpin molecular quantum mechanics. The proposed physical principle includes the molecular size consistency principle as a special case and reveals an intrinsic relationship between molecular locality, size consistency, and energy convexity. Application of wavefunction theory to the new principle shows that an individual molecule with a noninteger number of electrons is locally physical. The energy of a molecule is piecewise linear with respect to its number of electrons. The realness of the number of electrons allows the definition of the electronic chemical potential of a single molecule. A state function equivalent to the energy of a molecule can be defined using the chemical potential as a variable and used to express the physical principle as a simple additivity. The latter also shows that the quantum entanglement in the number of electrons can be viewed as all molecules sharing one chemical potential. When the energy of a molecule with a definite number of electrons is not convex with respect to the number of electrons, the state of the molecule is not always locally determinable even with a known number of electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者基于若干公认的基本化学知识提出了一个决定分子电子数的物理方程，从而给出分子的完整局域定义，并表明所有分子在电子数上都存在纠缠。该原理还导出分子能量的广延性与凸性，并将分子大小一致性原理作为特例。进一步的波函数理论分析表明，具有非整数电子数的单个分子在局域上是物理可接受的，且分子能量关于电子数呈分段线性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作者基于若干普遍接受的基础化学知识，提出了一个从物理上动机明确的方程，用于确定一个分子的电子数。它允许对分子作出完整的局域定义，并表明所有分子在电子数上都是纠缠的。它还导出了分子能量的广延性和凸性，而这两者是分子量子力学的基础。所提出的物理原理把分子大小一致性原理作为一个特例，并揭示了分子局域性、大小一致性与能量凸性之间的内在联系。将波函数理论应用于这一新原理表明，具有非整数电子数的单个分子在局域上是物理上成立的。分子的能量相对于其电子数是分段线性的。电子数的实数性允许定义单个分子的电子化学势。可以使用化学势作为变量来定义一个与分子能量等价的态函数，并将该物理原理表示为一种简单的加和性。后者还表明，电子数中的量子纠缠可以被视为所有分子共享同一个化学势。当一个具有确定电子数的分子的能量相对于电子数并不凸时，即使已知电子数，该分子的状态也并不总是可以局域地确定。

articles.title: Spin Fluctuations-induced Unconventional Transverse Spin Current in Spin Degenerate Antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 自旋涨落诱导的自旋简并反铁磁体中的非常规横向自旋流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.09964v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern magnetic memory technology requires unconventional transverse spin current to achieve deterministic switching of perpendicular magnetization. Spin current in antiferromagnets (AFMs) has been long thought to be trivial as nonmagnets. Recently, a class of spin-splitting AFMs has been shown to be able to generate unconventional spin current for spin-orbit torque (SOT) applications. However, such AFMs requires specific symmetry breaking, and have been largely restricted by the limited material candidates. Here, we reveal universal spin fluctuation-induced unconventional transverse spin current in conventional spin degenerate AFMs at finite temperature by taking collinear (AFM) L10-MnPt as an example. The field-free switching of perpendicular magnetization was achieved via out-of-plane anti-damping-like SOT, leveraging the spin current with both y- and z-spin polarizations in heterostructures with MnPt functioning as spin current source. Based on symmetry analyses and experimental characterizations of current-induced spin torques, we find that the spin current generated by L10-MnPt exhibits anisotropy that varies with the current direction, enforced by the low symmetry magnetic point group when its Néel vector is along [110]. From a fundamental perspective, it would be intriguing to uncover a mechanism underlying the emergence of unconventional spin currents in spin degenerate antiferromagnets, which is highly desirable for spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以共线 L10-MnPt 为例，揭示了在有限温度下，自旋涨落能够在常规自旋简并反铁磁体中产生普适的非常规横向自旋流。借助该自旋流，研究实现了垂直磁化的无场切换，并在异质结构中利用同时具有 y 与 z 自旋极化的自旋流实现了外平面反阻尼型自旋轨道力矩。结合对电流诱导自旋力矩的对称性分析与实验表征，作者还发现当 Néel 矢量沿 [110] 方向时，MnPt 产生的自旋流表现出随电流方向变化的各向异性。
authors: Cuimei Cao, Meng Zhu, Shiwei Chen, Yizhuo Song, Xiaoyu Feng, Zhenzhong Yang, Yihan Wang, Shiheng Liang, Qingfeng Zhan, Jia Zhang, Long You
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代磁存储技术需要非常规横向自旋流，以实现垂直磁化的确定性翻转。长期以来，反铁磁体（AFM）中的自旋流一直被认为如同非磁体一样是平凡的。最近，一类自旋劈裂反铁磁体已被证明能够产生用于自旋轨道力矩（SOT）应用的非常规自旋流。然而，这类反铁磁体需要特定的对称性破缺，并且很大程度上受限于材料候选者数量有限。本文以共线（AFM）L10-MnPt 为例，揭示了在有限温度下，自旋涨落诱导的、存在于常规自旋简并反铁磁体中的普适非常规横向自旋流。通过将 MnPt 作为自旋流源，利用其异质结构中的面外反阻尼型 SOT，实现了垂直磁化的无场切换。基于对电流诱导自旋力矩的对称性分析和实验表征，我们发现，当其 Néel 矢量沿 [110] 方向时，由 L10-MnPt 产生的自旋流呈现出随电流方向变化的各向异性，这一行为受低对称性的磁点群所约束。从基础物理角度看，揭示反铁磁自旋简并体系中非常规自旋流的出现机制将十分有趣，而这对于自旋电子学应用而言也极具价值。

articles.title: Multi-dimensional parameter space of higher-order exceptional points induced by Brillouin optoacoustics
articles.title_zh: 布里渊光声效应诱导的高阶异常点的多维参数空间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05064v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are degeneracies in the spectrum of non-Hermitian systems, where both the eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce. In the vicinity of an n-th order EP, the eigenvalues generally show n-th-root dependence on the system parameters, making EPs potentially promising candidates for ultra-sensitive measurements. Usually EPs are implemented in precisely fabricated nano- and microstructures. In this work, we instead show the experimental implementation of a third-order EP (EP3) using the synthetic dimension in a single-mode optical fiber, leveraging multi-frequency Brillouin scattering. We perform a multi-dimensional scan of the parameter space revealing not only an EP3 but also additional topological structures connected to it. Our work paves the way toward fabrication-free realizations of exceptional points of arbitrary order.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在单模光纤中利用合成维度和多频布里渊散射，实验实现了三阶异常点。作者对参数空间进行了多维扫描，不仅识别出该三阶异常点，还观察到与之相关的额外拓扑结构。该工作为无加工制造地实现任意阶异常点提供了新路径。
authors: Grigorii Slinkov, Anton Montag, Julius T. Gohsrich, Quentin Levoy, Paulina Fuentes Rivera, Flore K. Kunst, Birgit Stiller
articles.abstract_zh_full: 异常点（EP）是非厄米系统谱中的简并点，在此处本征值和本征矢都会合并。在 n 阶异常点附近，本征值通常对系统参数呈现 n 次根依赖，因此异常点有望成为超高灵敏测量的潜在候选。通常，异常点是通过精密制造的纳米和微结构来实现的。本文中，我们转而展示了利用单模光纤中的合成维度，并借助多频布里渊散射，实验实现三阶异常点（EP3）。我们对参数空间进行了多维扫描，揭示的不仅是一个 EP3，还有与之相连的额外拓扑结构。我们的工作为实现任意阶异常点的无加工制造方案铺平了道路。

articles.title: Enhancing ground-state cooling of center-of-mass motions via quantum squeezing from magnon nonlinearity
articles.title_zh: 利用磁振子非线性产生的量子压缩增强质心运动基态冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.06484v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Cooling massive oscillators to quantum ground state is an essential prerequisite for their precise control, quantum memory, and quantum ultrasensitive measurement, etc. In a cavity-magnomechanical system, the magnon-mechanical coupling, enhanced by microwave cavity driving, can be utilized to cool the center-of-mass motion of a levitated magnetic sphere. In this work, we report that the cooling performance can be further improved by exploiting quantum squeezing stemming from magnonic self-Kerr nonlinearity inherent to the ferrimagnetic yttrium-iron-garnet (YIG) sphere. By means of suitable pump driving, the Kerr nonlinearity is converted into quantum squeezing, yielding considerable enhancement of the center-of-mass cooling with properly chosen optimal parameters. Moreover, we demonstrate that this improvement mechanism for cooling the massive magnetic sphere still works even in the unresolved-sideband regime where the mechanical frequency is smaller than the magnon decay rate. Eventually, we quantify the powers of the driving pumps for practical implementation of our scheme in a typical system. Our findings may provide a novel way to quantum fundamental researches and technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 在腔磁振力学系统中，借助微波腔驱动增强的磁振子—机械耦合，可以冷却悬浮磁球的质心运动。本文进一步指出，铁磁石榴石球固有的磁振子自 Kerr 非线性可通过合适的泵浦驱动转化为量子压缩，从而显著提升冷却性能。作者还证明，即使在未分辨边带区，这一增强机制依然有效，并估算了实际实现所需的驱动功率。
authors: Jiate Xu, Xinqian Cui, Guolong Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将大质量振子冷却到量子基态，是实现其精确操控、量子存储以及量子超高灵敏测量等的一个基本前提。在腔磁振力学系统中，借助微波腔驱动所增强的磁振子—机械耦合，可用于冷却悬浮磁球的质心运动。本文报告说，通过利用铁磁钇铁石榴石（YIG）球中固有的磁振子自 Kerr 非线性，还可以进一步改善冷却性能。借助合适的泵浦驱动，这种 Kerr 非线性可转化为量子压缩，在适当选择最优参数时，可显著增强质心冷却效果。此外，我们证明了这种用于冷却大质量磁球的改进机制，即使在未分辨边带区也仍然有效，此时机械频率小于磁振子衰减率。最后，我们量化了在典型系统中实现该方案所需的驱动泵功率。我们的研究结果可能为量子基础研究和技术提供一种新的途径。

articles.title: Quantization Effects of Artificial Neural Networks for Embedded Edge-Computing Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于嵌入式边缘计算应用的人工神经网络量化效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.05479v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper examines the use of Quantized Neural Networks (QNNs) for two resource-constrained scientific applications: automated calibration of semi-conductor quantum bits (qubits) and scientific particle detectors. We evaluate the trade-offs between Post-Training Quantization (PTQ), Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), and ultra-low-bit Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) with respect to latency and resource usage. Our results demonstrate that PTQ achieves a four-fold reduction in memory usage for U-shaped CNN (U-Net) architectures. For the training of non-differentiable custom BNNs , we propose a novel, hardware-constrained learning approach using Genetic Algorithms (GAs). We showcase a LUT-based BNN architecture suitable for direct conversion to VHDL via the HCL4BNN framework. This method achieves nanosecond-scale inference latencies (10-15 ns) without requiring specialized DSP or BRAM resources.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考察了量化神经网络在两类资源受限科学应用中的使用：半导体量子比特的自动校准以及科学粒子探测器。作者比较了训练后量化、量化感知训练和超低比特二值神经网络在延迟与资源占用上的权衡，并提出一种用于不可微定制二值网络的遗传算法学习方法。结果表明，基于 LUT 的 BNN 架构可直接转换为 VHDL，并在不依赖专用 DSP 或 BRAM 资源的情况下实现纳秒级推理延迟。
authors: Alperen Aksoy, Ilja Bekman, Vesselin Dimitrov, Qader Dorosti, Chimezie Eguzo, Sarah Fleitmann, Christian Grewing, Fabian Hader, Andre Zambanini, Stefan van Waasen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文考察了量化神经网络（QNN）在两类资源受限的科学应用中的使用：半导体量子比特（qubit）的自动校准以及科学粒子探测器。我们评估了训练后量化（PTQ）、量化感知训练（QAT）以及超低比特二值神经网络（BNN）在延迟和资源使用方面的权衡。结果表明，对于 U 形 CNN（U-Net）架构，PTQ 可将存储器使用量降低四倍。针对不可微的定制 BNN 训练，我们提出了一种新的、受硬件约束的遗传算法（GA）学习方法。我们展示了一种基于查找表（LUT）的 BNN 架构，该架构适合通过 HCL4BNN 框架直接转换为 VHDL。该方法可实现纳秒量级的推理延迟（10–15 ns），且不需要专用的 DSP 或 BRAM 资源。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Quantum Control for Rovibrational Photoassociation in a Morse Molecular System
articles.title_zh: 用于 Morse 分子体系振动-转动光关联的物理信息神经量子控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.29610v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a Physics-Informed Neural Quantum Control (PINQC) framework for rovibrational photoassociation in a Morse molecular system. The proposed method combines neural-network-based laser-field generation with differentiable quantum propagation, allowing optimized laser pulses to be obtained directly from the underlying quantum dynamics without requiring external training data. The optimized control fields efficiently transfer an initially continuum-like Gaussian wave packet into the vibrational ground-state level, promoting continuum-to-bound population transfer through coherent rovibrational dynamics. The resulting photoassociation process involves both vibrational stabilization and rotational redistribution arising naturally from dipole-induced couplings between neighboring rotational channels. A central result of the present work is the successful application of the PINQC framework to extended rovibrational models containing larger rotational levels than those previously accessible in our conventional photoassociation calculations. The optimization remains numerically stable despite the increased complexity of the molecular system, demonstrating that differentiable optimization provides an effective strategy for treating rovibrational models of increased dimensionality.
