articles.title: Compton Polarimeter Prototype for the CUbesat Solar Polarimeter (CUSP) mission
articles.title_zh: CUbesat Solar Polarimeter（CUSP）任务的康普顿偏振仪原型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27460v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The space-based CUbesat Solar Polarimeter (CUSP) mission aims to measure the linear polarization of solar flares in the hard X-ray band (25-100 keV) by means of a dual-phase Compton polarimeter. CUSP will allow to study the magnetic reconnection and particle acceleration in the flaring magnetic structures of our star with its unprecedented sensitivity to solar flare polarization. CUSP is a project under development as part of the Alcor Program of the Italian Space Agency aimed at developing new CubeSat missions. In the frame of CUSP's Phase B, which started in December 2024, a flight-representative prototype of the Compton polarimeter has been developed and characterized with hard X-ray sources in the laboratory. This prototype consists of a 4×4 central matrix of plastic scintillator bars surrounded by 4 strips of 8 elongated GAGG scintillators, respectively coupled to a multi-anode photomultiplier tube and arrays of avalanche photodiodes. These sensors are read out by custom front-end electronics based on MAROC-3A and SKIROC-2A ASICs with a Xilinx Artix 7 FPGA. The plastic scintillators act as scatterers, while the GAGG bars fully absorb the scattered photons. Coincident plastic-GAGG events allow for reconstructing the Compton scattering direction, whose distribution allows for inferring the polarization parameters of the source. We report here the measured performance of the polarimeter prototype using well-known radioactive isotopes and X-ray tubes, allowing us to assess the performance of our polarimeter prototype over the full 25-100 keV energy range.
articles.abstract_zh: CUSP 是一项基于立方星的太阳偏振测量任务，旨在利用双相康普顿偏振仪测量太阳耀斑在 25–100 keV 硬 X 射线能段的线偏振。论文介绍了在任务 B 阶段开发的飞行代表性偏振仪原型及其实验室硬 X 射线表征。该原型通过塑料闪烁体与 GAGG 闪烁体的符合事件重建康普顿散射方向，并据此推断源的偏振参数。
authors: Nicolas De Angelis, Andrea Alimenti, Riccardo Campana, Mauro Centrone, Giovanni De Cesare, Ettore Del Monte, Sergio Di Cosimo, Enrico Costa, Sergio Fabiani, Abhay Kumar, Pasqualino Loffredo, Giovanni Lombardi, Gabriele Minervini, Fabio Muleri, Paolo Romano, Alda Rubini, Enrico Silva, Paolo Soffitta, Giovanni Cucinella, Vito Di Bari, Simone Di Filippo, Andrea Negri, Massimo Perelli, Davide Albanesi, Valerio Campamaggiore, Giulia de Iulis, Andrea Del Re, Paolo Leonetti, Alessandro Zambardi, Ilaria Baffo, Pierluigi Fanelli, Costantino Zazza, Andrea Curatolo, Nicolas Gagliardi, Dario Modenini, Daniele Pecorella, Alice Ponti, Paolo Tortora, Valerio Vagelli, Daniele Brienza, Immacolata Donnarumma, Matteo Mergè, Emanuele Zaccagnino, Alessandro Turchi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于空间的 CUbesat Solar Polarimeter（CUSP）任务旨在通过双相康普顿偏振仪测量太阳耀斑在硬 X 射线波段（25–100 keV）的线偏振。CUSP 将以其对太阳耀斑偏振前所未有的灵敏度，使研究人员能够研究我们恒星耀斑磁结构中的磁重联和粒子加速。CUSP 是意大利航天局 Alcor 计划下正在开发的项目，该计划旨在发展新的立方星任务。在 CUSP 于 2024 年 12 月启动的 B 阶段框架内，研究人员开发了一个具有飞行代表性的康普顿偏振仪原型，并在实验室中使用硬 X 射线源对其进行了表征。该原型由一个 4×4 的塑料闪烁体条中央矩阵组成，周围环绕 4 条各含 8 个细长 GAGG 闪烁体的条带，它们分别耦合到一个多阳极光电倍增管和雪崩光电二极管阵列。这些传感器由基于 MAROC-3A 和 SKIROC-2A ASIC、并配备 Xilinx Artix 7 FPGA 的定制前端电子学系统读出。塑料闪烁体充当散射体，而 GAGG 条则完全吸收散射后的光子。塑料-GAGG 的符合事件允许重建康普顿散射方向，其分布可用于推断源的偏振参数。我们在此报告使用已知放射性同位素和 X 射线管测得的偏振仪原型性能，这使我们能够评估该偏振仪原型在完整 25–100 keV 能量范围内的性能。

articles.title: Diamond's newfound defect may tame vibrations that hinder quantum light sources
articles.title_zh: 金刚石中新发现的缺陷或可抑制阻碍量子光源的振动
articles.abstract: Researchers in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign have discovered a new type of quantum light emitter in diamonds that could help overcome a number of challenges facing quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校电气与计算机工程系的研究人员在金刚石中发现了一种新的量子光发射体。这一发现可能有助于克服量子技术发展中面临的若干挑战，尤其是与量子光源稳定性相关的问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校电气与计算机工程系的研究人员在金刚石中发现了一种新型量子光发射体，这可能有助于克服量子技术所面临的多项挑战。

articles.title: Less-explored form of quantum code could be more powerful—and more stable—than its alternative in error correction
articles.title_zh: 较少被探索的量子编码形式在纠错中可能比替代方案更强大且更稳定
articles.abstract: In mathematics and getting dressed, some processes are commutative, while others are noncommutative. Commutative means the order doesn't matter (3 + 2 is the same as 2 + 3, and it doesn't matter which sock goes on first). Noncommutative means the order does matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇新闻介绍了一类较少被探索的量子纠错编码，其核心与可交换和不可交换过程的差异有关。文章用数学运算和穿衣顺序作类比，说明有些过程顺序无关，而有些过程顺序会影响结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在数学和穿衣中，有些过程是可交换的，而另一些过程是不可交换的。可交换意味着顺序无关紧要（3 + 2 与 2 + 3 相同，先穿哪只袜子也无关紧要）。不可交换意味着顺序很重要。

articles.title: Two independent studies push semiconductor qubits towards practical scales
articles.title_zh: 两项独立研究推动半导体量子比特迈向实用规模
articles.abstract: Semiconductor spin qubits are one of the most promising building blocks for future quantum computers, but turning them into a working, large-scale quantum computer has so far proven difficult. For now, two big questions remain open: how to connect qubits that aren't sitting right next to each other, and how to control huge numbers of them without an unmanageable tangle of wiring.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体自旋量子比特被认为是未来量子计算机最有前景的构件之一，但将其扩展为可运行的大规模量子计算机仍面临困难。当前关键挑战包括如何连接非相邻量子比特，以及如何在不产生难以管理的布线复杂性的情况下控制大量量子比特。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 半导体自旋量子比特是未来量子计算机最有前景的构建单元之一，但迄今为止，将它们转化为可工作的、大规模量子计算机仍被证明十分困难。目前仍有两个重大问题悬而未决：如何连接彼此并不相邻的量子比特，以及如何在不形成难以管理的布线乱团的情况下控制数量庞大的量子比特。

articles.title: Light's hidden properties save quantum information from the chaos of bad weather
articles.title_zh: 光的隐藏属性使量子信息免受恶劣天气混乱影响
articles.abstract: For years, researchers have tried to harness the "twist" of light to transmit data. This property describes how light spirals as it travels forward, and because it can be molded into a virtually infinite number of different twists, it provides a massive, promising alphabet for high-capacity communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员长期尝试利用光的“扭转”性质来传输数据，这种性质描述了光在向前传播时如何呈螺旋状演化。由于这种扭转可以被塑造成近乎无限多种不同形式，它为高容量通信提供了庞大且有前景的信息字母表。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多年来，研究人员一直试图利用光的“扭转”来传输数据。这一性质描述了光在向前传播时如何螺旋前进，并且由于它可以被塑造成几乎无限数量的不同扭转形式，因此为高容量通信提供了一个庞大而有前景的字母表。

articles.title: Physicists link the Riemann Hypothesis to phase transitions in quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 物理学家将黎曼假设与量子系统中的相变联系起来
articles.abstract: A new study in Nature Communications has established a link between the Riemann Hypothesis and dynamical phase transitions in engineered quantum systems, demonstrating the effect on a quantum processor.
articles.abstract_zh: 一项发表于《Nature Communications》的新研究建立了黎曼假设与工程化量子系统中动力学相变之间的联系。研究还在量子处理器上演示了相关效应，显示数学猜想与可控量子物理之间存在新的交叉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一项发表于《Nature Communications》的新研究建立了黎曼假设与工程化量子系统中的动力学相变之间的联系，并在量子处理器上展示了这一效应。

articles.title: Excited state optimization for strongly correlated quantum defects using ensemble variational Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 利用系综变分蒙特卡罗优化强关联量子缺陷的激发态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27377v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using the recently introduced ensemble variational Monte Carlo (VMC), we study optimized wave functions for strongly correlated point defects, including nitrogen-vacancy and silicon-vacancy centers in diamond and substitutional iron and chromium impurities in aluminum nitride. We study the effects of fully optimized determinant expansion parameters, orbitals, and Jastrow correlation factors on these systems. We find that orbitals from the hybrid functional PBE0 are much better (have lower objective functional) than semilocal PBE, which results in changes in the excitation energies up to 0.5 eV. Further improvements can be made by directly optimizing the objective functional, resulting in changes in excitation energies up to 0.2 eV. The most important parameter varies from defect to defect, reinforcing the necessity of optimizing all parameters to obtain accurate excited states in strongly correlated defects.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用新近提出的系综变分蒙特卡罗方法，研究金刚石 NV、SiV 中心以及氮化铝中铁、铬替位杂质等强关联点缺陷的优化波函数。结果表明，PBE0 杂化泛函轨道优于半局域 PBE，并可显著影响激发能；进一步直接优化目标泛函还能带来额外改进。不同缺陷中最关键的参数并不相同，说明需要同时优化行列式展开、轨道和 Jastrow 相关因子等全部参数。
authors: Kevin G. Kleiner, Lucas K. Wagner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用最近引入的系综变分蒙特卡罗（VMC），我们研究了强关联点缺陷的优化波函数，包括金刚石中的氮-空位和硅-空位中心，以及氮化铝中的替位铁和铬杂质。我们研究了完全优化的行列式展开参数、轨道和 Jastrow 相关因子对这些体系的影响。我们发现，来自杂化泛函 PBE0 的轨道比半局域 PBE 好得多（具有更低的目标泛函），这会导致激发能出现高达 0.5 eV 的变化。通过直接优化目标泛函还可以进一步改进，从而使激发能发生高达 0.2 eV 的变化。最重要的参数因缺陷而异，这进一步强调了为获得强关联缺陷的准确激发态而优化所有参数的必要性。

articles.title: Fluctuation electrodynamics of quantum capacitance in electron bilayers
articles.title_zh: 电子双层中量子电容的涨落电动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Capacitance is a thermodynamic probe of interacting electrons: it measures the energy cost of moving charge between conductors, and in low-dimensional systems this cost is shaped by exchange and correlation as much as by electrostatics. We develop a theory of the quantum capacitance of electron double layers, semiconductor quantum wells as well as monolayer and bilayer graphene devices, focusing on the contribution generated by interlayer correlations. Within a functional-integral formulation we show that the separation-dependent part of the ground-state energy is, at the level of ring diagrams, exactly the nonretarded Lifshitz expression for the van der Waals energy of two conducting sheets, with reflection amplitudes built from the layer polarizabilities. The interlayer correction to the inverse capacitance is the second density derivative of this energy: a Casimir compressibility. The zero-point fluctuations that generate Casimir forces between mirrors are here the coupled plasmons of the bilayer, and their contribution to the capacitance is obtained in closed form, with a universal coefficient; its sign shows that interlayer correlations oppose charging at high density. A Gell-Mann-Brueckner analysis gives the exact high-density limit in terms of universal functions. For graphene we find that monolayers follow the electron-gas template, while bilayer graphene is anomalous: interband screening suppresses the correction by orders of magnitude and reverses its sign in the experimentally relevant range of separations. We delineate the limits of the theory, identifying the dilute Wigner-crystal regime and electron-hole double layers near exciton condensation as regimes where the capacitance becomes a probe of interlayer pairing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文发展了电子双层、半导体量子阱以及单层和双层石墨烯器件中量子电容的理论，重点分析层间关联产生的贡献。作者指出，环图层级下与层间距相关的基态能量等价于两个导电片的非迟滞 Lifshitz 范德瓦尔斯能，而电容倒数的层间修正可理解为一种 Casimir 可压缩性。研究还给出高密度极限与石墨烯体系中的差异行为，并指出稀薄 Wigner 晶体和接近激子凝聚的电子-空穴双层是该理论需谨慎适用的区域。
authors: Dmitry Zverevich, Alberto F. Morpurgo, Alex Levchenko
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电容是相互作用电子的热力学探针：它测量在导体之间移动电荷的能量代价，而在低维系统中，这一代价不仅由静电学塑造，也同样受到交换和关联的影响。我们发展了电子双层、半导体量子阱以及单层和双层石墨烯器件中量子电容的理论，重点关注由层间关联产生的贡献。在泛函积分表述中，我们表明，在环图层级上，基态能量中依赖于层间距的部分，正是两个导电片的范德瓦尔斯能的非迟滞 Lifshitz 表达式，其中反射振幅由各层的极化率构成。电容倒数的层间修正是该能量对密度的二阶导数：一种 Casimir 可压缩性。在镜面之间产生 Casimir 力的零点涨落，在这里就是双层的耦合等离激元；它们对电容的贡献可以用闭合形式得到，并具有一个普适系数；其符号表明，在高密度下层间关联会反对充电。Gell-Mann-Brueckner 分析以普适函数的形式给出了精确的高密度极限。对于石墨烯，我们发现单层遵循电子气模板，而双层石墨烯则表现异常：带间屏蔽使修正量级降低数个数量级，并在实验相关的层间距范围内使其符号反转。我们划定了该理论的适用界限，指出稀薄 Wigner 晶体区域以及接近激子凝聚的电子-空穴双层，是电容成为层间配对探针的区域。

articles.title: Bose-Einstein condensation and superfluidity on a fuzzy sphere
articles.title_zh: 模糊球面上的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚与超流性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27470v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: According to Hohenberg's theorem, Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) in two dimensions is impossible for any temperature T>0. By contrast, superfluidity does occur in two dimensions at finite temperatures; it emerges due to the breaking of Galilei invariance. Here we consider BEC and superfluidity on a compact two-dimensional space taking the form of a non-commutative ("fuzzy") sphere, where the scalar bosonic fields are promoted to N× N matrices. The dimension N is related to the non-commutativity parameter of space and introduces an additional scale into the system. We find that non-commutativity favors ordered phases and so enhances BEC and superfluidity. We analyze BEC in ideal and weakly interacting Bose gases on a fuzzy sphere, finding in each case that the critical temperature of BEC is greater compared to that found in the case of a commutative sphere S². Then we investigate the superfluid response of weakly interacting Bose systems. To account for vortices in a superfluid, we show that, even on an ordinary sphere, the collective coordinates of vortices induce non-commutativity. With this in mind, we extend the definition of vortex defects to an inherently non-commutative sphere studied here, where the notion of a point is untenable. The non-commutativity is expected to be experimentally relevant to BEC and superfluidity since the fuzzy sphere has a thermodynamic limit distinct from the one defined over a plane, unlike the S² case. The significance of this difference is illustrated by the superfluid density calculation indicating that, in the large sphere limit, the normal fluid fraction on the fuzzy sphere yields a linear in T dependence, while on a commutative S² it exhibits the usual two-dimensional sim T³ behavior. This linear dependence, arising directly from non-commutativity, is reminiscent of Uemura's law in cuprate high-T_c superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察非对易“模糊”球面这一紧致二维空间上的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚与超流性，其中标量玻色场被提升为 N×N 矩阵。作者发现非对易性有利于有序相，从而增强凝聚和超流响应，并使理想及弱相互作用玻色气体的临界温度高于普通对易球面情形。研究还讨论了涡旋、超流密度及热力学极限，指出模糊球面上法向流体分数可呈线性温度依赖。
authors: Vira Shyta, Flavio S. Nogueira, Ashley M. Cook
articles.abstract_zh_full: 根据 Hohenberg 定理，在二维中任意温度 T>0 下都不可能发生玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）。相比之下，超流性确实会在有限温度的二维体系中出现；它源于 Galilei 不变性的破缺。这里我们考虑一个紧致二维空间上的 BEC 和超流性，该空间采取非对易（“模糊”）球面的形式，其中标量玻色场被提升为 N×N 矩阵。维数 N 与空间的非对易参数相关，并为系统引入了一个额外尺度。我们发现，非对易性有利于有序相，因此增强 BEC 和超流性。我们分析了模糊球面上理想和弱相互作用玻色气体中的 BEC，发现两种情况下 BEC 的临界温度都高于对易球面 S² 情形中的临界温度。随后我们研究了弱相互作用玻色体系的超流响应。为了在超流体中考虑涡旋，我们表明，即使在普通球面上，涡旋的集体坐标也会诱导非对易性。基于这一点，我们将涡旋缺陷的定义扩展到这里研究的本征非对易球面，在该球面上“点”的概念并不成立。预计这种非对易性与 BEC 和超流性的实验相关性很高，因为与 S² 情形不同，模糊球面具有不同于平面上定义的热力学极限。超流密度计算展示了这一区别的重要性：在大球面极限下，模糊球面上的法向流体分数呈现随 T 线性变化的依赖关系，而在对易 S² 上则表现出通常的二维约 T³ 行为。这种直接源于非对易性的线性依赖，让人联想到铜氧化物高温超导体中的 Uemura 定律。

articles.title: Entropic signatures of the single-impurity Kondo state
articles.title_zh: 单杂质 Kondo 态的熵特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kondo singlet---a many-body state formed by entanglement between a localized spin and the Fermi sea---has been studied extensively through its transport signatures in quantum dots. Here we report a thermodynamic measurement of the entropy suppression associated with the formation of the Kondo singlet, using temperature-dependent charge sensing and a Maxwell relation to track the suppression of spin entropy as the first electron is added to a strongly-coupled GaAs quantum dot. Plotting dN/dT against the simultaneously measured occupation N reveals an asymmetric lineshape with its peak shifted to N>1/2---a hallmark of Kondo screening---that weakens with increasing temperature and is qualitatively reproduced by numerical renormalization group (NRG) calculations, with a small but persistent offset to lower occupation relative to the theory. An independent measurement of conductance versus occupation on the same device provides a test of these quantities through the mixed-valence crossover and matches NRG within experimental uncertainty.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过热力学测量观察单杂质 Kondo 单态形成时伴随的自旋熵抑制。作者利用温度依赖的电荷传感和 Maxwell 关系，在强耦合 GaAs 量子点中追踪加入第一个电子时的熵变化。测得的 dN/dT 与占据数 N 的关系显示出 Kondo 屏蔽特征，并与数值重整化群计算总体相符；同一器件上的电导测量也支持该图像。
authors: Johann Drayne, Silvia Lüscher, Will Grant, Vahid Movahed, Tim Child, Saeed Fallahi, Geoffrey C. Gardner, Michael J. Manfra, Yaakov Kleeorin, Yigal Meir, Joshua Folk
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kondo 单态是由局域自旋与费米海之间的纠缠形成的多体态，长期以来人们通过其在量子点中的输运特征对其进行了广泛研究。这里我们报告了对 Kondo 单态形成所伴随的熵抑制的热力学测量，方法是利用温度依赖的电荷传感和 Maxwell 关系，在向强耦合 GaAs 量子点加入第一个电子时追踪自旋熵的抑制。将 dN/dT 与同时测得的占据数 N 作图，显示出一个不对称线形，其峰值移动到 N>1/2——这是 Kondo 屏蔽的标志——该特征随温度升高而减弱，并被数值重整化群（NRG）计算在定性上再现，不过相对于理论，它在较低占据数方向存在一个小而持续的偏移。在同一器件上对电导随占据数变化的独立测量，为这些量在混合价交叉区域中的表现提供了检验，并在实验不确定度范围内与 NRG 相符合。

articles.title: Single-crystal structural phase diagram of stoichiometric bilayer nickelate La3Ni2O7 under hydrostatic pressure
articles.title_zh: 流体静水压下化学计量双层镍酸盐 La3Ni2O7 单晶的结构相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27607v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The bilayer nickelate La3Ni2O7 has attracted intense interest following the discovery of high-temperature superconductivity under pressure, representing the first nickelate superconductor realized in bulk form. However, the crystal structure of the superconducting phase remains under active discussion, complicating efforts to establish its microscopic origin. Here we resolve these structural controversies by establishing a definitive pressure-temperature phase diagram, including the superconducting region of stoichiometric La3Ni2O7 single crystals under hydrostatic conditions using helium as the pressure-transmitting medium. At ambient pressure, La3Ni2O7 adopts a polar orthorhombic Am2m structure characterized by charge order between inequivalent Ni sites and NiO6 octahedral tilting. Upon compression, the system undergoes a direct transition from the charge-ordered Am2m phase to the tetragonal I4/mmm phase near 10 GPa, coinciding with the onset of bulk superconductivity. These results establish the intrinsic structural evolution of La3Ni2O7 and provide a structural framework for microscopic theories of nickelate superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在以氦为传压介质的流体静水压条件下，建立了化学计量 La3Ni2O7 单晶的压力—温度结构相图，并覆盖其超导区域。作者发现常压下材料为具有电荷有序和 NiO6 八面体倾斜的极性正交 Am2m 结构，约 10 GPa 时直接转变为四方 I4/mmm 相，且与体超导的出现相对应。该结果为理解镍酸盐超导的微观机制提供了明确的结构基础。
authors: Misaki Sasaki, Zhehong Liu, Takeshi Hara, Shunsuke Kitou, Markus Kriener, Haruto Yoshimochi, Shion Yamada, Chieko Terakura, Naohisa Hirao, Hirokazu Kadobayashi, Yusuke Wakabayashi, Yoshinori Tokura, Yasujiro Taguchi, Taka-hisa Arima, Yukako Fujishiro
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在压力下发现高温超导性之后，双层镍酸盐 La3Ni2O7 引起了强烈关注，它代表了首个以块体形式实现的镍酸盐超导体。然而，超导相的晶体结构仍在积极讨论之中，这使得确立其微观起源的努力变得复杂。在这里，我们通过在以氦作为传压介质的流体静水压条件下，建立化学计量 La3Ni2O7 单晶的确定性压力—温度相图，包括其超导区域，从而解决这些结构争议。在常压下，La3Ni2O7 采取极性正交 Am2m 结构，其特征是在不等价 Ni 位点之间存在电荷有序以及 NiO6 八面体倾斜。在压缩下，该体系在约 10 GPa 附近从电荷有序的 Am2m 相直接转变为四方 I4/mmm 相，并与体超导的出现相一致。这些结果确立了 La3Ni2O7 的本征结构演化，并为镍酸盐超导的微观理论提供了结构框架。

articles.title: Observation of Moiré Time Crystal in Floquet-driven Rydberg Atomic Gases
articles.title_zh: 在 Floquet 驱动的里德堡原子气体中观测莫尔时间晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Moiré time crystal is a non-equilibrium quantum phase emerging from the coherent interference of two distinct frequencies, at least one being the intrinsic oscillation of a symmetry-broken time crystal. Its hallmark is an ultra-long beat period, reflecting a time-domain mapping of the Moiré fringes that arise from mismatched spatial lattices. However, to date, no experimental realization of such a Moiré time crystal has been reported. In this work, by applying a bichromatic driving field with two distinct frequencies, we demonstrate that the interplay between long-range Rydberg interactions and dissipation gives rise to a unique comb-like Moiré pattern characterized by a beat-note comb, which superimposes subharmonic periodicity and fundamental frequencies. This Moiré pattern formed by two mismatched drives is staggered in the spectrum as the frequency of one driver changes. We experimentally map the phase diagram of the system and identify a robust region where the Moiré temporal order persists against perturbations in laser detuning. The reported Moiré time crystal not only provides a controllable platform for exploring emergent slow-fast dynamics and synthetic space-time symmetries but also opens avenues for engineering complex temporal order in driven quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作通过对里德堡原子气体施加双频驱动，实验实现并观测了由两种不匹配频率相干干涉产生的莫尔时间晶体。长程里德堡相互作用与耗散共同产生梳状莫尔谱图，表现为同时包含亚谐周期性和基频的拍频梳。作者绘制了相图，并确认了对激光失谐扰动具有鲁棒性的莫尔时间有序区域。
authors: Shuai Shi, Dong-Yang Zhu, Yu Yang, Chu-Rong Pan, Jing-Wen Tang, Ya-Peng Zhang, Yan-Li Zhou, Wei-Tao Liu, Li-Hua Zhang, Bang Liu, Dong-Sheng Ding
articles.abstract_zh_full: 莫尔时间晶体是一种非平衡量子相，产生于两个不同频率的相干干涉，其中至少一个频率是对称性破缺时间晶体的本征振荡。它的标志是超长拍频周期，反映了由不匹配空间晶格产生的莫尔条纹在时间域中的映射。然而，迄今尚未有此类莫尔时间晶体的实验实现被报道。在本工作中，通过施加具有两个不同频率的双色驱动场，我们证明长程里德堡相互作用与耗散之间的相互作用会产生一种独特的梳状莫尔图案，其特征是拍频梳，并叠加了亚谐周期性和基频。由两个不匹配驱动形成的这一莫尔图案会随着其中一个驱动频率的改变而在频谱中交错移动。我们在实验上绘制了该体系的相图，并确定了一个鲁棒区域，在该区域中莫尔时间有序能够抵抗激光失谐扰动。所报道的莫尔时间晶体不仅为探索涌现的快慢动力学和合成时空对称性提供了可控平台，也为在受驱动量子多体系统中设计复杂时间有序开辟了途径。

articles.title: Three-Dimensional Kardar--Parisi--Zhang Scaling in Polariton Condensates
articles.title_zh: 极化激元凝聚体中的三维 Kardar–Parisi–Zhang 标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28106v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) universality provides an example of macroscopic scaling generated by microscopic violation of detailed balance. While one- and two-dimensional realizations have been explored in driven condensates and growing interfaces, demonstrating KPZ scaling in three spatial dimensions remains a major challenge. Here we propose a three-dimensional exciton-polariton crystal as a platform for observation of 3D KPZ universality. Starting from a stochastic driven-dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii equation for a condensate formed in a three-dimensional photonic-crystal lower-polariton band, we eliminate the massive density and reservoir modes and obtain an effective 3+1-dimensional KPZ equation for the condensate phase. Numerical simulations of both the KPZ equation and the full driven-dissipative polariton model show an intermediate-asymptotic regime in which the first-order coherence obeys -łn |gone(0,Δ t)|propto |Δ t|²β and -łn |gone(Δ r,0)|propto |Δ r|²ḩⁱ, with exponents consistent with the 3+1 KPZ benchmarks β= 0.1845, ḩi= 0.3135. Our results identify three-dimensional polariton crystals as a controllable quantum fluid route to higher-dimensional nonequilibrium universality.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出三维激子—极化激元晶体可作为观测 3D KPZ 普适性的实验平台。作者从受驱动—耗散的随机 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程出发，消去密度和储库等有质量模式，得到凝聚相位的 3+1 维 KPZ 有效方程。数值模拟显示一阶相干函数在中间渐近区间呈现与 3+1 维 KPZ 基准指数一致的标度行为。
authors: Junhui Cao, Denis Novokreschenov, Artem Alexandrov, Timothy Halpin-Healy, Alexey Kavokin
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kardar–Parisi–Zhang（KPZ）普适性提供了一个由微观详细平衡破缺产生宏观标度的例子。尽管一维和二维实现已在受驱动凝聚体和生长界面中得到探索，在三维空间中展示 KPZ 标度仍然是一项重大挑战。在这里，我们提出三维激子—极化激元晶体可作为观测 3D KPZ 普适性的平台。从三维光子晶体下极化激元能带中形成的凝聚体的随机受驱动—耗散 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程出发，我们消去有质量的密度模式和储库模式，并得到描述凝聚体相位的有效 3+1 维 KPZ 方程。对 KPZ 方程和完整受驱动—耗散极化激元模型的数值模拟都显示出一个中间渐近区间，在该区间中一阶相干性满足 -ln |gone(0, Δt)| ∝ |Δt|²β 和 -ln |gone(Δr, 0)| ∝ |Δr|²χ，其指数与 3+1 维 KPZ 基准值 β = 0.1845、χ = 0.3135 一致。我们的结果表明，三维极化激元晶体提供了一条通过可控量子流体通向高维非平衡普适性的路径。

articles.title: Interacting Quantum Symmetric Exclusion Process
articles.title_zh: 相互作用量子对称排斥过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28255v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce and solve the Interacting Quantum Symmetric Exclusion Process (IQSEP), a family of models describing the stochastic quantum hopping of charged particles along the edges of a lattice, with hopping amplitudes that depend on the occupations of neighbouring sites. In the absence of interactions, they reduce to the standard quantum simple symmetric exclusion process, exhibiting coherent diffusive transport. For interactions of order one, they capture incoherent diffusive transport and its fluctuations, characterized by density-dependent diffusivity and mobility, making contact with the macroscopic fluctuation theory. By rescaling the interaction strength appropriately with the lattice mesh, we define a mesoscopic scaling regime that retains a finite coherence length in the continuous thermodynamic limit. This regime interpolates between coherent behavior at small length scales and incoherent behavior at large scales. The resulting scaling theory accounts for fluctuations of quantum coherences in interacting diffusive systems, going beyond the scope of standard fluctuating hydrodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者引入并求解了一类相互作用量子对称排斥过程，用于描述带电粒子在晶格边上的随机量子跃迁，且跃迁振幅依赖相邻格点占据。该模型在无相互作用时退化为标准量子简单对称排斥过程，而在有限相互作用下可刻画非相干扩散输运及其涨落。通过适当缩放相互作用强度，作者提出了保持有限相干长度的介观标度理论，连接小尺度相干行为与大尺度非相干行为。
authors: Denis Bernard, Friedrich Hübner, Stefano Scopa
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入并求解相互作用量子对称排斥过程（IQSEP），这是一族描述带电粒子沿晶格边进行随机量子跃迁的模型，其中跃迁振幅依赖于相邻格点的占据情况。在没有相互作用时，它们退化为标准的量子简单对称排斥过程，表现出相干扩散输运。对于一阶量级的相互作用，它们刻画非相干扩散输运及其涨落，其特征是密度依赖的扩散率和迁移率，并与宏观涨落理论建立联系。通过随晶格网格尺度适当地重新标度相互作用强度，我们定义了一个介观标度区域，在连续热力学极限中保留有限的相干长度。该区域在小长度尺度上的相干行为与大尺度上的非相干行为之间进行插值。所得标度理论能够解释相互作用扩散系统中量子相干性的涨落，超出了标准涨落流体力学的适用范围。

articles.title: Current-based RF charge sensing in a carbon nanotube
articles.title_zh: 碳纳米管中的基于电流的射频电荷传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultra-sensitive charge detection is a widely used tool for quantum electronics with applications in quantum information processing and in probing the physics of condensed matter systems. Existing approaches require either an impedance-matched resonant circuit, or millimeter-scale proximity between amplifier and sample, both adding complexity and constraining device design. In this work, we introduce a current-mode charge sensor in a suspended carbon nanotube, operating at the 1.25 MHz resonance of an RLC tank circuit and achieving a charge sensitivity of 0.15~μ e/sqrtHz. We utilize it to measure a double quantum dot (DQD) electrostatically defined in the same nanotube, revealing a highly regular charge stability diagram. We perform single-shot readout of the DQD charge state at an integration time of 3.56~μs, without any false assignments over 10⁷ measurements and a signal-to-noise ratio of 17 exceeding the state of the art.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种悬浮碳纳米管中的电流模式电荷传感器，在 RLC 谐振回路的 1.25 MHz 共振频率下工作，实现了 0.15 μe/√Hz 的电荷灵敏度。作者用其测量同一纳米管中静电定义的双量子点，获得高度规则的电荷稳定图。该器件还实现了 3.56 μs 积分时间下的单次电荷态读出，在 10⁷ 次测量中无错误判定，信噪比达到 17。
authors: Marta Cagetti, Stefan Forstner, Victor Champain, Roger Tormo-Queralt, Christoffer B. Møller, Sergio L. De Bonis, Chandan Samanta, Elsa Vázquez-Rodriguez, Eneko Mateos-Madinabeitia, David A. Czaplewski, Adrian Bachtold
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超灵敏电荷探测是量子电子学中广泛使用的工具，应用于量子信息处理以及凝聚态系统物理的探测。现有方法要么需要阻抗匹配的谐振电路，要么需要放大器与样品之间达到毫米尺度的近距离，这两者都会增加复杂性并限制器件设计。在本工作中，我们引入一种悬浮碳纳米管中的电流模式电荷传感器，它工作在 RLC 槽路的 1.25 MHz 共振频率下，并实现了 0.15 μe/√Hz 的电荷灵敏度。我们利用它测量在同一碳纳米管中通过静电定义的双量子点（DQD），揭示出高度规则的电荷稳定性图。我们在 3.56 μs 的积分时间下对 DQD 电荷态进行单次读出，在 10⁷ 次测量中没有任何错误判定，并获得了 17 的信噪比，超过了当前最先进水平。

articles.title: Quasiparticle phono-conversion: filming carriers coalescing into excitons
articles.title_zh: 准粒子声子转换：拍摄载流子并合为激子的过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Condensed matter physics is replete with phenomena involving high-energy free particles coalescing into low-energy bound few-particle states. While the cooling of the individual particles is well understood, the crucial step by which cold free carriers form a bound state remains elusive, involving complex energy and momentum relaxation pathways. Here, by combining ultrafast time- and momentum-resolved photoemission spectroscopy on a monolayer WSe₂ with the first-principles excitonic-Bloch equations, we resolve the conversion of initially free electrons and holes at the bandedges into bound excitons. With unprecedented energy resolution, we observe the transient coexistence of free-carrier and excitonic bands, accompanied by a transfer of spectral weight between the two. We establish the phononic origin of exciton formation and ascribe this coexistence to a sequential relaxation cascade toward the lowest-energy excitonic states, wherein intermediate states remain weakly populated. The efficiency of this process is controlled by valley multiplicity, large-momentum phonon emission and spin-flip processes. By elucidating how bound states emerge from their elementary constituents, our results point to strategies for engineering exciton formation, with direct implications for optical materials and devices that operate with excitons or free carriers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合单层 WSe2 的超快时间与动量分辨光电子能谱和第一性原理激子 Bloch 方程，解析了初始自由电子和空穴在带边转化为束缚激子的过程。实验以高能量分辨率观测到自由载流子带与激子带的瞬态共存及谱权重转移。结果表明激子形成具有声子起源，并受谷简并度、大动量声子发射和自旋翻转过程控制。
authors: Enrico Perfetto, Takumi Fukuda, Xing Zhu, Jacques Hawecker, Harley Suchiang, Joanna Nadolna, Nanami Tomoda, Suji Park, Houk Jang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Michael K. L. Man, Julien Madéo, Keshav M. Dani, Gianluca Stefanucci
articles.abstract_zh_full: 凝聚态物理中充满了涉及高能自由粒子并合为低能束缚少粒子态的现象。尽管单个粒子的冷却已得到充分理解，但冷的自由载流子形成束缚态这一关键步骤仍然难以捉摸，其中涉及复杂的能量和动量弛豫路径。在这里，通过将单层 WSe2 的超快时间与动量分辨光电子能谱与第一性原理激子 Bloch 方程相结合，我们分辨出最初位于带边的自由电子和空穴转化为束缚激子的过程。凭借前所未有的能量分辨率，我们观察到自由载流子带和激子带的瞬态共存，并伴随两者之间的谱权重转移。我们确立了激子形成的声子起源，并将这种共存归因于朝最低能激子态进行的顺序弛豫级联过程，其中中间态只保持弱占据。该过程的效率受谷多重性、大动量声子发射以及自旋翻转过程控制。通过阐明束缚态如何从其基本组成单元中涌现，我们的结果指出了设计激子形成过程的策略，并对依赖激子或自由载流子运行的光学材料和器件具有直接意义。

articles.title: Drumhead Surface States of Rhombohedral Graphite with Near Ideal Quantum Geometry Condition
articles.title_zh: 菱方石墨中接近理想量子几何条件的鼓面表面态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ideal quantum geometry (IQG) condition of equal magnitude between quantum metric (G(k)) and Berry curvature (Ømega(k)) as in |Ømega|/TrG=1 has been associated with realizing fractional Chern insulators for the flat band in few layers of rhombohedral graphene (RG). More recently the IQG condition has also been proposed for superconductivity in the flat band for thick RG layers. Using density functional theory and Wannier functions, we study the symmetry-protected topology of bulk RG, drumhead surface state (DSS) of semi-infinite RG surface, and the IQG condition for thick RG slabs. We find that bulk RG is a weak topological insulator with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), besides being effectively a chiral semimetal with chiral nodal line without SOC. We also find that the DSS flat band of semi-infinite and thick RG slabs have a sizable convex curvature with depth agreeing with the recent angular resolved phono-emission spectroscopy experiment. The calculated IQG also shows a convex shape with the K point at the center having a minimum with approximately |Ømega|/TrGapprox1. But the inner rim of the DSS region shows the strict IQG condition of |Ømega|/TrG=1. These results on semi-infinite and thick RG slabs from first-principles calculations provide useful information for the pristine DSS at the single particle level for future studies to consider when many-body interactions and strong correlations will be included.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用密度泛函理论和 Wannier 函数研究菱方石墨的体拓扑、半无限表面的鼓面表面态以及厚层板中的理想量子几何条件。结果显示，考虑自旋—轨道耦合时体菱方石墨为弱拓扑绝缘体，不考虑时则可视作具有手性节点线的手性半金属。作者还发现鼓面平带具有明显凸曲率，并且其理想量子几何比值在 K 点附近接近 1、在鼓面区域内缘严格满足条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子度规 G(k) 与 Berry 曲率 Ω(k) 大小相等的理想量子几何（IQG）条件，即 |Ω|/TrG = 1，已被认为与在少层菱方石墨烯（RG）的平带中实现分数量子反常霍尔绝缘体相关。最近，IQG 条件也被提出可用于厚层 RG 中平带的超导性。利用密度泛函理论和 Wannier 函数，我们研究了体 RG 的对称性保护拓扑、半无限 RG 表面的鼓面表面态（DSS），以及厚 RG 薄板中的 IQG 条件。我们发现，在具有自旋—轨道耦合（SOC）时，体 RG 是弱拓扑绝缘体；而在无 SOC 时，它还可有效地视为具有手性节点线的手性半金属。我们还发现，半无限和厚 RG 薄板的 DSS 平带具有显著的凸曲率，其深度与近期角分辨光电子能谱实验相一致。计算得到的 IQG 也显示出凸形形状，中心的 K 点具有一个最小值，并且近似满足 |Ω|/TrG ≈ 1。但 DSS 区域的内缘显示出严格的 IQG 条件 |Ω|/TrG = 1。这些来自第一性原理计算的半无限和厚 RG 薄板结果，为今后在纳入多体相互作用和强关联时研究单粒子层面的本征 DSS 提供了有用信息。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作利用密度泛函理论和 Wannier 函数研究菱方石墨的体拓扑、半无限表面的鼓面表面态以及厚层薄片中的理想量子几何条件。结果表明，考虑自旋轨道耦合时体相为弱拓扑绝缘体，不考虑自旋轨道耦合时可视为具有手性节线的半金属，表面平带的量子几何在部分区域接近理想条件。
articles.focus_relation: 该论文与我们在拓扑量子材料、Wannier 建模、低维碳基体系和平带电子结构计算方面相关。其对量子几何、Berry 曲率和表面态的第一性原理分析可为平带超导或分数量子反常霍尔体系研究提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步关注其 Wannier 化与半无限表面格林函数方法，并比较不同堆垛、应变或外场对量子几何条件的调控。也可考虑将机器学习哈密顿量用于快速筛选类似平带拓扑材料。

articles.title: Lifting Lifted Product Codes
articles.title_zh: 提升提升积码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28621v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Lifted product (LP) codes form an important class of quantum error correcting codes with favorable code parameters. We introduce a systematic construction of LP code families based on group extensions and graph lifts. The construction increases the code size while preserving the local structure of the Tanner graph, and relates code parameters, logical operators, and fault-tolerant logical-operation gadgets within the families through chain and cochain maps. As a first application, we obtain LP codes with better code parameters than previously reported ones. We then demonstrate that code-surgery gadgets can be transferred across the selected finite lifts through chain maps and, in several cases, implemented with lower space overhead. We also develop parallel product surgery for lifted clustered cyclic codes. Finally, we propose lifting as a systematic first step toward defining thermodynamic families for algebraically defined qLDPC codes without an underlying Euclidean lattice. For several base codes and selected lifts, coherent information exhibits finite-size crossings, while our results also indicate that additional conditions are needed to determine a unique family.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种基于群扩张和图提升的提升积量子纠错码族系统构造方法，可在保持 Tanner 图局域结构的同时增大码规模。作者通过链映射和上链映射关联码族中的参数、逻辑算符和容错逻辑操作工具，并获得了参数优于既有报道的提升积码。该研究还展示了码手术工具在有限提升之间的迁移，并将“提升”作为为无欧几里得晶格的代数 qLDPC 码定义热力学族的系统起点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 提升积（LP）码构成了一类重要的量子纠错码，具有有利的码参数。我们引入一种基于群扩张和图提升的 LP 码族系统构造方法。该构造在保持 Tanner 图局域结构的同时增大码的尺寸，并通过链映射和上链映射关联这些码族中的码参数、逻辑算符以及容错逻辑操作工具。作为第一个应用，我们获得了比此前报道更优参数的 LP 码。随后我们证明，码手术工具可以通过链映射在所选有限提升之间转移，并且在若干情况下能够以更低的空间开销实现。我们还为提升的簇状循环码发展了并行积手术。最后，我们提出将提升作为一个系统性第一步，用于为没有底层欧几里得晶格的代数定义 qLDPC 码定义热力学族。对于若干基码和所选提升，相干信息显示出有限尺寸交叉；同时，我们的结果也表明，还需要额外条件来确定唯一的码族。

articles.title: Theory of phonon angular momentum transport across a smooth crystal interface
articles.title_zh: 声子角动量跨越平滑晶体界面的输运理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.08874v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically elucidate the transfer of phonon angular momentum by acoustic modes across a smooth interface between crystals. We analyze this process, which is difficult to describe with the conventional acoustic mismatch model, using a reformulated boundary condition and the Boltzmann theory. For an interface between a chiral and an achiral crystal, our analysis reveals that thermal gradients in the chiral crystal induce angular momentum, which diffuses into the achiral crystal even without heat flow. Notably, the density of angular momentum can be enhanced near the interface. These findings advance our understanding of phonon transport and its interplay with electron spins.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从理论上阐明了声学模式在平滑晶体界面上传递声子角动量的机制。作者使用重新表述的边界条件和 Boltzmann 理论，处理传统声学失配模型难以描述的问题。对于手性与非手性晶体界面，结果表明手性晶体中的温度梯度可诱导角动量，并即使在无热流时也扩散进入非手性晶体，且界面附近角动量密度可增强。
authors: Yuta Suzuki, Shuntaro Sumita, Yusuke Kato
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上阐明声学模式在晶体之间的平滑界面上传递声子角动量的过程。我们使用重新表述的边界条件和 Boltzmann 理论来分析这一过程，而该过程难以用传统声学失配模型描述。对于手性晶体与非手性晶体之间的界面，我们的分析表明，手性晶体中的热梯度会诱导角动量，并且即使没有热流，角动量也会扩散到非手性晶体中。值得注意的是，角动量密度可在界面附近得到增强。这些发现推进了我们对声子输运及其与电子自旋相互作用的理解。

articles.title: Directional Photocurrent Generated by Quantum Interference Control
articles.title_zh: 由量子干涉控制产生的定向光电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.05318v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Although the absorption of light in a bulk homogeneous semiconductor produces photocarriers with non-zero momentum, it generally does not produce a current in the absence of an applied electric field because equal amounts of carriers with opposite momentum are injected. The interference of absorption processes, for example, between one-photon and two-photon absorption, can produce a current because constructive interference for carriers with one momentum can correspond to destructive interference for carriers with the opposite momentum. We show that for the interference between two-photon and three-photon absorption, the current has a narrower angular spread, i.e., a ``beam'' of electrons in a specified direction is produced in the semiconductor.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作讨论了体均匀半导体中通过量子干涉控制产生定向光电流的机制。通常光吸收会注入具有非零动量的光生载流子，但相反动量载流子数量相等使净电流为零。作者指出，两光子与三光子吸收之间的干涉可产生角分布更窄的电流，即在半导体中形成指定方向的电子“束”。
authors: Yiming Gong, Kai Wang, Steven T. Cundiff
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管体均匀半导体中光的吸收会产生具有非零动量的光生载流子，但在没有外加电场时通常不会产生电流，因为具有相反动量的载流子被等量注入。吸收过程之间的干涉，例如单光子吸收与双光子吸收之间的干涉，可以产生电流，因为对于具有某一动量的载流子为相长干涉时，对于具有相反动量的载流子可能对应于相消干涉。我们表明，对于双光子吸收与三光子吸收之间的干涉，电流具有更窄的角分布，也就是说，在半导体中产生了沿指定方向传播的电子“束”。

articles.title: Light-induced trion-exciton competition revealed by ultrafast photoemission
articles.title_zh: 超快光电子能谱揭示光诱导三重子—激子竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.22523v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Strong Coulomb interactions in low-dimensional quantum materials give rise to emergent bound states such as excitons and trions. Trions are conventionally secondary excitations, requiring both optical excitation and charge doping. In quasi-one-dimensional Ta₂NiS₅, however, an exceptionally large binding energy exceeding the single-particle band gap stabilizes an equilibrium trion gas under surface doping alone. Here, using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we show that trions can also be generated purely optically, without external charge. Following photoexcitation of pristine Ta₂NiS₅ we observe a bright, momentum-localized, in-gap feature with a slow, fluence-dependent relaxation. Rate-equation modeling identifies it as a mixed population of trions and excitons, with the trions formed via an unconventional single-particle pathway that requires no photoexcited hole. The trion-exciton composition is controlled by pump fluence, with trions dominating the late-time relaxation. In surface doped samples, the same model with unchanged rates reproduces the full dynamics, linking the light-induced trions to their equilibrium counterparts through pump-induced dissociation and recapture. These results establish trARPES as a direct probe of charged quasiparticles far from equilibrium and open routes to optical control of neutral and charged excitations in correlated materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用时间与角分辨光电子能谱发现，准一维 Ta2NiS5 中三重子不仅可在表面掺杂下形成，也可由光学激发在无外部电荷时产生。光激发原始样品后，作者观察到明亮、动量局域的带隙内特征及缓慢且依赖通量的弛豫。速率方程模型表明该信号来自三重子和激子的混合群体，且三重子—激子比例可由泵浦通量控制。
authors: Ittai Sidilkover, Nir Hen Levin, Yuval Nitzav, Shiri Gvishi, Abigail Dishi, Shaked Rosenstein, Noam Ophir, Irena Feldman, Andrei Varykhalov, Naaman Amer, Amit Kanigel, Anna Keselman, Iliya Esin, Hadas Soifer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低维量子材料中的强 Coulomb 相互作用会产生诸如激子和三重子等涌现束缚态。传统上，三重子是次级激发，需要光学激发和电荷掺杂同时存在。然而，在准一维 Ta2NiS5 中，超过单粒子带隙的异常大束缚能仅在表面掺杂下就能稳定平衡三重子气体。在这里，利用时间与角分辨光电子能谱，我们表明三重子也可以纯粹通过光学方式产生，而无需外部电荷。在对原始 Ta2NiS5 进行光激发之后，我们观察到一个明亮的、动量局域的带隙内特征，并具有缓慢且依赖通量的弛豫。速率方程建模将其识别为三重子和激子的混合群体，其中三重子通过一种非常规单粒子路径形成，该路径不需要光激发空穴。三重子—激子组成受泵浦通量控制，其中三重子主导后期弛豫。在表面掺杂样品中，使用相同模型且不改变速率即可再现完整动力学，从而通过泵浦诱导的解离和再俘获将光诱导三重子与其平衡态对应物联系起来。这些结果确立了 trARPES 作为远离平衡的带电准粒子的直接探针，并为在关联材料中对中性和带电激发进行光学控制开辟了途径。

articles.title: Hybrid light-matter excitations and spontaneous time-reversal symmetry breaking in two-dimensional Josephson Junctions
articles.title_zh: 二维 Josephson 结中的杂化光—物质激发与自发时间反演对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.07256v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the context of hybrid superconductor-semiconductor systems, Josephson junctions based on two-dimensional materials, such as graphene, offer promising opportunities because of their scalability and gate-tunable electronic properties. In this work, we investigate the inductive coupling between a quantum LC resonator and a superconducting loop embedding a short, ballistic, planar Josephson junction, with the graphene-based case as a representative example. Within a mean-field formalism, we analyze how the properties of the global system depend on the light-matter interaction coupling, the Fermi level of the two-dimensional material, and temperature. Our findings reveal that the current-phase relation can show features indicative of spontaneous time-reversal symmetry breaking. Furthermore, starting from the mean-field theory, we determine the low-energy spectrum of collective hybridized light-matter excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察量子 LC 谐振器与包含短弹道平面 Josephson 结的超导环之间的感性耦合，并以石墨烯基结作为代表。作者在平均场形式下分析了光—物质相互作用强度、二维材料费米能级和温度对整体系统性质的影响。结果显示电流—相位关系可能出现自发时间反演对称性破缺的特征，并进一步给出了低能杂化光—物质集体激发谱。
authors: V. Varrica, G. Falci, E. Paladino, F. M. D. Pellegrino
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在混合超导体—半导体系统的背景下，基于石墨烯等二维材料的 Josephson 结因其可扩展性和可由栅压调控的电子性质而提供了有前景的机会。在本工作中，我们研究量子 LC 谐振器与一个嵌入短的、弹道的、平面 Josephson 结的超导环之间的感性耦合，并以基于石墨烯的情形作为代表性例子。在平均场形式下，我们分析全局系统的性质如何依赖于光—物质相互作用耦合、二维材料的费米能级以及温度。我们的发现表明，电流—相位关系可以显示出指示自发时间反演对称性破缺的特征。此外，从平均场理论出发，我们确定了集体杂化光—物质激发的低能谱。

articles.title: Statistical properties of quantum jumps between macroscopic states of light: reading an operational coherence record
articles.title_zh: 光的宏观态之间量子跃迁的统计性质：读取一种操作性相干记录
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.07754v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose an experimental apparatus to reveal the quantum coherence manifested in downward quantum jumps of amplitude bistability. The underlying coherent superposition of macroscopic quantum states is translated into the statistical properties of the integrated charge deposited in the detector circuit of a mode-matched heterodyne/homodyne detection scheme. At first, the dynamical evolution of a signal transmitted from an auxiliary cavity is employed to pinpoint a macroscopic switching event in a bistable main cavity subject to direct photodetection. Once the decision is made on the occurrence of a downward switch, the main cavity mode is let to freely decay to the vacuum, monitored to the production of an integrated charge. In the long-time limit, the charge distribution over an identical collection of pure states generated during the jumps converges to the Q function (heterodyne detection) or marginals of the Wigner function (homodyne detection) dictated by the phase of the local oscillator. When fluctuations over the ensemble step in, we connect the statistical properties of several switching events and the ensuing production of current records, to the cavity field correlations associated with the breakdown of photon blockade.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种实验装置，用于揭示振幅双稳态向下量子跃迁中体现的量子相干性。宏观量子态的相干叠加被映射到模式匹配外差/同相检测方案中探测器电路所沉积积分电荷的统计性质。作者进一步将多次开关事件和电流记录的统计特征与光子阻塞崩塌相关的腔场关联联系起来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2512.07754v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们提出一种实验装置，用以揭示振幅双稳态的向下量子跃迁中所表现出的量子相干性。其背后的宏观量子态相干叠加被转化为在模式匹配的外差/同相检测方案中探测器电路所沉积积分电荷的统计性质。首先，利用从辅助腔传输出的信号的动力学演化，来精确定位一个受到直接光探测的双稳态主腔中的宏观开关事件。一旦判定发生了向下开关，主腔模便被允许自由衰减至真空，并在此过程中受到监测以产生积分电荷。在长时间极限下，对跃迁过程中生成的一组相同纯态而言，电荷分布收敛到 Q 函数（外差检测）或由本振相位决定的 Wigner 函数边缘分布（同相检测）。当系综涨落介入时，我们把若干开关事件及随后产生的电流记录的统计性质，与光子阻塞崩塌相关的腔场关联联系起来。

articles.title: Efficient Trotter-Suzuki Schemes for Long-time Quantum Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于长时间量子动力学的高效 Trotter-Suzuki 格式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.18756v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Accurately simulating long-time dynamics of many-body systems is a challenge in both classical and quantum computing due to the accumulation of Trotter errors. While low-order Trotter-Suzuki decompositions are straightforward to implement, their rapidly growing error limits access to long-time observables. We present a framework for constructing efficient high-order Trotter-Suzuki schemes by identifying their structure and directly optimizing their parameters over a high-dimensional space. This method enables the discovery of new schemes with significantly improved efficiency compared to traditional constructions, such as those by Suzuki and Yoshida. Based on the theoretical efficiency and practical performance, we recommend two novel highly efficient schemes at 4th and 6th order. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of these decompositions on the Heisenberg model and the quantum harmonic oscillator, and find that for a fixed final time they perform better across the computational cost. Even when using large time steps, they surpass established low-order schemes like the Leapfrog. Finally, we investigate the in-practice performance of different Trotter schemes and find the decompositions with more uniform coefficients tend to feature improved error accumulation over long times. We have included this observation into our choice of recommended schemes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对多体系统长时间动力学模拟中 Trotter 误差累积的问题，提出一种构造高阶 Trotter-Suzuki 分解的优化框架。该方法通过识别分解结构并在高维参数空间中直接优化，发现了效率显著优于传统构造的新格式。作者推荐了两个新的四阶和六阶高效方案，并在海森堡模型与量子谐振子上验证其长时间误差表现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2601.18756v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：由于 Trotter 误差的累积，精确模拟多体系统的长时间动力学在经典计算和量子计算中都是一项挑战。虽然低阶 Trotter-Suzuki 分解易于实现，但其快速增长的误差限制了对长时间可观测量的获取。我们提出一个用于构造高效高阶 Trotter-Suzuki 格式的框架，该框架通过识别其结构并在高维空间中直接优化其参数来实现。这一方法能够发现与 Suzuki 和 Yoshida 等传统构造相比效率显著提高的新格式。基于理论效率和实际性能，我们推荐两个新的高效格式，阶数分别为四阶和六阶。我们还在海森堡模型和量子谐振子上展示了这些分解的有效性，并发现对于固定的最终时间，它们在整个计算成本范围内表现更好。即使使用较大的时间步长，它们也优于 Leapfrog 等已有低阶格式。最后，我们考察了不同 Trotter 格式在实践中的性能，并发现系数更均匀的分解往往在长时间下具有更好的误差累积特性。我们已将这一观察纳入所推荐格式的选择之中。

articles.title: Can AI Follow In Einstein's Footsteps?
articles.title_zh: 人工智能能追随爱因斯坦的脚步吗？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27794v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI is accelerating physics discovery, but perhaps away from Einstein-level theory building. To understand this gap, we must recognize a striking trend: while being very successful, the most visible AI contributions to physics discovery appear to mirror the historical development of physics, but in reverse. Human discovery in physics progressed, in broad strokes, from ancient pattern prediction, through phenomenological laws such as Kepler's, to principle-based universal theories such as relativity and the Standard Model. On the AI side, prominent contributions to physics discovery point in the opposite direction: early milestones emphasized explicit equation-discovery methods, such as symbolic regression, whereas more recent frontier contributions are powerful predictors such as AlphaFold and GraphCast, which can be remarkably accurate yet do not provide clear theoretical understanding. If this trend continues, AI would become extraordinarily good at prediction but may struggle to ever propose its first serious contender to quantum gravity or other paradigm-level theories. We review the current landscape of AI for physics discovery and highlight a critical missing skill: the ability to pose the right questions or invent the right principles to guide the development of new theories and the tests to falsify them. This mode of discovery has driven many of the deepest advances since the 17th century, where symmetry, simplicity, and new mathematical frameworks guided theory construction before experimental tests. Equipping AI systems with such skills could move them from predicting within known frameworks to proposing the next paradigm-level discovery in physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论人工智能在物理发现中日益增强的作用，并指出其可能更擅长预测而非爱因斯坦式的理论构建。作者认为，AI 在物理中的显著贡献似乎沿着与人类物理学史相反的方向发展：从方程发现转向强预测模型。文章强调，AI 目前缺少提出正确问题、发明指导性原则并设计可证伪检验的能力，而这正是范式级理论突破所需的关键。
authors: Michael Shalyt, Nathan Regev, Marin Soljačić, Ido Kaminer
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27794v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：人工智能正在加速物理发现，但也许正在偏离爱因斯坦级别的理论构建。要理解这一差距，我们必须认识到一个引人注目的趋势：尽管非常成功，但人工智能对物理发现最显著的贡献似乎是在反向映照物理学的历史发展。粗略地说，人类在物理学中的发现从古代的模式预测，经过开普勒定律等唯象规律，发展到相对论和标准模型等基于原理的普适理论。在人工智能方面，物理发现中的突出贡献则指向相反方向：早期里程碑强调显式方程发现方法，如符号回归，而较新的前沿贡献则是 AlphaFold 和 GraphCast 等强大预测器，它们可以非常准确，却不能提供清晰的理论理解。如果这一趋势持续下去，人工智能将会在预测方面变得极其出色，但可能难以提出其第一个严肃的量子引力或其他范式级理论竞争者。我们回顾了人工智能用于物理发现的当前图景，并强调一项关键缺失技能：提出正确问题或发明正确原则的能力，以指导新理论的发展以及用于证伪这些理论的检验。自 17 世纪以来，这种发现模式推动了许多最深刻的进展，在其中，对称性、简洁性和新的数学框架在实验检验之前引导了理论构建。赋予人工智能系统此类技能，可能使其从在已知框架内进行预测，转向提出物理学中的下一个范式级发现。

articles.title: Brewster-anomaly delocalization for free-electron radiation
articles.title_zh: 自由电子辐射中的布儒斯特异常退局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Localization effects are central to disordered electronics and photonics. In electronics, Anderson localization governs electron confinement in randomly perturbed lattices. Similarly, its photonic counterpart inhibits light transport via disorder -- but with a unique exception: Brewster-anomaly delocalization, where the Brewster effect prevents multiple-scattering interference and counteracts the localization. Despite extensive research in electronics and photonics separately, the intricate role of localization effects in free-electron--light interactions -- vital for lasers, accelerators, microscopy and spectroscopy, and quantum information -- remains largely unexplored. At the same time, localization effects are widely regarded as a key factor limiting the efficient coupling between free electrons and light in random media. Here we overcome this key limitation via the unconventional interplay between Brewster-anomaly delocalization and free-electron radiation. In this way, free-electron radiation can be localization-free, intense and directional even in strongly disordered, unengineered multilayers. Essentially, this delocalization-mediated free-electron radiation is remarkably invariant not only to the random-medium configuration, but also to the light frequency and the electron velocity. Our findings unlock new opportunities for particle detectors and achromatic light sources operating in easy-to-fabricate complex media at previously inaccessible frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究自由电子与光相互作用中的局域化问题，并提出利用布儒斯特异常退局域化克服随机介质中自由电子-光耦合受限的机制。作者指出，在强无序、未经工程设计的多层结构中，自由电子辐射也可保持无局域化、强烈且定向。该机制对随机介质构型、光频率和电子速度表现出显著不变性，有望用于粒子探测器和消色差光源。
authors: Zheng Gong, Xiangfeng Xi, Hongsheng Chen, Owen D. Miller, Stefan Rotter, Xiao Lin
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27894v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：局域化效应是无序电子学和光子学中的核心问题。在电子学中，Anderson 局域化支配着随机扰动晶格中的电子束缚。类似地，其光子学对应物通过无序抑制光输运——但有一个独特例外：布儒斯特异常退局域化，其中布儒斯特效应阻止多重散射干涉并抵消局域化。尽管电子学和光子学分别已有大量研究，局域化效应在自由电子—光相互作用中的复杂作用仍在很大程度上未被探索，而这种相互作用对激光器、加速器、显微与光谱技术以及量子信息至关重要。与此同时，局域化效应被广泛认为是限制随机介质中自由电子与光高效耦合的关键因素。在这里，我们通过布儒斯特异常退局域化与自由电子辐射之间的非常规相互作用克服这一关键限制。通过这种方式，即使在强无序、未经工程设计的多层结构中，自由电子辐射也可以是无局域化的、强烈的且具有方向性。本质上，这种由退局域化介导的自由电子辐射不仅对随机介质构型，而且对光频率和电子速度都表现出显著的不变性。我们的发现为在易于制备的复杂介质中、在此前难以达到的频率下运行的粒子探测器和消色差光源开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: Nonclassical condensation pathways revealed by the multivariable theory of nucleation
articles.title_zh: 由成核多变量理论揭示的非经典凝结路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27997v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend classical nucleation theory (CNT) by explicitly incorporating the multidimensional nature of nucleation and the coupled roles of kinetics and thermodynamics. Specifically, we treat the cluster density as an independent variable, within both sharp-interface and diffuse-interface descriptions. The kinetics are governed by dynamical density functional theory. Applied to liquid condensation in the Lennard-Jones system, our two-variable (size--density) and three-variable (size--interface width--density) models reveal nonclassical nucleation mechanism. At low supersaturation, both models recover the classical picture, in which clusters nucleate and grow at the equilibrium liquid density. As supersaturation increases, a nonclassical behavior emerges: the critical cluster density decreases, and the nucleation pathway involves concomitant evolution in cluster size, density, and, within the diffuse-interface description, interfacial width. Our model with diffuse interface reveals a rapid increase in interfacial diffuseness at high supersaturation. Near the spinodal limit, both models predict the critical cluster with diverging sizes, densities approaching that of the metastable initial phase, and vanishing work of formation, which provides a smooth connection between nucleation and spinodal decomposition. Comparison with molecular dynamics simulations demonstrates that both models substantially outperform CNT. However, the weak non-monotonic dependence of the critical cluster density observed at very low supersaturation is captured only by diffuse-interface models. Overall, our findings indicate that CNT should be applied only in the low-supersaturation regime, and our work provides a robust foundation for its refinement beyond this limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过显式纳入成核的多维性质以及动力学与热力学的耦合作用，扩展了经典成核理论。作者将团簇密度作为独立变量，并在 Lennard-Jones 体系的液体凝结中建立二变量和三变量模型，揭示了随过饱和度升高出现的非经典成核机制。与分子动力学模拟比较表明，这些模型明显优于经典成核理论，并为其适用范围之外的修正提供基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27997v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们通过显式纳入成核的多维性质以及动力学和热力学的耦合作用，扩展经典成核理论（CNT）。具体而言，我们在尖锐界面和弥散界面两种描述中，都将团簇密度作为一个独立变量来处理。动力学由动力学密度泛函理论支配。应用于 Lennard-Jones 体系中的液体凝结时，我们的二变量（尺寸—密度）和三变量（尺寸—界面宽度—密度）模型揭示了非经典成核机制。在低过饱和度下，两个模型都恢复经典图像，即团簇以平衡液体密度成核并生长。随着过饱和度增加，非经典行为出现：临界团簇密度降低，成核路径涉及团簇尺寸、密度以及在弥散界面描述中界面宽度的协同演化。我们的弥散界面模型揭示，在高过饱和度下界面弥散性迅速增加。在接近旋节线极限时，两个模型都预测临界团簇具有发散的尺寸、接近亚稳初始相的密度以及趋于消失的形成功，这为成核和旋节分解之间提供了平滑连接。与分子动力学模拟的比较表明，两个模型都显著优于 CNT。然而，在极低过饱和度下观察到的临界团簇密度的弱非单调依赖性，只有弥散界面模型能够捕捉。总体而言，我们的发现表明 CNT 只应在低过饱和度区域使用，而我们的工作为在这一限制之外对其进行改进提供了坚实基础。

articles.title: Quantum Computing Enabled ab initio Molecular Dynamics Simulations
articles.title_zh: 量子计算赋能的从头算分子动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate a quantum-classical workflow for ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) in which quantum measurements from a chemistry-inspired LUCJ ansatz are post-processed using Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) to recover determinant subspaces and deliver energies and analytical nuclear gradients for dynamics. As an exact benchmark, we use full configuration interaction (FCI) in the STO-3G basis, enabling a direct assessment of the accuracy of SQD. In gas-phase benchmarks, SQD reproduces FCI energies and gradients to within 1 kcal mol⁻¹ of the FCI reference and yields stable AIMD trajectories. In explicit-solvent QM/MM simulations, SQD retains this agreement, matching FCI energy fluctuations and RMS gradient profiles and reproducing solute-solvent structure as quantified by radial distribution functions. Overall, these benchmarks establish LUCJ+SQD as a practical route for integrating current quantum hardware into QM/MM molecular dynamics and provide an early demonstration of condensed-phase QM/MM dynamics driven by a quantum electronic-structure engine.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种用于从头算分子动力学的量子-经典工作流，结合化学启发的 LUCJ 拟设、量子测量后处理和基于样本的量子对角化。作者以 STO-3G 基组下的全组态相互作用作为精确基准，评估 SQD 在能量、解析核梯度和动力学轨迹中的准确性。气相与显式溶剂 QM/MM 测试表明，LUCJ+SQD 可作为将当前量子硬件整合进分子动力学的可行路线。
authors: Susanta Das, Subhamoy Bhowmik, Zhen Li, Milana Bazayeva, Danil Kaliakin, Akhil Shajan, Kenneth M. Merz Jr
articles.focus_summary: 该文提出一种量子-经典混合的从头算分子动力学流程，利用 LUCJ 量子线路和样本量子对角化获得能量与解析核梯度。其在气相和显式溶剂 QM/MM 基准中与 FCI 结果接近，并能产生稳定动力学轨迹。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们工作的凝聚态材料模拟关联较弱，主要是量子计算电子结构方法探索；但其 AIMD 和能量/力计算框架与第一性原理分子动力学在方法层面有间接联系。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可作为前沿方法储备阅读，关注其梯度精度、体系规模和基组限制；短期内更适合作为量子计算辅助材料模拟的概念验证，而非直接用于复杂功能材料。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.28548v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们展示了一种用于从头算分子动力学（AIMD）的量子-经典工作流，其中来自受化学启发的 LUCJ 拟设的量子测量结果通过基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）进行后处理，以恢复行列式子空间，并为动力学提供能量和解析核梯度。作为精确基准，我们使用 STO-3G 基组中的全组态相互作用（FCI），从而能够直接评估 SQD 的准确性。在气相基准测试中，SQD 重现 FCI 能量和梯度，与 FCI 参考值的偏差在 1 kcal mol⁻¹ 以内，并产生稳定的 AIMD 轨迹。在显式溶剂 QM/MM 模拟中，SQD 保持了这种一致性，匹配 FCI 能量涨落和 RMS 梯度剖面，并再现了由径向分布函数量化的溶质-溶剂结构。总体而言，这些基准确立了 LUCJ+SQD 作为将当前量子硬件整合进 QM/MM 分子动力学的一条实用途径，并提供了由量子电子结构引擎驱动的凝聚相 QM/MM 动力学的早期演示。

articles.title: Robust Wavelength Selection for Partial Least Squares Sugar Content Estimation Using Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization
articles.title_zh: 使用组合贝叶斯优化实现偏最小二乘糖含量估计的稳健波长选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27645v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wavelength selection is one of the important preprocessing methods in near-infrared spectroscopy to improve prediction accuracy and interpretability of spectral data. We formulate wavelength-region selection for sugar content estimation as a binary black-box optimization problem and propose a method based on Bayesian optimization. The proposed method constructs a sparse quadratic surrogate model and sequentially extracts interested wavelength regions by Thompson sampling. Minimizing an acquisition function is performed as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem by simulated or quantum annealing. Experiments show that the proposed method improves the prediction accuracy of partial least squares regression and yields more consistent wavelength regions than genetic-algorithm-based selection and simulated annealing. Under one-bit local perturbations, the selected wavelength regions show minimal fluctuations in root mean square errors between observed and predicted values of a validation set. This local stability suggests that our method converges to a smoother error landscape and avoids isolated overfitted solutions. These results indicate that combinatorial Bayesian optimization is a useful framework for robust feature selection in spectroscopic prediction tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将近红外光谱中用于糖含量估计的波长区域选择表述为二元黑箱优化问题，并提出基于贝叶斯优化的方法。该方法构造稀疏二次替代模型，通过 Thompson 采样顺序提取感兴趣波长区域，并用模拟退火或量子退火求解二次无约束二元优化。实验显示，该方法提高了偏最小二乘回归的预测精度，并得到比遗传算法和模拟退火更一致、更稳健的波长区域。
authors: Mitsunobu Kanebako, Ami S. Koshikawa, Masaru Hitomi, Takuro Tanaka, Mahito Chiba, Maiko Mori, Masayuki Ohzeki
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27645v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：波长选择是近红外光谱中用于提高光谱数据预测精度和可解释性的重要预处理方法之一。我们将用于糖含量估计的波长区域选择表述为一个二元黑箱优化问题，并提出一种基于贝叶斯优化的方法。所提出的方法构造一个稀疏二次替代模型，并通过 Thompson 采样顺序提取感兴趣的波长区域。采集函数的最小化作为一个二次无约束二元优化问题，通过模拟退火或量子退火来执行。实验表明，所提出的方法提高了偏最小二乘回归的预测精度，并产生了比基于遗传算法的选择和模拟退火更一致的波长区域。在一比特局部扰动下，所选波长区域在验证集观测值与预测值之间的均方根误差方面表现出最小波动。这种局部稳定性表明，我们的方法收敛到更平滑的误差景观，并避免了孤立的过拟合解。这些结果表明，组合贝叶斯优化是光谱预测任务中稳健特征选择的有用框架。

articles.title: Safety-Gated Agentic Supervisory Control on a Coupled Distillation Benchmark: Regime Map, Auditable Gate, and Co-Design Findings
articles.title_zh: 耦合精馏基准上的安全门控智能体监督控制：工况图、可审计门控与协同设计发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27849v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An open-weight LLM can write composition setpoints every five minutes. What a plant still needs is a hard check: named constraints, logged margins, and an admit/block decision before the regulatory layer moves. This paper puts that check in a rule-based forked-twin counterfactual gate (nine pinned constraints) and leaves the regulatory layer unchanged. On Skogestad's Column A the ladder is PID-only (C0), linear MPC (C1), ungated agent (C2), and gated agent (C3) under one contract: identical level closure (M_D, M_B), scenarios, and seeds; C2/C3 share the linear-MPC backend. The split is not subtle. Off-nominal target acquisition: the agent beats Pareto-tuned linear MPC in the strong band (C2/C1 IAE ratio 0.361 at the upper CI). Disturbance rejection on the same 16-point grid inverts by 16.03 at the upper CI (10.18 at the point estimate), where an ungated LLM supervisor does not belong. The gate compresses a specification-abandonment attractor into a bounded offset (d approx. -1.4; P95 cell IAE 11.5 to 0.77). A one-line prompt fix removes the attractor at source (6/10 to 0/10; sensitivity only, not a new headline). In a 250-cell statistical pass, 534 of 590 gate interventions are spec-on-bound geometry: the operating specification sits on a safety limit, so a well-behaved OP becomes inoperable while misbehaving ones are only contained; 318 blocks still correct actively harmful proposals. Headlines are single-column and model-conditional on DeepSeek-V4-Flash. A second-family sweep (NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super) keeps the disturbance-rejection fails band and plant-side failure geography; magnitudes and protocol operability stay model-conditional, and Super target-acquisition strong cells are survivors only (not confirmation). Transfer means twin, constraint envelope, and setpoint interface, not a second plant class measured here.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究开放权重大语言模型作为精馏过程监督控制器时，如何通过规则化的分叉孪生反事实安全门控进行硬约束检查。作者在 Skogestad Column A 基准上比较 PID、线性 MPC、无门控智能体和门控智能体，发现无门控智能体在扰动抑制中存在显著失效，而门控可将危险或放弃规格的行为限制在有界范围内。结果强调，此类迁移依赖孪生模型、约束包络和设定值接口，而非已证明跨工厂类别泛化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27849v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：一个开放权重 LLM 可以每五分钟写入一次组成设定值。工厂仍然需要的是一种硬检查：命名约束、记录裕度，以及在调节层动作之前给出准入/阻断决策。本文将这一检查置于一个基于规则的分叉孪生反事实门控中（九个固定约束），并保持调节层不变。在 Skogestad 的 Column A 上，阶梯为仅 PID（C0）、线性 MPC（C1）、无门控智能体（C2）和门控智能体（C3），并遵循同一契约：相同的液位闭合（M_D、M_B）、场景和随机种子；C2/C3 共享线性 MPC 后端。差异并不细微。非标称目标获取：智能体在强区间中优于 Pareto 调优的线性 MPC（C2/C1 IAE 比值在置信区间上界为 0.361）。同一 16 点网格上的扰动抑制则在置信区间上界反转为 16.03（点估计为 10.18），在这种情况下，无门控 LLM 监督器并不适用。门控将一个规格放弃吸引子压缩为有界偏移（d 约为 -1.4；P95 单元 IAE 从 11.5 降至 0.77）。一行提示修正从源头移除了该吸引子（6/10 到 0/10；仅为敏感性分析，不是新的主要结论）。在 250 个单元的统计遍历中，590 次门控干预中有 534 次属于规格处于边界的几何情形：运行规格位于安全限值上，因此表现良好的操作点变得不可运行，而表现不良的操作点只是被限制；仍有 318 次阻断修正了主动有害的提案。主要结论是单塔的，并且以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 为模型条件。第二模型族扫描（NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super）保留了扰动抑制失败区间和工厂侧失败地理分布；幅度和协议可运行性仍为模型条件，而 Super 的目标获取强单元只是幸存者（并非确认）。迁移意味着孪生模型、约束包络和设定值接口，而不是在这里测量了第二类工厂。

articles.title: Entropy-Smooth Convex Optimization Cannot Be Accelerated
articles.title_zh: 熵平滑凸优化无法被加速
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27476v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove an Ømega(L/T) lower bound for the convergence rate of minimization in the class of functions that are convex and L-smooth relative to negative entropy on the standard d-simplex, valid for every first-order method when d = Ømega(T²⁾. In particular, this shows that mirror descent is optimal up to a logarithmic factor in this class. This may be surprising due to the fact that accelerated methods are readily available under the assumption of smoothness in ell₁₋ₙₒᵣₘ. While Dragomir et al. (Mathematical Programming, 2022) have already showed that acceleration might be impossible under relative smoothness, their prox-function is pathological and constructed together with the hard instance. In contrast, we show non-acceleration for a specific prox-function with particularly favorable structure. We also extend the result to the quantum setting, proving the same lower bound in the class of functions L-smooth relative to negative von Neumann entropy on the spectrahedron of d × d Hermitian positive-semidefinite matrices with unit trace.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在标准 d-单纯形上相对于负熵 L-平滑的凸函数类中，任意一阶方法的最小化收敛速率存在 Ω(L/T) 下界。该结果表明，镜像下降在该函数类中至多差一个对数因子即为最优，并说明即便相对平滑的近端函数具有良好结构也可能无法加速。作者还将该结论扩展到量子情形，即相对于负 von Neumann 熵平滑的谱面体函数类。
authors: Jacob M. Aguirre, Dmitrii M. Ostrovskii
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27476v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们证明，对于在标准 d-单纯形上相对于负熵为凸且 L-平滑的函数类中的最小化问题，当 d = Ω(T²) 时，对每一种一阶方法都成立 Ω(L/T) 的收敛速率下界。特别地，这表明镜像下降在该类中除一个对数因子外是最优的。鉴于在 ℓ₁ 范数平滑假设下加速方法很容易获得，这一点可能令人惊讶。虽然 Dragomir 等人（Mathematical Programming, 2022）已经表明在相对平滑下加速可能是不可能的，但他们的近端函数是病态的，并且是与困难实例一起构造的。相比之下，我们针对一个具有特别有利结构的特定近端函数证明了不可加速性。我们还将该结果扩展到量子情形，证明了在 d × d Hermitian 半正定矩阵且迹为一的谱面体上，相对于负 von Neumann 熵为 L-平滑的函数类中同样的下界。

articles.title: Strain turns non-chiral crystals left- or right-handed on demand
articles.title_zh: 应变可按需将非手性晶体转化为左手或右手构型
articles.abstract: Mechanical strain is one of the most common tools used to tailor the properties of materials. In piezoelectric materials, stretching or compressing a crystal generates an electrical polarization. In piezomagnetic materials, it induces magnetization. Researchers at the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) and the University of Oxford have now discovered that mechanical strain also induces chirality in non-chiral crystals, opening a new direction to control this property on demand and potentially imprint chiral electronic properties. This work has just been published in Nature.
articles.abstract_zh: 机械应变是调控材料性质的常用手段，通常可在压电材料中诱导电极化、在压磁材料中诱导磁化。本文报道，研究人员发现机械应变还能在非手性晶体中诱导手性，使材料可按需呈现左手或右手构型。该发现为可控引入手性及潜在印记手性电子性质提供了新途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机械应变是用于调控材料性质的最常见工具之一。在压电材料中，拉伸或压缩晶体会产生电极化。在压磁材料中，它会诱导磁化。马克斯·普朗克物质结构与动力学研究所（MPSD）和牛津大学的研究人员现已发现，机械应变也会在非手性晶体中诱导手性，从而开辟了一条按需控制这一性质并可能写入手性电子性质的新方向。这项工作刚刚发表于《Nature》。

articles.title: Tamarind seed polysaccharide attenuates oxidative stress in corneal epithelial cells exposed to UV and blue light
articles.title_zh: 罗望子种子多糖可减轻暴露于紫外和蓝光下角膜上皮细胞的氧化应激
articles.abstract: The ocular surface is constantly exposed to environmental radiation. While the damaging effects of ultraviolet (UV) radiation are well established, increasing exposure to artificial blue light has raised concerns regarding photo-induced oxidative stress at the corneal level. Preventive strategies to protect corneal epithelial cells from light-induced damage are therefore of growing interest. The protective effects of a tamarind seed polysaccharide (TSP)-based ophthalmic formulation were evaluated in rabbit corneal epithelial (RCE) cells exposed to blue light (405 nm) or UV radiation (365 nm). Cell viability, intracellular and mitochondrial oxidative stress, and cell morphology were assessed using complementary biochemical and high-content imaging approaches. Blue-light exposure moderately increased oxidative stress without affecting cell viability, whereas UV irradiation induced significant cytotoxicity and ROS accumulation. TSP pre-treatment significantly reduced cytosolic and mitochondrial ROS in a dose-dependent manner under both irradiation conditions and completely prevented UV-induced loss of viability. The fluorescence image analysis confirmed increased mitochondrial superoxide after irradiation, which was significantly attenuated by TSP, with a significant irradiation–treatment interaction. High-content imaging demonstrated preservation of mitochondrial organization and epithelial morphology in TSP-treated cells while no intrinsic cytotoxic or pro-oxidant effects were observed in non-irradiated samples. TSP exerts cytoprotective effects by attenuating oxidative stress and preserving mitochondrial integrity in corneal epithelial cells exposed to blue and UV light. These results support its potential use for protecting the ocular surface against environmental and digital light exposure.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究评估了基于罗望子种子多糖（TSP）的眼科制剂对兔角膜上皮细胞在蓝光或紫外辐照下的保护作用。结果显示，蓝光主要引起轻度氧化应激而不明显影响细胞活力，紫外照射则导致显著细胞毒性和活性氧积累。TSP预处理可剂量依赖性降低胞质和线粒体ROS，并在紫外条件下完全阻止细胞活力下降，提示其具有潜在的光防护作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 眼表持续暴露于环境辐射之中。尽管紫外（UV）辐射的损伤作用已得到充分确认，但人们对人工蓝光暴露增加在角膜层面引发光诱导氧化应激的担忧也日益上升。因此，用于保护角膜上皮细胞免受光诱导损伤的预防策略正受到越来越多关注。本研究在暴露于蓝光（405 nm）或紫外辐射（365 nm）的兔角膜上皮（RCE）细胞中，评估了一种基于罗望子种子多糖（TSP）的眼科制剂的保护作用。研究采用互补的生化方法和高内涵成像方法评估细胞活力、细胞内和线粒体氧化应激以及细胞形态。蓝光暴露在不影响细胞活力的情况下适度增加了氧化应激，而紫外照射则诱导了显著的细胞毒性和ROS积累。在两种照射条件下，TSP预处理均以剂量依赖性方式显著降低胞质和线粒体ROS，并完全防止了紫外线诱导的活力丧失。荧光图像分析证实，照射后线粒体超氧化物增加，而TSP显著减弱了这一增加，并且存在显著的照射—处理相互作用。高内涵成像显示，在TSP处理的细胞中，线粒体组织结构和上皮形态得到保留，而在未照射样品中未观察到其固有细胞毒性或促氧化作用。TSP通过减轻氧化应激并保持线粒体完整性，在暴露于蓝光和紫外光的角膜上皮细胞中发挥细胞保护作用。这些结果支持其用于保护眼表免受环境光和数字光暴露影响的潜在用途。

articles.title: Numerical Optimization Strategies for the Variational Hamiltonian Ansatz in Noisy Quantum Environments
articles.title_zh: 噪声量子环境下变分哈密顿量 Ansatz 的数值优化策略
articles.abstract: Variational quantum eigensolvers are considered promising approaches for quantum chemistry on near-term quantum hardware, yet their performance is strongly affected by sampling noise. Despite the widespread use of classical optimizers, their robustness under realistic finite-shot sampling conditions remains insufficiently understood.The optimization of the truncated Variational Hamiltonian Ansatz for H2, H4, and LiH is investigated using eight classical optimization algorithms. A total of 1,280 independent optimization runs are performed under both exact statevector and finite-shot sampling conditions.Finite-shot sampling is found to reshape optimization dynamics and reverse optimizer rankings observed in noiseless simulations. While gradient-based methods achieve near-machine precision in exact simulations, their performance deteriorates substantially under sampling noise. In contrast, population-based approaches, particularly the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy, remain robust, achieving corrected errors below 5 x 10-4 Ha for H2 and below 10-2 Ha for LiH.Finite-shot sampling is further shown to frequently produce apparent violations of the variational principle. By reevaluating candidate solutions using 105 measurements, sampling-induced fluctuations are exploited to obtain energy estimates beyond the intrinsic sampling limit.These results provide practical guidelines for optimizer selection and highlight the importance of high-shot reevaluation in noisy variational quantum chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在有限采样噪声下，截断变分哈密顿量 Ansatz 用于 H2、H4 和 LiH 时的优化表现，并比较了8种经典优化算法，共进行了1,280次独立运行。结果表明，有限采样会显著改变优化动力学，甚至颠覆无噪声情形下的优化器排序：梯度型方法在精确模拟中接近机器精度，但在采样噪声下性能明显下降。相比之下，群体式方法，尤其是协方差矩阵自适应进化策略，表现出更强鲁棒性，并且有限采样还会频繁造成表观上的变分原理违背。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 变分量子本征求解器被认为是在近期量子硬件上开展量子化学研究的有前景方法，但其性能受到采样噪声的强烈影响。尽管经典优化器被广泛使用，但在现实的有限测量次数采样条件下，它们的稳健性仍缺乏充分理解。本文使用八种经典优化算法，研究了针对H2、H4和LiH的截断变分哈密顿量拟设的优化问题。在精确态矢量和有限测量次数采样条件下，总共进行了1280次独立优化运行。研究发现，有限测量次数采样会重塑优化动力学，并逆转在无噪声模拟中观察到的优化器排名。虽然基于梯度的方法在精确模拟中达到接近机器精度的结果，但其性能在采样噪声下显著恶化。相比之下，基于种群的方法，尤其是协方差矩阵自适应进化策略，保持了稳健性，对于H2实现了低于5 x 10-4 Ha的校正误差，对于LiH实现了低于10-2 Ha的校正误差。研究进一步表明，有限测量次数采样经常产生对变分原理的表观违反。通过使用105次测量重新评估候选解，研究利用采样诱导的涨落获得了超越内在采样极限的能量估计。这些结果为优化器选择提供了实用指南，并强调了在有噪声变分量子化学中进行高测量次数复评的重要性。

articles.title: Band-Gap Engineering in Cubic MgTiX₃ (X = S, Se) Chalcogenide Perovskites: A DFT Study for Photovoltaic and Photodetection Applications
articles.title_zh: 立方 MgTiX₃（X = S, Se）硫族钙钛矿的带隙工程：面向光伏与光探测的 DFT 研究
articles.abstract: This study provides a comprehensive first-principles investigation of cubic MgTiS₃ and MgTiSe₃ chalcogenide perovskites, highlighting their potential for photovoltaic and photodetection applications. Using Density Functional Theory (DFT) within the Quantum ESPRESSO framework, structural stability was confirmed through generalized gradient approximation (GGA), while band-gap accuracy was refined using the HSE06 hybrid functional. The compounds exhibit wide band gaps of 2.8 eV (MgTiSe₃) and 3.3 eV (MgTiS₃), placing them in the visible-to-near-UV spectral range. Density of states analysis revealed strong p–d hybridization between Ti-3d and S-3p/Se-4p orbitals, enabling efficient optical transitions and charge-carrier generation. Optical property evaluation showed high absorption coefficients (~ 10⁹ m⁻¹), refractive indices near 2.5, and optical conductivity around 18 S/m, confirming strong photon absorption with minimal energy loss. Chalcogen substitution was demonstrated as an effective band-gap engineering strategy, offering tunability for diverse optoelectronic applications. Importantly, these materials combine non-toxic composition, cubic symmetry, and robust stability, positioning them as sustainable alternatives to lead-based perovskites. By integrating structural, electronic, optical, and thermoelectric insights, this work provides theoretical guidance for experimental realization of MgTiS₃ and MgTiSe₃. The findings underscore their promise as efficient, stable, and environmentally friendly materials for next-generation solar cells, photodetectors, and optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究基于密度泛函理论系统考察了立方 MgTiS₃ 与 MgTiSe₃ 的结构、电子与光学性质，并评估其在光伏和光探测中的应用潜力。计算表明，两者具有位于可见到近紫外范围的宽带隙，且 Ti-3d 与 S-3p/Se-4p 轨道之间存在明显 p-d 杂化，有利于光吸收与电荷载流子产生。结果还显示它们具有较高吸收系数、适中的折射率和较强光学响应，说明通过硫/硒替换可实现有效带隙调控，为无毒且稳定的光电材料设计提供了依据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究对立方MgTiS₃和MgTiSe₃硫族钙钛矿进行了全面的第一性原理研究，突出了它们在光伏和光探测应用中的潜力。采用Quantum ESPRESSO框架下的密度泛函理论（DFT），通过广义梯度近似（GGA）确认了结构稳定性，同时使用HSE06杂化泛函提高了带隙精度。这些化合物表现出2.8 eV（MgTiSe₃）和3.3 eV（MgTiS₃）的宽带隙，使其处于可见光至近紫外光谱范围。态密度分析显示，Ti-3d与S-3p/Se-4p轨道之间存在强p–d杂化，从而实现高效的光学跃迁和电荷载流子产生。光学性质评估显示其具有较高的吸收系数（约10⁹ m⁻¹）、接近2.5的折射率以及约18 S/m的光电导率，证实其具有强光子吸收能力且能量损失较小。研究证明，硫族元素替换是一种有效的带隙工程策略，可为多种光电子应用提供可调性。重要的是，这些材料结合了无毒组成、立方对称性和稳健稳定性，使其成为铅基钙钛矿的可持续替代材料。通过整合结构、电子、光学和热电方面的见解，本工作为MgTiS₃和MgTiSe₃的实验实现提供了理论指导。研究结果强调了它们作为下一代太阳能电池、光探测器和光电子器件中高效、稳定且环境友好材料的前景。

articles.title: Quantum in the palm of your hand: The evolution of superconducting qubits
articles.title_zh: 掌上量子：超导量子比特的演进
articles.abstract: Electrons zipping through transistors, powering the screens on our smartphones. Light zooming from distant stars to Earth, moving faster than anything else in the universe. Protons enabling MRI machines to analyze people's injuries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻条目围绕超导量子比特的发展展开，旨在以大众化方式介绍量子技术与现代物理现象的联系。原摘要主要由若干科普式引入语构成，未提供具体研究结论或数值，详情需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子飞速穿过晶体管，为我们智能手机的屏幕供能。光从遥远恒星疾驰到地球，比宇宙中任何其他事物都移动得更快。质子使MRI机器能够分析人们的损伤情况。

articles.title: Isolation of spin-valley locked nodal-line fermions in d-wave AV₂X₂O altermagnets
articles.title_zh: d波AV₂X₂O交替磁体中自旋—谷锁定节线费米子的分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystalline symmetries stabilize topological states with distinct electronic properties, while altermagnets exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization. Here, we combine first-principles calculations with a minimal tight-binding model to realize C-paired spin-valley-locked nodal-line fermions in the d-wave altermagnet AV₂X₂O (A = Rb, Cs, or K; X = Te, Se, or S). The low-energy electronic structure hosts coexisting spin-degenerate and spin-polarized nodal lines around C₄z-paired valleys near the Fermi level. The spin-polarized nodal lines are protected by the out-of-plane mirror symmetry M_z and remain robust against spin-orbit coupling. The minimal model reveals their microscopic origin and establishes a general design principle for their isolation. Layer engineering and electronic correlations serve as material-specific knobs for realizing these isolated spin-valley-locked nodal lines near the Fermi level. Our results establish the AV₂X₂O family as a versatile platform for exploring topological spin-valley locking in d-wave altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合第一性原理计算和最小紧束缚模型，在d波交替磁体AV₂X₂O中实现了C配对的自旋—谷锁定节线费米子。其低能电子结构在费米能级附近包含围绕C₄z配对谷的自旋简并和自旋极化节线，其中自旋极化节线受面外镜面对称性保护并对自旋—轨道耦合保持稳健。研究提出了分离这类节线的一般设计原则，并指出层工程和电子关联可作为材料调控手段。
authors: Pritesh Srivastava, Rahul Verma, Bahadur Singh
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26150v1 公告类型：新。摘要：晶体对称性可稳定具有独特电子性质的拓扑态，而交替磁体在没有净磁化的情况下表现出动量依赖的自旋劈裂。在这里，我们将第一性原理计算与最小紧束缚模型相结合，在d波交替磁体AV₂X₂O（A = Rb、Cs或K；X = Te、Se或S）中实现C配对的自旋—谷锁定节线费米子。低能电子结构在费米能级附近围绕C₄z配对谷承载共存的自旋简并和自旋极化节线。自旋极化节线受到面外镜面对称性M_z保护，并在自旋—轨道耦合下保持稳健。最小模型揭示了它们的微观起源，并建立了用于分离它们的一般设计原则。层工程和电子关联可作为材料特异性的调控旋钮，用于在费米能级附近实现这些分离的自旋—谷锁定节线。我们的结果确立了AV₂X₂O家族作为探索d波交替磁体中拓扑自旋—谷锁定的多功能平台。

articles.title: Quantum spin-glass criticality in disordered frustrated dimer magnets
articles.title_zh: 无序受挫二聚体磁体中的量子自旋玻璃临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study quantum phase transitions of Mott insulators between spin-glass and featureless paramagnetic phases. Specifically, we consider a triangular-lattice bilayer Heisenberg model with bond disorder. The clean system has two phases, a dimer quantum paramagnet and a non-collinear antiferromagnet, separated by a quantum critical point. Bond disorder destroys the antiferromagnetic phase via the interference of dipolar textures and results in spin-glass order, such that the system features a quantum phase transition between spin-glass and dimer phases. We study the vicinity of this transition using a variant of bond-operator theory and calculate thermodynamic observables as well as excitation spectra. Bond disorder leads to strong inhomogeneities near the transition which suppresses non-collinearities and leads to anomalously weak glassiness in the near-critical quantum spin glass. We characterize the low-energy excitations which have a strong tendency towards spatial localization, and we track the behavior of the amplitude (i.e. Higgs) mode across the glass phase whose spectral weight we find to be strongly suppressed due to interference effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察具有键无序的三角晶格双层海森堡模型中，自旋玻璃相与无特征顺磁相之间的量子相变。键无序通过偶极织构干涉破坏反铁磁相并产生自旋玻璃序，研究利用键算符理论变体计算热力学量和激发谱。结果显示临界附近存在强不均匀性、异常弱玻璃性、低能激发的局域化倾向，以及玻璃相中振幅（Higgs）模谱权重因干涉效应受到强抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26151v1 公告类型：新。摘要：我们研究莫特绝缘体在自旋玻璃相与无特征顺磁相之间的量子相变。具体而言，我们考虑具有键无序的三角晶格双层海森堡模型。洁净体系有两个相，即二聚体量子顺磁相和非共线反铁磁相，二者由一个量子临界点分隔。键无序通过偶极织构的干涉破坏反铁磁相，并导致自旋玻璃序，使得体系呈现自旋玻璃相与二聚体相之间的量子相变。我们使用一种键算符理论的变体研究该相变附近区域，并计算热力学可观测量以及激发谱。键无序在相变附近导致强烈的不均匀性，这抑制了非共线性，并在近临界量子自旋玻璃中导致异常弱的玻璃性。我们表征了低能激发，这些激发表现出强烈的空间局域化倾向，并追踪了振幅模（即Higgs模）在玻璃相中的行为；我们发现其谱权重由于干涉效应而受到强烈抑制。

articles.title: Influence of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles on the anisotropy of the dielectric properties of nematic liquid crystal 5CB
articles.title_zh: BaTiO₃纳米颗粒对向列液晶5CB介电性质各向异性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work is devoted to the mechanisms of dielectric response and electric conductivity of suspensions consisting of the nematic liquid crystal 5CB with different concentrations (from 0 to 10 wt.%) of ferroelectric BaTiO₃ nanoparticles with an average size of 24 nm. We revealed that the incorporation of nanoparticles influences significantly the dielectric permittivity magnitude and anisotropy, as well as dielectric losses of the suspension. A pronounced temperature dependence of the anisotropic dielectric permittivity of the suspensions was found at lower temperatures corresponding to the mesophase state; but it is also present at higher temperatures corresponding to the isophase. The dependence of the mesophase-isophase transition temperature on the concentration of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles appeared nonmonotonic. With increasing temperature, both the capacitance and the electrical resistance of the pure liquid crystal increase, as well as it increases in the suspensions with small concentration of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles. Due to space charge accumulation in the shells of nanoparticles, larger concentrations of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles influence strongly the ionic transport by promoting the formation of ionic-electronic screening. This effect modifies the dielectric properties and conduction mechanisms of the suspension, leading to the nonmonotonic dependence of the mesophase - isophase transition temperature versus the nanoparticle concentration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了含不同浓度铁电BaTiO₃纳米颗粒的向列液晶5CB悬浮体系的介电响应和电导机制。结果表明，纳米颗粒显著影响介电常数大小、各向异性和介电损耗，且介晶相—各向同性相转变温度随颗粒浓度呈非单调变化。较高浓度BaTiO₃通过纳米颗粒壳层中的空间电荷积累改变离子输运和屏蔽机制，从而影响悬浮体系的介电与导电行为。
authors: Juliya M. Gudenko, Oleksandr S. Pylypchuk, Victor V. Vainberg, Denis O. Stetsenko, Igor A. Gvozdovskyy, Serhii E. Ivanchenko, Eugene A. Eliseev, Vladimir N. Poroshin, Anna N. Morozovska
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26263v1 公告类型：新。摘要：本工作致力于研究由向列液晶5CB与不同浓度（从0到10 wt.%）平均尺寸为24 nm的铁电BaTiO₃纳米颗粒组成的悬浮体系的介电响应和电导机制。我们发现，纳米颗粒的引入显著影响悬浮体系的介电常数大小和各向异性，以及介电损耗。在对应于介晶相状态的较低温度下，悬浮体系的各向异性介电常数表现出明显的温度依赖性；但这种依赖性在对应于各向同性相的较高温度下也存在。介晶相—各向同性相转变温度对BaTiO₃纳米颗粒浓度的依赖呈现非单调性。随着温度升高，纯液晶的电容和电阻均增加，在含有低浓度BaTiO₃纳米颗粒的悬浮体系中也同样增加。由于纳米颗粒壳层中空间电荷的积累，较高浓度的BaTiO₃纳米颗粒通过促进离子—电子屏蔽的形成而强烈影响离子输运。这一效应改变了悬浮体系的介电性质和导电机制，导致介晶相—各向同性相转变温度随纳米颗粒浓度呈非单调依赖。

articles.title: Scale-dependent universality class crossover in magnetic skyrmion polymers
articles.title_zh: 磁斯格明子聚合物中尺度依赖的普适类交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dipolar magnetic skyrmions can assemble into chains with alternating helicity that act as one-dimensional polymers, yet their statistical mechanics violates the universal harmonic scaling observed in actin, DNA, and microtubules. From first principles, we compute the inter-skyrmion pair potential and find a bi-exponential form of competing interactions with two characteristic decay lengths that encode the distinct microscopic mechanisms of repulsion and attraction. Multiscale simulations reveal a power-law temperature dependence with exponent 1 in the worm-chain limit of a single bond, and exponent 1/2 in the three-bond limit. We find that the power-law behavior is remarkably independent of magnetic field strength, and the crossover is due to competing radial interactions responsible for the bonds, resulting in a quartic transverse confinement. We show that the precise form of the competing interactions (e.g., Morse or double-Yukawa) does not affect the temperature dependence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从第一性原理计算偶极磁斯格明子链中的斯格明子间相互作用，发现其呈具有两个特征衰减长度的双指数形式。多尺度模拟显示温度幂律在单键蠕虫链极限下指数为1，在三键极限下为1/2，且该行为对磁场强度高度不敏感。研究认为交叉源于形成键的竞争径向相互作用导致的四次横向限域，且竞争相互作用的具体形式不改变温度依赖性。
authors: R. L. Silva, R. C. Silva, R. L. Stamps
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26289v1 公告类型：新。摘要：偶极磁斯格明子可以组装成具有交替螺旋性的链，表现为一维聚合物，但其统计力学违反了在肌动蛋白、DNA和微管中观察到的普适谐性标度。我们从第一性原理出发计算斯格明子间成对势，并发现其具有竞争相互作用的双指数形式，包含两个特征衰减长度，编码排斥和吸引的不同微观机制。多尺度模拟揭示出一种幂律温度依赖性：在单个键的蠕虫链极限中指数为1，而在三键极限中指数为1/2。我们发现，该幂律行为显著地不依赖于磁场强度，而这种交叉源于负责形成键的竞争性径向相互作用，从而导致四次横向限域。我们表明，竞争相互作用的具体形式（例如Morse势或双Yukawa势）并不影响温度依赖性。

articles.title: Thermodynamics-Informed Machine Learning for Energy Materials Discovery
articles.title_zh: 面向能源材料发现的热力学知情机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning (ML) is transforming materials discovery by enabling rapid prediction of properties that previously required computationally expensive first-principles calculations.
