articles.abstract_zh: 磁镜是概念上最简单的等离子体约束构型之一，仍是热核聚变的有希望候选方案。其设计需要通过外加磁场来将等离子体约束在开口圆柱装置中。与环形封闭装置不同，磁镜约束本质上依赖于速度空间俘获和粒子从两端逸出的动力学机制。
authors: Lukas Einkemmer, Martin Guerra, Qin Li, Leonardo Zepeda-Núñez
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁镜是概念上最简单的等离子体约束构型之一，至今仍是热核聚变的有前景候选方案。其设计要求通过塑造外加磁场，将等离子体约束在一个开口圆柱装置内。与托卡马克和仿星器等环形闭合装置不同，磁镜中的约束本质上依赖动力学机制，尤其是速度空间俘获以及粒子经由开放端逃逸。我们将磁镜设计表述为一个由简化的多组分漂移-动力学-泊松模型支配的偏微分方程约束优化问题。由此得到的优化揭示了经典损失锥论证所未包含的两种物理效应。第一，通过泊松耦合产生的自洽电场充当次级约束势垒，并在非线性区显著改变粒子滞留。第二，优化后的磁场构型在定性上依赖于底层动力学模型：仅考虑电子的模型倾向于一种非常规的中心峰值磁场，而电子-离子完全耦合模型则恢复经典的边界峰值磁镜构型。这些结果表明，最优磁镜设计不能仅凭损失锥考虑来确定，而必须纳入等离子体自洽的非线性动力学。

articles.title: Preparing Small Gaussian Basis for Highly Accurate Ab Initio Description of Lithium Rydberg States
articles.title_zh: 用于锂里德伯态高精度从头描述的小型高斯基组构建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26728v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A new small and highly accurate Gaussian basis set has been developed for the ab initio description of ²Li Rydberg excited states up to n = 7 and S, P, D, F, and G angular momentum symmetry, and the appropriate optimization protocol is presented. The obtained Rydberg excitation energies are compared with results from other highly accurate approaches. At the EOM-CCSD level of theory the new basis exhibits higher than 10⁻² eV accuracy of the excitation energies and the ionization potential and provides superior results than an analogous universal Gaussian basis set, while utilizing even smaller number of basis functions. Plots of the 1-dimensional Rydberg-orbital cuts reveal a regular nodal structure along the logarithmic scale of the atomic radius reaching tens of angstrom far from the nucleus. The presented Rydberg basis set generation methodology is an important step towards routine ab initio Rydberg-state related investigations of more complex systems, such as large atoms and polyatomic molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为锂里德伯激发态构建了一套新的小型且高精度的高斯基组，适用于 n ≤ 7 的 S、P、D、F 和 G 对称性，并给出了相应的优化流程。与其他高精度方法相比，该基组在 EOM-CCSD 水平上对激发能和电离势均具有优于 10⁻² eV 的精度，且所用基函数数目更少。作者还展示了里德伯轨道的一维切片，揭示其在对数尺度下具有规则的节点结构。
authors: Jan Šmydke, Benjamín Andreides, Simona Dubcová
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文为锂里德伯激发态的从头计算描述开发了一套新的小型且高度精确的高斯基组，适用于 n = 7 以内的 ²Li 里德伯激发态以及 S、P、D、F 和 G 角动量对称性，并给出了相应的优化方案。所得到的里德伯激发能被与其他高精度方法的结果进行了比较。在 EOM-CCSD 理论水平上，这套新基组对激发能的精度优于 10⁻² eV，并且对电离势也具有同等水平的高精度，同时在使用更少基函数的情况下，其性能优于一个类似的通用高斯基组。对一维里德伯轨道切片的绘图显示，在原子半径的对数尺度上存在规则的节点结构，该结构可延伸到距原子核数十埃之外的区域。本文提出的里德伯基组生成方法，是迈向对更复杂体系（如重原子和多原子分子）开展常规从头算里德伯态研究的重要一步。

articles.title: Measurement of multiple mechanical properties from multi-dimensional signals in nanosecond laser ablation via PINN
articles.title_zh: 基于 PINN 的纳秒激光烧蚀多维信号多种力学性能测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate evaluation of mechanical properties in steels under ageing or service conditions remains a major challenge. We propose a thermo-mechanical coupling framework for nanosecond laser ablation based on energy conservation, which is embedded into a physics-informed neural network (PINN) to enable simultaneous inversion of multiple mechanical properties. A thermo-mechanical coupling coefficient is defined to uniformly describe the dynamic allocation of input laser energy among thermal diffusion, mechanical work and plasma shielding across different deformation stages under laser irradiation. Furthermore, hard-to-measure physical characteristics in the coupled equation are replaced with experimentally accessible features obtained through the simultaneous acquisition of spectroscopic, shockwave and surface-wave signals. Using 210 experimental datasets, the framework simultaneously recovers Young's modulus, yield strength, ultimate tensile strength and micro-Vickers hardness with high accuracy (R2=0.9927, 0.9912, 0.9916 and 0.9959 respectively), significantly outperforming the baseline method (ultrasonic velocity regression for E, R2=0.0012). Comparisons with linear normalization and unconstrained neural networks demonstrate that PINN achieves near-unity accuracy through the embedding of conservation-law constraints. Partial dependency analysis further uncovers the nonlinear coupling laws between input features and mechanical properties. The proposed paradigm, integrating conservation laws, measurable features and physics-informed learning, offers a universal approach for non-contact, high-precision and physically consistent multi-to-multi inversion of multiple material properties under nanosecond laser ablation conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于能量守恒的纳秒激光烧蚀热-力耦合框架，并将其嵌入物理信息神经网络（PINN）中，以同时反演多种力学性能。作者利用光谱、冲击波和表面波信号的同步采集，将耦合方程中难以测量的物理量替换为实验可获得特征。基于 210 组实验数据，该方法可高精度同时恢复杨氏模量、屈服强度、抗拉强度和显微维氏硬度，明显优于基线方法。
authors: Ying Zhou, Jian Wu, Ziyuan Song, Jinghui Li, Xinyu Guo, Hao Sun, Yuhua Hang, Cuixiang Pei, Xingwen Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确评估处于时效或服役条件下钢材的力学性能，仍然是一项重大挑战。我们提出一种基于能量守恒的纳秒激光烧蚀热-力耦合框架，并将其嵌入物理信息神经网络（PINN）中，以实现多种力学性能的同步反演。我们定义了一个热-力耦合系数，用于统一描述不同变形阶段中，入射激光能量在热扩散、机械功和等离子体屏蔽之间的动态分配。此外，我们用通过光谱、冲击波和表面波信号同步采集得到、且可实验测量的特征，替代了耦合方程中难以测量的物理特性。基于 210 组实验数据，该框架可同时高精度恢复杨氏模量、屈服强度、抗拉强度和显微维氏硬度，其决定系数分别为 0.9927、0.9912、0.9916 和 0.9959，显著优于基线方法（用于 E 的超声速度回归，R²=0.0012）。与线性归一化和无约束神经网络的比较表明，通过嵌入守恒律约束，PINN 可达到近乎完美的精度。偏依赖分析进一步揭示了输入特征与力学性能之间的非线性耦合规律。本文提出的范式将守恒定律、可测特征与物理信息学习相结合，为纳秒激光烧蚀条件下材料多性能的非接触、高精度、物理一致的多对多反演提供了一种通用方法。

articles.title: Rotating mirror with all-directional pinch compressions - The beauty and simplicity in controlled nuclear fusion
articles.title_zh: 具有全向钳缩压缩的旋转镜：受控核聚变中的美与简
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling nuclear fusion is so challenging that for decades, people have been asking: Are we closer to infinite clean energy? Upon the philosophy of beauty and simplicity, the current work points out that there can be a shortcut: the rotating mirror with detached electrodes and all-directional pinch compressions. This is based on the provisional patents filed recently by the University of Texas at Austin. The device combines the steady-state and fast processes in the two main streams of controlled nuclear fusion research: magnetic confinement fusion and inertial confinement fusion. The fuel plasma is preheated in a steady-state process in a rotating mirror with detached electrodes and then the pinch compressions in both radial and longitudinal directions are applied as the fast process. Preheating and longitudinal compression, in addition to the radial compression, significantly boost the nuclear fusion rate. Fast compression after the preheating limits the time for thermalization between ions and electrons and, therefore, minimizes the impact of electron bremsstrahlung radiation loss on ions. Based on the existing experimental results, the current method can be extrapolated to have the potential to reach or exceed the Lawson criterion for the first demonstration of the feasibility of peaceful usage of nuclear fusion energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种可能的受控核聚变捷径：带有分离电极和全向钳缩压缩的旋转镜装置。该方案将稳态过程与快速压缩过程结合起来，试图融合磁约束聚变与惯性约束聚变两条主线。基于已有实验结果，作者认为该方法有潜力逼近甚至达到 Lawson 判据，从而为和平利用核聚变能的可行性演示提供基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 控制核聚变是如此困难，以至于数十年来人们一直在问：我们离无限清洁能源还有多远？在美与简这一哲学理念之下，本文指出可能存在一条捷径：即带有分离电极和全向钳缩压缩的旋转镜装置。该设想基于德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校近期提交的临时专利。该装置将受控核聚变研究两大主流中的稳态过程与快速过程结合起来，即磁约束聚变和惯性约束聚变。燃料等离子体首先在具有分离电极的旋转镜中通过稳态过程预热，然后在快速过程中施加径向和纵向两个方向上的钳缩压缩。除径向压缩外，预热和纵向压缩可显著提升核聚变反应率。预热后再进行快速压缩，可限制离子与电子之间达到热平衡的时间，因此将电子轫致辐射损失对离子的影响降至最低。根据现有实验结果，对该方法进行外推后，显示其有潜力达到或超过 Lawson 判据，从而首次证明和平利用核聚变能在实验上的可行性。

articles.title: Magnetophotonic crystals with antiferromagnetic order
articles.title_zh: 具有反铁磁有序的磁光晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a magnetophotonic crystal formed by the pairs of layers with the opposite out-of-plane magnetization. Despite vanishing total magnetization such antiferromagnetic pattern opens photonic bandgap, gives rise to nontrivial topological phases and enables strong cross-polarized light reflection at frequencies inside the gap which can be harnessed for magnetically tunable polarization-rotating mirrors. We systematically explore optical properties of this structure highlighting fruitful connections to topological photonics and axion electrodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种由成对层组成的磁光晶体，其层间具有相反的面外磁化方向。尽管总磁化为零，这种反铁磁型排列仍可打开光子带隙，诱导非平庸拓扑相，并在带隙内实现强交叉偏振反射。作者进一步讨论了该结构与拓扑光子学及轴子电动力学之间的联系。
authors: Elina A. Kokurina, Aleksandra V. Otinova, Maxim Mazanov, Vladimir I. Belotelov, Maxim A. Gorlach
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一种磁光晶体，该晶体由一对层构成，且两层具有相反的面外磁化方向。尽管总磁化为零，这种反铁磁图案仍会打开光子带隙，产生非平庸的拓扑相，并使带隙内频率处出现强交叉偏振反射，这一性质可用于磁可调的偏振旋转镜。我们系统考察了这种结构的光学性质，并强调了它与拓扑光子学和轴子电动力学之间富有启发性的联系。

articles.title: Divertor topology and vacuum vessel design for stellarators
articles.title_zh: 托卡马克/螺旋器偏滤器拓扑与真空容器设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present stellarator optimization algorithms for designing the edge magnetic structure in vacuum fields, together with the vacuum vessel. First, we introduce a numerical method that robustly computes periodic-orbit fixed points of any type (elliptic, hyperbolic, or parabolic), which could form the basis of a divertor. To couple divertor and vacuum vessel design, we introduce parametric families of vacuum vessels for which point-to-vessel distances, and their derivatives, can be computed efficiently. The resulting algorithms use signed distance functions to enforce coil-vessel clearance while allowing coils to be placed on or off the vessel. Using these methods, we jointly optimize modular coils and the vacuum vessel to realize a wide range of magnetic topologies for diverting exhaust, including standard X-point divertors, and single- and double-null configurations. For the first time, we show that precise snowflake divertors can be achieved in stellarators. Using this framework, we generate a number of quasi-axisymmetric stellarator designs with compatible vacuum vessels and diverse divertor architectures, which we consider to be candidates for a next-generation STAR Lite prototype.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出用于螺旋器边缘磁结构设计的优化算法，并将其与真空容器联合设计。作者首先给出一种数值方法，可稳健计算任意类型的周期轨道固定点，并可作为偏滤器基础。随后构建可高效计算点到容器距离及其导数的参数化真空容器族，从而在优化中同时处理线圈与容器间隙约束。基于这些方法，作者实现了多种偏滤器磁拓扑的联合优化，包括标准 X 点、单零和双零构型，并首次展示了螺旋器中的精确雪花偏滤器设计。
authors: Andrew Giuliani, Raffael Wendlinger, Misha Padidar, Robert Davies, Shibabrat Naik, Calvin Lowe, Georg Harrer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了用于设计真空场中边缘磁结构的螺旋器优化算法，并将其与真空容器设计相结合。首先，我们引入一种数值方法，能够稳健地计算任意类型（椭圆型、双曲型或抛物型）的周期轨道固定点，这些固定点可作为偏滤器的基础。为了将偏滤器设计与真空容器设计耦合起来，我们引入了一类参数化真空容器族，对于这类容器，可以高效地计算点到容器的距离及其导数。由此产生的算法使用带符号距离函数来保证线圈与容器之间的间隙约束，同时允许线圈布置在容器上或容器外。利用这些方法，我们联合优化了模块化线圈与真空容器，实现了多种用于引导排气的磁拓扑，包括标准 X 点偏滤器，以及单零和双零构型。我们首次表明，螺旋器中可以实现精确的雪花偏滤器。借助这一框架，我们生成了若干准轴对称螺旋器设计，它们具有兼容的真空容器和多样的偏滤器架构；我们认为这些设计可作为下一代 STAR Lite 原型的候选方案。

articles.title: SPECTRE: A robust solver for 3D equilibria with arbitrary topology
articles.title_zh: SPECTRE：一种适用于任意拓扑的三维平衡稳健求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present SPECTRE, a new equilibrium code based on the Multi-Region relaxed MHD model for robustly calculating 3D equilibria with general magnetic topology, allowing for flux surfaces, magnetic islands, and chaos. The code builds on a previous MRxMHD solver, SPEC, but performs significantly better thanks to a new formulation of force, the use of a stable trust-region-based least squares minimization scheme, as well as several additional features. SPECTRE is verified through application to configurations with known equilibrium solutions, in vacuum and with finite beta, both in the fixed boundary and the free boundary mode. Notably, these include vacuum equilibria of a quasi-axisymmetric (QA) device in fixed-boundary mode, and of W7-X in the free-boundary mode, along with a classical stellarator finite-beta free-boundary case. Finally, the solver is applied to a modern optimized finite-beta quasi-isodynamic (QI) configuration, where we demonstrate calculation of a strongly-shaped equilibrium with a core island which is in agreement with a HINT calculation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 SPECTRE，一种基于多区域弛豫 MHD 模型的新平衡代码，可稳健计算具有一般磁拓扑的三维平衡态，包括磁通面、磁岛和混沌区域。与前一代 MRxMHD 求解器 SPEC 相比，SPECTRE 通过新的力的表述、稳定的信赖域最小二乘算法等改进而显著提升。作者在多个已知解的构型上验证了该代码，并将其应用于现代优化的有限 β 准静磁构型，展示了与 HINT 结果一致的强形变平衡解。
authors: E. Balkovic, J. Loizu, E. Lanti, C. Smiet, C. Lazzati, R. Ramasamy, A. Goodman, J. Geiger, J. P. Graves
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出 SPECTRE，一种基于多区域弛豫 MHD 模型的新平衡代码，可稳健地计算具有一般磁拓扑的三维平衡态，允许存在磁通面、磁岛和混沌区域。该代码建立在此前的 MRxMHD 求解器 SPEC 之上，但由于采用了新的力表述、稳定的信赖域最小二乘最小化方案以及若干附加功能，性能显著提升。我们通过将其应用于具有已知平衡解的构型对 SPECTRE 进行了验证，包括真空情形以及有限 β 情形，且同时覆盖固定边界和自由边界模式。值得注意的是，这些验证包括了准轴对称（QA）装置在固定边界模式下的真空平衡，以及 W7-X 在自由边界模式下的真空平衡，还有一个经典螺旋器的有限 β 自由边界案例。最后，我们将该求解器应用于一种现代优化的有限 β 准双重对称（QI）构型，展示了一个具有强烈形变和核心磁岛的平衡解，其结果与 HINT 计算一致。

articles.title: Strong imposition of Dirichlet boundary velocities in structure-preserving discretizations of elastodynamics
articles.title_zh: 弹性动力学结构保持离散化中 Dirichlet 边界速度的强施加
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26248v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The imposition of boundary velocities in finite element models of port-Hamiltonian elastodynamics typically relies on Lagrange multipliers, yielding Differential-Algebraic Equations (DAEs). Alternatively, weak imposition methods that maintain an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) structure often exhibit poor accuracy at Dirichlet boundaries. To address these limitations, this paper introduces an additive kinematic decomposition at the continuous level, splitting the displacement and velocity fields into a relative dynamic component that vanishes on the boundary and a prescribed lifting function extending into the interior domain. This decomposition induces a distributed port that maps the effects of the boundary actuation inside the domain. By incorporating this mapping into suitable virtual power principles, we derive lifted port-Hamiltonian system (PHS) models that, upon finite element discretization, reduce to ODE systems in which Dirichlet boundary velocities are strongly imposed. The framework is applied to derive 2-field and 4-field formulations suited to distinct PHS geometric representations. Furthermore, we show that under specific shape functions, standard FEM schemes are recovered, demonstrating that the lifting framework in the discrete models is equivalent to the classic algebraic matrix partitioning in computational mechanics practice. The energy-balance properties and computational performance of the proposed methodology are verified through numerical simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对端口-哈密顿弹性动力学有限元模型中边界速度的施加问题，本文提出一种连续层面的加性运动学分解方法。该方法将位移和速度分解为边界上为零的相对动态分量，以及向内部区域延拓的预设提升函数，从而在离散后得到仅含常微分方程、且可强施加 Dirichlet 边界速度的模型。作者进一步证明，在适当的形函数下，该框架可恢复标准有限元方案，并通过数值实验验证了能量平衡性质与计算性能。
authors: Cristobal Ponce, Hector Ramirez, Yongxin Wu, Ning Liu, Yann Le Gorrec
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在端口-哈密顿弹性动力学的有限元模型中，边界速度的施加通常依赖拉格朗日乘子，从而得到微分-代数方程（DAEs）。另一种弱施加方法虽然通常保持常微分方程（ODE）结构，但在 Dirichlet 边界处往往精度较差。为解决这些限制，本文在连续层面引入一种加性运动学分解，将位移和速度场分解为两部分：其一是边界上消失的相对动态分量，其二是向内部区域延拓的预设提升函数。该分解产生一个分布式端口，用于将边界驱动的影响映射到域内。通过将这一映射纳入适当的虚功原理，我们推导出提升后的端口-哈密顿系统（PHS）模型；在进行有限元离散后，模型化为 ODE 系统，其中 Dirichlet 边界速度可被强施加。该框架被用于推导适用于不同 PHS 几何表示的两场和四场形式。此外，我们证明在特定形函数下可以恢复标准 FEM 方案，表明离散模型中的提升框架等价于计算力学实践中经典的代数矩阵分块。所提方法的能量平衡性质和计算性能通过数值模拟得到了验证。

articles.title: Origins and mitigation of double descent in reduced order modeling
articles.title_zh: 降阶建模中双下降现象的起源与缓解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26414v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Latent low-dimensional structure in datasets of natural and engineered systems enables their sparse sensing, or full-state reconstruction from historical data and very few carefully chosen localized measurements. Depending on the reconstruction algorithm, sensor locations, and measurement noise, the reconstruction risk curves demonstrate a diversity of patterns including a dramatic peak in error known as double descent in Machine Learning literature. Here we explore those scenarios under a unified Data-Noise Averaging theory. Qualitatively, we formulate sufficient criteria for double descent to emerge through a catastrophic amplification of a pathological signal in reconstruction. Quantitatively, we predict the detailed risk curves at a fraction of computational cost, trace reconstruction instability to individual sensors and their combinations, and provide regularization mechanisms to mitigate the instability. We demonstrate results for both static reconstruction of Sea Surface Temperature patterns and time integration of a reduced order model of a PDE.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在统一的数据-噪声平均理论下研究了重建风险曲线中的双下降现象。作者从定性和定量两方面分析了由传感器位置、噪声与重建算法共同导致的不稳定性，并提出相应的正则化机制加以缓解。文中以海表温度静态重建和 PDE 降阶模型的时间积分为例验证了方法有效性。
authors: Andrei A. Klishin, J. Nathan Kutz, Krithika Manohar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自然系统和工程系统数据中的潜在低维结构，使得它们可以通过稀疏传感，或利用历史数据与少量精心选择的局部测量来实现全状态重建。根据重建算法、传感器位置以及测量噪声的不同，重建风险曲线会呈现多种形态，其中包括机器学习文献中所称的“双下降”现象，即误差出现一个剧烈峰值。本文在统一的数据-噪声平均理论下研究这些情形。定性上，我们给出了双下降出现的充分条件：即在重建过程中，某个病态信号被灾难性放大。定量上，我们能够以极低的计算成本预测详细的风险曲线，追踪重建不稳定性到单个传感器及其组合，并给出可缓解该不稳定性的正则化机制。我们分别针对海表温度模式的静态重建，以及一个 PDE 降阶模型的时间积分展示了这些结果。

articles.title: The Internal Magnetic Field Structure of ICMEs in the Heliosphere
articles.title_zh: 日球层中 ICMEs 的内部磁场结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26702v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Interplanetary coronal mass ejections (ICMEs) are major drivers of heliospheric disturbances and space-weather effects. Here we present a multi-spacecraft study of 96 magnetic clouds (MCs) distributed over a broad range of heliocentric distances, and reconstruct their internal magnetic structure with a uniform-twist Gold--Hoyle (GH) flux-rope model. From the fits, we derive the axial field strength B₀, the twist density (turn density) τ, the GH parameter ømega, and the integrated twist number n. We find that B₀ and the turn density τ both decrease with increasing heliocentric distance, consistent with expansion and axial stretching during propagation. A key result is that the upper envelope in the τ--R plane corresponds to a nearly constant boundary in the dimensionless GH parameter ømega=2π Rτ, close to ømegasim2. Therefore, the inferred upper value of τ is not scale-independent, but follows τₘₐₓsimeq ømegaₘₐₓ/(2π R) for a given flux-rope radius. In contrast, the estimated integrated turn number n shows no similarly clear radial organization in the present sample. This study investigates the ICME structure and magnetic field characteristics across heliocentric distances from 0.07 to 5.4~AU, thereby providing observational constraints on the large-scale evolution of interplanetary magnetic flux ropes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 96 个磁云的多航天器观测，在不同日心距离范围内重建其内部磁结构，并采用统一扭转的 Gold–Hoyle  फ्लux rope 模型进行拟合。结果表明，轴向磁场强度和扭转密度均随日心距离增大而减小，反映了传播过程中的膨胀与轴向拉伸。研究还发现，τ–R 平面中的上包络对应于近似恒定的无量纲参数 ω≈2πRτ≈2，从而给出扭转上限随尺度变化的约束。
authors: Ziwei Huang, Zhenjun Zhou, Yudong Ye, Ming Xiong, Yuming Wang, Yutian Chi, Daniel Heyner, Hans-Ulrich Auster, Ingo Richter, Beatriz Sanchez-Cano
articles.abstract_zh_full: 日球层中的行星际日冕物质抛射（ICMEs）是引发日球扰动和空间天气效应的主要驱动因素。本文基于多航天器研究，对分布在广泛日心距离范围内的 96 个磁云（MCs）进行了分析，并利用统一扭转的 Gold–Hoyle（GH）磁通绳模型重建其内部磁结构。由拟合结果我们提取了轴向磁场强度 B₀、扭转密度（转数密度）τ、GH 参数 ω，以及积分扭转数 n。我们发现，B₀ 和转数密度 τ 都会随着日心距离增加而减小，这与传播过程中的膨胀和轴向拉伸相一致。一个关键结果是，τ–R 平面中的上包络对应于无量纲 GH 参数 ω=2πRτ 的一个近似恒定边界，且该值接近 ω≈2。因此，所推断的 τ 上限并不是尺度无关的，而是对于给定的磁通绳半径满足 τₘₐₓ≈ωₘₐₓ/(2πR)。相比之下，在本样本中，估计得到的积分转数 n 并未显示出同样清晰的径向组织规律。本研究考察了日心距离从 0.07 到 5.4 AU 范围内的 ICME 结构与磁场特性，从而为行星际磁通绳的大尺度演化提供了观测约束。

articles.title: Recent Progress in Ab-Initio Nuclear Theory for Precision Physics Searches in Muonic Atoms and Superallowed β Decays
articles.title_zh: 用于缪子原子和超允许 β 衰变精密物理搜索的从头算核理论最新进展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26781v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Precision tests of the Standard Model at low energy are increasingly limited by nuclear-structure theory rather than by experiment. We review two such cases: the two-photon-exchange correction to the Lamb shift in muonic atoms, and the texorpdfstringγ Wgamma-W box radiative correction to superallowed texorpdfstringβbeta decays. Although they probe different physics, both are governed by the same generalized hadronic tensor, so that the chiral effective field theory Hamiltonians and currents, Lanczos-based response methods, and Bayesian uncertainty quantification developed for one carry over directly to the other. We summarize recent ab initio progress in light nuclei and its impact on nuclear charge radii, on the helium isotope-shift puzzle, and on the extraction of texorpdfstringVᵤdVud for the top-row CKM unitarity test, and state a future outlook.
articles.abstract_zh: 低能区对标准模型的精密检验越来越受核结构理论而非实验精度所限制。本文综述了两个相关问题：缪子原子拉姆位移中的双光子交换修正，以及超允许 β 衰变中的 γW 方框辐射修正。尽管它们探测的物理不同，但都由同一个广义强子张量所支配，因此为其中一项发展出的手征有效场论哈密顿量、流算符、基于 Lanczos 的响应方法和贝叶斯不确定度量化，均可直接迁移到另一项问题中。
authors: Simone Salvatore Li Muli, Michael Gennari
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低能区对标准模型的精密检验，正日益受到核结构理论而非实验的限制。本文综述了两个这样的案例：缪子原子中拉姆位移的双光子交换修正，以及超允许 β 衰变中的 γW 方框辐射修正。尽管它们探测的是不同的物理过程，但两者都由同一个广义强子张量所支配，因此为其中一个问题发展出的手征有效场论哈密顿量和流、基于 Lanczos 的响应方法以及贝叶斯不确定度量化技术，都可以直接迁移到另一个问题中。我们总结了近期在轻核中的从头算进展及其对原子核电荷半径、氦同位素位移之谜，以及对用于顶行 CKM 幺正性检验的 Vᵤd 提取的影响，并给出了未来展望。

articles.title: Nonlinear Stability and Instability of Finite-Energy Solutions of the Compressible Euler-Riesz Equations with General Pressure Laws
articles.title_zh: 具有一般压力定律的可压缩 Euler-Riesz 方程有限能量解的非线性稳定性与不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26782v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The compressible Euler-Riesz equations arise in the modeling of a wide range of physical phenomena, including stellar dynamics, plasma physics, and mathematical biology. In this paper, we investigate the nonlinear stability and instability of steady states for the multidimensional compressible Euler-Riesz equations under general pressure laws. In the polytropic case, we establish the nonlinear instability of steady states in the mass-supercritical regime for attractive potentials; this is achieved by analyzing the concavity of the free energy along mass-preserving dilations. At the mass-critical exponent, we show that, for any steady state, there exist solutions that start arbitrarily close to it, but develop growing support. For general pressure laws, we employ a concentration-compactness approach to prove the existence of energy minimizers and establish the nonlinear stability of steady states. Moreover, we quantify the finite-time stability by deriving a relative entropy bound for finite-energy solutions, without requiring uniform pointwise upper and lower bounds on the density. We further exploit the convexity of the second moment to obtain quantitative growth estimates for solutions with positive energy, thereby proving the local nature of the stability result. Finally, we prove the global existence of finite-energy weak solutions to the compressible Euler-Riesz equations with spherical symmetry for general pressure laws via the compensated compactness method, thereby yielding unconditional stability around steady states within the class of weak solutions. The approach developed in this paper should be useful for solving other nonlinear partial differential equations involving similar difficulties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了多维可压缩 Euler-Riesz 方程在一般压力定律下平衡态的非线性稳定性与不稳定性。对于多方情形，作者在质量超临界的吸引势情形下证明了平衡态的非线性不稳定性，并在质量临界指数处证明了解可从任意接近平衡态的初值出发而支撑范围增长。对于一般压力定律，作者通过集中-紧性方法建立能量极小解的存在性并证明平衡态的非线性稳定性，同时给出有限时间稳定性的定量相对熵估计。
authors: Jose A. Carrillo, Samuel R. Charles, Gui-Qiang G. Chen, Difan Yuan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可压缩 Euler-Riesz 方程出现在多种物理现象的建模中，包括恒星动力学、等离子体物理和数学生物学。本文研究了多维可压缩 Euler-Riesz 方程在一般压力定律下稳态的非线性稳定性与不稳定性。对于多方情形，我们通过分析保质量膨胀下自由能的凹性，证明了吸引势情形下质量超临界区间内稳态的非线性不稳定性。在质量临界指数处，我们表明，对于任意一个稳态，存在一些解，它们的初值可以任意接近该稳态，但其支撑区域会不断增长。对于一般压力定律，我们采用集中-紧性方法证明能量极小解的存在，并建立稳态的非线性稳定性。此外，我们通过推导有限能量解的相对熵估计，量化了有限时间稳定性，而无需对密度施加强上下点态一致界。我们还利用二阶矩的凸性，得到正能量解的定量增长估计，从而证明该稳定性结果具有局部性。最后，我们通过补偿紧性方法，证明了具有球对称的一般压力定律可压缩 Euler-Riesz 方程有限能量弱解的全局存在性，从而在弱解类别内得到平衡态附近的无条件稳定性。本文发展的方法也应有助于解决其他具有类似困难的非线性偏微分方程。

articles.title: Embedded quantum computing for many-body surface reaction
articles.title_zh: 用于多体表面反应的嵌入式量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27009v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predictive simulations of catalytic interfaces require correlated electronic-structure treatments that describe localized chemical transformations while retaining the influence of the extended metallic environment. We introduce QC-DFET, a quantum-computing density-functional embedding framework that maps surface-reaction active spaces to compact, environment-aware qubit Hamiltonians. A reaction-consistent active-space protocol preserves orbital continuity along reaction coordinates, while quantum-selected configuration interaction based on measurements from the Zuchongzhi superconducting quantum processor and strongly contracted perturbation theory capture static and dynamic correlation. On Cu(111), QC-DFET treats active spaces up to 28 qubits and is validated through a hierarchy of experimentally constrained surface-chemistry challenges. H2 dissociation/desorption tests balanced bond breaking and recombination barriers, CO adsorption tests site selectivity and metal-adsorbate bonding, and formate hydrogenation tests competing hydrogenation branches with different kinetic and thermodynamic signatures. Across these cases, QC-DFET reproduces bidirectional H2 barriers, recovers the observed top-site preference and adsorption strength of CO, and reconciles the experimentally benchmarked H2COO* reverse barrier with the lower forward barrier to HCOOH*. These results establish embedded quantum computing as a practical route to correlated surface-reaction energetics.
articles.abstract_zh: 催化界面的预测模拟需要能够描述局域化学转化并保留延展金属环境影响的相关电子结构方法。本文提出 QC-DFET，一种量子计算密度泛函嵌入框架，可将表面反应活性空间映射为紧凑且考虑环境效应的量子比特哈密顿量。该方法在 Cu(111) 上通过一系列实验约束的表面化学问题得到验证，能够再现 H2、CO 和甲酸加氢等反应的关键能垒与吸附特征。
authors: Dedong Wan, Xiaopeng Li, Yi Fan, Jie Liu, Xiongzhi Zeng, Zhenyu Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 催化界面的预测模拟需要采用相关电子结构处理方法，以描述局域化学转化，同时保留延展金属环境的影响。我们提出 QC-DFET，一种量子计算密度泛函嵌入框架，可将表面反应活性空间映射为紧凑且考虑环境效应的量子比特哈密顿量。反应一致的活性空间协议在反应坐标上保持轨道连续性，而基于来自祖冲之超导量子处理器测量结果的量子选定组态相互作用以及强缩并微扰理论，则用于捕捉静态相关和动态相关。对于 Cu(111)，QC-DFET 可处理多达 28 个量子比特的活性空间，并通过一系列实验约束的表面化学挑战得到验证。H2 解离/脱附测试平衡了化学键断裂与复合势垒，CO 吸附测试检验了位点选择性和金属-吸附体键合，而甲酸根加氢测试则检验了具有不同动力学和热力学特征的竞争性加氢路径。对于这些案例，QC-DFET 重现实验上双向的 H2 势垒，恢复了观测到的 CO 顶位偏好及吸附强度，并协调了经实验标定的 H2COO* 逆向势垒与更低的正向势垒至 HCOOH*。这些结果表明，嵌入式量子计算是处理相关表面反应能量学的实用途径。

articles.title: Electromagnetic turbulence in EAST plasmas with internal transport barrier
articles.title_zh: 具有内部输运势垒的 EAST 等离子体中的电磁湍流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.04044v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this study, global nonlinear electromagnetic gyrokinetic simulations are conducted to investigate turbulence in the Internal transport barrier (ITB) region of the EAST tokamak discharge with weakly reversed magnetic shear. Linear simulations reveal two dominant ion temperature gradient (ITG) modes: a higher frequency mode at the q=1 surface, which dominates in the electrostatic limit, and a lower frequency mode near the qₘᵢₙ surface, which prevails under the experimental β (the ratio of plasma pressure to magnetic pressure). Finite β effects effectively suppress higher frequency ITG modes, and once βᵢ on axis exceeds 0.5%, this ITG mode is no longer dominant, and the ITG mode near qₘᵢₙ surface becomes the primary instability. Therefore, electromagnetic effects play a crucial role in stabilizing ITG modes, and in causing the transition between the most unstable mode at different radial positions. The linear growth rate of the unstable mode in the electrostatic limit is approximately 1.25 times higher than that of the dominant mode in the electromagnetic case. However, in the electromagnetic nonlinear regime, the thermal ion heat conductivity is reduced by at least a factor of 4. This reduction primarily results from nonlinear electromagnetic effects enhancing the shearing effect of zonal flows, thereby further suppressing microturbulence. Finally, energetic particles exert a slight stabilizing effect on ITG turbulence due to dilution and finite β contributions. It is emphasized that the electromagnetic effect on ITG with weak magnetic shear should be included to accurately calculate the transport coefficients.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用全局非线性电磁 gyrokinetic 模拟，研究 EAST 托卡马克弱反转磁剪切放电中内部输运势垒（ITB）区域的湍流。线性结果表明存在两个主导的离子温度梯度（ITG）模，其中在电静近似下占优的是 q=1 面附近的高频模，而在实验 β 条件下占优的是 qₘᵢₙ 面附近的低频模。电磁效应会显著抑制高频 ITG 模，并通过增强回旋流剪切进一步降低离子热输运。
authors: Yuehao Ma, Pengfei Liu, Jian Bao, Zhihong Lin, Huishan Cai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究采用全局非线性电磁 gyrokinetic 模拟，研究 EAST 托卡马克弱反转磁剪切放电中内部输运势垒（ITB）区域的湍流。线性模拟揭示了两个主导的离子温度梯度（ITG）模：一个是位于 q=1 面的高频模，在电静极限下占主导；另一个是位于 qₘᵢₙ 面附近的低频模，在实验 β（等离子体压强与磁压强之比）条件下占主导。有限 β 效应能够有效抑制高频 ITG 模，并且一旦轴上 βᵢ 超过 0.5%，该 ITG 模便不再占主导，而 qₘᵢₙ 面附近的 ITG 模成为主要不稳定性。因此，电磁效应在稳定 ITG 模以及引发不同径向位置最不稳定模之间的转变中起着关键作用。电静极限下不稳定模的线性增长率约为电磁情况下主导模的 1.25 倍。然而，在电磁非线性区间，热离子热导至少降低 4 倍。这种降低主要源于非线性电磁效应增强了回旋流的剪切作用，从而进一步抑制了微湍流。最后，高能粒子由于稀释效应和有限 β 贡献，对 ITG 湍流产生轻微的稳定作用。需要强调的是，在弱磁剪切条件下，ITG 的电磁效应应被纳入考虑，以便准确计算输运系数。

articles.title: Cross-scale Interaction between Microturbulence and Fishbone in Fusion Plasmas
articles.title_zh: 融合等离子体中微湍流与鱼骨模的跨尺度相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.04051v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Global gyrokinetic simulations are performed for the first time to investigate cross-scale interactions between electromagnetic ion temperature gradient (ITG) turbulence and fishbone instability in tokamak plasmas. The investigation of fluctuation response in the multiscale simulation including both instabilities indicates a strong impact of fishbone on ITG turbulence. Detailed analysis reveals that fishbone-driven zonal radial electric fields at nonlinear saturation significantly suppress electromagnetic ITG turbulence, reducing ion thermal transport close to the neoclassical level. The simulation results agree well with experimental observations that turbulence suppression during fishbone bursts. These findings advance understanding of multiscale interactions that enhance thermal confinement in fusion plasmas.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次通过全局 gyrokinetic 模拟研究托卡马克等离子体中电磁离子温度梯度（ITG）湍流与鱼骨模不稳定性的跨尺度相互作用。结果表明，鱼骨模在非线性饱和阶段产生的回旋流径向电场会显著抑制 ITG 湍流，使离子热输运降低至接近新经典水平。模拟结果与实验中鱼骨爆发期间湍流受到抑制的观测一致。
authors: Yuehao Ma, Bin Zhang, Pengfei Liu, Jian Bao, Zhihong Lin, Huishan Cai, Liutian Gao, AhDi Liu, Hailin Zhao, Tao Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文首次通过全局 gyrokinetic 模拟研究托卡马克等离子体中电磁离子温度梯度（ITG）湍流与鱼骨模不稳定性之间的跨尺度相互作用。对包含这两种不稳定性的多尺度模拟中的涨落响应分析表明，鱼骨模对 ITG 湍流具有强烈影响。进一步分析发现，在非线性饱和阶段，由鱼骨模驱动的回旋流径向电场会显著抑制电磁 ITG 湍流，使离子热输运降低到接近新经典水平。模拟结果与实验观测到的鱼骨爆发期间湍流抑制现象高度一致。这些发现加深了对增强聚变等离子体热约束的多尺度相互作用的理解。

articles.title: Central Equations and Band Structures of Linear Magnetohydrodynamic Waves in a Magneto-Lattice
articles.title_zh: 磁晶格中线性磁流体力学波的中心方程与能带结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.00649v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the band structures and propagation properties of linear ideal magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) waves in a plasma with a spatially periodic background magnetic field (a magneto-lattice ). We develop a plane-wave expansion approach in two equivalent forms: one written using the usual linearized MHD perturbation variables and another written in terms of the fluid displacement. We validate both formulations with numerical tests, including an empty-lattice limit that recovers the uniform-plasma dispersion. The method enables efficient computation of dispersion relations and reveals intrinsic frequency band gaps and cutoff behavior caused by magnetic periodicity. We show that the band gap width increases with the amplitude of the periodic magnetic-field modulation (relative to the uniform background field), leading to suppression of selected wave modes. In addition, the magnetic periodicity splits the Alfvén continuum into multiple branches, a feature absent in uniform plasmas. These results provide a framework for tailoring MHD wave propagation in structured plasmas and may be useful for future studies of plasma metamaterials and topological plasma waves.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有空间周期性背景磁场的等离子体中线性理想磁流体力学波的能带结构与传播性质。作者建立了两种等价的平面波展开形式，并验证其可恢复均匀等离子体色散关系。结果表明，磁场周期性会引入频率带隙与截止行为，并将阿尔芬连续谱分裂为多个分支。
authors: Shiyu Sun, Peifeng Fan, Yulei Wang, Qiang Chen, Xingkai Li, Weihua Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究具有空间周期性背景磁场（磁晶格）的等离子体中线性理想磁流体力学（MHD）波的能带结构与传播性质。我们发展了一种平面波展开方法，并给出两种等价形式：一种用通常的线性化 MHD 微扰变量表示，另一种用流体位移表示。我们通过数值测试验证了这两种表述，包括一个空晶格极限，该极限可恢复均匀等离子体的色散关系。该方法能够高效计算色散关系，并揭示由磁场周期性导致的本征频率带隙和截止行为。我们表明，带隙宽度随周期性磁场调制幅度（相对于均匀背景场）的增加而增大，从而抑制某些选定的波模。此外，磁场周期性会将阿尔芬连续谱分裂为多个分支，而这一特征在均匀等离子体中并不存在。这些结果为调控结构化等离子体中的 MHD 波传播提供了框架，并可能有助于未来对等离子体超材料和拓扑等离子体波的研究。

articles.title: The Spectral Topology of Global Imbalances:A Graph-Theoretic Framework for Systemic Risk in the Balance of Payments
articles.title_zh: 全球失衡的谱拓扑：国际收支系统性风险的图论框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.02541v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We model global balance-of-payments linkages as a directed weighted exposure network and study systemic fragility through the spectrum of the associated operators. From a signed bilateral-flow matrix, we construct a nonnegative exposure lift, derive a spectral stability criterion for linear propagation, and define node- and edge-level risk measures using Perron-Frobenius geometry, PageRank, and marginal spectral impact. We further give two complementary extensions: a directed Laplacian formulation for shock diffusion and a non-backtracking threshold for cascade formation on sparse exposure networks. The framework identifies systemic risk as a topological property of the global network rather than a collection of isolated country indicators, and it yields mathematically explicit diagnostics for resilience, concentration of stress, and targeted stabilization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将全球国际收支关联建模为有向加权敞口网络，并从相关算子的谱性质研究系统性脆弱性。作者基于带符号的双边流矩阵构建非负敞口提升，并用 Perron-Frobenius 几何、PageRank 和边际谱影响定义节点与边层面的风险度量。该框架将系统性风险视为全球网络的拓扑属性，而非孤立国家指标的简单集合。
authors: Chandrasekhar Gokavarapu (Department of Mathematics, Government College), Sanjeev Kumar Chejarla (Department of Economics, Government College), Balayya Rajana (Department of Economics, Government College), V. N. S. R. Murthy Duggirala (Department of Mathematics, Government College, Principal, Government Degree College, Seethanagaram, East Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh, India), Srinivasulu Chittaru (Department of Mathematics, Government College, Department of Mathematics, Government Degree College, Seethanagaram, East Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh, India)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将全球国际收支关联建模为一个有向加权敞口网络，并通过相关算子的谱研究系统性脆弱性。基于带符号的双边流矩阵，我们构造了一个非负敞口提升，推导出线性传播的谱稳定性判据，并使用 Perron-Frobenius 几何、PageRank 以及边际谱影响定义节点和边层面的风险度量。我们还给出了两个互补的扩展：一种是用于冲击扩散的有向拉普拉斯表述，另一种是用于稀疏敞口网络上级联形成的非回溯阈值。该框架将系统性风险识别为全球网络的拓扑属性，而非孤立国家指标的集合，并给出关于韧性、压力集中以及针对性稳定化的数学上明确的诊断方法。

articles.title: On the double-adiabatic equations in the relativistic regime
articles.title_zh: 相对论区中的双绝热方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25594v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We revisit the double adiabatic evolution equations and extend them to the relativistic and ultrarelativistic regimes. We analytically solve the relativistic, time-dependent drift kinetic equation for a homogeneous, magnetized, collisionless plasma and obtain a solution explicitly dependent on the magnetic field and density variations. In the case of an initial relativistic Maxwellian distribution, a natural extension to an anisotropic Maxwell-Jüttner is obtained. We calculate the moments of this time-dependent solution and obtain analytical expressions for the evolution of the perpendicular and parallel pressures in the ultrarelativistic case. We numerically solve the moment equations in the relativistic case and obtain general expressions for the double-adiabatic equations in this regime. We confirm our results using fully kinetic particle-in-cell simulations of shearing and compressing boxes. Our findings can be readily applied to relativistic species including cosmic-rays and electron-positron pairs, present in astrophysical plasmas like pulsar wind nebulae, astrophysical jets, black hole accretion flows, and Van Allen radiation belts.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视双绝热演化方程，并将其推广到相对论及超相对论区。作者解析求解了均匀、磁化、无碰撞等离子体中的相对论时变漂移动力学方程，得到显式依赖磁场和密度变化的解，并由此导出相应的压力演化关系。结果可用于宇宙线、电子-正电子对及多种高能天体等离子体场景。
authors: Francisco Ley, Aaron Tran, Ellen G. Zweibel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们重新审视双绝热演化方程，并将其推广到相对论和超相对论区。我们解析求解了均匀、磁化、无碰撞等离子体中的相对论时变漂移动力学方程，得到一个显式依赖磁场与密度变化的解。对于初始相对论麦克斯韦分布，得到了一个自然推广，即各向异性的 Maxwell-Jüttner 分布。我们计算了这一时变解的矩，并在超相对论情况下得到垂直和平行压力演化的解析表达式。我们在相对论情形下对矩方程进行了数值求解，并得到该区间内双绝热方程的一般表达式。我们还通过对剪切和压缩盒的全动理学粒子-网格模拟验证了结果。我们的发现可直接应用于相对论性粒子种类，包括宇宙线和电子-正电子对，它们存在于脉冲星风星云、天体喷流、黑洞吸积流以及范艾伦辐射带等天体物理等离子体中。

articles.title: Restoring the Conical Intersection Topology using Convex Density Functional Theory
articles.title_zh: 利用凸密度泛函理论恢复锥形交叉的拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.20476v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Conical intersections are central to the description of photophysics and photochemistry. Nevertheless, in non-adiabatic molecular dynamics simulations, they are fundamentally challenging for single-reference electronic structure methods. Density functional theory (DFT) and its time-dependent extension (TDDFT) represent the most widely used theoretical approaches in physics, chemistry, and biology. However, the treatment of ground and excited states as separate problems leads to breakdowns in the topological structure of potential energy surfaces near conical intersections. In this work, we solve this long-standing issue by presenting Convex DFT, a framework that, by explicitly enforcing convexity of the variational problem within an appropriately defined subspace, guarantees a unique and continuous electronic solution across regions of degeneracies. We demonstrate that Convex DFT yields smooth and physically meaningful intersection seams by comparison with multireference wave function methods. In this way, we establish the method as a robust and computationally efficient DFT approach for treating electronically degenerate regions. These developments represent a critical step toward reliable non-adiabatic simulations beyond the limitations of conventional TDDFT.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对单参考电子结构方法在锥形交叉附近无法正确描述拓扑结构的问题，提出了凸密度泛函理论（Convex DFT）。该方法通过在适当定义的子空间内显式施加变分问题的凸性，保证在简并区域内电子解的唯一性与连续性。与多参考波函数方法比较表明，该方法能够给出平滑且物理合理的交叉缝。
authors: Federico Rossi, Tommaso Giovannini, Henrik Koch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锥形交叉是描述光物理和光化学的核心概念。然而，在非绝热分子动力学模拟中，对于单参考电子结构方法而言，它们本质上是困难的。密度泛函理论（DFT）及其时间依赖扩展（TDDFT）是物理、化学和生物学中最广泛使用的理论方法。然而，将基态和激发态作为彼此分离的问题处理，会导致在锥形交叉附近势能面的拓扑结构崩坏。在这项工作中，我们通过提出 Convex DFT 解决了这一长期存在的问题。该框架在适当定义的子空间内显式施加变分问题的凸性，从而保证在简并区域内电子解的唯一性和连续性。我们通过与多参考波函数方法比较，证明 Convex DFT 能够给出平滑且物理上合理的交叉缝。借此，我们将该方法确立为一种稳健且计算高效的 DFT 方案，可用于处理电子简并区域。这些进展是迈向超越传统 TDDFT 限制、实现可靠非绝热模拟的关键一步。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出一种名为 Convex DFT 的新框架，用于修复密度泛函在圆锥交叉附近的拓扑问题。作者通过约束变分问题的凸性，获得跨简并区连续且唯一的电子解，并展示了其在激发态交叉面的平滑性。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在非绝热分子动力学、激发态动力学和光电材料中关注的电子简并问题有一定关联，但更偏方法论而非具体材料应用。对处理圆锥交叉、非辐射过程和超快动力学建模有一定启发。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步阅读其对简并态连续性的数学处理，并思考是否可与现有非绝热动力学框架结合。若后续涉及光激发、载流子弛豫或化学反应路径，可评估其适用性。

articles.title: Enhanced Variational Quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold Network
articles.title_zh: 增强型变分量子 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.22604v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) places the trainable functions on the synapses rather than on the neurons. Existing quantum implementations either lack accuracy (Variational Quantum KAN, VQKAN) or rely on block encoding and Quantum Signal Processing, which demand many control gates and ancillae. We propose the Enhanced Variational Quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (EVQKAN), a variational ansatz that emulates a 2N_q-dimensional KAN layer matrix by tiling controlled rotations through a sum-operator construction, using only 2N_q⁻¹ trainable spline functions per layer. On the fitting of an elementary function, EVQKAN attains a significantly lower test error than Quantum Neural Networks (QNN), VQKAN and Adaptive VQKAN (Mann-Whitney p<0.002, Cliff's δłeq-0.86 over ten attempts; EVQKAN beats VQKAN on every attempt), though classical KAN is more accurate still. On a two-dimensional classification task the ordering reverses: under a leak-free protocol introduced here, EVQKAN classifies above chance (accuracy 0.620, p=0.0005) but is significantly less accurate than a QNN carrying one fifth as many parameters (Δaccuracy -0.134, p=0.0014; ΔAUC -0.252, p=0.0002). We withdraw the classification results of an earlier version of this work: their encoding placed the target label into the circuit as a feature for EVQKAN but not for the methods it was compared against. The dominant error source is overfitting from an under-determined training set; enlarging that set closes the train-test gap by 58% (Spearman p<10⁻³). We also report the circuit cost in full --- three layers emit 1017 operations, or 4110 two-qubit gates once the multi-controlled gates are decomposed --- so the construction is simulator-scale and fault-tolerant-era rather than NISQ-ready, with block encoding and qubitization the route to reducing it.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出增强型变分量子 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（EVQKAN），旨在缓解现有量子 KAN 实现精度不足或电路开销过大的问题。该方法用较少的可训练样条函数，通过分层控制旋转与求和算符构造来近似 KAN 层矩阵。在函数拟合任务上，EVQKAN 优于多种量子神经网络基线，但在二维分类任务上不及参数更少的 QNN，且作者指出早期版本的分类结果存在编码偏差并予以撤回。
authors: Hikaru Wakaura, Rahmat Mulyawan, Andriyan B. Suksmono
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）将可训练函数放在突触上，而不是放在神经元上。现有的量子实现要么精度不足（变分量子 KAN，VQKAN），要么依赖块编码和量子信号处理，这些方法需要大量控制门和辅助比特。我们提出增强型变分量子 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（EVQKAN），这是一种变分 ansatz，它通过求和算符构造来平铺受控旋转，从而模拟一个 2N_q 维 KAN 层矩阵，并且每层只使用 2N_q⁻¹ 个可训练样条函数。针对一个基本函数的拟合，EVQKAN 获得了显著低于量子神经网络（QNN）、VQKAN 和自适应 VQKAN 的测试误差（Mann-Whitney p<0.002，十次尝试中的 Cliff's δ≤-0.86；EVQKAN 在每一次尝试中都优于 VQKAN），不过经典 KAN 的准确性仍然更高。在一个二维分类任务上，排序则相反：在本文引入的无泄漏协议下，EVQKAN 的分类结果高于随机水平（准确率 0.620，p=0.0005），但显著低于一个仅有其五分之一参数量的 QNN（Δ准确率 -0.134，p=0.0014；ΔAUC -0.252，p=0.0002）。我们撤回了本工作早期版本中的分类结果：当时的编码把目标标签作为特征放入了 EVQKAN 的电路中，而与之比较的方法并未如此处理。主要误差来源是训练集欠定导致的过拟合；扩大训练集后，训练-测试差距缩小了 58%（Spearman p<10⁻³）。我们还完整报告了电路代价——三层电路共产生 1017 个操作，或在分解多控制门后达到 4110 个双量子比特门——因此该构造适用于模拟器规模以及容错时代，而非 NISQ 时代；降低这一代价的途径是采用块编码和量子化。

articles.title: Intermediate Excited State Relaxation Dynamics of Boron Vacancy Spin Defects in Hexagonal Boron Nitride
articles.title_zh: 六方氮化硼中硼空位自旋缺陷的中间激发态弛豫动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.22815v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Optically addressable spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride offer promising potential for 2D quantum sensing, though excited-state dynamics remain poorly understood. In particular, the non-radiative relaxation paths from the excited triplet states to the ground state, specially those involving a shelving intermediate state (IS), remain largely hypothetical, and the rate constants have yet to be directly measured. In this work, we investigate the relaxation dynamics of the IS in the optical pumping cycle in a broad temperature range. We measure a 24.0(3) ns relaxation time from IS to the ground state at room temperature, which approximately doubles at low temperatures. Simulations reveal how spin populations and ground-state polarization evolve with varying excitation rate. Accordingly, we optimize optically detected magnetic resonance pulse sequences to account for the effects of IS relaxation. This considerably enhances spin manipulation efficiency, allowing substantial optimization of the quantum sensor's sensitivity based on boron vacancies.
articles.abstract_zh: 六方氮化硼中的可光学寻址自旋缺陷在二维量子传感中具有潜力，但其激发态动力学仍不清楚。本文测量了室温下中间态到基态的弛豫时间，并分析了不同激发率下自旋布居和基态极化的演化。结果可用于优化基于硼空位的光学磁共振脉冲序列，从而提升量子传感灵敏度。
authors: Paul Konrad, Mehran Kianinia, Lesley Spencer, Andreas Sperlich, Lukas Hein, Selin Steinicke, Igor Aharonovich, Vladimir Dyakonov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 六方氮化硼中的可光学寻址自旋缺陷为二维量子传感提供了有前景的潜力，但其激发态动力学仍未被充分理解。尤其是从激发三重态到基态的非辐射弛豫路径，特别是那些涉及一个储备中间态（IS）的路径，仍主要停留在假设层面，其速率常数也尚未被直接测量。在本工作中，我们研究了光抽运循环中 IS 的弛豫动力学，并覆盖了较宽的温度范围。我们在室温下测得 IS 到基态的弛豫时间为 24.0(3) ns，在低温下这一时间大约加倍。模拟揭示了在不同激发率下，自旋布居和基态极化如何演化。基于此，我们优化了光学探测磁共振脉冲序列，以考虑 IS 弛豫的影响。这显著提高了自旋操控效率，从而能够基于硼空位对量子传感器灵敏度进行大幅优化。

articles.title: Super-resolving frequency measurement with mode-selective quantum memory
articles.title_zh: 利用模选择性量子存储实现超分辨频率测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.20514v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: High-precision optical frequency measurement underpins modern science and technology, yet conventional spectroscopic techniques struggle to resolve sub-linewidth spectral features. Here, we introduce a platform for super-resolved frequency estimation based on a mode-selective atomic Raman quantum memory implemented in warm caesium vapour. By precisely engineering the light-matter interaction, the memory coherently stores the optimal temporal mode with high fidelity and retrieves it on demand, achieving mode crosstalk as low as 0.34%. To estimate the separation between two spectral lines, we experimentally measure the mean squared error of the frequency estimate, reaching a sensitivity of 1/20 of the linewidth and a (34±4)-fold enhancement in precision over direct intensity measurements. This enhanced frequency resolution, combined with on-demand storage, retrieval, and mode-conversion capabilities, establishes a pathway toward multifunctional memory-based time-frequency sensors and their integration within quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于温热铯蒸气中模选择性原子拉曼量子存储的平台，用于超分辨频率估计。通过精确设计光物质相互作用，存储器能够高保真地存储最优时间模并按需读出，从而显著降低模式串扰。实验结果表明，该方案在两条谱线间隔估计中可实现远优于直接强度测量的频率分辨率。
authors: Shicheng Zhang, Aonan Zhang, Ilse Maillette de Buy Wenniger, Paul M. Burdekin, Steven Sagona-Stophel, Anindya Rastogi, Sarah E. Thomas, Ian A. Walmsley
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高精度光学频率测量是现代科学与技术的基础，但传统光谱技术难以分辨亚线宽的光谱特征。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于模选择性原子拉曼量子存储的平台，用于在温热铯蒸气中实现超分辨频率估计。通过精确设计光-物质相互作用，该存储器能够以高保真度相干地存储最优时间模，并按需读出，实现低至 0.34% 的模式串扰。为了估计两条谱线之间的间隔，我们实验测量了频率估计的均方误差，达到线宽的 1/20 灵敏度，并且相对于直接强度测量实现了 (34±4) 倍的精度提升。该增强的频率分辨率结合按需存储、读出和模转换能力，为多功能基于存储器的时频传感器及其在量子网络中的集成奠定了路径。

articles.title: The hidden structure of innovation networks
articles.title_zh: 创新网络的隐结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10224v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Innovation emerges from complex collaboration patterns - among inventors, firms, or institutions. However, not much is known about the overall mesoscopic structure around which inventive activity self-organizes. Here, we tackle this problem by employing patent data to analyze both individual (co-inventorship) and organization (co-ownership) networks in three strategic domains (artificial intelligence, biotechnology and semiconductors). We characterize the mesoscale structure (in terms of clusters) of each domain by comparing two alternative methods: a standard baseline - modularity maximization - and one based on the minimization of the Bayesian Information Criterion, within the Stochastic Block Model and its degree-corrected variant. We find that, across sectors, inventor networks are denser and more clustered than organization ones - consistently with the presence of small recurrent teams embedded into broader institutional hierarchies - whereas organization networks have a neater role-based structures, with few bridging firms coordinating the most peripheral ones; still, both are characterized by the presence of local core-periphery structures. We also find that the discovered meso-structures are connected to innovation output. In particular, Lorenz curves of forward citations show a pervasive inequality in technological influence: across sectors and methods, both inventor (especially) and organization networks consistently show high levels of concentration of citations in a few of the discovered clusters. Our results demonstrate that the baseline modularity-based method may not be capable of fully capturing the way collaborations drive the spreading of inventive impact across technological domains. This is due to the presence of local hierarchies that call for the more refined tools of Bayesian inference.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用专利数据研究发明活动在发明人、企业和机构之间如何自组织成中观结构。作者比较了模块度最大化与基于贝叶斯信息准则最小化的两类方法，发现发明人网络通常比组织网络更稠密、更聚类，而组织网络则呈现更清晰的角色结构。研究还表明，发现的中观结构与创新产出高度相关，少数簇中集中分布着大量前向引用。
authors: Lorenzo Emer, Anna Gallo, Mattia Marzi, Andrea Mina, Tiziano Squartini, Andrea Vandin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 创新源于复杂的协作模式——这些模式发生在发明人、企业或机构之间。然而，对于围绕发明活动自组织形成的整体中观结构，人们所知并不多。在这里，我们利用专利数据，同时分析三个战略领域（人工智能、生物技术和半导体）中的个体（共同发明）网络与组织（共同所有）网络，以解决这一问题。我们通过比较两种替代方法来刻画每个领域的中尺度结构（以簇的形式表示）：一种是标准基线——模块度最大化；另一种是在随机块模型及其度校正变体框架内、基于最小化贝叶斯信息准则的方法。我们发现，在各个行业中，发明人网络比组织网络更稠密、聚类程度更高——这与小型、重复出现的团队嵌入于更广泛的机构层级之中相一致——而组织网络则具有更清晰的基于角色的结构，只有少数起桥接作用的企业协调最外围的企业；尽管如此，两类网络都表现出局部核心-边缘结构的存在。我们还发现，所发现的中观结构与创新产出相关。特别是，前向引用的洛伦兹曲线显示技术影响存在广泛的不平等：跨行业和跨方法来看，发明人网络（尤其如此）和组织网络都一致表现出引用高度集中于少数几个已发现簇中的现象。我们的结果表明，基于模块度的基线方法可能无法完全捕捉协作如何推动技术领域中发明影响扩散的方式。这是由于存在局部层级结构，因此需要更精细的贝叶斯推断工具。

articles.title: A robust and stable hybrid neural network/finite element method for 2D flows that generalizes to different geometries
articles.title_zh: 一种稳健且稳定的二维流体混合神经网络/有限元方法，可推广到不同几何形状
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.16598v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The deep neural network multigrid solver (DNN-MG) combines a coarse-grid finite element simulation with a deep neural network that corrects the solution on finer grid levels, thereby improving the computational efficiency. In this work, we discuss various design choices for the DNN-MG method and demonstrate significant improvements in accuracy and generalizability when applied to the solution of the nonstationary Navier-Stokes equations. We investigate the stability of the hybrid simulation and show how the neural networks can be made more robust with the help of replay buffers. After an initial single-step training, we run the hybrid simulation for extended periods and compute new reference solutions of the neural network perturbed state for each step. By retraining on this data, the error caused by the neural network over multiple time-steps due to distributional shift can be effectively reduced without the need for a differentiable numerical solver. Furthermore, we compare multiple neural network architectures, including recurrent neural networks and Transformers, and study their ability to utilize more information from an increased temporal and spatial receptive field. Transformers allow us to make use of information from cells outside the predicted patch even with unstructured meshes while maintaining the locality of our approach. This can further improve the accuracy of DNN-MG without a significant impact on performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一种将粗网格有限元与深度神经网络结合的混合求解器，用于求解非定常 Navier-Stokes 方程。作者通过重放缓冲区增强训练稳定性，并考察了循环神经网络与 Transformer 等不同结构对时空信息利用能力的影响。结果表明，该方法在保持局部性的同时，对不同几何具有更好的泛化能力。
authors: Robert Jendersie, Nils Margenberg, Christian Lessig, Thomas Richter
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深度神经网络多重网格求解器（DNN-MG）将粗网格有限元模拟与深度神经网络结合，由神经网络在更细网格层级上对解进行修正，从而提高计算效率。在这项工作中，我们讨论了 DNN-MG 方法的多种设计选择，并证明当其应用于非定常 Navier-Stokes 方程求解时，在准确性和泛化能力方面都得到了显著提升。我们研究了这种混合模拟的稳定性，并展示了如何借助重放缓冲区使神经网络更稳健。在完成初始的单步训练后，我们对混合模拟运行更长时间，并针对神经网络扰动状态的每一步计算新的参考解。通过在这些数据上重新训练，可以有效减少由于分布漂移导致的、多时间步累积的神经网络误差，而且无需可微数值求解器。此外，我们比较了多种神经网络结构，包括循环神经网络和 Transformer，并研究它们利用更大时间与空间感受野中更多信息的能力。即使在非结构化网格上，Transformer 也允许我们使用所预测补丁之外单元的信息，同时保持我们方法的局部性。这可以在不显著影响性能的情况下，进一步提升 DNN-MG 的准确性。

articles.title: Geometry-Enabled Radiation from Structured Paraxial Electrons
articles.title_zh: 结构化近轴电子的几何诱导辐射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.07858v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a microscopic calculation of spontaneous photon emission by twisted (paraxial) electrons propagating through inhomogeneous, axisymmetric magnetic fields. We construct exact electron states that incorporate transverse mode structure and wavefront curvature by combining the Foldy-Wouthuysen transformation with a geometric framework based on Lewis-Ermakov invariants and metaplectic transformations. We show that the evolution of such structured states corresponds to an open path in the space of quadratic forms, giving rise to a geometric contribution to the emission amplitude that cannot be eliminated by gauge choice or adiabatic arguments. The inverse radius of curvature of the electron wavefront controls a finite-window boundary contribution to the emission amplitude in regions where the external magnetic field vanishes locally, this contribution vanishes when the observation window is extended to infinity. Presented mechanism generalizes Landau-level radiation to nonasymptotic, structured electron states and establishes a direct connection between noncyclic geometric evolution and photon emission.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从微观层面计算了扭曲近轴电子在非均匀轴对称磁场中传播时的自发光子发射。作者构造了包含横向模结构与波前曲率的精确电子态，并指出非循环几何演化会对发射振幅产生不可由规范选择或绝热论证消除的贡献。该机制推广了朗道能级辐射，揭示了结构化电子态几何演化与光子发射之间的直接联系。
authors: M. S. Epov, I. E. Shenderovich, S. S. Baturin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们给出了扭曲（近轴）电子在非均匀、轴对称磁场中传播时自发光子发射的微观计算。我们通过将 Foldy-Wouthuysen 变换与基于 Lewis-Ermakov 不变量和元辛变换的几何框架相结合，构造了包含横向模结构和波前曲率的精确电子态。我们表明，这类结构化态的演化对应于二次型空间中的一条开放路径，从而在发射振幅中产生一种几何贡献，这种贡献不能通过规范选择或绝热论证加以消除。电子波前曲率半径的倒数控制着发射振幅中的有限观测窗口边界贡献；在外部磁场局域为零的区域中，当观测窗口扩展到无穷大时，该贡献消失。所提出的机制将朗道能级辐射推广到非渐近的结构化电子态，并建立了非循环几何演化与光子发射之间的直接联系。

articles.title: Acceleration of relativistic protons in a CME-perturbed solar wind
articles.title_zh: CME 扰动太阳风中相对论质子的加速
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.23723v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate the impact of a Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) on the transport and acceleration of relativistic protons in the solar wind using a coupled 3D Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) simulation and a test-particle approach. The CME is driven by a spheromak injected into a Parker solar wind at a heliocentric distance of 0.139 AU. The trajectories of 5 GeV protons, injected toward the CME from 3 AU, are integrated in the guiding-center approximation and scattered in velocity space with a mean free path łambda|. Our results show that the CME can increase the protons' energy by several GeV. The acceleration occurs during the time particles stream along the portion of a magnetic field line downstream of the quasi-perpendicular portion of the CME-driven shock. In our configuration, the maximum energy gain, which is of the order of a few percent per passage through the acceleration region, occurs when the shock approaches 0.3 AU. Large energy gains require multiple passes through the acceleration region, which is made possible by the combined action of the mirror force and pitch angle scattering. The efficiency of the acceleration on time scales of the order of hours scales as łambda|⁻³/². Energy spectra harden for decreasing parallel mean free path łambda|.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用三维磁流体力学模拟与试验粒子方法，研究日冕物质抛射对太阳风中相对论质子输运和加速的影响。结果表明，CME 可使 5 GeV 质子获得数 GeV 的能量增益，主要发生在准垂直激波下游磁力线区段的传播过程中。多次通过加速区、镜像力与俯仰角散射共同增强加速效率，且效率随平行平均自由程减小而提高。
authors: Ahmed Houeibib, Filippo Pantellini, Lea Griton
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用耦合的三维磁流体力学（MHD）模拟和试验粒子方法，研究日冕物质抛射（CME）对太阳风中相对论质子输运与加速的影响。该 CME 由一个注入 Parker 太阳风中的球马克驱动，注入位置为距日心 0.139 AU。我们在导引中心近似下积分从 3 AU 朝向 CME 注入的 5 GeV 质子的轨迹，并以平均自由程 λ 对其速度空间进行散射。我们的结果表明，CME 可以使质子的能量增加数 GeV。加速发生在粒子沿 CME 驱动激波的准垂直部分下游的一段磁力线流动期间。在我们的构型中，当激波接近 0.3 AU 时，能量增益达到最大，其量级为每次通过加速区获得几个百分点的增益。大的能量增益需要多次通过加速区，而这由镜像力和俯仰角散射的共同作用所实现。在小时量级时间尺度上，加速效率按 λ⁻³/² 的规律缩放。随着平行平均自由程 λ 减小，能谱变硬。

articles.title: Resource-efficient Quantum Algorithms for Selected Hamiltonian Subspace Diagonalization
articles.title_zh: 用于选定哈密顿子子空间对角化的资源高效量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13160v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum algorithms for selecting a subspace of Hamiltonians to diagonalize have emerged as a promising alternative to variational algorithms in the NISQ era. So far, such algorithms, which include the quantum selected configuration interaction (QSCI) and sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), have been formulated within second-quantization in Fock space, which leads to inefficient usage of qubit resources. We introduce the first QSCI algorithm developed in the CI-matrix (CIM) framework, which is known to have optimal qubit scaling of exactly łceil łog₂ (N) c̊eil where N is the size of the CIM. In addition, we introduce a novel single-bit flip error mitigation which comes at the overhead of a single qubit and we combine this with a stochastic approximate Trotterization evolution adapted from qDRIFT. Simulating benchmark N₂ and naphthalene molecules on quantum hardware, our results achieved similar accuracy as SQD methods but with significantly less quantum resources. However, our CIM-QSCI algorithm and SQD methods could not match the performance of classical heat-bath CI (HCI) for the same task. Hence, we introduce an augmented version of QSCI called quantum selected heat-bath CI (QSHCI). This variant replaces classical heat-bath sampling with quantum sampling from QSCI to achieve performance comparable to HCI. We note that a current drawback of our approach is the preprocessing cost of O(N²łog N) for constructing the CIM and performing the Pauli decomposition. This can be further improved by considering efficient CIM access models for the stochastic Trotter evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了首个基于 CI 矩阵框架的量子选定组态相互作用算法，以改善以往 Fock 空间二次量子化方法的量子比特资源效率。作者还引入单比特翻转误差缓解与随机近似 Trotter 演化，并在 N₂ 和萘分子基准中展示了接近 SQD 的精度且量子资源更少。由于该方法仍不及经典热浴 CI，作者进一步提出 QSHCI 以结合量子采样与热浴思想，但当前仍存在构造 CI 矩阵和 Pauli 分解的预处理开销。
authors: Vincent Graves, Manqoba Q. Hlatshwayo, Theodoros Kapourniotis, Konstantinos Georgopoulos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于选择哈密顿子子空间并进行对角化的量子算法，已成为 NISQ 时代变分算法的一种有前景替代方案。迄今为止，这类算法，包括量子选定组态相互作用（QSCI）和基于采样的量子对角化（SQD），都是在 Fock 空间的二次量子化框架内表述的，这导致量子比特资源使用效率较低。我们引入了第一个在 CI 矩阵（CIM）框架中发展的 QSCI 算法，而该框架已知具有精确为 ⌈log₂(N)⌉ 的最优量子比特缩放，其中 N 是 CIM 的大小。此外，我们提出了一种新的单比特翻转误差缓解方法，其额外开销仅为一个量子比特，并将其与一种改编自 qDRIFT 的随机近似 Trotter 化演化相结合。在量子硬件上模拟基准 N₂ 和萘分子时，我们的结果达到了与 SQD 方法相近的精度，但所需量子资源显著更少。然而，我们的 CIM-QSCI 算法和 SQD 方法在同一任务上无法达到经典热浴 CI（HCI）的性能。因此，我们提出了一种增强版 QSCI，称为量子选定热浴 CI（QSHCI）。该变体以来自 QSCI 的量子采样替代经典热浴采样，从而达到可与 HCI 相比的性能。我们指出，当前方法的一个缺点是构造 CIM 和执行 Pauli 分解需要 O(N²log N) 的预处理成本。通过为随机 Trotter 演化考虑高效的 CIM 访问模型，可以进一步改进这一点。

articles.title: Cherenkov plasmons emission by primordial neutrinos
articles.title_zh: 原初中微子的切伦科夫等离激元发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.00044v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the emission of Cherenkov plasmons by the gas of neutrinos with a nonzero temperature and a chemical potential. The background plasma, consisting of charged leptons, is taken to be nonrelativistic. The energy emission rate is obtained for longitudinal plasmons. To get the neutrino emissivity we average quantum field theory matrix element over the distribution functions of incoming and outgoing particles. Our results are applied for the description of the cooling down of a neutrino cluster formed in the early universe. Such clusters can exist owing to the neutrino interaction with a hypothetical light scalar boson. Using particular cluster parameters, we demonstrate that the considered cooling mechanism is efficient for some clusters. We find the temperature range where the proposed cooling channel is valid. Some useful calculations of the polarization tensor, as well as the plasmon form factors and their dispersion relations are also provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有非零温度和化学势的中微子气体发射切伦科夫等离激元的过程，并假设由带电轻子组成的背景等离子体为非相对论性。作者计算了纵向等离激元的能量发射率，并将结果用于早期宇宙中中微子团簇冷却的描述。研究表明，在特定团簇参数下，该冷却机制对某些团簇有效，并给出了适用的温度范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有非零温度和化学势的中微子气体对切伦科夫等离激元的发射。由带电轻子组成的背景等离子体被认为是非相对论性的。我们得到了纵向等离激元的能量发射率。为得到中微子发射率，我们对入射和出射粒子的分布函数平均了量子场论矩阵元。我们的结果被用于描述早期宇宙中形成的中微子团簇的冷却。这类团簇可以因中微子与一种假想的轻标量玻色子的相互作用而存在。使用特定的团簇参数，我们证明所考察的冷却机制对某些团簇是有效的。我们找到了所提出冷却通道适用的温度范围。文中还提供了极化张量以及等离激元形状因子及其色散关系的一些有用计算。

articles.title: Global monitoring of methane point sources using deep learning on hyperspectral radiance measurements from EMIT
articles.title_zh: 利用 EMIT 高光谱辐亮度测量和深度学习开展全球甲烷点源监测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.10094v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Anthropogenic methane (CH4) point sources are critical drivers of near-term climate forcing, safety hazards, and system-inefficiencies. Space-based imaging spectroscopy is an emerging tool for identifying emissions globally, but existing approaches largely rely on manual plume identification. Here, we present the Methane Analysis and Plume Localization with EMIT (MAPL-EMIT) model, an end-to-end vision transformer framework that leverages the complete radiance spectrum from the Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation (EMIT) instrument to jointly retrieve methane enhancements across all pixels within a scene. This approach brings together spectral information with spatial context to significantly lower detection limits. MAPL-EMIT simultaneously supports enhancement quantification, plume delineation, and source localization, even for overlapping plumes. The model was trained on 3.6 million physics-based synthetic plumes injected into global EMIT radiance data. Synthetic evaluation confirms the model's ability to identify plumes with high recall and precision and to capture weaker plumes relative to existing matched-filter approaches. On real-world benchmarks, MAPL-EMIT captures 84% of known hand-annotated NASA-L2B plume complexes across a test set of 1084 EMIT granules, while capturing roughly 1.5 times as many plausible plumes compared to human analysts. Further verification against coincident airborne data, top-emitting landfills, and controlled release experiments confirms the model's ability to identify previously uncaptured sources. By incorporating model-generated metrics such as spectral fit scores and estimated noise levels, the framework can limit false-positives. Overall, MAPL-EMIT enables high-throughput implementation on the full EMIT data catalog, shifting methane monitoring to a rapid, scalable paradigm for global plume mapping at the facility scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 MAPL-EMIT 模型，利用 EMIT 仪器的完整辐亮度光谱与视觉 Transformer 框架，实现全球甲烷羽流增强量反演、羽流勾勒和源定位。模型在注入全球 EMIT 辐亮度数据的 360 万个物理合成羽流上训练，相比传统匹配滤波方法可捕捉更弱羽流。真实基准和多源验证显示，该方法能够以设施尺度支持快速、可扩展的全球甲烷羽流制图，并通过拟合和噪声指标控制误报。
authors: Vishal V. Batchu, Michelangelo Conserva, Alex Wilson, Anna M. Michalak, Varun Gulshan, Philip G. Brodrick, Andrew K. Thorpe, Christopher V. Arsdale
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人为甲烷（CH4）点源是近期气候强迫、安全风险和系统低效率的关键驱动因素。星载成像光谱学是全球识别排放的一种新兴工具，但现有方法在很大程度上依赖人工识别羽流。在这里，我们提出 Methane Analysis and Plume Localization with EMIT（MAPL-EMIT）模型，这是一个端到端视觉 Transformer 框架，利用 Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation（EMIT）仪器的完整辐亮度光谱，在一个场景内对所有像素的甲烷增强进行联合反演。该方法将光谱信息与空间上下文结合起来，从而显著降低检测限。MAPL-EMIT 同时支持增强量定量、羽流边界刻画和源定位，即使对于相互重叠的羽流也是如此。该模型在 360 万个基于物理的合成羽流上训练，这些合成羽流被注入全球 EMIT 辐亮度数据中。合成评估证实，该模型能够以高召回率和高精度识别羽流，并且相对于现有匹配滤波方法能够捕捉更弱的羽流。在真实世界基准上，MAPL-EMIT 在由 1084 个 EMIT 数据颗粒组成的测试集中捕捉到 84% 的已知人工标注 NASA-L2B 羽流复合体，同时捕捉到的可信羽流数量约为人工分析人员的 1.5 倍。与同时段机载数据、高排放垃圾填埋场和受控释放实验的进一步验证，确认了该模型识别此前未被捕获源的能力。通过纳入模型生成的指标，如光谱拟合分数和估计噪声水平，该框架可以限制假阳性。总体而言，MAPL-EMIT 能够在完整 EMIT 数据目录上实现高通量应用，将甲烷监测转向一种面向设施尺度全球羽流制图的快速、可扩展范式。

articles.title: JAX-AMG: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Sparse Linear Solver Library for JAX
articles.title_zh: JAX-AMG：面向 JAX 的 GPU 加速可微稀疏线性求解器库
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09001v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sparse linear systems from PDE discretizations are central to scientific computing, yet no existing JAX-ecosystem solver simultaneously provides GPU-accelerated algebraic multigrid (AMG), automatic differentiation (AD), and distributed multi-GPU execution. JAX-AMG fills this gap by wrapping the NVIDIA AmgX solver suite as a native JAX primitive, exposing AMG and Krylov methods with configurable preconditioners through a unified interface compatible with JIT compilation, reverse-mode AD via adjoint methods, batched solves, and MPI-based distributed execution. Solver caching amortizes setup costs across repeated solves, making JAX-AMG practical for PDE-constrained optimization and inverse problems. The result is a robust, scalable sparse linear algebra layer that integrates seamlessly into differentiable simulation and scientific machine learning pipelines.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍 JAX-AMG，一个将 NVIDIA AmgX 求解器套件封装为原生 JAX primitive 的稀疏线性求解器库。它同时支持 GPU 加速代数多重网格、Krylov 方法、自动微分、批量求解和基于 MPI 的分布式多 GPU 执行。通过求解器缓存摊销设置成本，JAX-AMG 适用于 PDE 约束优化、反问题、可微仿真和科学机器学习流程。
authors: Yi Liu, Xiantao Fan, Jian-Xun Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 来自 PDE 离散化的稀疏线性系统是科学计算的核心，但现有 JAX 生态系统求解器尚无一种能够同时提供 GPU 加速代数多重网格（AMG）、自动微分（AD）和分布式多 GPU 执行。JAX-AMG 通过将 NVIDIA AmgX 求解器套件封装为原生 JAX primitive 来填补这一空白，并通过一个与 JIT 编译、基于伴随方法的反向模式 AD、批量求解以及基于 MPI 的分布式执行兼容的统一接口，暴露带有可配置预条件子的 AMG 和 Krylov 方法。求解器缓存可在重复求解中摊销设置成本，使 JAX-AMG 对 PDE 约束优化和反问题具有实用性。其结果是一个稳健、可扩展的稀疏线性代数层，可无缝集成到可微仿真和科学机器学习流水线中。

articles.title: Automorphism-Induced Non-Canonicity in Top-k Explanations of Graph Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 图神经网络 Top-k 解释中的自同构诱导非规范性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A gradient-based GNN explainer given a molecule with two chemically equivalent nitro groups assigns them attribution scores that are equal to the last bit. It cannot do otherwise: message passing is exactly permutation equivariant, so any automorphism of the input leaves every attribution invariant. Yet the standard report, the top-k edges, names one of the two, and which one is settled by the order of an array. We show this is a structural obstruction rather than an implementation slip. When no minimal valid explanation is fixed by the input's automorphism group, no rule can be single-valued, minimal and symmetry-respecting at once. For the exact-k reports used in practice we give a parameter-free criterion, mechanised in Lean 4 with no axiom dependencies, that decides from the graph alone whether every score-optimal report of that size must split an orbit. Across 21298 instance-budget decisions the criterion agrees with a mechanical model-equivalence check without exception, and no severing case we found admitted a neutral alternative. The obstruction is common. Nontrivial automorphisms occur in 93.4% of Mutagenicity, the dataset the seminal explainability papers use, so the measure-zero dismissal of symmetric inputs, sound on the continuous domains it was made for, collapses here. At the sparsity budget those papers report, 24.0% of molecules with two interchangeable nitro groups (6 of 25) surface exactly one of them, every one arbitrary under mechanical verification. A model's blindness also manufactures symmetry: every MUTAG molecule contains atoms chemistry separates and the network provably cannot, and a matched control shows the resolution is set by what the model reads rather than how it is parameterised. Reporting orbits removes the arbitrariness at 0.11 ms and 0.43 extra edges per graph.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，图神经网络解释中的 Top-k 边报告在存在输入自同构时会产生结构性任意性，而非简单实现错误。由于消息传递严格满足置换等变性，化学等价结构的归因无法被模型区分，但 Top-k 报告仍可能因数组顺序任意选择其中之一。作者给出形式化判据并在 Lean 4 中机械化验证，发现该问题在常用分子数据集中相当普遍，而报告轨道可低成本消除任意性。
authors: Xin Xu, Siru Tao, Kaizhen Tan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一个基于梯度的 GNN 解释器在给定一个含有两个化学等价硝基的分子时，会为它们分配精确到最后一位都相等的归因分数。它不可能做出其他结果：消息传递严格地具有置换等变性，因此输入的任何自同构都会使每个归因保持不变。然而标准报告，即 top-k 边，会指定这两个硝基中的一个，而究竟是哪一个则由数组的顺序决定。我们表明，这是一个结构性障碍，而不是实现疏漏。当不存在被输入自同构群固定的最小有效解释时，没有任何规则能够同时是单值的、最小的并且尊重对称性。对于实践中使用的 exact-k 报告，我们给出一个无参数判据，该判据在 Lean 4 中被机械化实现且不依赖任何公理，能够仅从图本身决定该大小的每个分数最优报告是否都必须切分一个轨道。在 21298 个实例—预算决策中，该判据与机械化模型等价性检查完全一致，没有例外，并且我们发现的任何切分案例都没有允许中性替代方案。该障碍很常见。在开创性可解释性论文所使用的 Mutagenicity 数据集中，93.4% 的样本存在非平凡自同构，因此把对称输入视为测度为零的排除理由，虽然在其原本针对的连续域中是合理的，但在这里失效了。在那些论文报告的稀疏性预算下，含有两个可互换硝基的分子中有 24.0%（25 个中的 6 个）恰好显示其中一个，而其中每一个在机械验证下都是任意的。模型的盲视也会制造对称性：每个 MUTAG 分子都包含化学上可区分但网络被证明无法区分的原子，而匹配对照表明，分辨率由模型读取的内容决定，而不是由其参数化方式决定。报告轨道可在 0.11 毫秒和每图额外 0.43 条边的代价下消除这种任意性。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作讨论了图神经网络解释中因图自同构导致的非唯一性问题，指出 top-k 解释在对称性下可能无法保持单值、最小和对称一致三者兼得。作者给出了一种判定准则，并用形式化验证证明其正确性。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们使用图神经网络和等变神经网络开展材料建模有间接关系，主要体现在模型可解释性和对称性约束的理论理解上。但它不涉及具体材料物理或材料性质预测。
articles.focus_suggestion: 若团队后续加强 GNN 可解释性研究，可借鉴其关于自同构和解释非唯一性的讨论。对于材料图模型，值得考虑设计更符合物理对称性的解释方法。

articles.title: Q-Steer: Action-Value Guidance for Molecular Policy Optimization
articles.title_zh: Q-Steer：用于分子策略优化的动作价值引导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26391v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Oracle-limited molecular optimization gives reward only after a complete molecule is generated, while each rollout requires many local next-token decisions. This delayed-feedback interface makes molecular policy optimization myopic: an optimizer can learn that a molecule was good without knowing which intermediate actions made it good. We introduce Q-Steer, a rollout-time action-value steering primitive for molecular language models. Q-Steer uses an offline-trained and frozen prefix-action value scorer, PAVS-Q, that estimates the downstream reward of taking a candidate next token under a partial SMILES prefix, then adds a normalized value bonus to sampling logits. The optimizer update rule and online oracle budget are unchanged; the claim is fixed-online-oracle performance, not equal total compute. On PMO23 with a fixed 10,000-call online budget, complete factorial studies across two molecular language-model backbones and four optimizers show that Q-Steer improves mean valid-unique score in all eight backbone-optimizer cells, with positive macro mean-score gains between +0.033 and +0.049 and 18-20 task wins per cell. Mechanism controls show that action identity matters: prefix-broadcast values are nearly neutral, while shuffled action values harm performance. These results support Q-Steer as a reusable rollout-time action-value wrapper that improves average molecular optimization reward across optimizer families and policy backbones without changing the online oracle budget.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Q-Steer，一种用于分子语言模型采样阶段的动作价值引导机制，以缓解分子优化中完整分子生成后才获得奖励所导致的延迟反馈问题。Q-Steer 使用离线训练并冻结的前缀—动作价值评分器，在部分 SMILES 前缀下估计候选下一标记的下游奖励，并将归一化价值奖励加入采样 logits。实验显示，在固定在线 oracle 预算下，该方法在多种模型骨干和优化器组合中稳定提升分子优化平均奖励。
authors: Xinyu Wang, Jinbo Bi, Minghu Song
articles.abstract_zh_full: Oracle 受限的分子优化只有在完整分子生成后才给出奖励，而每次 rollout 都需要许多局部的下一标记决策。这种延迟反馈接口使分子策略优化变得短视：优化器可以学到某个分子是好的，却不知道哪些中间动作使它变好。我们提出 Q-Steer，这是一种用于分子语言模型的 rollout 时动作价值引导原语。Q-Steer 使用一个离线训练并冻结的前缀—动作价值评分器 PAVS-Q，该评分器估计在部分 SMILES 前缀下采取候选下一标记的下游奖励，然后将归一化价值奖励加入采样 logits。优化器更新规则和在线 oracle 预算保持不变；本文主张的是固定在线 oracle 下的性能，而不是相同总计算量。在 PMO23 上，在固定 10000 次调用的在线预算下，跨两个分子语言模型骨干和四个优化器的完整析因研究表明，Q-Steer 在全部八个骨干—优化器单元中都提高了平均有效唯一分数，宏平均分数增益为正，介于 +0.033 到 +0.049 之间，并且每个单元赢得 18—20 个任务。机制控制实验表明，动作身份很重要：前缀广播价值几乎是中性的，而打乱的动作价值会损害性能。这些结果支持将 Q-Steer 作为一种可复用的 rollout 时动作价值包装器，它能够在不改变在线 oracle 预算的情况下，跨优化器家族和策略骨干提升平均分子优化奖励。

articles.title: AgentGFM: A Graph Foundation Model with Node-Agent Information-Flow Control
articles.title_zh: AgentGFM：具有节点代理信息流控制的图基础模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable knowledge from multi-domain graphs and adapt to unseen scenarios. As a fundamental source of relational semantics in graphs, the transferability of topological patterns has long been central to GFM research. However, local structural patterns may vary across graphs and even among nodes within the same graph. Despite such structural variation, most existing GFMs rely on manually designed propagation schemes and apply them to new graphs largely unchanged. Such fixed schemes may not suit the diverse structural patterns of different nodes. This raises a key question: can each node autonomously determine how information should be propagated through the graph? We refer to this capability as information-flow control. Inspired by recent advances in agent technology, we formulate this problem as agent-based decision making and treat each node as an agent. Accordingly, we propose AgentGFM, in which all node agents follow a shared end-to-end trainable policy rather than using independent models. For adaptive information-flow control, each node interacts with the graph through a predict-act-observe-correct process. During the act stage, the node makes three decisions: source reception, signal-channel selection and gain-aware node-wise halting. The resulting observation is compared with the prediction and their discrepancy is used to correct the node state and guide subsequent interactions. Extensive experiments across node-level, graph-level and large-scale transfer scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of AgentGFM across diverse graph topologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 AgentGFM，将图基础模型中的信息传播控制表述为基于代理的决策问题，并把每个节点视为共享可训练策略下的代理。各节点通过预测—行动—观察—校正流程，自主决定源接收、信号通道选择和带增益感知的节点级停止。跨节点级、图级和大规模迁移场景的实验表明，该方法能适应多样图拓扑并提升迁移表现。
authors: Jingbo Cui, Jitao Zhao, Di Jin, Dongxiao He
articles.abstract_zh_full: 图基础模型（GFMs）旨在从多领域图中学习可迁移知识，并适应未见场景。作为图中关系语义的基本来源，拓扑模式的可迁移性长期以来一直是 GFM 研究的核心。然而，局部结构模式可能在不同图之间变化，甚至在同一图的不同节点之间变化。尽管存在这种结构变化，大多数现有 GFM 仍依赖人工设计的传播方案，并在很大程度上不加改变地将其应用于新图。这类固定方案可能并不适合不同节点的多样结构模式。这提出了一个关键问题：每个节点能否自主决定信息应如何在图中传播？我们将这种能力称为信息流控制。受近期代理技术进展的启发，我们将该问题表述为基于代理的决策，并把每个节点视为一个代理。因此，我们提出 AgentGFM，其中所有节点代理遵循一个共享的端到端可训练策略，而不是使用彼此独立的模型。为了实现自适应信息流控制，每个节点通过预测—行动—观察—校正过程与图交互。在行动阶段，节点作出三个决策：源接收、信号通道选择以及增益感知的节点级停止。所得观察与预测进行比较，其差异用于校正节点状态并指导后续交互。跨节点级、图级和大规模迁移场景的大量实验证明了 AgentGFM 在多样图拓扑上的有效性。

articles.title: AIGen: Automating AI Bill of Materials Generation Through Hybrid MLOps Integration
articles.title_zh: AIGen：通过混合 MLOps 集成自动生成 AI 物料清单
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) systems requires rigorous documentation of their constituent artifacts, e.g., datasets, model weights, training pipelines, and runtime dependencies. Although the Software Package Data Exchange (SPDX) 3.0 standard introduced native support for AI and dataset profiles, practical tooling capable of generating standards-compliant AI Bills of Materials (AIBoMs) in an automated and extensible manner remains scarce. This paper presents AIGen, a modular AIBoM generator that produces machine-readable, interoperable inventories of AI system components that comply with the SPDX 3.0 AI profile. AIGen works on top of the MLflow MLOps framework and combines mining heuristics with Large Language Models to generate AIBoMs. A plugin interface allows practitioners to extend the tool with domain-specific collectors without modifying the core codebase, supporting heterogeneous AI frameworks such as Hugging Face, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. AIGen is designed to facilitate compliance with the European Union AI Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and ISO/IEC 42001, providing a concrete, reusable foundation for transparent, accountable AI supply chain governance. Tool URL: https://github.com/danielebifolco/AIGen Tool Video: https://youtu.be/ₙAbXDWfVL4
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 AIGen，一个模块化 AI 物料清单生成器，可生成符合 SPDX 3.0 AI 配置文件的机器可读、可互操作组件清单。AIGen 构建于 MLflow 之上，结合挖掘启发式方法与大语言模型，并通过插件接口支持 Hugging Face、PyTorch、TensorFlow 等异构 AI 框架。该工具旨在支持 AI 供应链的透明、可问责治理，并有助于满足欧盟 AI 法案、NIST AI 风险管理框架和 ISO/IEC 42001 等合规需求。
authors: Federica Pepe, Daniele Bifolco, Costantino Martignetti, Aureliano D'Amici, Fabiano Izzo, Damian A. Tamburri, Massimiliano Di Penta
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工智能（AI）系统的负责任开发和部署，需要对其组成工件进行严格文档化，例如数据集、模型权重、训练流水线和运行时依赖。尽管 Software Package Data Exchange（SPDX）3.0 标准引入了对 AI 和数据集配置文件的原生支持，但能够以自动化且可扩展方式生成符合标准的 AI 物料清单（AIBoM）的实用工具仍然稀缺。本文提出 AIGen，这是一个模块化 AIBoM 生成器，可生成符合 SPDX 3.0 AI 配置文件的、机器可读且可互操作的 AI 系统组件清单。AIGen 构建在 MLflow MLOps 框架之上，并结合挖掘启发式方法与大语言模型来生成 AIBoM。插件接口允许实践者在不修改核心代码库的情况下，用特定领域的收集器扩展该工具，从而支持 Hugging Face、PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 等异构 AI 框架。AIGen 旨在促进对欧盟 AI 法案、NIST AI 风险管理框架和 ISO/IEC 42001 的合规，为透明、可问责的 AI 供应链治理提供一个具体且可复用的基础。作者提供了工具仓库和演示视频。

articles.title: Mixture-of-experts for handwriting trajectory reconstruction from IMU sensors
articles.title_zh: 用于从 IMU 传感器重建手写轨迹的专家混合模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26708v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The use of digital pens for online handwriting trajectory reconstruction is a prevalent method for human-computer interaction. In this study, we focus on a digital pen equipped with sensors where we aim at reconstructing the online handwriting trajectory. This pen enables writing on any surface and preserving the digital trace of handwriting. This type of pen could be used as an aid to learning to write in classroom. In this paper, we propose a new approach learning to finely reconstruct the touching trajectories while precisely analyzing the hovering part in order to position the next touching trace correctly. This relies on a Mixture-Of-Experts (MOE) approach. The first expert is dedicated for the pencil touch, and is named touching expert model. The second one is dedicated for the hovering pen trajectory, and is named hovering expert model. We improve on the learning of each of these experts based on additional context or specific examples. In addition we introduce a novel public benchmark dataset, to enable future research and comparisons in the field of handwriting reconstruction. The results demonstrates a significant enhancement compared to its primary competitors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究配备传感器的数字笔在任意表面书写时的在线手写轨迹重建问题，并提出基于专家混合模型的新方法。该方法分别使用触碰专家和悬停专家来精细重建落笔轨迹并分析悬空运动，以更准确地定位下一段落笔轨迹。作者还发布新的公共基准数据集，实验显示该方法相较主要竞争方法有显著提升。
authors: Florent Imbert, Eric Anquetil, Yann Soullard, Romain Tavenard
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用数字笔进行在线手写轨迹重建是人机交互中的一种常见方法。在本研究中，我们关注一种配备传感器的数字笔，目标是重建在线手写轨迹。这支笔能够在任意表面上书写，并保存手写的数字轨迹。这类笔可在课堂中用作学习书写的辅助工具。在本文中，我们提出一种新方法，学习精细重建触碰轨迹，同时精确分析悬停部分，以便正确定位下一段触碰痕迹。该方法依赖于专家混合（MOE）方法。第一个专家专用于铅笔触碰，称为触碰专家模型。第二个专家专用于笔的悬停轨迹，称为悬停专家模型。我们基于额外上下文或特定示例改进了每个专家的学习。此外，我们引入了一个新的公共基准数据集，以支持手写重建领域的未来研究和比较。结果表明，与其主要竞争方法相比，该方法取得了显著提升。

articles.title: Equilibrium Training of Energy-Based Models with Parallel Trajectory Tempering
articles.title_zh: 采用并行轨迹温度调节的能量模型平衡训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Energy-Based Models (EBMs) provide an interpretable framework for generative modeling of scientific data, but poor Markov Chain Monte Carlo mixing often limits their reliability. We introduce a training algorithm based on Parallel Trajectory Tempering (PTT), which exploits the continuity of the optimization path to maintain equilibrium sampling throughout learning. This enables stable and fast training on highly multimodal and data-scarce scientific datasets. Combined with reservoir sampling and adaptive optimization, PTT has a computational cost comparable to Persistent Contrastive Divergence, making it a practical replacement for standard training methods. It also provides direct estimates of thermalization times, equilibrium samples from trained models, and accurate log-likelihoods at essentially no additional cost. Experiments on Restricted Boltzmann Machines show that PTT consistently outperforms existing EBM training approaches. On discrete tabular data, it also surpasses state-of-the-art deep generative models, yielding higher-quality samples and greater robustness to overfitting and limited data. Our results make equilibrium maximum-likelihood training of EBMs practical and computationally efficient.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于并行轨迹温度调节的能量模型训练算法，旨在缓解马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合不佳导致的可靠性问题。该方法利用优化路径的连续性，在学习过程中维持平衡采样，并结合蓄水池采样与自适应优化，使计算成本接近持久对比散度。实验表明，该方法在受限玻尔兹曼机和离散表格数据上优于现有训练方法及部分先进深度生成模型，并提高样本质量与抗过拟合能力。
authors: Nicolas Béreux, Aurélien Decelle, Cyril Furtlehner, Beatriz Seoane
articles.abstract_zh_full: 能量模型（EBM）为科学数据的生成建模提供了一个可解释框架，但马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合不佳常常限制其可靠性。我们提出一种基于并行轨迹温度调节（PTT）的训练算法，该算法利用优化路径的连续性，在整个学习过程中维持平衡采样。这使得在高度多模态且数据稀缺的科学数据集上实现稳定而快速的训练成为可能。结合蓄水池采样和自适应优化，PTT 的计算成本与持久对比散度相当，使其成为标准训练方法的实用替代方案。它还能够在基本没有额外成本的情况下，直接估计热化时间、从训练好的模型获得平衡样本，并得到准确的对数似然。受限玻尔兹曼机上的实验表明，PTT 持续优于现有 EBM 训练方法。在离散表格数据上，它也超过了最先进的深度生成模型，产生更高质量的样本，并在过拟合和有限数据方面表现出更强鲁棒性。我们的结果使 EBM 的平衡最大似然训练变得实用且计算高效。

articles.title: From Classification to Regression: Using a Fruitfly to Solve Equations
articles.title_zh: 从分类到回归：利用果蝇机制求解方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a novel approach to regression tasks using classification which is motivated by the mechanism used by fruitflies to sense their environment. Specifically, we formulate a general framework for learning nonlinear input-output relationships by replacing complex global surrogate models with a finite library of representative local patterns. Since scientific data often occupy limited and recurring regions of the input space, we generate predictions by measuring similarities between a query and stored patterns, then combining their associated responses through weighted reconstruction.
