CNN performance depends on interactions among spectral physics, dataset regime, acquisition protocol, validation design, and deployment conditions. We organize the literature around three moderators. First, NIR signals are indirect, highly collinear, and shaped by broad overlapping bands, scattering, temperature, and matrix effects. Second, CNN design should be interpreted through receptive-field reasoning: kernel size, depth, dilation, and multi-scale branches determine the wavelength span available to the model, whereas the effective receptive field indicates which parts are actually used. Third, validation design can behave as a hidden hyperparameter because random splits may reward architectures that exploit shared batch, instrument, season, or process-run structure instead of transferable chemical information. We therefore propose a conditional design framework in which preprocessing, architecture, hyperparameter optimization, transfer evaluation, interpretability, and reproducibility are treated as coupled components. Rather than seeking a universally optimal CNN, the framework aims to support physics-aware, shift-aware, and reproducible model comparison in NIR chemometrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述讨论了卷积神经网络在可见-近红外光谱化学计量学中的应用，并指出文献中关于核大小、网络深度、预处理和迁移鲁棒性的许多“矛盾”其实源于实验条件不完整，而非真正的不相容结论。作者从光谱物理、数据集特征、采集与验证方案、以及部署环境四个维度梳理影响CNN表现的关键因素。文章强调应结合感受野与任务条件进行模型设计，而不是孤立比较网络结构优劣。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近红外（NIR和Vis-NIR）光谱被广泛用于食品、农业、制药、过程分析技术和生物过程监测中的快速、无损分析。然而，近红外化学计量学中的深度学习研究常常在卷积神经网络（CNN）设计方面得出相互冲突的结论，包括卷积核大小、深度、预处理、模型复杂度和迁移鲁棒性。本文综述认为，许多表面上的矛盾反映的是实验条件化不完整，而不是发现彼此不相容。CNN性能取决于光谱物理、数据集状态、采集协议、验证设计和部署条件之间的相互作用。我们围绕三个调节因素组织文献。第一，NIR信号是间接的、高度共线的，并受到宽而重叠的谱带、散射、温度和基质效应的影响。第二，CNN设计应通过感受野推理来解释：卷积核大小、深度、空洞率和多尺度分支决定模型可利用的波长跨度，而有效感受野表明哪些部分实际上被使用。第三，验证设计可能表现为隐藏的超参数，因为随机划分可能奖励那些利用共享批次、仪器、季节或过程运行结构的架构，而不是奖励可迁移的化学信息。因此，我们提出一种条件化设计框架，其中预处理、架构、超参数优化、迁移评估、可解释性和可复现性被视为相互耦合的组成部分。该框架并非寻求一种普遍最优的CNN，而是旨在支持近红外化学计量学中具有物理意识、偏移意识且可复现的模型比较。

articles.title: Practical Quantum Advantage before Fault Tolerance via Quantum-Informed Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 通过量子感知机器学习在容错之前实现实用量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13422v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Early quantum devices can deliver a practical advantage before fault tolerance. The role we identify is a statistical module within a classical scientific workflow: a compressed memory with a collective two-copy readout, evaluated against a verifiable definition of practical quantum advantage. We develop this mechanism in quantum-informed machine learning for chaotic dynamical systems. A family of k-indexed higher-order quantum statistical priors (Q-Priors) hosts the k-point marginal of the invariant measure on n_q = kq qubits. We prove a two-stage advantage. In the representation stage, superposition and entanglement compactly store non-factorisable spatial correlations of the invariant measure on n_q qubits. In the extraction stage, joint Bell measurements estimate any emphpost hoc Pauli functional with a copy-pair count independent of n_q, whereas any adaptive single-copy protocol for the corresponding full-Pauli read-out requires Ømega(2ⁿ_q) copies; this is a provable quantum-classical separation in copy-measurement complexity. The two-copy read-out is realised in simulation and on superconducting processors. Two case studies instantiate the mechanism in workflows of scientific value. In a turbulent channel-flow study, the readout yields the velocity-direction coherence as a named non-diagonal correlator, and the k = 2 Q-Prior recovers invariant-measure statistics that the unregularised baseline loses. In a medium-range weather forecasting workflow on the ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis, the diagonal k łeq 2 Q-Prior steers a Koopman rollout, improves anomaly correlation skill and stabilises long-horizon rollouts against collapse onto a static mean field. Together, the mechanism and these two case studies satisfy our practical-advantage definition, identifying a candidate route to practical quantum advantage before fault-tolerant hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出早期量子设备在容错之前也能作为经典科学工作流中的统计模块，体现出可验证的实用量子优势。作者在面向混沌动力系统的量子感知机器学习框架中构建了高阶量子统计先验，并证明在信息表示与提取两个阶段均存在优势：量子态可压缩存储不可分解相关，而联合Bell测量可用与量子比特数无关的复制对数量估计后验Pauli泛函。该机制已在模拟和超导量子处理器上实现，展示了短期量子硬件的应用前景。
authors: Maida Wang, Xiao Xue, Minh Chung, Peter V. Coveney
articles.abstract_zh_full: 早期量子设备可以在容错之前提供实用优势。我们所确定的作用是经典科学工作流中的一个统计模块：一种压缩记忆，带有集体两副本读出，并依据可验证的实用量子优势定义进行评估。我们在用于混沌动力系统的量子启发机器学习中发展了这一机制。一族以k为索引的高阶量子统计先验（Q-Priors）在n_q = kq个量子比特上承载不变测度的k点边缘分布。我们证明了两阶段优势。在表示阶段，叠加和纠缠在n_q个量子比特上紧凑地存储不变测度的不可因子化空间相关性。在提取阶段，联合贝尔测量能够用与n_q无关的副本对数量估计任意事后Pauli泛函，而用于相应全Pauli读出的任何自适应单副本协议都需要Ω(2ⁿ_q)个副本；这是副本—测量复杂度上的可证明量子—经典分离。该两副本读出在仿真和超导处理器上得到实现。两个案例研究在具有科学价值的工作流中实例化了这一机制。在湍流通道流研究中，读出给出了速度方向相干性这一命名的非对角关联量，并且k = 2的Q-Prior恢复了未正则化基线所丢失的不变测度统计。在基于ECMWF ERA5再分析资料的中期天气预报工作流中，对角的k ≤ 2 Q-Prior引导Koopman滚动预报，提高了距平相关技巧，并稳定了长时程滚动预报，避免其坍缩到静态平均场。总之，该机制和这两个案例研究满足我们对实用优势的定义，指出了一条在容错硬件之前通往实用量子优势的候选路线。

articles.title: Eliminating Propagation Delay: Attention-Based Spatial-Temporal Fusion Graph Convolution Network for Traffic Flow Prediction
articles.title_zh: 消除传播延迟：用于交通流预测的基于注意力的时空融合图卷积网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting traffic flow is crucial to optimizing transportation systems and improving urban mobility. Many graph convolution-based models have been proposed to extract spatial-temporal features and predict traffic flow. However, most focus on spatial-temporal and semantic correlation in topological relationships. There are two primary problems to address. Firstly, the convolutional structure in the model focuses on utilizing static spatial dependencies and spatial-temporal relationships in topological structures, while neglecting the different information propagation delays between adjacent nodes in the convolution. Secondly, these methods often stack a large number of complex structures, resulting in a substantial increase in computational time during the model training phase, thereby disregarding the model's requirements for timeliness. In this paper, we propose a novel network called the Attention-Based Spatial-Temporal Fusion Graph Convolution Network (A-STFGCN). We design a spatial-temporal fusion block to extract the spatial-temporal feature correlations with propagation delay errors removed and to capture both long-term and short-term temporal characteristics of the data within a multi-head self-attention mechanism based on a mask matrix. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate that our method achieves the best overall performance while having good computation and data utilization efficiency compared with the eight baseline methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 交通流预测对于优化交通系统和提升城市出行效率至关重要。现有图卷积模型主要关注拓扑结构中的时空与语义关联，但往往忽视相邻节点之间不同的信息传播延迟，且复杂堆叠结构会带来较高训练开销。本文提出一种新的 A-STFGCN，通过时空融合模块在去除传播延迟误差的同时建模长短期依赖，以兼顾预测效果与效率。
authors: Jinpeng Chen, Ziyu Yu, Tao Wang, Jun Ma, Hongbo Gao, Senzhang Wang, Zufeng Zhang, Kaimin Wei
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测交通流对于优化交通系统和改善城市出行至关重要。已有许多基于图卷积的模型被提出，用于提取时空特征并预测交通流。然而，大多数模型关注拓扑关系中的时空相关性和语义相关性。主要有两个问题需要解决。首先，模型中的卷积结构侧重于利用拓扑结构中的静态空间依赖和时空关系，而忽略了卷积中相邻节点之间不同的信息传播时延。其次，这些方法常常堆叠大量复杂结构，导致模型训练阶段的计算时间显著增加，从而忽视了模型对及时性的要求。本文提出一种新型网络，称为基于注意力的时空融合图卷积网络（A-STFGCN）。我们设计了一个时空融合块，用于提取去除传播时延误差后的时空特征相关性，并在基于掩码矩阵的多头自注意力机制中捕获数据的长期和短期时间特性。在五个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，与八种基线方法相比，我们的方法在具备良好计算效率和数据利用效率的同时，实现了最佳总体性能。

articles.title: Physics-Informed CNN-LSTM for Street-Scale Urban Flood Prediction: Reconciling Aggregate Accuracy and Street-Level Plausibility
articles.title_zh: 面向街道尺度城市洪水预测的物理约束 CNN-LSTM：兼顾整体精度与街道级合理性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning surrogate models trained with mean-squared-error loss produce statistically accurate but physically unconstrained flood predictions: water may flow uphill, appear spontaneously, or smooth over street-level corridors. We develop a physics-informed training framework for CNN-LSTM models that predict urban flood depths at 15 min intervals over a 128x128 spatial grid. Three differentiable penalty terms are embedded into the loss: (i) a gravity loss penalizing depth increases against the water-surface-elevation gradient, (ii) a continuity loss enforcing local mass conservation with rainfall-adaptive thresholds, and (iii) a topography-aware false-alarm penalty modulated by the topographic wetness index (TWI). We evaluate on the Norfolk, Virginia flood dataset spanning two storm events (August 2017 and September 2022, 300 samples), with all variants trained on identical splits and robustness assessed over repeated random splits and leave-one-storm-out tests. A road-proximal evaluation restricted to a TWI-derived street mask quantifies street-level skill. The physics-constrained model achieves near-zero gravity violations (order 1e-6) and the highest street-channel recall (0.77 +/- 0.09 vs 0.44 +/- 0.10 for the unconstrained baseline), the capability most relevant to traffic routing, and its advantage more than doubles on a held-out storm; a uniform false-alarm variant attains 16% lower mean absolute error but suppresses street recall to 0.25. The TWI-modulated penalty reconciles this trade-off: it improves on the uniform variant on every metric, recovering 60% higher street recall at the lowest MAE among constrained variants and the best street-level F1. These results expose a fundamental tension between aggregate pixel-level error and application-specific physical plausibility, and show that terrain-aware loss modulation offers a principled resolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 仅以均方误差训练的深度学习替代模型虽然可能获得统计上准确的洪水预测，但往往缺乏物理约束，出现逆坡流动、水体凭空出现或过度平滑等问题。本文为 CNN-LSTM 洪水预测模型引入物理信息训练框架，在损失函数中加入重力约束、连续性约束和地形相关误报惩罚，以预测街道尺度的城市洪水深度。作者在诺福克洪水数据集上进行了评估，并采用街道掩膜进一步考察道路邻近区域的表现。结果表明，该物理约束模型能显著减少不合理物理违背，并提升街道级预测可行性。
authors: Luc DCosta, Yidi Wang, Jonathan L. Goodall, Rohan Chandra
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用均方误差损失训练的深度学习代理模型会产生统计上准确但物理上不受约束的洪水预测：水可能向上坡流动、凭空出现，或抹平街道级通道。我们开发了一种用于CNN-LSTM模型的物理约束训练框架，该模型以15分钟间隔预测128×128空间网格上的城市洪水深度。三个可微惩罚项被嵌入损失函数中：（i）重力损失，用于惩罚逆水面高程梯度方向的水深增加；（ii）连续性损失，通过降雨自适应阈值强制局部质量守恒；以及（iii）由地形湿度指数（TWI）调制的地形感知误报警惩罚。我们在弗吉尼亚州诺福克洪水数据集上进行评估，该数据集涵盖两次风暴事件（2017年8月和2022年9月，300个样本），所有变体均在相同划分上训练，并通过重复随机划分和留一风暴测试评估鲁棒性。基于TWI导出的街道掩膜进行的道路邻近评估量化了街道级能力。物理约束模型实现了近零重力违规（约1e-6量级）和最高的街道通道召回率（0.77 ± 0.09，而无约束基线为0.44 ± 0.10），这是与交通路径规划最相关的能力，并且其优势在留出风暴上增加到两倍以上；均匀误报警变体取得了低16%的平均绝对误差，但将街道召回率压低至0.25。TWI调制惩罚协调了这一权衡：它在每项指标上都优于均匀变体，在约束变体中以最低MAE恢复了高60%的街道召回率，并取得了最佳街道级F1。这些结果揭示了总体像素级误差与面向应用的物理合理性之间的根本张力，并表明地形感知损失调制提供了一种有原则的解决方案。

articles.title: CondPSE: A Polynomial-Filtered Structural Encoder with Conditional Modulation for Graphs
articles.title_zh: CondPSE：一种带条件调制的多项式滤波结构编码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25169v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Message-passing graph neural networks are bounded by the 1-WL test and can miss topological structure that distinguishes non-isomorphic graphs. Positional and structural encodings (PSE) inject such topology-derived signals, and learned PSE encoders such as GPSE pretrain a single encoder to produce these signals from random node probes, which can then be frozen and reused as inputs across downstream graph models. We present CondPSE, a learned PSE encoder that applies a learnable polynomial graph filter bank to standard Gaussian node probes and refines the resulting structural-response branches through FiLM-style modulation conditioned on cross-filter, local message-passing, and graph-level signals. CondPSE is pretrained to reconstruct node-level positional/structural targets and graph-level invariants, and is then frozen for use as a downstream input encoding. On synthetic structural-discrimination benchmarks, CondPSE separates graph structures that 1-WL-bounded message passing cannot: it raises CSL accuracy from 42.9% to 97.3% and EXP accuracy from 68.3% to 99.9% relative to GPSE, and ablations show that the polynomial filter bank accounts for most of this gain. On real molecular property prediction, the picture is more limited. With a hybrid local-message-passing/global-attention backbone, CondPSE performs comparably to GPSE without surpassing it, and a ZINC backbone sweep shows no consistent ordering between the two encoders. We report these results and discuss why strong synthetic structural discrimination does not, on its own, yield a downstream advantage for frozen learned PSE encoders, including the role of downstream integration and possible mismatch between structural pretraining targets and molecular property labels.
articles.abstract_zh: 消息传递图神经网络受 1-WL 检验能力限制，难以捕获区分非同构图的某些拓扑结构。为此，本文提出 CondPSE，一种学习型位置与结构编码器，它将高斯节点探针输入到可学习的多项式图滤波器组中，并通过受交叉滤波、局部消息传递和图级信号条件化的 FiLM 式调制机制细化结构响应。CondPSE 先预训练以重建节点级位置/结构目标和图级不变量，再冻结作为下游模型输入。实验显示，它在合成结构区分任务上优于 GPSE，并能显著提升难以被 1-WL 区分的图结构识别能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 消息传递图神经网络受限于1-WL测试，可能遗漏能够区分非同构图的拓扑结构。位置和结构编码（PSE）注入这类源自拓扑的信号，而诸如GPSE的学习式PSE编码器会预训练一个单一编码器，从随机节点探针生成这些信号，之后可被冻结并作为输入在不同下游图模型中复用。我们提出CondPSE，这是一种学习式PSE编码器，它将可学习的多项式图滤波器组应用于标准高斯节点探针，并通过受跨滤波器、局部消息传递和图级信号条件化的FiLM式调制来细化所得结构响应分支。CondPSE被预训练以重构节点级位置/结构目标和图级不变量，随后被冻结，用作下游输入编码。在合成结构判别基准上，CondPSE能够分离1-WL受限消息传递无法区分的图结构：相对于GPSE，它将CSL准确率从42.9%提高到97.3%，将EXP准确率从68.3%提高到99.9%，消融实验表明，多项式滤波器组贡献了这一增益的大部分。在真实分子性质预测上，情况更为有限。配合混合局部消息传递/全局注意力骨干网络时，CondPSE的表现与GPSE相当但未超过后者，并且ZINC骨干网络扫描显示两个编码器之间不存在一致排序。我们报告这些结果，并讨论为什么强合成结构判别能力本身并不能为冻结的学习式PSE编码器带来下游优势，包括下游集成的作用，以及结构预训练目标与分子性质标签之间可能存在的不匹配。

articles.title: Multi-Scale Structural Features for Continual, Comprehensible Visual Recognition in a Developmental Learning Framework
articles.title_zh: 面向持续且可解释视觉识别的多尺度结构特征：一种发展式学习框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Contemporary machine learning struggles to learn continually, reuse prior knowledge, and expose a comprehensible internal structure. A recently proposed developmental, gradient-free learning framework addresses these limitations by learning a discrete, topological model of its inputs through local variation and selection, yielding an inherent continual-learning guarantee: new observations refine existing structure without overwriting past knowledge, and without replay buffers or predefined task boundaries. Its extension to visual inputs demonstrated this principle on shape recognition, but relied on a feature representation of limited expressivity that capped recognition accuracy. We introduce a new visual feature representation that encodes shape structure across multiple scales, capturing edge and contour features together with their spatial relations, and integrate it with the network-refinement learning process; we further improve the learning dynamics and the read-out used to predict from the learned model. The study targets two-dimensional shape, with class-incremental MNIST as a controlled, interpretable benchmark in which continual-learning behavior can be measured directly. Our approach substantially increases accuracy over the prior representation, matching or exceeding replay- and regularisation-based baselines at comparable storage while storing no past data, and preserves the framework's defining behavior: earlier-learned classes are retained as new ones are introduced, with no destructive adaptation, and the learned representations remain human-interpretable. What separates the methods is retention: the baselines surrender most of a just-trained class within its own cycle and relearn it afterwards, which ours does not. The significance lies in the manner of learning. The system integrates information one sample at a time while provably preserving its responses to...
articles.abstract_zh: 当代机器学习在持续学习、知识复用以及内部结构可理解性方面仍面临困难。发展式、无梯度学习框架通过局部变化与选择学习输入的离散拓扑模型，从而天然具备持续学习能力：新观测只会细化既有结构，而不会覆盖旧知识。本文在该框架下引入一种新的视觉特征表示，以多尺度方式编码形状结构，捕获边缘、轮廓及其空间关系，并结合网络细化过程与改进的读出机制提升识别性能。研究以二维形状识别和类增量 MNIST 为对象，旨在在可解释设置下验证该表示的有效性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当代机器学习难以持续学习、复用先验知识，并展现可理解的内部结构。近期提出的一种发展式、无梯度学习框架通过局部变异和选择来学习其输入的离散拓扑模型，从而给出内在的连续学习保证：新的观察会细化已有结构而不覆盖过去知识，并且不需要回放缓冲区或预定义任务边界。该框架向视觉输入的扩展在形状识别上展示了这一原则，但依赖一种表达能力有限的特征表示，从而限制了识别准确率。我们引入一种新的视觉特征表示，该表示在多个尺度上编码形状结构，捕获边缘和轮廓特征及其空间关系，并将其与网络细化学习过程相结合；我们还进一步改进了学习动态以及用于从所学模型进行预测的读出机制。本研究聚焦二维形状，以类增量MNIST作为受控且可解释的基准，在其中可以直接测量连续学习行为。我们的方法相较先前表示大幅提高准确率，在相近存储条件下达到或超过基于回放和正则化的基线，同时不存储任何过去数据，并保留该框架的定义性行为：随着新类别被引入，较早学习的类别得以保留，没有破坏性适应，并且学习到的表示仍然可由人理解。区分这些方法的是保留能力：基线方法在其自身周期内会丧失刚训练类别的大部分，并在之后重新学习，而我们的方法不会。其意义在于学习的方式。该系统一次一个样本地整合信息，同时可证明地保持其对……的响应。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Broad Learning System: An Efficient Backpropagation-Free Framework for Solving Partial Differential Equations
articles.title_zh: 物理信息广度学习系统：一种高效的无反向传播偏微分方程求解框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding governing physical laws into deep neural networks. However, their reliance on computationally expensive gradient-based optimization and deep architectures often results in slow training, high computational cost, and limited scalability. In this work, we propose a novel physics-informed broad learning system (PI-BLS), the first physics-informed learning framework based on broad RdNNs. The proposed formulation embeds the governing differential operator and the associated initial and boundary constraints directly into a linear output-layer optimization problem, thereby replacing nonlinear gradient-based training with a deterministic least-squares solution obtained via the pseudoinverse. Consequently, the entire learning process is reduced to a single linear optimization stage while preserving the underlying physical constraints. As a result, PI-BLS offers an efficient learning paradigm for a physics-informed learning framework for solving PDEs that eliminates iterative backpropagation while preserving the underlying physical constraints. Experimental results on representative forward PDE benchmarks demonstrate that PI-BLS achieves competitive and often superior performance with reduced training time and model parameters compared with conventional PINNs.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络通过将控制方程嵌入深度网络来求解偏微分方程，但其依赖代价高昂的基于梯度优化的深层结构，训练缓慢且可扩展性有限。本文提出物理信息广度学习系统 PI-BLS，这是首个基于广义随机神经网络的物理信息学习框架。该方法将微分算子以及初始/边界条件直接嵌入线性输出层优化问题中，用伪逆求解确定性的最小二乘解，从而以单次线性优化替代迭代式反向传播。该框架在保留物理约束的同时，显著提升了求解 PDE 的效率。
authors: Pinki Khatun, M. Sajid, Abhinav Jha, M. Tanveer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理约束神经网络（PINNs）通过将支配物理定律嵌入深度神经网络，已成为求解偏微分方程（PDEs）的有力范式。然而，它们对计算代价高昂的基于梯度优化和深层架构的依赖，常常导致训练缓慢、计算成本高和可扩展性有限。在这项工作中，我们提出一种新颖的物理约束宽度学习系统（PI-BLS），这是第一个基于宽度RdNN的物理约束学习框架。所提出的公式将支配微分算子以及相关初始和边界约束直接嵌入线性输出层优化问题中，从而用通过伪逆获得的确定性最小二乘解取代非线性基于梯度的训练。因此，整个学习过程被简化为一个单一的线性优化阶段，同时保留底层物理约束。由此，PI-BLS为用于求解PDE的物理约束学习框架提供了一种高效学习范式，它在保留底层物理约束的同时消除了迭代反向传播。在代表性正向PDE基准上的实验结果表明，与传统PINNs相比，PI-BLS以更少的训练时间和模型参数实现了有竞争力且往往更优的性能。

articles.title: SpectONet: A Physics-Guided Spectral Deep Operator Network for Euler-Bernoulli Beam Dynamics
articles.title_zh: SpectONet：面向欧拉-伯努利梁动力学的物理引导谱深算子网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper proposes a novel physics-guided spectral deep operator network, termed SpectONet, for solving Euler-Bernoulli beam (EBB) vibration problems. The proposed framework integrates the operator-learning capability of DeepONet with physics-informed constraints and Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto (CGL) sensor placement. Unlike conventional DeepONet frameworks, which commonly employ uniformly distributed sensors, SpectONet uses nonuniform spectral sensor locations with a higher concentration of points near the domain boundaries. This sampling strategy improves the finite-dimensional representation of boundary-sensitive structural responses while requiring only a limited number of branch-network inputs. The governing beam equation, together with the associated initial and boundary conditions, incorporated into the training objective to promote physically consistent and generalizable predictions. Numerical experiments on three synthetic EBB vibration problems and a real-world bridge vibration dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Comparisons with strong baselines such as, Vanilla DeepONet, PI-DeepONet, PINN, and CNN-UNet show that SpectONet consistently achieves lower prediction errors across all considered evaluation metrics. In particular, SpectONet achieves at least (64%) improvement over the considered baseline models across the three synthetic problems and at least (37%) for the real-world problems. These results demonstrate that SpectONet provides an accurate, computationally efficient, and physically consistent operator-learning framework for structural vibration analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的物理引导谱深算子网络 SpectONet，用于求解欧拉-伯努利梁振动问题。该框架将 DeepONet 的算子学习能力与物理信息约束相结合，并采用 Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto 传感器布置，在靠近边界处放置更多非均匀谱采样点，以更好刻画边界敏感的结构响应。训练目标中同时包含控制方程及初始、边界条件，从而促进物理一致且具有泛化能力的预测。作者在合成梁振动问题和真实桥梁振动数据集上验证了该方法，并与多种强基线进行了比较。
authors: Shivani Saini, Ramesh Kumar Vats, Arup Kumar Sahoo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出一种新颖的物理引导谱深度算子网络，称为SpectONet，用于求解欧拉—伯努利梁（EBB）振动问题。所提出的框架将DeepONet的算子学习能力与物理约束以及Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto（CGL）传感器布置相结合。不同于通常采用均匀分布传感器的传统DeepONet框架，SpectONet使用非均匀谱传感器位置，在域边界附近布置更密集的点。这种采样策略改善了对边界敏感结构响应的有限维表示，同时只需要有限数量的分支网络输入。支配梁方程连同相关初始和边界条件被纳入训练目标，以促进物理一致且可泛化的预测。对三个合成EBB振动问题和一个真实桥梁振动数据集的数值实验展示了所提出框架的有效性。与Vanilla DeepONet、PI-DeepONet、PINN和CNN-UNet等强基线的比较表明，SpectONet在所有考虑的评估指标上始终取得更低预测误差。特别地，在三个合成问题上，SpectONet相对于所考虑的基线模型至少提升64%，在真实世界问题上至少提升37%。这些结果表明，SpectONet为结构振动分析提供了一种准确、计算高效且物理一致的算子学习框架。

articles.title: Prototype Adaptation for Zero-Shot sEMG Movement Classification
articles.title_zh: 面向零样本 sEMG 动作分类的原型自适应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) enables the control of prostheses, allowing upper-limb amputees to re-gain some hand function. Most current research focuses on recognizing basic movements for prosthesis control. However, in most daily activities, such as opening a door, combined movements are essential. However, collecting training data for all possible combined movements is time-consuming and requires re-training of the model for any new combination. We propose two novel recognition approaches, Compositional Prototype Interpolation (CPI) and Synthetic Adaptation for Prototypes (SAP), that enable zero-shot learning of combined, novel and unseen movements in Prototype Networks after training only with basic movements. Our methods rest on a linear interpolation assumption in the embedding space, which we study by inspecting the geometry of combined motions in signal and embedding space. In experiments on the NearLab and NinaPro DB3 data sets as well as our newly recorded BasCom dataset, our proposed SAP outperforms prior zero-shot learning methods with accuracy improvements on combined movements of more than 20%. This advantage is maintained in online inference experiments in a user study.
articles.abstract_zh: 表面肌电（sEMG）可用于假肢控制，但现有研究大多关注基本动作识别，而实际日常活动中常常需要组合动作。由于为所有组合动作采集训练数据代价高昂，且新组合出现时通常需要重新训练模型，本文提出两种新的识别方法：Compositional Prototype Interpolation（CPI）与 Synthetic Adaptation for Prototypes（SAP）。这两种方法基于原型网络，在仅使用基本动作训练后，即可实现对组合、未见动作的零样本识别，并依赖嵌入空间中的线性插值假设。实验在 NearLab、NinaPro DB3 和新录制的 BasCom 数据集上进行，结果表明 SAP 在组合动作上的准确率较以往零样本方法提升超过 20%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 表面肌电（sEMG）能够实现假肢控制，使上肢截肢者重新获得部分手部功能。当前大多数研究聚焦于识别用于假肢控制的基本动作。然而，在大多数日常活动中，例如开门，组合动作是必不可少的。然而，为所有可能的组合动作收集训练数据耗时很长，并且对任何新组合都需要重新训练模型。我们提出两种新的识别方法，即组合式原型插值（CPI）和用于原型的合成适配（SAP），使原型网络在仅使用基本动作训练后，能够对组合的、新颖的和未见过的动作进行零样本学习。我们的方法基于嵌入空间中的线性插值假设，并通过考察组合动作在信号空间和嵌入空间中的几何结构来研究这一假设。在NearLab和NinaPro DB3数据集以及我们新记录的BasCom数据集上的实验中，我们提出的SAP优于既有零样本学习方法，在组合动作上的准确率提升超过20%。这一优势在用户研究中的在线推理实验中仍得以保持。

articles.title: Matryoshka Agent: Unfolding Sub-Agents for Long-Horizon Machine Learning Engineering
articles.title_zh: Matryoshka Agent：面向长程机器学习工程的子代理展开式框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25090v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning engineering (MLE) tasks require long-horizon decision making over iterative solution debugging and refinement, under expensive and feedback-driven environment interactions. Developing and training a monolithic agent for such tasks is fundamentally challenging, as it must simultaneously manage extremely long and noisy contexts, explore vast solution spaces, and remain effective under limited model capacity and computational budgets. To address these challenges, we propose Matryoshka Agent, a unified hierarchical agent framework for complex long-horizon tasks. Matryoshka Agent decomposes agentic problem solving into a coordinated hierarchy of decision making and execution: a high-level Orchestrator maintains compact, long-horizon exploration states and issues strategic instructions, while lower-level Sub-Agents execute concrete solution attempts through direct environment interaction, mediated by standardized Tool interface. This design decouples strategic exploration from costly execution, substantially reducing the burden of long-context reasoning and enabling efficient iterative refinement. We further develop an efficient training paradigm for Matryoshka Agent. Experimental results on a broad range of MLE tasks with diverse model types and scales demonstrate that Matryoshka Agent is an effective and scalable paradigm for long-horizon MLE tasks and complex agentic problem solving. Notably, Matryoshka Agent enables Qwen3-4B-Instruct to reach Orchestrator performance comparable to o4-mini. Applying Matryoshka Agent to Qwen3-30B-Coder results in at most 36.7% relative performance gain.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习工程任务通常需要在昂贵且反馈驱动的环境交互中进行长程决策，包括反复调试与方案迭代。直接训练单体代理面临长上下文、巨大搜索空间以及有限计算预算等困难。为此，本文提出 Matryoshka Agent，一种统一的层次化代理框架：高层 Orchestrator 维护紧凑的长程探索状态并发出策略指令，底层 Sub-Agents 通过标准化工具接口与环境交互，执行具体方案尝试。该设计将战略探索与高成本执行解耦，降低长上下文推理负担，并支持更高效的迭代改进。
authors: Rushi Qiang, Changhao Li, Haotian Sun, Yuchen Zhuang, Chao Zhang, Bo Dai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习工程（MLE）任务需要在迭代式方案调试和改进中进行长时程决策，并且环境交互昂贵且受反馈驱动。为这类任务开发和训练单体智能体在根本上具有挑战性，因为它必须同时管理极长且嘈杂的上下文、探索巨大的方案空间，并在模型容量和计算预算有限的情况下保持有效。为应对这些挑战，我们提出Matryoshka Agent，这是一种用于复杂长时程任务的统一层级智能体框架。Matryoshka Agent将智能体式问题求解分解为一个协调的决策与执行层级：高层编排器维护紧凑的长时程探索状态并发出战略指令，而低层子智能体通过直接环境交互执行具体方案尝试，并由标准化工具接口进行中介。这一设计将战略探索与昂贵执行解耦，显著降低长上下文推理负担，并支持高效的迭代改进。我们进一步为Matryoshka Agent开发了一种高效训练范式。在涵盖不同模型类型和规模的广泛MLE任务上的实验结果表明，Matryoshka Agent是用于长时程MLE任务和复杂智能体式问题求解的一种有效且可扩展范式。值得注意的是，Matryoshka Agent使Qwen3-4B-Instruct达到与o4-mini相当的编排器性能。将Matryoshka Agent应用于Qwen3-30B-Coder可带来最高36.7%的相对性能增益。

articles.title: Toward an Organizational Science of Multi-Agent LLM Systems: Decoupling Who, How, and Which Algorithm
articles.title_zh: 面向多智能体 LLM 系统的组织科学：解耦“谁、如何以及采用哪种算法”
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25446v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-agent frameworks built on large language models (LLMs) routinely entangle three logically distinct concerns: who is on the team (organization), how members align (coordination), and which algorithm fuses their work (collaboration protocol). IMACS (Intelligent Multi-Agent Collaboration System) separates the three into orthogonal, independently swappable layers. Classic organizational theory (Belbin roles, Mintzberg coordination, RACI accountability) becomes executable, validated configuration, and the framework places six published collaboration algorithms behind a common interface while exposing roles, coordination, and accountability as independently configurable factors. We use this separation to conduct controlled comparisons in which organizational assignments vary while the collaboration protocol is held fixed. It also turns protocol choice into a variable that can be learned: Adaptive Org Routing, a contextual-bandit meta-protocol, selects a protocol per task under an explicit quality-cost tradeoff, outperforms every fixed protocol in a controlled study, and trains online on real benchmark and LLM-judge rewards. The ablations expose a mechanism. Accountability placement changes outcomes exactly when the protocol routes the deliverable through the accountable agent, and the winning placement flips across model families, so organizational design cannot be hard-coded; it must be revalidated, or learned, for each model binding.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体框架通常把三个本质不同的问题混杂在一起：团队中“谁”参与、成员“如何”协调，以及采用“哪种算法”融合各方工作。本文提出 IMACS（Intelligent Multi-Agent Collaboration System），将这三者拆分为彼此独立、可自由替换的层。经典组织理论中的角色分工、协调机制与责任分配被转化为可执行配置，同时将六种已发表协作算法纳入统一接口。作者据此开展受控比较，并进一步提出基于上下文 bandit 的自适应组织路由机制，可按任务选择协作协议，在质量与成本之间取得更优折中。
authors: Huan Chen, Xiang Song, Jian Jin, Pan Ren, Liang-Jie Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 建立在大语言模型（LLM）之上的多智能体框架通常将三个逻辑上不同的关注点纠缠在一起：团队中有谁（组织）、成员如何对齐（协调），以及采用哪种算法融合他们的工作（协作协议）。IMACS（智能多智能体协作系统）将这三者分离为正交且可独立替换的层。经典组织理论（Belbin角色、Mintzberg协调、RACI问责）变为可执行且经验证的配置，并且该框架将六种已发表的协作算法置于共同接口之后，同时将角色、协调和问责作为可独立配置的因素暴露出来。我们利用这种分离进行受控比较，其中组织分配发生变化，而协作协议保持固定。它还将协议选择转变为一个可学习的变量：自适应组织路由是一种上下文老虎机元协议，在显式质量—成本权衡下为每个任务选择协议，在一项受控研究中优于每一种固定协议，并基于真实基准和LLM评审奖励进行在线训练。消融实验揭示了一种机制。当且仅当协议将交付物路由通过负责智能体时，问责位置会改变结果，并且获胜的位置会随模型家族而翻转，因此组织设计不能被硬编码；必须针对每一种模型绑定重新验证，或进行学习。

articles.title: Can Deep Generative Models Reproduce Non-Stationary Gaussian Random Fields?
articles.title_zh: 深度生成模型能否重现非平稳高斯随机场？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25929v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep generative models (DGMs) are widely used for complex high-dimensional data and increasingly applied to spatial and spatio-temporal modeling. Their generated samples implicitly represent the learned data distribution and associated uncertainty. However, for real-world data, assessing whether DGMs have learned the underlying process is difficult because the ground truth is unknown and evaluation often relies on observations alone. We evaluate representative DGMs, flow matching (FM), DDPM, score-SDE, and VAE, on a known non-stationary Gaussian random field. This paper provides comprehensive metrics to assess recovery of the ground-truth mean and covariance structures, with oracle samples and a stationary control as references. All four models recover the mean surface, while their covariance recovery differs across model families: DDPM and score-SDE recover the covariance structure reasonably well, FM exhibits mildly attenuated non-stationarity and slight variance under-dispersion, and VAE has difficulty recovering the covariance structure. An experiment on ERA5 temperature anomalies further demonstrates how the framework can support the validation and development of DGMs for complex real-world spatio-temporal data.
articles.abstract_zh: 深度生成模型已广泛用于复杂高维数据，并逐渐应用于空间和时空建模，但其生成样本是否真正恢复了底层过程仍难以判断，尤其在真实世界数据中缺乏地面真值时更是如此。本文在一个已知的非平稳高斯随机场上评估了代表性的生成模型，包括 flow matching、DDPM、score-SDE 和 VAE，并设计了一组用于衡量均值与协方差恢复情况的指标，以 oracle 样本和稳态对照作为参考。结果显示，四种模型都能较好恢复均值面，但协方差恢复差异明显：DDPM 和 score-SDE 表现较好，flow matching 对非平稳性的刻画略有衰减，VAE 则较难重建协方差结构。作者还在 ERA5 气温异常上进行了实验，说明该评估框架可用于检验空间不确定性建模能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深度生成模型（DGMs）广泛用于复杂的高维数据，并且越来越多地应用于空间和时空建模。它们生成的样本隐式表示了学习到的数据分布及相关不确定性。然而，对于真实世界数据而言，由于真实值未知且评估通常仅依赖观测，判断 DGMs 是否学到了潜在过程是困难的。我们在一个已知的非平稳高斯随机场上评估了具有代表性的 DGMs，包括流匹配（FM）、DDPM、score-SDE 和 VAE。本文提供了全面的指标，用于评估对真实均值和协方差结构的恢复，并以 oracle 样本和一个平稳对照作为参考。四种模型都恢复了均值面，而它们对协方差的恢复在不同模型家族之间存在差异：DDPM 和 score-SDE 能够较好地恢复协方差结构，FM 表现出轻微衰减的非平稳性和轻度方差欠分散，而 VAE 难以恢复协方差结构。在 ERA5 温度异常上的实验进一步表明，该框架可用于支持对复杂真实世界时空数据的 DGMs 的验证与开发。

articles.title: PEANUT: Perturbations by Eigenvector Alignment for Attacking Graph Neural Networks Under Topology-Driven Message Passing
articles.title_zh: PEANUT：通过特征向量对齐扰动攻击拓扑驱动消息传递下的图神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26136v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs) have achieved strong performance on tasks involving relational data. However, small perturbations to graph structure can significantly alter their outputs, raising concerns about their robustness in real-world deployment in security critical environments. In this work, we study a core vulnerability in MPNNs that explicitly consume graph topology via the adjacency matrix or Laplacian as part of their message passing mechanism. We show that this design choice exposes an extremely vulnerable attack surface, with significant effects even under minimal perturbation. Building on this observation, we propose PEA, a simple, gradient-free, black-box injection attack that requires only a single query to the target model, capitalizing on this vulnerability by constructing a perturbation aligned with a specific significant eigenvector to induce large output deviations. Unlike graph modification attacks, PEA operates under the realistic assumption that adversaries cannot alter the original graph and are limited to injecting new nodes at inference time. PEA requires no iterative optimization, parameter learning, or surrogate models---which require additional training and remain susceptible to differences in model priors and generalization capabilities---thereby avoiding significant computational overhead and the associated transferability challenges. We evaluate PEA on popular benchmark datasets across three graph learning tasks, showing consistent performance degradation under realistic attack constraints despite its simplicity. Our results reveal a fundamental security weakness in topology-driven message passing architectures and urge an implementation shift, as the worst effects of such attacks can be substantially mitigated through appropriate input filtering.
articles.abstract_zh: 消息传递神经网络在关系数据任务上表现突出，但对图结构的微小扰动可能非常敏感，这在安全关键场景中引发了鲁棒性问题。本文研究了一类核心脆弱性：当模型在消息传递中显式使用邻接矩阵或拉普拉斯矩阵等拓扑信息时，其攻击面会变得尤为脆弱。基于此，作者提出一种简单的、无梯度、黑盒的注入攻击 PEA，只需一次查询即可通过构造与某个显著特征向量对齐的扰动来诱导模型输出产生较大偏移。该攻击假设攻击者不能修改原图，只能在推理阶段注入新节点，因此更贴近实际威胁模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 消息传递神经网络（MPNNs）在涉及关系数据的任务上取得了很强的性能。然而，对图结构的微小扰动可能显著改变其输出，这引发了人们对其在安全关键环境中实际部署时鲁棒性的担忧。在这项工作中，我们研究了 MPNNs 中的一个核心漏洞：它们在消息传递机制中通过邻接矩阵或拉普拉斯矩阵显式使用图拓扑。我们表明，这种设计选择暴露了一个极其脆弱的攻击面，即使在最小扰动下也会产生显著影响。基于这一观察，我们提出了 PEA，一种简单、免梯度、黑盒的注入攻击，它只需对目标模型进行一次查询，通过构造与某个特定重要特征向量对齐的扰动来诱导较大的输出偏差。不同于图修改攻击，PEA 采用了更现实的假设，即攻击者无法修改原始图，而仅限于在推理时注入新节点。PEA 不需要迭代优化、参数学习或代理模型——这些方法需要额外训练，并且仍然容易受到模型先验和泛化能力差异的影响——因此避免了显著的计算开销以及相关的迁移性挑战。我们在三个图学习任务的常用基准数据集上评估了 PEA，结果表明，尽管其方法简单，但在现实攻击约束下仍能持续降低性能。我们的结果揭示了拓扑驱动消息传递架构存在根本性的安全弱点，并呼吁调整实现方式，因为这类攻击的最坏影响可以通过适当的输入过滤显著缓解。

articles.title: Structured Scaling of AI Discovery Across Diverse Scientific Domains
articles.title_zh: 跨多科学领域的 AI 发现结构化扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.19341v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scientific discovery often requires many cycles of proposing, testing, and refining candidate solutions. Language models can increasingly participate in these loops, but simply generating more attempts does not ensure progress: parallel searches may duplicate one another and iterative refinement may become trapped in poor directions. The central challenge is therefore not only to scale AI-driven discovery, but to structure that scaling so that evaluation signals compound over time. Here we introduce SimpleTES (Simple Test-time Evaluation-driven Scaling), a framework that focuses on the structured scaling of AI discovery loops, organizing evaluator queries across independent trajectories, iterative refinement, local candidate selection, and the selective reuse of evaluated histories. Drawing on structural features of scientific communities, SimpleTES uses a single open-source GPT-OSS model to establish new state-of-the-art solutions across 28 open-ended problems in diverse scientific domains ranging from quantum physics and astronomy to biology, AI, and mathematics. These include a 24.5% reduction in quantum circuit compilation overhead, up to 23% lower propulsive cost for deep-space trajectories, a 2.17x faster lasso-path solver, an 8.5% lower-error whole-brain neural-activity predictor, the fastest reported TriMul kernel, and new mathematical constructions beyond prior human or AI records. We further post-train the model for long-horizon discovery by assigning each attempt the final outcome of the trajectory it helped produce. This improves performance on both training and held-out mathematics problems, further advancing the frontier. Together, these results establish structured scaling as a general mechanism for advancing AI scientific discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 科学发现通常需要经历提出、测试和修正候选方案的多轮循环。语言模型可以参与这一过程，但简单地增加尝试次数并不必然带来进展，因为并行搜索可能重复，迭代修正也可能陷入错误方向。本文提出 SimpleTES（Simple Test-time Evaluation-driven Scaling），通过组织独立轨迹、迭代精炼、本地候选选择以及对已评估历史的选择性复用，构建一种结构化的 AI 发现扩展框架，使评估信号能够随时间累积。作者使用单个开源 GPT-OSS 模型，在量子物理、天文学、生物学、AI 和数学等 28 个开放式问题上取得了新的最佳结果。
authors: Haotian Ye, Haowei Lin, Jingyi Tang, Yizhen Luo, Rahul Thapa, Caiyin Yang, Chang Su, Rui Yang, Ruihua Liu, Rundao Li, Zeyu Li, Pengwei Sun, Chong Gao, Dachao Ding, Guangrong He, Miaolei Zhang, Lina Sun, Wenyang Wang, Yuchen Zhong, Zhuohao Shen, Puheng Li, Pan Lu, Bianxiao Cui, Di He, Jianzhu Ma, Junfeng Li, Hexi Baoyin, Yejin Choi, Stefano Ermon, Xiaowen Chu, Tongyang Li, Yuzhi Xu, James Zou
articles.abstract_zh_full: 科学发现通常需要经历多轮提出、测试和改进候选方案的循环。语言模型可以越来越多地参与这些循环，但仅仅生成更多尝试并不能保证进展：并行搜索可能彼此重复，而迭代改进也可能陷入糟糕的方向。因此，中心挑战不仅在于扩展 AI 驱动的发现能力，还在于如何通过结构化方式扩展这种能力，使评估信号能够随时间累积。本文提出 SimpleTES（Simple Test-time Evaluation-driven Scaling），这是一个聚焦于 AI 发现循环结构化扩展的框架，它组织评估器查询，以覆盖独立轨迹、迭代改进、局部候选选择以及已评估历史的选择性复用。借鉴科学共同体的结构特征，SimpleTES 使用单个开源 GPT-OSS 模型，在 28 个来自不同科学领域的开放式问题上建立了新的最先进结果，这些领域从量子物理和天文学到生物学、AI 和数学不等。这些结果包括：量子线路编译开销降低 24.5%，深空轨迹推进成本最高降低 23%，lasso 路径求解器速度提升 2.17 倍，全脑神经活动预测误差降低 8.5%，最快已报道的 TriMul 内核，以及超越先前人类或 AI 记录的新数学构造。我们进一步通过将每次尝试都标注为其所帮助产生的轨迹的最终结果，对模型进行长期发现的后训练。这一做法同时提升了训练集和留出数学问题上的表现，进一步推进了前沿。总体而言，这些结果确立了结构化扩展作为推进 AI 科学发现的一般机制。

articles.title: Adaptive Measurement Allocation for Learning Kernelized SVMs Under Noisy Observations
articles.title_zh: 噪声观测下学习核化 SVM 的自适应测量分配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.22275v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Kernel methods are typically formulated under the assumption of exact, noise-free access to the Gram matrix. However, in emerging settings each kernel entry must be inferred from noisy observations, and its accuracy depends on how a limited measurement budget is allocated. Despite this, existing approaches overwhelmingly rely on uniform allocation, which equalizes estimator variance but ignores the highly non-uniform dependence of kernelized classifiers on the Gram matrix. In this work, we formulate measurement allocation for noisy kernel estimation as a task-aware optimization problem tailored to kernelized Support Vector Machines (SVMs). We derive a variance-aware allocation framework that combines classifier sensitivity with estimator uncertainty, leading to a Neyman-type allocation rule for measurement-based kernels and a Bernoulli specialization relevant to quantum kernel estimation. Building on this analysis, we develop an adaptive measurement allocation strategy that combines margin sensitivity and active set instability, concentrating measurements on the most classifier-relevant regions of the kernel matrix. Theoretical analysis reveals distinct allocation regimes governed by the heterogeneity of the induced allocation weights, identifying conditions under which adaptive or uniform strategies are preferable. Experiments on synthetic and quantum-kernel datasets demonstrate improved classifier fidelity relative to uniform allocation, while a dual coefficient stability criterion enables substantial measurement savings through early stopping. Together, these results establish adaptive measurement allocation as an effective alternative to uniform sampling for learning with noisy kernels, improving both predictive accuracy and measurement efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 核方法通常默认可无噪声地精确获得 Gram 矩阵，但在新兴场景中，每个核元素都需要通过有限且带噪的观测来估计。本文将面向核化支持向量机的测量分配表述为任务感知优化问题，结合分类器敏感性与估计不确定性，推导出一种方差感知的分配框架，并给出类似 Neyman 分配的规则以及适用于量子核估计的 Bernoulli 特化形式。基于此，作者提出一种自适应测量策略，将测量集中于对分类边界最关键的核矩阵区域，以提升有限预算下的学习效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 核方法通常建立在能够精确、无噪声地访问 Gram 矩阵这一假设之上。然而，在新兴场景中，每个核条目都必须从带噪观测中推断出来，而其精度取决于如何分配有限的测量预算。尽管如此，现有方法几乎都依赖均匀分配，这种方法虽然能使估计器方差均衡，却忽略了核化分类器对 Gram 矩阵高度非均匀的依赖关系。在这项工作中，我们将带噪核估计的测量分配表述为一个面向任务的优化问题，并针对核化支持向量机（SVM）进行定制。我们推导了一个方差感知的分配框架，将分类器敏感性与估计器不确定性结合起来，从而为基于测量的核导出了一个 Neyman 型分配规则，并给出一个与量子核估计相关的伯努利特化形式。在此分析基础上，我们开发了一种自适应测量分配策略，将边界敏感性与活动集不稳定性结合起来，把测量集中在核矩阵中对分类器最相关的区域。理论分析揭示了由分配权重异质性所控制的不同分配机制，并指出了自适应或均匀策略各自更优的条件。对合成数据和量子核数据集的实验表明，与均匀分配相比，该方法能提高分类器保真度，而一个双重系数稳定性准则则可通过提前停止实现显著的测量节省。综合来看，这些结果表明，自适应测量分配是学习带噪核的有效替代方案，优于均匀采样，并同时提升预测准确性和测量效率。

articles.title: The Ray Tracing Sampler: Bayesian Sampling of Neural Networks for Everyone
articles.title_zh: 射线追踪采样器：人人可用的神经网络贝叶斯采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.25824v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We derive a family of Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling methods based on following ray paths in a medium where the refractive index n(x) is a function of the desired likelihood L(x), extending past work on isokinetic sampling. The simplest ray tracing method propagates rays at constant speed through parameter space, leading to orders of magnitude higher resilience to heating for stochastic gradients as compared to both Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) and Stochastic Gradient HMC, as well as the ability to cross any likelihood barrier, including holes in parameter space. Using the simplest ray tracing method, we sample the posterior distributions of neural network outputs for a variety of different architectures, including a preliminary exploration of the 1.5 billion-parameter GPT-2 (Generative Pre-trained Transformer 2) architecture, all on a single consumer-level GPU. We also show that prior samplers including traditional HMC, the original microcanonical HMC, Metropolis, Gibbs, and even Monte Carlo integration are special cases within a generalized ray tracing framework, which can sample according to an arbitrary weighting function. Public code and documentation for C, JAX, and PyTorch are available at https://bitbucket.org/pbehroozi/ray-tracing-sampler/src
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一类基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛的采样方法，其核心思想是在介质中沿射线路径传播，并将折射率设计为目标似然的函数，从而推广了既有的等动能采样思想。最简单的射线追踪方法在参数空间中以恒定速度传播，相比 HMC 和随机梯度 HMC 对“加热”更具鲁棒性，而且能够跨越任意似然势垒，包括参数空间中的空洞。作者还用该方法对多种神经网络架构的后验分布进行采样，并展示了其在单块消费级 GPU 上对 15 亿参数 GPT-2 架构的初步探索。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推导出一族马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样方法，其基础是在一个介质中沿射线路径传播，其中折射率 n(x) 是所需似然 L(x) 的函数，并将先前关于等动能采样的工作加以扩展。最简单的射线追踪方法以恒定速度在参数空间中传播射线，与 Hamiltonian Monte Carlo（HMC）和随机梯度 HMC 相比，它在面对随机梯度加热时具有数量级更高的鲁棒性，同时还能跨越任何似然障碍，包括参数空间中的空洞。利用这一最简单的射线追踪方法，我们对多种不同架构的神经网络输出后验分布进行了采样，其中包括对 15 亿参数的 GPT-2（Generative Pre-trained Transformer 2）架构的初步探索，而且全部在一块消费级 GPU 上完成。我们还表明，包括传统 HMC、原始微正则 HMC、Metropolis、Gibbs 甚至 Monte Carlo 积分在内的先前采样器，都是一个更一般的射线追踪框架中的特例，而该框架可以按照任意加权函数进行采样。C、JAX 和 PyTorch 的公开代码与文档可在所给地址获取。

articles.title: Kernel Forge: An Agent Harness for LLM-based Generation and Optimization of CUDA Kernels
articles.title_zh: Kernel Forge：面向基于 LLM 的 CUDA 内核生成与优化的智能体框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly embedded in everyday software, and most of their runtime is spent in a small set of compute kernels such as matrix multiplication, convolution, and normalization. Optimizing these kernels is one of the most direct ways to reduce latency and cost, but it has traditionally required expert engineers to hand-write low-level GPU code. Agentic systems built on large language models (LLMs) can now generate and optimize kernels with far less human effort, yet existing tools are largely evaluated on randomly generated tensors and isolated kernels, emit standalone CUDA code that developers must manually reintegrate, mostly target only LLM PyTorch models, and offer limited support for inspecting and debugging results. We present Kernel Forge, an open-source, end-to-end agentic harness that accepts any unmodified PyTorch model in place. Kernel Forge supports vision, diffusion, and LLM workloads, uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore multiple optimization paths rather than a single linear refinement chain, and ships with a graphical user interface for monitoring progress, inspecting candidate kernels, and debugging failures. We evaluate Kernel Forge on four PyTorch models spanning vision, diffusion, and LLM workloads on an NVIDIA DGX Spark with GB10 GPU. With only 50 optimization iterations per kernel, it optimizes 14 kernels to outperform PyTorch eager mode, reaching 1.52× on adaptiveₐᵥgpool2d in ResNet-50, 1.70× on groupₙₒᵣₘ in Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, 2.83× on softmax in Gemma 4 E2B, and 1.54× on softmax in Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出开源端到端智能体框架 Kernel Forge，用于自动生成和优化 CUDA 内核，以减少对人工低层 GPU 编程的依赖。与现有方法不同，它可直接接入未经修改的 PyTorch 模型，支持视觉、扩散和语言模型工作负载，并使用蒙特卡洛树搜索探索多条优化路径，而非单一线性迭代。系统还提供图形界面，便于监控优化过程、查看候选内核并辅助调试。
authors: Joshua Brodsky, Dhravid Kumar, Savini Kashmira, Jayanaka Danatanarayana, Jason Mars, Krisztian Flautner, Lingjia Tang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习模型正越来越多地嵌入日常软件中，而其大部分运行时间消耗在少数计算内核上，例如矩阵乘法、卷积和归一化。优化这些内核是降低延迟和成本最直接的方法之一，但传统上这需要专家工程师手工编写底层 GPU 代码。如今，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统可以以更少的人力生成并优化内核，但现有工具大多是在随机生成的张量和孤立内核上评估的，输出的是开发者必须手动重新集成的独立 CUDA 代码，主要只针对 LLM 的 PyTorch 模型，并且对结果检查和调试的支持有限。我们提出 Kernel Forge，这是一个开源的端到端智能体执行框架，可直接接收任何未修改的 PyTorch 模型。Kernel Forge 支持视觉、扩散和 LLM 工作负载，使用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）来探索多条优化路径，而不是单一的线性改进链，并配备图形用户界面，用于监控进展、检查候选内核以及调试失败情况。我们在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 搭载 GB10 GPU 的环境下，对涵盖视觉、扩散和 LLM 工作负载的四个 PyTorch 模型评估了 Kernel Forge。每个内核仅进行 50 次优化迭代，它就优化了 14 个内核，使其性能超过 PyTorch eager 模式，其中包括 ResNet-50 中 adaptiveₐᵥgpool2d 达到 1.52×，Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 中 groupₙₒᵣₘ 达到 1.70×，Gemma 4 E2B 中 softmax 达到 2.83×，以及 Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B 中 softmax 达到 1.54×。

articles.title: Physics-Grounded Fluid Video Generation with a Simulation Dataset and Dual-Stream Optical-Flow Supervision
articles.title_zh: 融合模拟数据集与双流光流监督的物理约束流体视频生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling content but routinely violate elementary physics when the subject involves fluids: liquid columns break apart in mid-air, container water levels fail to rise as liquid is poured in, and splashes disperse without regard to momentum or gravity. We attribute this gap to the fact that large-scale video-text corpora contain almost no explicit motion supervision, so models learn to imitate fluid appearance rather than dynamics. We address this with two contributions. First, we build a physics-simulation fluid dataset combining 1,638 MPM-simulated pouring/sloshing videos with 2,320 keyword-filtered real pouring videos mined from stock footage, plus two held-out test sets: a 1,515-video real-video benchmark and an 18-prompt text-to-first-frame generalization benchmark. Second, we introduce a dual-stream image-to-video architecture built on a pretrained diffusion-transformer video generator. It augments the standard RGB decoder with a lightweight Optical-Flow Decoder branch trained with explicit end-point-error and smoothness losses, fused into the RGB stream via zero-initialized convolutions so the pretrained backbone starts undisturbed. Only the two decoders are updated; the encoder, temporal transformer, and text encoder remain frozen. Across two model scales (1.3B and 14B) and two test sets, our method improves VideoPhy-2 Physical-Commonsense and Video-Quality scores over the frozen backbone by up to 8.75 and 4.65 points, outperforms a leading open competitor, and is preferred by human raters in a blind study. A direct optical-flow read-out evaluation further shows an end-point error as low as 0.54 pixels in-distribution, confirming the model has internalized a coherent motion prior rather than merely improving surface appearance.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对现有视频扩散模型在流体生成中常违背基本物理规律的问题，本文指出其根源在于大规模视频文本语料几乎缺乏显式运动监督，模型往往只学到外观而非动力学。为此，作者构建了一个流体仿真数据集，包含 MPM 模拟的倒液和晃动视频、从素材库中筛选的真实倒液视频，以及两个独立测试集。与此同时，提出一种双流图像到视频架构，在预训练视频扩散变换器基础上增加轻量光流解码分支，并通过端点误差与平滑性损失进行训练，再以零初始化卷积融合进 RGB 分支。
authors: Ruijie Su, Yuanzhi Liang, Xiaohua Xie, Jianhuang Lai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 视频扩散模型能够生成视觉上引人入胜的内容，但当主体涉及流体时，它们经常违反基本物理规律：液柱会在半空中断裂，向容器中倒液时水位不会上升，飞溅会不顾动量或重力而扩散。我们认为，这一差距源于大规模视频-文本语料库几乎不包含显式运动监督，因此模型学到的是流体外观，而非动力学。我们通过两个贡献来解决这一问题。首先，我们构建了一个物理仿真流体数据集，将 1,638 个基于 MPM 仿真的倒液/晃动视频与 2,320 个通过关键词筛选、从素材视频中挖掘出的真实倒液视频结合起来，并额外设置了两个保留测试集：一个包含 1,515 个视频的真实视频基准，以及一个 18 个提示词的文本到首帧泛化基准。其次，我们提出了一种双流图像到视频架构，建立在预训练的扩散 Transformer 视频生成器之上。该架构在标准 RGB 解码器之外增加了一个轻量级光流解码器分支，并使用显式的端点误差和光滑性损失进行训练，再通过零初始化卷积将其融合到 RGB 流中，从而使预训练骨干在初始阶段不受干扰。只有这两个解码器被更新；编码器、时序 Transformer 和文本编码器保持冻结。在两个模型规模（1.3B 和 14B）以及两个测试集上，我们的方法相较于冻结骨干，将 VideoPhy-2 的物理常识和视频质量得分最高提升 8.75 和 4.65 分，优于一个领先的开源竞争方法，并在盲测中更受人类评分者偏好。直接的光流读出评估进一步表明，在分布内条件下端点误差低至 0.54 像素，证实模型已内化了连贯的运动先验，而不仅仅是改善了表面外观。

articles.title: A Density-Matrix Framework for Electronic-Structure Analysis of Functional-Group and Salt Effects in Lithium-Metal Electrolytes
articles.title_zh: 面向锂金属电解质官能团与盐效应电子结构分析的密度矩阵框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The reactivity of lithium-metal electrolytes arises from the interplay of molecular functional groups, Li⁺ solvation, and salt-anion participation. This interplay operates through the redistribution of electron density across donor, anion, and cation centers, which is most directly read out from the electronic structure resolved in space. Quantum-chemical calculations deliver such readouts faithfully, yet become computationally demanding across this multidimensional design space, and machine-learning electronic-structure models seldom cover chemically diverse solvation shells or electrolyte-relevant readouts. Here, we present a density-matrix-centered AI platform (EMolStudio) for electronic-structure prediction and analysis. Its workflow integrates molecular functionalization, explicit Li⁺ first-shell assembly, density-matrix prediction with idempotency projection, and readouts of frontier orbitals, electrostatic potential, Li⁺⁻donor bond order, and electron localization. We apply EMolStudio to 163,655 functionalized molecules and 22,500 explicit Li⁺ first-shell clusters across four lithium salts. We find that 1) at the molecular scale, functionalization distinguishes CO₂Me, CN, F/CF₃, and sulfonyl groups by chemically distinct changes in frontier levels, electrostatic potential, and Li⁺⁻donor contact, consistent with π^*-acceptor, inductive, and polarization contributions, with sublinear accumulation at higher degrees of functionalization; 2) in explicit solvation shells, anion identity reshapes frontier-orbital localization: LiTDI anchors the HOMO on the anion across the entire library, whereas LiDFOB pairs an anion-hosted HOMO with strongly functional-group-dependent LUMO hosting. EMolStudio thereby translates functional-group and salt choices into electronic-structure hypotheses relevant to lithium-bond formation, desolvation, and interphase reactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 锂金属电解质的反应性来源于分子官能团、Li⁺ 溶剂化与盐阴离子参与之间的耦合，而这种耦合本质上体现为电子密度在供体、阴离子与阳离子中心之间的重新分布。为在更大设计空间中高效获得这种电子结构信息，作者提出了以密度矩阵为核心的 AI 平台 EMolStudio，将分子官能化、显式 Li⁺ 第一溶剂化壳组装、密度矩阵预测及幂等性投影整合到同一流程中，并可输出前线轨道、电势、Li⁺-供体键级和电子局域化等读出量。该平台被用于大规模候选分子与簇体系分析，以研究官能团和盐种对锂电解质电子结构的影响。
authors: Mingkang Liu, Huize Yu, Yanbin Gao, Nan Yao, Xiang Chen, Lei Shen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锂金属电解液的反应性源于分子官能团、Li⁺ 溶剂化以及盐阴离子参与之间的相互作用。这种相互作用通过电子密度在供体、阴离子和阳离子中心之间的重新分布来实现，而这一过程最直接的读出方式，是在空间上分辨的电子结构。量子化学计算能够忠实地给出这种读出，但在这一多维设计空间中会变得计算代价很高，而机器学习电子结构模型很少覆盖化学多样的溶剂化壳层或面向电解液的读出量。这里，我们提出了一个以密度矩阵为中心的 AI 平台（EMolStudio），用于电子结构预测与分析。其工作流整合了分子官能化、显式 Li⁺ 第一壳层组装、带幺正投影的密度矩阵预测，以及前线轨道、电静势、Li⁺-供体键级和电子局域化的读出。我们将 EMolStudio 应用于 163,655 个官能化分子和 22,500 个显式 Li⁺ 第一壳层簇，覆盖四种锂盐。我们发现：1）在分子尺度上，官能化通过前线能级、电静势和 Li⁺-供体接触的化学上不同的变化，将 CO₂Me、CN、F/CF₃ 和磺酰基区分开来，这与 π^*-受体效应、诱导效应和极化效应一致，而且在更高官能化程度下呈次线性累积；2）在显式溶剂化壳层中，阴离子身份重塑了前线轨道局域化：LiTDI 使整个库中的 HOMO 锚定在阴离子上，而 LiDFOB 则表现为由阴离子承载的 HOMO 与强烈依赖官能团的 LUMO 承载相结合。EMolStudio 因而将官能团和盐的选择转化为与锂键形成、脱溶剂化和界面反应相关的电子结构假设。

articles.title: Interactive Reward Agent: GUI Task Evaluation via Environment-State Verification
articles.title_zh: 交互式奖励代理：基于环境状态验证的 GUI 任务评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphical user interface task evaluation aims to determine whether a GUI agent has successfully completed a user instruction. Automated GUI task evaluation has received increasing attention because the evaluation results can serve as reward signals for both test-time scaling and post-training. However, reliable GUI task evaluation remains challenging because the judgments often require access to environment states, such as system configurations, file data, and application settings, beyond the screenshots of execution trajectories. In this paper, we propose an interactive reward agent (IRA) based on a propose-then-verify framework to acquire and verify evidence from the post-execution environment. Given a task instruction and a GUI environment after the GUI agent execution, IRA first proposes the task completion conditions and then verifies them by invoking system tools, application tools, and GUI tools. This design combines evidence from both visible interfaces and the environment state in an interactive process. We further introduce GUI-RewardBench, a benchmark of 321 GUI task trajectories spanning 10 Ubuntu desktop application categories. Experiments show that IRA achieves 86.9% accuracy on GUI-RewardBench, outperforming existing evaluator baselines. We further apply IRA to reinforcement learning of GUI agents, achieving a 34.0% OSWorld success rate, which demonstrates that IRA can provide effective reward signals for training GUI agents.
articles.abstract_zh: 图形界面任务评估旨在判断 GUI 代理是否成功完成用户指令，但仅凭执行轨迹截图往往不足以可靠判定，因为许多任务还依赖系统配置、文件数据和应用状态等环境信息。为此，本文提出交互式奖励代理 IRA，采用“先提出、后验证”的框架：先根据任务指令和执行后的 GUI 环境提出完成条件，再调用系统工具、应用工具和 GUI 工具对这些条件进行验证。作者同时构建了 GUI-RewardBench，包含321条 GUI 任务轨迹，覆盖10类 Ubuntu 桌面应用场景。
authors: Chenrui Shi, Yuwei Wu, Yang Liu, Ruining Feng, Zirui Shang, Zhi Gao, Lifeng Fan, Che Sun
articles.abstract_zh_full: 图形用户界面任务评估旨在判断 GUI 智能体是否成功完成了用户指令。自动化 GUI 任务评估正受到越来越多关注，因为评估结果可以作为测试时扩展和后训练的奖励信号。然而，可靠的 GUI 任务评估仍然具有挑战性，因为判断往往需要访问环境状态，例如系统配置、文件数据和应用设置，而不仅仅是执行轨迹的截图。在本文中，我们提出一种基于“先提出、后验证”框架的交互式奖励智能体（IRA），用于从执行后的环境中获取并验证证据。给定任务指令和 GUI 智能体执行后的 GUI 环境，IRA 首先提出任务完成条件，然后通过调用系统工具、应用工具和 GUI 工具来验证这些条件。该设计在交互过程中结合了来自可见界面和环境状态的证据。我们进一步引入 GUI-RewardBench，这是一个包含 321 条 GUI 任务轨迹的基准，覆盖 10 类 Ubuntu 桌面应用。实验表明，IRA 在 GUI-RewardBench 上达到了 86.9% 的准确率，优于现有评估基线。我们还将 IRA 应用于 GUI 智能体的强化学习，使 OSWorld 成功率达到 34.0%，这表明 IRA 能够为训练 GUI 智能体提供有效的奖励信号。

articles.title: Toward Standardized Cross-Vendor Agent Tool Trust Management in Autonomous Networks
articles.title_zh: 面向自主网络中跨厂商智能体工具信任管理的标准化方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous Network Levels 4-5 require AI agents to invoke tools across vendor boundaries without human oversight, yet existing management standards lack a standardized mechanism for cross-vendor trust visibility. When a tool from Vendor B is compromised, agents from Vendor A continue invoking it -- unaware of the trust degradation -- causing cascading service impact. We present AgentToolMO, a proposed 3GPP NRM information model for agent tool trust management. The model comprises: a formally defined trust state machine with provable graduated enforcement, damped cascade propagation with bounded convergence, cross-vendor trust notifications via existing Management Services (MnS) interfaces, and retroactive impact assessment through NRM dependency graph traversal. Simulation-based evaluation across multi-vendor topologies shows that standardized cross-vendor notifications reduce blast radius from hours-scale undetected propagation to near-real-time containment bounded by MnS notification delivery, with cascade convergence guaranteed in bounded iterations and sub-linear notification scaling across vendor domains. The framework operates within existing 3GPP management infrastructure, leverages existing protocols, and provides a standardization pathway for trustworthy multi-vendor autonomous network management.
articles.abstract_zh: 面向 4-5 级自主网络，AI 智能体需要在无人干预下跨厂商调用工具，但现有管理标准缺乏统一的跨厂商信任可见性机制。本文提出 AgentToolMO，一种面向 3GPP NRM 的工具信任管理信息模型，包含形式化信任状态机、带阻尼的级联传播与有界收敛机制、基于现有 MnS 接口的跨厂商信任通知，以及通过 NRM 依赖图遍历进行的事后影响评估。仿真结果表明，该方案可将故障影响范围从小时级的隐蔽传播缩减为近实时遏制，并在多厂商域中实现有界级联收敛。
authors: Ravi Kant Sharma, Ashutosh Uttam, Ajay Kumar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自治网络 4-5 级要求 AI 智能体在无人监督的情况下跨厂商边界调用工具，但现有管理标准缺乏标准化的跨厂商信任可见机制。当来自厂商 B 的某个工具被攻破时，厂商 A 的智能体仍会继续调用它——而不会意识到信任已退化——从而导致级联式的服务影响。我们提出 AgentToolMO，这是一个面向 3GPP NRM 的工具信任管理信息模型。该模型包括：一个形式化定义且具有可证明分级执行机制的信任状态机、带有有界收敛特性的阻尼级联传播、通过现有管理服务（MnS）接口实现的跨厂商信任通知，以及通过 NRM 依赖图遍历进行的事后影响评估。基于多厂商拓扑的仿真评估表明，标准化的跨厂商通知可将影响范围从以小时计的未检测传播缩短为受 MnS 通知传递限制的近实时遏制，级联收敛可在有界迭代内保证，并且跨厂商域的通知规模增长为次线性。该框架运行于现有 3GPP 管理基础设施之内，利用现有协议，并为可信的多厂商自治网络管理提供了标准化路径。

articles.title: Neural Network Learning of One-Bit Protocols for Qubit Measurement Simulation
articles.title_zh: 用神经网络学习用于量子比特测量模拟的一比特协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23645v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Communication complexity provides a natural framework for quantifying the classical resources required to reproduce quantum statistics. In the qubit prepare-and-measure scenario, two classical bits have been shown to be necessary and sufficient to simulate arbitrary qubit states and arbi- trary quantum measurements exactly. However, this result does not exclude the possibility that restricted families of measurements may admit accurate 1-bit classical approximations. We use a neural network procedure to demonstrate that a single bit can achieve high average accuracy for specific measurement families. A performance analysis of our neural network reveals that symmet- ric measurements with uniformly weighted elements, such as those forming regular polyhedra, are particularly amenable to this restricted communication. By analyzing the patterns learned by the neural network, we derive an analytical protocol that is extremely accurate for finite information- ally complete symmetric configurations and becomes exact in the limit of a continuous isotropic measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 通信复杂性为量化复现量子统计所需的经典资源提供了自然框架。在量子比特准备-测量情形中，已知精确模拟任意量子态与任意测量需要且只需2个经典比特，但这并不排除某些受限测量族可以用1比特实现较高精度近似。本文利用神经网络方法证明，针对特定测量族，一比特即可获得较高平均准确率，尤其适用于元素等权、对称性强的测量集合，如规则多面体构型。进一步分析网络学到的模式后，作者给出了一个解析协议，对有限的、信息完备且对称的构型非常准确，并在连续各向同性测量极限下趋于精确。
authors: Josep Escrig, Mani Zartab, Giulio Gasbarri, Estel Ferrer, Ramon Muñoz-Tapia, Gael Sentís
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通信复杂度为量化重现量子统计所需的经典资源提供了一个自然框架。在量子比特准备-测量场景中，已有研究表明，恰好需要且足以用两个经典比特来精确模拟任意量子态和任意量子测量。然而，这一结果并不排除这样一种可能性：受限的测量族可能允许高精度的 1 比特经典近似。我们使用一种神经网络程序，展示了单个比特能够在特定测量族上实现很高的平均精度。对神经网络性能的分析表明，具有均匀加权元素的对称测量，例如形成规则多面体的测量，特别适合这种受限通信。通过分析神经网络学到的模式，我们导出了一种解析协议，它对有限的信息完备对称构型极其精确，并且在连续各向同性测量的极限下变为精确。

articles.title: Agentic AI for Scientific Reasoning in Autonomous Quantum Sensing Experiments
articles.title_zh: 用于自主量子传感实验中科学推理的智能体人工智能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25145v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We implement an agentic AI workflow built around a large language model (LLM) agent for autonomous experiments with nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond. NV centers are a widely used platform for quantum sensing, and the ability to control many measurements from a computer makes NV experiments a natural setting for autonomous workflows. We make two main contributions. First, we demonstrate an autonomous NV experiment workflow that combines persistent project records, quantitative calculation and data analysis tools, and deterministic experiment control. In one autonomous experiment, the agent selected a single NV center, calibrated its resonant frequency, measured (T₂^ast) with Ramsey measurements, and added a Carr--Purcell--Meiboom--Gill (CPMG) measurement to check a weak feature that could be related to nearby (¹³C). Second, we introduce two offline benchmarks that evaluate the agent's reasoning separately from laboratory execution. We evaluated both benchmarks with GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5, and GPT-5.6 Sol. In the Ramsey checkpoint benchmark, greater reasoning effort generally improved recognition of a residual resonance calibration offset. By contrast, in the pulsed optically detected magnetic resonance (pODMR) data evaluation benchmark, pulse sequence information alone produced more false positive resonance judgments at higher reasoning effort. Requiring an expected signal calculation kept false positive rates low across all three models and reasoning settings. The results suggest a clear division of labor for autonomous experiments. The agent forms scientific hypotheses and uses quantitative tools to evaluate data, while deterministic code controls the hardware and enforces safety constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实现了一种围绕大型语言模型智能体构建的智能体 AI 工作流，用于金刚石氮-空位中心的自主实验。研究展示了可持续记录、定量分析工具与确定性实验控制相结合的自主实验流程，并提出两个离线基准以独立评估智能体推理能力。结果表明，自主实验中智能体更适合提出科学假设并借助定量工具评估数据，而硬件控制和安全约束应由确定性代码执行。
authors: Takuya Isogawa, Ryotaro Okabe, Nutdech Phadetsuwannukun, Mingda Li, Paola Cappellaro
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.25145v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：我们实现了一种围绕大型语言模型（LLM）智能体构建的智能体 AI 工作流，用于金刚石中氮-空位（NV）中心的自主实验。NV 中心是量子传感中广泛使用的平台，而从计算机控制大量测量的能力使 NV 实验成为自主工作流的天然应用场景。我们做出了两项主要贡献。第一，我们展示了一种自主 NV 实验工作流，该工作流结合了持续性的项目记录、定量计算和数据分析工具，以及确定性的实验控制。在一次自主实验中，智能体选择了一个单个 NV 中心，校准了其共振频率，通过 Ramsey 测量测定了 T₂^ast，并增加了一项 Carr--Purcell--Meiboom--Gill（CPMG）测量，以检查一个可能与附近 ¹³C 有关的弱特征。第二，我们引入了两个离线基准，用于将智能体的推理能力与实验室执行分开评估。我们使用 GPT-5.4、GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 评估了这两个基准。在 Ramsey 检查点基准中，更大的推理投入通常提高了对残余共振校准偏移的识别能力。相比之下，在脉冲式光探测磁共振（pODMR）数据评估基准中，仅凭脉冲序列信息会在更高推理投入下产生更多假阳性共振判断。要求进行预期信号计算则使所有三个模型和推理设置下的假阳性率都保持较低。结果表明，自主实验中存在清晰的分工。智能体形成科学假设并使用定量工具评估数据，而确定性代码控制硬件并执行安全约束。

articles.title: Data-Driven Prediction and Classification of Multi-Component Alloys Using Interpretable Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 利用可解释机器学习对多组分合金进行数据驱动的预测与分类
articles.abstract: The design of advanced metallic alloys is challenged by complex, nonlinear interactions among multiple alloying elements, making conventional trial-and-error approaches costly and time-intensive. This study presents an integrated, interpretable machine learning framework applied to a dataset of 2,672 multi-component alloy systems, using elemental composition as the sole input. A multi-output Random Forest Regressor simultaneously predicts Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS) and Liquidus Temperature, achieving a test R² of 0.848 and a 5-fold cross-validation R² of 0.849 ± 0.017, outperforming Linear Regression (R² = 0.512) and Gradient Boosting (R² = 0.787) baselines. A Logistic Regression classifier identifies high-performance alloy compositions defined by simultaneous UTS and liquidus temperature thresholds achieving an overall accuracy of 82% and an AUC of 0.871. Threshold sensitivity analysis confirms classification stability across varying performance criteria. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and K-Means clustering, applied to the full compositional feature space, reveal three distinct alloy families with systematic differences in mechanical and thermal properties. Critically, interpretability is preserved throughout via SHAP analysis and permutation-based feature importance, identifying Vanadium (V), Iron (Fe), Tungsten (W), and Carbon (C) as the dominant compositional drivers a finding that both confirms and extends established metallurgical understanding. The dataset was verified to contain no missing values across all 31 elemental features. Collectively, the proposed framework provides a scalable and interpretable foundation for accelerated alloy screening, property prediction, and data-driven materials discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一个可解释机器学习框架，仅以元素组成为输入，对 2672 个多组分合金体系的力学和热学性质进行预测与分类。多输出随机森林在极限抗拉强度和液相线温度预测上优于线性回归和梯度提升基线，逻辑回归分类器也能较好识别高性能合金。SHAP 和置换重要性分析显示 V、Fe、W 和 C 是主要成分驱动因素，为加速合金筛选和数据驱动材料发现提供了可扩展基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 先进金属合金的设计受到多种合金元素之间复杂、非线性相互作用的挑战，这使得传统试错方法成本高且耗时。本研究提出了一个集成的、可解释的机器学习框架，并将其应用于包含 2672 个多组分合金体系的数据集，其中仅使用元素组合作为输入。一个多输出随机森林回归器同时预测极限抗拉强度（UTS）和液相线温度，在测试集上达到 0.848 的 R²，在 5 折交叉验证中达到 0.849 ± 0.017 的 R²，优于线性回归（R² = 0.512）和梯度提升（R² = 0.787）基线。一个逻辑回归分类器识别由同时满足 UTS 和液相线温度阈值所定义的高性能合金组成，达到 82% 的总体准确率和 0.871 的 AUC。阈值敏感性分析证实了分类在不同性能标准下的稳定性。对完整组成特征空间应用主成分分析（PCA）和 K-Means 聚类，揭示出三类不同的合金家族，它们在机械和热学性质上存在系统性差异。关键的是，通过 SHAP 分析和基于置换的特征重要性，整个过程中均保持了可解释性，识别出钒（V）、铁（Fe）、钨（W）和碳（C）是主导性的组成驱动因素，这一发现既证实又扩展了既有冶金学认识。经验证，该数据集在全部 31 个元素特征上均不含缺失值。总体而言，所提出的框架为加速合金筛选、性质预测和数据驱动材料发现提供了可扩展且可解释的基础。

articles.title: Dark-mode theory for quadratic bosonic networks
articles.title_zh: 二次玻色网络的暗模理论
articles.abstract: Determining dark modes in quadratic bosonic networks is both fundamental and imperative, since the dark modes are critical to coherent network manipulation and quantum resource transfer, and such networks are applicable to wide parameter regimes and various physical areas. Here, we develop a symplectic singular value decomposition (SSVD) method for identifying the number and form of the dark modes in quadratic bosonic networks. This method maps the emergence of dark modes onto a computationally tractable symplectic null-space problem, enabling their systematic identification in large-scale quadratic bosonic networks.We adopt the SSVD method to study both the collective cooling of multiple mechanical modes and optomechanical entanglement generation in linearized optomechanical networks. We find that the appearance of the dark modes suppresses the cooling performance and entanglement generation. Our work paves the way for engineering dark modes in quadratic bosonic networks, and the SSVD method has wide applicability in quantum physics, quantum information science, and many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种辛奇异值分解方法，用于识别二次玻色网络中暗模的数量和形式。该方法将暗模的出现转化为可计算的辛零空间问题，并被用于研究线性化光机械网络中的多机械模集体冷却和光机械纠缠生成。研究发现暗模会抑制冷却性能和纠缠生成，该方法在量子物理、量子信息和多体物理中具有广泛适用性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定二次玻色网络中的暗模既是基础性的，也是迫切需要的，因为暗模对于相干网络操控和量子资源转移至关重要，而这类网络适用于宽广的参数范围和各种物理领域。在此，我们发展了一种辛奇异值分解（SSVD）方法，用于识别二次玻色网络中暗模的数量和形式。该方法将暗模的出现映射为一个计算上可处理的辛零空间问题，从而能够在大规模二次玻色网络中对其进行系统识别。我们采用 SSVD 方法研究了线性化光机械网络中多个机械模的集体冷却以及光机械纠缠的生成。我们发现，暗模的出现会抑制冷却性能和纠缠生成。我们的工作为二次玻色网络中的暗模工程铺平了道路，并且 SSVD 方法在量子物理、量子信息科学和多体物理中具有广泛适用性。

articles.title: Rivaling Foil Gauges: A Soft De-Shorting Strain Sensor with Intrinsic Off-Axis Insensitivity
articles.title_zh: 媲美箔式应变计：一种具有内在离轴不敏感性的柔性去短路应变传感器
articles.abstract: Soft robots, owing to their inherent compliance and safety, are ideal for human–machine interaction and applications in unstructured environments. However, proprioception, which is a prerequisite for intelligent interaction, remains difficult to achieve in soft systems. Conventional metal foil strain gauges, featuring low hysteresis and a high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), are the standard for surface strain measurement; yet their intrinsically nonstretchable nature precludes their use on deformable bodies. Existing flexible strain sensors have addressed stretchability, but generally suffer from signal hysteresis and low SNR; more critically, the bending, twisting, and compressive deformations that accompany soft-body motion introduce severe crosstalk into the output. Here we present a sliding-electrode de-shorting strain sensor that brings near-metallic sensing quality into a flexible architecture via the de-shorting mechanism. The sensing core consists of an elastomeric cavity filled with ionic liquid and a pair of metallic sliding electrodes inserted deep into the cavity. In the initial state, the metallic electrodes electrically short the ionic liquid in the radial direction, confining the signal generation to a small region between the two electrodes. As the sensor is stretched, the electrodes recede relative to the cavity; the ionic liquid previously in the radial region is progressively released from the shorted state and joins the conduction path, and the impedance magnitude changes accordingly. Since the signal is generated essentially by the geometric redistribution of the ionic conduction path under the control of the rigid sliding electrodes, and not by aspect-ratio changes of a flexible material or by percolation-network evolution, the sensor simultaneously achieves low hysteresis and a high SNR approaching those of metal strain gauges. The sliding de-shorting architecture further shields interference signals generated by bending, twisting, and compression in the shorted region, giving the sensor intrinsic insensitivity to off-axis deformation. The sensor exhibits a hysteresis of 0.23% over 0–30% strain, an SNR of 59 dB at 1% strain, an equivalent input strain noise as low as 11 µε, and a maximum stretchability of 70%. Under 360◦ bending, 360◦ twisting, and 50% compression, the output fluctuation remains below 0.5% of the full-scale signal. We integrated the sensors onto an unactuated elastic silicone pillar and, relying solely on the sensors’ own signals as feedback, reconstructed in real time the approximate three-dimensional configuration of the pillar under coupled bending–twisting deformation. The “liquid–rigid–soft” transition design demonstrated here offers a general route to near-metallic sensing quality in flexible systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种滑动电极去短路应变传感器，通过刚性滑动电极控制离子导电路径的几何重分布，在柔性结构中实现接近金属应变计的低滞后和高信噪比。该结构能屏蔽弯曲、扭转和压缩产生的干扰，对离轴变形具有内在不敏感性。实验显示其在低噪声、高拉伸性和复杂变形下稳定输出方面表现突出，并可用于实时重构柔性硅胶柱的近似三维构型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 软体机器人因其固有的柔顺性和安全性，非常适合人机交互以及非结构化环境中的应用。然而，本体感知作为智能交互的前提，在软系统中仍然难以实现。传统金属箔式应变计具有低滞后和高信噪比（SNR）的特点，是表面应变测量的标准；但其本质上不可拉伸的特性使其无法用于可变形物体。现有柔性应变传感器已经解决了可拉伸性问题，但通常存在信号滞后和低 SNR；更关键的是，伴随软体运动发生的弯曲、扭转和压缩变形会在输出中引入严重串扰。在此，我们提出一种滑动电极去短路应变传感器，通过去短路机制将近金属级的传感质量引入柔性架构。传感核心由一个填充离子液体的弹性体腔体和一对深入插入腔体的金属滑动电极组成。在初始状态下，金属电极在径向方向上将离子液体电短路，把信号产生限制在两个电极之间的小区域内。当传感器被拉伸时，电极相对于腔体后退；原先位于径向区域中的离子液体逐渐从短路状态中释放出来并加入导电路径，阻抗幅值随之变化。由于信号本质上是由刚性滑动电极控制下离子导电路径的几何重分布产生，而不是由柔性材料的长宽比变化或渗流网络演化产生，因此该传感器同时实现了接近金属应变计的低滞后和高 SNR。滑动去短路架构进一步屏蔽了短路区域中由弯曲、扭转和压缩产生的干扰信号，使传感器对离轴变形具有内在不敏感性。该传感器在 0–30% 应变范围内表现出 0.23% 的滞后，在 1% 应变下 SNR 为 59 dB，等效输入应变噪声低至 11 µε，最大可拉伸性为 70%。在 360° 弯曲、360° 扭转和 50% 压缩下，输出波动保持在满量程信号的 0.5% 以下。我们将传感器集成到一个未驱动的弹性硅胶柱上，并仅依赖传感器自身信号作为反馈，实时重构了该柱在耦合弯曲—扭转变形下的近似三维构型。这里展示的“液体—刚性—柔性”过渡设计为柔性系统中实现近金属级传感质量提供了一条通用路径。

articles.title: High-Sensitivity NIR Blood Analyte Sensing Using a Double-Defect 1D Photonic Crystal: A Comparative TMM and FEM Investigation
articles.title_zh: 使用双缺陷一维光子晶体的高灵敏近红外血液分析物传感：TMM 与 FEM 的比较研究
articles.abstract: In the present work, a symmetric one-dimensional (1D) Silicon/Silicon Dioxide double-defect photonic crystal biosensor for high-resolution blood component screening in the near-infrared (NIR) regime has been proposed. The proposed structure, optimized for a central design wavelength of 1550 nm, is represented as (:Air/łeft(BA)N-B-D-B-D-i̊ght(BA)N-B/Air), where A and B represent Silicon Dioxide and Silicon layers, respectively, and D denotes identical microfluidic defect cavities containing blood analytes. The transmission spectra and localized electric field confinement profiles are rigorously modelled and validated using the Transfer Matrix Method (TMM) and a 1D Finite Element Method (FEM) Helmholtz solver. Due to electromagnetic state hybridization in the coupled defect cavities, the transmission spectrum exhibits split resonance modes (Peak 1 and Peak 2) inside the photonic bandgap. Under normal incidence θ = 00 with a period N = 7, the sensor achieves a high refractive index sensitivity of up to (:544.14nm/RIU) for Hemoglobin, extremely narrow linewidths (FWHM down to 5.08 pm), and Quality Factors (Q) up to 2.76×105 for Plasma, resulting in a Limit of Detection (LoD) in the order of 10− 6 RIU. The transition to extreme oblique angles of incidence (up to 800) significantly elongates the optical path length through the cavity defects, enhancing the peak sensitivity to 784.18 nm/RIU and narrowing the resonance FWHM to sub-picometer levels 0.25 pm, which yields an ultra-high Quality Factor of 5.32×106 and a Figure of Merit ((:FoM)) of 3.12×106 RIU− 1 for the Plasma component. The comparative analysis shows perfect agreement between TMM and FEM calculations, with minor resonance peak shifts (+ 50 to + 90 pm) arising from finite-element discretization grid rounding, and peak shift discrepancies of less than 5 pm, validating the numerical consistency of the model. These results demonstrate that the proposed symmetric double-defect configuration represents a highly sensitive, and stable optical platform for rapid NIR blood diagnostics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种对称一维硅/二氧化硅双缺陷光子晶体生物传感器，用于近红外波段高分辨率血液成分筛查。研究采用传输矩阵法和一维有限元 Helmholtz 求解器对透射光谱与局域电场进行建模和验证，结果显示双缺陷耦合导致带隙内分裂共振峰。该结构在法向和大角度入射下均表现出高灵敏度、高品质因数和低检测限，TMM 与 FEM 结果高度一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本工作中，提出了一种对称的一维（1D）硅/二氧化硅双缺陷光子晶体生物传感器，用于近红外（NIR）区域的高分辨率血液成分筛查。所提出的结构针对 1550 nm 的中心设计波长进行了优化，表示为 Air/(BA)^N-B-D-B-D-(BA)^N-B/Air，其中 A 和 B 分别代表二氧化硅层和硅层，D 表示包含血液分析物的相同微流控缺陷腔。透射光谱和局域电场限制分布通过传输矩阵法（TMM）和一维有限元法（FEM）Helmholtz 求解器进行了严格建模和验证。由于耦合缺陷腔中的电磁态杂化，透射光谱在光子带隙内表现出分裂的共振模式（峰 1 和峰 2）。在法向入射 θ = 0° 且周期数 N = 7 时，该传感器对血红蛋白实现了高达 544.14 nm/RIU 的高折射率灵敏度，具有极窄线宽（FWHM 低至 5.08 pm），并且对血浆的品质因数（Q）高达 2.76×10⁵，从而使检测限（LoD）达到 10⁻⁶ RIU 量级。当入射角转变为极端斜入射角（最高 80°）时，通过腔缺陷的光学路径长度显著增加，使峰值灵敏度提高到 784.18 nm/RIU，并将共振 FWHM 缩窄至亚皮米水平 0.25 pm，从而对血浆成分获得 5.32×10⁶ 的超高品质因数和 3.12×10⁶ RIU⁻¹ 的品质因子指标（FoM）。比较分析显示，TMM 与 FEM 计算完全一致，有限元离散网格取整导致了较小的共振峰位移（+50 至 +90 pm），且峰位移差异小于 5 pm，验证了模型的数值一致性。这些结果表明，所提出的对称双缺陷构型代表了一种用于快速近红外血液诊断的高灵敏且稳定的光学平台。

articles.title: BQEB ForecastBench: Benchmarking AI Models for Smart Grid Forecasting Using BQEB-Data v1
articles.title_zh: BQEB ForecastBench：使用 BQEB-Data v1 对智能电网预测 AI 模型进行基准测试
articles.abstract: The rapid transformation of modern power systems through renewable energy integration, distributed energy resources, battery energy storage, electric vehicle charging, and dynamic electricity markets has significantly increased the need for accurate, reproducible, and standardized forecasting methodologies. Although artificial intelligence has demonstrated strong potential for smart-grid forecasting, objective comparison across forecasting models remains challenging due to inconsistent datasets, heterogeneous experimental protocols, and limited availability of open benchmarking frameworks. This paper presents BQEB ForecastBench, an open benchmarking framework for evaluating artificial intelligence models on smart-grid forecasting tasks using the publicly available BQEB-Data v1 benchmark dataset. Developed as the forecasting evaluation component of the broader BIO-Quantum Energy Brain (BQEB) research initiative, the benchmark establishes standardized forecasting tasks, chronological data partitioning, transparent evaluation metrics, and reproducible experimental procedures. Two operationally significant forecasting problems are investigated: next-hour electricity load forecasting and day-ahead electricity price forecasting. Three baseline machine learning models—Linear Regression, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting—are evaluated using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), and the coefficient of determination (R²). Experimental results demonstrate that Linear Regression achieves the best overall performance for both forecasting tasks, obtaining an RMSE of 9.94 MW and R² = 0.9288 for load forecasting, and an RMSE of 4.39 USD/MWh and R² = 0.2078 for electricity price forecasting. The results further highlight the greater stochastic complexity of electricity price prediction compared with demand forecasting. By providing publicly accessible benchmark data, standardized evaluation protocols, and reproducible baseline results, BQEB ForecastBench establishes a reusable reference framework for future research in machine learning, deep learning, intelligent energy forecasting, and trustworthy artificial intelligence for next-generation smart-grid systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 BQEB ForecastBench，一个基于公开 BQEB-Data v1 数据集的智能电网预测 AI 模型开放基准框架。该框架定义了标准化预测任务、时间顺序数据划分、透明评价指标和可复现实验流程，并评估了负荷预测与电价预测两个任务。基线结果显示线性回归在两个任务上总体表现最佳，同时也表明电价预测比需求预测具有更强随机复杂性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代电力系统通过可再生能源并网、分布式能源资源、电池储能、电动汽车充电以及动态电力市场快速转型，显著增加了对准确、可复现和标准化预测方法的需求。尽管人工智能在智能电网预测中显示出强大潜力，但由于数据集不一致、实验协议异质以及开放基准框架可用性有限，不同预测模型之间的客观比较仍然具有挑战性。本文提出 BQEB ForecastBench，这是一个开放基准框架，用于使用公开可用的 BQEB-Data v1 基准数据集评估智能电网预测任务中的人工智能模型。作为更广泛的 BIO-Quantum Energy Brain（BQEB）研究计划的预测评估组成部分，该基准建立了标准化预测任务、按时间顺序的数据划分、透明的评价指标以及可复现的实验程序。研究考察了两个具有重要运行意义的预测问题：下一小时电力负荷预测和日前电价预测。三个基线机器学习模型——线性回归、随机森林和梯度提升——使用平均绝对误差（MAE）、均方根误差（RMSE）、平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）以及决定系数（R²）进行评估。实验结果表明，线性回归在两个预测任务中均取得最佳总体性能，在负荷预测中获得 9.94 MW 的 RMSE 和 R² = 0.9288，在电价预测中获得 4.39 USD/MWh 的 RMSE 和 R² = 0.2078。结果还进一步突出表明，与需求预测相比，电价预测具有更大的随机复杂性。通过提供公开可访问的基准数据、标准化评估协议和可复现的基线结果，BQEB ForecastBench 为机器学习、深度学习、智能能源预测以及面向下一代智能电网系统的可信人工智能未来研究建立了一个可复用的参考框架。

articles.title: Dust–Ion Acoustic Solitons and Shocks in a Four-Component Electronegative Dusty Plasma with Warm Adiabatic Ions and Nonthermal Electrons
articles.title_zh: 含暖绝热离子和非热电子的四组分电负性含尘等离子体中的尘埃—离子声孤子与激波
articles.abstract: Nonlinear electrostatic structures in dusty plasmas are strongly modified when additional charged species and non-Maxwellian electrons are present, as occurs in laboratory SF6-argon systems and in space environments such as Earth’s mesosphere and Saturn’s E-ring. This work theoretically investigates dust–ion acoustic (DIA) solitary and shock waves in an unmagnetized, collisionless electronegative dusty plasma composed of warm adiabatic positive ions, cold negative ions, Cairns-distributed nonthermal electrons, and stationary negatively charged dust grains. Using the reductive perturbation method, the Korteweg–de Vries (KdV) equation is derived for the nondissipative limit and the Korteweg–de Vries–Burgers (KdV-B) equation when ion viscosity is included. This yields analytical expressions for the DIA phase speed, nonlinear, dispersive, and dissipative coefficients, as well as their dependence on the nonthermal parameter, negative-ion concentration, dust concentration , ion mass ratio, and positive to negative ion temperature ratio. Numerical analysis shows that the phase velocity increases electron nonthermality, negative-ion concentration, and higher positive-ion temperature whereas decreased with dust content. Lighter positive ions and lower negative-ion concentration can narrow structures and induce a polarity change, whereas warmer positive ions produce shorter and wider solitons. For shock structures, viscosity induces a transition from oscil-latory to monotonic profiles, controlled by the ratio of dissipation to dispersion. The dissipative coefficient scales linearly with viscosity, with a composition-dependent slope, suggesting an observational method to infer plasma composition from shock thickness. The model provides a unified framework for interpreting DIA solitary and shock structures in electronegative dusty plasmas.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究了未磁化、无碰撞电负性含尘等离子体中的尘埃—离子声孤立波和激波，该等离子体由暖绝热正离子、冷负离子、Cairns 分布非热电子和静止负电尘埃粒子组成。通过约化摄动法，研究分别在无耗散极限和考虑离子黏性的情况下推导出 KdV 方程与 KdV-Burgers 方程。数值分析表明非热性、负离子浓度、尘埃含量、离子质量比和温度比会显著影响相速度、结构宽度、极性和激波形态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当存在额外带电物种和非 Maxwell 电子时，含尘等离子体中的非线性静电结构会受到强烈修正，这种情况出现在实验室 SF6-氩系统以及地球中间层和土星 E 环等空间环境中。本工作从理论上研究了未磁化、无碰撞电负性含尘等离子体中的尘埃—离子声（DIA）孤立波和激波，该等离子体由暖绝热正离子、冷负离子、Cairns 分布非热电子以及静止的带负电尘埃粒子组成。使用约化摄动法，在无耗散极限下推导出 Korteweg–de Vries（KdV）方程，并在包含离子黏性时推导出 Korteweg–de Vries–Burgers（KdV-B）方程。这给出了 DIA 相速度、非线性系数、色散系数和耗散系数的解析表达式，以及它们对非热参数、负离子浓度、尘埃浓度、离子质量比和正负离子温度比的依赖关系。数值分析表明，相速度随着电子非热性、负离子浓度和较高正离子温度而增加，而随尘埃含量增加而降低。较轻的正离子和较低的负离子浓度可以使结构变窄并诱导极性变化，而较暖的正离子会产生更短且更宽的孤子。对于激波结构，黏性会诱导从振荡型剖面到单调型剖面的转变，这由耗散与色散之比控制。耗散系数随黏性线性变化，其斜率依赖于组分，这提示可通过激波厚度推断等离子体组成的观测方法。该模型为解释电负性含尘等离子体中的 DIA 孤立结构和激波结构提供了统一框架。

articles.title: The proton has no lifetime, only a cross-section: Triality-locked baryon number and vortex-catalyzed nucleon decay
articles.title_zh: 质子没有寿命，只有截面：三重性锁定的重子数与涡旋催化的核子衰变
articles.abstract: Every limit on proton decay is reported as a lower bound on the proton lifetimean intrinsic constant of nature. We argue that the proton may possess no such constant. If baryon number is an exact discrete gauge symmetry, locked to the Z3 centre of colour through the embedding of baryon number as a fourth colour, then single-nucleon decay (∆B = 1) and neutronantineutron oscillation (∆B = 2) are forbidden at all scales, including by quantum gravity. The minimal genuinely allowed violation is ∆B = 3, the selection rule the electroweak sphaleron already obeys, and it cannot be carried eciently by any local operator. It is realized instead inside the cores of the Z3 baryonic vortices that the breaking U(1)B →Z3 necessarily produces, via CallanRubakov / AlfordMarch-RussellWilczek catalysis with a strong-interaction cross-section. The observable is then not a lifetime but a rate Γp = ndef σv set by the local density of baryonic defects.
