articles.title: Berry curvature effects of chiral superconducting rhombohedral graphene
articles.title_zh: 手性超导菱方石墨烯中的 Berry 曲率效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the Berry curvature effects of the Bogoliubov quasiparticles in chiral superconducting rhombohedral graphene. Using a two-band Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian to describe the superconducting quasiparticles, we calculate the momentum-space Berry curvature, the orbital magnetic moment, the anomalous thermal-Hall and the anomalous spin- and orbital-Nernst transport of the chiral p-wave superconducting states. We investigate the impact of the normal-state energy band warping in rhombohedral graphene, which can cause the Bogoliubov Fermi surface for quasiparticle excitations. We find that the Bogoliubov Fermi surface qualitatively modulates the anomalous Hall transports, inducing a deviation of the thermal Hall conductivity from the quantized value and strongly enhancing the spin- and orbital-Nernst responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了手性超导菱方石墨烯中 Bogoliubov 准粒子的 Berry 曲率效应。作者利用两带 Bogoliubov–de Gennes 哈密顿量，计算了动量空间 Berry 曲率、轨道磁矩以及手性 p 波超导态的异常热霍尔和自旋/轨道 Nernst 输运。结果表明，正常态能带翘曲可产生 Bogoliubov 费米面，并显著改变异常霍尔输运：热霍尔电导偏离量子化值，同时自旋与轨道 Nernst 响应被强烈增强。
authors: Jian-Hua Zeng, Zhi Wang, Qian Niu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了手性超导菱面体堆垛石墨烯中 Bogoliubov 准粒子的贝里曲率效应。利用描述超导准粒子的两带 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 哈密顿量，我们计算了动量空间贝里曲率、轨道磁矩，以及手性 p 波超导态中的异常热霍尔和异常自旋、轨道 Nernst 输运。我们还考察了菱面体堆垛石墨烯中正常态能带翘曲的影响，该翘曲可导致准粒子激发的 Bogoliubov 费米面。我们发现，Bogoliubov 费米面会在定性上调制异常霍尔输运，使热霍尔电导偏离量子化值，并显著增强自旋和轨道 Nernst 响应。

articles.title: Magnetic-texture winding controls fermion-parity switches in an interacting p-wave magnet wire
articles.title_zh: 磁纹理绕数调控相互作用 p 波磁性线中的费米子宇称翻转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coplanar magnetic spirals map locally onto uniform spin--orbit-coupled wires, but on a ring the rotating spin frame can change the electronic boundary condition. We prove, level by level in every fixed-particle-number sector, that even and odd texture windings impose boundary phases separated by half the single-electron flux period. Changing the winding by one also changes the physical pitch in inverse proportion to the circumference; a symmetric comparison removes this leading pitch correction. In the number-conserving topological phase, a global parity constraint then reverses the fermion-parity assignment of neighboring phase-winding branches. Density-matrix renormalization-group simulations show this reversal, support an Ising transition coexisting with a gapless charge mode, and relate the finite-size parity splitting to an independently calculated charge stiffness. Magnetic-texture winding thus changes the many-body spectrum through a global boundary condition that is not determined by the local band dispersion, providing a closed-geometry, number-conserving probe of topological pairing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了共面磁螺旋在局域上可映射到均匀自旋轨道耦合线，但在环形几何中，旋转自旋框架会改变电子边界条件。作者逐能级证明：偶数与奇数绕数对应的边界相位相差半个单电子磁通周期。进一步地，在守粒子数的拓扑相中，全局宇称约束会翻转相邻相位-绕数分支的费米子宇称标记；密度矩阵重整化群计算支持这一结论，并显示其与 Ising 相变和无能隙电荷模共存。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 共面磁螺旋在局域上可映射到均匀的自旋—轨道耦合导线，但在环形几何中，旋转的自旋参考系会改变电子边界条件。我们逐级证明，在每一个固定粒子数扇区中，偶数和奇数纹理绕数会施加相差半个单电子磁通周期的边界相位。将绕数改变 1 也会使物理螺距按环周长的倒数发生变化；而对称比较则去除了这一首要的螺距修正。在守恒粒子数的拓扑相中，一个全局奇偶约束会反转相邻相位-绕数分支的费米子奇偶性分配。密度矩阵重整化群模拟显示了这种反转，支持一个与无能隙电荷模共存的 Ising 转变，并将有限尺寸的奇偶性分裂与一个独立计算的电荷刚度联系起来。因此，磁纹理绕数通过一个并非由局域能带色散决定的全局边界条件改变多体能谱，为闭合几何中、守恒粒子数条件下的拓扑配对提供了一种探测方式。

articles.title: Interaction-driven electronic ferroelectricity in van der Waals heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 范德华异质结构中的相互作用驱动电子铁电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong electronic correlations in narrow-band systems provide a promising route to realize emergent quantum phases. While ferroelectricity in van der Waals materials is typically associated with inversion symmetry breaking driven by lattice distortions, interlayer sliding, or moiré reconstruction, the possibility of generating ferroelectricity directly from electronic interactions remains largely unexplored. Here, using molecular beam epitaxy, scanning tunneling microscopy, and ab initio calculations, we investigate two stacking geometries of bilayer 1T-TaSe₂, A-C and A-C', formed by coupled Star-of-David charge density wave phases. We show that both stackings realize quasi-one-dimensional interacting chains, but are governed by distinct interaction mechanisms. In the A-C stacking, strong interlayer hybridization leads to dimerization and the formation of a band insulating state. In contrast, the A-C' stacking is dominated by interlayer Coulomb interactions, producing a spontaneous charge imbalance between layers that gives rise to an out-of-plane ferroelectric polarization. Furthermore, we demonstrate that ferroelectric and antiferroelectric interchain configurations can be stabilized and electrically switched by an external field. Our results prove that bilayer 1T-TaSe₂ is a platform for interaction-driven electronic ferroelectricity, establishing an overlooked family of charge-ordered correlated states in 1T-TaSe₂ multilayers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合分子束外延、扫描隧道显微镜和第一性原理计算，研究了双层 1T-TaSe₂ 中两种堆垛构型 A-C 与 A-C' 的电子关联效应。结果表明，这两种堆垛都形成准一维相互作用链，但主导机制不同：A-C 堆垛中强层间杂化导致二聚化并形成能带绝缘体，而 A-C' 堆垛则主要受层间库仑相互作用控制，产生自发层间电荷不平衡并诱导面外铁电极化。该工作表明，电子相互作用本身即可在范德华体系中驱动铁电性。
authors: Ziying Wang, Ana Vera Montoto, Mohammad Amini, Yuxiao Ding, Jose L. Lado, Robert Drost, Adolfo O. Fumega, Peter Liljeroth
articles.abstract_zh_full: 窄带系统中的强电子关联为实现涌现量子相提供了一条很有前景的途径。尽管范德华材料中的铁电性通常与由晶格畸变、层间滑移或莫尔重构驱动的反演对称性破缺相关，但直接由电子相互作用生成铁电性的可能性在很大程度上仍未被探索。这里，我们利用分子束外延、扫描隧道显微镜和第一性原理计算，研究了由耦合的 Star-of-David 电荷密度波相形成的双层 1T-TaSe2 的两种堆垛几何 A-C 和 A-C'。我们表明，这两种堆垛都实现了准一维相互作用链，但由不同的相互作用机制所支配。在 A-C 堆垛中，强层间杂化导致二聚化并形成能带绝缘态。相比之下，A-C' 堆垛由层间库仑相互作用主导，产生层间自发电荷不平衡，从而导致面外铁电极化。此外，我们证明了铁电和反铁电的链间构型可以被外电场稳定并实现电学切换。我们的结果证明，双层 1T-TaSe2 是相互作用驱动电子铁电性的一个平台，并为 1T-TaSe2 多层结构中一类此前被忽视的电荷有序相关态建立了基础。

articles.title: Atomic-scale phase-field modeling with dopants: Stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation with fractional site occupancy
articles.title_zh: 含掺杂原子的原子尺度相场建模：基于分数占位的随机自洽谐近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase-field modeling has achieved great success in predicting pattern formation in materials, such as the formation of ferroelectric domains. However, because it is typically based on continuum mechanics, conventional phase-field modeling cannot be straightforwardly applied to atomic-scale pattern formation, such as dopant segregation and vacancy ordering, which are driven by chemical potentials. Here, we extend the phase-field concept to the atomic scale by formulating the free energy of atomic systems within stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA) theory to allow fractional site occupations. Our methodology enables us to directly calculate the derivative of the free energy with respect to site occupation and thereby obtain the chemical potential, successfully reproducing Ag distributions in bulk Cu as well as the resulting lattice expansion. Furthermore, we applied our methodology to investigate dopant segregation around a Σ5(310)[001] Cu grain boundary doped with Ag atoms. We found that Ag atoms preferentially segregate at the vertices of the triangular motif of a grain boundary. As the number of dopants increases, excess Ag atoms segregate near the vertices and then at the bottom sites of the triangular motif. This study extends the phase-field concept to discrete atomic systems, enabling the identification of preferential dopant-segregation sites and thereby visualizing atomic-scale pattern formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将相场思想推广到原子尺度，并在随机自洽谐近似（SSCHA）理论中引入分数占位，从而构建原子体系的自由能描述。该方法可直接计算自由能对格点占据数的导数，进而得到化学势，成功再现了体相铜中 Ag 的分布及其引起的晶格膨胀。作者还将其用于研究 Ag 掺杂 Cu Σ5(310)[001] 晶界附近的偏聚行为，发现 Ag 原子倾向于聚集在晶界三角结构的顶点位置。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相场建模在预测材料中的图案形成方面取得了巨大成功，例如铁电畴的形成。然而，由于它通常基于连续介质力学，传统相场建模无法直接应用于原子尺度的图案形成，如由化学势驱动的掺杂偏聚和空位有序。这里，我们将相场概念扩展到原子尺度，通过在随机自洽谐近似（SSCHA）理论中表述原子系统的自由能来允许分数位点占据。我们的方法使我们能够直接计算自由能对位点占据的导数，从而得到化学势，成功再现了块体 Cu 中 Ag 的分布以及由此引起的晶格膨胀。进一步地，我们将该方法应用于研究含 Ag 掺杂原子的 Σ5(310)[001] Cu 晶界周围的掺杂偏聚。我们发现，Ag 原子优先偏聚在晶界三角构型的顶点处。随着掺杂原子数增加，多余的 Ag 原子先偏聚在顶点附近，然后再偏聚到该三角构型的底部位点。本研究将相场概念扩展到离散原子系统，使得识别优先掺杂偏聚位点成为可能，从而能够可视化原子尺度的图案形成。

articles.title: Dynamic hysteresis in an autocatalytic reaction network
articles.title_zh: 自催化反应网络中的动态滞后
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Here we show that an autocatalytic reaction network can exhibit dynamic hysteresis as a result of the competition between its intrinsic relaxation time scale and that of the periodic drive. The autocatalytic reaction steps generate bistability in the concentration of the autocatalytic species, and periodic pumping of the product species provides the external drive. Hysteresis arises from the lag between the concentration response of the autocatalytic species and the external periodic drive. The resulting hysteresis-loop area quantifies the extent of the system's hysteretic response. Using the periodically driven Schlögl model as a representative bistable chemical system, we use this loop area to determine how the magnitude of the hysteretic response is controlled by the driving protocol, intrinsic fluctuations, and the size of the system. Varying the driving frequency and the strength of the fluctuations causes a turnover of the hysteresis loop area, whereas the area changes monotonically with driving amplitude and system size. These trends identify the driving protocol and fluctuation strength as primary controls on the magnitude of dynamic hysteresis. In contrast to stochastic resonance, which is typically associated with weak periodic forcing and noise-assisted amplification, dynamic hysteresis can characterize the reaction-system response over a wider range of external control conditions. We further show that the delayed concentration response is mirrored in Shannon entropy and in the total entropy production rate, connecting dynamic hysteresis to information-theoretic and stochastic-thermodynamic measures of irreversibility. Overall, we identify and interpret the role of the controlling factors in chemical dynamic hysteresis and suggest implications for efficient chemical logic gates and eventually, chemical computers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，自催化反应网络在周期驱动下可因内禀弛豫时间尺度与外部驱动时间尺度的竞争而出现动态滞后。自催化反应步骤产生双稳态，而对产物种的周期泵浦构成外驱，从而使响应浓度相对驱动产生滞后并形成滞后回线。以周期驱动的 Schlögl 模型为例，作者用回线面积定量表征滞后响应，并考察了驱动协议、涨落强度与系统尺寸对滞后强度的影响。
authors: Sheela Yadav, Jason R. Green, Moupriya Das
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，自催化反应网络可因其内禀弛豫时间尺度与周期驱动时间尺度之间的竞争而表现出动态滞后。自催化反应步骤会使自催化物种的浓度出现双稳态，而对产物物种进行周期泵浦则提供外部驱动。滞后源于自催化物种浓度响应与外部周期驱动之间的滞后。由此得到的滞后回线面积定量表征了系统的滞后响应程度。以周期驱动的 Schlögl 模型作为代表性的双稳态化学系统，我们利用这一回线面积来确定驱动方案、内禀涨落以及系统尺寸如何控制滞后响应的大小。改变驱动频率和涨落强度会使滞后回线面积发生转折，而回线面积则随驱动幅度和系统尺寸单调变化。这些趋势表明，驱动方案和涨落强度是控制动态滞后幅度的主要因素。与通常与弱周期驱动和噪声辅助放大相关的随机共振不同，动态滞后可以在更广泛的外部控制条件下表征反应系统的响应。我们进一步表明，延迟的浓度响应也体现在 Shannon 熵和总熵产生率中，从而将动态滞后与信息论和随机热力学中的不可逆性度量联系起来。总体而言，我们识别并解释了化学动态滞后中的控制因素作用，并指出其对高效化学逻辑门以及最终化学计算机具有潜在意义。

articles.title: Chiral thermal fluctuations and enhanced refrigeration in a nonreciprocal nanomechanical system
articles.title_zh: 非互易纳米机械系统中的手性热涨落与增强制冷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how the breaking of reciprocity influences thermal flows and microscopic thermodynamic processes such as refrigeration and energy conversion is of broad current interest. We report experimental measurements of thermal flows and refrigeration in nanomechanical resonator networks in which nonreciprocity is controlled through an optically-induced synthetic magnetic flux. Time-modulated optomechanical interactions allow controlled coupling, gauge fields, and refrigeration processes through nanomechanical frequency conversion. We quantify nonequilibrium heat flows between resonators coupled to dissipative baths of different occupation and image heat and effective temperature in networks through measuring correlations of fluctuations. Synthetic magnetism is shown to imprint chirality on thermal fluctuations in a loop of resonators, leading to pronounced chiral flows with different handedness in distinct frequency bands. We find that the heat flows in a non-equilibrium system are tuned by the synthetic magnetic flux, which redistributes energy in the thermal steady-state. Specifically, we illustrate how nonreciprocity enhances the refrigeration of a resonator in the strong coupling regime, reducing its temperature below the bound that applies to time-reversal symmetric networks. These results experimentally demonstrate the impact of nonreciprocity on thermodynamic machines, and provide new methods to characterize them at the microscopic level.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过实验测量研究了由光学诱导合成磁通控制的纳米机械谐振器网络中的热流与制冷过程。时间调制的光机械相互作用实现了可控耦合、规范场以及通过频率转换实现的制冷，并可借助涨落关联测量非平衡热流与有效温度。结果显示，合成磁场会在谐振器环路中赋予热涨落以手性特征，形成明显的定向热流，并通过重分配稳态能量来增强制冷效果。
authors: Jesse J. Slim, Javier del Pino, Sander A. Mann, Ewold Verhagen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解互易性破缺如何影响热流以及制冷和能量转换等微观热力学过程，是当前具有广泛兴趣的问题。我们报告了对纳米机械谐振器网络中热流和制冷的实验测量，其中非互易性通过光诱导的合成磁通进行控制。时间调制的光机械相互作用通过纳米机械频率转换实现了可控耦合、规范场和制冷过程。我们量化了与不同占据数耗散热浴耦合的谐振器之间的非平衡热流，并通过测量涨落相关性在网络中成像热量和有效温度。研究表明，合成磁性会在谐振器环路中的热涨落上刻印手性，从而在不同频带中产生具有不同旋向的显著手性流。我们发现，非平衡系统中的热流可由合成磁通调控，该磁通会在热稳态中重新分配能量。具体而言，我们展示了非互易性如何在强耦合区域增强一个谐振器的制冷，使其温度降低到适用于时间反演对称网络的界限以下。这些结果在实验上证明了非互易性对热力学机器的影响，并提供了在微观层面表征它们的新方法。

articles.title: Accessing Few-Layer CrI₃ Magnetoelasticity Through Bulk Single Crystals
articles.title_zh: 通过块体单晶探测少层 CrI₃ 的磁弹耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The persistence of ferromagnetic long-range order in monolayers of the van der Waals semiconductor CrI₃ opens new routes for spintronic applications based on two-dimensional quantum magnets. In the fabrication of such devices, the constituent materials inevitably experience anisotropic strain, which modifies their intrinsic electronic properties. At the same time, strain can serve as a powerful tuning parameter, driving the material to desired regimes. While several theoretical studies have investigated the effect of biaxial in-plane strain on CrI₃ numerically, experiments are widely limited to the application of hydrostatic pressure. Here, we perform high-resolution magnetostriction experiments on bulk CrI₃ samples, and ab-initio-based magnetoelastic calculations, to elucidate the role of uniaxial lattice strain on the magnetic properties. Our data show that magnetostriction in CrI₃ is unexpectedly sensitive to surface effects, which enables us to investigate the influence of in-plane and out-of-plane strain separately, in both the bulk ferromagnetic (BFM) phase emerging at Tₘ̊ C=61,K and the surface antiferromagnetic (SAFM) phase below T^* simeq 50,K. In particular, we quantify the uniaxial strain dependence of the surface interlayer coupling Jm̊ SAFMₚₑᵣₚ and the surface spin-flip field B^*, which drastically exceed the strain effects in the BFM phase by a factor of sim 30. The large magnetostrictive response allows us to study the magnetoelastic coupling in few-layer CrI₃ through experiments on bulk single crystals, without requiring exfoliation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过高分辨磁致伸缩实验和基于第一性原理的磁弹计算，研究了块体 CrI₃ 中单轴晶格应变对磁性性质的影响。研究动机在于：CrI₃ 单层保持铁磁长程有序，使其成为二维量子磁体和自旋电子学的重要候选材料，而应变又是调控其性质的关键手段。结果表明，CrI₃ 的磁致伸缩对表面效应异常敏感，从而使得研究者能够分别考察面内与面外应变在块体铁磁相及表面反铁磁相中的作用。
authors: J. Arneth, M. Möller, D. A. S. Kaib, P. P. Stavropoulos, A. Razpopov, M. Jonak, S. Spachmann, M. Abdel-Hafiez, S. Biswas, K. Riedl, R. Valentí, R. Klingeler
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德华半导体 CrI₃ 单层中铁磁长程有序的保持，为基于二维量子磁体的自旋电子学应用开辟了新途径。在这类器件的制备过程中，组成材料不可避免地会经历各向异性应变，从而改变其本征电子性质。与此同时，应变也可以作为一种强有力的调控参数，将材料驱动到所需状态。尽管已有若干理论研究从数值上考察了双轴面内应变对 CrI₃ 的影响，实验上却很大程度局限于施加静水压力。在这里，我们对块体 CrI₃ 样品开展高分辨率磁致伸缩实验，并进行基于从头算的磁弹性计算，以阐明单轴晶格应变对磁性质的作用。我们的数据显示，CrI₃ 中的磁致伸缩对表面效应具有出乎意料的敏感性，这使我们能够在 T_C=61 K 出现的块体铁磁（BFM）相以及 T*≈50 K 以下的表面反铁磁（SAFM）相中，分别研究面内和面外应变的影响。特别地，我们量化了表面层间耦合 J_SAFM⊥ 和表面自旋翻转场 B* 对单轴应变的依赖性，它们对应变的响应大幅超过 BFM 相中的应变效应，约为其 30 倍。巨大的磁致伸缩响应使我们无需剥离即可通过块体单晶实验研究少层 CrI₃ 中的磁弹性耦合。

articles.title: Distinct finite-temperature phase diagrams of non-invertible Kennedy--Tasaki duals
articles.title_zh: 非可逆 Kennedy–Tasaki 对偶的不同有限温相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24231v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Do two Hamiltonians related by a non-invertible transformation necessarily share the same finite-temperature phase diagram? For a cluster-model interpolation H(s) and its Kennedy--Tasaki dual tilde H(s), the map is a partial isometry and equates only their all-plus-sector partition functions. In one dimension, thermal order is forbidden on both sides, leaving only the common zero-temperature transition at s=tfrac12. In three dimensions, however, the inequivalence is exact already at s=0: the cluster model has an analytic paramagnetic free energy, whereas its dual mathbb Z₂ gauge theory has a deconfinement transition at T_capprox1.31. Quantum Monte Carlo shows that the mismatch occupies a finite window of the interpolation, marked by a self-dual frozen wedge on the cluster side and a deconfined dome on the gauge side; once both close the two phase diagrams agree again, coinciding over the entire remaining interval up to the shared trivial endpoint s=1.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论非可逆变换关联的两个哈密顿量是否必然共享相同的有限温相图。以簇模型插值哈密顿量及其 Kennedy–Tasaki 对偶为例，作者指出该映射只是一个部分等距变换，只能对应它们在全正扇区中的配分函数。研究表明，在一维中两侧都不允许热序，因此只有共同的零温相变；但在三维中，两者在有限参数区间内的有限温行为明显不同：簇模型保持解析的顺磁自由能，而其对偶的 Z₂ 规范理论则出现去禁闭相变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由非可逆变换联系起来的两个哈密顿量是否必然共享相同的有限温相图？对于簇模型插值 H(s) 及其 Kennedy–Tasaki 对偶 H̃(s)，该映射是一个部分等距映射，并且只使它们的全正扇区配分函数相等。在一维中，两侧都禁止热有序，因此只留下在 s=1/2 处共同的零温转变。然而在三维中，这种不等价性早在 s=0 时就是精确的：簇模型具有解析的顺磁自由能，而其对偶的 Z₂ 规范理论在 T_c≈1.31 处具有退禁闭转变。量子蒙特卡罗表明，这种不匹配占据插值中的一个有限窗口，其特征是在簇模型一侧出现自对偶冻结楔形区域，在规范理论一侧出现退禁闭穹顶；一旦二者都闭合，两个相图便再次一致，并在直到共同平庸端点 s=1 的整个剩余区间内重合。

articles.title: Square Net TaSiAs Nanowires with Topological Surface Conduction and Linear Magnetoresistance
articles.title_zh: 具有拓扑表面导电与线性磁阻的方网 TaSiAs 纳米线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24244v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Square-net topological materials exhibit various interesting properties arising from the interplay of their structural diversity, topologically protected bands and different possible electronic features, including intrinsic magnetic ordering and superconductivity. However, little is known about the low-dimensional structures of these materials and their properties. Realization of low-dimensional topological square-net materials has the potential of enabling enhancement of their quantum behavior arising from quasi-compact 1D geometry and high surface-to-volume ratio, and their integration into functional devices. This work reports on the synthesis and properties of high-quality, single-crystal nanowires of Si square-net material TaSiAs. The chemical-vapor-transport produces TaSiAs nanowires that are chemically encapsulated with a thin dielectric shell of SiO2, enabling remarkable ambient stability and a pristine surface, which are critical for observing robust topologically protected surface states. Atomic-resolution structural analysis reveals a sharp core-shell interface, and a Si square-net lattice extending along the nanowire axis. These chemically protected nanowires allowed us to observe rich electrical and magnetotransport features, including 4 to 11 times lower room-temperature resistivity than the closest bulk analogues and non-saturating linear magnetoresistance, revealing topologically protected coherent surface transport. First-principles calculations show a wide-range (4 eV) linear band dispersion, alongside different Dirac cones that are protected by either symmorphic (C4) or non-symmorphic symmetries, predicting transport features consistent with our results. The findings demonstrate the unique properties of low-dimensional square-net topological materials and their potential applications, including next-generation interconnects, spintronic devices and quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了方网拓扑材料 TaSiAs 高质量单晶纳米线的合成与结构特征。化学气相输运制备得到的纳米线外覆薄 SiO₂ 介电壳层，因此具有优异的环境稳定性和洁净表面，这对于观测稳健的拓扑保护表面态至关重要。原子分辨结构分析显示，纳米线具有清晰的核壳界面，并且 Si 方网晶格沿纳米线轴向延伸，为进一步研究其低维拓扑输运性质奠定了基础。
authors: Anand Roy, Ofek Goldreich, Guy Ohad, Barun Barick, Olga Brontvein, Ora Bitton, Katya Rechav, Yishay Feldman, Leeor Kronik, Ernesto Joselevich
articles.abstract_zh_full: 方网拓扑材料展现出多种有趣性质，这些性质源于其结构多样性、拓扑保护能带以及不同可能电子特征之间的相互作用，包括本征磁有序和超导性。然而，人们对这些材料的低维结构及其性质知之甚少。实现低维拓扑方网材料有可能借助准紧凑的一维几何形状和高表面积体积比来增强其量子行为，并将其集成到功能器件中。本工作报道了 Si 方网材料 TaSiAs 高质量单晶纳米线的合成与性质。化学气相输运制备出 TaSiAs 纳米线，其外部由一层薄的 SiO₂ 介电壳层进行化学封装，从而具有显著的环境稳定性和原始洁净表面，这对于观测稳健的拓扑保护表面态至关重要。原子分辨结构分析揭示出清晰的核壳界面，以及沿纳米线轴向延伸的 Si 方网晶格。这些受化学保护的纳米线使我们能够观察到丰富的电学和磁输运特征，包括比最接近的块体类似物低 4 至 11 倍的室温电阻率，以及非饱和线性磁阻，揭示出拓扑保护的相干表面输运。第一性原理计算显示出宽范围（4 eV）的线性能带色散，并存在由共形（C4）或非共形对称性保护的不同狄拉克锥，预言的输运特征与我们的结果一致。这些发现展示了低维方网拓扑材料的独特性质及其潜在应用，包括下一代互连、自旋电子器件和量子计算。

articles.title: Catalyst Diffusion Transformer: Generative Inverse Design of Heterogeneous Catalysts
articles.title_zh: 催化剂扩散 Transformer：异相催化剂的生成式逆向设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The vast chemical design space and complex, interdependent design variables make catalyst discovery for targeted properties highly labor- and resource-intensive. Although generative models have emerged as a promising solution, existing approaches are generally limited to single-property conditioning or narrow chemical spaces. Here, we present Catalyst Diffusion Transformer (CatDiT), a unified framework for inverse catalyst design that generates valid and novel structures ranging from intermetallic alloys to oxide surfaces. By learning compressed latent representations, CatDiT enables efficient training and rapid sampling while supporting simultaneous conditioning on adsorbate type, binding energy, and catalyst class. The model provides reliable control of discrete properties and directional control of continuous properties, enriching candidate pools for reaction-specific catalyst discovery. As a representative application, multi-conditional generation for the nitrogen reduction reaction (NRR) yields 28 density functional theory (DFT)-relaxed alloy candidates that satisfy the target activity window and lie above the pure-metal *N-*H scaling line, corresponding to a ~1.5-fold enrichment over the source distribution. These results establish CatDiT as a practical and scalable approach for property-directed catalyst inverse design and targeted catalyst generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出催化剂扩散 Transformer（CatDiT），用于异相催化剂的统一逆向设计，可生成从金属间化合物到氧化物表面的一系列有效且新颖的结构。该模型通过学习压缩潜变量表示，实现高效训练与快速采样，并支持同时对吸附物种、结合能和催化剂类别进行条件控制。作为示例，作者将其用于氮还原反应的多条件生成，获得了 28 个经 DFT 弛豫后满足目标活性窗口的合金候选体。
authors: Hayoung Doo, Dong Hyeon Mok, Seoin Back, Jonggeol Na
articles.abstract_zh_full: 广阔的化学设计空间以及复杂且相互依赖的设计变量，使面向目标性质的催化剂发现高度依赖劳动和资源。尽管生成模型已成为一种有前景的解决方案，现有方法通常局限于单一性质条件或狭窄化学空间。在这里，我们提出 Catalyst Diffusion Transformer（CatDiT），这是一个用于催化剂逆向设计的统一框架，能够生成从金属间合金到氧化物表面的有效且新颖结构。通过学习压缩的潜在表征，CatDiT 支持高效训练和快速采样，同时支持对吸附物类型、结合能和催化剂类别进行同步条件控制。该模型能够可靠控制离散性质，并对连续性质进行方向性控制，从而丰富面向特定反应催化剂发现的候选池。作为代表性应用，面向氮还原反应（NRR）的多条件生成产生了 28 个经密度泛函理论（DFT）弛豫的合金候选体，这些候选体满足目标活性窗口，并位于纯金属 *N-*H 标度线之上，相对于源分布对应约 1.5 倍的富集。这些结果确立了 CatDiT 作为一种实用且可扩展的方法，可用于性质导向的催化剂逆向设计和靶向催化剂生成。

articles.title: Steady base states in a two-dimensional chiral fluid. The chiral Stokes cavity
articles.title_zh: 二维手性流体中的稳态基态：手性 Stokes 腔
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop from first principles the hydrodynamics of a two-dimensional chiral fluid, i.e. one carrying a net microscopic angular-momentum (spin) field. Enforcing angular-momentum conservation without imposing stress-tensor symmetry, we derive the full form of the stress tensor and of the spin flux, and we show that the entire chiral response is generated from the classical Newtonian one by a single operation of direct physical origin --- the 90ⁱ̧rc rotation through which chirality acts, mirrored at the particle level by transverse forces (Caprini & Marini Bettolo Marconi 2025). Applied to the irreducible (deviatoric) decomposition, the rotation assigns to each classical channel a chiral partner --- pressure to chiral pressure, bulk and shear viscosities to their odd counterparts, the spin-flux gradient to its rotated image --- one coefficient and one mechanical action per channel, with no further cross-couplings. In this representation the steady base states become elementary. Quiescent states are organised by a holomorphic chiral complex potential, the mechanical and chiral pressures forming a conjugate harmonic pair subject to a topological existence condition; inhomogeneous activity forces azimuthal flows; and a boundary-driven confined flow, the chiral Stokes cavity, obeys a modified Helmholtz--Poisson system, solved in closed form in a circular domain and numerically in a square one. A single dimensionless group controls both geometries and sets the crossover from a screened, single-vortex regime to a sequence of sign-reversing vortical structures. The theory yields quantitative predictions, amenable to direct comparison with experiments on air-fluidised chiral disks (López-Castaño et al. 2022), and recovers the phenomenological frameworks of the chiral-fluid literature as particular cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从第一性原理出发建立了二维手性流体的流体力学理论，即描述具有净微观角动量（自旋）场的流体。作者在不要求应力张量对称的前提下引入角动量守恒，推导出完整的应力张量与自旋通量，并指出手性响应可由经典牛顿响应通过一个 90° 旋转操作生成。基于该表述，静态基态及其压力、自旋相关量的结构可被清晰刻画，为手性 Stokes 腔中的稳态分析提供了统一框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从第一性原理出发发展二维手性流体的流体力学，即一种携带净微观角动量（自旋）场的流体。通过在不施加应力张量对称性的情况下强制角动量守恒，我们推导出应力张量和自旋通量的完整形式，并表明整个手性响应都可由经典牛顿响应通过一个具有直接物理来源的单一操作生成——即手性发挥作用所通过的 90° 旋转，这一过程在粒子层面由横向力所对应（Caprini 与 Marini Bettolo Marconi，2025）。应用于不可约（偏量）分解时，该旋转为每一个经典通道指定一个手性伙伴——压力对应手性压力，体黏度和剪切黏度对应其奇黏度对应物，自旋通量梯度对应其旋转像——每个通道对应一个系数和一种力学作用，且不存在进一步的交叉耦合。在这种表示中，稳态基态变得十分基本。静止态由一个全纯手性复势组织起来，机械压力和手性压力形成一对共轭调和函数，并受拓扑存在条件约束；非均匀活性会驱动方位流；而边界驱动的受限流动，即手性 Stokes 空腔，服从修正的 Helmholtz–Poisson 系统，该系统在圆形区域中得到闭式解，在方形区域中得到数值解。一个单一的无量纲群控制两种几何，并设定从屏蔽的单涡旋状态到一系列符号反转涡旋结构的交叉。该理论给出了定量预言，可与空气流化手性圆盘实验（López-Castaño 等，2022）直接比较，并将手性流体文献中的唯象框架作为特例加以恢复。

articles.title: Aligning Heterogeneous DFT Datasets: A Graph Neural Network Approach to Cross-Functional Formation Energies
articles.title_zh: 异构 DFT 数据集对齐：用于跨泛函形成能预测的图神经网络方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24327v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heterogeneous density functional theory (DFT) calculations, particularly plane-wave implementations, introduce systematic formation energy errors ranging from tens to hundreds of meV/atom, depending on the selection of exchange-correlation functionals, kinetic energy cutoffs, pseudopotentials, and dispersion corrections. As demonstrated by the MatPES dataset, identical structures can exhibit an average energy discrepancy of 107 meV/atom between PBE and r2SCAN calculations. Such method-dependent discrepancies hinder the integration of multi-source DFT data, greatly limiting the scale and quality of datasets for training robust materials AI models. Here, we resolve this fundamental data silo barrier via graph-based transfer learning. Leveraging 380,190 structurally paired PBE-r2SCAN entries from the MatPES database, we train a structure-aware graph neural network to predict cross-functional energy residuals and align inconsistent DFT energy scales. By adopting GPTFF model architecture, the model converts conventional PBE energies to r2SCAN-level accuracy with a mean absolute error of 14.3 meV/atom, compared with 18.2 meV/atom achieved by CHGNet. This versatile approach effectively upgrades massive legacy PBE datasets to high-precision r2SCAN standards. It enables reliable predictions of phase stability, battery voltage profiles, and reaction thermodynamics, while allowing the integration of multi-source DFT data to advance the development of high-performance materials foundation models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对不同密度泛函理论计算设置导致的形成能系统偏差，提出基于图神经网络的迁移学习框架，以对齐多来源 DFT 能量标度。作者利用 MatPES 中大量 PBE–r2SCAN 结构配对数据训练结构感知模型，预测跨泛函能量残差，并将常规 PBE 能量转换到接近 r2SCAN 的精度。结果表明，该方法可显著降低能量误差，有助于打破材料 AI 训练数据中的方法学数据孤岛。
authors: Yidong Huang, Tenglong Lu, Hanwen Kang, Junfeng Huang, Sheng Meng, Miao Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 异构密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，尤其是平面波实现，会引入从数十到数百 meV/atom 不等的系统性形成能误差，这取决于交换-相关泛函、动能截断、赝势和色散校正的选择。正如 MatPES 数据集所展示的，相同结构在 PBE 与 r2SCAN 计算之间可表现出平均 107 meV/atom 的能量差异。这类依赖方法的差异阻碍了多源 DFT 数据的整合，极大限制了用于训练稳健材料 AI 模型的数据集规模和质量。在这里，我们通过基于图的迁移学习解决这一基础性数据孤岛障碍。利用 MatPES 数据库中 380,190 个结构配对的 PBE-r2SCAN 条目，我们训练了一个结构感知图神经网络，用以预测跨泛函能量残差并对齐不一致的 DFT 能量尺度。通过采用 GPTFF 模型架构，该模型将常规 PBE 能量转换到 r2SCAN 级别精度，平均绝对误差为 14.3 meV/atom，而 CHGNet 达到的是 18.2 meV/atom。这一通用方法能够有效地将海量遗留 PBE 数据集升级到高精度 r2SCAN 标准。它使得相稳定性、电池电压曲线和反应热力学的可靠预测成为可能，同时允许整合多源 DFT 数据，以推动高性能材料基础模型的发展。

articles.title: Hybrid-parity sliding multiferroics
articles.title_zh: 混合宇称滑移多铁性材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sliding ferroelectrics provide a nonvolatile platform for the electrical control of unconventional magnetism through reversible interlayer sliding. However, the coupling between sliding ferroelectricity and hybrid-parity nonrelativistic spin splitting (NSS) remains largely unexplored. Here, we introduce a class of hybrid-parity sliding multiferroics in which the spontaneous ferroelectric polarization is coupled to certain NSS components through interlayer sliding, allowing these components to be reversibly switched in an electrical way. Symmetry analysis identifies coplanar magnets as natural platforms for realizing this form of sliding multiferroicity. First-principles calculations establish bilayer VBr₂ as a representative example, demonstrating the coupled reversal of the out-of-plane ferroelectric polarization (±0.12 pC/m) and the signs of both even- and odd-parity NSS components via an interlayer-sliding pathway with an ultralow barrier of 6 meV/f.u. The signs of these NSS components are locked to the sliding-switchable ferroelectric polarization and encoded in the spin-current responses, providing a signature of the coupled ferroic switching. Our findings expand the scope of sliding multiferroics and the functionality of sliding ferroelectrics for low-energy, nonvolatile logic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一类“混合宇称滑移多铁性材料”，其中层间滑移诱导的铁电极化与非相对论自旋劈裂分量相耦合，并可通过电学方式可逆切换。对称性分析表明，共面磁体是实现此类滑移多铁性的天然平台。第一性原理计算以双层 VBr₂ 为例，展示了低能垒滑移路径下铁电极化与偶、奇宇称自旋劈裂符号的协同反转，为电控自旋响应提供了新机制。
authors: Zhenzhou Guo, Jiangtao Yu, Shibo Fang, Jin Cao, Xiaodong Zhou, Yee Sin Ang, Wenhong Wang, Zhenxiang Cheng, Xiaotian Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 滑移铁电体通过可逆层间滑移，为非常规磁性的电学控制提供了一种非易失平台。然而，滑移铁电性与混合宇称非相对论自旋劈裂（NSS）之间的耦合仍很大程度上未被探索。在这里，我们引入一类混合宇称滑移多铁性材料，其中自发铁电极化通过层间滑移与某些 NSS 分量耦合，从而允许这些分量以电学方式可逆切换。对称性分析确定共面磁体是实现这种滑移多铁性的天然平台。第一性原理计算确立双层 VBr₂ 为一个代表性例子，展示了通过具有 6 meV/f.u. 超低势垒的层间滑移路径，实现面外铁电极化（±0.12 pC/m）以及偶宇称和奇宇称 NSS 分量符号的耦合反转。这些 NSS 分量的符号被锁定到可由滑移切换的铁电极化上，并编码在自旋流响应中，为耦合铁性切换提供了标志。我们的发现扩展了滑移多铁性材料的范围以及滑移铁电体在低能耗、非易失逻辑器件中的功能性。

articles.title: Large-area CVD Graphene for Photogating-Based Photodetection
articles.title_zh: 用于基于光栅控效应光探测的大面积 CVD 石墨烯
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Our work explores large-area CVD graphene as a scalable platform for photodetectors. We show that substrate-induced photogating in graphene/SiO₂/Si structures enables a photoconductivity signal in mono-, bi-, and trilayer CVD graphene. The devices respond to illumination with photon energies above the Si band gap and do not respond to telecom frequency, suggesting the photoconductivity mechanism through the photogating. Large sample area and gate voltage-dependent resistivity measurements allow us to prove the dominant role of the photogating directly, demonstrating similarity of the capacitive recharging current and the photoresponse. The sensitivity is the highest (995 A/W) for the monolayer graphene. Increasing the number of graphene layers reduces the sensitivity due to screening and parallel conduction, but can improve detectivity by lowering the noise level. The sensitivity of CVD graphene device depends on fabrication route of photolitography: device with metal contacts fabricated before graphene transfer show higher photoresponce. Thus, our work demonstrate the potential of industrially relevant CVD graphene for sensitive photogating-based photodetectors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究大面积 CVD 石墨烯作为可扩展光探测器平台的潜力，证明石墨烯/SiO₂/Si 结构中的衬底诱导光栅控效应可在单层、双层和三层石墨烯中产生光电导信号。器件仅对高于硅带隙的光子能量有响应，而对电信波段无响应，支持光栅控机制解释。单层石墨烯表现出最高响应度，多层结构因屏蔽和平行导电降低响应度但可能通过降低噪声提高探测率；制备流程，尤其是金属接触形成顺序，也会影响光响应。
authors: D. A. Matienko, D. P. Borisenko, A. Yu. Kuntsevich
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们的工作探索了大面积 CVD 石墨烯作为光探测器可扩展平台的可能性。我们表明，石墨烯/SiO₂/Si 结构中的衬底诱导光栅控效应，使单层、双层和三层 CVD 石墨烯中能够出现光电导信号。这些器件对光子能量高于 Si 带隙的照明作出响应，而对电信频率不响应，这表明光电导机制来自光栅控。大样品面积以及栅压依赖电阻率测量使我们能够直接证明光栅控的主导作用，显示出电容再充电电流与光响应之间的相似性。单层石墨烯的灵敏度最高，为 995 A/W。增加石墨烯层数会由于屏蔽和平行导电而降低灵敏度，但可通过降低噪声水平来提高探测率。CVD 石墨烯器件的灵敏度取决于光刻的制备路线：在石墨烯转移之前制备金属接触的器件表现出更高光响应。因此，我们的工作展示了具有工业相关性的 CVD 石墨烯在高灵敏光栅控光探测器中的潜力。

articles.title: Anomalous Localization in Magnetically Doped Two-Dimensional Topological Insulators
articles.title_zh: 磁掺杂二维拓扑绝缘体中的反常局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional topological insulators (2DTIs) harbor spin-polarized edge states that are topologically protected by time-reversal symmetry against non-magnetic structural disorder. However, coupling to magnetic impurities breaks this symmetry, inducing backscattering and destroying perfect quantization. While the impact of isolated dilute magnetic impurities is well understood, the transport properties in the presence of dense, disordered ensembles of magnetic moments remain poorly understood. In this work, we develop an analytical framework, supported by extensive numerical simulations, that captures the behavior of edge transport in two-dimensional topological insulators (2DTIs) with a finite concentration of magnetic impurities. We predict the onset of Anderson localization and uncover an anomalous localization regime characterized by a sub-exponential decay of the conductance, scaling as łn a̧l G propto -sqrtL, where L is the system length. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the transport exhibits a universal scaling behavior governed solely by the effective impurity concentration. Applying our model to Mn-doped HgTe quantum wells, we find excellent agreement with experimental data. These findings provide a theoretical foundation for understanding anomalous localization phenomena in magnetically doped topological phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察有限浓度磁性杂质对二维拓扑绝缘体边缘输运的影响。作者建立解析框架并结合数值模拟，预测磁性无序可导致 Anderson 局域化，并发现一种电导随系统长度呈亚指数衰减的反常局域化区域。研究还指出输运行为由有效杂质浓度控制并呈现普适标度，可用于理解如 Mn 掺杂 HgTe 量子阱等体系中的边缘态退相干与反向散射。
authors: Felippe Amorim, Washington F. dos Santos, Mauro S. Ferreira, Alexandre Reily Rocha, Caio Lewenkopf
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维拓扑绝缘体（2DTI）具有自旋极化边缘态，这些边缘态受到时间反演对称性的拓扑保护，可抵抗非磁性结构无序。然而，与磁性杂质的耦合会破坏这种对称性，引起反向散射并破坏完美量子化。尽管孤立稀疏磁性杂质的影响已得到很好理解，存在致密、无序磁矩集合时的输运性质仍了解不足。在本工作中，我们发展了一个解析框架，并由广泛的数值模拟支持，用以刻画具有有限浓度磁性杂质的二维拓扑绝缘体（2DTI）中的边缘输运行为。我们预测了 Anderson 局域化的出现，并揭示出一种反常局域化区域，其特征是电导呈次指数衰减，标度关系为 ln G ∝ -√L，其中 L 为系统长度。此外，我们证明输运表现出仅由有效杂质浓度控制的普适标度行为。将我们的模型应用于 Mn 掺杂 HgTe 量子阱时，我们发现其与实验数据高度一致。这些发现为理解磁掺杂拓扑相中的反常局域化现象提供了理论基础。

articles.title: A Grand-Canonical Solution to a Class of Random Optimization Problems
articles.title_zh: 一类随机优化问题的巨正则解法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24455v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a general framework to solve a class of combinatorial opti- mization problems, including the matching problem, the Traveling Salesman Problem, and also the minimum weight k-factor problem. By reformulating these problems as an arrangement model, we recast the optimization task into a grand-canonical ensemble, where chemical potentials are used to re- lax strict topological constraints. The analytical solution found can serve as a polynomial-time algorithm to compute an approximate minimum cost for arbitrary k and link-weight distributions. Our framework is complementary to existing approaches and reveals new connections between combinatorial optimization and the statistical physics of disordered systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出求解一类组合优化问题的通用框架，涵盖匹配问题、旅行商问题以及最小权 k-因子问题等。作者将这些问题重写为排列模型，并引入巨正则系综，通过化学势放松严格拓扑约束。所得解析解可作为多项式时间近似算法，用于估计不同 k 值和边权分布下的最小代价，同时揭示组合优化与无序系统统计物理之间的新联系。
authors: Izat B Baybusinov, Enrico M Fenoaltea, Zhen Han, Yi-Cheng Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入一个通用框架，用以求解一类组合优化问题，包括匹配问题、旅行商问题以及最小权重 k-因子问题。通过将这些问题重新表述为一种排列模型，我们把优化任务改写为巨正则系综，其中使用化学势来放松严格的拓扑约束。所找到的解析解可作为一种多项式时间算法，用于在任意 k 和边权分布下计算近似最小代价。我们的框架与现有方法互为补充，并揭示了组合优化与无序系统统计物理之间的新联系。

articles.title: Neural RHEED alignment with limited training data during CdTe MBE growth
articles.title_zh: CdTe 分子束外延生长中基于少量训练数据的神经网络 RHEED 对准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a data-efficient neural-vision assisted method to automate crystallographic alignment during molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth. Trained on reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) patterns from only 15 CdTe structures, our model - enabled by physics-aware postprocessing - reliably infers crystallographic directions, replacing manual frame-by-frame inspection. To this end, we design, test, and critically compare neural-network architectures based on 2D and 3D ResNet configurations, both with and without postprocessing that leverages the physical constraints of RHEED image acquisition. Our work delivers (i) a fully trained neural system ready for closed-loop deployment in future CdTe growth experiments and (ii) a generalizable pipeline for new materials where access to diverse RHEED datasets is limited. More broadly, this study represents a step toward AI-driven MBE growth and demonstrates the potential of machine-learning-assisted automation in thin-film synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种数据高效的神经视觉辅助方法，用于自动化分子束外延生长中的晶向对准。模型仅使用 15 个 CdTe 结构的反射高能电子衍射图样训练，并结合物理约束后处理，能够可靠推断晶体学方向。作者比较了二维和三维 ResNet 架构及其后处理效果，展示了面向 CdTe 闭环生长和小数据新材料体系的可推广自动化流程。
authors: Bartłomiej Turowski, Jakub J. Meixner, Róża Dziewikatkowska, Wojciech Zaleszczyk, Tomasz Wojciechowski, Valentine V. Volobuev, Marcin M. Wysokiński, Tomasz Wojtowicz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入一种数据高效的神经视觉辅助方法，用于在分子束外延（MBE）生长过程中自动化晶体学对准。我们的模型仅基于来自 15 个 CdTe 结构的反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）图样进行训练，并在物理感知后处理的支持下，能够可靠推断晶体学方向，从而取代逐帧人工检查。为此，我们设计、测试并批判性比较了基于 2D 和 3D ResNet 配置的神经网络架构，包括带有和不带有利用 RHEED 图像采集物理约束的后处理两种情况。我们的工作提供了：（i）一个训练完成的神经系统，可在未来 CdTe 生长实验中进行闭环部署；以及（ii）一个可推广到新材料的流程，适用于难以获得多样化 RHEED 数据集的情形。更广泛地说，本研究代表着迈向 AI 驱动 MBE 生长的一步，并展示了机器学习辅助自动化在薄膜合成中的潜力。

articles.title: Amortized Posteriors for Estimation of Material Constitutive Parameters from Multimodal Measurements on Small Punch Tests
articles.title_zh: 基于小冲杆试验多模态测量反演材料本构参数的摊销后验方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24534v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bayesian calibration of material constitutive parameters from multimodal mechanical test data is often limited by the need to specify a joint likelihood across measurement modalities that differ in dimensionality, noise structure, and physical units. The resulting posteriors are often broad or strongly correlated, causing standard Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) samplers to mix poorly. Here, we present an amortized, likelihood-free framework that combines Gaussian process (GP) surrogates with Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) to learn conditional posteriors over constitutive parameters directly from synthetic multimodal parameter--observation pairs, avoiding hand-crafted likelihoods and repeated MCMC sampling. Once trained, the GP--CFM model generates posterior samples for each new specimen at negligible cost. The utility of this novel approach is demonstrated in this paper by estimating the values of Young's modulus and yield strength from the early portion of the force--displacement (F--D) curve and a Digital Image Correlation (DIC)-based displacement field measured in a Small Punch Test (SPT). It is observed that the F--D data alone produce broad posteriors, consistent with limited parameter discrimination in the global response. Adding the DIC-measured displacement field was seen to contract the posteriors and shift them towards the independently measured tensile reference values. This work establishes a robust likelihood-free framework for the inference of material constitutive parameters from multimodal data, demonstrated through SPT--DIC integration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种无似然、摊销式贝叶斯框架，用于从多模态力学测试数据中估计材料本构参数，避免手工构造跨模态联合似然和重复 MCMC 采样。方法结合高斯过程代理模型与条件流匹配，直接从合成的参数—观测数据对中学习条件后验分布。作者以小冲杆试验中早期力—位移曲线和 DIC 位移场为例，估计杨氏模量与屈服强度，展示了多模态信息融合对参数不确定性表征的价值。
authors: Mohammad Ali Seyed Mahmoud, Aditya Venkatraman, Raj Mahat, Samantha Mitra, Surya R. Kalidindi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从多模态力学试验数据对材料本构参数进行贝叶斯校准，常常受到需要指定跨测量模态联合似然的限制，而这些模态在维度、噪声结构和物理单位方面各不相同。由此得到的后验分布往往较宽或具有强相关性，导致标准马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）采样器混合不佳。在这里，我们提出一种摊销的无似然框架，将高斯过程（GP）代理模型与条件流匹配（CFM）相结合，直接从合成的多模态参数—观测对中学习本构参数的条件后验，从而避免手工构造似然和重复进行 MCMC 采样。训练完成后，GP—CFM 模型能够以可忽略的成本为每个新试样生成后验样本。本文通过利用小冲杆试验（SPT）中测得的力—位移（F—D）曲线早期部分以及基于数字图像相关（DIC）的位移场来估计杨氏模量和屈服强度的数值，展示了这一新方法的效用。研究观察到，仅使用 F—D 数据会产生较宽的后验，这与全局响应对参数区分能力有限相一致。加入 DIC 测得的位移场后，后验被收缩，并向独立测得的拉伸参考值移动。本工作建立了一种稳健的无似然框架，用于从多模态数据推断材料本构参数，并通过 SPT—DIC 集成进行了展示。

articles.title: Magnetic anisotropy in the near-stoichiometric van der Waals ferromagnet Fe₃GeTe₂
articles.title_zh: 近化学计量范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe₂ 中的磁各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24543v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasi-two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) ferromagnets such as the series Fe₃₋ₓGeTe₂, with a relatively high Curie temperature and robust metallicity, offer an ideal platform for investigating itinerant magnetism in reduced dimensions. Here, we present a comprehensive electron spin resonance (ESR) investigation of single-crystalline almost-stoichiometric Fe₃.₀₃ ± ₀.₀₃GeTe₂ across wide ranges of frequencies, temperatures, and magnetic fields to gain quantitative insights into its magnetic anisotropy and spin dynamics. Frequency-dependent ESR measurements establish Fe₃GeTe₂ as an easy-axis ferromagnet. Temperature-dependent high-field ESR reveals a large internal field that gradually decreases at higher temperatures. Remarkably, this internal field persists even above T_C, evidencing short-range spin correlations in Fe₃GeTe₂. Analysis of spin-wave modes yields a strong uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy Kᵢₙₜ approx - 5 × 10⁶ erg cm⁻³ at 3 K and a large magnon gap Δ(3 K) approx 87.8 ± 13.7 GHz (approx 0.363 ± 0.057 meV). Our study highlights that small variations in Fe content in Fe₃GeTe₂ lead to substantial changes in the magnon gap at low temperatures, indicating the extreme sensitivity of spin dynamics to the chemical composition. These results establish Fe₃GeTe₂ as a model vdW ferromagnet for exploring tunable anisotropies and magnon excitations in metallic 2D magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过宽频率、温度和磁场范围的电子自旋共振实验，系统考察近化学计量单晶 Fe₃GeTe₂ 的磁各向异性与自旋动力学。频率依赖测量表明该材料为易轴铁磁体，高场 ESR 发现较大的内部场，并且该内部场在居里温度以上仍部分存在，说明短程自旋关联持续存在。自旋波分析给出强单轴磁晶各向异性和较大的磁振子能隙，表明微小 Fe 含量变化可显著影响其磁性质。
authors: Riju Pal, Joyal John Abraham, Satyabrata Bera, Mintu Mondal, Atindra Nath Pal, Bernd Buchner, Vladislav Kataev, Alexey Alfonsov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准二维（2D）范德瓦耳斯（vdW）铁磁体，如 Fe₃₋ₓGeTe₂ 系列，具有相对较高的居里温度和稳健的金属性，为研究低维巡游磁性提供了理想平台。在这里，我们对单晶近化学计量 Fe₃.₀₃ ± ₀.₀₃GeTe₂ 在宽频率、温度和磁场范围内进行了全面的电子自旋共振（ESR）研究，以获得其磁各向异性和自旋动力学的定量认识。频率依赖的 ESR 测量确立了 Fe₃GeTe₂ 是一种易轴铁磁体。温度依赖的高场 ESR 揭示了一个较大的内场，该内场在较高温度下逐渐减小。值得注意的是，该内场甚至在 T_C 以上仍然存在，证明 Fe₃GeTe₂ 中存在短程自旋关联。对自旋波模式的分析得到强单轴磁晶各向异性 Kᵢₙₜ 约为 -5 × 10⁶ erg cm⁻³（3 K），以及较大的磁振子能隙 Δ(3 K) 约为 87.8 ± 13.7 GHz（约 0.363 ± 0.057 meV）。我们的研究强调，Fe₃GeTe₂ 中 Fe 含量的微小变化会导致低温下磁振子能隙发生显著改变，表明自旋动力学对化学组成极其敏感。这些结果确立了 Fe₃GeTe₂ 作为一种模型 vdW 铁磁体的地位，可用于探索金属二维磁体中可调控的各向异性和磁振子激发。

articles.title: Quantum oscillation fingerprints of altermagnetism in hole-doped RuO2
articles.title_zh: 空穴掺杂 RuO₂ 中交替磁性的量子振荡指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24599v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism, characterized by its ferromagnetism-like spin-splitting band structure and antiferromagnetism-like magnetic order, has garnered considerable attention recently. Although hole doping may promote magnetism in the debated altermagnet candidate RuO2, the evolution of its electronic and magnetic properties under hole doping remains poorly understood. Based on first-principles calculations, we employ quantum oscillations to study hole-doped RuO2. We find that hole doping can enhance spin splitting and reconstruct the Fermi surface in RuO2, which is revealed by the angle-dependent quantum oscillation frequency. By tracking a pair of closed Fermi-surface pockets, we identify a meaningful correlation between the magnetic moment of Ru and a quantum-oscillation-based signature of spin splitting. This correlation follows a quasi-linear trend over a broad doping range, which can be captured by a minimal two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic model. In addition, the hole-doped RuO2 exhibits a transition from a nonmagnetic to an altermagnetic state via an intermediate state. The quasi-linear correlation through quantum oscillation and the distinct quantum oscillation frequency of the stable altermagnetic state can serve as useful signatures for identifying the altermagnetic state in RuO2. Our results provide a comprehensive framework for understanding hole-doped RuO2, offering new insights into altermagnetic transitions and their identification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于第一性原理计算，利用量子振荡分析空穴掺杂 RuO₂ 的电子结构和磁性演化。结果表明，空穴掺杂可增强自旋劈裂并重构费米面，这可通过角度依赖的量子振荡频率识别。作者进一步发现 Ru 磁矩与基于量子振荡的自旋劈裂特征之间存在近似线性关联，并可由二维 d 波交替磁性简化模型描述，为实验识别掺杂 RuO₂ 中的交替磁性提供了判据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁性以其类似铁磁性的自旋劈裂能带结构和类似反铁磁性的磁有序为特征，近来受到广泛关注。尽管空穴掺杂可能促进存在争议的交替磁候选材料 RuO2 中的磁性，但其电子和磁性质在空穴掺杂下的演化仍然了解不足。基于第一性原理计算，我们利用量子振荡研究空穴掺杂 RuO2。我们发现，空穴掺杂可以增强 RuO2 中的自旋劈裂并重构费米面，这可由角度依赖的量子振荡频率揭示。通过追踪一对闭合费米面口袋，我们识别出 Ru 磁矩与基于量子振荡的自旋劈裂特征之间存在有意义的关联。该关联在较宽掺杂范围内遵循准线性趋势，并可由一个最小二维 d 波交替磁模型捕捉。此外，空穴掺杂 RuO2 经由一个中间态表现出从非磁态到交替磁态的转变。通过量子振荡得到的准线性关联以及稳定交替磁态的独特量子振荡频率，可作为识别 RuO2 中交替磁态的有用特征。我们的结果为理解空穴掺杂 RuO2 提供了一个全面框架，并为交替磁转变及其识别提供了新的见解。

articles.title: A General Model of Interfacial Chemical Equilibrium in Phase-Field Method
articles.title_zh: 相场方法中界面化学平衡的一般模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a new approach to interfacial equilibria among multiple solution phases in the phase-field method. It employs auxiliary non-conserved variables to describe the composition differences among different phases, and their temporal evolution is driven by the differences among different chemical diffusional potentials. It is reduced to the Wheeler-Boettinger-McFadden (WBM) model of equal interfacial chemical compositions and to the Kim-Kim-Suzuki (KKS) model of equal interfacial chemical diffusion potentials as two limiting cases. It can directly incorporate thermodynamic databases without any further approximations and simplifications. It is generally applicable to a wide range of problems involving composition evolution and chemical equilibria, including processes such as interdiffusion between two ordered phases not sharing any common composition range, which would pose difficulty to the existing treatments using WBM and KKS models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于相场方法中多溶液相界面平衡的新模型，通过引入辅助非守恒变量描述不同相之间的成分差异，并由化学扩散势差驱动其演化。该模型在两个极限下可分别退化为 Wheeler–Boettinger–McFadden 模型和 Kim–Kim–Suzuki 模型。它能够直接结合热力学数据库而无需额外近似，适用于多种涉及成分演化与化学平衡的问题，包括传统模型难以处理的有序相互扩散情形。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了一种在相场方法中处理多个溶液相之间界面平衡的新方法。该方法采用辅助非守恒变量来描述不同相之间的成分差异，其时间演化由不同化学扩散势之间的差异驱动。作为两个极限情形，它可化简为具有相等界面化学成分的 Wheeler-Boettinger-McFadden（WBM）模型，以及具有相等界面化学扩散势的 Kim-Kim-Suzuki（KKS）模型。它能够在不进行任何进一步近似和简化的情况下直接纳入热力学数据库。该方法通常适用于涉及成分演化和化学平衡的广泛问题，包括两个不共享任何共同成分范围的有序相之间的互扩散等过程；这类过程会给现有使用 WBM 和 KKS 模型的处理方法带来困难。

articles.title: Skew scattering induced contribution to orbital Hall response
articles.title_zh: 斜散射诱导的轨道霍尔响应贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Our study provides the disorder-induced contribution to the orbital Hall conductivity in three-dimensional Weyl semimetals with broken time-reversal symmetry. Using the quantum kinetic approach, we analyse the impact of side-jump and skew scattering contributions to the system. The dependence of the orbital Hall conductivity on both disorder potential and the Fermi energy is explicitly demonstrated. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the higher-order disorder contribution, especially from the third power of disorder potential, dominates the orbital Hall conductivity under an oscillating electric field in a time-reversal symmetry broken Weyl semimetal, suppressing other scattering mechanisms, including the side jump contributions. We can enhance the extrinsic orbital Hall conductivity by tuning the strength of the disorder potential, applied energy, and choosing the system with appropriate Weyl node separation. Finally, our results are supported by numerical estimations and highlight potential experimental relevance for advancing orbitronics device technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了时间反演对称性破缺三维 Weyl 半金属中无序诱导的轨道霍尔电导贡献。作者采用量子动力学方法，考察旁跳与斜散射机制，并明确展示轨道霍尔电导对无序势和费米能级的依赖。研究指出，在振荡电场下，高阶无序项尤其是三阶无序势贡献可主导轨道霍尔响应，并可通过调节无序强度、外加能量和 Weyl 节点间距增强外禀轨道霍尔效应。
authors: Dayana Joy, Vivek Pandey, Rhonald Burgos Atencia, Pankaj Bhalla
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们的研究给出了时间反演对称性破缺的三维 Weyl 半金属中由无序诱导的轨道霍尔电导贡献。利用量子动理学方法，我们分析了旁跳和斜散射贡献对该系统的影响。轨道霍尔电导对无序势和费米能量的依赖被明确展示。此外，我们证明，在时间反演对称性破缺的 Weyl 半金属中，在振荡电场作用下，高阶无序贡献，特别是来自无序势三次方的贡献，会主导轨道霍尔电导，并抑制包括旁跳贡献在内的其他散射机制。我们可以通过调节无序势强度、施加能量以及选择具有适当 Weyl 节点分离的系统来增强外禀轨道霍尔电导。最后，我们的结果得到了数值估计的支持，并突出了其在推进轨道电子学器件技术方面的潜在实验相关性。

articles.title: Sign-optimized Quantum Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 符号优化量子蒙特卡洛
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The sign problem breaks the polynomial scaling of Quantum Monte Carlo methods. We alleviate it by rotation of the local basis of the Hilbert space, such that the phase of off-diagonal matrix elements of the rotated Hamiltonian is minimized. These minima coincide with optima of the average sign. We benchmark our method for frustrated Heisenberg antiferromagnets in one dimension and on the two-dimensional maple-leaf lattice. Our approach reveals more efficient bases with improved sign in a large part of the parameter space for all models considered, enabling us to reach lower temperatures, on par with state-of-the-art numerical linked cluster expansions which we directly compare to.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出通过旋转希尔伯特空间局域基来缓解量子蒙特卡洛中的符号问题，使旋转后哈密顿量非对角矩阵元的相位最小化，从而优化平均符号。作者在一维受挫 Heisenberg 反铁磁体和二维 maple-leaf 晶格上进行了基准测试。结果显示，该方法在较大参数范围内找到更高效的基底并改善符号表现，使模拟能够达到更低温度，并与先进的数值联通团簇展开结果相当。
authors: Julius S. Herz, Robin Schäfer, Matías G. Gonzalez, David J. Luitz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 符号问题破坏了量子蒙特卡罗方法的多项式标度。我们通过旋转希尔伯特空间的局域基来缓解这一问题，使旋转后哈密顿量的非对角矩阵元相位最小化。这些最小值与平均符号的最优值相一致。我们在一维受挫海森堡反铁磁体以及二维枫叶晶格上的受挫海森堡反铁磁体中对我们的方法进行了基准测试。对于所考虑的所有模型，我们的方法在很大一部分参数空间中揭示了具有改进符号的更高效基，使我们能够达到更低温度，并与最先进的数值链簇展开处于同等水平；我们还与其进行了直接比较。

articles.title: Fluctuation theorems for autonomous work in the quantum regime
articles.title_zh: 量子区自主功的涨落定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24690v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fluctuation theorems for work provide universal constraints on nonequilibrium fluctuations, yet their quantum generalizations often rely on externally prescribed classical driving protocols. While for classical systems, fluctuation theorems have been extended to autonomous work, where the dynamics of the work source is subject to the backaction of the system, their generalization to the quantum regime is constrained by the uncertainty principle. Here, we extend fluctuation theorems for autonomous work from the classical regime to the quantum regime. By performing successive projective measurements over the work source and the system, we derive Jarzynski-type and Crooks-type fluctuation theorems for autonomous inclusive work from initial mixed thermal states. These relations are analogous to fluctuation theorems for autonomous work in the classical regime and explicitly incorporate the fluctuations of the work source. However, quantum noncommutativity prevents a consistent reduction to the nonautonomous counterparts, even in the limit of a large work source and correspondingly negligible backaction. By contrast, under the exclusive work definition, the nonautonomous limit is recovered when the measured observable of the work source commutes with its bare Hamiltonian and the backaction of the system on the work source is negligible. Our results are illustrated with the Dicke model, where a single-mode radiation field and an ensemble of two-level atoms act as the system of interest and the work source, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将经典自主功体系中的涨落定理推广到量子区，重点处理功源动力学会受到系统反作用影响的情形。作者通过对功源和系统进行连续投影测量，从初始混合热态出发推导了自主包含功的 Jarzynski 型和 Crooks 型涨落关系，并显式纳入功源涨落。研究指出，由于量子非对易性，即使在大功源、反作用可忽略的极限下，也难以一致地还原为通常的外驱动非自主涨落定理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 功的涨落定理为非平衡涨落提供了普适约束，但其量子推广通常依赖于外部预先规定的经典驱动协议。虽然对于经典系统，涨落定理已被扩展到自主功情形，其中功源的动力学受系统反作用影响，但其推广到量子区域受到不确定性原理的限制。在这里，我们将自主功的涨落定理从经典区域扩展到量子区域。通过对功源和系统进行连续投影测量，我们从初始混合热态推导了自主包含功的 Jarzynski 型和 Crooks 型涨落定理。这些关系类似于经典区域中的自主功涨落定理，并显式纳入功源的涨落。然而，即使在功源很大且相应反作用可忽略的极限下，量子非对易性也阻止其一致地化简为非自主对应形式。相比之下，在排他功定义下，当功源的被测可观测量与其裸哈密顿量对易且系统对功源的反作用可忽略时，非自主极限得以恢复。我们的结果用 Dicke 模型加以说明，其中单模辐射场和二能级原子系综分别充当感兴趣系统和功源。

articles.title: Practical advantage beyond the quadratic speedup limit with fully-quantum walks
articles.title_zh: 全量子行走实现超越二次加速极限的实际优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22818v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a new class of fully-quantum Metropolis walks in which both the proposal and acceptance steps are intrinsically quantum. Unlike standard quantum walks obtained by quantizing classically efficient Markov chains, our algorithm employs Hamiltonian simulation as a quantum-native proposal mechanism, enlarging the class of quantum walks beyond classical counterparts. We target the problem of sampling from the low-temperature Gibbs distribution of classical dense Ising models, within a fixed error in total variation distance. This approach achieves about a cubic polynomial asymptotic advantage over previous quantum-walks, resulting in a total sixth-degree polynomial queries speedup compared to the best classical walk. This shows that speedups beyond the widely assumed quadratic limit are possible within the quantum walk formalism. We perform a complete fault-tolerant compilation of all algorithmic primitives and benchmark against CPU, GPU, and FPGA implementations of the best classical Markov chain. Under identical hardware assumptions, the resulting advantage runtime crossover is reduced from approximately 10³ years for conventional quantum walks to less than one day. These results identify fully-quantum Markov chains as a promising route toward practical quantum advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一类全量子 Metropolis 行走，其中提议步骤和接受步骤都具有内禀量子性质，而非仅量子化经典高效马尔可夫链。算法以哈密顿量模拟作为量子原生的提议机制，用于在固定总变差误差下采样经典稠密 Ising 模型的低温 Gibbs 分布。作者报告其相较既有量子行走具有约三次多项式渐近优势，并相对最佳经典行走达到总计六次多项式查询加速，同时进行了容错编译和与 CPU、GPU、FPGA 经典实现的基准比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了一类新的全量子 Metropolis 行走，其中提议步骤和接受步骤都是内禀量子的。不同于通过量子化经典高效 Markov 链而获得的标准量子行走，我们的算法采用哈密顿量模拟作为量子原生的提议机制，将量子行走类别扩展到经典对应物之外。我们瞄准的问题是在总变差距离固定误差内，从经典稠密 Ising 模型的低温 Gibbs 分布中进行采样。相较此前的量子行走，该方法实现了约三次多项式的渐近优势，从而相对于最佳经典行走获得总计六次多项式查询加速。这表明，在量子行走形式体系内，超越广泛假定的二次限制的加速是可能的。我们对所有算法原语进行了完整的容错编译，并与最佳经典 Markov 链的 CPU、GPU 和 FPGA 实现进行了基准比较。在相同硬件假设下，由此得到的优势运行时间交叉点从传统量子行走的约 10³ 年降低到不到一天。这些结果表明，全量子 Markov 链是通向实用量子优势的一条有前景路径。

articles.title: Universal scaling framework for parameterized quantum evolutions at criticality
articles.title_zh: 临界点处参数化量子演化的普适标度框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22863v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Variational ansätze are a cornerstone of quantum many-body physics, providing compact approximations to complex ground states using finite resources. Recent quantum-technology advances have introduced a new class based on layered parameterized evolutions. Assessing whether they can represent critical ground states is challenging: correlations span all length scales, while finite circuit depth limits how far they extend. Building on finite-resource scaling from tensor networks, we assign each ansatz an emergent correlation length ξ_D, the longest range over which it faithfully captures critical correlations. Its growth with refinement parameter D, ξ_D propto D^κ, defines an exponent κ measuring how efficiently an architecture converts resources into long-distance correlations. Applying this framework to the critical transverse-field Ising model, with D the circuit depth of parameterized evolutions, we compare ansätze with nearest-neighbor and long-range generators, and layers where generators act separately or combined. All ansätze are compatible with algebraic growth, but fitted exponents range from κsimeq1 to κsimeq3. Exponential interactions give the largest exponents, while power-law interactions stay close to nearest-neighbor behavior, showing long-range support alone gives no scaling advantage. Combined-generator layers generally outperform separable ones, so layer organization matters alongside interaction range. Finally, a quasiparticle analysis shows finite depth leaves an unresolved window of width ξ_D⁻¹ around the low-energy modes responsible for long-distance correlations. The emergent correlation length thus acts as an infrared resolution scale, providing a benchmark for critical-state preparation and a guide for designing resource-efficient variational architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种用于评估分层参数化量子演化变分拟设在临界基态表示能力上的有限资源标度框架。作者为每类拟设定义涌现关联长度 ξ_D，并以其随资源参数 D 的增长指数 κ 衡量架构将有限资源转化为长程关联的效率。以临界横场 Ising 模型为例，研究比较了近邻与长程生成元、分离或组合层结构等方案，发现不同拟设均与代数增长相容，但拟合指数差异显著。
authors: Jan T. Schneider, Cristian Tabares, Alejandro González-Tudela, Luca Tagliacozzo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 变分 ansatz 是量子多体物理的基石，它利用有限资源为复杂基态提供紧凑近似。近期量子技术进展引入了一类基于分层参数化演化的新型 ansatz。评估它们能否表示临界基态具有挑战性：关联跨越所有长度尺度，而有限线路深度限制了关联能够延伸的距离。借鉴张量网络中的有限资源标度，我们为每个 ansatz 指定一个涌现关联长度 ξ_D，即其能够忠实捕捉临界关联的最长范围。其随细化参数 D 的增长 ξ_D 正比于 D^κ，定义了指数 κ，用于衡量一种架构将资源转化为长距离关联的效率。将该框架应用于临界横场 Ising 模型，并以参数化演化的线路深度作为 D，我们比较了具有最近邻和长程生成元的 ansatz，以及生成元分别作用或组合在同一层中的 ansatz。所有 ansatz 都与代数增长相容，但拟合指数范围从 κ 约为 1 到 κ 约为 3。指数型相互作用给出最大的指数，而幂律相互作用仍接近最近邻行为，表明仅有长程支撑并不带来标度优势。组合生成元层通常优于可分生成元层，因此除相互作用范围外，层组织方式也很重要。最后，准粒子分析表明，有限深度会在负责长距离关联的低能模式附近留下一个宽度为 ξ_D⁻¹ 的未解析窗口。因此，涌现关联长度充当红外分辨率尺度，为临界态制备提供基准，并为设计资源高效的变分架构提供指导。

articles.title: CP2K: An electronic structure and molecular dynamics software package - Dynamics, Transport, and Spectroscopic Response
articles.title_zh: CP2K：电子结构与分子动力学软件包——动力学、输运与光谱响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22916v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One of the distinguishing aspects of CP2K is its seamless integration of diverse structural and transition-state optimization techniques with advanced sampling approaches including Monte Carlo, molecular dynamics, and metadynamics, enabling the efficient exploration of complex potential- and free-energy landscapes, including rare events. These capabilities are combined with a broad hierarchy of energy and force evaluation methods, ranging from classical and machine-learned interaction potentials and mixed quantum-classical multiscale and semiempirical schemes, to highly accurate quantum-mechanical electronic-structure approaches. At the heart of the latter lies the Gaussian and plane-wave framework, along with its augmented all-electron generalization, which have been described in detail in our previous code review [T. D. Kühne et al., J. Chem. Phys. 152, 194103 (2020)]. Building on this foundation, the present work revisits the methods within CP2K that turn electronic structure into dynamics, transport, and spectroscopic response. Particular emphasis is placed on the coupling between static response calculations and nuclear motion: spectra may be evaluated at optimized structures, averaged over thermally sampled configurations, obtained from time-correlation functions along ab-initio or path integral molecular trajectories, or followed in real time together with electronic and nuclear dynamics. The same modular structure also enables equilibrium and biased transport simulations, from Kubo-type linear response to open-boundary approaches under external potentials, highlighting CP2K's unique capability to unify quantum chemistry with quantum and statistical mechanics within a versatile, holistic simulation environment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述介绍 CP2K 中将电子结构计算与动力学、输运和光谱响应相结合的方法体系。CP2K 将结构与过渡态优化、高级采样、蒙特卡罗、分子动力学和元动力学等功能，与从经典势、机器学习势到量子力学电子结构方法的多层级能量与力评估相整合。本文在既有高斯和平面波框架基础上，重点回顾静态响应计算与核运动耦合等用于模拟动力学和谱学响应的功能。
authors: Jan Wilhelm, Anna Hehn, Hossam Elgabarty, Beliz Sertcan Gökmen, Maximilian Graml, Stepan Marek, Ritaj Tyagi, Frederick Stein, Johann V. Potoschnig, Augustin Bussy, Christian S. Ahart, Zehua Chen, Linnea Andersson, Zdenek Futera, Filip Ivanovic, Margherita Buraschi, Christoph Schran, Remi Pasquier, Leonard Prokisch, Bibek Samal, Jelena Schmitz, Shridhar Sanjay Shanbhag, Harald Forbert, Ole Schütt, Franz Pöschl, Sebastian Ehlert, Stefano Battaglia, Michele Nottoli, Benjamin Stamm, Vamsee Voora, Rustam Z. Khaliullin, Sergey K. Chulkov, Matt B. Watkins, Clotilde S. Cucinotta, Jochen Blumberger, Chao Zhang, Yang Yang, Dominik Marx, Matthias Krack, Jürg Hutter, Marcella Iannuzzi, Thomas D. Kühne
articles.abstract_zh_full: CP2K 的一个显著方面是，它将多种结构和过渡态优化技术与包括蒙特卡罗、分子动力学和元动力学在内的先进采样方法无缝集成，从而能够高效探索复杂的势能和自由能景观，包括稀有事件。这些能力与广泛层级的能量和力评估方法相结合，其范围从经典和机器学习相互作用势、混合量子—经典多尺度与半经验方案，到高度精确的量子力学电子结构方法。后者的核心是高斯和平面波框架及其增强的全电子推广，这些已在我们先前的代码综述中详细描述[T. D. Kühne et al., J. Chem. Phys. 152, 194103 (2020)]。在这一基础上，本文重新审视 CP2K 中将电子结构转化为动力学、输运和光谱响应的方法。特别强调静态响应计算与核运动之间的耦合：光谱可以在优化结构处计算，可以对热采样构型进行平均，可以从从头算或路径积分分子轨迹上的时间关联函数获得，也可以与电子和核运动一起实时跟踪。同样的模块化结构还支持平衡和偏置输运模拟，从 Kubo 型线性响应到外部势作用下的开放边界方法，突出了 CP2K 在一个通用且整体化的模拟环境中统一量子化学与量子及统计力学的独特能力。

articles.title: Mixing times and spectra of non-equilibrium symmetric exclusion processes on general graphs
articles.title_zh: 一般图上非平衡对称排斥过程的混合时间与谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22991v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The symmetric exclusion process (SEP) is a classical model of interacting particles on a graph, in which multiple particles execute random walks subject to the constraint that no two particles may occupy the same vertex. The version of the process in which the number of particles is fixed, is by now very well understood, through the study of reversible Markov chains. In this paper, we study the non-equilibrium version of the SEP, in which some vertices of the graph interact with external heat baths, held at different temperatures, that mediate transport through the graph. The resulting steady-state distribution is still the stationary distribution of a natural Markov chain, but the chain is no longer reversible. This means that even the steady-state distribution is very hard to describe, and indeed is the subject of a rich literature, which has focused almost exclusively on graphs which are finite subsets of the lattice Z^d. Very little is known about other important quantities, notably the mixing time. We derive various quantitative results about the non-equilibrium SEP for arbitrary graphs with arbitrary heat baths. Our main result is a bound on the mixing time in terms of the worst-case hitting time of a single particle to any of the heat baths; this bound is tight up to two logarithmic factors in the size of the graph. We then use this result to derive a simple algorithm, running in time roughly nO⁽k⁾, that computes the steady-state joint occupation distribution for any set of k vertices; since the steady-state distribution is very elusive, this provides a potentially useful tool to study its k-wise correlations for small values of k. Finally, we prove that the spectrum of the Markov chain associated with the non-reversible dynamics for the SEP is independent of the heat bath temperatures; thus in particular the spectrum is always real.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究一般图上的非平衡对称排斥过程，其中部分顶点与不同温度的外部热浴相互作用，从而驱动粒子输运。与固定粒子数的可逆情形不同，该过程对应的自然马尔可夫链通常不可逆，使稳态分布和混合时间等量难以刻画。作者针对任意图和任意热浴推导了若干定量结果，旨在拓展此前主要集中于整数格子有限子集的研究。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对称排斥过程（SEP）是图上相互作用粒子的经典模型，其中多个粒子执行随机游走，并受限于任意两个粒子不能占据同一顶点。粒子数固定的版本如今已经通过对可逆马尔可夫链的研究而得到很好的理解。本文研究SEP的非平衡版本，其中图上的某些顶点与外部热浴相互作用，这些热浴处于不同温度，并通过它们在图上介导输运。由此产生的稳态分布仍然是某个自然马尔可夫链的平稳分布，但该链不再可逆。这意味着即使是稳态分布也极难描述，事实上这一直是一个丰富研究方向的主题，而这些研究几乎完全聚焦于Z^d晶格的有限子集图上。关于其他重要量，尤其是混合时间，人们所知甚少。我们针对具有任意热浴的任意图，推导了非平衡SEP的若干定量结果。我们的主要结果是给出一个混合时间上界，该上界以单个粒子到任一热浴的最坏情形首次到达时间为参数；这一上界在图大小的两个对数因子意义下是紧的。随后我们利用这一结果给出一种简单算法，其运行时间大致为nO⁽k⁾，可计算任意k个顶点集合的稳态联合占据分布；由于稳态分布极难获得，这为研究其在小k情形下的k-体关联提供了一个潜在有用的工具。最后，我们证明与SEP的非可逆动力学相关的马尔可夫链谱与热浴温度无关；因此，特别地，其谱总是实数。

articles.title: Digital techniques for the frustrated Ising ring: the role of counter-diabatic terms
articles.title_zh: 受挫 Ising 环的数字技术：反绝热项的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23074v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the role of local counter-diabatic (CD) terms in enhancing the performance of discrete-time digital protocols for a frustrated Ising ring, a system with an exponentially small spectral gap that acts as a bottleneck for conventional quantum annealing. The techniques investigated range from a digitised version of a fixed-schedule protocol, including lowest-order analytical CD terms, all the way to a full-fledged Quantum Approximate Optimisation Algorithm (QAOA), including variational CD terms (DC-QAOA). By analyzing the resulting residual energy, we show that DC-QAOA combined with Chopped RAndom Basis (CRAB) quantum control techniques for optimizing the circuit parameters, can outperform all the other strategies. By monitoring the ground-state population during the dynamics we learn that DC-QAOA finds effective shortcuts towards the target state through intermediate excited states, a process that is unexpectedly enhanced by the inclusion of local CD unitaries. Our results highlight the importance of flexible variational control of CD dynamics and demonstrate that digital optimization can explore operator dynamics that remain inaccessible to standard analytical CD constructions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察局域反绝热项在提升受挫 Ising 环离散时间数字协议性能中的作用，该系统具有指数小谱隙，是常规量子退火的瓶颈。作者比较了包含最低阶解析反绝热项的数字化固定调度方案，以及含变分反绝热项的 QAOA 等策略。结果表明，结合 CRAB 量子控制优化参数的 DC-QAOA 可优于其他方法，并可能通过中间激发态形成通向目标态的有效捷径。
authors: Kiran Thengil, Vincenzo Roberto Arezzo, Giuseppe E. Santoro
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究局域反绝热（CD）项在提升离散时间数字协议性能中的作用，所针对的是一个受挫伊辛环系统。该系统具有指数小的谱隙，而这构成了常规量子退火的瓶颈。所研究的技术范围从固定日程协议的数字化版本（包括最低阶解析CD项），一直到完整的量子近似优化算法（QAOA），其中还包括变分CD项（DC-QAOA）。通过分析所得的剩余能量，我们表明，与Chopped RAndom Basis（CRAB）量子控制技术结合、用于优化电路参数的DC-QAOA，能够优于其他所有策略。通过监测动力学过程中的基态占据率，我们发现DC-QAOA通过中间激发态找到了通往目标态的有效捷径，而引入局域CD幺正后，这一过程还出人意料地得到了增强。我们的结果强调了对CD动力学进行灵活变分控制的重要性，并表明数字优化能够探索标准解析CD构造所无法触及的算符动力学。

articles.title: Autonomous Physical Computation: A Categorical Closure Criterion for Physical and Neuromorphic Reservoirs
articles.title_zh: 自主物理计算：物理与神经形态储备池的范畴闭合判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23902v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physical reservoirs, neuromorphic devices, and wave-mediated systems often possess memory, feedback, and rich state-dependent dynamics, but these properties do not by themselves establish autonomous computation. Here we develop a closure criterion for autonomous physical computation, motivated by the wave--particle walker. We formulate the walker as a stroboscopic reservoir with state, where the wave field stores an exponentially decaying trace of previous droplet impacts and guides future motion through local slope coupling. This model separates physical writing, storage, reading, feedback, and externally triggered erasure. We then define computation as robust coarse-grained transition preservation: a physical map implements an abstract transition only when a coarse-graining satisfies compositionality, with abstract states realized by separated physical basins and transitions stable under noise. Autonomous physical computation requires a further closure condition: an internal physical readout state must select the next physical operation. This criterion classifies the wave--particle walker as a wave-memory machine with genuine Turing-like primitives, but not as a closed autonomous physical computer, because the erasing phase shift is externally imposed. The framework turns this distinction into a design principle: memory becomes autonomous computation when physical readout basins are coupled back to operation selection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于判定自主物理计算的闭合准则，特别面向物理储备池、神经形态器件和波介导系统。作者以波—粒行走器为动机，将其表述为具有状态的频闪储备池，并区分物理写入、存储、读取、反馈和外部触发擦除等环节。文章将计算定义为稳健的粗粒化转移保持，并进一步要求内部物理读出态能够选择下一步物理操作，以此区分一般波记忆动力学与真正的自主计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理储备、类脑器件和波动介导系统往往具有记忆、反馈和丰富的状态依赖动力学，但这些性质本身并不能建立自主计算。这里我们发展了一种面向自主物理计算的闭包判据，其动机来自波-粒行者。我们将该行者表述为一个具有状态的时序储备系统，其中波场存储对先前液滴撞击的指数衰减痕迹，并通过局部坡度耦合引导未来的运动。该模型区分了物理写入、存储、读出、反馈以及外部触发的擦除。随后，我们将计算定义为鲁棒的粗粒化转移保持：只有当某个粗粒化满足组合性，且抽象状态由彼此分离的物理盆地实现、并且在噪声下转移保持稳定时，物理映射才实现了某个抽象转移。自主物理计算还需要一个更进一步的闭包条件：内部物理读出态必须能够选择下一次物理操作。该判据将波-粒行者归类为一种波记忆机器，具有真正的图灵式原语，但并不是一个封闭的自主物理计算机，因为擦除相位偏移是由外部施加的。该框架将这一区别转化为一种设计原则：当物理读出盆地与操作选择重新耦合时，记忆就成为自主计算。

articles.title: Non-Centrosymmetric γ-Phase GaS Nanobelts for On-Chip Nonlinear Photonic Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向片上非线性光子应用的非中心对称 γ 相 GaS 纳米带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23939v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Second-order nonlinear optical processes in van der Waals (vdW) semiconductors offer a compelling route toward compact, integrable photon-conversion platforms. Among III-VI vdW semiconductors, GaS is particularly attractive owing to its wide bandgap suppressing two-photon absorption under near-infrared laser excitation. However, bulk GaS typically crystallizes in the centrosymmetric β phase, which eliminates second-order nonlinearity and severely limits its application in nonlinear photonics. Here, we demonstrate that GaS nanobelts synthesized via self-catalyzed vapor-liquid-solid growth predominantly crystallize in non-centrosymmetric γ-phase stacking. This behavior originates from edge-selective growth kinetics at the Ga catalyst interface, which stabilizes the γ phase and enables deterministic in-plane dipole moment alignment. The GaS nanobelts exhibit strong second-harmonic generation (SHG) with intensities comparable to those of GaSe, a widely used nonlinear optical material. Furthermore, we integrate the nanobelts onto SiN waveguides and demonstrate efficient on-chip SHG and sum-frequency generation. These results establish γ-GaS nanobelts as a transferable one-dimensional nonlinear materials well suited for on-chip photonic integration and indicate their strong potential for nonlinear optical applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了通过自催化气-液-固生长制备的 GaS 纳米带主要呈现非中心对称 γ 相堆垛，从而克服体相 GaS 常见中心对称 β 相抑制二阶非线性的限制。作者认为这种相选择源于 Ga 催化剂界面的边缘选择性生长动力学，并使面内偶极矩取向可确定。所得纳米带表现出强二次谐波产生，且被集成到 SiN 波导上实现片上二次谐波和和频产生，显示其在集成非线性光子学中的潜力。
authors: Yukihiro Endo, Masato Takiguchi, Yoshiaki Sekine, Hisashi Sumikura, Yoshitaka Taniyasu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德瓦耳斯（vdW）半导体中的二阶非线性光学过程为紧凑、可集成的光子转换平台提供了一条极具吸引力的途径。在III-VI类vdW半导体中，GaS尤其具有吸引力，因为其宽带隙可抑制近红外激光激发下的双光子吸收。然而，体相GaS通常结晶为具有中心对称性的β相，这会消除二阶非线性并严重限制其在非线性光子学中的应用。这里，我们证明了通过自催化气-液-固生长合成的GaS纳米带主要结晶为非中心对称的γ相堆垛。这一行为源于Ga催化剂界面处的边缘选择性生长动力学，它稳定了γ相并实现了确定性的面内偶极矩取向。GaS纳米带表现出强的二次谐波产生（SHG），其强度可与广泛使用的非线性光学材料GaSe相媲美。此外，我们将这些纳米带集成到SiN波导上，并演示了高效的片上二次谐波产生和和频产生。这些结果确立了γ-GaS纳米带作为一种可转移的一维非线性材料，非常适合集成到片上光子器件中，并表明其在非线性光学应用中具有很强的潜力。

articles.title: Quantitative infrared nanoscopy: Probe-cavity eigenmodes and nano-gap polaritons for strongly coupled nanoscale optics
articles.title_zh: 定量红外纳米显微：强耦合纳米尺度光学中的探针腔本征模与纳米间隙极化激元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23950v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Optical nanoscopies including near-field optical microscopy and spectroscopy circumvent the diffraction limit of conventional optics thanks to the nanoscale light focus emerging at the apex of a sharp irradiated probe. However, while strong optical coupling between the apex and its dielectric environment affords both enhanced nanoscopic measurement sensitivity and potentially ultra-strong fields within a nano-gap cavity, the conditions for this coupling remain poorly quantified by prevailing analytic models. Here we present a robust formalism of probe-cavity eigenmodes that fully describes how mutual near-field interactions between probe and environment produce a composite response to external fields qualitatively distinct from that of its distinct components. This "EigenProbe" model identifies the fundamental excitations of realistic optical nanoscopies as nano-gap polaritons, which provide an elegant basis to accurately predict near-field microscopy and spectroscopy experiments especially when probe-sample interactions are non-perturbative. Through comparison to carefully controlled nanoscopies of polar phonons and molecular vibrations alike, we show how nano-gap polaritons are both realized and utilized for reliable and rapid "inversion" of local optical constants. This advance demands both a careful understanding of the probe response through quantitative calibration, and our efficient semi-analytic description of cavity eigenmode scattering at the probe apex. Our EigenProbe formalism sets the stage for maturing diverse and proliferating optical nanoscopies into precision metrologies of nano-scale optical environments, and guides future use of nano-gap cavities to manipulate local excitations of quantum materials and to achieve strong coupling over photonic emitters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出探针腔本征模形式化框架，用于定量描述近场光学显微和光谱中探针尖端与介电环境之间的强近场耦合。该“EigenProbe”模型将真实光学纳米显微中的基本激发识别为纳米间隙极化激元，可处理探针—样品相互作用非微扰的情形。通过与受控的极性声子和分子振动纳米显微实验比较，作者展示该模型有助于更准确预测近场显微和光谱响应。
authors: Benjamin Allen, Brayden Lukaskawcez, Alyssa Bragg, Nitzan Hirshberg, Leo Fan Bowen Lo, Michael Fogler, Dimitri N. Basov, Stephanie Gilbert-Corder, Hans Bechtel, Alexander S. McLeod
articles.abstract_zh_full: 包括近场光学显微镜和光谱在内的光学纳米成像，依靠在受激发尖锐探针顶端出现的纳米尺度聚光来规避传统光学的衍射极限。然而，虽然探针顶端与其介电环境之间的强光学耦合既带来了增强的纳米尺度测量灵敏度，也可能在纳米间隙腔体中产生超强场，但这种耦合成立的条件在现有解析模型中仍缺乏充分定量。这里我们提出一种稳健的探针-腔本征模形式化描述，它能够完整刻画探针与环境之间的互近场作用如何对外场产生复合响应，而这种响应在定性上不同于其各自独立部分的响应。这个“EigenProbe”模型将真实光学纳米成像的基本激发识别为纳米间隙极化子，它为准确预测近场显微与光谱实验提供了优雅的基础，尤其是在探针-样品相互作用处于非微扰区间时。通过与针对极性声子和分子振动所进行的精细控制纳米成像实验比较，我们展示了纳米间隙极化子既可以被实现，也可以被用于可靠且快速地反演局域光学常数。这一进展既要求对探针响应进行细致的定量标定，也需要我们在探针顶端对腔本征模散射进行高效的半解析描述。我们的EigenProbe形式化为将多样且迅速增长的光学纳米成像技术成熟为纳米尺度光学环境的精密计量学奠定了基础，并为未来利用纳米间隙腔操控量子材料中的局域激发以及实现与光子发射体的强耦合提供了指导。

articles.title: Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions in a Pseudo-Hermitian Hamiltonian: The Imbalanced-Pairing Kitaev Model
articles.title_zh: 赝厄米哈密顿量中的动力学量子相变：非平衡配对 Kitaev 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23956v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Although parity-time (PT)-symmetric Hamiltonians are often associated with real energy spectra, PT symmetry is neither a sufficient nor a necessary condition for a real spectrum. More generally, real spectra are associated with the broader class of pseudo-Hermitian Hamiltonians, of which PT-symmetric Hamiltonians constitute a simple subclass. Here, we investigate the nonequilibrium dynamics of the imbalanced-pairing Kitaev model, a prototypical pseudo-Hermitian system, under a linearly time-dependent chemical potential. The dynamics are analyzed within the biorthogonal framework using the concept of dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs). We show that, under a linear ramp protocol, DQPTs occur only when the post-ramp Hamiltonian possesses a real energy spectrum. For positive values of the non-Hermiticity parameter (γ>0), where the energy spectrum remains entirely real, a ramp crossing a single quantum critical point gives rise to a single family of critical times, analogous to the Hermitian case. Furthermore, for ramps crossing two critical or exceptional points, the critical sweep velocity above which DQPTs disappear decreases as the non-Hermiticity parameter is reduced and vanishes in the staggered-pairing limit, γ=-1.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在双正交框架下考察非平衡配对 Kitaev 模型这一典型赝厄米系统在化学势线性时变驱动下的非平衡动力学量子相变。作者指出，在线性斜坡协议下，只有当斜坡后的哈密顿量具有实能谱时才会出现动力学量子相变。对于非厄米参数 γ>0 且能谱保持全实时，穿越单个量子临界点会产生与厄米情形类似的一族临界时间；穿越两个临界点或例外点时，动力学相变消失的临界扫速会发生变化。
authors: R. Jafari, Alireza Akbari, Shukhrat Mardonov, H. Yavartanoo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管对称-时间（PT）对称哈密顿量常常与实能谱相关联，但PT对称性既不是实谱的充分条件，也不是必要条件。更一般地，实谱与更广泛的伪厄米哈密顿量类别相关，而PT对称哈密顿量只是其中一个简单子类。这里，我们研究非平衡配对Kitaev模型这一典型伪厄米系统在化学势线性随时间变化驱动下的非平衡动力学。我们在双正交框架内，借助动力学量子相变（DQPT）的概念来分析该动力学。我们表明，在一个线性扫描协议下，DQPT只会在扫描结束后的哈密顿量具有实能谱时发生。对于非厄米参数的正值（γ>0），此时能谱保持完全为实，当扫描穿越单个量子临界点时，会产生一族临界时刻，类似于厄米情形。此外，对于穿越两个临界点或例外点的扫描，DQPT消失的临界扫描速度会随着非厄米参数的减小而降低，并在交错配对极限γ=-1时趋于零。

articles.title: Non-classical photon statistics in frequency-modulated double quantum dot cavity systems
articles.title_zh: 频率调制双量子点腔系统中的非经典光子统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24067v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum dynamics of a double quantum dot two-level system, coupled to a leaking microwave resonator mode, is theoretically investigated. The double quantum dot is driven by applying a continuous field giving rise to time-dependent modulations of its energy separation between the ground levels of each dot, forming the qubit. Therefore, the cavity resonances occur when the difference between the resonator and the qubit frequencies equals the multiple of the modulation frequency, respectively. In the strong Coulomb interaction limit and the weak couplings of the combined system, i.e. the qubit and the single-mode cavity, to corresponding electronic, phononic or photonic reservoirs, we have demonstrated that the output cavity electromagnetic field is formed of a single-photon flux obeying the sub-Poissonian quantum photon statistics. This was proved via Fano's factor behaviour or by comparing the resonator's second- and third-order photon correlation functions, respectively. The phonon, the cavity mode dephasing or the environmental temperatures influence on the quantum properties of the photons are also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从理论上研究了耦合到有损微波谐振腔模的双量子点二能级系统的量子动力学。通过连续驱动调制双量子点基态能级间隔，系统在谐振腔频率与量子比特频率差等于调制频率整数倍时产生腔共振。作者在强库仑相互作用和弱环境耦合条件下表明，输出腔场可形成服从亚泊松统计的单光子通量，并讨论了声子、腔退相干和环境温度对光子量子性质的影响。
authors: T. Mihaescu, A. Isar, M. A. Macovei
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文理论研究了一个与有损微波谐振腔模耦合的双量子点两能级系统的量子动力学。通过施加一个连续场对双量子点进行驱动，从而使其两个点基态之间的能级分离产生随时间变化的调制，形成量子比特。因此，当谐振腔与量子比特频率之差等于调制频率的整数倍时，会出现腔共振。在强库仑相互作用极限，以及组合系统——即量子比特与单模腔——与对应电子、声子或光子库的弱耦合条件下，我们证明了输出的腔电磁场由符合亚泊松量子光子统计的单光子通量构成。这一点可通过Fano因子行为，或通过比较谐振腔的二阶和三阶光子关联函数来证明。我们还讨论了声子、腔模去相干以及环境温度对光子量子性质的影响。

articles.title: Lead nanoparticles, the deep-ultraviolet to near-infrared plasmonic platform
articles.title_zh: 铅纳米颗粒：覆盖深紫外至近红外的等离激元平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24340v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Among the other non-noble metals, lead (Pb) is a material of particular interest for plasmonic applications in the deep ultraviolet spectral region. However, experimental studies on its plasmonic performance have not yet been conducted. In this work, the dependence of the optical properties of spherical lead nanoparticles on their diameter is demonstrated. The plasmonic performance of chemically synthesized lead nanoparticles is evaluated at the single-particle level by means of a combination of scanning transmission electron microscopy and electron energy loss spectroscopy. Our findings demonstrate that these nanoparticles support localized surface plasmon resonances across the entire spectrum from near-infrared to deep-ultraviolet. This range was identified as the most extensive among all plasmonic elemental metals, extending to wavelengths below 200 nanometers. Consequently, lead nanoparticles exhibit stable plasmonic performance over a remarkably broad wavelength range, thereby substantiating their potential as a multispectral plasmonic platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究实验评估了球形铅纳米颗粒随直径变化的光学性质及其等离激元性能。作者结合扫描透射电子显微镜和电子能量损失谱，在单颗粒水平表征化学合成铅纳米颗粒。结果显示，这些颗粒可在从近红外到深紫外、甚至低于 200 纳米波长的宽光谱范围内支持局域表面等离激元共振，表明铅纳米颗粒有望作为多光谱等离激元平台。
authors: Michael Foltýn, Michal Kvapil, Kristýna Bukvišová, Tomáš Šikola, Michal Horák
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在其他非贵金属中，铅（Pb）是一种在深紫外光谱区域用于等离激元应用时特别值得关注的材料。然而，迄今尚未开展关于其等离激元性能的实验研究。在这项工作中，我们展示了球形铅纳米颗粒光学性质对其直径的依赖关系。我们通过扫描透射电子显微镜与电子能量损失谱的组合，在单颗粒层面评估了化学合成铅纳米颗粒的等离激元性能。我们的结果表明，这些纳米颗粒能够在从近红外到深紫外的整个光谱范围内支持局域表面等离激元共振。经识别，这一范围是所有等离激元元素金属中最宽的，延伸到200纳米以下的波长。因此，铅纳米颗粒在非常宽的波长范围内表现出稳定的等离激元性能，从而证明其作为多光谱等离激元平台的潜力。

articles.title: Quantum Fisher information and imperfect detection in a monitored fermion chain
articles.title_zh: 监测费米子链中的量子费舍尔信息与不完美探测
