articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24438v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the metrological properties of a continuously monitored Kitaev chain in the presence of imperfect detection. The system is conditioned on a no-click record, while each emitted fermion is registered only with probability 0łeq qłeq 1. Because the conditional dynamics remains Gaussian, the steady state is fully characterized by the fermionic correlation matrix. This allows a direct evaluation of the quantum Fisher information and of the mean Uhlmann curvature. For perfect detection, the monitored steady state retains a singular critical structure and the quantum Fisher information with respect to the chemical potential becomes super-extensive. For any q<1, imperfect detection introduces a finite smoothing length that rounds the singularity and restores extensive scaling. The detector efficiency behaves instead as a compatible mixed-state estimation parameter, as signaled by the vanishing mean Uhlmann curvature. These results show that incomplete trajectory information destroys the metrological enhancement associated with monitored criticality through a mechanism that differs from ordinary thermal smearing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在连续监测的 Kitaev 费米子链中，探测不完美性对计量性质的影响。系统在无点击记录条件下演化，每个发射费米子仅以概率 q 被探测到；由于条件动力学仍保持高斯形式，稳态可由费米子关联矩阵完全表征，从而可直接计算量子费舍尔信息和 Uhlmann 平均曲率。结果表明，理想探测下稳态保留奇异临界结构，化学势相关的量子费舍尔信息呈超广延标度；而任意 q<1 都会引入有限平滑长度，削弱奇异性并恢复广延标度。
authors: Giovanni Di Fresco, Davide Valenti, Angelo Carollo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在不完美探测条件下连续监测的Kitaev链的计量性质。系统在无点击记录条件下演化，而每个被发射的费米子仅以0≤q≤1的概率被记录。由于条件动力学保持高斯型，稳态可以由费米子关联矩阵完全刻画。这使得量子费舍尔信息和Uhlmann平均曲率能够被直接计算。对于完美探测，受监测稳态保留了奇异的临界结构，并且关于化学势的量子费舍尔信息呈超广延标度。对于任何q<1，不完美探测都会引入一个有限的平滑长度，从而将奇异性抹平并恢复广延标度。另一方面，探测器效率表现为一个相容的混态估计参数，这可由Uhlmann平均曲率为零所表明。这些结果说明，不完整的轨迹信息通过一种不同于普通热展宽的机制，破坏了由受监测临界性带来的计量增强。

articles.title: Impact of disorder and phonons on the Hubbard bands of Mott insulators in strong electric fields
articles.title_zh: 强电场下无序与声子对莫特绝缘体哈伯德带的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2310.11833v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We characterize the current-carrying non-equilibrium steady-state (NESS) in a single-band Hubbard model confronted with a static electric field in the presence of quenched disorder. Beyond linear response regime, the electric field amplitude must be such to compensate for at least half of the band gap in order to have a non-negligible stationary current. As disorder is not expected to dissipate the extra energy injected by the field, optical phonons assisted by a fermionic heat bath serve as dissipation channels for the current-induced Joule heat generated by the accelerated electrons. The NESS of the system is addressed by means of the dynamical mean-field theory using the so-called auxiliary master equation approach as impurity solver. Disorder effects are treated locally via the coherent potential approximation (CPA) and the self-consistent Born (SCB) approach. In the regime in which the two schemes yield similar results, we employ the SCB as it is computationally cheaper than the CPA. We show that, in a purely electronic setup, the disorder-induced dephasing cannot contribute states within the gap but only smear out the edges of the Hubbard bands. When phonons are taken into account, the different nature of disorder-induced dephasing and phonon-related dissipation becomes clear. We show that although both disorder and electron-phonon interaction enhance the current at off-resonant fields, disorder effects play a marginal role since they cannot provide in-gap states which are instead brought about by phonons and represent the privileged relaxation pathway for excited electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考察了单带 Hubbard 模型在静态电场、淬火无序以及耗散声子环境下的非平衡稳态输运。研究指出，在远离线性响应的条件下，电场幅度至少需要补偿半个带隙，才会产生可观的稳态电流；无序主要通过去相干展宽带边，而难以在带隙内真正引入态。作者结合动力学平均场理论、辅助主方程求解器以及局域无序处理方法，进一步说明光学声子与费米热浴可作为耗散通道，用于移除加速电子产生的焦耳热。
authors: Tommaso Maria Mazzocchi, Daniel Werner, Enrico Arrigoni
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们刻画了在淬火无序存在下、单带Hubbard模型在静态电场作用下承载电流的非平衡稳态（NESS）。在远离线性响应的区间内，电场幅度必须至少补偿半个带隙，才会产生不可忽略的稳态电流。由于无序不被认为能够耗散电场注入的额外能量，因此由费米热浴辅助的光学声子充当了电流引起的焦耳热的耗散通道，该焦耳热由被加速的电子产生。我们借助动力学平均场理论，并以辅助主方程方法作为杂质求解器来处理该系统的NESS。无序效应则通过相干势近似（CPA）和自洽Born（SCB）方法在局域层面处理。在两种方案给出相似结果的参数区间，我们采用计算代价更低的SCB。我们表明，在纯电子设置中，由无序引起的去相干不能向带隙内贡献态，只会对Hubbard带边缘进行展宽。将声子纳入考虑后，无序诱导去相干与声子相关耗散的不同性质变得清晰。我们表明，尽管无序和电子-声子相互作用都能在失谐电场下增强电流，但无序效应只占次要作用，因为它不能提供带隙内态；而带隙内态则是由声子引入的，并构成受激电子优先的弛豫通道。

articles.title: Enhancing Carrier Mobility by Remote Phonons
articles.title_zh: 远程声子对载流子迁移率的增强作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.08114v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Remote phonons from dielectrics are generally believed to degrade carrier mobility in adjacent semiconductors through Fröhlich scattering of polar-optical phonons (POPs). Here, we show that remote phonons can instead enhance the mobility in van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures. We developed a first-principles computational framework to evaluate these remote phonon effects. Applying our approach to monolayer InSe semiconductor encapsulated by h-BN dielectric layers, we show that electron mobility is enhanced due to coupling between POPs in InSe and h-BN, which gives rise to a new collective phonon mode where the dielectric Fröhlich potential partially cancels that in the semiconductor. Guided by this mechanism, we further identified additional dielectrics that yield similar mobility enhancement. This work offers not only an effective computational method to evaluate the remote phonon effects but also insights into mobility engineering for next-generation electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 通常认为介电层中的远程声子会通过极化光学声子的 Fröhlich 散射降低相邻半导体中的迁移率。本文提出，在范德瓦耳斯异质结构中，远程声子反而可以提升迁移率，并建立了相应的第一性原理计算框架。以 h-BN 包覆的单层 InSe 为例，作者发现 InSe 与 h-BN 的极化光学声子耦合会形成新的集体声子模，使介电层与半导体中的 Fröhlich 势部分相互抵消，从而增强电子迁移率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 来自介电体的远程声子通常被认为会通过极性光学声子（POP）的Fröhlich散射而降低邻近半导体中的载流子迁移率。这里，我们表明，远程声子实际上可以在范德瓦耳斯（vdW）异质结构中增强迁移率。我们开发了一个第一性原理计算框架，用于评估这些远程声子效应。将该方法应用于被h-BN介电层包覆的单层InSe半导体，我们发现由于InSe与h-BN中的POP之间的耦合，电子迁移率得到了增强，这种耦合产生了一种新的集体声子模，其中介电体中的Fröhlich势与半导体中的势部分相互抵消。在这一机制的指导下，我们进一步识别出其他能够产生类似迁移率增强的介电材料。这项工作不仅提供了一种评估远程声子效应的有效计算方法，也为下一代电子器件中的迁移率工程提供了见解。

articles.title: Strange metallicity encompasses high magnetic field-induced superconductivity in UTe2
articles.title_zh: UTe2中的奇异金属性包容高磁场诱导超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.12131v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A strange metallic state - characterized by an electrical resistivity that rises linearly in temperature T at a rate governed by Planckian energetic dissipation - is present in a number of unconventional superconductors. Despite widespread investigative efforts, the microscopic properties of strange metallicity continue to defy elementary description. Here we investigate heavy fermion UTe₂, which hosts a suite of exotic spin-triplet superconducting phases, the most extreme of which resides in a narrow angular window of intense magnetic fields > 40 T. Through angle-dependent magnetotransport measurements in pulsed magnetic fields, we find that this superconductive phase emerges from a strange metallic state with Planckian T-linear resistivity confined to a small region of phase space where the field-induced superconductivity is strongest, suggesting a shared underlying mechanism. These findings reveal a novel setting for strange metallicity - in contrast to the general case of singlet superconductivity emerging on the border of antiferromagnetism, here strange metallicity accompanies field-induced triplet superconductivity within a spin-polarized magnetic state. This result demonstrates the remarkable ubiquity of strange metallicity across diverse materials settings, and highlights UTe₂ as a unique platform for exploring the interplay between unconventional superconductivity and quantum criticality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过角分辨磁输运测量研究了重费米子体系 UTe₂ 中的高磁场超导相。结果显示，这一在强磁场下出现的极端自旋三重态超导相，起源于一个狭窄相空间内的奇异金属态，其电阻率呈现受普朗克极限耗散控制的线性温度依赖。作者据此认为，奇异金属性与场诱导超导之间可能共享某种底层机制，为理解非常规超导提供了新的物理场景。
authors: T. I. Weinberger, H. Chen, Z. Wu, M. Long, A. Cabala, Y. Skourski, J. Sourd, T. Haidamak, V. Sechovsky, M. Valiska, F. M. Grosche, A. G. Eaton
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一种奇异金属态——其特征是电阻率随温度T线性升高，并且其增长速率受Planckian能量耗散所支配——存在于若干非常规超导体中。尽管进行了广泛的研究，奇异金属性的微观性质仍然难以用基础理论来描述。这里我们研究重费米子UTe₂，它包含一系列奇异的自旋三重态超导相，其中最极端的一个存在于强磁场超过40 T的一个很窄角度窗口中。通过在脉冲磁场中的角度依赖磁输运测量，我们发现该超导相源自一种奇异金属态；这种奇异金属态具有Planckian T线性电阻率，并且被限制在一个很小的相空间区域内，而该区域正是场诱导超导最强的地方，这表明二者具有共同的底层机制。这些发现揭示了奇异金属性的一个新场景——不同于反铁磁性边界上出现的单态超导这一普遍情形，这里奇异金属性伴随着自旋极化磁态中的场诱导三重态超导出现。该结果表明，奇异金属性在各种材料体系中具有显著普遍性，并凸显UTe₂作为探索非常规超导与量子临界性相互作用的独特平台。

articles.title: Distinguishing features of longitudinal magnetoconductivity for a Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl node
articles.title_zh: Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 节点纵向磁电导的区别性特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.12380v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The band-degeneracy points in the Brillouin zones of chiral crystals exist in multiple avatars, with the high-symmetry points being able to host multifold nodes of distinct characters. A class of such crystals, assisted by the spin-orbit coupling, harbours fourfold degeneracy in the form of Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl node (RSWN) at the Γ-point. Our aim is to explore the nature of longitudinal magnetoconductivity, arising from applying collinear electric and magnetic fields, for such systems. Adjusting the chemical potential to lie near the intrinsic energy-location of the RSWN, the multifold nature of the RSWN is revealed by an interplay of intraband and interband scatterings, which would not arise in twofold degeneracies like the conventional Weyl nodes. The current study fills up the much-needed gap in obtaining the linear response from an exact computation, rather than the insufficient relaxation-time approximation employed earlier.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了立方手性晶体中 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 节点在共线电场与磁场下的纵向磁电导响应。通过将化学势调至接近该节点的本征能量位置，作者揭示了多重简并结构所导致的带内与带间散射协同效应，这种行为不同于普通 Weyl 节点的二重简并情形。该工作给出了基于精确线性响应计算的结果，弥补了以往采用弛豫时间近似所带来的不足。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性晶体布里渊区中的能带简并点以多种形态存在，其中高对称点能够承载具有不同特征的多重节点。在自旋—轨道耦合的辅助下，这类晶体中的一类会在 Γ 点以 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 节点（RSWN）的形式呈现四重简并。我们的目标是探索这类体系在施加共线电场和磁场时所产生的纵向磁电导的性质。通过将化学势调节到 RSWN 的本征能量位置附近，RSWN 的多重性质会由带内散射和带间散射的相互作用显现出来，而这种现象不会出现在传统 Weyl 节点等二重简并中。当前研究通过精确计算获得线性响应，弥补了此前采用不充分的弛豫时间近似所留下的亟需填补的空白。

articles.title: Non-Quantum-Critical Routes to Magnetic Superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 通往磁性超导的非量子临界路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.18996v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electronic superconductivity is most commonly understood to be associated with magnetic quantum criticality. This framework is natural when a quantum critical point is present below the peak of the T_c dome, but it is less satisfactory in the many systems where electronic superconductivity appears without a visible quantum critical point (QCP). Why and where does superconductivity emerge in such cases, given that its condensation energy is generally much smaller than the energy scale of the magnetic order itself? Here we develop an energetic perspective of this non-quantum-critical route to electronic superconductivity. When magnetic order becomes incipient but cannot be fully realized, the opening of a pairing gap lowers the free-energy cost of the nearby fluctuating magnetic state. This means that pairing can become strongest where long range order first becomes fragile. As a result, the strongest pairing tendency can sometimes occur at the edge of the superconducting dome closest to the loss of magnetism, even when T_c itself is relatively small there. The relevant organizing principle is therefore not quantum criticality itself, but proximity to unrealized or disappearing magnetic order. Because many unconventional superconductors show no clear QCP, this perspective provides an alternative framework for understanding the phase diagram of a large class of electronic superconductors and may help identify new superconducting materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从能量学角度讨论了电子超导并不伴随明显量子临界点时的起源问题。作者指出，当磁性有序处于临界前驱状态但无法真正建立时，引入配对能隙反而能够降低邻近涨落磁态的自由能代价，因此配对倾向可能在磁性开始变得脆弱的区域最强。由此，超导穹顶靠近磁性消失边界的一侧未必对应最高 Tc，但可能对应最强配对驱动力，说明决定机制不一定是传统意义上的量子临界性。
authors: Zhiqiang Wang, Ke Wang, K. Levin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子超导最通常被理解为与磁性量子临界性相关。当在 T_c 穹顶峰值下方存在量子临界点时，这一框架是自然的，但在许多没有可见量子临界点（QCP）却出现电子超导的体系中，这一框架就不那么令人满意。在这类情况下，鉴于超导凝聚能通常远小于磁有序本身的能量尺度，超导为什么以及在哪里会出现？在这里，我们发展了一种关于这种通往电子超导的非量子临界路径的能量学视角。当磁有序变得初生但无法完全实现时，配对能隙的打开会降低邻近涨落磁态的自由能代价。这意味着，在长程有序最初变得脆弱的位置，配对可能变得最强。因此，最强的配对倾向有时可能出现在最靠近磁性丧失一侧的超导穹顶边缘，即使那里的 T_c 本身相对较小。相关的组织原则因此并不是量子临界性本身，而是接近未实现或正在消失的磁有序。由于许多非常规超导体没有显示出清晰的 QCP，这一视角为理解一大类电子超导体的相图提供了替代框架，并可能有助于识别新的超导材料。

articles.title: Nematic and chiral superconductivity emerging within the loop-current phase in kagome metals
articles.title_zh: 笼目金属中循环电流相内涌现的向列与手征超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.04433v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The kagome metals AV₃Sb₅ (A = Cs, Rb, K) host multiple symmetry-breaking phases, including charge-density-wave and loop-current orders, and exhibit highly exotic superconductivity with pronounced nematicity and chirality. Remarkably, even dilute impurities transform this exotic superconducting state into an isotropic s-wave state. These observations pose a challenge to existing theoretical scenarios. We show that loop-current order induces nematic chiral d-wave superconductivity in kagome metals. The loop-current-induced orbital magnetization (OM) stabilizes one chiral superconducting channels. This OM-chirality coupling mechanism is generic and applies to pairing driven by either attractive or repulsive interactions. Furthermore, coexisting loop-current and bond orders give rise to pronounced nematic chiral superconductivity even for an almost C₆₋ₛymmetric Fermi surface. For attractive pairing, dilute impurities suppress the chiral state and restore a conventional s-wave phase, as observed experimentally. The theory further predicts a robust 2×2 pair-density modulation. This study provides key insights into time-reversal-symmetry-breaking exotic superconductivity in kagome metals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了笼目金属 AV₃Sb₅ 中循环电流序与超导态之间的关系。作者表明，循环电流产生的轨道磁化可以稳定某一手性超导通道，从而诱导向列型手征 d 波超导；这一机制对吸引或排斥配对相互作用都具有普适性。进一步地，当循环电流与键序共存时，即使费米面几乎保持 C₆ 对称，也会出现显著的向列手征超导，并且稀释杂质可抑制手性态、恢复常规 s 波超导，同时理论还预言了稳健的 2×2 配对密度调制。
authors: Rina Tazai, Youichi Yamakawa, Hiroshi Kontani
articles.abstract_zh_full: 笼目金属 AV₃Sb₅（A = Cs、Rb、K）承载多种对称性破缺相，包括电荷密度波和环流序，并表现出具有显著向列性和手性的高度奇异超导。值得注意的是，即使是稀薄杂质也会将这种奇异超导态转变为各向同性的 s 波态。这些观测对现有理论图像提出了挑战。我们表明，环流序会在笼目金属中诱导向列手性 d 波超导。环流诱导的轨道磁化（OM）会稳定一个手性超导通道。这种 OM—手性耦合机制是普适的，并适用于由吸引相互作用或排斥相互作用驱动的配对。此外，即使对于几乎 C₆ 对称的费米面，共存的环流序和键序也会产生显著的向列手性超导。对于吸引配对，稀薄杂质会抑制手性态并恢复常规 s 波相，正如实验所观察到的。该理论还进一步预言了稳健的 2×2 配对密度调制。本研究为理解笼目金属中破缺时间反演对称性的奇异超导提供了关键见解。

articles.title: Terahertz electrodynamics in a zero-field Wigner crystal
articles.title_zh: 零磁场 Wigner 晶体的太赫兹电动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.10624v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In clean two-dimensional (2D) systems, electrons are expected to self-organize into a regular lattice, a Wigner crystal, when their mutual Coulomb repulsion overwhelms kinetic energy. Understanding the Wigner crystal at zero magnetic field is a long-sought goal in physics, thanks to its fundamental simplicity and possible connection to the density-driven metal-insulator transition. To date, evidence for such a crystal has been reported across various platforms. However, the AC conductivity of a zero-field Wigner crystal, a key observable characterizing its electrodynamics, has never been measured. Here, we develop an ultrasensitive on-chip terahertz (THz) spectroscopy technique to probe the AC conductivity in electrostatically gated monolayer MoSe2 encapsulated in hexagonal boron nitride. We observe a sub-THz resonance corresponding to the pinning mode of a zero-field Wigner crystal, whose frequency is orders of magnitude higher than those under high magnetic fields. Using the pinning mode as an indicator, we reveal that moderate disorder notably stabilizes the Wigner crystal. With increasing density towards melting, we find that the pinning mode of the Wigner crystal coexists with a growing Drude component characteristic of an electron liquid, and the competition between these two components in the conductivity spectra leads to the insulator-metal transition of the 2D electron system. Our findings not only elucidate the low-energy electrodynamics of a zero-field Wigner crystal, but also establish on-chip THz spectroscopy as a powerful probe for correlated quantum phases in two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用超灵敏片上太赫兹光谱，探测了零磁场下二维 Wigner 晶体的交流电导。实验在电静控单层 MoSe₂ 中观察到一个亚太赫兹共振，对应于零磁场 Wigner 晶体的钉扎模，其频率显著高于高磁场条件下报道的同类模式。结果还表明，中等无序反而有助于稳定 Wigner 晶体，并进一步考察了随载流子密度升高、接近熔化时该晶体态的演化。
authors: Su-Di Chen, Ruishi Qi, Ha-Leem Kim, Qixin Feng, Ruichen Xia, Dishan Abeysinghe, Jingxu Xie, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Dung-Hai Lee, Feng Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在洁净的二维（2D）体系中，当电子之间的库仑排斥超过动能时，电子预计会自组织成规则晶格，即 Wigner 晶体。由于其基本简洁性以及与密度驱动的金属—绝缘体转变的可能联系，理解零磁场下的 Wigner 晶体一直是物理学中的长期目标。迄今为止，关于这种晶体的证据已在多种平台上被报道。然而，零磁场 Wigner 晶体的交流电导这一表征其电动力学的关键可观测量从未被测量过。在这里，我们发展了一种超灵敏片上太赫兹（THz）光谱技术，用于探测六方氮化硼封装的静电栅控单层 MoSe₂ 中的交流电导。我们观察到一个亚 THz 共振，对应于零磁场 Wigner 晶体的钉扎模，其频率比高磁场下的相应频率高出数个数量级。以钉扎模作为指示器，我们揭示出适度无序会显著稳定 Wigner 晶体。随着密度增加并趋向熔化，我们发现 Wigner 晶体的钉扎模与表征电子液体的不断增强的 Drude 分量共存，并且电导谱中这两个分量之间的竞争导致二维电子体系发生绝缘体—金属转变。我们的发现不仅阐明了零磁场 Wigner 晶体的低能电动力学，而且确立了片上 THz 光谱作为探测二维材料中关联量子相的有力手段。

articles.title: D-Wave Phonon Angular Momentum Texture in Altermagnets by Magnon-Phonon Hybridization
articles.title_zh: 通过磁振子-声子杂化实现反铁磁体中的 d 波声子角动量纹理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.08357v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In altermagnets, the magnon bands are anisotropically spin-split in reciprocal space without relativistic or dipolar spin-spin interactions. In this work, we theoretically study magnons and phonons coupled by spin-lattice interaction in a two-dimensional square-lattice d-wave altermagnet. We show that phonon-chirality-selective magnon-phonon hybridization can be caused by interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction leading to the emergence of hybrid quasiparticles that possess finite phonon angular momentum. These hybrid quasiparticles are called magnon polarons and consist of spin-polarized magnons and chiral phonons. Their phonon angular momentum texture follows the d-wave character of the magnon spin texture opening up the possibility of phononic counterparts to the electronic response effects in altermagnets, such as a phonon angular momentum splitter effect, i.e., the generation of a transverse phonon angular momentum current induced by a temperature gradient -- the bosonic analog of the spin-splitter effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究了二维方格 d 波反磁体中磁振子与声子在自旋-晶格相互作用下的耦合行为。作者发现，由界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用引起的手征选择性杂化，可形成同时具有有限声子角动量的混合准粒子，即磁振子极化子。其声子角动量纹理遵循 d 波磁子自旋纹理，为声子版的电子输运响应效应提供了可能，例如由温度梯度驱动的声子角动量分离效应。
authors: Hannah Bendin, Alexander Mook, Ingrid Mertig, Robin R. Neumann
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在交替磁体中，即使没有相对论性或偶极自旋—自旋相互作用，磁振子能带也会在倒易空间中发生各向异性的自旋劈裂。在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究二维方格 d 波交替磁体中通过自旋—晶格相互作用耦合的磁振子和声子。我们表明，界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用能够引起声子手性选择性的磁振子—声子杂化，从而产生具有有限声子角动量的杂化准粒子。这些杂化准粒子被称为磁振子极化子，由自旋极化的磁振子和手性声子组成。它们的声子角动量织构遵循磁振子自旋织构的 d 波特征，从而开启了实现交替磁体中电子响应效应的声子对应物的可能性，例如声子角动量分流效应，即由温度梯度诱导产生横向声子角动量流——这是自旋分流效应的玻色子类比。

articles.title: Magnetic Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in Bernal Bilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: Bernal 双层石墨烯中的磁性体光伏效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20498v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the shift-current response of inversion-broken AB-stacked bilayer graphene under in-plane and perpendicular magnetic fields, from the perturbative regime to strong orbital quantization, in both two-dimensional bulk systems and finite nanoribbons. An in-plane field enters through opposite momentum shifts in the two layers and leaves the bulk band dispersion essentially unchanged, producing only a modest, frequency-dependent redistribution of the shift-current spectrum. A weak perpendicular field is treated using a gauge-covariant Peierls expansion. The resulting band corrections are concentrated near Berry-curvature hot spots, although the dominant shift-current transitions occur elsewhere, and the valley-summed response is even in the field with a leading quadratic correction. At strong perpendicular field, a rational-flux magnetic supercell reveals nearly flat Landau-level-like bulk bands and a greatly enhanced density of states, yet the bulk shift current is almost completely quenched because the relevant optical matrix elements and shift-vector contributions are suppressed or cancel. Finite ribbons retain optically active boundary channels: in zigzag ribbons, magnetic reconstruction turns edge-derived states from dark states into bright photovoltaic channels, with the associated peak scaling inversely with ribbon width. These results show that magnetic control of the nonlinear photovoltaic response is governed by wave-function reconstruction and quantum-geometric matrix elements rather than by the density of states alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了反演对称破缺的 AB 堆垛双层石墨烯在面内与垂直磁场下的 shift current 响应，涵盖从微扰区到强轨道量子化区的行为。结果显示，面内磁场主要引起光谱的有限重分布，而弱垂直磁场的能带修正集中在 Berry 曲率热点附近，但整体 shift current 对磁场呈偶对称且主要只有二次修正。强垂直磁场下，尽管形成了近似平带的朗道级 bulk 带并显著提高态密度，体相 shift current 仍几乎被完全抑制，原因在于相关光学矩阵元和位移矢量贡献受到压制或相互抵消；有限纳米带则保留了部分光学响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究反演对称性破缺的 AB 堆垛双层石墨烯在面内和垂直磁场下的位移电流响应，范围从微扰区域到强轨道量子化区域，并同时考虑二维体体系和有限纳米带。面内磁场通过两层中相反的动量位移进入，并使体能带色散基本保持不变，仅产生适度的、依赖频率的位移电流谱重分布。弱垂直磁场采用规范协变的 Peierls 展开处理。所得能带修正集中在 Berry 曲率热点附近，尽管占主导的位移电流跃迁发生在其他位置，并且谷求和后的响应关于磁场为偶函数，其主导修正为二次项。在强垂直磁场下，有理磁通磁超胞显示出近乎平坦的类 Landau 能级体能带以及大幅增强的态密度，然而体位移电流几乎被完全淬灭，因为相关的光学矩阵元和位移矢量贡献受到抑制或相互抵消。有限纳米带保留了具有光学活性的边界通道：在锯齿形纳米带中，磁重构将源自边缘的态从暗态转变为明亮的光伏通道，相关峰值与纳米带宽度成反比缩放。这些结果表明，非线性光伏响应的磁控制受波函数重构和量子几何矩阵元支配，而不仅仅由态密度决定。

articles.title: Accelerating discovery of infrared nonlinear optical materials with large shift current via high-throughput screening
articles.title_zh: 通过高通量筛选加速发现具有大位移电流的红外非线性光学材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.04717v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Discovering nonlinear optical (NLO) materials with strong shift current response, particularly in the infrared (IR) regime, is essential for next-generation optoelectronics yet remains highly challenging in both experiments and theory, which still largely relies on case by case studies. Here, we employ a high-throughput screening strategy, applying a multi-step filter to the Materials Project database (>154,000 materials), which yielded 2,519 candidate materials for detailed first-principle evaluation. From these calculations, we identify 32 NLO materials with strong shift current response (σ > 100 μ A/V²⁾. Our work reveals that layered structures with C₃ᵥ symmetry and heavy p-block elements (e.g. Te, Sb) exhibit apparent superiority in enhancing shift current. More importantly, 9 of these compounds show shift current response peaks in the IR region, with the strongest reaching 616 μ A/V², holding significant application potential in fields such as IR photodetection, sensing, and energy harvesting. Beyond identifying promising candidates, this work establishes a comprehensive and high-quality first-principles dataset for NLO response, providing a solid foundation for future AI-driven screening and accelerated discovery of high-performance NLO materials, as demonstrated by a prototype machine-learning application.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用高通量筛选策略，从 Materials Project 数据库中超过 15.4 万种材料出发，经过多步过滤后获得 2519 个候选体系，并进一步开展第一性原理评估。作者最终识别出 32 种具有强 shift current 响应的非线性光学材料，其中层状结构、C₃ᵥ 对称性以及含 Te、Sb 等重 p 区元素的材料表现尤为突出。值得注意的是，9 种化合物在红外区出现了明显响应峰，最强可达 616 μA/V²，显示出在红外探测、传感与能量采集中具有应用潜力。
authors: Aiqin Yang, Dian Jin, Mingkang Liu, Daye Zheng, Qi Wang, Qiangqiang Gu, Jian-Hua Jiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 发现具有强位移电流响应的非线性光学（NLO）材料，特别是在红外（IR）区域中的材料，对于下一代光电子学至关重要，但在实验和理论上仍然极具挑战，目前很大程度上仍依赖逐例研究。在这里，我们采用高通量筛选策略，对 Materials Project 数据库（超过 154,000 种材料）应用多步骤过滤，得到 2,519 种候选材料用于详细的第一性原理评估。通过这些计算，我们识别出 32 种具有强位移电流响应的 NLO 材料（σ > 100 μA/V²）。我们的工作揭示，具有 C₃ᵥ 对称性的层状结构和重 p 区元素（例如 Te、Sb）在增强位移电流方面表现出明显优势。更重要的是，其中 9 种化合物在 IR 区域显示出位移电流响应峰，最强达到 616 μA/V²，在红外光探测、传感和能量收集等领域具有重要应用潜力。除了识别有前景的候选材料外，本工作还建立了一个全面且高质量的 NLO 响应第一性原理数据集，为未来 AI 驱动的筛选和高性能 NLO 材料的加速发现提供了坚实基础，原型机器学习应用也展示了这一点。

articles.title: Bayesian Parameter Estimation for Predictive Modeling of Illumination-Dependent Current-Voltage Curves
articles.title_zh: 用于光照依赖电流-电压曲线预测建模的贝叶斯参数估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.01859v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning enables rapid estimation of material parameters in solar cells via neural-network-based surrogate models. However, the reliability of extracted parameters depends on underlying assumptions such as the choice of one-dimensional drift-diffusion model and selection of free material parameters. To validate the inferred parameters, we perform predictive modeling of light-intensity-dependent current-voltage (JV) characteristics. Well-known physical effects, including the influence of external resistance and recombination dynamics on illumination-dependent device performance, are reflected in parameter estimation and prediction workflow. We show that correct treatment of dark shunt resistance and emphasizing shifted current (J + Jsc) during fitting enhances prediction accuracy at low to intermediate illumination level. Additionally, we analyze the information content of various input JV curve combinations, demonstrating that including at least one illuminated JV, preferably not under high illumination due to series resistance effects, is critical for reliable parameter estimation and device performance prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论了利用机器学习和贝叶斯参数估计，从太阳能电池的电流-电压曲线中快速提取材料参数的可行性与可靠性。作者指出，参数反演结果依赖于一维漂移-扩散模型和自由参数选择等假设，因此需要借助不同光照强度下的预测性建模来验证。研究表明，正确处理暗态并联电阻，并在拟合中强调移位电流 J+Jsc，可提高低到中等光照下的预测精度；同时，在输入数据中至少包含一条受光 JV 曲线，且最好不要来自过强光照条件，对可靠参数估计和器件性能预测尤为关键。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习能够通过基于神经网络的替代模型快速估计太阳能电池中的材料参数。然而，所提取参数的可靠性取决于底层假设，例如一维漂移—扩散模型的选择以及自由材料参数的选择。为了验证推断出的参数，我们对光强依赖的电流—电压（JV）特性进行预测建模。众所周知的物理效应，包括外部电阻和复合动力学对光照依赖器件性能的影响，都被反映在参数估计和预测工作流程中。我们表明，正确处理暗态并联电阻，并在拟合过程中强调平移电流（J + Jsc），可提高低到中等光照水平下的预测精度。此外，我们分析了各种输入 JV 曲线组合的信息含量，证明纳入至少一条光照 JV 曲线对于可靠的参数估计和器件性能预测至关重要，并且优选不是高光照下的 JV 曲线，因为高光照会受到串联电阻效应影响。

articles.title: Parameterizing DFT+U+V from Hybrid Functionals: A Wannier-Function-Based Approach for Strongly Correlated Materials
articles.title_zh: 基于杂化泛函参数化 DFT+U+V：面向强关联材料的 Wannier 函数方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.20814v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an approach to parameterize DFT+U+V from hybrid-functional calculations using Wannier-function projections. The method constructs a common localized Wannier basis for both semilocal DFT and hybrid-functional calculations, then determines effective on-site (U) and intersite (V) Hubbard parameters by minimizing the Hamiltonian mismatch within the correlated subspace. This procedure yields interaction parameters that reproduce the hybrid-functional electronic structure at a fraction of the computational cost and allow efficient structural relaxations and further many-body calculations. We validate the workflow on three oxide systems with different electronic characters: MgO (wide-gap insulator), NiO (antiferromagnetic charge-transfer insulator), and V₂O₅ (d⁰ transition-metal oxide). In all cases, the mapped DFT+U+V parameters reproduce hybrid-functional band gaps, densities of states, and magnetic moments and improve upon semilocal DFT while maintaining computational efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种利用杂化泛函计算和 Wannier 函数投影来参数化 DFT+U+V 的方法。作者在半局域 DFT 与杂化泛函计算中构造共同的局域 Wannier 基，并通过最小化关联子空间内哈密顿量差异来确定有效在位 U 和近邻 V 参数。该流程在 MgO、NiO 和 V₂O₅ 中验证，能够以较低计算成本再现杂化泛函的能带间隙、态密度和磁矩，并优于半局域 DFT。
authors: Dmitry M. Korotin, Anna A. Anisimova, Vladimir I. Anisimov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种利用 Wannier 函数投影从杂化泛函计算中参数化 DFT+U+V 的方法。该方法为半局域 DFT 和杂化泛函计算构建一个共同的局域 Wannier 基，然后通过最小化关联子空间内的哈密顿量不匹配来确定有效的在位（U）和位间（V）Hubbard 参数。该过程产生的相互作用参数能够以一小部分计算成本再现杂化泛函电子结构，并允许进行高效的结构弛豫和进一步的多体计算。我们在三种具有不同电子特征的氧化物体系上验证了该工作流程：MgO（宽带隙绝缘体）、NiO（反铁磁电荷转移绝缘体）和 V₂O₅（d⁰ 过渡金属氧化物）。在所有情况下，映射得到的 DFT+U+V 参数都再现了杂化泛函的带隙、态密度和磁矩，并在保持计算效率的同时相较半局域 DFT 有所改进。

articles.title: Bridging Crystal Structure and Material Properties via Bond-Centric Descriptors
articles.title_zh: 通过以化学键为中心的描述符连接晶体结构与材料性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.18876v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Although chemical bonding is the fundamental mechanistic bridge connecting atomic structure to macroscopic material properties, current data-driven materials science largely treats it as an implicit "black box". Existing machine learning (ML) models rely predominantly on geometric coordinates, forcing them to implicitly relearn complex quantum mechanics from scratch. This lack of intermediate physical features limits model interpretability and generalizability, particularly when training data is scarce. To solve this problem, we introduce MattKeyBond, a bond-centric materials database that explicitly maps the local electronic landscape and bonding interactions of materials. Building on this, we propose Bonding Attractivity (BA), a novel element-specific descriptor that quantifies the intrinsic capability of atoms to form covalent networks. By providing pre-calculated, energy-dimensional bonding descriptors, MattKeyBond transforms the implicit "black box" into physically interpretable features. This strategy relieves ML models from the burden of deducing physical laws from pure geometry, enabling accurate predictions even with limited data and seamlessly integrating electronic structure theory into modern AI workflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，现有数据驱动材料模型通常将化学键作为隐含黑箱处理，限制了可解释性和小数据条件下的泛化能力。作者提出以键为中心的材料数据库 MattKeyBond，用于显式刻画局域电子环境和成键相互作用，并引入元素特异性的“成键吸引力”描述符来量化原子形成共价网络的内禀能力。该策略为机器学习模型提供预计算的物理可解释成键特征，从而减少模型仅从几何结构中重新学习量子规律的负担。
authors: Jian-Feng Zhang, Ze-Feng Gao, Xiao-Qi Han, Bo Zhan, Dingshun Lv, Miao Gao, Kai Liu, Xinguo Ren, Zhong-Yi Lu, Tao Xiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管化学键是连接原子结构与宏观材料性质的基本机制桥梁，当前数据驱动的材料科学在很大程度上仍将其视为一个隐含的“黑箱”。现有机器学习（ML）模型主要依赖几何坐标，迫使它们从头开始隐式地重新学习复杂的量子力学。这种中间物理特征的缺乏限制了模型的可解释性和泛化能力，特别是在训练数据稀缺时。为了解决这一问题，我们引入 MattKeyBond，这是一个以化学键为中心的材料数据库，显式映射材料的局域电子景观和键合相互作用。在此基础上，我们提出键合吸引力（BA），这是一种新的元素特异性描述符，用于量化原子形成共价网络的内在能力。通过提供预先计算的、具有能量维度的键合描述符，MattKeyBond 将隐含的“黑箱”转化为具有物理可解释性的特征。这一策略减轻了 ML 模型从纯几何中推断物理规律的负担，使其即使在有限数据下也能实现准确预测，并将电子结构理论无缝整合到现代 AI 工作流中。

articles.title: Mesoscopic scattering dynamics under generic uniform SU(2) gauge fields: Spin-momentum relaxation and coherent backscattering
articles.title_zh: 一般均匀 SU(2) 规范场下的介观散射动力学：自旋-动量弛豫与相干背散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02879v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the time- and momentum-resolved dynamics of matter waves undergoing elastic scattering from a disordered potential in the presence of spatially uniform SU(2) gauge fields. We derive the disorder-averaged density matrix as a function of time and momentum within the weak-localization regime. By accurately approximating the frequency dependence of the ladder and maximally crossed diagram series beyond the diffusion approximation, we describe short-time spin-momentum dynamics on timescales comparable to the scattering mean free time, for arbitrary strengths of the SU(2) gauge fields and disorder. We also present a cubic equation that determines the spin isotropization time, which gives accurate asymptotic forms in the limits where the spin-orbit length is much longer (Dyakonov-Perel spin relaxation regime) or much shorter than the scattering mean free path, as well as in the SU(2)-symmetric (persistent spin helix) limit. Comparison with numerical simulations over a broad range of spin-orbit coupling strengths shows quantitative agreement for the predicted spin isotropization time. The same framework also reproduces both the relaxation of the momentum distribution and the transient backscattering peak with a momentum offset coexisting with the robust coherent backscattering dip.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究物质波在无序势弹性散射并受到空间均匀 SU(2) 规范场作用时的时间与动量分辨动力学。作者在弱局域化框架下推导无序平均密度矩阵，并改进阶梯图与最大交叉图级数的频率依赖近似，以描述接近平均自由时间尺度的短时自旋-动量演化。研究给出决定自旋各向同性化时间的三次方程，在不同自旋轨道耦合极限和持久自旋螺旋极限下均与数值模拟符合良好。
authors: Masataka Kakoi, Christian Miniatura, Keith Slevin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究物质波在存在空间均匀 SU(2) 规范场时从无序势发生弹性散射的时间分辨和动量分辨动力学。我们在弱局域化区域内推导了作为时间和动量函数的无序平均密度矩阵。通过在扩散近似之外准确近似梯形图和最大交叉图级数的频率依赖性，我们描述了与散射平均自由时间相当的时间尺度上的短时自旋—动量动力学，并适用于任意强度的 SU(2) 规范场和无序。我们还给出一个决定自旋各向同性化时间的三次方程，该方程在自旋—轨道长度远长于散射平均自由程（Dyakonov-Perel 自旋弛豫区域）或远短于散射平均自由程的极限，以及在 SU(2) 对称（持久自旋螺旋）极限中，给出了准确的渐近形式。与宽范围自旋—轨道耦合强度下的数值模拟比较表明，预测的自旋各向同性化时间具有定量一致性。同一框架还再现了动量分布的弛豫，以及与稳健相干背散射凹陷共存的、带有动量偏移的瞬态背散射峰。

articles.title: Pairing mechanism and superconductivity in 1313 phase La₃Ni₂O₇
articles.title_zh: 1313 相 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中的配对机制与超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.21533v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recently, the observation of superconductivity (SC) with T_c approx 3.6 K in the pressurized 1313 La₃Ni₂O₇ has attracted considerable interest. Here, we systematically investigate the electronic properties and superconducting mechanism of 1313 La₃Ni₂O₇ using density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT) and random phase approximation (RPA). Our DFT+DMFT calculations reveal that the single-layer (SL) subsystem exhibits nearly insulating behavior, with the dz^₂ orbital showing Mott physics, while the trilayer (TL) subsystem remains metallic. This indicates that SC primarily resides in the TL subsystem, whose Ni-e_g orbitals are found to be hole-doped relative to bulk La₄Ni₃O₁₀. Based on DFT+DMFT-derived low-energy Hamiltonian, RPA-based analysis yields an s±-wave pairing symmetry within the TL subsystem. Importantly, we identify two key factors that contribute to the significant suppression of T_c in 1313 La₃Ni₂O₇ compared to bulk La₄Ni₃O₁₀. First, the hole doping in the TL subsystem, as established by DMFT, leads to a decreased pairing strength, as confirmed by RPA calculations -- a trend resembling that in bulk La₄Ni₃O₁₀. Second, the SL subsystem acts as a bridge connecting adjacent superconducting TL subsystems, thereby forming an S-N-S Josephson junction. The resulting interlayer Josephson coupling governs the phase coherence between TL subsystems and further suppresses the global T_c. Combinedly, our findings suggest that the high-T_c phase in the RP La₃Ni₂O₇ family should be attributed to the 2222 La₃Ni₂O₇ rather than the 1313 La₃Ni₂O₇.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对加压 1313 相 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中约 3.6 K 超导现象，结合 DFT+DMFT 与 RPA 系统分析其电子性质和配对机制。DFT+DMFT 结果表明单层子系统近似绝缘且 dz² 轨道呈现 Mott 物理，而三层子系统保持金属性，因此超导主要位于三层子系统。基于低能哈密顿量的 RPA 分析给出三层子系统中的 s± 波配对，并指出空穴掺杂导致配对强度降低等因素可能解释其 Tc 相比 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 的显著抑制。
authors: Cui-Qun Chen, Ming Zhang, Fan Yang, Dao-Xin Yao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，在加压 1313 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中观察到 T_c 约为 3.6 K 的超导（SC）引起了广泛兴趣。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT）以及随机相近似（RPA），系统研究 1313 La₃Ni₂O₇ 的电子性质和超导机制。我们的 DFT+DMFT 计算表明，单层（SL）子系统表现出近乎绝缘的行为，其中 dz² 轨道显示出 Mott 物理，而三层（TL）子系统保持金属性。这表明 SC 主要存在于 TL 子系统中，并且发现其 Ni-e_g 轨道相对于体相 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 是空穴掺杂的。基于 DFT+DMFT 得到的低能哈密顿量，基于 RPA 的分析在 TL 子系统内给出了 s± 波配对对称性。重要的是，我们确定了两个关键因素，它们导致 1313 La₃Ni₂O₇ 的 T_c 相比体相 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 显著降低。第一，如 DMFT 所确定的，TL 子系统中的空穴掺杂导致配对强度降低，这一点由 RPA 计算所证实——这一趋势类似于体相 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 中的情况。第二，SL 子系统充当连接相邻超导 TL 子系统的桥梁，从而形成 S-N-S Josephson 结。由此产生的层间 Josephson 耦合控制 TL 子系统之间的相位相干，并进一步抑制全局 T_c。综合来看，我们的发现表明，RP La₃Ni₂O₇ 家族中的高 T_c 相应归因于 2222 La₃Ni₂O₇，而不是 1313 La₃Ni₂O₇。

articles.title: Persistent currents in signed directed networks
articles.title_zh: 带符号有向网络中的持续电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06716v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Network theory can be fruitfully used to describe quantum coherence in physical systems. To that purpose we introduce persistent currents in signed directed networks by interpreting the signed magnetic Laplacian as an effective Hamiltonian and the associated edge phases as a discrete gauge field. In a canonical ensemble, persistent currents arise as thermodynamic responses to variations of gauge-invariant fluxes. We show that these fluxes are naturally defined on the cycle space of the network, and that the resulting currents are constrained to the divergence-free subspace and decompose onto independent cycles. This formulation provides a direct generalization of persistent currents from rings and lattices to arbitrary topologies. Detection of persistent currents provides a signature of the quantum phase coherence supported by the network, and a direct signature of the geometry of its cycle space. Such a mapping, not only allows a practical way to deal with quantum coherence for a variety of situations in the field of quantum technologies, but it also allows a physical interpretation of the importance of the Laplacian operator in graph theory, linking its role to the one of Hamiltonian (i.e. a tight-binding one) in physical systems. To test the power of the method, we construct a signed directed network that reproduces the Hofstadter butterfly spectrum.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将带符号磁拉普拉斯算符解释为有效哈密顿量，并将边相位视为离散规范场，从而在带符号有向网络中引入持续电流。作者表明，在正则系综中，持续电流可看作对规范不变通量变化的热力学响应，而这些通量自然定义在网络的循环空间上。所得电流受无散度条件约束，并可分解到独立循环上，从而将环和晶格中的持续电流推广到任意拓扑网络。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 网络理论可以被巧妙地用于描述物理系统中的量子相干性。为此，我们通过将有符号磁拉普拉斯算符解释为有效哈密顿量，并将相关的边相位解释为离散规范场，在有符号有向网络中引入了持久电流。在正则系综中，持久电流作为对规范不变磁通变化的热力学响应而出现。我们表明，这些磁通自然地定义在网络的回路空间上，并且所得电流受到无散子空间的约束，同时可分解到各个独立回路上。该表述为将环和晶格中的持久电流直接推广到任意拓扑提供了方法。对持久电流的探测给出了网络所支持的量子相位相干性的标志，也直接反映了其回路空间几何结构的特征。这样的映射不仅为量子技术领域中的多种情形处理量子相干性提供了一种实用方法，而且还为图论中拉普拉斯算符的重要性提供了物理解释，将其作用与物理系统中的哈密顿量（即紧束缚哈密顿量）联系起来。为检验该方法的能力，我们构造了一个有符号有向网络，使其重现了霍夫施塔特蝴蝶谱。

articles.title: Many-Body Protection of Topological Edge Memory in Strong Interacting Quenches
articles.title_zh: 强相互作用淬火中拓扑边缘记忆的多体保护
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19437v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum quenches drive edge states far from equilibrium, yet whether the memory of a topological initial state survives in a non-integrable, interacting system has remained largely unexplored. We study this question in the bond-alternating XXZ chain---an interacting Su--Schrieffer--Heeger model hosting symmetry-protected topological edge modes with markedly enhanced boundary magnetization---and analyze quenches across all combinations of single-particle and many-body initial and final Hamiltonians. The results organize by a single distinction as we rigorously establish in this work: whether the post-quench Hamiltonian is free or genuinely interacting. For a free post-quench Hamiltonian, the dynamics is solved exactly by a correlation-matrix approach; the boundary-mode return amplitude decays as t⁻³/², and initial interactions enter only through a dressed one-body density matrix. For a genuinely interacting post-quench Hamiltonian, finite-time stability bounds prove that away from local resonances the first-dimer magnetization remains stable on time windows growing as arbitrarily large powers of the inverse inter-dimer coupling. Matrix product state simulations across all four protocols show that interactions in the final Hamiltonian markedly extend finite-time boundary memory---with local suppression near the isotropic SU(2) point---revealing a many-body protection mechanism in a non-integrable system where scrambling would otherwise wash out initial-state memory fast.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察非可积相互作用体系在量子淬火后是否仍能保留拓扑初态的边缘记忆，模型为具有键交替的 XXZ 链，即相互作用 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型。作者分析单粒子与多体初末哈密顿量的各种组合，并指出动力学主要取决于淬火后的哈密顿量是否为真正相互作用体系。对于自由末态哈密顿量，边界模返回振幅按 t⁻³/² 衰减；对于相互作用末态哈密顿量，有限时间稳定性界证明在避开局域共振时边界磁化可在随反二聚体间耦合幂次增长的时间窗口内保持稳定。
authors: Yuxiao Hang, Stephan Haas, Rishabh Jha
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子淬火会将边缘态驱动到远离平衡的状态，但在一个非可积、相互作用的体系中，拓扑初态的记忆是否能够存活，至今仍未得到充分研究。我们在键交替 XXZ 链中研究这一问题——该模型是一个相互作用的 Su--Schrieffer--Heeger 模型，具有对称性保护的拓扑边缘模，并呈现显著增强的边界磁化——并分析了跨越单粒子与多体初态和末态哈密顿量各种组合的淬火过程。结果可由一个单一的区分来组织，而我们在本文中严格证明了这一点：淬火后的哈密顿量是自由的还是确实相互作用的。对于自由的淬火后哈密顿量，动力学可通过关联矩阵方法精确求解；边界模的回返振幅按 t⁻³/² 衰减，而初态中的相互作用只会通过一个重整化后的单体密度矩阵进入。对于真正相互作用的淬火后哈密顿量，有限时间稳定性界证明：在远离局域共振的情况下，第一二聚体的磁化在随逆二聚体耦合的任意大幂次增长的时间窗口内保持稳定。跨越全部四种协议的矩阵乘积态模拟表明，末态哈密顿量中的相互作用显著延长了有限时间的边界记忆——在各向同性 SU(2) 点附近则有局部抑制——揭示了在一个非可积系统中存在的多体保护机制，而在这种系统里，混沌化本应很快抹去初态记忆。

articles.title: A Combined Tight Binding with Machine Learning Potential Model for Magnesium Compounds
articles.title_zh: 面向镁化合物的紧束缚与机器学习势结合模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25853v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a model for magnesium-based systems that combines density functional tight binding (DFTB) with MACE, a machine learning interatomic potential (DFTB+MACE). In this model, the conventional repulsive potential, pair potential, is replaced by a many-body MACE potential. The MACE component of the model is trained on the difference between density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces and the corresponding DFTB values, but neglecting the pair potential contribution. Using this model we performed structural relaxation of MgO-CO2 adsorption systems, molecular dynamics calculations of water clusters and phonon spectrum calculations of stable fcc-MgO and metastable bcc-MgO structures. We compare the performance of our model with a pure MACE model and with DFT. We demonstrate that the DFTB+MACE model achieves improved accuracy relative to DFTB with a pair potential, in many cases with only a moderate increase in computational cost. In addition, it can provide electronic structures that most of the machine learning potentials cannot. The training dataset, originally developed for MACE, may not fully represent all regions of the potential surface we may encounter during simulations. Expanding the dataset for a wider potential surface is expected to further enhance predictive accuracy of DFTB+MACE model. Overall, the resulting DFTB+MACE framework enables simulations at length and time scales beyond the reach of first-principles methods while retaining an explicit description of electronic structures, making it particularly attractive for studying charge-transfer in materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种用于镁基体系的 DFTB+MACE 模型，将密度泛函紧束缚方法与机器学习原子间势 MACE 结合。模型用多体 MACE 势替代传统成对排斥势，并训练其拟合 DFT 与去除成对势贡献后的 DFTB 能量和力差异。作者在 MgO-CO₂ 吸附结构弛豫、水团簇分子动力学以及 fcc-MgO 和 bcc-MgO 声子谱计算中测试该模型，显示其相较传统 DFTB 精度提高、计算成本适中，并可提供多数机器学习势无法直接给出的电子结构信息。
authors: Jiwen Yu, Arash A. Mostofi, Andrew Horsfield
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种适用于镁基体系的模型，将密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）与 MACE 一种机器学习原子间势结合起来（DFTB+MACE）。在该模型中，传统的排斥势，即双体势，被一个多体 MACE 势所取代。MACE 部分的模型以密度泛函理论（DFT）能量和力与相应 DFTB 数值之间的差值作为训练目标，但不包括双体势贡献。利用该模型，我们对 MgO-CO2 吸附体系进行了结构弛豫、对水团簇进行了分子动力学计算，并对稳定的面心立方 MgO 以及亚稳的体心立方 MgO 结构进行了声子谱计算。我们将该模型的性能与纯 MACE 模型以及 DFT 进行了比较。结果表明，与采用双体势的 DFTB 相比，DFTB+MACE 模型实现了更高的准确性，并且在许多情况下只带来了适度的计算成本增加。此外，它还能提供大多数机器学习势无法提供的电子结构。原始训练数据集最初是为 MACE 开发的，可能并不能充分表征我们在模拟中可能遇到的势能面所有区域。扩大数据集以覆盖更宽广的势能面，预计将进一步提升 DFTB+MACE 模型的预测精度。总体而言，所得到的 DFTB+MACE 框架使得在超出第一性原理方法可及的长度和时间尺度上进行模拟成为可能，同时保留了对电子结构的显式描述，因此特别适合研究材料中的电荷转移。

articles.title: Active quantum memory: Exploring the quantum dynamical process of voltage-gated ion channel
articles.title_zh: 主动量子记忆：电压门控离子通道量子动力学过程探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.12362v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: It is known that the opening or closing mechanism of a voltage-gated ion channel is triggered by the potential difference across the cell membrane in the nervous system. Based on this picture, we model the ion channel as a nanoscale two-terminal ionic tunneling junction. We apply an external time-varying voltage on the junction to mimic the membrane potential difference in the stimulation of neurons. We derive the non-Markovian quantum Langevin equation from the first principle of quantum mechanics for the ion transport in ion channels, and obtain the ion transport current in terms of quantum tunnelings of ions controlled by the time-varying voltage. We find that the time-varying voltage induces an effective magnetic flux, which causes quantum coherence in ion tunnelings. This effective magnetic flux induces further an oscillatory component to the spectral structure of the ion system, forming a time-dependent quantum memory. Such voltage-induced memory is defined as the active quantum memory, which manifests in the system with a regular oscillatory sideband structure in the ion transport current. The sideband structure demonstrates a multi-crossing hysteresis in the I-V curve, responding to the variation of the time-varying voltage (membrane potential difference). We also find that the strength of active quantum memory can be described by the ratio of amplitude and frequency of the time-varying voltage, and can be quantitatively measured through the number of non-zero cross points in the current-voltage hysteresis and conductance-voltage diagram. Additionally, we explore the temperature dependence of the active quantum memory in such a system. Further, we apply this model to the ion channel system on the biological energy scale. The description of these active quantum memory characteristics provides a quantum mechanical understanding to the underlying mechanism of ion channel dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将电压门控离子通道建模为纳米尺度双端离子隧穿结，并用外加时变电压模拟神经元膜电位差。作者从量子力学第一性原理推导离子输运的非马尔可夫量子朗之万方程，并将离子电流表述为受时变电压控制的量子隧穿过程。结果表明，时变电压会诱导有效磁通并产生离子隧穿的量子相干，进而形成具有振荡边带结构的时间依赖“主动量子记忆”。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 众所周知，神经系统中电压门控离子通道的开启或关闭机制，是由细胞膜两侧的电势差触发的。基于这一图像，我们将离子通道建模为一个纳米尺度的双端离子隧穿结。我们在该结上施加外部时变电压，以模拟神经元刺激中的膜电位差。我们从量子力学第一性原理推导出适用于离子通道中离子输运的非马尔可夫量子朗之万方程，并以时变电压控制下离子量子隧穿的形式得到离子输运电流。我们发现，时变电压会诱导出一个有效磁通，从而在离子隧穿中引发量子相干。该有效磁通还会在离子系统的谱结构中诱导进一步的振荡分量，形成一种时间依赖的量子记忆。这种由电压诱导的记忆被定义为主动量子记忆，其在系统中表现为离子输运电流中规则的振荡边带结构。该边带结构在 I-V 曲线中展示出多次交叉滞回，并响应时变电压（膜电位差）的变化。我们还发现，主动量子记忆的强度可以由时变电压的幅值与频率之比来描述，并可通过电流-电压滞回图和电导-电压图中非零交点的数目进行定量测量。此外，我们探讨了该系统中主动量子记忆对温度的依赖性。进一步地，我们将该模型应用于生物能量尺度上的离子通道系统。对这些主动量子记忆特征的描述，为离子通道动力学的潜在机制提供了量子力学理解。

articles.title: QG from SymQRG: AdS₃/CFT₂ Correspondence as Topological Symmetry-Preserving Quantum RG Flow
articles.title_zh: 从 SymQRG 到量子引力：作为保持拓扑对称性的量子重整化群流的 AdS₃/CFT₂ 对应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.12045v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: By analyzing non-perturbative RG flows that explicitly preserve given topological symmetries, we show that each of their coarse-graining steps can be expressed as a quantum path integral of the SymTFT in one higher dimension. When the symmetries involved include the Virasoro defect lines, such as in the case of TbarT deformations, this RG kernel is the 3D quantum gravitational path integral. For 2D CFTs whose structure constants are under control, we identify the corresponding ground state of the SymTFT, from which the Wheeler-DeWitt equation emerges as the non-perturbative no-flux constraint: the gravitational path integral acts on this state as the projector that renders symmetry-preserving coarse-graining exact. These observations are summarized in the slogan: SymQRG = QG. The exact discrete formulation of Liouville theory in i̧teChen:2024unp allows us to identify a universal SymQRG kernel, constructed from quantum 6j symbols of U_q(SL(2,R)): it provides a discrete realization of two copies of the Virasoro TQFT on Σ× I, and manifests as an exact and analytic 3D background-independent MERA-type holographic tensor network. Many aspects of the AdS/CFT correspondence, including the factorization puzzle, admit a natural interpretation within this framework. We propose that the non-perturbative AdS₃/CFT₂ correspondence is a maximal form of topological holography, in which the physical boundary is fixed by kinematics alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过分析显式保持给定拓扑对称性的非微扰重整化群流，指出每一步粗粒化都可表示为高一维 SymTFT 的量子路径积分。当所涉对称性包含 Virasoro 缺陷线时，例如 TbarT 形变，该 RG 核对应三维量子引力路径积分。作者进一步从受控结构常数的二维 CFT 出发识别 SymTFT 基态，并将 Wheeler-DeWitt 方程理解为非微扰无通量约束，概括为“SymQRG = QG”。
authors: Ning Bao, Ling-Yan Hung, Yikun Jiang, Zhihan Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过分析明确保持给定拓扑对称性的非微扰 RG 流，我们表明其每一步粗粒化都可以表示为高一维 SymTFT 的量子路径积分。当所涉及的对称性包括 Virasoro 缺陷线时，例如在 TbarT 变形的情形下，这个 RG 核就是三维量子引力路径积分。对于结构常数处于可控状态的二维 CFT，我们识别出相应的 SymTFT 基态，并由此导出 Wheeler-DeWitt 方程作为非微扰“无通量”约束：引力路径积分作用在该态上，充当使保持对称性的粗粒化变为精确的投影算符。这些观察可概括为一句口号：SymQRG = QG。Liouville 理论在 i̧teChen:2024unp 中的精确离散化使我们能够识别一个普适的 SymQRG 核，它由 U_q(SL(2,R)) 的量子 6j 符号构造而成：它提供了在 Σ×I 上两个 Virasoro TQFT 的离散实现，并表现为一个精确且解析的、三维背景无关的 MERA 型全息张量网络。AdS/CFT 对应中的许多方面，包括因子分解难题，都可在这一框架中获得自然解释。我们提出，非微扰的 AdS₃/CFT₂ 对应是拓扑全息的一种最大形式，其中物理边界仅由运动学本身固定。

articles.title: Fermi--Born--Infeld electrodynamics: a nonlinear theory with physical gauge
articles.title_zh: 费米-玻恩-因费尔德电动力学：一种具有物理规范的非线性理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a nonlinear extension of Fermi's electrodynamics by incorporating a Born--Infeld structure that depends directly on the four-potential A_μ rather than on the field strength Fμν. The resulting theory, which we call Fermi--Born--Infeld (FBI) electrodynamics, eliminates the U(1) gauge redundancy by elevating the Lorenz gauge to a dynamical condition. The Lagrangian is built from the determinant of a metric-like tensor gμν = ημν + 2κ, partial₍μ Aν₎, ensuring that the canonical energy--momentum tensor and the spin density remain unique and free of gauge ambiguities. We derive the field equations, which reduce to partial_ν(sqrt-g, gμν) = 0, and show that the Lorenz condition partial_μ A^μ = 0 emerges dynamically from retarded boundary conditions and the requirement of a positive-energy spectrum. The nonlinearities modify the propagation of longitudinal modes; we argue, via a Vainshtein-like mechanism, that the nonlinear self-interactions may stabilize the longitudinal mode, opening the possibility of a stable massive scalar photon under extreme field conditions. We also compute the spin density from the Noether current and discuss its properties. The FBI theory preserves the physical gauge of Fermi's original formulation while incorporating the regularization features of Born--Infeld electrodynamics, making it a candidate for describing electromagnetic phenomena in strong-field regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作构造了费米电动力学的非线性推广，引入直接依赖四维势 A_μ 而非场强 Fμν 的 Born-Infeld 结构，并称之为 Fermi-Born-Infeld 电动力学。该理论通过将洛伦兹规范提升为动力学条件来消除 U(1) 规范冗余，使能量-动量张量和自旋密度具有唯一性并避免规范歧义。作者推导了场方程，讨论洛伦兹条件如何由推迟边界条件和正能谱要求动力学地产生，并指出非线性自相互作用可能在极端场条件下稳定纵向模。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过引入直接依赖于四维势 A_μ 而非场强 Fμν 的 Born--Infeld 结构，构造了费米电动力学的一个非线性推广。我们将该理论称为费米—Born—Infeld（FBI）电动力学。该理论消除了 U(1) 规范冗余，并将洛伦兹规范提升为一个动力学条件。其拉格朗日量由一个类似度规的张量 gμν = ημν + 2κ, partial₍μ Aν₎ 的行列式构成，从而确保正则能动张量和自旋密度都是唯一的，并且不受规范歧义影响。我们推导了场方程，证明它们可化为 partial_ν(sqrt-g, gμν) = 0，并显示洛伦兹条件 partial_μ A^μ = 0 会在迟延边界条件以及正能谱要求下动态涌现。非线性会修正纵向模的传播；我们借助类似 Vainshtein 的机制论证，这些非线性自相互作用可能稳定纵向模，从而在极端场强条件下打开存在稳定的有质量标量光子的可能性。我们还由诺特流计算了自旋密度并讨论了其性质。FBI 理论保留了费米原始表述中的物理规范，同时纳入了 Born--Infeld 电动力学的正则化特征，因此可作为描述强场区电磁现象的候选理论。

articles.title: A Single-Tuning-Element Loaded Pixelated Tunable Band-Pass Filters with Low Loss via Inverse Synthesis on Massive-Scale Dataset
articles.title_zh: 基于大规模数据集逆向综合的低损耗单调谐元件加载像素化可调带通滤波器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a novel three-phase inverse-design flow for synthesizing tunable pixelated band-pass filters. The workflow consists of: 1) acquisition of a massive dataset ~300000 5-port S-parameter samples using the group's custom electromagnetic solvers accelerated by method-of-moments pre-computation; 2) identification of an initial seed through brute-force search with dataset augmentation by dynamically reassigning the input, output, and tuning ports and randomly applying open or short terminations to the remaining ports; and 3) fine-tuning of the selected seed using a direct-binary-search algorithm. Two design targets are considered: 4G mid-/high-band tunable band-pass filters and 5G n79/UNIII-band tunable band-pass filters. One designed filter achieves a 28% tuning range, with passband peaks reconfigured from 4.64 to 6.16 GHz and insertion loss from 1.3 to 1.8 dB in simulation. All inversely designed filters use only a single varactor, representing the first reported demonstration of continuously reconfigurable inverse design in the microwave regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种三阶段逆向设计流程，用于综合可调像素化带通滤波器。流程包括利用自研电磁求解器获取约 30 万个五端口 S 参数样本、通过蛮力搜索和端口/终端条件增强寻找初始种子，以及使用直接二进制搜索算法进行精调。针对 4G 与 5G 频段目标，设计结果显示仅使用单个变容二极管即可实现连续可重构滤波，其中一个滤波器在仿真中达到 28% 调谐范围且插入损耗为 1.3–1.8 dB。
authors: Woojun Lee, Pouya Faeghi, Jeffrey S. Walling
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种用于综合可调像素化带通滤波器的新型三阶段逆向设计流程。该工作流包括：1）利用作者组自研的电磁求解器，并借助矩量法预计算加速，获得约 300000 个五端口 S 参数样本的大规模数据集；2）通过穷举搜索识别初始种子，同时通过动态重新分配输入、输出和调谐端口，以及对其余端口随机施加开路或短路终端来增强数据；3）使用直接二进制搜索算法对所选种子进行微调。我们考虑了两个设计目标：4G 中/高频段可调带通滤波器和 5G n79/UNIII 频段可调带通滤波器。所设计的一种滤波器实现了 28% 的调谐范围，通带峰值在仿真中从 4.64 GHz 重构到 6.16 GHz，插入损耗从 1.3 dB 增加到 1.8 dB。所有逆向设计的滤波器都只使用一个变容二极管，这代表了在微波频段首次报道的连续可重构逆向设计示范。

articles.title: Investigating planar Proca metamaterials in nonlinear (2+1)-Electrodynamics
articles.title_zh: 非线性 (2+1) 维电动力学中平面 Proca 超材料的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The present work pursues the investigation of the physics of a planar electromagnetic system incorporating nonlinear effects, as well as de Broglie-Proca and Chern-Simons mass terms in vacuum, which can be tuned to describe new planar metamaterials (MTMs) potentially suitable for technological applications. As a result, we observe interesting effects generated by a spatially dispersive profile that emerges from non-linearity. This characterizes the three-dimensional QED vacuum as a nonlocal metamaterial. The constitutive relations are derived, and the dielectric function of the metamaterial (MTM) exhibits spatial dispersion due to the Chern-Simons mass. The dispersion relations are analyzed in terms of applied external electromagnetic fields and both the de Broglie-Proca and Chern-Simons mass parameters. We also notice that, in the special case in which only a background magnetic field is present, this field gives no contribution neither to the dielectric function nor to the spatial dispersion profile, as is the case when both the electric and magnetic fields are present.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨一种包含非线性效应、de Broglie-Proca 质量项和 Chern-Simons 质量项的平面电磁系统，可用于描述潜在的新型平面超材料。作者推导了本构关系，并发现非线性诱导的空间色散使三维 QED 真空表现为非局域超材料。研究分析了介电函数和色散关系对外加电磁场以及两类质量参数的依赖，并指出在仅存在背景磁场的特殊情况下，该磁场不影响介电函数和空间色散轮廓。
authors: Widervan de Deus Morais, Stamatios Strikos, Ronaldo Thibes, José Abdalla Helayël-Neto
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文致力于研究一个包含非线性效应以及真空中的德布罗意—普罗卡（de Broglie-Proca）和 Chern-Simons 质量项的平面电磁系统的物理学，该系统可被调节为描述可能适用于技术应用的新型平面超材料（MTM）。因此，我们观察到由非线性产生的一个有趣效应，即空间色散分布的出现。这表明三维 QED 真空表现为一种非局域超材料。文中推导了本构关系，并且该超材料的介电函数由于 Chern-Simons 质量而表现出空间色散。我们以外加电磁场以及德布罗意—普罗卡和 Chern-Simons 质量参数为变量分析了色散关系。我们还注意到，在只有背景磁场的特殊情形下，该磁场对介电函数和空间色散分布都没有贡献；当电场和磁场同时存在时，也是如此。

articles.title: Protocols of coherent motion control for an interaction-driven Rydberg gate
articles.title_zh: 面向相互作用驱动里德堡量子门的相干运动控制协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generating entanglement between two Rydberg atoms is at the core of neutral-atom quantum computers. Current two-qubit gates operate in the Rydberg-blockade regime, in which the full strength of the van der Waals interaction between the two Rydberg atoms is not directly exploited, to avoid sensitivity to the position noise of the tweezer-trapped atoms, at the cost of a longer time spent in the Rydberg state. Here, we propose a set of techniques based on coherent control of the atomic motion obtained by combining optical tweezers and a two-dimensional optical lattice, and a sequence of multiple on/off pulses. The protocols keep the two-qubit gate error contribution from position noise below 10⁻⁴, heat the atom by less than~Δ n = 0.01, while being robust to alignment errors of the potential up to 50~nm and thermal excitation up to barn = 3. This toolbox opens the path for new two-qubit Rydberg gates directly, or partially, driven by the interaction, in which the atoms spend only sim 10~ns in the Rydberg state, minimizing the increasingly dominant error source originating from its finite lifetime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一组基于光镊、二维光晶格以及多重开/关脉冲序列的原子运动相干控制技术，用于实现更直接利用里德堡原子间相互作用的双量子比特门。协议可将由位置噪声导致的门误差贡献控制在10⁻⁴以下，原子加热小于约Δn=0.01，并对最高50 nm的势阱对准误差和平均热激发数约3保持鲁棒。该工具箱有望使原子仅在约10 ns内处于里德堡态，从而降低有限寿命带来的主要误差。
authors: Valentin Magro, Wojciech Adamczyk, Sylvain de Léséleuc
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在中性原子量子计算中，在两个里德堡原子之间产生纠缠是核心问题。目前的双比特门运行在里德堡阻塞机制下，在该机制中，并未直接利用两个里德堡原子之间范德瓦尔斯相互作用的全部强度，以避免对光镊束缚原子位置噪声的敏感性，但代价是原子在里德堡态中停留的时间更长。在这里，我们提出一组基于原子运动相干控制的技术，这些技术通过结合光镊和二维光晶格，以及一系列多次开/关脉冲来实现。该协议将由位置噪声导致的双比特门误差贡献保持在 10⁻⁴ 以下，使原子加热小于 Δ n = 0.01，同时对势场对准误差高达 50 nm 以及热激发高达 barn = 3 仍具有鲁棒性。该工具箱为新的双里德堡门开辟了路径，这些门可以直接或部分由相互作用驱动，在此过程中原子在里德堡态中的停留时间仅约 10 ns，从而将来源于有限寿命、且日益成为主导的误差降至最低。

articles.title: Non-volatile integrated photonics on lithium tantalate-on-insulator
articles.title_zh: 基于绝缘体上钽酸锂的非易失集成光子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scalable reconfigurable photonic integrated circuits require low-loss, high-speed optical control without continuous holding power. Yet widely used thermo-optic tuning and continuously biased electro-optic tuning consume static power and introduce thermal crosstalk or bias drift. Here we demonstrate a monolithic non-volatile photonics platform on lithium tantalate-on-insulator (LTOI). In congruent x-cut lithium tantalate, the switched ferroelectric-domain configuration is retained after the write field is removed. On the same LTOI platform, we demonstrate a waveguide propagation loss of approximately 0.05-0.06 dB/cm and multilevel non-volatile phase tuning in separate devices. The programmed states remain distinguishable through 10⁶ write cycles. Weighted segmented electrodes resolve 137 phase positions across a π range, corresponding to an analogue phase-setting resolution of approximately 0.007π. We further combine non-volatile phase control with high-speed electro-optic modulation to achieve zero-static-power bias control of a >110 GHz modulator and a 59.3 dB extinction ratio after non-volatile trimming. At the system level, an image-edge-detection chip achieves a measured energy efficiency of 3.48 TOPS/W. These results establish LTOI as an integrated photonics platform that combines persistent optical reconfigurability with low-loss routing and high-speed electro-optic modulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种单片集成的绝缘体上钽酸锂非易失光子平台，利用铁电畴翻转后可保持的特性实现无需持续保持功耗的相位调控。作者在同一平台上实现了约0.05–0.06 dB/cm的低波导传播损耗、多级非易失相位调谐，并在10⁶次写入循环后仍保持可区分状态。通过加权分段电极实现π范围内137个相位位置，并结合高速电光调制，展示了零静态功耗偏置控制和高消光比调制能力。
authors: Yuhang Li, Miao Deng, Xun Zhang, Cheng Zeng, Chijun Li, Yiqi Dai, Yuankang Huang, Siyu Lu, Zhenwu Mo, Xiao Wu, Peng Tan, Yong Zhang, Yikai Su, Jinsong Xia
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可扩展的可重构光子集成电路要求低损耗、高速的光学控制，而不需要持续的维持功率。然而，广泛使用的热光调谐和连续偏置的电光调谐会消耗静态功率，并引入热串扰或偏置漂移。在这里，我们在绝缘型铌酸锂钽（LTOI）上展示了一个单片非易失光子平台。在同成分 x-cut 铌酸锂钽中，切换后的铁电畴构型在移除写入电场后仍能保持。基于同一 LTOI 平台，我们在不同器件中实现了约 0.05-0.06 dB/cm 的波导传播损耗以及多级非易失相位调谐。经编程的状态在 10⁶ 次写入循环后仍可区分。加权分段电极在 π 范围内分辨出 137 个相位位置，对应约 0.007π 的模拟相位设定分辨率。我们进一步将非易失相位控制与高速电光调制结合，实现了对一个 >110 GHz 调制器的零静态功耗偏置控制，并在非易失微调后获得 59.3 dB 的消光比。在系统层面，一个图像边缘检测芯片实现了实测 3.48 TOPS/W 的能量效率。这些结果确立了 LTOI 作为一个集持久光学可重构性、低损耗布线和高速电光调制于一体的集成光子平台。

articles.title: Curl-based Electric-Field Boundary Condition for the Accurate and Stable Electromagnetic Scattering Analysis
articles.title_zh: 用于精确稳定电磁散射分析的基于旋度的电场边界条件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a curl-based Electric-Field Integral Equation (Curl-EFIE) for the electromagnetic scattering analysis from perfect electric conductors. The formulation is derived by enforcing a vanishing curl on the EFIE over the boundary manifold, achieved by testing the internal electric field with orthogonal tangent solenoidal disks. We demonstrate that a Method-of-Moments (MoM) discretization of the Curl-EFIE converges to a Galerkin-discretized MFIE as the testing disk dimensions vanish, yielding stable, breakdown-free impedance matrices for low frequencies and dense grids. Unlike the strongly singular kernels of the MFIE, the Curl-EFIE utilizes weakly singular kernels, significantly simplifying source integral evaluations. As a first-kind integral equation, it bypasses the MFIE's Gram matrix requirement, facilitating the analysis of non-matching triangulations. Furthermore, a linear combination of the Curl-EFIE and the conventional EFIE provides an interior-resonance-free formulation analogous to the Combined Field Integral Equation (CFIE). Finally, the Curl-EFIE performs particularly well at capturing the scattering behavior of sharp- edged and cornered geometries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种基于旋度的电场积分方程（Curl-EFIE），用于理想电导体的电磁散射分析，其思路是在边界流形上强制电场积分方程的旋度为零。作者表明，当测试盘尺寸趋于零时，其矩量法离散形式收敛到Galerkin离散的磁场积分方程，并在低频和密网格情况下产生稳定且无击穿的阻抗矩阵。与传统MFIE相比，Curl-EFIE仅涉及弱奇异核，简化了源积分计算，并可与常规EFIE线性组合形成类似CFIE的无内谐振公式。
authors: Eduard Ubeda, Alex Heldring, Juan M. Rius, Vladimir Okhmatovski
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种基于旋度的电场积分方程（Curl-EFIE），用于完美电导体的电磁散射分析。该表述通过在边界流形上强制 EFIE 的旋度为零而推导得到，这一过程是通过用正交的切向无散盘测试内部电场来实现的。我们证明，Curl-EFIE 的矩量法离散在测试盘尺寸趋于零时会收敛到伽辽金离散的 MFIE，从而在低频和稠密网格下得到稳定、无退化的阻抗矩阵。与 MFIE 的强奇异核不同，Curl-EFIE 只使用弱奇异核，从而显著简化了源积分的计算。作为一种第一类积分方程，它绕开了 MFIE 对 Gram 矩阵的要求，便于分析非匹配三角剖分。此外，Curl-EFIE 与传统 EFIE 的线性组合给出一种无内部共振的表述，类似于组合场积分方程（CFIE）。最后，Curl-EFIE 在捕捉尖边和角点几何体的散射行为方面表现尤为出色。

articles.title: Three-dimensional confinement of light in photonic crystals without bandgaps
articles.title_zh: 无带隙光子晶体中的三维光限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that confinement of light in three dimensions is possible in photonic crystals without a complete photonic bandgap. Our approach exploits symmetry-protected quadratic degeneracies in the bulk band structure, where the photonic density of states vanishes at an isolated frequency. By introducing a point defect, we create a localized mode whose symmetry representation is incompatible with that of the surrounding bulk modes, suppressing coupling to propagating channels. The combination of vanishing density of states and a symmetry mismatch yields bound defect modes despite the absence of a spectral gap, as confirmed by time- and frequency-domain numerical simulations. This approach highlights the role of engineering the photonic environment around the defect to enable confinement, potentially providing a new route for designing optical cavities in three-dimensional photonic crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究证明，即使不存在完整光子带隙，三维光子晶体中仍可实现光的三维局域限制。其机制利用体能带结构中的对称性保护二次简并点，使光子态密度在孤立频率处消失；引入点缺陷后，缺陷模的对称表示与周围体模不匹配，从而抑制与传播通道的耦合。时域与频域数值模拟验证了这种无谱隙束缚缺陷模，为三维光子晶体光学腔设计提供了新思路。
authors: Manxi Shi, Sachin Vaidya, Ali Ghorashi, Steven G. Johnson, Marin Soljačić
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，在没有完整光子带隙的光子晶体中，也有可能实现三维方向上的光约束。我们的方法利用了体能带结构中的对称性保护二次简并，在某个孤立频率处光子态密度为零。通过引入一个点缺陷，我们产生了一个局域模，其对称性表象与周围体模的对称性表象不相容，从而抑制了与传播通道的耦合。态密度消失与对称性失配的结合，尽管没有谱隙，仍然产生了束缚缺陷模，这一点已由时域和频域数值模拟证实。该方法强调了围绕缺陷来设计光子环境的重要性，以实现约束，因而可能为在三维光子晶体中设计光学腔提供一条新途径。

articles.title: Approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser for reducing energy consumption
articles.title_zh: 利用半导体激光器的近似储备池计算以降低能耗
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23288v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning technique for predicting time-series data. The quantization of the response signal from the reservoir is required for the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have been reported to investigate the effect of bit quantization and sampling frequency. In this study, we introduce a concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the amplitude of node states in the reservoir and output weights. We evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and energy consumption per sample. We achieve significant reduction of energy consumption by optimizing the number of quantization bits, the sampling frequency, and the injection current of the semiconductor laser, while maintaining the prediction performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究半导体激光器光子储备池计算中响应信号量化位数和采样频率对性能与能耗的影响。作者提出“近似储备池计算”概念，对储备池节点状态幅度和输出权重进行量化，并在混沌时间序列预测任务中评估预测性能与单样本能耗。结果表明，通过优化量化位数、采样频率和半导体激光器注入电流，可在保持预测性能的同时显著降低能耗。
authors: Tatsuki Ito, Kazutaka Kanno, Satoshi Kawakami, Atsushi Uchida
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光子储备池计算是一种有前景的物理机器学习技术，可用于预测时间序列数据。为实现光子储备池计算，需要对来自储备池的响应信号进行量化，并且需要优化量化位数和采样频率，以实现高性能和低能耗。然而，关于位量化和采样频率影响的研究报道很少。在本研究中，我们通过量化储备池中节点状态的幅度和输出权重，引入了一种利用半导体激光器的近似储备池计算概念。我们评估了混沌时间序列预测任务的性能以及每个样本的能耗。通过优化量化位数、采样频率和半导体激光器的注入电流，我们在保持预测性能的同时实现了能耗的显著降低。

articles.title: PI-GINOT: Data-free geometry-informed neural operator learning for finite-strain hyperelasticity on parametric DogBone specimens
articles.title_zh: PI-GINOT：面向参数化哑铃试样有限应变超弹性的无数据几何信息神经算子学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parametric nonlinear solid-mechanics simulations are widely used in virtual testing, optimisation, and uncertainty analysis, but repeated finite-element simulations become costly when geometry changes. This paper presents PI-GINOT, a physics-informed neural operator that predicts finite-strain hyperelastic responses across a four-parameter family of DogBone specimens without using finite-element training data. Each specimen is described by a boundary point cloud, which is encoded into geometry features. A cross-attention decoder then predicts displacement at arbitrary points. Displacement boundary conditions are enforced exactly, while stresses are computed using automatic differentiation and a compressible Neo-Hookean plane-stress model. Training is guided by equilibrium, traction-free and symmetry conditions, deformation stability, and internal force consistency. Abaqus simulations are used only after training for validation. Across eight test geometries, PI-GINOT achieves displacement errors of 2.1%-7.1%, peak von Mises stress errors of 0.9%-13.3%, and section-force errors below 10.3%. Larger errors occur in individual stress components, especially for narrow specimens, mainly because of steep stress gradients near the gauge-to-fillet transition. These results show that PI-GINOT can provide useful geometry-dependent predictions for nonlinear solid mechanics without labelled simulation data, while also revealing where better local stress resolution is still needed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出PI-GINOT，一种物理信息神经算子，可在不使用有限元训练数据的情况下预测四参数族哑铃试样的有限应变超弹性响应。方法以边界点云编码几何特征，通过交叉注意力解码器预测任意点位移，并精确施加位移边界条件；应力由自动微分和可压缩Neo-Hookean平面应力模型计算。训练由平衡、无牵引、对称、变形稳定性和内力一致性约束引导，Abaqus仅用于训练后验证，在8个测试几何上取得较低的位移、峰值von Mises应力和截面力误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 参数化非线性固体力学仿真广泛用于虚拟测试、优化和不确定性分析，但当几何形状发生变化时，重复的有限元仿真会变得成本高昂。本文提出PI-GINOT，一种物理信息神经算子，可在不使用有限元训练数据的情况下，预测四参数狗骨试样族的有限应变超弹性响应。每个试样由边界点云描述，并被编码为几何特征。随后，交叉注意力解码器在任意点预测位移。位移边界条件被精确施加，而应力则使用自动微分和可压缩Neo-Hookean平面应力模型计算。训练由平衡条件、无牵引和对称条件、变形稳定性以及内力一致性共同引导。Abaqus仿真仅在训练后用于验证。在八种测试几何形状上，PI-GINOT实现了2.1%至7.1%的位移误差、0.9%至13.3%的峰值von Mises应力误差，以及低于10.3%的截面力误差。较大的误差出现在各个应力分量中，尤其是在窄试样中，这主要是由于标距段到圆角过渡区域附近存在陡峭的应力梯度。这些结果表明，PI-GINOT能够在没有标注仿真数据的情况下，为非线性固体力学提供有用的几何相关预测，同时也揭示了仍然需要更好的局部应力分辨率的区域。

articles.title: Self-consistent orbital-free nuclear density functional theory with a physics-constrained learned nonlocal kinetic energy functional
articles.title_zh: 采用物理约束学习非局域动能泛函的自洽无轨道核密度泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23328v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonlocal kinetic-energy density functionals (KEDFs) can encode nuclear shell structure in orbital-free density functional theory (OFDFT), but self-consistency requires accurate functional derivatives and a stable solution of the Euler equation. We construct a density-dependent-kernel KEDF whose correction is learned from Kohn-Sham (KS) reference data. Linearity in the kernel shape yields analytic Euler--Lagrange (EL) responses. The fit uses exact energy-matching equalities and soft quadratic inequality penalties for violations of prescribed tail-response and selected-path energy-rise margins, evaluated by an active-set repeated penalized least-squares iteration. We formulate the radial EL equation as the rearranged one-orbital eigenproblem. In a constant-k_F ¹⁶O benchmark it converges without density mixing and agrees with imaginary-time evolution (ITE) to sub-keV energy. Adaptive-step ITE gives final species EL residuals of at most 0.07 MeV in the reported calculations, and rearranged diagonalization reaches the same stationary densities. For spherical N=Z systems without spin--orbit or Coulomb terms, nucleus-specific fits for A=16 to 140 reproduce shell patterns and radii. A correction trained on three nuclei transfers the shell pattern and radius, but not the absolute energy, to a previously unseen A=140 system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了一种密度依赖核的非局域动能密度泛函，用于在无轨道核密度泛函理论中编码核壳层结构，并从Kohn-Sham参考数据学习修正项。由于核形状具有线性形式，作者可获得解析的Euler–Lagrange响应，并通过带主动集的重复惩罚最小二乘拟合满足能量匹配及尾部响应、能量上升等物理约束。文中还将径向Euler–Lagrange方程重写为单轨道本征问题，并在¹⁶O等球形N=Z体系基准中验证了自洽求解的稳定性和精度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非局域动能密度泛函能够在无轨道密度泛函理论中编码核壳层结构，但自洽性要求准确的泛函导数以及Euler方程的稳定求解。我们构建了一种密度依赖核的动能密度泛函，其修正项从Kohn-Sham参考数据中学习得到。核形状中的线性性产生解析的Euler-Lagrange响应。拟合使用精确的能量匹配等式，以及对违反规定尾部响应和选定路径能量上升裕度的软二次不等式惩罚，并通过主动集重复惩罚最小二乘迭代进行评估。我们将径向Euler-Lagrange方程表述为重排的单轨道本征问题。在恒定k_F的¹⁶O基准中，它无需密度混合即可收敛，并且与虚时间演化在亚keV能量精度上一致。自适应步长虚时间演化在所报告的计算中给出的最终分物种Euler-Lagrange残差至多为0.07 MeV，而重排对角化达到相同的定态密度。对于没有自旋-轨道项或库仑项的球形N=Z体系，针对A=16至140的特定原子核拟合再现了壳层模式和半径。一个在三个原子核上训练的修正能够将壳层模式和半径迁移到此前未见的A=140体系，但不能迁移绝对能量。

articles.title: Temperature dependence of Bloch equations
articles.title_zh: 布洛赫方程的温度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We review the temperature dependence of Bloch equations. The temperature dependence of nuclear magnetization in thermodynamic equilibrium and relaxation are reviewed, and relations are developed to account for the temperature effects in a nuclear magnetic resonance experiment. It is found that the temperature dependence of the Bloch equations precisely accounts for the temperature effects observed in a nuclear magnetic resonance experiment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文回顾了布洛赫方程中的温度依赖效应，重点讨论热力学平衡下核磁化强度以及弛豫过程随温度变化的规律。作者建立了用于描述核磁共振实验中温度效应的相关关系。研究认为，引入温度依赖后的布洛赫方程能够准确解释核磁共振实验中观测到的温度效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们综述了Bloch方程的温度依赖性。本文回顾了热力学平衡下核磁化强度以及弛豫过程的温度依赖性，并建立了用于说明核磁共振实验中温度效应的关系。研究发现，Bloch方程的温度依赖性能够精确说明核磁共振实验中观察到的温度效应。

articles.title: When Every Simulation Counts: Value-Based Reinforcement Learning for Accelerated Photonics Inverse Design
articles.title_zh: 每次仿真都很关键：用于加速光子学逆向设计的基于价值的强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers (PCSELs) can combine high-power operation with narrow-divergence surface emission, but optimizing coupled parameters requires costly full-wave simulations. Deep Q-network (DQN) optimization can reuse simulated transitions to guide edits, yet which value-learning mechanisms remain reliable under tight simulation budgets is unknown. We address this gap by comparing baseline DQN and six value-based variants for a seven-variable PCSEL design under a shared objective, simulator, 83-call budget, and four matched initializations. Beyond endpoints, we analyze sample efficiency, policy behavior, and physical response to separate learning gains from favorable starts or exploratory jumps. Dueling DQN is the only variant to improve all four seeds. Relative to the first evaluated designs, its selected structures increase the mean quality factor () from to (), reduce wavelength error by 64%, and increase upward power by 47%; compared with baseline DQN, they achieve a higher mean under the same budget. Other variants yield no consistent improvement; Double DQN reproduces baseline trajectories, while Rainbow-lite shows high upside but strong seed dependence. These results identify Dueling DQN as the most reliable configuration tested for simulation-budget-limited PCSEL inverse design and provide a reproducible framework for attributing algorithmic gains in scientific optimization. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Longying-Wen/PCSEL-RL.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对光子晶体面发射激光器设计中全波仿真成本高的问题，比较了基线DQN及六种基于价值的变体在严格83次仿真预算下的优化表现。作者不仅考察最终结果，还分析样本效率、策略行为和物理响应，以区分学习机制带来的收益与初始条件或探索跳变的影响。结果显示，Dueling DQN是唯一在四个随机种子上均改进的变体，并在提高品质因子、降低波长误差和增强向上出射功率方面优于基线DQN，而其他变体未表现出一致改进。
authors: Longying Wen, Feiyang Wu, Jinglin Yu, Chongxian Yuan, Renjie Li, Zhaoyu Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光子晶体面发射激光器能够将高功率运行与窄发散角表面发射结合起来，但优化耦合参数需要代价高昂的全波仿真。深度Q网络优化能够复用已仿真的状态转移来指导设计修改，然而在严格仿真预算下，哪些价值学习机制仍然可靠尚不清楚。我们通过在共同目标、仿真器、83次调用预算和四个匹配初始化条件下，比较基线DQN和六种基于价值的变体来弥补这一空白。除了终点结果外，我们还分析样本效率、策略行为和物理响应，以将学习收益与有利起点或探索性跳跃区分开来。Dueling DQN是唯一能改进全部四个随机种子的变体。相对于首次评估的设计，其选择的结构使平均品质因数（）从提高到（），将波长误差降低64%，并将向上功率提高47%；与基线DQN相比，它们在相同预算下实现了更高的平均值。其他变体没有产生一致改进；Double DQN复现了基线轨迹，而Rainbow-lite表现出较高上限但强烈依赖随机种子。这些结果表明，在所测试的配置中，Dueling DQN是受仿真预算限制的光子晶体面发射激光器逆向设计中最可靠的方案，并为归因科学优化中的算法收益提供了一个可复现框架。源代码已公开提供。

articles.title: Maximum updraft velocity beyond CAPE: the role of boundary layer dynamics and pressure perturbations
articles.title_zh: 超越CAPE的最大上升气流速度：边界层动力学与压力扰动的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep convective updraft velocities play a key role in the Earth's climate system, influencing precipitation extremes, lightning, and the planetary energy budget. While Convective Available Potential Energy (CAPE) is widely used to explain maximum updraft velocity (wₘₐₓ), CAPE is an imperfect predictor as updrafts are also influenced by entrainment, boundary layer dynamics, pressure perturbations, and condensate loading. However, the relative importance of these processes and how they interact to set wₘₐₓ in individual clouds remains unclear. Here, we use equation learning to identify compact, physically interpretable relationships linking environmental and in-cloud conditions to wₘₐₓ in individual tracked clouds across idealized radiative-convective equilibrium regimes spanning a range of sea surface temperatures and radiative cooling rates. For pre-storm prediction, CAPE and local mean boundary layer vertical velocity (øverlinewbₗ) together explain nearly half the variance in wₘₐₓ across regimes (R²⁼⁰.47). While CAPE captures regime-mean differences, it has little predictive value within a single simulation. øverlinewbₗ is essential for capturing cloud-to-cloud variability, including the suppression of wₘₐₓ even at high CAPE values. At the time of peak intensity, a simple approximate Bernoulli-like invariant combining maximum pressure perturbation and maximum cloud condensate explains 89% of the variance (R²⁼⁰.89). The tight link between wₘₐₓ and pressure perturbation supports the sticky thermals hypothesis and highlights the importance of dynamic pressure effects, often neglected in updraft theories. These results highlight øverlinewbₗ as an important regulator of convective intensity alongside CAPE, and demonstrate that dynamic pressure plays an important role within individual updrafts.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用方程学习方法，在理想化辐射-对流平衡条件下识别环境和云内条件与单个云最大上升气流速度之间的紧凑、可解释关系。结果表明，在风暴前预测中，对流有效位能（CAPE）与局地平均边界层垂直速度共同可解释跨不同情景近一半的最大上升气流速度方差。CAPE主要刻画不同情景的平均差异，但在单次模拟内部预测能力有限；边界层垂直运动对解释个体云上升速度至关重要，摘要还指出压力扰动等过程参与调控。
authors: Bety Pechacova, Alejandro Casallas, Tom Beucler, Lokahith Agasthya, Caroline Muller
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深对流上升气流速度在地球气候系统中发挥关键作用，影响极端降水、闪电以及行星能量收支。尽管对流有效位能被广泛用于解释最大上升气流速度（wₘₐₓ），但CAPE并不是完美的预测因子，因为上升气流还受到卷入、边界层动力学、压力扰动和凝结物负载的影响。然而，这些过程的相对重要性以及它们如何相互作用以决定单个云中的wₘₐₓ仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用方程学习来识别紧凑且具有物理可解释性的关系，这些关系将环境条件和云内条件与单个被跟踪云中的wₘₐₓ联系起来，研究对象覆盖了一系列海表温度和辐射冷却率的理想化辐射-对流平衡状态。对于风暴前预测，CAPE和局地平均边界层垂直速度（øverlinewbₗ）共同解释了跨状态wₘₐₓ方差的近一半（R²=0.47）。尽管CAPE能够捕捉状态平均差异，但在单次模拟内部几乎没有预测价值。øverlinewbₗ对于捕捉云与云之间的变异性至关重要，包括即使在高CAPE值下对wₘₐₓ的抑制。在峰值强度时刻，一个由最大压力扰动和最大云凝结物组成的简单近似Bernoulli型不变量解释了89%的方差（R²=0.89）。wₘₐₓ与压力扰动之间的紧密联系支持了黏性热泡假说，并突出了动态压力效应的重要性，而这种效应在上升气流理论中常被忽略。这些结果突出表明，øverlinewbₗ是与CAPE并列的对流强度重要调节因子，并证明动态压力在单个上升气流内部发挥重要作用。

articles.title: Nonreciprocal subdiffraction imaging with staggered gyromagnetic photonic crystals
articles.title_zh: 交错旋磁光子晶体中的非互易亚衍射成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23708v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Subdiffraction imaging serves as a novel technique to enhance the optical imaging resolution, where a backscattering-free approach remains so far unavailable. Here, we theoretically predict and experimentally demonstrate that the gyromagnetic photonic crystals applied with staggered magnetic fields support nonreciprocal light propagation beyond the diffraction limit. Broadband subdiffraction imaging was experimentally observed to span the frequency window traversing a pair of spectrally separated Dirac points, where near-flat equi-frequency contours (EFCs) emerged while experiencing an enforced shape transition. Our findings establish a practical paradigm for constructing backscattering-immune super-resolution imaging systems based on topological photonic crystal platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作从理论和实验上展示，施加交错磁场的旋磁光子晶体可支持超越衍射极限的非互易光传播，从而实现抗背散射的亚衍射成像。实验观察到宽带亚衍射成像，其频率窗口跨越一对谱上分离的Dirac点，并伴随近乎平坦的等频轮廓及其受约束的形状转变。该结果为基于拓扑光子晶体构建抗背散射超分辨成像系统提供了可行范式。
authors: Rui Ding, Tianshu Zhang, Jiarui Yu, Namitha Nandakumar, Quanlong Yang, Mudi Wang, D. Y. Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 亚衍射成像是一种提高光学成像分辨率的新技术，而迄今为止仍缺乏一种无背散射的方法。在这里，我们从理论上预测并通过实验演示，施加交错磁场的旋磁光子晶体支持超过衍射极限的非互易光传播。实验观测到宽带亚衍射成像跨越了穿过一对光谱分离的Dirac点的频率窗口，在该窗口中，近乎平坦的等频轮廓出现，同时经历受迫形状转变。我们的发现为基于拓扑光子晶体平台构建免疫背散射的超分辨成像系统建立了一种实用范式。

articles.title: Post-FWI Injection of Learned Priors Using a Flow Matching Model
articles.title_zh: 利用流匹配模型在全波形反演后注入学习先验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23719v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) is a powerful tool for subsurface velocity reconstruction but remains highly ill-posed, sensitive to acquisition limitations, often requiring some form of regularization to reduce artifacts and enhance resolution. While recent developments have shown that generative models can inject learned priors directly into the FWI optimization process, such approaches typically require additional, computationally expensive inversion iterations. In this study, we propose a post-FWI refinement strategy based on a Flow Matching (FM) generative model, which leverages learned geological priors without re-running FWI. The method guides the deterministic generative process using the FWI result, as well as well logs, if available. Synthetic and field data experiments demonstrate that we can inject well information and our geological expectations (prior) into the provided FWI result, and thus, we can effectively enhance its resolution and geological quality. In fact, the well prior even managed to alter the model depth to fit the well information, which is a form of correcting for depth misties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于流匹配生成模型的全波形反演后处理策略，用于在不重新运行昂贵反演迭代的情况下向速度模型注入学习到的地质先验。该方法以FWI结果为引导，并可结合井测资料，对确定性生成过程进行约束。合成与实测数据实验表明，该方法可提高FWI结果的分辨率和地质合理性，并能利用井约束修正深度不匹配等问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全波形反演是地下速度重建的有力工具，但它仍然高度不适定，对采集限制敏感，并且通常需要某种形式的正则化以减少伪影并提高分辨率。尽管近期进展表明，生成模型可以将学习到的先验直接注入全波形反演优化过程中，但这类方法通常需要额外且计算成本高昂的反演迭代。在本研究中，我们提出一种基于流匹配生成模型的后全波形反演精化策略，该策略利用学习到的地质先验，而无需重新运行全波形反演。该方法使用全波形反演结果以及在可用情况下的测井曲线来引导确定性生成过程。合成数据和现场数据实验表明，我们可以将井信息和我们的地质预期（先验）注入给定的全波形反演结果中，从而有效提高其分辨率和地质质量。事实上，井先验甚至成功地改变了模型深度以匹配井信息，这是一种校正深度错配的形式。

articles.title: Adjoint Sensitivity Maps for Passive Flow Control Around Rotating Circular Cylinders Across a Wide Operating Envelope
articles.title_zh: 宽运行范围内旋转圆柱被动流动控制的伴随灵敏度图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rotating circular cylinders are employed in a variety of engineering applications, one prominent example being Flettner rotors for wind-assisted ship propulsion. Besides optimizing the aerodynamic performance of the cylinder itself, passive flow-control devices placed in its vicinity offer additional potential for manipulating the resulting aerodynamic forces. The present work introduces a topology-based adjoint sensitivity analysis for rotating circular cylinders over a wide operating envelope covering Reynolds numbers from 1E+01 to 1E+07 and spinning ratios between 0 and 2 pi. Local sensitivity fields associated with drag, lift, and torque are derived using a porous-medium formulation and validated by dedicated forward simulations employing both distributed Darcy-type source terms and a sensitivity-informed passive flow-control structure. Particular emphasis is placed on the combined sign distribution of the drag and lift sensitivities, yielding intuitive design maps that directly identify regions where local momentum extraction simultaneously improves or deteriorates both objectives.
