articles.title: Local thermal probe in a model molecular chain: A dissipaton-based approach
articles.title_zh: 模型分子链中的局域热探针：一种基于 dissipaton 的方法
articles.abstract: We study a system consisting of an infinite one-dimensional model molecular chain locally coupled to a probe. Starting from the Hamiltonian of the chain–probe composite and the corresponding spectral densities, we evaluate the heat current between the probe and the chain. Inspired by the perspective of quantum dissipative dynamics, we adopt a dissipaton-based quantum approach that is nonperturbative and non-Markovian. The dissipaton algebra yields a set of hierarchically coupled equations of motion for the c-number dissipaton moments, with iterative cross-tier connections when higher-order chain–probe interactions are included. Numerical results reveal the effects of temperature, probe frequency, on-site energy modification, and higher-order couplings on heat transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个无限一维模型分子链与局域探针耦合时的热输运问题，并计算了探针与链之间的热流。作者采用基于 dissipaton 的量子动力学方法，该方法具有非微扰和非马尔可夫特征，可处理较复杂的链—探针相互作用。数值结果分析了温度、探针频率、在位能修正以及高阶耦合对热输运的影响。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Electrowetting on thick substrates: A modified Young–Lippmann equation
articles.title_zh: 厚基底上的电润湿：修正的 Young–Lippmann 方程
articles.abstract: Electrowetting is a versatile technique for controlling the apparent contact angle of drops on thin insulating films through an externally applied potential. In the light of slide electrification—the spontaneous charging of sliding drops on dielectric substrates—electrowetting has gained new importance. Drops can spontaneously attain kilovolt potentials and undergo spontaneous electrowetting. Often, drop sizes and substrate thicknesses are comparable, violating the assumptions underlying the Young–Lippmann and the plate capacitor equations. In this work, I numerically determine the capacitance of sessile drops on thick substrates and introduce an analytical approximation. I derive a modified Young–Lippmann equation that quantitatively describes electrowetting ranging from thin films to substrate thicknesses many times the drop size.
articles.abstract_zh: 电润湿是一种通过外加电势调控液滴表观接触角的技术，通常适用于薄绝缘膜体系。本文关注滑动液滴自发带电及其在厚基底上的电润湿行为，此时液滴尺寸与基底厚度可相当，经典 Young–Lippmann 方程和板电容近似不再适用。作者通过数值计算给出厚基底上静滴电容，并提出解析近似，进而导出一个可定量描述从薄膜到远大于液滴尺寸基底的修正 Young–Lippmann 方程。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Quantum machine learning for predicting properties of van der Waals bilayers
articles.title_zh: 用于预测范德华双层性质的量子机器学习
articles.abstract: Layering two-dimensional (2D) materials into van der Waals bilayers provides an effective method to achieve innovative quantum states and tunable electronic properties. Exploring the extensive configurational space resulting from various layer combinations, twist angles, and stacking patterns presents a significant computing challenge. As the volume of accessible datasets expands, training machine learning models on conventional hardware may ultimately become excessively expensive, prompting the advancement of quantum machine learning (QML) methodologies for materials discovery. This study presents a quantum-enhanced machine learning framework for predicting the bandgaps of van der Waals bilayers utilizing quantum simulators. We start with conventional feature selection to ascertain the most important descriptors affecting electronic properties. The properties are subsequently encoded into quantum states utilizing parameterized quantum circuits. We evaluated three quantum feature maps, namely ZFeatureMap, ZZFeatureMap, and PauliFeatureMap, and observed task-dependent performance. For the classification task, ZFeatureMap with two repetitions gave the strongest quantum-classifier performance, whereas for Quantum Support Vector Regressor (QSVR) bandgap regression, PauliFeatureMap with one repetition achieved the lowest average root-mean-square error (RMSE). These results indicate that feature-map choice should be optimized separately for classification and regression rather than being interpreted as the universal superiority of a single feature map. Using these feature-map comparisons, we employ a QSVR and a variational quantum regressor to predict the bandgaps of 1850 semiconducting vdW bilayers, illustrating that QML may attain significant predictive accuracy despite limited training data. Overall, the results demonstrate the feasibility of a simulator-based QML workflow for materials-property prediction. The quantum classifiers are competitive with the classical support vector classifier (SVC) baseline for zero-gap/non-zero-gap classification, whereas the classical Support Vector Regression (SVR) achieves the lowest RMSE in the regression task. Therefore, the present study should be interpreted as an exploratory benchmark of hybrid classical–quantum models for van der Waals (vdW) bilayers rather than as evidence of a definitive quantum performance advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维材料层状堆叠形成的范德华双层为实现新颖量子态和可调电子性质提供了有效途径，但其组态空间极其庞大，计算探索成本很高。本文提出一种基于量子模拟器的量子增强机器学习框架，用于预测范德华双层的带隙，并先通过传统特征选择筛选影响电子性质的关键描述符。随后将这些特征编码进参数化量子电路，比较了 ZFeatureMap、ZZFeatureMap 和 PauliFeatureMap 等量子特征映射，结果表明不同任务对特征映射的敏感性不同；文摘后半部分缺失，具体性能结论需查阅原文。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Surrogate functionals for machine-learned orbital-free density functional theory
articles.title_zh: 用于机器学习的轨道自由密度泛函理论代理泛函
articles.abstract: We introduce surrogate functionals : machine-learned energy functionals for orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT) which are defined not by universal fidelity to a physical reference, but merely by the requirement that density optimization with a fixed procedure yields the true ground-state density. Helpfully, training surrogate functionals requires only ground-state densities as labels, no energies or gradients away from the ground state. We here propose a gradient-descent-improvement loss that guarantees exponential convergence of the density to the ground state, and combine it with an adaptive sampling scheme that concentrates learning around the optimization trajectories actually visited during inference. On the QM9 and QMugs benchmarks, surrogate functionals achieve density errors competitive with or improving upon the state of the art for fully supervised machine-learned OF-DFT, while eliminating the need for the O ( N 3 ) orthonormalization step required by prior work, yielding improved runtime scaling for larger systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出“代理泛函”这一类机器学习能量泛函，用于轨道自由密度泛函理论（OF-DFT）。与追求对物理参考体系的全局严格一致不同，代理泛函只要求在固定优化流程下能够收敛到真实基态密度，因此训练时只需基态密度标签，无需能量或远离基态的梯度信息。作者提出一种梯度下降改进损失函数，以保证密度向基态指数收敛，并结合自适应采样聚焦于推断阶段实际访问的优化轨迹；在 QM9 和 QMugs 基准上，该方法在密度误差上达到或优于现有全监督 OF-DFT 方法，同时避免了以往工作中的 O(N³⁾ 正交化步骤，提升了大体系下的运行效率。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Decoding vibrational energy transfer in CO–O 2 collisions: Vibrational state-to-state rate coefficient datasets on a new potential energy surface
articles.title_zh: 解析 CO–O2 碰撞中的振动能量转移：新势能面上的振动态到振动态速率系数数据集
articles.abstract: Energy exchanges in collisions between carbon monoxide (CO) and molecular oxygen (O 2 ) are investigated in this paper, and comprehensive datasets of state-to-state rate coefficients for vibration-to-vibration (V–V) and vibration-to-translation/rotation (V–T/R) energy transfer processes are obtained. The data are generated using a mixed quantum–classical (MQC) dynamical method on a newly developed potential energy surface, which is optimized against available experimental data and high-level ab initio calculations. The MQC dataset covers a broad temperature range from 100 to 5000 K, with additional extension through a Gaussian process regression technique to incorporate key V–T/R and near-resonant V–V processes, which include vibrational states of v CO up to 30, as well as the full vibrational ladder of O 2 up to its dissociation limit. The results reveal the dominance of V–V kinetics at lower temperatures and the increasing importance of V–T/R processes at higher temperatures. The present dataset addresses a critical gap in the kinetic modeling of CO + O 2 collisions in high-temperature gaseous environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一氧化碳（CO）与分子氧（O2）碰撞中的能量交换过程，系统给出了振动-振动（V–V）以及振动-平动/转动（V–T/R）能量转移的状态到状态速率系数数据。数据基于一个新构建的势能面，结合混合量子-经典动力学方法生成，并通过实验数据和高精度从头算结果进行了优化。作者还利用高斯过程回归扩展了关键的 V–T/R 以及近共振 V–V 过程，覆盖 CO 振动态至 v=30、O2 完整振动阶梯以及 100–5000 K 的温区，为高温气相环境中 CO + O2 碰撞的动力学建模提供了重要数据。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Machine learning of electronic structure and atomistic properties from the external potential
articles.title_zh: 基于外部势的电子结构与原子尺度性质机器学习
articles.abstract: Electronic structure calculations remain a major bottleneck in atomistic simulations and, not surprisingly, have attracted significant attention in machine learning (ML). Most existing approaches learn a direct map from molecular geometries, typically represented as graphs or encoded local environments, to molecular properties or use ML as a surrogate for electronic structure theory by targeting quantities, such as Fock or density matrices expressed in an atomic orbital (AO) basis. Inspired by the Hohenberg–Kohn theorem, in this work, we propose an operator-centric framework in which the external (nuclear) potential, expressed in an AO basis, serves as the model input. From this operator, we construct hierarchical, body-ordered representations of atomic configurations that closely mirror the principles underlying several popular atom-centered descriptors. At the same time, the matrix-valued nature of the external potential provides a natural connection to equivariant message-passing neural networks. In particular, we show that successive products of the external potential provide a scalable route to equivariant message passing and enable an efficient description of nonlocal effects. We demonstrate that this approach can be used to model molecular properties, such as energies and dipole moments, from the external potential or to learn effective operator-to-operator maps, including mappings to the Fock matrix from which multiple molecular observables can be simultaneously derived.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子结构计算仍是原子尺度模拟中的主要瓶颈，因此相关机器学习研究受到广泛关注。本文受 Hohenberg–Kohn 定理启发，提出一种以外部（核）势的原子轨道基表示作为模型输入的算符中心框架，并据此构造与原子中心描述符原则相近的分层、按体数排序表示。作者进一步指出，外部势的矩阵形式天然连接到等变消息传递神经网络，且外部势的连续乘积可作为实现可扩展等变消息传递的一条途径，从而有效描述非局域效应。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Auger spectra of thiouracils: Three molecules and four edges
articles.title_zh: 硫代尿嘧啶的俄歇谱：三种分子与四个边
articles.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive investigation of the Auger spectra of three thionated uracils using a combination of theory and experiment. Non-resonant Auger spectra measured at the K-edges of carbon, nitrogen, and oxygen, as well as at the L 2,3 edge of sulfur, are reported. Even though the final decay states (valence two-hole states) are the same for all edges, the resulting Auger spectra are strikingly different, highlighting the local nature of the Auger decay. Theoretical modeling, which employed a series of approaches incorporating varying levels of correlation and different treatments of the metastable states, provides a clear interpretation of the experimental spectra. The analysis highlights the crucial role of electron correlation, evident in both the density of the decay states and the spectra constructed using channel-specific partial decay widths, as well as the importance of spin–orbit coupling in shaping the L-edge spectra of thiouracils.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合理论与实验，对三种硫代尿嘧啶分子的俄歇谱进行了系统研究。作者测量了碳、氮、氧 K 边以及硫 L2,3 边的非共振俄歇谱，尽管不同边缘对应的终态都为价层双空穴态，但谱形却显著不同，凸显了俄歇衰变的局域性。理论部分采用了不同相关水平和亚稳态处理方法的多种模型，对实验谱进行了清晰解释，并强调了电子相关与自旋-轨道耦合在谱形形成中的关键作用。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

For three of these proposals, based on two kinds of absorbing boundary conditions and imaginary potentials, we compu… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033072] Published Fri Jul 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究量子粒子到达探测器时的探测时间分布问题，并比较了文献中若干不同的定义方案。作者基于两类吸收边界条件以及虚势方法，推导并计算了相应的时间分布。该工作有助于澄清量子到达时间问题中不同表述之间的关系。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Federated Learning for Decentralized Pharmaceutical Crystallization: Achieving Personalized Predictive Accuracy with Minimal Data
articles.title_zh: 面向去中心化制药结晶的物理信息联邦学习：以最少数据实现个性化预测精度
articles.abstract: In decentralized pharmaceutical manufacturing, developing robust predictive models for crystallization is often hindered by proprietary data silos and the inherent heterogeneity of site-specific process dynamics. Standard machine learning approaches struggle with data scarcity and frequently fail to respect the underlying physical laws, leading to catastrophic divergence in outlier scenarios. This study introduces a novel Physics-Informed Federated Learning (F-PINN) framework designed to enable collaborative model training across multiple manufacturing sites while strictly preserving data privacy. By embedding the Population Balance Equation (PBE) directly into the federated global loss function, the F-PINN framework acts as a "Physical Foundation Model" that remains robust against sensor bias and significant data gaps. We further propose a Personalized Adaptation phase that allows the global model to fine-tune to local growth kinetics (G) and residence times (τ). Results demonstrate that while standard federated averaging yields a generalized model, our personalized F-PINN approach achieves a 99.72% reduction in Mean Squared Error (MSE) compared to data-only models in high-heterogeneity sites. Specifically, the physics-informed priority prevents the model from diverging under noisy conditions, maintaining structural stability where standard neural networks fail. This research provides a scalable, privacy-preserving pathway for the implementation of Pharma 4.0 digital twins in multi-site industrial crystallization networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种物理信息联邦学习框架，用于解决去中心化制药制造中结晶过程建模面临的数据孤岛、隐私限制和工艺异质性问题。作者将群体平衡方程直接嵌入联邦全局损失函数，使模型在保留数据隐私的同时满足基本物理约束，并增强对传感器偏差和数据缺失的鲁棒性。进一步引入个性化适配阶段，使全局模型能够针对不同工厂的局部生长动力学和停留时间进行微调，从而提升预测精度。

articles.title: Giant Second‐Harmonic Generation Enhancement in Ferroelectric Crystal via Three‐Dimensional Strain Engineering

articles.title: Plasma agriculture makes strides toward super-seeding conventional methods
articles.title_zh: 等离子体农业在超越传统播种方法方面取得进展
articles.abstract: Occasionally, the sun unleashes powerful flares and coronal mass ejections, which hurl plasma and energetic particles into space. On the infant Earth, this solar activity drove cascades of atmospheric chemical reactions that may have helped form the building blocks of life. More recently, scientists have discovered that applying plasma to seeds in a controlled way can trigger similar activity, making them faster-growing and more resilient. Researchers at Nagoya University and Kyushu University in Japan have compiled a comprehensive review of this new field—termed "plasma agriculture"—as a potential sustainable solution to address global food shortages.
articles.abstract_zh: 太阳耀斑和日冕物质抛射会将等离子体与高能粒子抛入空间，并可能在早期地球大气中触发生命前体相关的化学反应。近期研究发现，在受控条件下将等离子体作用于种子，可促进类似反应，使作物生长更快并增强抗逆性。日本名古屋大学和九州大学研究人员综述了“等离子体农业”这一新兴领域，讨论其作为缓解全球粮食短缺的可持续技术路径的潜力。

articles.title: Does the North-South Asymmetry Anticipate High Solar Activity in the 2050's?
articles.title_zh: 南北不对称性能否预示21世纪50年代的高太阳活动？
articles.abstract: We have survived the maximum phase of Solar Cycle 25. It was a more active cycle than Solar Cycle 24, peaking at an averaged Sunspot Number (SN) of 157 vs. 116 for SC 24. Now is the time to find ways to improve our ability to predict solar activity one or more than one cycles ahead. One way to predict a dynamical system is through adiabatic invariants that vary slowly on the timescale of the oscillation period while tracking the evolution of the system at longer timescales. We will describe using the envelope of the North-South asymmetry in active region properties and hemispheric sunspot number as one such invariant of solar activity. A cumulative sum is used to generate a running integral of the asymmetry. The sum produces an envelope of solar activity that indicates large activity in the mid-2100's. The long time coverage of the sunspot number dataset, especially the catalog of active region sizes and positions, is essential to this study. The catalog contains metadata from the photographs recorded since 1874. The integrated North-South asymmetry of the hemispheric sunspot number is shown to be similar to that of the active regions.Extending the dataset to earlier dates with sunspot drawings gave a similar time of the zero crossing. Using the increasing number of sunspot drawings could extend the algorithm to earlier dates and encompass more of the possible longterm variations in the solar magnetic field. The cumulative sum may also provide a quantitative comparison of the various time series of sunspots.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注太阳活动的跨周期预测，提出利用活动区性质和半球太阳黑子数的南北不对称性包络作为一种缓慢变化的动力学指示量。作者通过累积和方法构建不对称性的运行积分，并将其用于追踪长期太阳活动演化。研究强调自1874年以来太阳黑子与活动区图像目录的长期覆盖对于该分析至关重要，并指出半球太阳黑子数与活动区的积分南北不对称性具有相似特征。

articles.title: Experimental Study and Wavelet Neural Network Prediction of Unconfined Compressive Strength of Acrylate Copolymer-Emulsion-Cured Saline Soil
articles.title_zh: 丙烯酸酯共聚乳液固化盐渍土无侧限抗压强度的试验研究与小波神经网络预测
articles.abstract: As coastal chloride-saline soil is prone to geological hazards such as salt expansion and frost heave settlement, traditional curing materials present problems of poor environmental compatibility and poor curing efficacy. In this study, an acrylic-ester copolymer emulsion (ZM) was developed independently as a curing agent for artificially prepared chloride-saline soil, and the influence of four factors—curing-agent dosage, curing age, salt content, and moisture content—on unconfined compressive strength (UCS) was investigated. The microscopic curing mechanism was revealed by combining infrared spectroscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analyses. It was found that the UCS of the cured soil showed a non-uniform distribution, and traditional models were difficult to use to accurately represent its strength characteristics. By modifying the excitation and output functions of the wavelet neural network with two different weights and optimising the dilation and translation parameters using the gradient descent method, an improved random wavelet network prediction model was established using the curing-agent dosage, curing age, salt content, and moisture content as input variables and UCS as the output variable. The experimental results show that the UCS increased markedly with increasing ZM dosage and curing age, whereas the strength of the uncured samples showed no obvious improvement. Increasing salt content reduced both the UCS and residual strength, and all samples exhibited strain-softening failure. The UCS showed a trend of first increasing and then decreasing with increasing moisture content, reaching a peak at the optimal moisture content (+ 0–5%). Microscopic analysis indicated that no new functional groups or minerals were generated by ZM curing; instead, ZM improved the soil structure by encapsulating soil particles and filling pores. Given the non-uniform distribution of the UCS, the improved wavelet neural network effectively compensated for the shortcomings of traditional models and achieved more accurate engineering prediction of the UCS.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对滨海氯盐渍土易发生盐胀、冻胀沉降且传统固化材料环境适应性和加固效果不足的问题，研究开发了丙烯酸酯共聚乳液固化剂，并考察固化剂掺量、龄期、含盐量和含水率对无侧限抗压强度的影响。作者结合红外光谱和扫描电镜分析揭示微观固化机制。鉴于固化土强度呈非均匀分布且传统模型难以准确表征，研究进一步构建了改进随机小波网络预测模型，以提高强度预测能力。

articles.title: Online Flatness Detection Method and Experimental Research of Aircraft Rudder Surface Based on Bidirectionally Coupled PSO-SA Hybrid Optimization Algorithm
articles.title_zh: 基于双向耦合PSO-SA混合优化算法的飞机舵面平面度在线检测方法与实验研究
articles.abstract: Online flatness detection of aircraft rudder surfaces serves as a pivotal core procedure for ensuring the manufacturing precision, aerodynamic performance and operational safety of aeronautical components. Traditional plane fitting-based detection approaches are constrained by low detection efficiency, susceptibility to local optimal solutions, weak anti-noise robustness and limited automation capability, which fail to satisfy the micron-level high-precision online detection requirements for curved composite rudder surfaces in batch manufacturing scenarios. To address the aforementioned technical bottlenecks, this study proposes a bidirectionally coupled PSO-SA hybrid optimization algorithm for non-convex minimum zone flatness evaluation of curved rudder surfaces, which overcomes the unidirectional open-loop iteration limitation inherent in conventional serial PSO-SA composite frameworks. Two targeted algorithmic improvements are elaborated in this work: a residual-adaptive nonlinear inertia weight strategy, which dynamically balances global exploration and local exploitation capabilities based on the fluctuation characteristics of free-form surface measurement residuals; and a measurement noise-modified Metropolis acceptance criterion, which substantially enhances the algorithm’s anti-interference performance against on-machine trigger sampling noise. Integrating with the trigger-type on-machine detection hardware of computer numerical control (CNC) machine tools, an integrated online detection system is established to realize the full-process functions of point cloud data acquisition, error compensation, intelligent plane fitting and flatness error evaluation. Meanwhile, the complete technical workflow involving measurement path planning, probe calibration and algorithm iterative solution is systematically illustrated. Comparative simulation experiments implemented on the MATLAB platform demonstrate that the proposed algorithm exhibits superior performance in convergence speed, fitting accuracy and optimization stability over five mainstream algorithms, including standard particle swarm optimization (PSO), standard simulated annealing (SA), comprehensive learning PSO (CLPSO), adaptive cooling SA and conventional serial PSO-SA. On-machine physical measurement experiments are conducted on 24 aircraft rudder workpieces covering aluminum alloy skins and assembled riveted components. After multi-dimensional systematic calibration, the overall detection error of the developed system is controlled within 1 µm. The experimental results indicate that the average flatness error calculated by the proposed bidirectionally coupled PSO-SA algorithm is 29.7 µm, which is 30.1% and 38.5% lower than that of standard PSO and standard SA, respectively, fully complying with the aviation flatness tolerance specification of 0.1–0.3 mm. Moreover, the full detection cycle for a single workpiece is only 2.1 min, achieving a 34.4% reduction in detection time compared with standard PSO and effectively improving the efficiency of online in-process inspection. One-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) combined with Tukey’s post-hoc test further verifies that the accuracy superiority of the proposed algorithm is statistically significant. This research provides a targeted theoretical basis and complete engineering implementation scheme for intelligent flatness detection of aerospace curved thin-walled parts, and offers a valuable technical reference for form and position error evaluation of irregular industrial components under noisy measurement conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向飞机复合材料舵面批量制造中的微米级高精度在线平面度检测需求，针对传统平面拟合方法效率低、易陷入局部最优、抗噪性弱和自动化不足等问题展开。作者提出一种双向耦合粒子群优化—模拟退火混合算法，用于曲面舵面非凸最小区域平面度评定。研究重点包括残差自适应非线性惯性权重等改进策略，以增强全局搜索与局部开发的动态平衡能力。

articles.title: Reliability-Guided Spectrum Generative Augmentation for Few-Shot Emitter Identification in Mobile Networks
articles.title_zh: 面向移动网络少样本辐射源识别的可靠性引导频谱生成增强方法
articles.abstract: With the evolution of next-generation mobile networks, the electromagnetic spectrum is becoming an interactive operating environment that simultaneously carries communication, sensing, and autonomous control functions. In integrated sensing and communication systems, low-altitude mobile networks, and self-organizing wireless infrastructures, reliable recognition of active radio emitters is essential for spectrum awareness and secure coordination. Specific emitter identification (SEI) supports this requirement by extracting hardware-dependent radio-frequency fingerprints from received signals. Nevertheless, dynamic spectrum operation usually provides only a few labeled observations for newly accessed or intermittently visible emitters, which makes conventional deep SEI models prone to unstable decision boundaries. This paper proposes a reliability-guided spectrum generative augmentation framework, named RSGA-SEI, for few-shot SEI in embodied spectrum intelligence. RSGA-SEI maps baseband observations into contour stella image samples, uses spectrum-aware generation to synthesize auxiliary spectrum samples, and adopts reliability-weighted classification to regulate the contribution of generated data. Different from prototype-geometry optimization, the classifier forms prototypes only from measured support samples and weights synthetic samples according to their feature consistency with the real support set. The resulting design connects spectrum perception, sample expansion, emitter recognition, and adaptive spectrum action in a compact closed-loop workflow. The 5-shot evaluation reaches an accuracy of 87.14% while keeping the online inference path compact.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着下一代移动网络发展，电磁频谱同时承载通信、感知和自主控制功能，对活跃无线电辐射源的可靠识别提出更高要求。该文提出RSGA-SEI框架，用于少样本条件下的特定辐射源识别，通过从接收信号中提取硬件相关射频指纹来支持频谱感知和安全协同。方法将基带观测映射为轮廓星座图样本，利用频谱感知生成模型合成辅助样本，并通过可靠性加权分类缓解少量标注数据导致的决策边界不稳定问题。

articles.title: Forecasting Lab Climates: A Machine Learning Decision Support System for Humidity-Sensitive Experiments
articles.title_zh: 实验室气候预测：面向湿度敏感实验的机器学习决策支持系统
articles.abstract: The reproducibility of electrospinning is strongly influenced by the ambient environment, as temperature and relative humidity affect solvent evaporation, jet stability, and fiber formation. In practice, these variables are often documented only retrospectively, which limits the ability of researchers to anticipate weather-driven shifts in laboratory conditions and in turn can hinder reproducibility. Here, we present a machine-learning-based decision-support framework for forecasting indoor laboratory relative humidity from local meteorological measurements and forecasts and internal climate measurements. To preserve room-specific influences such as orientation, ventilation context, and local thermal buffering, we trained and evaluated separate regression models for four laboratories within the same building rather than assuming a single shared indoor-outdoor transfer function. We then used site-specific weather forecasts to assess predictive performance and uncertainty across forecast horizons from 1 to 7 days. To examine user-related indoor variability without relying on direct occupancy sensing, we additionally analyzed working- and non-working-day patterns using a calendar-based occupancy proxy and Wasserstein-distance heatmaps. The resulting framework provides a seven-day indoor humidity forecast with lead-day-specific prediction intervals intended to support experiment planning under weather-responsive indoor conditions. Because the study was conducted in four laboratories within a single building, the trained models should be understood as site-specific rather than directly transferable to other laboratory environments. The broader contribution of this work therefore lies in the forecasting and decision-support workflow, which can be adapted to other settings using local data. At its current stage, the framework is intended to indicate likely indoor relative humidity shifts and their uncertainty; the experimental significance of those shifts remains to be interpreted by the researcher in the context of the specific polymer system and target fiber outcome.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对静电纺丝等湿度敏感实验的可重复性问题，提出一种利用机器学习预测实验室室内相对湿度的决策支持框架。模型结合本地气象观测与预报以及室内气候测量数据，并针对同一建筑内四个实验室分别训练回归模型，以保留朝向、通风和热缓冲等房间特异性影响。研究还评估了1至7天预报时段内的预测性能与不确定性，并通过工作日与非工作日模式分析间接考察人员活动带来的室内变化。

articles.title: 3D Gaussian Distribution and RGB Reconstruction (3DGS-RGB) based GNSS Multipath Detection — Part II: From Statistical-Space Ellipsoids to RGB Color Space Features
articles.title_zh: 基于三维高斯分布与RGB重构的GNSS多路径检测（二）：从统计空间椭球到RGB颜色空间特征
articles.abstract: Multipath effects remain a major challenge for robust Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning in urban environments. Part I of this work established an equiprobability-ellipsoid model for the normalized Q-branch early (E), prompt (P), and late (L) correlation vector and derived the corresponding Neyman–Pearson detection threshold [1]. This paper extends that statistical-domain framework by linearly mapping the same normalized correlation vector into the red (R), green (G), and blue (B) color space. The R/G/B chan nel axes provide another orthogonal coordinate basis, so that the same correlation-domain observation is re-expressed as a color point without introducing additional information. Based on this representation, the value (V), saturation (S), and hue (H) attributes are used to characterize the magnitude, contrast, and angular composition of the mapped correlation values. The threshold relationships between the statistical-domain detector and the color-domain features are then derived. The V- and S based bounds are shown to have explicit functional relationships with the detection threshold in Part I, whereas the H feature is treated as an angular distributional variable and converted into an illustrative probability-ratio statistic. Monte Carlo simulations verify the theoretical color-feature relationships under different LOS and multipath parameter settings. Multipath detection performance is further evaluated using controlled simulations, Spirent Sim3D urban replay data, and dynamic field-test data collected in a dense urban environment. The results show that the RGB representation preserves the statistical-domain interpreta tion while providing complementary color-domain features, espe cially through the hue distribution under short-delay multipath. This work establishes an interpretable bridge from statistical space ellipsoids to RGB color space features and provides a theoretical basis for future image- and learning-based multipath analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文延续第一部分中针对归一化Q支路早、即时、晚相关向量建立的等概率椭球模型和Neyman–Pearson检测阈值，将同一相关向量线性映射到RGB颜色空间。RGB通道作为另一组正交坐标基，将相关域观测重新表达为颜色点，而不引入额外信息。作者进一步利用明度、饱和度和色调特征描述映射值的幅度、对比度和角度组成，并推导统计域检测器与颜色域特征阈值之间的关系。
