We further store and retrieve time-energy-entangled telecom photons, violating an entanglement-witness bound by more than 11 standard deviations. Our results establish erbium-doped thin-film lithium niobate as a programmable light--matter interface for spectrally multiplexed quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 面向频谱复用的电信量子网络，量子存储器需要同时具备高效存储和可编程频率寻址能力。本文在同位素纯化的 ¹⁶⁷Er³⁺ 掺杂薄膜铌酸锂微环中展示了一种腔增强量子存储器，利用长寿命超精细搁置态实现持久且高对比度的原子频率梳制备，并通过腔阻抗匹配获得片上存储效率。该器件的本征电光响应支持最高 20 MHz 的频率选择性存储与路由。作者还实现了电信波段时间-能量纠缠光子的存取，并显著违反纠缠见证界限，表明该平台可作为频谱复用量子网络中的可编程光-物质接口。
authors: Chengdong Yang, Hanwen Guo, Yu-Yang An, Qian He, Chi Lu, Ziheng Jiang, Yan-Qing Lu, Shining Zhu, Xiao-Song Ma

articles.title: Automatic Differentiation from Scratch: How PyTorch Computes Gradients in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 从零理解自动微分：PyTorch 如何在物理信息神经网络中计算梯度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13042v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper traces, with explicit numerical values, how PyTorch's automatic differentiation (AD) engine computes gradients for Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) training -- a setting that requires two levels of differentiation: computing the physics derivative haty'(t)=dhaty/dt through the network, and computing parameter gradients nabla_θ L of a loss that itself depends on haty'(t). Using a 1-3-3-1 multilayer perceptron and the initial value problem y'(t)+y(t)=0, y(0)=1, we trace the complete pipeline at every node: the computational graph built during the forward pass, the reverse-mode backward traversal that computes all 22 parameter gradients in a single pass, and the graph-on-graph mechanism by which textttcreate_graph=True enables correct differentiation through the physics-informed residual. Every adjoint value is verified against the hand derivations of Tahimi (2026), connecting the P/Q sensitivity framework to the vector--Jacobian products used by PyTorch's autograd engine.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以显式数值追踪 PyTorch 自动微分引擎在物理信息神经网络训练中计算梯度的全过程。该场景需要两层微分：一是通过网络计算物理导数，二是对依赖该导数的损失函数计算参数梯度。作者以一个 1-3-3-1 多层感知机和初值问题 y'(t)+y(t)=0、y(0)=1 为例，逐节点展示前向传播构建计算图、反向模式一次遍历计算全部 22 个参数梯度，以及 create_graph=True 如何支持对物理残差继续求导。文中还将每个伴随量与手工推导进行验证，并把 P/Q 灵敏度框架与 PyTorch autograd 中的向量-雅可比积联系起来。

articles.title: What Your Model Threw Away and Why You'll Want It Back: Masking, Fingerprinting, and Privacy from Discarded Geometry
articles.title_zh: 模型丢弃了什么以及为何你会想找回它：来自被舍弃几何的信息掩蔽、指纹识别与隐私
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a framework for the information discarded by machine learning models whose inputs carry a Lie group action. Given a representation π of a Lie group G on a space V and a learned function fo̧lon V → R, we define two objects measuring the symmetry invisible to f. The null fiber at a point x in V is the set N_G(f,x) = g in G : f(π(g⁻¹) ḑot x) = f(x) of group elements whose inverse action on x is undetectable by f. When N_G(f,x) is independent of x, it coincides with the stabilizer Stab_G(f), the largest subgroup of G under which f is invariant. For smooth maps to R, the preimage theorem guarantees that null fibers have dimension at least dim G - 1 at generic inputs, regardless of architecture. For compact groups acting on themselves, the Peter--Weyl theorem yields a spectral characterization of both objects in terms of the Fourier coefficient matrices of f. We show that null fiber elements can be computed efficiently via Newton iteration on the orbit map, at a cost comparable to a few gradient evaluations. Applications to data masking, model fingerprinting, and privacy-preserving computation are developed and tested experimentally on molecular property prediction under SO(3) and spherical image classification under the Möbius group PSL(2, C). The framework applies uniformly to classical neural networks and variational quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个框架，用于分析输入带有李群作用的机器学习模型所丢弃的信息。给定李群表示和学习函数，作者定义了点处的零纤维以及函数的稳定子，用以刻画模型不可见的对称性；在适当条件下，零纤维可与最大不变子群相联系。文章利用原像定理给出一般维数下界，并在紧群作用于自身的情形下借助 Peter-Weyl 定理给出谱刻画。作者还提出可通过轨道映射上的牛顿迭代高效计算零纤维元素，并将该框架应用于数据掩蔽、模型指纹识别和隐私保护计算。

articles.title: PQFA: Parallel Quantum Feature Augmentation of Fused Representations for Multimodal Classification
articles.title_zh: PQFA：用于多模态分类的融合表示并行量子特征增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most multimodal learning methods improve how heterogeneous representations are aligned and fused, while post-fusion enhancement remains less explored. We propose Parallel Quantum Feature Augmentation (PQFA), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that applies multiple shallow variational quantum circuits to fused multimodal features. Text and image representations extracted by frozen RoBERTa and ViT encoders are processed through bidirectional cross-attention, attentive pooling, and adaptive gated fusion. The fused feature is then amplitude-encoded into parallel quantum circuits, whose measurement readouts are concatenated with the classical representation for prediction. We evaluate PQFA on MM-IMDb and N24News through controlled comparisons using the same encoders, fusion backbone, data splits, projection dimension, and augmentation output width. PQFA consistently outperforms both the fusion backbone without quantum augmentation and a width-matched MLP augmentation baseline, while using approximately 2.2K augmentation parameters compared with 24.0K for the MLP branch. Missing-modality experiments further show improved robustness when textual or visual inputs are incomplete, with particularly clear gains when the more informative textual modality is severely degraded. Controlled ablations and feature-space analyses indicate that the improvement cannot be reproduced by random feature mappings, increased classical width, or untrained quantum transformations. Quantum-state diagnostics additionally show stable predictive performance across the tested simulated noise levels and distinct branch-specific transformations of the encoded states. These results establish PQFA as an effective and parameter-efficient strategy for post-fusion augmentation in hybrid quantum-classical multimodal learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 多数多模态学习方法主要关注异构表示的对齐与融合，而融合后的特征增强相对不足。本文提出并行量子特征增强 PQFA，这是一种混合量子-经典框架，将多个浅层变分量子线路应用于融合后的多模态特征。文本和图像特征由冻结的 RoBERTa 与 ViT 提取，经双向交叉注意力、注意力池化和自适应门控融合后进行振幅编码，并将量子测量读出与经典表示拼接用于预测。实验在 MM-IMDb 和 N24News 上表明，在受控比较条件下，PQFA 持续优于无量子增强的融合骨干和参数宽度匹配的 MLP 增强基线，并在缺失模态情况下表现出更好鲁棒性。

articles.title: Implementations of Quantum and Classical Topology-Aligned Architectures for Molecular Property Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于分子性质预测的量子与经典拓扑对齐架构实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For low-data and resource-constrained regimes typical of quantum chemistry, parameter-efficient learning is a key objective. Here, we propose a topology-aligned inductive bias in which the model architecture mirrors the molecular bond graph: atoms map to a fixed register of computational units, and bonds determine which pairs interact through shared learnable parameters. This principle is instantiated in two architectures: a variational quantum circuit (Iso-QGNN), and a parameter-matched classical message-passing model (Iso-CGNN). The models are benchmarked on HOMO-LUMO and dipole moment binary classification tasks over the QM9 benchmark. With 64 trainable parameters, the implementations achieve test AUCs of approximately 0.88 (quantum) and 0.91 (classical) on the gap task, and close to 0.78 (both) on the dipole task. The models reach 90% of asymptotic performance within about 250 training molecules and gradient norms remain stable throughout training. These results indicate that the topology-aligned inductive bias is the active ingredient driving parameter efficiency at QM9 scale, with implications for matched-baseline benchmarking in quantum machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子化学中常见的低数据和资源受限场景下，参数高效学习十分关键。本文提出一种拓扑对齐的归纳偏置，使模型架构镜像分子键图：原子映射到固定计算单元寄存器，化学键决定哪些单元通过共享可学习参数相互作用。作者分别实现了变分量子线路 Iso-QGNN 和参数匹配的经典消息传递模型 Iso-CGNN，并在 QM9 数据集的 HOMO-LUMO 能隙与偶极矩二分类任务上进行评测。结果显示，两类模型在仅 64 个可训练参数下取得较高测试 AUC，并能在约 250 个训练分子内达到渐近性能的 90%，说明拓扑对齐归纳偏置是参数效率的主要来源。
authors: James T. Pegg, Hubert Okadome Valencia, Ronin Wu

articles.title: Mono-Z Dark Matter Search with Neural Spline Flows Using CMS Run 2015D Open Data
articles.title_zh: 使用神经样条流和 CMS 2015D 运行开放数据开展单 Z 暗物质搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a search for dark matter (DM) produced in association with a leptonically decaying (Z) boson at (sqrts=13) TeV using CMS Run 2015D open data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of (2.32,fb⁻¹) together with simplified-model Monte Carlo simulation. Events are selected in the mono-(Zi̊ghtarrowell⁺ell⁻) final state in both the (μμ) and (ee) channels. Forty kinematic observables are extracted from MINIAOD and MINIAODSIM, cleaned with physics-motivated selections, and reduced to a 37-dimensional feature vector. Five Neural Spline Flows are trained independently to model Standard Model background and mediator-specific DM signal densities. The per-event test statistic is constructed from the log-likelihood ratio between the signal and background density estimates, providing sensitivity across the full kinematic phase space without requiring a hard upper (MET) threshold. A simultaneous profile-likelihood fit combining the two channels yields observed (expected) 95% confidence level upper limits on the signal-strength parameter of (μ<0.0177) ((0.0018)) for the scalar mediator, (μ<0.0362) ((0.0039)) for the vector mediator, and (μ<0.0498) ((0.0069)) for the axial-vector mediator. The observed limits are weaker than expected because of a residual high-(MET) background-modeling discrepancy rather than evidence for a DM signal. To our knowledge, this is the first application of Neural Spline Flow likelihood-ratio scoring to a mono-(Z) dark matter search using CMS Run 2015D open data simultaneously in the (μμ) and (ee) channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 CMS Run 2015D 开放数据和简化模型蒙特卡罗模拟，在质心能量 13 TeV 下搜索与轻子衰变 Z 玻色子伴随产生的暗物质信号。作者在 μμ 和 ee 两个道道中提取并筛选多维运动学特征，训练神经样条流来分别建模标准模型背景和不同媒介子的暗物质信号密度。基于信号与背景密度估计的对数似然比构造逐事件检验统计量，并通过联合剖面似然拟合给出不同媒介子模型的信号强度上限。
authors: Hitesh Rasineni (VIT-AP University, Amaravati, India), Bhavishya Chebrolu (Mohan Babu University, Tirupati, India)

articles.title: RF Spectrogram Anomaly Detection with Quantum Kitchen Sinks: Architecture, Representation, and Hardware Validation
articles.title_zh: 基于量子厨房水槽的射频谱图异常检测：架构、表征与硬件验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13897v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The broadcast nature of wireless channels exposes radio-frequency (RF) networks to anomalous and malicious transmissions, making anomaly detection a fundamental requirement for secure spectrum management. Quantum Kitchen Sinks (QKS) offer a lightweight hybrid quantum feature map suitable for near-term quantum devices, yet their behavior on structured signal data remains poorly understood. In this paper, we extend the standard QKS template with multi-depth data re-uploading and ring entanglement, and evaluate the resulting pipeline on controlled RF spectrogram anomaly detection. We introduce a validation-locked five-stage ablation protocol that systematically separates the effects of shallow architecture, re-uploading depth, episode budget, input representation, and classical readout. Across the completed benchmark, Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) representations consistently dominate raw and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) inputs, moderate-depth entangled QKS configurations form the strongest operating regime, and QKS improves over matched classical direct-readout baselines across all evaluated representation-readout pairs on the held-out test set, with the best configuration reaching a test Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.8778 and a test F1 of 0.7995. The study bridges two levels of realism: real measured sub-6,GHz cellular signals on the data side and real-device validation on the ibm_quebec Quantum Processing Unit (QPU) on the computing side, with AUROC deviations below 0.013 relative to simulation. These results provide a practical, reproducible framework for deploying QKS-based anomaly detection in wireless networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究无线射频网络中的异常和恶意传输检测，扩展了量子厨房水槽方法，引入多深度数据重上传和环形纠缠结构。作者提出五阶段消融验证流程，以区分浅层架构、重上传深度、训练预算、输入表征和经典读出等因素的影响。实验表明，离散余弦变换表征优于原始输入和 PCA 输入，中等深度的纠缠 QKS 配置表现较强，并在多个表征—读出组合上优于匹配的经典直接读出基线。
authors: Abdallah Aaraba, Alexis Vieloszynski, Remon Polus, Ola Ahmad, Soumaya Cherkaoui

articles.title: Lyapunov Exponent as Physics-Informed Dense Reward: RL Discovery of Stabilization Beyond the Kapitza Pendulum
articles.title_zh: 作为物理信息密集奖励的李雅普诺夫指数：强化学习发现超越卡皮察摆的稳定化策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We suggest using the Lyapunov characteristic exponent (LCE) as a dense reward signal for the reinforcement learning problem of stabilizing the inverted pendulum with vertical motion. With LCE, the agent not only successfully found the oscillatory motion known as the Kapitza pendulum but also damped the pendulum's pivoting, leaving it in a strictly upright position.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出将李雅普诺夫特征指数作为强化学习中的密集奖励信号，用于解决具有竖直驱动的倒立摆稳定问题。借助该奖励，智能体不仅能够发现卡皮察摆中已知的振荡稳定机制，还能进一步抑制支点运动，使摆保持严格直立。该研究展示了物理信息奖励在非线性动力系统控制策略发现中的潜力。

articles.title: Leveraging unlabelled data for generalizable neural population decoding
articles.title_zh: 利用未标注数据实现更具泛化性的神经群体解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Robust and accurate neural decoders are integral to neurotechnologies such as brain-computer interfaces and closed-loop experiments. Recent work has shown that tokenizing neural data at the spike level facilitates multi-session pretraining and delivers state-of-the-art decoding performance. However, current spike-based models are restricted to supervised learning (SL), limiting training to datasets with paired behavioural labels. To address this limitation, we introduce MOJO (Masked autOencoder-based JOint training), a training framework for spike-tokenizing models that jointly leverages self-supervised learning (SSL) via masked autoencoding and SL objectives. We evaluate MOJO on three spiking datasets spanning monkey motor cortex during reaching tasks and multi-regional mouse recordings during vision and decision making tasks, demonstrating superior performance over purely SL-trained models. This improvement is especially pronounced when training with limited labelled data, particularly in few-shot finetuning, where only a small amount of labelled data from a new session is available. Incorporating SSL also yields more interpretable neuronal representations, improving performance on brain region classification and spike-statistics prediction without explicit optimization for these tasks. We further show that MOJO generalizes beyond spiking data to human electrocorticography during speech, where it continues to outperform purely SL-trained models and achieves performance comparable to neuro-foundation models (NFMs) designed specifically for continuous signals. Overall, augmenting spike-tokenizing models with SSL improves performance in label-impoverished settings and enables the use of unlabelled data across various tasks and species, while generalizing to other neural modalities. These results suggest a path towards more flexible and scalable data usage when training NFMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文面向脑机接口和闭环实验中的神经解码问题，提出 MOJO 框架，将基于掩码自编码的自监督学习与监督学习目标联合用于脉冲标记化模型训练。作者在猴运动皮层到达任务和小鼠视觉、决策任务的多种脉冲数据集上验证了该方法。结果显示，MOJO 相比纯监督训练模型具有更好的解码性能，尤其在标注数据有限和新会话少样本微调场景中提升更为明显，同时还带来更具可解释性的表示。
authors: Ximeng Mao, Nanda H. Krishna, Avery Hee-Woon Ryoo, Matthew G. Perich, Guillaume Lajoie

articles.title: GFlowRL: Scaling Distribution-Matching RL to Large Language Models
articles.title_zh: GFlowRL：将分布匹配强化学习扩展到大语言模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13394v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) offer a promising alternative to reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) for large reasoning models, encouraging diverse reasoning paths by matching reward distributions rather than collapsing to dominant modes. Recent work shows promise on math and code, but scaling GFlowNet-style RL to modern post-training pipelines remains difficult: as model size, rollout horizon, reward noise, and distributed-systems complexity grow together, a learned prompt-conditional partition function becomes a source of gradient instability and engineering overhead rather than a useful normalizer. Through systematic analysis, we find that the learned partition function, previously treated as essential, can be replaced by an in-batch Monte Carlo estimate computed from the rollout group already required for training. We propose GFlowRL, a streamlined GFlowNet-style RL algorithm that removes the auxiliary partition network entirely while preserving the reward-distribution-matching objective, completed by two stabilizers: importance-sampling correction for rollout/trainer drift and asymmetric flow-gap clipping for outlier residuals. GFlowRL exceeds all counterparts on math, code, and adversarial red-teaming benchmarks, reaching a Codeforces rating of 2048 at the 14B scale (within 25 Elo of o3-mini) and attaining the highest average ASR@1 on AdvBench and HarmBench, outperforming the previous SOTA multi-turn attacker in a regime where FlowRL, a prior GFlowNet-style method, diverges. The same recipe transfers to all evaluated MoE configurations up to 235B parameters, where FlowRL again fails to converge. To our knowledge, GFlowRL is the first GFlowNet-style RL algorithm to scale stably across both dense and sparse architectures. Code will be at: https://github.com/microsoft/gflowrl
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对大推理模型训练中 GFlowNet 式强化学习难以扩展的问题，指出传统学习式提示条件分区函数在大模型、长轨迹和有噪声奖励下可能导致梯度不稳定和工程负担。作者提出 GFlowRL，用训练所需 rollout 组中的批内蒙特卡罗估计替代辅助分区网络，同时保留奖励分布匹配目标。该方法还引入用于校正 rollout 与训练器漂移的重要性采样以及非对称 flow-gap 裁剪等稳定化机制，以支持更大规模语言模型后训练。
authors: Xiaodong Liu, Michael Xu, Jack W. Stokes, Paul Smolensky, Doug Burger, Jianfeng Gao

articles.title: Deformable State Estimation for Autonomous Surgical Tissue Retraction Under Partial Observability
articles.title_zh: 部分可观测条件下自主手术组织牵拉的可变形状态估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13475v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Surgical tissue retraction requires effective manipulation planning under partial and noisy perception. We study state estimation for deformable tissue retraction, where only sparse observations of the tissue surface are available at decision time. We propose a learned state estimator that reconstructs the full deformable mesh state from 40 noisy vertex observations. The estimator combines a multilayer perceptron with a low-dimensional PCA latent representation and is trained using geometry-aware regularization that encourages smooth and physically plausible deformations. We evaluate the approach in a 2D deformable sheet simulation using single-step and multi-step retraction planning. Results show that the learned estimator achieves 98.1% of oracle performance in multi-step retraction while supporting efficient inference. These results demonstrate that learned, geometry-regularized state estimation can support effective deformable manipulation under realistic perception constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究在稀疏且有噪声感知条件下进行手术组织牵拉规划所需的可变形状态估计。作者提出一种学习型状态估计器，从 40 个带噪顶点观测重构完整可变形网格状态，并结合多层感知机、低维 PCA 潜表示和几何感知正则化，以促进平滑且物理合理的形变。二维可变形薄片仿真结果显示，该估计器在多步牵拉中达到 oracle 性能的 98.1%，同时保持高效推理。
authors: Everest Yang, Skye Thompson, George D. Konidaris

articles.title: Topology-Agnostic Mesh Reconstruction of Deformable Objects from Sparse Touch
articles.title_zh: 基于稀疏触觉的可变形物体拓扑无关网格重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13479v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Estimating the full shape of a deformable object is especially challenging when vision is unavailable: in the dark, inside an opaque bag, behind the manipulating hand, or under heavy self-occlusion. Touch is the natural sensor in these settings, but touches are sparse and local. We present a single topology-agnostic estimator that reconstructs the full mesh of a deformable object from only a few touches and no vision, using one permutation-invariant cross-attention architecture that handles a 1D rope, a 2D cloth, and a 3D volumetric soft body. The learned estimator reduces reconstruction error by roughly two-thirds relative to non-learned geometric mesh completion and a Gaussian-process surface baseline, and it outperforms a simpler global-pool set encoder, with the gap growing as more touches are observed. We then show that the estimator's deep-ensemble uncertainty can be used to learn where to touch next, which lowers error further and beats both random touching and a Gaussian-process active baseline at sparse budgets. This gain is modest on average but grows with self-occlusion and on the error tail. When vision is also available, where to touch barely matters, motivating the vision-free setting we study.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注在无视觉条件下，仅依靠少量局部触觉观测重建可变形物体完整形状的问题。作者提出一种拓扑无关的置换不变交叉注意力估计器，可统一处理一维绳索、二维布料和三维体积软体。实验表明，该学习型方法相较非学习几何补全和高斯过程表面基线显著降低重建误差，并且其深度集成不确定性还可用于主动选择下一次触摸位置，在稀疏观测、自遮挡和高误差尾部场景中进一步改善性能。

articles.title: Spectral-Informed Neural Networks Outperform Spectral Methods in High-dimensional PDEs
articles.title_zh: 谱信息神经网络在高维偏微分方程中优于谱方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13566v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For low-dimensional problems (dłeq3), spectral methods can achieve exceptionally high accuracy. For middle-dimensional problems (4 łeq d łesssim 10), spectral methods remain feasible through specific techniques such as sparse grids or hyperbolic cross. However, for high-dimensional problems (dgg 10), spectral methods suffer frome the curse of dimensionality. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising approach to overcome this challenge, offering scalability to high dimensions, but often suffer from limited accuracy and efficiency. Recently proposed spectral-informed neural networks (SINNs) combine spectral methods with PINNs, operating directly in the spectral domain to avoid spatial derivative computations and to reduce memory consumption. In this work, we introduce Modified SINNs, which integrate coefficient decay scaling and basis embeddings motivated by harmonic analysis to enhance accuracy in high-dimensional problems and enable accurate approximation of unknown spectral coefficients. Numerical experiments on steady and time-dependent partial differential equations demonstrate that Modified SINNs outperform sparse grid spectral methods on middle-dimensional problems with incomplete spectral information and achieve superior accuracy compared to PINNs on high-dimensional problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对传统谱方法在高维偏微分方程中遭遇维数灾难、而物理信息神经网络精度和效率有限的问题，研究谱信息神经网络的改进形式。作者提出 Modified SINNs，引入由调和分析启发的系数衰减缩放和基嵌入，以提升高维问题中的谱系数逼近能力。稳态和含时偏微分方程数值实验表明，该方法在高维场景中相较传统谱方法和原有相关神经网络方法具有更好的表现。

articles.title: Towards quantum machine learning for assessing the resilience of post-quantum cryptography
articles.title_zh: 面向评估后量子密码韧性的量子机器学习方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13722v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The potential capabilities of quantum computers motivated the development of cryptographic protocols suitable for securing communication against adversaries with access to large fault-tolerant quantum computers. However, even though current quantum computers are limited in terms of size and precision, they can still be useful for finding loopholes and weaknesses in the post-quantum cryptographic protocols. In this work, we present an attempt to utilize the capabilities of Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks (QGANs), one of the promising architectures used in quantum machine learning, for this purpose. We describe an example application of QGAN architecture for the purpose of loading the probability distribution of the hash-based digital signatures into the memory of a quantum computer. Our results confirm that near-term hybrid quantum-classical methods possess capabilities required for this purpose. The presented approach can be used as a first step in the workflow, enabling the utilization of quantum computing for attacking post-quantum cryptographic primitives.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作探讨近中期量子计算机和量子机器学习在发现后量子密码协议漏洞方面的潜在用途。作者以量子生成对抗网络为例，展示如何将基于哈希的数字签名相关概率分布加载到量子计算机内存中。结果表明，混合量子—经典方法具备执行此类任务的能力，可作为利用量子计算评估或攻击后量子密码原语的工作流程初步环节。

articles.title: Quantum Topological Data Encoding
articles.title_zh: 量子拓扑数据编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13847v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many datasets encountered across a wide range of domains possess rich geometric and topological structure that is difficult to capture using conventional vector-based representations. Quantum machine learning offers the possibility of processing high-dimensional data in Hilbert spaces, but its practical success depends critically on how classical data is encoded into quantum states. We introduce emphquantum topological data encoding (QTDE), a general framework for encoding topological information into quantum states via topology-driven quantum evolution. Our method generalises an existing topology-driven quantum encoding framework to higher-dimensional data. We test the proposed method on clique-complexes classification tasks, and provide preliminary evidence that topology-driven quantum representations can capture discriminative information beyond that available through direct comparisons of classical topological descriptors. The proposed quantum representations consistently outperform a baseline based on direct comparisons of the combinatorial Laplacians describing the underlying topological structure. We indicate several areas of application where the framework can be used to provide a more efficient and reliable data representation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出量子拓扑数据编码框架，通过由拓扑结构驱动的量子演化将拓扑信息编码为量子态，以改进经典数据到量子态的表示方式。该方法将已有拓扑驱动量子编码扩展到更高维数据，并在团复形分类任务上进行测试。初步结果显示，拓扑驱动的量子表示能够捕获超出直接比较经典拓扑描述子的信息，并优于基于组合拉普拉斯算子直接比较的基线。
authors: Adam Wesołowski, Dimitrios Thanos, Daniel Leykam, Lirandë Pira

articles.title: EM-GANSim: Real-time and Accurate EM Simulation Using Conditional GANs for 3D Indoor Scenes
articles.title_zh: EM-GANSim：面向三维室内场景的实时高精度条件 GAN 电磁仿真
articles.abstract: arXiv:2405.17366v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a novel machine-learning (ML) approach (EM-GANSim) for real-time electromagnetic (EM) propagation that is used for wireless communication simulation in 3D indoor environments. Our approach uses a modified conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) that incorporates encoded geometry and transmitter location while adhering to the electromagnetic propagation theory. The overall physically-inspired learning is able to predict the power distribution in 3D scenes, which is represented using heatmaps. We evaluated our method on 15 complex 3D indoor environments, with 4 additional scenarios later included in the results, showcasing the generalizability of the model across diverse conditions. Our overall accuracy is comparable to ray tracing-based EM simulation, as evidenced by lower mean squared error values. Furthermore, our GAN-based method drastically reduces the computation time, achieving a 5X speedup on complex benchmarks. In practice, it can compute the signal strength in a few milliseconds on any location in 3D indoor environments. We also present a large dataset of 3D models and EM ray tracing-simulated heatmaps. To the best of our knowledge, EM-GANSim is the first real-time algorithm for EM simulation in complex 3D indoor environments. We plan to release the code and the dataset.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 EM-GANSim，一种用于三维室内无线通信仿真的实时电磁传播机器学习方法。该方法采用改进的条件生成对抗网络，将场景几何和发射器位置编码并结合电磁传播理论，以热图形式预测三维场景中的功率分布。实验覆盖多个复杂室内环境，结果显示其精度可与基于射线追踪的电磁仿真相当，同时在复杂基准上显著缩短计算时间，并可在毫秒级估计任意位置的信号强度。

articles.title: Computation-aware Energy-harvesting Federated Learning with Pipelined Cyclic Scheduling
articles.title_zh: 采用流水线循环调度的计算感知能量采集联邦学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.11949v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a powerful paradigm for distributed learning, but increasing model complexity leads to significant energy consumption from client-side computations for local training. This challenge is critical in energy-harvesting FL (EHFL) systems, where the participation availability of each device fluctuates because of limited energy. To address this, we propose PipeCycle, a battery-aware distributed learning framework that organizes clients into pipelined cyclic groups. When a group completes its intra-group aggregation, its aggregated model is relayed directly to a newly formed group as a reference for local training, allowing multiple groups to coexist in the pipeline while overlapping client recharging periods with active training in other pipeline stages. We provide a convergence analysis of PipeCycle under a realistic energy consumption model in which local training spans multiple time slots, and show that the cyclic structure of the pipeline imposes a finite-horizon staleness bound that avoids the exponential factors typical of asynchronous FL analyses. Numerical experiments across both IID and non-IID data and various battery charging probabilities show that PipeCycle reaches a target accuracy with substantially lower cumulative energy than existing FL baselines, particularly under severe label skew where competing cyclic schemes collapse to near-chance accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究能量采集联邦学习中客户端本地训练能耗高、设备参与受电量波动限制的问题。作者提出 PipeCycle，一种电池感知的分布式学习框架，将客户端组织为流水线式循环组，并在组内聚合完成后将聚合模型直接传递给新组作为本地训练参考，从而使训练与其他设备充电阶段重叠进行。论文在考虑多时隙本地训练的现实能耗模型下给出收敛分析，并指出循环流水线结构可提供有限时延界，数值实验覆盖 IID 和非 IID 数据设置。

articles.title: Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion for Solving Parameterized PDEs
articles.title_zh: 用于求解参数化偏微分方程的解耦潜在动力学流形融合方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12676v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generalizing neural surrogate models across different PDE parameters remains difficult because changes in PDE coefficients often make learning harder and optimization less stable. The problem becomes even more severe when the model must also predict beyond the training time range. Existing methods usually cannot handle parameter generalization and temporal extrapolation at the same time. Standard parameterized models treat time as just another input and therefore fail to capture intrinsic dynamics, while recent continuous-time latent methods often rely on expensive test-time auto-decoding for each instance, which is inefficient and can disrupt continuity across the parameterized solution space. To address this, we propose Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion (DLDMF), a physics-informed framework that explicitly separates space, time, and parameters. Instead of unstable auto-decoding, DLDMF maps PDE parameters directly to a continuous latent embedding through a feed-forward network. This embedding initializes and conditions a latent state whose evolution is governed by a parameter-conditioned Neural ODE. We further introduce a dynamic manifold fusion mechanism that uses a shared decoder to combine spatial coordinates, parameter embeddings, and time-evolving latent states to reconstruct the corresponding spatiotemporal solution. By modeling prediction as latent dynamic evolution rather than static coordinate fitting, DLDMF reduces interference between parameter variation and temporal evolution while preserving a smooth and coherent solution manifold. As a result, it performs well on unseen parameter settings and in long-term temporal extrapolation. Experiments on several benchmark problems show that DLDMF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy, parameter generalization, and extrapolation robustness.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对神经代理模型在不同偏微分方程参数之间泛化困难、且难以进行时间外推的问题，提出了物理信息框架 DLDMF。该方法显式解耦空间、时间与参数，通过前馈网络将 PDE 参数映射到连续潜在嵌入，并用参数条件化的 Neural ODE 描述潜在状态演化，以避免测试时低效且不稳定的自动解码。整体目标是在参数泛化与长期时间预测之间取得更稳健的统一建模能力。

articles.title: New universal operator approximation theorem for encoder-decoder architectures
articles.title_zh: 面向编码器—解码器架构的新型通用算子逼近定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.24092v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Motivated by the rapidly growing field of mathematics for operator approximation with neural networks, we present a novel universal operator approximation theorem for broad classes of encoder-decoder architectures and a wide range of input and output spaces. In this study, we focus on the approximation of continuous operators between infinite-dimensional normed or metric spaces in the topology of uniform convergence on compact sets. Unlike standard results in the operator learning literature, we additionally investigate the case where the approximating sequence of encoder-decoder architectures can be chosen independently of the compact sets. Taking a topological perspective, we point out that compact-set-independent approximation is a strictly stronger property in most relevant operator learning frameworks. To establish our results, we introduce new approximation properties of input and output spaces tailored to encoder-decoder architectures. These properties enable us to prove a universal operator approximation theorem ensuring uniform convergence on every compact subset of the input space. Our results unify and extend existing universal operator approximation theorems for various encoder-decoder architectures, including classical DeepONets, BasisONets, MIONets, architectures based on frames and other related approaches. A notable feature of our framework is that it also applies to metric spaces beyond the normed setting. In particular, it allows the consideration of p-Wasserstein spaces of probability measures as input or output spaces, and Skorohod spaces of càdlàg functions as input spaces. This generality also opens up potential applications in optimal transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出了适用于广泛编码器—解码器神经网络架构的通用算子逼近定理，研究无限维赋范空间或度量空间之间连续算子的逼近问题。与常见算子学习结果不同，作者重点考察逼近序列是否可独立于具体紧集选择，并指出这种紧集无关逼近在多数算子学习框架中是更强的性质。论文从拓扑视角引入输入、输出空间的新逼近性质，从而统一并扩展了已有理论。

articles.title: Self-Improving AI Coding Agents Through Accumulated Behavioral Rules: A Closed-Loop Framework
articles.title_zh: 通过累积行为规则实现自我改进的 AI 编程智能体：一种闭环框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13091v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM-based coding agents repeat the same classes of mistakes across sessions because they lack a mechanism to retain corrections from human review feedback. We present a closed-loop framework in which every accepted review comment is codified as a persistent behavioral rule, progressively expanding the set of error classes the agent can self-detect. The framework combines an accumulating rule set in a version-controlled instruction file, a self-review checklist executed before code submission, and automated validation that ensures rule set integrity as it grows. In deployment across a 35+ service microservices platform, the rule set grew from 5 to 18 behavioral rules, 15+ language-specific standards, and a 15-item self-review checklist, all derived from real review feedback. We present empirical results from 11 recorded working sessions spanning code generation, PR review, incident investigation, and cross service refactoring. We observe that accumulated rules shift review effort from low-level correctness toward design-level validation, achieve a measured 0% recurrence rate for ruled-against error classes, and transfer across heterogeneous agent interfaces. We compare our approach against related work in experiential LLM learning (Reflexion, ExpeL, Voyager) and automated code review (CodeReviewer, SWE-bench agents), showing that our framework achieves persistent cross-session learning without weight updates, operates on production codebases rather than synthetic benchmarks, and addresses an orthogonal dimension (behavioral consistency over time) that existing benchmarks do not measure. The result is a coding agent that improves with every review cycle, accumulating the engineering wisdom of its human collaborators without changing a single model weight.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种闭环机制，将人工代码评审中被接受的反馈转化为持久化行为规则，使基于大语言模型的编程智能体能够在后续会话中避免重复错误。框架包括版本控制的规则文件、提交前自审清单以及保证规则集完整性的自动化验证。作者在一个包含 35 个以上服务的微服务平台中部署并记录 11 次工作会话，观察到规则积累可将评审重点从低层错误转向设计验证，并减少已被规则覆盖错误类型的复发。

articles.title: Active Beyond-Diagonal RIS Empowered Heterogeneous Edge Computing: A Distributional Reinforcement Learning Approach
articles.title_zh: 主动超对角可重构智能表面赋能的异构边缘计算：一种分布式强化学习方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Active beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RISs) enables hybrid transmitting and reflecting mode to achieve effective signal amplification and full-space coverage, thus providing a promising solution for blockage-aware uplink offloading in heterogeneous mobile edge computing (MEC) systems. However, practical hybrid mode active BD-RIS are realized by reciprocal devices, which inherently generate cross-sector energy leakage that will reshape the system-level energy-latency tradeoff. This paper studies energy-aware offloading and resource allocation for reciprocal active BD-RIS-assisted heterogeneous MEC, where offloading decisions, CPU/GPU computation allocation, transmit powers, receive processing, and active BD-RIS are tightly coupled. The resulting problem is a high-dimensional mixed integer nonconvex problem and is difficult to solve efficiently by conventional per-instance optimization. To address this challenge, we develop an end-to-end joint optimization framework based on a refined version of the distributional soft actor--critic algorithm, named as DSAC-T. By modeling return distributions rather than only expected values, DSAC-T improves policy stability under reward heterogeneity and feasibility-boundary sensitivity. Compared with other baseline algorithms, DSAC-T achieves the best energy-latency reward, the highest feasibility ratio of 81.67%, and a fast online decision time of 0.0267 s per scenario.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究主动超对角可重构智能表面辅助异构移动边缘计算中的上行卸载与资源分配问题，重点考虑实际互易器件导致的跨扇区能量泄漏及其对能耗—时延权衡的影响。问题涉及卸载决策、CPU/GPU 计算分配、发射功率、接收处理和 RIS 配置的强耦合，是高维混合整数非凸优化问题。作者提出基于改进分布式软演员—评论家算法 DSAC-T 的端到端联合优化框架，通过建模回报分布而非仅估计期望回报来提升复杂场景下的决策能力。

articles.title: Rethinking Penetration Testing for AI-Enabled Systems: From Resource Compromise to Behavioral Objective Violation
articles.title_zh: 重新思考 AI 赋能系统的渗透测试：从资源攻陷到行为目标违背
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14006v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Penetration testing traditionally evaluates whether adversaries can exploit weaknesses in software, infrastructure, configurations, or operational controls to achieve security-relevant compromise. This paradigm remains necessary for AI-enabled systems, but it is no longer sufficient. In such systems, adversaries may influence prompts, retrieved content, sensor inputs, training data, memory, tools, or human-AI interaction loops to alter system behavior without directly compromising the underlying infrastructure. This paper reframes penetration testing for AI-enabled systems as objective-driven behavioral evaluation. We define an AI-enabled system as one in which learned models materially influence behavior affecting operational outcomes, and we define AI-enabled penetration as the feasible induction of AI-governed behavior that violates one or more operational objectives under an explicit threat model. This definition preserves conventional penetration testing while extending it to adversarial pathways such as prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, data poisoning, sensor manipulation, retrieval poisoning, tool misuse, and agentic misalignment. We further propose a testing workflow that identifies operational objectives, maps AI-governed behavior, analyzes adversarial influence surfaces, defines behavioral failure criteria, executes scenario-based tests, and reports evidence linking adversarial action to objective violation. A running example involving an AI-enabled security operations center assistant illustrates how penetration may occur through behavioral influence rather than infrastructure compromise. Together, the definitions, workflow, and example provide a technical framework for evaluating adversarial success in deployed AI-enabled systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，传统渗透测试关注软件、基础设施和配置被攻陷，在 AI 赋能系统中仍然必要但已不足够。作者将 AI 赋能系统的渗透测试重新定义为面向目标的行为评估，即在明确威胁模型下诱导由 AI 支配的系统行为违反一个或多个运行目标。该框架在保留传统渗透测试的同时，扩展到提示注入、间接提示注入、数据投毒、传感器操控、检索投毒、工具误用和智能体交互等对抗路径。
authors: Mohammad Allahbakhsh, Mohammad Hassan Bahari, Moslem Attar-Raouf

articles.title: Left-right asymmetry in predicting brain activity from LLMs' representations emerges with their formal linguistic competence
articles.title_zh: 从大语言模型表征预测脑活动中的左右不对称性随其形式语言能力而出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.12811v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: When humans and large language models (LLMs) process the same text, activations in the LLMs correlate with brain activity measured, e.g., with functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). Moreover, it has been shown that, as the training of an LLM progresses, the performance in predicting brain activity from its internal activations improves more in the left hemisphere than in the right one. The aim of the present work is to understand which kind of competence acquired by the LLMs underlies the emergence of this left-right asymmetry. Using the OLMo-2 7B language model at various training checkpoints and fMRI data from English participants, we compare the evolution of the left-right asymmetry in the correlation between brain activity and model predictions alongside performance on several benchmarks. We observe that the asymmetry co-emerges with the formal linguistic abilities of the LLM. These abilities are demonstrated in two ways: by the model's capacity to assign a higher probability to an acceptable sentence than to a grammatically unacceptable one within a minimal contrasting pair, and by its ability to produce well-formed text. By contrast, the left-right asymmetry does not align with the performance on arithmetic or Dyck language tasks; nor with text-based tasks involving world knowledge and reasoning. We generalize these results to another family of LLMs (Pythia) and two other languages, French and Chinese. Our observations indicate that the left-right asymmetry in brain predictivity matches the progress in formal linguistic competence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究大语言模型处理文本时的内部激活与人类 fMRI 脑活动之间的相关性，特别关注训练过程中左、右半球预测能力不对称性的出现机制。作者使用 OLMo-2 7B 不同训练检查点和英语被试 fMRI 数据，将左右不对称性变化与多项能力基准表现进行比较。结果显示，这种不对称性与模型形式语言能力共同出现，包括判断语法可接受性以及生成形式良好语言的能力。

articles.title: A Hybrid Source for Deterministic Generation of Atom-Photon Entangled States
articles.title_zh: 用于确定性产生原子—光子纠缠态的混合源
articles.abstract: In this work, we propose a scheme for the generation of atom--photon entangled states in a hybrid system comprising a ((ḩi⁽²⁾)) nonlinear medium and a multilevel atom, both embedded inside a cavity. Under appropriate tuning of the pump, cavity modes, and control-pulse frequencies, a pump photon is coherently down-converted into a single cavity photon while simultaneously exciting the atom, thereby generating a joint atom--photon excitation. In this setting, it is possible to generate an entangled state between the photon and the atom. By generating the excitation directly within the atomic system, importantly, this approach avoids the fundamental inefficiencies that arise when interfacing single photons with quantum memories. The nonlinear medium is driven by a pump pulse, while a control pulse transfers the atomic excitation to long-lived memory states. The properties of the emitted photon, particularly its central frequency, are determined by the interplay between the pump, control field, and cavity modes, providing the flexibility to tailor the emitted photon to existing quantum communication channels. Thus, the proposed scheme offers a promising route toward the realization of quantum repeater nodes in quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种在腔内结合二阶非线性介质与多能级原子的混合系统，用于生成原子—光子纠缠态。在适当调谐泵浦、腔模和控制脉冲频率时，泵浦光子可相干下转换为单个腔光子并同时激发原子，从而形成联合原子—光子激发。该方案直接在原子系统内产生激发，避免了单光子与量子存储器接口中的基本低效，并可通过泵浦、控制场和腔模调节发射光子的频率特性。

articles.title: Nociceptive Responses and Resting-State Functional Connectivity of the Human Midbrain Tegmentum
articles.title_zh: 人类中脑被盖的伤害感受反应与静息态功能连接
articles.abstract: (248/250 words) The rostromedial tegmental nucleus (RMTg) has been shown to inhibit midbrain dopaminergic centers through its GABAergic projections, and to be critical for regulating responses to aversive and rewarding stimuli. This nucleus has primarily been evaluated in rodents and non-human primates, while recent postmortem analysis of human brainstem tissue localized GABergic cell clusters in the putative RMTg. The objectives of this preliminary investigation in healthy controls (HC) were to (i) define RMTg function during evoked thermal stimulation and the resting-state using 7T functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), and (ii) explore the expression of putative RMTg markers, µ-opioid receptors (OPMR1), nociceptin receptors (NOPR), and FOXP1 as well as tyrosine hydroxylase (TH) in the midbrain tegmentum. Relative to 40°C stimuli, greater responses to 46°C (normally noxious) in the putative RMTg as well as raphe nuclei, locus coeruleus, substantia nigra, thalamus, putamen, and anterior cingulate were observed. Resting-state 7T fMRI showed robust RMTg functional connectivity with components of mesocorticolimbic and nigrostriatal circuitry, thalamus, hippocampus, and cerebellar subdivision. In postmortem analyses, neurons immunolabeled for OPMR1, NOPR, and FOXP1 were detected in an area adjacent to the decussation of the superior cerebellar peduncle. These immune-positive neurons in the area of the putative RMTg were adjacent to intense TH immunoreactivity. This investigation provides novel evidence of activation of a distinct area within the human midbrain tegmentum, putatively identified as the RMTg, particularly during nociceptive processing in addition to its resting-state connectivity with the broader central nervous system. Further exploration of the human RMTg is warranted.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本初步研究健康对照者中疑似吻内侧被盖核在热刺激和静息态下的功能，使用 7T 功能磁共振成像并结合脑组织标志物探索。相较于 40°C 刺激，46°C 通常伤害性热刺激在疑似 RMTg 及多个疼痛和奖惩相关脑区引发更强反应。静息态结果显示 RMTg 与中脑皮层边缘、多巴胺相关通路、丘脑、海马和小脑等区域存在功能连接，提示其可能参与人类厌恶、疼痛和奖赏调节网络。

articles.title: Exact Localized Information Capacity of a Local Observable in a Hilbert-Space-Shattered System
articles.title_zh: 希尔伯特空间破碎系统中局域可观测量的精确局域信息容量
articles.abstract: How many bits of information a local observable can retain forever is a sharp, operational measure of a system's memory, but it has been quantified only for many-body localization, where it rests on approximate integrals of motion, and for generic systems, where it is obtained numerically. Systems with strong Hilbert-space fragmentation possess an emphexact and complete commutant algebra, yet their memory has been characterized only through autocorrelation Mazur bounds or by counting protected qubits---never as an information capacity in bits. Here we define the localized information capacity of a local observable as the Holevo/mutual information its infinite-time-retained state carries about the initial state, and show that in a fragmented system it equals, in emphclosed form, the projection of the observable onto the commutant, Cuniv=sum_α[Tr(A P_α)]²/(D,Tr P_α). This value is Hamiltonian-independent and is a rigorous lower bound on the true infinite-time autocorrelation; the excess is non-universal dynamical memory, which we show grows under disorder. For the spin-1 dipole-conserving chain we derive the sector count in closed form from a finite transfer structure on sector boundary types---Pell-number growth, K_L=2PL₊₁-1sim(1+sqrt2)^L, the silver ratio; the capacity density provably converges, with the numerical value ḩiᵢₙfty=1.09(1) bits per site, and fragmentation nearly doubles the autocorrelation floor guaranteed by all polynomial multipole charges. For the t--J_z chain the capacity closes fully: exactly 2/3 bit per site, the particle density times one retained spin bit. We further show why the complete labelling of the retained bits resists strict locality: the height dynamics is a partially-commutative (trace) monoid whose natural complete invariant---computable by a strictly local sweep---is provably incomplete for the gated physical moves, the missing labels being frozen orderings that are precisely statistically localized data. Our results turn the memory of a shattered Hilbert space into an exact bit count and explain, from first principles, why its complete integrals of motion are statistically rather than sharply localized.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出用无限时间保留态关于初始态所携带的 Holevo 信息或互信息来定义局域可观测量的局域信息容量。作者证明，在具有强希尔伯特空间碎裂的系统中，该容量可由可观测量投影到对易代数上的闭式表达精确给出，并且与具体哈密顿量无关。该结果为无限时间自相关提供严格下界，同时将超出的部分解释为非普适的动力学记忆，并在自旋-1 偶极守恒链等模型中进一步分析其结构。

articles.title: An Embedded Model-Data Interactive Drive Method for Power System Dispatch
articles.title_zh: 面向电力系统调度的嵌入式模型—数据交互驱动方法
articles.abstract: Because high renewable penetration challenges power system flexibility, traditional model-driven dispatch faces severe computational bottlenecks from massive security constraints, whereas pure data-driven methods struggle with reliability and physical boundary violations. To resolve this problem, this paper proposes an embedded model‒data interactive framework for day‒ahead and intraday multistage economic dispatch. Innovatively, one-dimensional nodal sequences are mapped into two-dimensional multichannel image tensors to capture spatiotemporal coupling. A U-Net-based generative adversarial network (U-Net GAN), augmented with topology-preserving skip connections and a physics-informed loss function, learns the global power flow distributions. The U-Net GAN, which serves as a power flow surrogate model, is integrated into traditional scheduling models, replacing time-consuming cross-validation with millisecond-level inference, thereby enabling the identification and elimination of redundant constraints. Multiscale case studies confirm that this collaborative approach achieves a balance between scheduling efficiency, computational timeliness, and operational reliability while strictly ensuring physical safety boundaries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对高比例可再生能源接入下电力系统调度面临的灵活性与计算瓶颈问题，提出一种用于日前和日内多阶段经济调度的模型—数据交互框架。方法将一维节点序列映射为二维多通道图像张量，以捕获时空耦合，并采用带拓扑保持跳跃连接和物理信息损失的 U-Net GAN 学习全局潮流分布。该代理模型嵌入传统调度模型中，用毫秒级推理替代耗时校验，以识别并剔除冗余约束，在效率、时效性和运行可靠性之间取得平衡。

articles.title: The Spin Wavelength Electromagnetic Nonlocality (SWEN) Theory: A Spin-Geometry Framework for Orbital and Field Structures
articles.title_zh: 自旋波长电磁非局域性理论：轨道与场结构的自旋—几何框架
articles.abstract: This study examines how rotational states can generate density gradients and geometric structures across physical systems. An observationally motivated framework is developed in which gravitational acceleration is described through rotational parameters, particularly the spin period and the synchronous orbital scale, without explicit dependence on mass and the gravitational constant. Within this formulation, the synchronous orbital scale emerges as a geometric reference linking internal radial structure with external orbital configuration. The analysis suggests that rotational geometry may play a fundamental role in organizing scale-dependent structures in planetary and orbital systems. The framework further establishes a connection between rotational dynamics and electromagnetic field structures, providing a possible interpretation of how rotational configurations influence both mechanical and field-related properties. Extending this reinterpretation across hierarchical scales, the model explores how large-scale rotational structures associated with the central region of the Milky Way, including Sagittarius A*, may contribute to structural patterns spanning from galactic environments to microscopic domains. The resulting SWEN (Spin Wavelength Electromagnetic Nonlocality) framework offers a unified geometric perspective on rotation-driven organization across multiple physical scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出一种自旋波长电磁非局域性理论框架，探讨旋转状态如何在不同物理系统中产生密度梯度和几何结构。作者尝试用自旋周期和同步轨道尺度等旋转参数描述引力加速度，而不显式依赖质量和引力常数，并将同步轨道尺度视为连接内部径向结构与外部轨道构型的几何参照。该框架进一步讨论旋转动力学与电磁场结构之间的联系，并将其扩展到银河系中心等大尺度旋转结构的解释中；相关物理有效性仍需结合原文推导与实证检验。

articles.title: Real-Time FPGA-in-the-Loop Validation of a Sequential Eliminative Lévy Flight MPPT Method for Global Maximum Power Point Tracking under Partial Shading
articles.title_zh: 基于SELF的最大功率点跟踪方法在部分遮阴条件下的实时FPGA在环验证
articles.abstract: This paper proposes and validates, through FPGA-in-the-Loop (FIL) implementation, a Sequential Eliminative Lévy Flight (SELF)-based Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) controller for photovoltaic systems operating under partial shading conditions. The controller regulates a DC–DC boost converter to ensure operation at the global maximum power point (GMPP), even under rapidly changing irradiance. To enhance tracking performance, the algorithm employs a mode-switching strategy that adaptively balances exploration and exploitation using real-time indicators of particle dispersion and power variation. The method further integrates a deterministic SELF search process, an effective reinitialization mechanism, and simplified hardware-oriented velocity and position update equations. Implemented on an Artix-7 FPGA using a finite state machine and fixed-point arithmetic, the architecture exploits parallel processing to achieve fast convergence, high accuracy, and low latency with moderate hardware cost. Lévy-distributed random steps are generated from 16-bit LFSRs through a piecewise approximation technique. Real-time co-simulation using Vivado, MATLAB/Simulink, and VHDL confirms the effectiveness of the proposed approach, achieving about 98% tracking efficiency and a convergence time of 0.18 s under partial shading.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并通过FPGA-in-the-Loop方式验证了一种用于光伏系统的序贯淘汰式莱维飞行（SELF）最大功率点跟踪控制器。该控制器面向部分遮阴与快速辐照变化条件，通过模式切换、自适应探索—开发平衡以及重初始化机制，提高对全局最大功率点的搜索能力。其在Artix-7 FPGA上的实现表明，该方法具有较快收敛速度、较高精度和较低时延，并适合硬件部署。

articles.title: Continuous and sustainable electrosynthesis of free hydroxylamine enabled by a self-regenerative catalyst system
articles.title_zh: 自再生催化体系实现自由羟胺的连续可持续电合成
articles.abstract: Direct electrosynthesis of hydroxylamine (NH2OH) from nitrate offers a promising alternative for upgrading nitrogenous product in chemical industry. However, catalyst aging, especially in acidic media, remains a critical challenge due to the irreversible surface reconstruction under cathodic potentials, which limits long-term catalytic activity. Here, we develop an eco-efficient regenerative catalyst system that overcomes this durability bottleneck through a dynamic in situ catalyst self-repair strategy. By adding trace Bi3+ in solution, active metallic Bi nanofractals form on demand during electrolysis, delivering a 91.0% Faradaic efficiency for electrochemical HNO3-to-NH2OH conversion. Periodically switching to open-circuit potential fully resets the aged catalyst back into its ionic state without extra energy inputs. Leveraging this reversible Bi3+/Bi redox cycle, we demonstrate a continuous operation of HNO3-to-NH2OH conversion for 30 days, with a consistent product selectivity of over 90% and current density of ~ 0.4 A cm-2. This potential-driven regenerative strategy provides an efficient approach for sustainable synthesis of fine chemicals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种具有动态原位自修复能力的再生催化体系，用于从硝酸电合成羟胺。通过在溶液中加入微量Bi3+，电解过程中可按需生成活性金属Bi纳米结构，从而克服酸性条件下催化剂老化与表面重构带来的耐久性问题。研究还表明，周期性切换至开路电位可将老化催化剂恢复为离子态，实现长时间连续运行并保持较高选择性。

articles.title: Testing the Anelastic Convective Entity Model against a Cloud-Resolving Model for a Case of Elevated Convection
articles.title_zh: 将无粘性对流实体模型与云分辨模型用于高空对流个例的对比检验
articles.abstract: Convection initiation under strong convective inhibition (CIN) is examined using the Anelastic Convective Entity (ACE) model--a potential candidate for representing convective processes in global models--and compared against a cloud-resolving model (the Vector Vorticity Model or VVM). Results here illustrate deviations from parcel-theory based expectations. Both models produce precipitation even with weak initial vertical velocity (w), highlighting effects of nonlocal perturbation pressure and the adaptability of the updraft to induce inflow from unstable layers. For a near-surface initial perturbation of kilometer-scale horizontal dimension, a comparable depth of vertical velocity develops almost instantly due to the pressure-mediated nonlocal acceleration. Even for surface initial perturbations, convection initiates near the top of the inversion layer, due to the adaptive entrainment from conditionally unstable heights. Once (w) exceeds a certain threshold, which is substantially lower than anticipated by surface-initiated parcel theory, the timing and intensity of precipitation remain largely unchanged. This illustrates that overcoming conventional CIN is not the primary limiting factor for convection. Corresponding experiments in Superparameterized Community Atmosphere Model (SPCAM) show analogous behavior in sub-GCM-grid CRMs but compare less well with the VVM experiments than ACE. A reduced-humidity experiment with VVM further exhibits convection initiated by buoyancy oscillations interacting with the adaptive inflow, even for a near-surface initial perturbation, which both ACE and SPCAM/embedded CRMs struggle to capture. Overall, however, these findings suggest that elevated convection might be better represented in global models if traditional parcel-based parameterizations were replaced with time-dependent representations that inherently include nonlocal pressure-mediated effects and adaptive inflow.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用无粘性对流实体（ACE）模型并与云分辨模型VVM对比，研究强对流抑制条件下的对流触发机制。结果表明，即使初始垂直速度较弱，也可能在非局地压力扰动和上升气流自适应进气的作用下产生降水。研究显示，突破传统基于气块理论的对流抑制阈值并非唯一关键限制因素，非局地动力过程同样重要。

articles.title: Downscaling Without Deletion: Disentangling Synaptic Downscaling from Glymphatic Waste Clearance in NREM Sleep — A Two-Process Model
articles.title_zh: 无需删除的下调：区分NREM睡眠中的突触下调与类淋巴废物清除——双过程模型
articles.abstract: The Synaptic Homeostasis Hypothesis (SHY) correctly identified that NREM sleep triggers proportional synaptic downscaling — but this core insight has been widely misinterpreted as evidence for “synaptic pruning” (deletion). This paper extends SHY by formally distinguishing two functionally independent processes that are conflated under the pruning umbrella: (P1) reversible synaptic downscaling — AMPA receptor endocytosis, spine shrinkage, proportional strength reduction ; and (P2) glymphatic clearance — AQP4-gated convective flushing of metabolic waste from the perisynaptic space. We demonstrate that key evidence cited for pruning can be reinterpreted under the P1+P2 model without additional entities, and propose falsifiable predictions (2×2 factorial AQP4/Homer1a manipulation). P1-downscaled spines enter a metastable state (P3: Metastable Downscaled State, MDS) characterized by AMPAR internalization with retained PSD scaffold, with an estimated 24-48 hour time window before probabilistic commitment toward re-expansion or irreversible degeneration. Spine fate in this window depends on P2 clearance efficacy. We discuss a major potential counter-evidence — the absence of widespread spine loss in AQP4 knockout models — noting this may reflect a measurement gap (most AQP4 studies did not perform longitudinal spine tracking) rather than falsification of the model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对突触稳态假说进行扩展，正式区分了NREM睡眠中常被混淆的两种独立过程：可逆的突触下调与类淋巴系统介导的代谢废物清除。作者指出，许多被解释为“突触修剪”的证据，也可在这两个过程并行的框架下得到说明。文中进一步提出了可检验预测，并讨论了下调后棘突的亚稳态及其后续命运可能受清除效率影响。
